UBERON:0005594.name: head somite
UBERON:0005594.def: Somite located in the head region, caudal to the otic vesicle.

UBERON:0005597.name: lung primordium
UBERON:0005597.def: A pair of lateral diverticula just over the liver rudiment representing the primordia of the lungs, formed by the floor of the foregut just anterior to the liver diverticulum.

UBERON:0005598.name: trunk somite
UBERON:0005598.def: A somite that is part of a trunk.

UBERON:0005600.name: crus commune
UBERON:0005600.def: A region formed by non-ampulated ends of posterior and superior semicircular canals of vestibular apparatus in inner ear.

UBERON:0005601.name: dorsal mesocardium
UBERON:0005601.def: The part of the mesocardium dorsal to the embryonic heart; it breaks down to form the transverse sinus of the pericardium.

UBERON:0005602.name: dorsal mesogastrium
UBERON:0005602.def: The portion of mesentery attached to the greater curvature of the stomach is named the dorsal mesentery (or dorsal mesogastrium, when referring to the portion at the stomach), and the part which suspends the colon is termed the mesocolon. The dorsal mesogastrium develops into the greater omentum.

UBERON:0005604.name: extrahepatic part of hepatic duct
synonym: extrahepatic part of the hepatic duct

UBERON:0005605.name: intrahepatic part of hepatic duct
synonym: intrahepatic part of the hepatic duct

UBERON:0005608.name: hyoid artery
UBERON:0005608.def: The second arch becomes the hyoid artery, which is prominent in early development and normally persists as the caroticotympanic branch of the ICA[Padget].

UBERON:0005609.name: iliac artery
UBERON:0005609.def: Any of the arteries that arise from a bifurcation of the aorta supplying the pelvic or abdomen. Examples: Common iliac artery, External iliac artery, Internal iliac artery.

UBERON:0005610.name: iliac vein
UBERON:0005610.def: Any of the three veins including the common, external and internal iliac veins.

UBERON:0005611.name: inner canthus
UBERON:0005611.def: A corner of the medial (inner) part of an eye.

UBERON:0005612.name: intercostal artery
UBERON:0005612.def: One of a group of arteries that supply the area between the ribs ('costae'), called the intercostal space.

UBERON:0005614.name: lens anterior epithelium
UBERON:0005614.def: A layer of cuboidal epithelial cells bounded anteriorly by the capsule of the lens and posteriorly by the lens cortex.

UBERON:0005616.name: mesenteric artery
UBERON:0005616.def: Arteries which arise from the abdominal aorta and distribute to most of the intestines.

UBERON:0005617.name: mesenteric vein
UBERON:0005617.def: A vein that returns blood from the intestines.

UBERON:0005619.name: secondary palatal shelf
UBERON:0005619.def: The outgrowths of the embryonic maxillary prominences that come together during prenatal development to form the secondary palate.

UBERON:0005620.name: primary palate
UBERON:0005620.def: The part of the palate formed from the intermaxillary segment.

UBERON:0005621.name: rhomboid
UBERON:0005621.def: A rhombus-shaped muscle associated with the scapula and chiefly responsible for its retraction. There are two rhomboid muscles.

UBERON:0005623.name: semi-lunar valve
UBERON:0005623.def: The valves that gate the flow of blood from the ventricles into the aorta and pulmonary trunk.

UBERON:0005624.name: suprarenal artery
UBERON:0005624.def: Artery that supplies blood to the adrenal glands.

UBERON:0005625.name: tubotympanic recess lumen
UBERON:0005625.def: The cavity formed by the tubotympanic recess epithelium.

UBERON:0005626.name: ventral mesogastrium
UBERON:0005626.def: Portion of ventral mesentery closest to the stomach.

UBERON:0005628.name: ileal artery
UBERON:0005628.def: The ileal arteries feed oxygenated blood into the ileum, a portion of the small intestine in mammals, reptiles, and birds. They are branches of the superior mesenteric artery.
synonym: ileal branch of superior mesenteric artery

UBERON:0005629.name: vascular plexus
UBERON:0005629.def: A vascular network formed by frequent anastomoses between the blood vessels (arteries or veins) of a part.

UBERON:0005630.name: fetal membrane
UBERON:0005630.def: The amnion and chorion which surround and protect a developing fetus.

UBERON:0005631.name: extraembryonic membrane
UBERON:0005631.def: Intrinsic membrane that arises from embryonic germ layers and grow to surround the developing embryo.

UBERON:0005711.def: A mesentery of duodenum that is part of a foregut.

UBERON:0005712.name: midgut duodenum mesentery
UBERON:0005712.def: A mesentery of duodenum that is part of a midgut.

UBERON:0005719.name: footplate apical ectodermal ridge
UBERON:0005719.def: An apical ectodermal ridge that is part of a footplate.

UBERON:0005720.name: hindbrain venous system
UBERON:0005720.def: A venous system that is part of a hindbrain.

UBERON:0005721.name: pronephric mesoderm
UBERON:0005721.def: A mesoderm that has the potential to develop into a pronephros.

UBERON:0005722.name: obsolete nephrotome
UBERON:0005722.def: The nephrotome is a section of the mesoderm. It gives rise to the pronephros and eventually to the rest of the kidney. A nephrotome is an obsolete term used to describe rounded mesodermal portions of the forming pronephros. In old texts the pronephros is described as forming through the fusion of multiple nephrotomes. Modern visualization methods such as scanning electron microscopy, in situ hybridization and confocal microscopy, combined with the simple approach of peeling off the epidermis to see the forming kidney, have shown that this is not the case. Nephric mesenchyme separates from the intermediate mesoderm as a single elongated primordia. As this primordia begins to undergo epithelialization the anterior portions of the pronephros form rounded protrusions, which then later become the dorsal branches of the pronephros that link to nephrostomes (distinct from nephrotomes). These rounded bumps are probably the structures observed in histological sections that are referred to as nephrotomes. Nephrostomes are thin ciliated funnels that link pronephric nephrons to the ceolom, and are not related to nephrotomes.

UBERON:0005723.name: floor plate spinal cord region
UBERON:0005723.def: A multi-tissue structure that is part of a spinal cord and is part of a floor plate.

UBERON:0005724.name: roof plate spinal cord region
UBERON:0005724.def: A tissue that is part of a spinal cord and is part of a roof plate.

UBERON:0005725.name: olfactory system
UBERON:0005725.def: A sensory system that is capable of olfaction (the sensory perception of smell).

UBERON:0005727.name: obsolete somitomere
UBERON:0005727.def: Obsoleted definition: In the developing vertebrate embryo, the somitomeres are loose masses of paraxial mesoderm derived cells that form along each side of the neural tube towards the end of the third gestational week. The approximately 50 pairs of somitomeres begin developing in the cranial (head) region, continuing in a caudal (tail) direction until the end of week four[WP].

UBERON:0005729.name: pectoral appendage field
UBERON:0005729.def: A limb/fin field that has the potential to develop into a pectoral appendage bud mesenchyme.
synonym: pectoral appendage field of lateral plate mesoderm

UBERON:0005730.name: pelvic appendage field
UBERON:0005730.def: A limb/fin field that has the potential to develop into a pelvic appendage bud mesenchyme.
synonym: pelvic appendage field of lateral plate mesoderm

UBERON:0005731.name: fin field
UBERON:0005731.def: A limb/fin field that has_potential_to_developmentally_contribute_to a paired fin bud.
UBERON:0005731.synonym: fin field of lateral plate mesoderm

UBERON:0005732.name: paired limb/fin field
UBERON:0005732.def: A ring of cells capable of forming a limb or paired fin[Gilbert,modified].
synonym: limb/fin field of lateral plate mesoderm

UBERON:0005733.name: limb field
UBERON:0005733.def: A ring of cells capable of forming a limb.
UBERON:0005733.synonym: limb field of lateral plate mesoderm

UBERON:0005734.name: tunica adventitia of blood vessel
UBERON:0005734.def: The outermost layer of a blood vessel, composed mainly of fibrous tissue.

UBERON:0005737.name: swim bladder tunica externa
UBERON:0005737.def: Multi-tissue structure that is the external layer of the swim bladder that is covered by the peritoneum, and made of elastic fibres and ichthyocol (short needles of collagen).

UBERON:0005738.name: swim bladder tunica interna
UBERON:0005738.def: Multi-tissue structure that is the internal layer of the swim bladder and is comprised of thin endoderm and a smooth muscle layer called the muscularis mucosa with longitudinal and circular fibres with some collagen.

UBERON:0005740.name: tunica intima of artery
UBERON:0005740.def: A tunica intima that is part of a artery.

UBERON:0005742.name: adventitia
UBERON:0005742.def: An outermost connective tissue covering of an organ, vessel, or other structure[WP].

UBERON:0005743.name: obsolete central nervous system plus retina

UBERON:0005744.name: bone foramen
UBERON:0005744.def: Anatomical space that is an opening in a bone, usually for passage of blood vessels or nerves.

UBERON:0005745.name: optic foramen
UBERON:0005745.def: An opening in the skull through which cranial nerve II passes.[MP].

UBERON:0005746.name: primary vitreous
UBERON:0005746.def: Embryonic fibrovascular mesodermal tissue located between the optic cup and lens vesicle that normally regresses during the development of the vitreous body[MP].

UBERON:0005749.name: glomerular tuft
UBERON:0005749.def: The capillary loops of the kidney that normally function as a filtration unit[MP].

UBERON:0005750.name: glomerular parietal epithelium
UBERON:0005750.def: A single layer of simple squamous epithelium in the glomerular capsule. Does not function in filtration[UBERON]. outer layer of the glomerular capsule composed of a single layer of simple squamous epithelium[MP].

UBERON:0005751.name: glomerular visceral epithelium
UBERON:0005751.def: The inner (visceral) layer of the renal glomerular capsule, overlying the capillaries, composed of podocytes, and separated from the outer (parietal) layer by the capsular (Bowman's) space[BTO]. This epithelial layer is superficially adjacent to the thickened glomerular basement membrane and is made of podocytes. Beneath the visceral layer lie the glomerular capillaries[WP]. This inner epithelial layer of the glomerular capsule surrounds the capillary endothelial cells and is composed of highly specialized epithelial cells (podocytes) that are separated by filtration slits; the inner visceral layer is separated from the outer parietal layer by the urinary space (also known as the Bowman's or capsular space)[MP].
synonym: inner epithelial layer of Bowman's capsule

UBERON:0005753.name: caudal part of nephrogenic cord
UBERON:0005753.def: The metanephros develops from the most caudal part of the nephrogenic cord that is itself derived from the intermediate plate mesoderm.

UBERON:0005754.name: rostral part of nephrogenic cord
UBERON:0005754.def: The initial renal anlage that develops from the most rostral part of the nephrogenic cord is termed the pronephros.

UBERON:0005760.name: urorectal septum
UBERON:0005760.def: The ridge of mesoderm covered with endoderm that in the early developing embryo partitions the endodermal cloaca into the primary urogenital sinus (ventrally) and the anorectal canal of the hindgut (dorsally); the urorectal septum eventually fuses with the cloacal membrane, dividing it into a dorsal anal membrane and a larger ventral urogenital membrane - this area of fusion is represented in the adult by the perineal body[MP].

UBERON:0005764.name: acellular membrane
UBERON:0005764.def: An acellular anatomical structure that is the bounding layer of a anatomical structure.

UBERON:0005769.name: basement membrane of epithelium
UBERON:0005769.def: An acellular membrane that is part of the epithelium, lies adjacent to the epithelial cells, and is the fusion of the the basal lamina and the reticular lamina.

UBERON:0005777.name: glomerular basement membrane
UBERON:0005777.def: The layer of extracellular matrix that lies between the endothelium of the glomerular capillaries and the podocytes of the inner or visceral layer of the Bowman capsule; it is a fusion of the endothelial cell and podocyte basal laminas and acts as a physical barrier and an ion-selective filter.

UBERON:0005787.name: lamina densa of glomerular basement membrane
UBERON:0005787.def: Middle layer of the glomerular basement membrane.
synonym: lamina densa of glomerular basement membrane
middle layer of glomerular basement membrane

UBERON:0005788.name: lamina rara interna
UBERON:0005788.def: Layer of the glomerular basement membrane adjacent to the glomerular capillary.
synonym: internal layer of glomerular basement membrane
lamina interna of glomerular basement membrane

UBERON:0005789.name: lamina rara externa
UBERON:0005789.def: Layer of the glomerular basement membrane adjacent to the podocytes and capsular space.
synonym: external layer of glomerular basement membrane
lamina externa of glomerular basement membrane

UBERON:0005792.name: nephric ridge
UBERON:0005792.def: Nephric tubules (nephrons) form embryonically along the nephric ridge. The ridge comprises three regions; anterior, middle and posterior. The functional kidney uses nephrons from only one or two regions of the ridge. A pronephric kidney uses only the nephrons from the anterior region of the ridge. A mesonephric kidney uses only the middle region, a metanephric kidney uses only the posterior region and an opisthonephric kidney uses the middle and posterior regions.

UBERON:0005796.name: duplex uterus
UBERON:0005796.def: The duplex uterus is doubled, and is found in monotremes, marsupials, elephants and rodents.

UBERON:0005797.name: bipartite uterus
UBERON:0005797.def: The bipartite uterus is y-shaped externally and divided internally (ungulates, carnivores).

UBERON:0005798.name: bicornuate uterus
UBERON:0005798.def: The bicornate uterus is y-shaped but has no internal partition (some ungulates, whales).

UBERON:0005799.name: simplex uterus
UBERON:0005799.def: The simplex uterus has only one uterine chamber (primates).

UBERON:0005800.name: section of aorta
UBERON:0005800.def: Any portion of the aorta including the ascending and descending aorta, and aortic arch or a portion of the aortic orifice of the left ventricle.

UBERON:0005805.name: dorsal aorta
UBERON:0005805.def: The dorsal aorta is a blood vessel in a single-pass circulatory system that carries oxygenated blood from the gills to the rest of the body. In a single-pass circulatory system blood passes once through the heart to supply the body once.

UBERON:0005806.name: portal system
UBERON:0005806.def: In the circulatory system of animals, a portal venous system occurs when a capillary bed drains into another capillary bed through veins, without first going through the heart. Both capillary beds and the blood vessels that connect them are considered part of the portal venous system. They are relatively uncommon as the majority of capillary beds drain into veins which then drain into the heart, not into another capillary bed. Portal venous systems are considered venous because the blood vessels that join the two capillary beds are either veins or venules. Examples of such systems include the hepatic portal system and the hypophyseal portal system. Unqualified, 'portal venous system' often refers to the hepatic portal system. For this reason, 'portal vein' most commonly refers to the hepatic portal vein[WP].

UBERON:0005807.name: rostral ventrolateral medulla
UBERON:0005807.def: Control of blood pressure is crucially dependent on the integrity of a small region of the brainstem called the ventrolateral medulla. Within this part of the brain are the cells that control the heart, blood vessels, swallowing, breathing and many other functions of the body that are not noticed at a conscious level; such unconscious activities are known as 'Autonomic'. One of these regions is the Rostral Ventrolateral Medulla (RVLM) is also known as the pressor area of the medulla (medulla pressor). It receives inhibitory GABAergic input from the caudal ventrolateral medulla (CVLM). The RVLM is the primary regulator of the sympathetic nervous system, sending excitatory fibers (catecholaminergic) to the sympathetic preganglionic neurons in the spinal cord, via reticulospinal tract[WP].

UBERON:0005808.name: bone tissue of long bone
UBERON:0005808.def: A bone tissue that is part of a long bone.

UBERON:0005809.name: cortex of manus bone
UBERON:0005809.def: The outer or sperficial part of a bone of the manus.

UBERON:0005810.name: cervical vertebra 1 anterior tubercle
UBERON:0005810.def: The conical ventral projection on the arch of the atlas.
synonym: tubercle of anterior arch of atlas

UBERON:0005813.name: tubercle
UBERON:0005813.def: A round nodule, small eminence, or warty outgrowth on an anatomical surface, such as bones, skin, or within the lungs (in the case of tuberculosis). They are also found on the leading edge of Humpback Whale's flippers, improving fluid flow over the flipper's surface[WP].

UBERON:0005814.name: arch of atlas
UBERON:0005814.def: A vertebral arch that is part of the first cervical vertebra.

UBERON:0005815.name: anterior tubercle of transverse process of cervical vertebra
UBERON:0005815.def: The anterior arch forms about one-fifth of the ring: its anterior surface is convex, and presents at its center the anterior tubercle for the attachment of the Longus colli muscles.
synonym: anterior costal tubercle of transverse process of cervical vertebra

UBERON:0005816.name: posterior tubercle of transverse process of cervical vertebra
UBERON:0005816.def: The posterior arch of a cervical vertebra forms about two-fifths of the circumference of the ring: it ends behind in the posterior tubercle, which is the rudiment of a spinous process and gives origin to the Recti capitis posteriores minores. The diminutive size of this process prevents any interference with the movements between the atlas and the skull.
synonym: posterior costal tubercle of transverse process of cervical vertebra

UBERON:0005817.name: neuraxis flexure
UBERON:0005817.def: An anatomical structure that is regional part of the central nervous system where there is a significant bend of the axis.

UBERON:0005818.name: cephalic midbrain flexure
UBERON:0005818.def: A sharp, ventrally concave bend in the developing midbrain of the embryo[MP].

UBERON:0005819.name: cervical flexure
UBERON:0005819.def: A ventrally concave flexure of the embryonic brain occurring at the junction of hindbrain and spinal cord[MP].

UBERON:0005820.name: pontine flexure
UBERON:0005820.def: A dorsally concave bend of the embryonic rhombencephalon that produces a thinning of the roof of the pons and medulla oblongata and defines the boundary between the metencephalon and myelencephalon in the embryo[MP].

UBERON:0005821.name: gracile fasciculus
UBERON:0005821.def: A group of axons that are from neurons involved in proprioception from the lower trunk and lower limb[GO]. The fasciculus gracilis (tract of Goll) is a bundle of axon fibres in the dorsomedial spinal cord that carries information about fine touch, vibrations, and conscious proprioception from the lower part of the body to the brain stem. It is part of the posterior column of the spinal cord, which also contains the fasciculus cuneatus, which carries the same information from the upper part of the body. This tract and its continuation in the brain stem is often referred to as the posterior column-medial lemniscus pathway. The fasciculus gracilis is wedge-shaped on transverse section and lies next the posterior median septum, its base being at the surface of the medulla spinalis, and its apex directed toward the posterior gray commissure. It increases in size from below upward, and consists of long thin fibers that are derived from the posterior nerve roots, and ascend as far as the medulla oblongata, where they end in the nucleus gracilis. The tract of Goll was named after Swiss neuroanatomist Friedrich Goll[WP].

UBERON:0005826.name: gracile fasciculus of spinal cord
UBERON:0005826.def: A gracile fasciculus that is part of a spinal cord.
synonym: spinal cord segment of fasciculus gracilis
spinal cord segment of gracile fasciculus

UBERON:0005832.name: cuneate fasciculus
UBERON:0005832.def: An axon tract in the spinal cord and medulla which primarily transmits information from the forelimb and trunk. It is part of the dorsal column-medial lemniscus pathway.

UBERON:0005835.name: cuneate fasciculus of spinal cord
UBERON:0005835.def: An axon tract in the spinal cord which primarily transmits information from the forelimb and trunk. It is part of the posterior column-medial lemniscus pathway.

UBERON:0005837.name: fasciculus of spinal cord
UBERON:0005837.def: A fascicle that is part of a spinal cord.

UBERON:0005838.name: fasciculus of brain
UBERON:0005838.def: A fascicle that is part of a brain.

UBERON:0005839.name: thoracic spinal cord dorsal column
UBERON:0005839.def: A subdivision of spinal cord dorsal column that is part of a thoracic spinal cord.
synonym: dorsal funiculus of thoracic segment of spinal cord
dorsal white column of thoracic segment of spinal cord
thoracic segment of dorsal funiculus of spinal cord

UBERON:0005840.name: sacral spinal cord dorsal column
UBERON:0005840.def: A subdivision of spinal cord dorsal column that is part of a sacral spinal cord.
synonym: sacral subsegment of dorsal funiculus of spinal cord

UBERON:0005841.name: cervical spinal cord dorsal column
UBERON:0005841.def: A subdivision of spinal cord dorsal column that is part of a cervical spinal cord.
synonym: cervical segment of dorsal funiculus of spinal cord
dorsal funiculus of cervical segment of spinal cord
dorsal white column of cervical segment of spinal cord

UBERON:0005842.name: lumbar spinal cord dorsal column
UBERON:0005842.def: A subdivision of spinal cord dorsal column that is part of a lumbar spinal cord.
synonym: dorsal funiculus of lumbar segment of spinal cord
dorsal white column of lumbar segment of spinal cord
lumbar segment of dorsal funiculus of spinal cord
lumbar segment of gracile fasciculus of spinal cord

UBERON:0005843.name: sacral spinal cord
UBERON:0005843.def: A spinal cord segment that adjacent_to a sacral region.

UBERON:0005844.name: spinal cord segment
synonym: axial regional part of spinal cord

UBERON:0005845.name: caudal segment of spinal cord
UBERON:0005845.def: A spinal cord segment that adjacent_to a caudal region.

UBERON:0005847.name: thoracic spinal cord lateral column
UBERON:0005847.def: A subdivision of spinal cord lateral column that is part of a thoracic spinal cord.

UBERON:0005848.name: sacral spinal cord lateral column
UBERON:0005848.def: A subdivision of spinal cord lateral column that is part of a sacral spinal cord.

UBERON:0005849.name: cervical spinal cord lateral column
UBERON:0005849.def: A subdivision of spinal cord lateral column that is part of a cervical spinal cord.

UBERON:0005850.name: lumbar spinal cord lateral column
UBERON:0005850.def: A subdivision of spinal cord lateral column that is part of a lumbar spinal cord.

UBERON:0005852.name: thoracic spinal cord ventral column
UBERON:0005852.def: A subdivision of spinal cord ventral column that is part of a thoracic spinal cord.

UBERON:0005853.name: sacral spinal cord ventral column
UBERON:0005853.def: A subdivision of spinal cord ventral column that is part of a sacral spinal cord.

UBERON:0005854.name: cervical spinal cord ventral column
UBERON:0005854.def: A subdivision of spinal cord ventral column that is part of a cervical spinal cord.

UBERON:0005855.name: lumbar spinal cord ventral column
UBERON:0005855.def: A subdivision of spinal cord ventral column that is part of a lumbar spinal cord.

UBERON:0005856.name: developing mesenchymal condensation
UBERON:0005856.def: A delimited region of dense mesenchyme within looser mesenchyme.

UBERON:0005863.name: cartilaginous condensation
UBERON:0005863.def: Cell condensation that is an aggregation of mesenchymal cells that are committed to differentiate into chondroblasts and chondrocytes.

UBERON:0005866.name: pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0005866.def: A delimited region of dense mesenchyme within looser mesenchyme whose cells are committed to become chondroblasts.

UBERON:0005867.name: mandibular prominence
UBERON:0005867.def: The paired ventral prominences formed by bifurcation of the first pharyngeal arches in the embryo; the two prominences unite ventrally and fuse to form the mandible and lower lip.

UBERON:0005868.name: maxillary prominence
UBERON:0005868.def: The paired dorsal prominences formed by bifurcation of the first pharyngeal arches in the embryo that unite with the ipsilateral medial nasal process to form the upper jaw.

UBERON:0005869.name: maxillary process of inferior nasal concha
UBERON:0005869.def: From the lower border of the inferior nasal concha, a thin lamina, the maxillary process, curves downward and lateralward; it articulates with the maxilla and forms a part of the medial wall of the maxillary sinus.
synonym: maxillary process of inferior nasal turbinate

UBERON:0005870.name: olfactory pit
UBERON:0005870.def: An indentation of the olfactory placode which ends when the pits hollows out to form the nasopharynx[GO].

UBERON:0005871.name: palatine process of maxilla
UBERON:0005871.def: A thick, horizontal process of the maxilla. It forms the anterior three quarters of the hard palate, the horizontal plate of the palatine bone making up the rest.

UBERON:0005872.name: 1st arch pharyngeal cleft
UBERON:0005872.def: A groove that is situated between the 1st and 2nd pharyngeal arch.

UBERON:0005873.name: 2nd arch pharyngeal cleft
UBERON:0005873.def: A groove that is situated between the 2nd and 3rd pharyngeal arch.

UBERON:0005874.name: 3rd arch pharyngeal cleft
UBERON:0005874.def: A groove that is situated between the 3rd and 4th pharyngeal arch.

UBERON:0005875.name: 4th arch pharyngeal cleft
UBERON:0005875.def: A groove that is situated between the 4th and 5th pharyngeal arch.

UBERON:0005876.name: undifferentiated genital tubercle
UBERON:0005876.def: The embryonic anlage of the external genitalia, which emerges as paired swellings ventral to the cloacal membrane, is proposed to be derived from all three germ layers, and gives rise to the penis, clitoris, scrotum, labia, and foreskin.

UBERON:0005879.name: pharyngeal cleft
UBERON:0005879.def: An external pocketing of pharyngeal ectoderm that contacts a region of endoderm (a pharyngeal pouch) and interdigitates in the anterior and posterior directions by the pharyngeal arches.

UBERON:0005880.name: prepollex
UBERON:0005880.def: A rudimentary additional digit-like structure on the preaxial side of the thumb of certain amphibians and mammals[dictionary.com].

UBERON:0005881.name: autopodial extension
UBERON:0005881.def: A subdivision of the autopod that corresponds to one or more bones arranged in series branching from the main limb axis.

UBERON:0005882.name: neural tube alar plate
UBERON:0005882.def: The mantle layer of the neural tube that lies dorsal to the sulcus limitans and contains primarily sensory neurons and interneurons involved in communication of sensory impulses.

UBERON:0005883.name: neural tube lateral wall mantle layer

UBERON:0005884.name: hyoid arch skeleton
UBERON:0005884.def: A subdivision of skeleton that supports pharyngeal arch 2.

UBERON:0005886.name: post-hyoid pharyngeal arch skeleton
UBERON:0005886.def: The part of the pharyngeal arch skeleton that excludes the skeleton of arches 1 and 2.

UBERON:0005891.name: coelomic epithelium
UBERON:0005891.def: The epithelial lining of the surface of the coelom.

UBERON:0005892.name: mesonephric early distal tubule
UBERON:0005892.def: The mesonephric equivalent of the ascending limb, or straight distal segment, of metanephric nephrons.

UBERON:0005893.name: leg bone
UBERON:0005893.def: A bone that is part of the region of the hindlimb that includes the zeugopod and stylopod. Examples: patella, femur, tibia. Counter-examples: any pes phalanx.

UBERON:0005894.name: obsolete locomotive weight-bearing appendage
UBERON:0005894.def: OBSOLETE: A leg is a limb on which an animal walks and stands (GO:0035110).

UBERON:0005895.name: insect leg
UBERON:0005895.def: The walking appendages of each segment of the ventral adult external thorax[FBbt]. A leg derived from an imaginal disc[GO].

UBERON:0005896.name: obsolete jointed/prehensile appendage
UBERON:0005896.def: A jointed or prehensible appendage used for locomotion or manipulation. Examples: human arm, human leg, octopus tentacle, insect limb[Wikipedia]. A limb is an appendage of an animal used for locomotion or grasping. For example a leg, arm or some types of fin[GO].

UBERON:0005897.name: manus bone
UBERON:0005897.def: A bone that is part of the manus skeleton. Note that this includes the carpal bones.

UBERON:0005899.name: pes bone
UBERON:0005899.def: A bone that is part of the pes skeleton.
synonym: bone of foor proper or tarsal skeleton

UBERON:0005902.name: occipital region
UBERON:0005902.def: Anatomical cluster that is located in the posterior region of the cranium and forms the margin of the foramen magnum and occipital condyles.

UBERON:0005903.name: duct of seminal vesicle
UBERON:0005903.def: Each seminal vesicle consists of a single tube, coiled upon itself, and giving off several irregular cecal diverticula; the separate coils, as well as the diverticula, are connected together by fibrous tissue. When uncoiled, the tube is about the diameter of a quill, and varies in length from 10 to 15 cm.; it ends posteriorly in a cul-de-sac; its anterior extremity becomes constricted into a narrow straight duct called the excretory duct of seminal gland (or duct of the seminal vesicle), which joins with the corresponding ductus deferens to form the ejaculatory duct[WP].

UBERON:0005904.name: duct of male reproductive system
UBERON:0005904.def: Any of the ducts that are part of a male reproductive system.

UBERON:0005906.name: serous sac
UBERON:0005906.def: Organ with organ cavity, which has as parts a serous membrane and a serous cavity . Examples: pleural sac, pericardial sac, tendon sheath, bursa.[FMA].

UBERON:0005908.name: conjunctival sac
UBERON:0005908.def: A serous sac which is the aggregate of the conjunctiva plus the conjunctival space.

UBERON:0005911.name: endo-epithelium
UBERON:0005911.def: Epithelium that derives from the endoderm. Examples: urothelium, transitional epithelium of ureter, epithelium of prostatic gland.[FMA].

UBERON:0005912.name: transitional epithelium of major calyx
UBERON:0005912.def: An urothelium of ureter that is part of a mucosa of major calyx.

UBERON:0005919.name: supreme nasal concha
UBERON:0005919.def: A thin bony plate occasionally found projecting from the inner wall of the ethmoid labyrinth, above the bony superior nasal concha, and the mucous membrane covering the plate.

UBERON:0005920.name: superior nasal concha
UBERON:0005920.def: The back part of the medial surface of the labyrinth of ethmoid is subdivided by a narrow oblique fissure, the superior meatus of the nose, bounded above by a thin, curved plate, the superior nasal concha. The bone found in superior nasal concha is part of the ethmoid bone.

UBERON:0005921.name: middle nasal concha
UBERON:0005921.def: The medial surface of the labyrinth of ethmoid consists of a thin lamella, which descends from the under surface of the cribriform plate, and ends below in a free, convoluted margin, the middle nasal concha. It is rough, and marked above by numerous grooves, directed nearly vertically downward from the cribriform plate; they lodge branches of the olfactory nerves, which are distributed to the mucous membrane covering the superior nasal concha.

UBERON:0005922.name: inferior nasal concha
UBERON:0005922.def: A turbinal located on the maxilla bone.

UBERON:0005925.name: ethmoidal process of inferior nasal concha
UBERON:0005925.def: Behind the lacrimal process of the inferior nasal conchae lies a broad, thin plate, the ethmoidal process, which ascends to join the uncinate process of the ethmoid; from its lower border a thin lamina, the maxillary process, curves downward and lateralward; it articulates with the maxilla and forms a part of the medial wall of the maxillary sinus.
synonym: ethmoidal process of inferior nasal turbinate

UBERON:0005928.name: external naris
UBERON:0005928.def: A naris that provides one of the small external openings of the head that give passage to air for breathing.

UBERON:0005931.name: primary choana
UBERON:0005931.def: Initial opening of the nasal pits and olfactory sac of the embryo into the rostral part of the primordial oronasal cavity, before the formation of the secondary palate.

UBERON:0005932.name: bulb of hair follicle
UBERON:0005932.def: Thickening of the proximal end of the hair follicle. Contains rapidly proliferating, rather undifferentiated matrix cells (transient amplifying cells), melanocytes and outer root sheath cells.

UBERON:0005941.name: hair inner root sheath
UBERON:0005941.def: A multilayered tube composed of terminally differentiated hair follicle keratinocytes that is surrounded by the outer root sheath; the layers of the inner root sheath include the companion layer, Henle's layer, Huxley's layer and the inner root sheath cuticle[MP].
synonym: inner root sheath of hair follicle
internal root sheath of hair follicle

UBERON:0005942.name: hair outer root sheath
UBERON:0005942.def: A stratified epithelium that surrounds the hair follicle that merges proximally with the basal layer of the interfollicular epidermis and distally with the hair bulb.
synonym: external root sheath of hair follicle
outer root sheath of hair follicle

UBERON:0005944.name: axial skeleton plus cranial skeleton
UBERON:0005944.def: Subdivision of skeleton which consists of cranial skeleton, set of all vertebrae, set of all ribs and sternum[FMA, modified].

UBERON:0005946.name: outflow tract of atrium
UBERON:0005946.def: An outflow tract that is part of a cardiac atrium.

UBERON:0005953.name: outflow part of right ventricle
UBERON:0005953.def: Anteriosuperior, smooth-walled portion of the cavity of the right ventricle, beginning at the supraventricular crest and terminating in the pulmonary trunk.

UBERON:0005956.name: outflow part of left ventricle
UBERON:0005956.def: Anterosuperior fibrous portion of the left ventricle that connects to the ascending aorta.

UBERON:0005965.name: outflow part of right atrium
UBERON:0005965.def: Outflow part of atrium which consists of wall and cavity of the outflow part of right atrium and the tricuspid valve.[FMA].

UBERON:0005966.name: outflow part of left atrium
UBERON:0005966.def: An outflow tract of atrium that is part of a left atrium.

UBERON:0005967.name: conotruncal ridge
UBERON:0005967.def: One of the pair of spiral mesenchymal swellings in the primordial ventricular outflow tract, that eventually fuse to form the conotruncal septum, dividing the subvalvular outflow tract and contributing to the membranous interventricular septum[MP].

UBERON:0005968.name: infundibulum of hair follicle
UBERON:0005968.def: The portion of the hair follicle from the entrance of the sebaceous gland duct to the epidermal surface opening.

UBERON:0005969.name: eye trabecular meshwork
UBERON:0005969.def: A pore-like structure surrounding the entire circumference of the anterior chamber of the eye through which aqueous humor circulates[MP].

UBERON:0005970.name: brain commissure
UBERON:0005970.def: Any of the nerve fiber tracts that span the longitudinal fissure between the cerebral and/or cerebellar hemispheres of the brain.

UBERON:0005971.name: amniotic fold
UBERON:0005971.def: A sheet of somatopleure that grows upward over the embryo and eventually meets in the midline enclosing the embryo, eventually giving rise to the amnion and chorion[Kardong].

UBERON:0005972.name: tunnel of Corti
UBERON:0005972.def: A triangular, fluid-filled space normally found between the inner and outer rows of supporting pillar cells in the organ of Corti.

UBERON:0005973.name: blood-inner ear barrier
UBERON:0005973.def: The function of the group of barriers and transport systems which regulate the transport of various substances from blood to inner ear tissue and maintain the microhomeostasis and functional integrity of the inner ear; the endothelial cells of the inner ear blood capillaries, linked to each other by tight junctions, represent the main component of the blood-inner ear barrier.

UBERON:0005974.name: posterior cerebellomedullary cistern
UBERON:0005974.def: A space between the cerebellum and the dorsal surface of the medulla[MP]. The cisterna magna (or cerebellomedullary cistern) is one of three principal openings in the subarachnoid space between the arachnoid and pia mater layers of the meninges surrounding the brain. The openings are collectively referred to as cisterns. The cisterna magna is located between the cerebellum and the dorsal surface of the medulla oblongata. Cerebrospinal fluid produced in the fourth ventricle drains into the cisterna magna via the lateral apertures and median aperture. The two other principal cisterns are the pontine cistern located between the pons and the medulla, and the interpeduncular cistern located between the cerebral peduncles. Cerebral spinal fluid can also be obtained by puncture of the cisterna magna (cistern puncture).

UBERON:0005975.name: hair follicle bulge
UBERON:0005975.def: The area located in the bottom of the permanent portion of a resting (telogen) hair follicle where the cells of the external root sheath of the hair follicle are contiguous with the basal layer of the epidermis; this portion of the follicle is involved in the generation of a new hair at the onset of the hair growth cycle (anagen) and contains the hair follicle stem cells.

UBERON:0005976.name: ansiform lobule crus I
UBERON:0005976.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0005976. Please replace it using linked reference.
synonym: ansiform lobe of the cerebellum, crus 1
crus I of the ansiform lobule
crus I of the ansiform lobule (HVII)
crus primum lobuli ansiformis cerebelli [h vii a]
first crus of ansiform lobule of cerebellum [hVIIa]

UBERON:0005977.name: ansiform lobule crus II
UBERON:0005977.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0005977. Please replace it using linked reference.
synonym: ansiform lobe of the cerebellum, crus 2
crus II of the ansiform lobule (HVII)
crus secundum lobuli ansiformis cerebelli [hVII A]
second crus of ansiform lobule of cerebellum [hVIIa]

UBERON:0005978.name: olfactory bulb outer nerve layer
UBERON:0005978.def: Superficial layer of the main olfactory bulb containing axons from the olfactory nerve and glial cells.
synonym: olfactory bulb main olfactory nerve layer

UBERON:0005979.name: crista terminalis
UBERON:0005979.def: The vertical crest of the interior wall of the right atrium that lies to the right of the sinus of the vena cava and separates this from the remainder of the right atrium.

UBERON:0005980.name: pectinate muscle
UBERON:0005980.def: The prominent ridges of atrial myocardium located on the inner surface of most of the right atrium and both the right and left auricular regions[MP].

UBERON:0005981.name: vena cava sinus
UBERON:0005981.def: The portion of the cavity of the right atrium of the heart that receives the blood from the vena cavae and is separated from the rest of the atrium by the crista terminalis.
synonym: cavity of inflow part of right atrium

UBERON:0005982.name: Bachmann's bundle
UBERON:0005982.def: The impulse conduction tract that originates in the sinoatrial node and transmits signal to the left atrium.

UBERON:0005983.name: heart layer
UBERON:0005983.def: The laminar structure of the heart.

UBERON:0005984.name: subendocardium layer
UBERON:0005984.def: The layer of loose fibrous tissue located between the endocardium and myocardium which contains the nerves and the impulse-conducting system (Purkinje fibers) of the heart.

UBERON:0005985.name: coronary vessel
UBERON:0005985.def: Any of the arteries or veins that supply blood to the heart or return blood from the heart muscles to the circulation.

UBERON:0005986.name: left bundle branch
UBERON:0005986.def: The left branch of the atrioventricular bundle that separates at the bundle of His, descends the septal wall of the left ventricle and connects to the terminal Purkinje fiber[MP].
synonym: left bundle branch of bundle of His

UBERON:0005987.name: right bundle branch
UBERON:0005987.def: The right branch of the atrioventricular bundle that separates just below the bundle of His, descends the septal wall of the right ventricle and connects to the terminal Purkinje fibers[MP].
synonym: right bundle branch of bundle of His
right right crus of atrioventricular bundle

UBERON:0005988.name: atrium myocardial trabecula
UBERON:0005988.def: The supporting bundles of muscular fibers lining the walls of the atrial myocardium.

UBERON:0005989.name: atrioventricular septum
UBERON:0005989.def: The wall of the heart that separates the right atrium and left ventricle; and is located just above the septal cusp of the tricuspid valve.

UBERON:0005990.name: aortic valve cusp
UBERON:0005990.def: The three fibrous triangular components and associated flap of the aortic valve.

UBERON:0005991.name: aortic valve anulus
UBERON:0005991.def: The fibrous ring of the aortic valve that attaches the cusps of aortic valve to the wall of left ventricle, and which consists of portions of the fibrous scallops of the posterior, right anterior and left anterior cusps.

UBERON:0005992.name: pulmonary valve cusp
UBERON:0005992.def: The three fibrous triangular components and associated flap of the pulmonary valve.

UBERON:0005993.name: pulmonary valve anulus
UBERON:0005993.def: The fibrous ring of the pulmonary valve that attaches the cusps of pulmonary valve to the wall of right ventricle, and which consists of portions of the fibrous scallops of the anterior, right posterior and left posterior cusps.

UBERON:0005994.name: chorda tendineae
UBERON:0005994.def: The tendinous strands that connect the papillary muscles on the wall of the ventricles to the leaflets of the atrioventricular valves; the chordae tendineae serve to prevent the AV valves from prolapsing back into the atria.

UBERON:0005995.name: mitral valve anulus
UBERON:0005995.def: The fibrous ring of the mitral valve that attaches the cusps of mitral valve to the heart, and which consists of portions of the fibrous scallops of the anterior and posterior cusps.

UBERON:0005996.name: mitral valve cusp
UBERON:0005996.def: The two fibrous components and associated flaps of the mitral valve.

UBERON:0005997.name: tricuspid valve anulus
UBERON:0005997.def: The fibrous ring of the tricuspid valve that attaches the cusps of tricuspid valve to the heart, and which consists of portions of the fibrous scallops of the anterior cusp (infundibular cusp), the posterior cusp (marginal cusp), and the septal cusp (medial cusp).

UBERON:0005998.name: tricuspid valve cusp
UBERON:0005998.def: The three fibrous triangular components and associated flaps of the tricuspid valve.
synonym: septal cusp of right atrioventricular valve
septal leaflet of right-sided tricuspid valve

UBERON:0006002.name: vitelline artery
UBERON:0006002.def: The paired arteries that carry blood to the yolk sac from the dorsal aorta.

UBERON:0006003.name: integumentary adnexa
UBERON:0006003.def: Anatomical structure embedded in or located in the integument that is part of the integumental system. Examples: hair, follicles, skin glands, claws, nails, feathers.

UBERON:0006004.name: hair follicle matrix region
UBERON:0006004.def: The bulb region adjacent to the dermal papilla that contains rapidly proliferating matrix cells that give rise to the various cell lineages of the hair shaft and inner root sheath.
synonym: lower part of bulb of hair follicle
lower zone of bulb of hair follicle

UBERON:0006005.name: hair follicle isthmus
UBERON:0006005.def: The middle part of the hair follicle that extends from the sebaceous duct to the bulge.

UBERON:0006006.name: metoptic pillar
UBERON:0006006.def: The posterior border of the optic nerve foramen.

UBERON:0006007.name: pre-Botzinger complex
UBERON:0006007.def: The group of interneurons within the medulla oblongata's ventral respiratory group that are important for the generation of ventilatory (inspiratory) rhythmogenesis[MP].

UBERON:0006008.name: fibrous ring of heart
UBERON:0006008.def: A ring of ribrous tissue that surrounds the atrioventricular and arterial orifices.

UBERON:0006009.name: cusp of cardiac valve
UBERON:0006009.def: The part of the heart valves that serves to seal the heart valves when closed. There are three cusps for each valve except for the mitral valve, which has only two (hence its alternate name, 'bicuspid valve'). 'Nodules' are located at the tip of the valve, to form a tighter seal[WP].

UBERON:0006010.name: hyaloid canal
UBERON:0006010.def: A small transparent canal running through the vitreous body from the optical nerve disc to the lens. It is formed by an invagination of the hyaloid, a membrane which encloses the vitreous body[WP].

UBERON:0006013.name: interdigital region between manual digits
UBERON:0006013.def: An interdigital region that is part of a manus.

UBERON:0006014.name: interdigital region between pedal digits
UBERON:0006014.def: An interdigital region that is part of a pes.

UBERON:0006015.name: webbed interdigital region
UBERON:0006015.def: A membranous region of skin between the digits.

UBERON:0006016.name: interdigital region between digits 1 and 2
UBERON:0006016.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a digit 1 and adjacent_to a digit 2.
UBERON:0006016.synonym: interdigital region between digits I and II

UBERON:0006019.name: interdigital region between digits 2 and 3
UBERON:0006019.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a digit 2 and adjacent_to a digit 3.
UBERON:0006019.synonym: interdigital region between digits II and III

UBERON:0006022.name: interdigital region between digits 3 and 4
UBERON:0006022.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a digit 3 and adjacent_to a digit 4.
UBERON:0006022.synonym: interdigital region between digits III and IV

UBERON:0006025.name: interdigital region between digits 4 and 5
UBERON:0006025.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a digit 4 and adjacent_to a digit 5.
UBERON:0006025.synonym: interdigital region between digits IV and V

UBERON:0006026.name: interdigital region between manual digits 1 and 2
UBERON:0006026.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a manual digit 1 and adjacent_to a manual digit 2.
UBERON:0006026.synonym: interdigital region between manual digits I and II

UBERON:0006029.name: interdigital region between manual digits 2 and 3
UBERON:0006029.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a manual digit 2 and adjacent_to a manual digit 3.
UBERON:0006029.synonym: interdigital region between manual digits II and III

UBERON:0006032.name: interdigital region between manual digits 3 and 4
UBERON:0006032.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a manual digit 3 and adjacent_to a manual digit 4.
UBERON:0006032.synonym: interdigital region between manual digits III and IV

UBERON:0006035.name: interdigital region between manual digits 4 and 5
UBERON:0006035.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a manual digit 4 and adjacent_to a manual digit 5.
UBERON:0006035.synonym: interdigital region between manual digits IV and V

UBERON:0006038.name: interdigital region between pedal digits 1 and 2
UBERON:0006038.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a pedal digit 1 and adjacent_to a pedal digit 2.
UBERON:0006038.synonym: interdigital region between pedal digits I and II

UBERON:0006041.name: interdigital region between pedal digits 2 and 3
UBERON:0006041.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a pedal digit 2 and adjacent_to a pedal digit 3.
UBERON:0006041.synonym: interdigital region between pedal digits II and III

UBERON:0006044.name: interdigital region between pedal digits 3 and 4
UBERON:0006044.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a pedal digit 3 and adjacent_to a pedal digit 4.
UBERON:0006044.synonym: interdigital region between pedal digits III and IV

UBERON:0006047.name: interdigital region between pedal digits 4 and 5
UBERON:0006047.def: An interdigital region that adjacent_to a pedal digit 4 and adjacent_to a pedal digit 5.
UBERON:0006047.synonym: interdigital region between pedal digits IV and V

UBERON:0006048.name: digit 1
UBERON:0006048.def: A digit that is part of a digit 1 plus metapodial segment.

UBERON:0006049.name: digit 2
UBERON:0006049.def: A digit that is part of a digit 2 plus metapodial segment.

UBERON:0006050.name: digit 3
UBERON:0006050.def: A digit that is part of a digit 3 plus metapodial segment.

UBERON:0006051.name: digit 4
UBERON:0006051.def: A digit that is part of a digit 4 plus metapodial segment.

UBERON:0006052.name: digit 5
UBERON:0006052.def: A digit that is part of a digit 5 plus metapodial segment.

UBERON:0006054.name: surface of occiput
UBERON:0006054.def: The occiput is the anatomical term for the posterior (back) portion of the head.

UBERON:0006058.name: multi-limb segment region
UBERON:0006058.def: A collection of two or more connected limb segments. Examples: arm (comprising stylopod and zeugopod regions).

UBERON:0006059.name: falx cerebri
UBERON:0006059.def: The falx cerebri, also known as the cerebral falx, so named from its sickle-like form, is a strong, arched fold of dura mater which descends vertically in the longitudinal fissure between the cerebral hemispheres. It is narrow in front, where it is attached to the crista galli of the ethmoid; and broad behind, where it is connected with the upper surface of the tentorium cerebelli. Its upper margin is convex, and attached to the inner surface of the skull in the middle line, as far back as the internal occipital protuberance; it contains the superior sagittal sinus. Its lower margin is free and concave, and contains the inferior sagittal sinus. The falx cerebri is known to calcify with age.

UBERON:0006060.name: conotruncus
UBERON:0006060.def: The distal portion of Bulbus cordis that forms an outflow channel and gives rise to the proximal conus cordis.

UBERON:0006061.name: process of vertebra
UBERON:0006061.def: A process projection from a part of the vertebra such as centrum or arches. Examples: transverse process, diapophyses, parapophyses, and zygapophyses (both the cranial zygapophyses and the caudal zygapophyses).

UBERON:0006062.name: zygapophysis
UBERON:0006062.def: Paired processes at the cephalic and caudal ends of the neural arch. They function as interlocking structures between adjacent vertebrae, and limit dorsoventral flexion and lateral movement of the column in the trunk region[AAO]. The articular processes or zygapophyses of a vertebra, in human anatomy contain two superior and two inferior, spring from the junctions of the pedicles and laminae. These stick out of an end of a vertebra to lock with a zygapophysis on the next vertebra, to make the backbone more stable. The superior processes project upward from a lower vertebra, and their articular surfaces are directed more or less backward. The inferior processes project downward from a higher vertebra, and their articular surfaces are directed more or less forward and outward. The articular surfaces are coated with hyaline cartilage.

UBERON:0006063.name: cartilaginous neural arch
UBERON:0006063.def: One of the cartilaginous structures surrounding the embryonic spinal cord, formed by the dorsal growth of the dorsolateral arcualia; it is the primordium of the vertebral arch.

UBERON:0006065.name: hemal arch
UBERON:0006065.def: A vertebral arch that is attached to the ventral surface or the vertebral centrum and encloses and protects the caudal artery and vein ventrally.

UBERON:0006067.name: musculature of hindlimb zeugopod
UBERON:0006067.def: Any collection of muscles that is part of a hindlimb zeugopod.

UBERON:0006068.name: bone of tail
UBERON:0006068.def: A bone that is part of a post-anal tail.

UBERON:0006071.name: caudal region
UBERON:0006071.def: Subdivision of an organism along anterior-posterior axis that is the posteriormost region, extending past the anus (or cloaca, if present), consisting of a tail in some fully formed chordates (or a tail bud in embryos). In animals that have a sacral region, this is the region immediately posterior to this.

UBERON:0006072.name: cervical region of vertebral column
UBERON:0006072.def: That portion of the spine comprising the cervical vertebrae. The neck area of the spine.

UBERON:0006073.name: thoracic region of vertebral column
UBERON:0006073.def: That part of the spine comprising the thoracic vertebrae.

UBERON:0006074.name: lumbar region of vertebral column
UBERON:0006074.def: Subdivision of vertebral column that corresponds to the lumbar subdivision of the body, containing the lumbar vertebrae.

UBERON:0006075.name: sacral region of vertebral column
UBERON:0006075.def: Subdivision of vertebral column that corresponds to the sacral subdivision of the body, containing the sacral vertebrae or sacrum.

UBERON:0006076.name: caudal region of vertebral column
UBERON:0006076.def: Subdivision of vertebral column that corresponds to the caudal subdivision of the body, containing the caudal vertebrae.

UBERON:0006077.name: subdivision of vertebral column
UBERON:0006077.def: A collection of all skeletal elements in some subdivision of the vertebral column.

UBERON:0006078.name: subdivision of spinal cord lateral column

UBERON:0006079.name: subdivision of spinal cord dorsal column
UBERON:0006079.synonym: segment of dorsal funiculus of spinal cord

UBERON:0006080.name: obsolete segment of white matter of spinal cord

UBERON:0006081.name: fundus of gallbladder
UBERON:0006081.def: The fundus of gallbladder is the portion of the gallbladder which lies the farthest from the cystic duct. It is covered with peritoneum. A traditional cholecystectomy is most commonly performed from the infundibulum to the fundus. It's at the same level as the transpyloric plane.

UBERON:0006082.name: fundus of urinary bladder
UBERON:0006082.def: The base or posterior surface of the urinary bladder contains the trigone of the bladder and the outlet where urine empties through the internal urethral orifice.

UBERON:0006083.name: perirhinal cortex
UBERON:0006083.def: Region of cortex near to the rhinal sulcus. It is defined differently in different nomenclatures, due in part to the lack of agreement on the definition of the border of this region. In the rat, the perirhinal cortex occupies only caudal levels of the rhinal sulcus while in the monkey, it occurpies the full rostrocaudal extent of the rhinal sulcus (Burwell et al., Hippocampus, 5: 390-408, 1995).

UBERON:0006086.name: stria medullaris
UBERON:0006086.def: The major afferent track to the habenula from the telencephalon (particularly in the septal side) in all vertebrates[Butler and Hodos].

UBERON:0006087.name: internal arcuate fiber bundle
UBERON:0006087.def: Internal arcuate fibers are the axons of second-order neurons contained within the gracile and cuneate nuclei of the medulla oblongata. These fibers cross from one side of the medulla to the other to form the medial lemniscus. Part of the dorsal column-medial lemniscus system (second neuron), the internal arcuate fibers are important for relaying the sensation of fine touch and proprioception to the thalamus and ultimately to the cerebral cortex.

UBERON:0006088.name: inferior parietal cortex
UBERON:0006088.def: Component of the parietal lobe. The inferior parietal cortex label includes the inferior parietal gyrus and the angular gyrus and lies inferior to the superior parietal gyrus. The rostral and caudal boundaries were the supramarginal gyrus and the parieto-occipital incisure respectively. The medial and lateral boundaries were the superior parietal gyrus and the middle temporal gyrus respectively (Christine Fennema-Notestine).

UBERON:0006091.name: inferior horn of the lateral ventricle
UBERON:0006091.def: The part of the lateral ventricle extending downward and anteriorly in the temporal lobe.
synonym: inferior horn of the lateral ventricle

UBERON:0006092.name: cuneus cortex
UBERON:0006092.def: Component of the occipital lobe. The rostral boundary was the first coronal slice above the calcarine sulcus where the cuneus cortex becomes visible whereas the caudal boundary was the last slice where the calcarine sulcus was visualized. The medial boundary was the most medial portion of the occipital and parietal cortices. The superio-lateral boundary was the parieto-occipital fissure whereas the inferolateral boundary was the pericalcarine cortex (Christine Fennema-Notestine).

UBERON:0006093.name: precuneus cortex
UBERON:0006093.def: Component of the pareital lobe. The rostral boundary was the posterior extent of the paracentral lobule whereas the caudal boundary was the lingual gyrus. The medial and lateral boundaries were the parieto-occipital fissure and the superior parietal gyrus respectively (Christine Fennema-Notestine).
synonym: medial area of the superior parietal cortex

UBERON:0006094.name: superior parietal cortex
UBERON:0006094.def: Copmonent of the parietal lobe. The rostral and caudal boundaries of the superior parietal cortex were the precentral gyrus and lateral occipital cortex respectively. The medial and lateral boundaries were the precuneus and/or cuneus cortex and the infererior parietal cortex respectively (Christine Fennema-Notestine).

UBERON:0006095.name: anterior transverse temporal area 41
UBERON:0006095.def: A subdivision of the cytoarchitecturally defined temporal region of cerebral cortex. It occupies the anterior transverse temporal gyrus (H) in the bank of the lateral sulcus on the dorsal surface of the temporal lobe. Cytoarchitecturally it is bounded medially by the parainsular area 52 (H) and laterally by the posterior transverse temporal area 42 (H) (Brodmann-1909). Adapted from Brain Info.

UBERON:0006096.name: posterior transverse temporal area 42
UBERON:0006096.def: A subdivision of the cytoarchitecturally defined temporal region of cerebral cortex. It is located in the bank of the lateral sulcus on the dorsal surface of the temporal lobe. Cytoarchitecturally it is bounded medially by the anterior transverse temporal area 41(H) and laterally by the superior temporal area 22 (Brodmann-1909). Adapted from Brain Info.

UBERON:0006098.name: basal nuclear complex
UBERON:0006098.def: The deep nuclei of telencephalic origin found in the basal region of the forebrain.

UBERON:0006099.name: Brodmann (1909) area 1
UBERON:0006099.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0006099. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0006100.name: Brodmann (1909) area 3
UBERON:0006100.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0006100. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0006101.name: Brodmann (1909) area 24
UBERON:0006101.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0006101. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0006102.name: Brodmann (1909) area 35
UBERON:0006102.def: Brodmann area 35, together with Brodmann area 36, is most frequently referred to as perirhinal cortex.

UBERON:0006104.name: Brodmann (1909) area 36
UBERON:0006104.def: Ectorhinal area 36 is a subdivision of the cytoarchitecturally defined temporal region of cerebral cortex. With its medial boundary corresponding approximately to the rhinal sulcus it is located primarily in the fusiform gyrus. Cytoarchitecturally it is bounded laterally and caudally by the inferior temporal area 20, medially by the perirhinal area 35 and rostrally by the temporopolar area 38 (H) (Brodmann-1909). Together with Brodmann area 35, it comprises the perirhinal cortex.

UBERON:0006107.name: basolateral amygdaloid nuclear complex
UBERON:0006107.def: A set of amygdalar nuclei comprising the lateral nucleus (LA), the basal nucleus (BA), and the accessory basal nuclei (ABN). These nuclei are bordered laterally by the external capsule and medially by the central amygdalar nucleus as well as the amygdalohippocampal area. This definition refers to the rat Basolateral nuclear complex.
synonym: set of basolateral nuclei of amygdala

UBERON:0006108.name: corticomedial nuclear complex
UBERON:0006108.def: These structures are referred to as nuclei but have a layered cortical like structure. These areas include the anterior amygdaloid area, posterior amygdaloid area, the periamygdaloid cortex, and the bed nucleus of the accessory olfactory tract.
synonym: set of corticomedial nuclei of amygdala

UBERON:0006114.name: lateral occipital cortex
UBERON:0006114.def: Component of the occipital lobe. The rostral and caudal boundaries of the lateral occipital cortex were the superior parietal gyrus and as the last visible portion of occipital cortex respectively. The medial and lateral boundaries were the cuneus/pericalcarine cortex and the inferior temporal/inferior parietal gyri respectively (Christine Fennema-Notestine).

UBERON:0006115.name: posterior column of fornix
UBERON:0006115.def: Part of fornix adjacent to the fimbria comprising flattened bands of fibers that extend from the fimbria, running underneath the corpus callosum.
synonym: posterior column of fornix of forebrain

UBERON:0006117.name: accessory nerve fiber bundle
UBERON:0006117.def: Fibers of the accessory nerve (11th cranial nerve) contained within the medulla.

UBERON:0006118.name: lamina I of gray matter of spinal cord
UBERON:0006118.def: Cytoarchitectural part of spinal cord gray matter.
synonym: lamina i of gray matter of spinal cord

UBERON:0006119.name: subbrachial nucleus
UBERON:0006119.def: A group of cells ventral to the nucleus of brachium of inferior colliculus in the mouse (Paxinos-2001).

UBERON:0006120.name: superior colliculus superficial gray layer
UBERON:0006120.def: Layer of the superior colliculus, lying just deep to the outermost stratum zonale (Carpenter, A Core Text of Neuroanatomy, 3rd ed., 1985, pg 175).
synonym: outer gray layer of superior colliculus
stratum griseum superficiale of superior colliculus
superficial gray layer of superior colliculus
superficial gray layer of the superior colliculus
superficial grey layer of superior colliculus
superficial grey layer of the superior colliculus

UBERON:0006121.name: hemispheric lobule VIII
UBERON:0006121.def: The biventer lobule (or biventral lobule) is triangular in shape; its apex points backward, and is joined by the gray band to the pyramid. The lateral border is separated from the inferior semilunar lobule by the postpyramidal fissure. The base is directed forward, and is on a line with the anterior border of the tonsil, and is separated from the flocculus by the postnodular fissure.
synonym: lobule VIII of hemisphere of cerebellum

UBERON:0006123.name: horizontal limb of the diagonal band
synonym: horizontal limb of the diagonal band
horizontal limb of the diagonal band of Broca
nucleus of the horizontal limb of the diagonal band

UBERON:0006124.name: vertical limb of the diagonal band
synonym: nucleus of the vertical limb of the diagonal band
vertical limb of the diagonal band
vertical limb of the diagonal band of Broca

UBERON:0006127.name: funiculus of spinal cord
UBERON:0006127.def: A funiculus of neuraxis that is part of a spinal cord.

UBERON:0006133.name: funiculus of neuraxis
UBERON:0006133.def: The cerebrospinal nerves consist of numerous nerve fibers collected together and enclosed in membranous sheaths. A small bundle of fibers, enclosed in a tubular sheath, is called a funiculus; if the nerve is of small size, it may consist only of a single funiculus; but if large, the funiculi are collected together into larger bundles or fasciculi, which are bound together in a common membranous investment. Examples include: Anterior funiculus of the spinal cord Lateral funiculus of the spinal cord Posterior funiculus of the spinal cord Funiculus solitarius of the medulla Funiculus separans.

UBERON:0006134.name: nerve fiber
UBERON:0006134.def: A threadlike extension of a nerve cell and consists of an axon and myelin sheath (if it is myelinated) in the nervous system. There are nerve fibers in the central nervous system and peripheral nervous system. A nerve fiber may be myelinated and/or unmyelinated. In the central nervous system (CNS), myelin by oligodendroglia cells is formed. Schwann cells form myelin in the peripheral nervous system (PNS). Schwann cells also make a thin covering in an axon without myelin (in the PNS). A peripheral nerve fiber contains an axon, myelin sheath, schwann cells and its endoneurium. There are no endoneurium and schwann cells in the central nervous system.

UBERON:0006135.name: myelinated nerve fiber
UBERON:0006135.def: Axons of neurons encased in a lipoproteinaceous material called myelin. (MeSH).

UBERON:0006137.name: proper palmar digital artery
UBERON:0006137.def: The proper palmar digital arteries travel along the sides of the phalanges (along the contiguous sides of the index, middle, ring, and little fingers), each artery lying just below its corresponding digital nerve. Alternative names for these arteries are: proper volar digital arteries, collateral digital arteries, arteriae digitales palmares propriae, or aa. digitales volares propriae. They anastomose freely in the subcutaneous tissue of the finger tips and by smaller branches near the interphalangeal joints. Each also gives off a couple of dorsal branches which anastomose with the dorsal digital arteries, and supply the soft parts on the back of the second and third phalanges, including the matrix of the fingernail. The proper palmar digital artery for the medial side of the little finger arises directly from the ulnar artery deep to the palmaris brevis muscle, but the rest arise from the common palmar digital arteries.
synonym: set of proper palmar digital arteries

UBERON:0006139.name: plantar digital vein
UBERON:0006139.def: The plantar digital veins arise from plexuses on the plantar surfaces of the digits, and, after sending intercapitular veins to join the dorsal digital veins, unite to form four metatarsal veins.

UBERON:0006140.name: palmar digital vein
UBERON:0006140.def: The palmar digital veins (or volar digital veins) on each finger are connected to the dorsal digital veins by oblique intercapitular veins. Some sources distinguish between the 'proper palmar digital veins', which are more distal, and the 'common palmar digital veins', which are more proximal.

UBERON:0006145.name: dorsal digital artery of pes
UBERON:0006145.def: The dorsal digital arteries of foot are small arteries which supply the toes.

UBERON:0006146.name: dorsal digital artery of manus
UBERON:0006146.def: Dorsal digital arteries arise from the bifurcation of dorsal metacarpal arteries. They travel along the sides and dorsal aspects of the phalanges of the middle finger, ring finger, and little finger. They communicate with the proper palmar digital arteries. They run with the dorsal digital nerves of ulnar nerve and dorsal digital nerves of radial nerve.

UBERON:0006165.name: median dorsal digital artery for digit 1
synonym: median dorsal digital artery for digit 01
median dorsal digital artery for digit I

UBERON:0006166.name: lateral dorsal digital artery for digit 5
synonym: lateral dorsal digital artery for digit 05
lateral dorsal digital artery for digit V

UBERON:0006170.name: mesonephric capsule
UBERON:0006170.def: The mesonephric capsule is the tough fibrous layer surrounding the mesonephros, covered in a thick layer of perinephric adipose tissue.

UBERON:0006171.name: renal sinus
UBERON:0006171.def: A hollowed out area on the medial margin of the kidney. The renal sinus opens at the renal hilum; it contains the renal aa. and vv., major calyces and renal pelvis, perirenal fat.

UBERON:0006172.name: rectal diverticulum
UBERON:0006172.def: The rectal diverticulum is an outgrowth of the cloaca and links the pronephric kidney to the exterior.

UBERON:0006174.name: pronephric sinus
UBERON:0006174.def: The pronephric sinus is an ill-defined capillary network that lies between the pronephric tubules.

UBERON:0006182.name: mesonephric glomerular mesangium
UBERON:0006182.def: The mesonephric glomerular mesangium is the thin membrane connective tissue composed of mesangial cells in the mesonephros, which helps to support the capillary loops in a renal glomerulus.

UBERON:0006183.name: mesonephric glomerular capillary
UBERON:0006183.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0006183. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0006189.name: mesonephric connecting tubule
UBERON:0006189.def: The mesonephric connecting tubule is a tubular segment of the mesonephric nephron; it connects the distal tubule to the collecting duct in the mesonephros.

UBERON:0006190.name: mesonephric distal tubule
UBERON:0006190.def: The mesonephric distal tubule is a mesonephric nephron tubule that begins at the macula densa and extends to the mesonephric connecting tubule.

UBERON:0006192.name: mesonephric proximal tubule
UBERON:0006192.def: The mesonephric proximal tubule extends from the capsule to the distal tubule.

UBERON:0006194.name: renal sinus of right kidney
UBERON:0006194.def: A renal sinus that is part of a right kidney.

UBERON:0006195.name: renal sinus of left kidney
UBERON:0006195.def: A renal sinus that is part of a left kidney.

UBERON:0006196.name: mesonephric sinus
UBERON:0006196.def: A renal sinus that is part of a mesonephros.

UBERON:0006197.name: auricular vein
UBERON:0006197.def: Any vein serving the ear region.

UBERON:0006198.name: dorsal intercostal artery
UBERON:0006198.def: The highest intercostal artery (supreme intercostal artery, superior intercostal artery) is an artery in the human body that usually gives rise to the first and second posterior intercostal arteries, which supply blood to their corresponding intercostal space. It usually arises from the costocervical trunk, which is a branch of the subclavian artery.
synonym: dorsal branch of superior intercostal artery

UBERON:0006199.name: posterior auricular vein
UBERON:0006199.def: The posterior auricular vein begins upon the side of the head, in a plexus which communicates with the tributaries of the occipital vein and superficial temporal veins. It descends behind the auricula, and joins the posterior division of the posterior facial vein to form the external jugular. It receive the stylomastoid vein, and some tributaries from the cranial surface of the auricula.

UBERON:0006204.name: inguinal ligament
UBERON:0006204.def: A band running from the pubic tubercle to the anterior superior iliac spine. Its anatomy is very important for operating on hernia patients. It forms the base of the inguinal canal through which an indirect inguinal hernia may develop. The inguinal ligament runs from the anterior superior iliac spine of the ilium to the pubic tubercle of the pubic bone. It is formed by the external abdominal oblique aponeurosis and is continuous with the fascia lata of the thigh.

UBERON:0006205.name: pectineal ligament
UBERON:0006205.def: An extension of the lacunar ligament that runs on the pectineal line of the pubic bone.

UBERON:0006206.name: iridocorneal angle
UBERON:0006206.def: Acute angle occurring between the iris and the cornea at the periphery of the anterior chamber of the eye[MP].

UBERON:0006207.name: aortico-pulmonary spiral septum
UBERON:0006207.def: The spiral septum that separates the truncus arteriosus into a ventral pulmonary trunk and the dorsal aorta[MP]. The aorticopulmonary septum is developmentally formed from neural crest, specifically the cardiac neural crest, and actively separates the aorta and pulmonary arteries and fuses with the interventricular septum within the heart during development. The actual mechanism of septation of the outflow tract is poorly understood, but is recognized as a dynamic process with contributions from contractile, hemodynamic, and extracellular matrix interactions.

UBERON:0006208.name: auditory hillocks
UBERON:0006208.def: A collection of protruberances derived from pharyngeal arches 1 and 2 that develop into the folds of the pinna and gradually shift upwards and backwards to their final position on the head.

UBERON:0006209.name: basioccipital cartilage element
UBERON:0006209.def: A basioccipital endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0006211.name: buccopharyngeal membrane
UBERON:0006211.def: The thin bilaminar membrane derived from the prechordal plate that is devoid of mesoderm and formed by the apposition of the stomodeal ectoderm with the foregut endoderm; after the embryonic head fold has evolved it lies at the caudal limit of the stomodeum, forming a septum between the primitive mouth and pharynx; the membrane eventually disappears, and thus a communication is established between the mouth and the future pharynx.

UBERON:0006212.name: bulbo-ventricular groove
UBERON:0006212.def: Depression at base of developing heart that contains a population of cardiomyocytes that migrate and contribute to the interventricular septum.

UBERON:0006213.name: carpus cartilage element
UBERON:0006213.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a carpal bone.

UBERON:0006214.name: carpus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0006214.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a carpal bone.

UBERON:0006215.name: rhombic lip
UBERON:0006215.def: The posterior section of the developing metencephalon recognized transiently within the vertebrate embryo; the rhombic lip extends posteriorly from the roof of the fourth ventricle to dorsal neuroepithelial cell and can be divided into eight structural units based on rhombomeres 1-8 (r1-r8), recognized at early stages of hindbrain development; producing granule cells and five brainstem nuclei, the rhombic lip plays an important role in developing a complex cerebellar neural system.
synonym: dorsal part of alar plate of metencephalon

UBERON:0006216.name: cervical sinus of His
UBERON:0006216.def: A temporary depression caudal to the second pharyngeal arch, containing the succeeding pharyngeal arches; it is overgrown by the second pharyngeal arch and closes off as the cervical vesicle. This sinus is bounded in front by the hyoid arch, and behind by the thoracic wall.

UBERON:0006217.name: cloacal membrane
UBERON:0006217.def: The membrane that covers the embryonic cloaca, formed by the union of proctodeal (anal pit) ectoderm and cloacal endoderm, with no intervening mesoderm; the urorectal septum joins the cloacal membrane and divides it into an anal membrane and a urogenital membrane; the point where the urorectal septum intersects the cloacal membrane is the future site of the perineal body; proliferation of mesoderm and ectoderm around the cloacal membrane produces primordial tissues of the external genitalia in both sexes: the genital tubercle, genital folds, and genital swellings.

UBERON:0006222.name: future diencephalon
UBERON:0006222.def: The foremost region of the future forebrain that develops into the diencephalon.

UBERON:0006228.name: exoccipital pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0006228.def: An exoccipital endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0006233.name: female genital tubercle
UBERON:0006233.def: A differentiated genital tubercle that is part of a female reproductive system.

UBERON:0006234.name: femur pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0006234.def: A femur endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0006235.name: foregut-midgut junction
UBERON:0006235.def: An anatomical junctions that overlaps the foregut and midgut.

UBERON:0006238.name: future brain
UBERON:0006238.def: The embryonic precursor of the brain.

UBERON:0006239.name: future central tendon
UBERON:0006239.def: A tendon that has the potential to develop into a central tendon.

UBERON:0006240.name: future forebrain
UBERON:0006240.def: A presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a forebrain.

UBERON:0006242.name: gallbladder primordium
UBERON:0006242.def: A sac-like cavity ventral to the liver, lying in the sub-mesodermal space and closed by a thin sheet of ectodermal cells, from which the future gall bladder develops.

UBERON:0006245.name: humerus cartilage element
UBERON:0006245.def: A humerus endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0006246.name: humerus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0006246.def: A humerus endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0006247.name: iliac pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0006247.def: An iliac endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0006248.name: incus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0006248.def: An incus endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0006250.name: infundibular recess of 3rd ventricle
UBERON:0006250.def: A funnel-shaped diverticulum that extends downward from the anterior aspect of the floor of the third ventricle into the infundibulum of the hypophysis; the embryonic structure gives rise the neural component of the pituitary (pas nervosa).

UBERON:0006253.name: embryonic intraretinal space
UBERON:0006253.def: The space separating the outer pigment epithelium and the inner neural retina of the optic cup and of the retina.

UBERON:0006254.name: ischial cartilage element
UBERON:0006254.def: An ischial endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0006255.name: ischial pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0006255.def: An ischial endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0006257.name: laryngotracheal groove
UBERON:0006257.def: A groove in the floor of the pharynx formed from the ventral diverticulum of endoderm that arises from the floor of the foregut caudal to the pharynx. This structure is the precursor for the larynx and trachea[WP,edited].

UBERON:0006259.name: lens pit
UBERON:0006259.def: A pitlike depression in the ectoderm of the lens placode where the primordial lens is developing[TFD].

UBERON:0006261.name: male genital tubercle
UBERON:0006261.def: A differentiated genital tubercle that is part of a male reproductive system.

UBERON:0006262.name: malleus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0006262.def: A malleus endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0006264.name: mouth-foregut junction
UBERON:0006264.def: An anatomical junctions that overlaps the mouth and foregut.

UBERON:0006266.name: nasolacrimal groove
UBERON:0006266.def: Groove between maxillary prominence and lateral nasal process.

UBERON:0006267.name: notochordal plate
UBERON:0006267.def: The notochordal plate is the dorsal part of the notochordal process when the ventral portion breaks down. It is continuous laterally with the endoderm that composes the roof of the primitive foregut and is in contact dorsally with the neural tube. The folding off of the notochordal plate gives rise to the notochord.

UBERON:0006268.name: notochordal process
UBERON:0006268.def: A midline cellular cord formed from the migration of mesenchymal cells from the primitive knot.

UBERON:0006270.name: optic pit
UBERON:0006270.def: A small indentation in the central part of the optic placode.

UBERON:0006271.name: orbital fissure
