UBERON:0008833.def: A nerve arising from the second and third cervical nerves from the cervical plexus and innervating the skin over the parotid gland, the skin of part of the ear, the adjacent portion of the scalp, cheek, and angle of the jaw.

UBERON:0008834.name: prostomium
UBERON:0008834.def: The first body segment in annelids worms. It is in front of (but does not include) the mouth, being usually a small shelf- or lip-like extension over the dorsal side of the mouth.

UBERON:0008835.name: hepatic diverticulum
UBERON:0008835.def: An out-pocket of thickened ventral foregut epithelium adjacent to the developing heart. Constitutes the first morphological sign of the embryonic liver. The anterior portion of the hepatic diverticulum gives rise to the liver and intrahepatic biliary tree, while the posterior portion forms the gall bladder and extrahepatic bile ducts.

UBERON:0008838.name: metapodial pad
UBERON:0008838.def: A thick, spongy layer of tissue located under the metacarpal and metatarsal joints of the autopod.

UBERON:0008839.name: palmar pad
UBERON:0008839.def: An autopod pad that is in the metacarpal region.

UBERON:0008840.name: plantar pad
UBERON:0008840.def: An autopod pad that is in the metatarsal region.

UBERON:0008841.name: suspensory ligament
UBERON:0008841.def: A ligament that supports a body part, especially an organ.

UBERON:0008842.name: suspensory ligament of testis
UBERON:0008842.def: The cranial atrophic portion of the urogenital ridge attached to the cranial pole of the intraabdominal embryonic testis.

UBERON:0008843.name: gubernaculum testis
UBERON:0008843.def: The fetal ligament attached to the inferior end of the epididymis and testis and, at its other end, to the bottom of the scrotum; it is present during, and is thought to guide, the descent of the testis into the scrotum and then atrophies.

UBERON:0008844.name: gubernaculum (female)
UBERON:0008844.def: A gubernaculum that is part of a female reproductive system.

UBERON:0008845.name: nonskeletal ligament
UBERON:0008845.def: A ligament that does not connect two skeletal elements.

UBERON:0008846.name: skeletal ligament
UBERON:0008846.def: Dense regular connective tissue connecting two or more adjacent skeletal elements[VSAO,modified].

UBERON:0008847.name: ovarian ligament
UBERON:0008847.def: A fibrous ligament that connects the ovary to the lateral surface of the uterus.

UBERON:0008848.name: cranial suspensory ligament
UBERON:0008848.def: Connects the cranial tip of the future gonad to the dorsocranial abdominal cavity.

UBERON:0008851.name: ectoplacental cavity
UBERON:0008851.def: Closed space within the ectoplacental cone, formed by the fusion of the parts of the amniotic fold that separate it from the amniotic cavity[MP]. a developmental cavity that exists in some mammals and is derived by division of the proamniotic space; it is further removed from the embryo than the amniotic cavity in some mammals.

UBERON:0008852.name: visceral yolk sac
UBERON:0008852.def: Extraembryonic tissue membrane, formed from the visceral endoderm and the extraembryonic mesoderm, which is located ventral to the embryonic disc and is connected to the presumptive midgut of the embryo; the yolk that it contains is the site of embryonic hematopoiesis and vitelline circulation is involved in early embryonic circulation; it is the origin of the primordial germ cells.

UBERON:0008853.name: parietal yolk sac
UBERON:0008853.def: Tissue that consists of two cellular layers (parietal endoderm and trophoblast) separated by a relatively thick nonvascular basement membrane (Reichert's membrane), and acts as a protective layer to supports and facilitates transport of nutrients between the uterine tissue and the yolk sac cavity.

UBERON:0008854.name: root of molar tooth
UBERON:0008854.def: The part of a molar tooth that is implanted in the gum; mandibular and maxillary molars usually have two and three roots, respectively.

UBERON:0008855.name: placenta metrial gland
UBERON:0008855.def: A group of granular epithelial cells in the uterine muscle beneath the placenta that develops during pregnancy in rodents and some other species.

UBERON:0008856.name: stomach muscularis externa
UBERON:0008856.def: The smooth muscle layer of the stomach wall that functions to churn and mix food and gastric secretions as well as to move food along the digestive tract to the intestines.

UBERON:0008857.name: stomach smooth muscle circular layer
UBERON:0008857.def: The middle layer of the muscularis; it is continuous with the circular layer of the esophagus, but is absent in the fundus and lies concentric to the longitudinal axis of the stomach; the circular layer is normally tonically constricted forming a functional pyloric sphincter, which controls the movement of chyme into the duodenum.
synonym: middle circular muscle layer of stomach

UBERON:0008858.name: pyloric canal
UBERON:0008858.def: The short narrow part of the stomach extending from the pyloric antrum to the pyloric sphincter.

UBERON:0008859.name: cardiac gastric gland
UBERON:0008859.def: A gastric gland in the cardiac region of the stomach; cardiac glands are fewer in number than in the fundus and body, and secrete mucin which coats the stomach and protects it[MP].

UBERON:0008860.name: intermediate gastric gland
UBERON:0008860.def: Any of the branched tubular glands in the mucosa of the fundus and body of the stomach that secrete most of the digestive substances secreted by the stomach.

UBERON:0008861.name: pyloric gastric gland
UBERON:0008861.def: The gastric glands in the pyloric region of the stomach; the pyloric glands secrete mucin, which coats the stomach and protects it, and hormones such as gastrin and enkephalin[MP].

UBERON:0008862.name: stomach smooth muscle inner oblique layer
UBERON:0008862.def: The innermost layer of the muscularis; it is not present in all sections of the stomach but is clearly seen in the fundus and near the lesser curvature of the corpus; the oblique fibers disappear distally (towards the pyloric antrum); the oblique layer is responsible for creating the motion that churns and physically breaks down the food.
synonym: inner oblique muscle layer of stomach
oblique fiber layer of gastric muscularis

UBERON:0008863.name: stomach smooth muscle outer longitudinal layer
UBERON:0008863.def: The most superficial layer of the muscularis; it has two sections, a longitudinal layer that is common with the esophagus and ends in the corpus, and a longitudinal layer that originates in the corpus and spreads into the duodenum.
synonym: outer longitudinal muscle layer of stomach

UBERON:0008866.name: enamel knot
UBERON:0008866.def: A transient cluster of cells in the central part of the dental epithelium facing the dental mesenchyme, which acts as an organizing center, providing positional information for tooth morphogenesis and regulating the growth of tooth cusps.

UBERON:0008867.name: trabecular network of bone
UBERON:0008867.def: The network of intersecting plates and spicules in cancellous bone which form a meshwork of intercommunicating spaces filled with blood vessels and marrow; in mature bone, the trabeculae are aligned in parallel with the lines of major compressive or tensile force.

UBERON:0008870.name: pulmonary alveolar parenchyma
UBERON:0008870.def: The distinguishing cell types of the lung alveolar tissue, including pulmonary epithelial cells (pneumocytes), alveolar capillary endothelial cells, interstitial cells (fibroblasts) and alveolar macrophages.

UBERON:0008873.name: alveolar pore
UBERON:0008873.def: The openings in the alveolar septum that permit air flow between adjacent alveoli.

UBERON:0008874.name: pulmonary acinus
UBERON:0008874.def: The largest lung subunit in which all airways participate in gas exchange, and it is composed of the parenchyma of the respiratory bronchioles, alveolar ducts, and alveoli.

UBERON:0008876.name: hypodermis skeletal muscle layer
UBERON:0008876.def: Any skeletal muscle organ in the hypodermis / superficial fascia.

UBERON:0008877.name: epidermal-dermal junction
UBERON:0008877.def: The multi-layer basement membrane between the dermis and epidermis that serves to adhere the dermis and epidermis, provide mechanical support for the epidermis, and forms a barrier to cells and large molecules across the junction.

UBERON:0008881.name: rostral migratory stream
UBERON:0008881.def: Unique telencephalic subventricular zones that extend from the lateral ventricles into the olfactory bulbs. Newly produced GABAergic interneurons migrate along the RMS and settle in the bulb.

UBERON:0008882.name: spinal cord commissure
UBERON:0008882.def: The nerve fiber tracts that span the midline of the spinal cord.

UBERON:0008883.name: osteoid
UBERON:0008883.def: Bone tissue that is an unmineralized bone matrix deposited by osteoblasts prior to the mineralization of bone tissue.

UBERON:0008884.name: left putamen
UBERON:0008884.def: A putamen that is part of a left cerebral hemisphere.

UBERON:0008885.name: right putamen
UBERON:0008885.def: A putamen that is part of a right cerebral hemisphere.

UBERON:0008886.name: pulmonary vascular system
UBERON:0008886.def: The part of the cardiovascular system consisting of all pulmonary arteries and all pulmonary veins.

UBERON:0008887.name: rectal venous plexus
UBERON:0008887.def: The hemorrhoidal plexus (or rectal venous plexus) surrounds the rectum, and communicates in front with the vesical venous plexus in the male, and the uterovaginal plexus in the female. A free communication between the portal and systemic venous systems is established through the hemorrhoidal plexus.

UBERON:0008888.name: vesical venous plexus
UBERON:0008888.def: The vesical plexus envelops the lower part of the bladder and the base of the prostate and communicates with the pudendal and prostatic plexuses. It is drained, by means of several vesical veins, into the hypogastric veins.

UBERON:0008889.name: uterine venous plexus
UBERON:0008889.def: The uterine plexuses lie along the sides and superior angles of the uterus between the two layers of the broad ligament, and communicate with the ovarian and vaginal plexuses. They are drained by a pair of uterine veins on either side: these arise from the lower part of the plexuses, opposite the external orifice of the uterus, and open into the corresponding hypogastric vein.

UBERON:0008891.name: external gill
UBERON:0008891.def: External gills are the gills of an animal, most typically an amphibian, that are exposed to the environment, rather than set inside the pharynx and covered by gill slits, as they are in most fishes[BTO].

UBERON:0008894.name: pharyngeal gill precursor
UBERON:0008894.def: A primordium or bud that develops into a gill.

UBERON:0008895.name: splanchnocranium
UBERON:0008895.def: Subdivision of endoskeleton derived from pharyngeal arches.

UBERON:0008896.name: post-hyoid pharyngeal arch
UBERON:0008896.def: A pharyngeal arch that is posterior to the hyoid arch. i.e. any pharyngeal arch with a number 3 or higher.

UBERON:0008897.name: fin
UBERON:0008897.def: An external projection of an aquatic animal as a fish used in propelling or guiding the body[BTO].

UBERON:0008902.name: lateral recess of third ventricle
UBERON:0008902.def: Lateral protrusion of the third ventricle.

UBERON:0008904.name: neuromast
UBERON:0008904.def: Volcano-shaped lateral line sensory organ located in characteristic positions within the skin epithelium and containing hair cells and their support elements.

UBERON:0008906.name: lateral line nerve
UBERON:0008906.def: Cranial nerves that carry afferent and efferent fibers for the lateral line system.

UBERON:0008907.name: dermal bone
UBERON:0008907.def: Skeletal element that forms superficially in the organism, usually in association with the ectoderm[VSAO].

UBERON:0008909.name: perichordal bone
UBERON:0008909.def: Bone element that is adjacent to the notochord.

UBERON:0008911.name: chondral bone
UBERON:0008911.def: Replacement bone that forms within or surrounding a cartilaginous skeletal element.

UBERON:0008913.name: perichondral bone
UBERON:0008913.def: Bone element that is located on the surface of a cartilage element.

UBERON:0008915.name: pore
UBERON:0008915.def: An anatomical space that is an opening, usually at the end of a canal or duct, on the surface of the integument or the lining of an internal anatomical space.

UBERON:0008917.name: ampullary organ
UBERON:0008917.def: Organ that consists of receptor cells located within an epidermal invagination and functions as an electroreceptor.

UBERON:0008918.name: ampulla of Lorenzini
UBERON:0008918.def: The ampullae of Lorenzini are special sensing organs called electroreceptors, forming a network of jelly-filled pores. Each ampulla consists of a canal opening to the surface by a pore in the skin and ending blindly in a cluster of small pockets full of special jelly. The ampullae are mostly clustered into groups inside the body, each cluster having ampullae connecting with different parts of the skin, but preserving a left-right symmetry. The canal lengths vary from animal to animal, but the distribution of the pores is generally specific to each species. The ampullae pores are plainly visible as dark spots in the skin. They provide fish with a sixth sense capable of detecting electromagnetic fields as well as temperature gradients[WP].

UBERON:0008921.name: substratum of layer of retina
UBERON:0008921.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0008921. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0008922.name: sublaminar layer S1
UBERON:0008922.def: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the inner nuclear layer and comprises 20 percent of the inner plexiform layer of retina.

UBERON:0008923.name: sublaminar layer S2
UBERON:0008923.def: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the S1 and S3 layers and comprises 20 percent of the inner plexiform layer of retina.

UBERON:0008924.name: sublaminar layer S3
UBERON:0008924.def: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the S2 and S4 layers and comprises 20 percent of the inner plexiform layer of retina.

UBERON:0008925.name: sublaminar layer S4
UBERON:0008925.def: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the S3 and S5 layer and comprises 20 percent of the inner plexiform layer of retina.

UBERON:0008926.name: sublaminar layer S5
UBERON:0008926.def: A retinal neural layer that is immediately adjacent to the retinal ganglion cell layer and comprises 20 percent of the ganglion plexiform layer of retina.

UBERON:0008927.name: sublaminar layers S1 or S2
UBERON:0008927.def: One of sublaminar layers S1 or S2.

UBERON:0008928.name: sublaminar layers S2 or S3
UBERON:0008928.def: One of sublaminar layers S2 or S3.

UBERON:0008929.name: sublaminar layers S4 or S5
UBERON:0008929.def: One of sublaminar layers S4 or S5.

UBERON:0008930.name: somatosensory cortex
UBERON:0008930.def: Area of the parietal lobe concerned with receiving general sensations. It lies posterior to the central sulcus.

UBERON:0008933.name: primary somatosensory cortex
UBERON:0008933.def: (Chapin & Lin, 1984, rat): the region considered as the SI cortex is not a cytoarchitecturally homogeneous structure but consists instead of a patchwork array of areas containing dense aggregations of layer IV granule cells, surrounded by granule-cell-sparse regions. As was shown by Welker (b71,b76), and in our own mapping studies (see Fig. 3), this discontinuous pattern of granular, or koniocortical, zones contains within itself a map of the ratbs cutaneous periphery. There are clear subtypes within this cytoarchitectural subregion, notably including the bgranular aggregateb type of cytoarchitecture characteristic of the paw, limb, and mystacial vibrissae areas, and the bbarrel-fieldb type (originally described by Woolsey and Van der Loos, b70) seen in the nose and perioral regions. In the mouse, but not the rat, such barrels also cover the whole whisker representation (Welker and Woolsey, b74).

UBERON:0008934.name: secondary somatosensory cortex
UBERON:0008934.def: The area of the upper bank of the lateral sulcus that is involved in somatic sensation.

UBERON:0008935.name: gastropod albumen gland
UBERON:0008935.def: The posterior oviduct opens into the large white albumen gland which adds a layer of albumen to the zygote before it reaches the egg capsule gland.

UBERON:0008936.name: gastropod genital pore
UBERON:0008936.def: A small opening on the side of the head in some gastropods through which the penis is protruded.

UBERON:0008937.name: visceral hump
UBERON:0008937.def: Mollusks have three distinct divisions of their body. The head contains the sensory equipment (eyes, antennae, etc) and the primitive brain. The visceral hump, which is the main body, contains most of the organs, including a complete digestive and excretory tract as well as the reproductive organs. The visceral hump also includes the two external flaps of tissue, which are known as the mantle.

UBERON:0008939.name: pedal ganglion
UBERON:0008939.def: The pedal ganglia mainly are necessary for coordination of locomotion of a snail.

UBERON:0008940.name: parietal ganglion
UBERON:0008940.def: A lateral ganglion that innervates pallial cavity, gills and skin of a snail[BTO,modified].

UBERON:0008941.name: pleural ganglion
UBERON:0008941.def: A knot of nerves in The pallial cavity that innervates the mantle of a snail[BTO,modified].

UBERON:0008942.name: gastropod cerebral ganglion
UBERON:0008942.def: The cerebral ganglia are primarily sensual centres, that compute information from the eyes as well as from the tactile and position sensors (statocystes). Besides coordination they also serve the locational memory of a snail.

UBERON:0008943.name: headfoot
UBERON:0008943.def: The head-foot is the part you see most easily in slugs and snails. It is mostly a muscular organ covered in cilia and rich in mucous cells, which the mollusc uses to move around, it normally tapers to a tail at one end and has a head incorporated in the front. The head includes a mouth, eyes and tentacles, the last two may be much reduced or even absent. In those species with shells the head-foot can be drawn into the shell.

UBERON:0008944.name: albumen
UBERON:0008944.def: Albumen is the clear liquid contained within an egg and consists of water and proteins, among which are ovomucin and ovomucoid. It protects the egg yolk and provides additional nutrition for the growth of the embryo.

UBERON:0008945.name: extraembryonic endoderm
UBERON:0008945.def: An extraembryonic epithelium that is formed by the delaminated cells of the primitive endoderm (hypoblast) that goes on to form the yolk sac. In mammals, as in avians, these cells do not produce any part of the newborn organism (i.e. they are extraembryonic).

UBERON:0008946.name: lung parenchyma
UBERON:0008946.def: A parenchyma that is part of a lung.

UBERON:0008948.name: upper lobe of lung
UBERON:0008948.def: A lobe of the lung that is closest to the head.

UBERON:0008949.name: lower lobe of lung
UBERON:0008949.def: The bottom most subdivision of either the right or left lung.

UBERON:0008950.name: azygous lobe of lung
UBERON:0008950.def: The azygous lobe of the lung is an accessory lobe of the right lung. It is rare and usually associated with an abnormality of the azygous vein. It is produced by an aberrant position of the azygous vein near the hilum of the lung. It divides the right superior lobe near the apex of the lung down to the hilum in roughly the median plane. The fissure created, the meso-azygous fissure, is lined by both visceral and parietal pleura. The lobe lies superomedial to the fissure.

UBERON:0008951.name: left lung lobe
UBERON:0008951.def: A lobe of lung that is part of a left lung.

UBERON:0008952.name: upper lobe of left lung
UBERON:0008952.def: The lobe of the left lung that is closest to the head.

UBERON:0008953.name: lower lobe of left lung
UBERON:0008953.def: A lower lobe of lung that is part of a left lung.

UBERON:0008954.name: lingula of left lung
UBERON:0008954.def: Anterioinferior portion of left upper lung lobe.

UBERON:0008955.name: middle lobe of lung
UBERON:0008955.def: A lobe of the lung that is situated somewhere between an upper lobe and lower lobe.

UBERON:0008956.name: involucrum
UBERON:0008956.def: A layer of new bone growth outside existing bone seen in pyogenic osteomyelitis. It results from the stripping off of the periosteum by the accumulation of pus within the bone, and new bone growing from the periosteum.

UBERON:0008957.name: sequestrum
UBERON:0008957.def: A piece of dead bone that has become separated during the process of necrosis from normal/sound bone..

UBERON:0008959.name: auditory bulla
UBERON:0008959.def: A hollow bony structure on the ventral, posterior portion of the skull of placental mammals that encloses parts of the middle and inner ear. In most species, it is formed by the tympanic part of the temporal bone.

UBERON:0008960.name: melon organ
UBERON:0008960.def: The melon is an ovoid-shaped, fatty organ found in the forehead of all toothed whales (odontocetes), including dolphins and porpoises (Cranford et al., 1996; Harper, C. J., et al., 2008) and believed to be used in echolocation.

UBERON:0008961.name: parabronchus
UBERON:0008961.def: Tertiary bronchus in the avian lung.

UBERON:0008962.name: forelimb bone
UBERON:0008962.def: A bone that is part of a forelimb region. Examples: humerus, any of the phalanges. Counter-example: scapula (a bone of the pectoral girdle). Note that we consider the forelimb to end at the shoulder.

UBERON:0008963.name: hoof
UBERON:0008963.def: The tip of a toe of an ungulate mammal, strengthened by a thick horny (keratin) covering. The hoof consists of a hard or rubbery sole, and a hard wall formed by a thick nail rolled around the tip of the toe. The weight of the animal is normally borne by both the sole and the edge of the hoof wall. Hooves grow continuously, and are constantly worn down by use.

UBERON:0008964.name: abdominal ganglion of visceral hump
UBERON:0008964.def: An unpaired knot of nerves in The visceral sacs that innervates the pallial organs as well as the inner organs.

UBERON:0008967.name: centrum semiovale
UBERON:0008967.def: The semioval center is the white matter found underneath the grey matter on the surface of the cerebrum. The term is synonymous with cerebral white matter. The white matter, located in each hemisphere between the cerebral cortex and nuclei, as a whole has a semioval shape. It consists of cortical projection fibers, association fibers and cortical fibers.

UBERON:0008969.name: dental follicle
UBERON:0008969.def: A sac containing the developing tooth and its odontogenic organ. The dental follicle (DF) differentiates into the periodontal ligament. In addition, it may be the precursor of other cells of the periodontium, including osteoblasts, cementoblasts and fibroblasts. They develop into the alveolar bone, the cementum with Sharpey's fibers and the periodontal ligament fibers respectively.

UBERON:0008971.name: left colon
UBERON:0008971.def: The distal portion of the colon; it develops embryonically from the hindgut and functions in the storage and elimination of waste.

UBERON:0008972.name: right colon
UBERON:0008972.def: The proximal portion of the colon, extending from the ileocecal valve usually to a point proximal to the left colic flexure; it develops embryonically from the terminal portion of the midgut and functions in absorption.

UBERON:0008974.name: apocrine gland
UBERON:0008974.def: Any exocrine gland whose cells bud their secretions off through the plasma membrane producing membrane-bound vesicles in the lumen; the apical portion of the secretory cell of the gland pinches off and enters the lumen; it loses part of its cytoplasm in their secretions; apocrine secretion is functional during hormonal stress or puberty; an example of true apocrine glands are mammary glands, responsible for secreting breast milk.

UBERON:0008975.name: oviduct shell gland
UBERON:0008975.def: A gland in the posterior expansion of the oviduct that secretes the calcareous surroundings of the egg shell.

UBERON:0008976.name: snake venom gland
UBERON:0008976.def: The venom gland of snakes is in actual fact a modified salivary gland and is linked to the groove in the fangs by a duct.

UBERON:0008977.name: pes anserinus of tibia
UBERON:0008977.def: The pes anserinus is the insertion of the conjoined tendons of three muscles onto the anteromedial (front and inside) surface of the proximal extremity of the tibia.

UBERON:0008978.name: anal sac
UBERON:0008978.def: In carnivores, either of two sacs found between the internal and external anal sphincters, lined with sebaceous glands and in some species with apocrine glands.

UBERON:0008979.name: carcass
UBERON:0008979.def: A body of a multi-cellular organism that is no longer living.

UBERON:0008981.name: obsolete rhinencephalon
UBERON:0008981.def: The olfactory region of the brain, located in the cerebrum.

UBERON:0008982.name: fascia
UBERON:0008982.def: A dense regular connective tissue that that connects muscles together[WP, modified].

UBERON:0008987.name: renal parenchyma
UBERON:0008987.def: The functional tissue of the kidney, consisting of the nephrons.

UBERON:0008989.name: submucosal esophageal gland
UBERON:0008989.def: One of the racemose glands in the walls of the esophagus that in humans are small and serve principally to lubricate the food but in some birds secrete a milky fluid on which the young are fed.
synonym: mucous gland of submucosa of esophagus

UBERON:0008992.name: chorion frondosum
UBERON:0008992.def: The part of the chorion where the villi persist, forming the foetal part of the placenta.

UBERON:0008993.name: habenular nucleus
UBERON:0008993.def: Either of the two neural nuclei within the habenula.

UBERON:0008994.name: equine glandular stomach
UBERON:0008994.def: Stomach found in horses; includes cardiac, proper gastric and pyloric glandular zones.

UBERON:0008995.name: nucleus of cerebellar nuclear complex
UBERON:0008995.def: Four accumulations of gray substance embedded in the white substance of the cerebellum, comprising the nucleus dentatus, nucleus emboliformis, nucleus globosus, and nucleus fastigii.

UBERON:0008998.name: vasculature of brain
UBERON:0008998.def: System pertaining to blood vessels in the brain.

UBERON:0008999.name: hoof lamina
UBERON:0008999.def: The tissues which attach the third phalanx to the hoof wall.

UBERON:0009000.name: ischial spine
UBERON:0009000.def: A bony process projecting backward and medialward from the posterior border of the ischium.

UBERON:0009002.name: placental membrane
UBERON:0009002.def: The membrane separating the fetal from the maternal blood in the placenta.

UBERON:0009005.name: femorotibial joint
UBERON:0009005.def: One of the two primary bendings of a typical leg, pertains to the femur and the tibia.

UBERON:0009006.name: deep inguinal lymph node
UBERON:0009006.def: One of several small inconstant lymph nodes, proximal, intermediate and distal deep to the fascia lata and medial to the femoral vein; they receive lymph from the deep structures of the lower limb, from the glans penis and from superficial inguinal nodes; efferents pass to the external iliac nodes.

UBERON:0009007.name: superficial inguinal lymph node
UBERON:0009007.def: A group of 12-20 lymph nodes that lie in the subcutaneous tissue below the inguinal ligament and along the terminal part of the great saphenous vein; they drain the skin and subcutaneous tissue of the lower abdominal wall, perineum, buttocks, external genitalia, and lower limbs.

UBERON:0009009.name: carotid sinus nerve
UBERON:0009009.def: A sensory branch of the glossopharyngeal nerve (CN IX) carrying signals from the baroceptors (blood pressure receptors) in the bifurcation of the carotid artery to the nucleus of the solitary tract (nucleus solitarius).

UBERON:0009010.name: periurethral tissue
UBERON:0009010.def: Any portion of tissue that surrounds a urethra.

UBERON:0009013.name: white fibrocartilage
UBERON:0009013.def: Fibrocartilage in which strong bundles of white fibrous tissue predominate.

UBERON:0009014.name: lower back skin
UBERON:0009014.def: A zone of skin that is part of a lower back.

UBERON:0009015.name: upper back skin
UBERON:0009015.def: A zone of skin that is part of a dorsal thoracic segment of trunk.

UBERON:0009020.name: left uterine horn
UBERON:0009020.def: An uterine horn that is in the left side of a uterus.

UBERON:0009022.name: right uterine horn
UBERON:0009022.def: An uterine horn that is in the right side of a uterus.

UBERON:0009024.name: adrenal gland X zone
UBERON:0009024.def: A transient cortical layer juxtaposed to the medulla and the zona reticularis; in males, this zone rapidly involutes at the onset of puberty whereas this zone persists in females until the first pregnancy or later in adulthood in non-pregnant females.

UBERON:0009025.name: gastroepiploic artery
UBERON:0009025.def: One of two (right and left) arteries along the greater curvature of the stomach that supply blood to the greater omentum and stomach.

UBERON:0009026.name: iliac circumflex artery
UBERON:0009026.def: One of two (deep circumflex and superficial circumflex) iliac arteries that supply the lower abdomen, inguinal lymph nodes, sartorius, and tensor fasciae latae.

UBERON:0009027.name: vesical artery
UBERON:0009027.def: An artery that supplies blood to the urinary bladder.

UBERON:0009029.name: pudendal vein
UBERON:0009029.def: Either the internal or external pudendal vein, running from the genital-vulvar area and abdomen and down the leg.

UBERON:0009030.name: left pulmonary vein
UBERON:0009030.def: Vein that drains left lung and returns blood to the heart.

UBERON:0009032.name: right pulmonary vein
UBERON:0009032.def: Vein that drains right lung and returns blood to the heart.

UBERON:0009035.name: renal straight tubule
UBERON:0009035.def: Any region of a nephron tubule that is straight. Examples: distal convoluted tubule, proximal convoluted tuble.

UBERON:0009038.name: sulcus ampullaris
UBERON:0009038.def: The groove on the external surface of the ampulla of each semicircular duct where the nerve enters the ampullary crest.

UBERON:0009039.name: lymph node germinal center
UBERON:0009039.def: A germinal center that is located in a lymph node.

UBERON:0009040.name: deep circumflex iliac artery
UBERON:0009040.def: The deep circumflex iliac artery (or deep iliac circumflex artery) is an artery in the pelvis that travels along the iliac crest of the pelvic bone.

UBERON:0009041.name: superficial circumflex iliac artery
UBERON:0009041.def: The superficial iliac circumflex artery (or superficial circumflex iliac), the smallest of the cutaneous branches of the femoral artery, arises close to the superficial epigastric artery, and, piercing the fascia lata, runs lateralward, parallel with the inguinal ligament, as far as the crest of the ilium. It divides into branches which supply the integument of the groin, the superficial fascia, and the superficial subinguinal lymph glands, anastomosing with the deep iliac circumflex, the superior gluteal and lateral femoral circumflex arteries.

UBERON:0009042.name: prostatic venous plexus
UBERON:0009042.def: The prostatic veins form a well-marked prostatic plexus which lies partly in the fascial sheath of the prostate and partly between the sheath and the prostatic capsule. It communicates with the pudendal and vesical plexuses.

UBERON:0009044.name: pudendal venous plexus
UBERON:0009044.def: The pudendal plexus (vesicoprostatic plexus) lies behind the arcuate pubic ligament and the lower part of the pubic symphysis, and in front of the bladder and prostate. Its chief tributary is the deep dorsal vein of the penis, but it also receives branches from the front of the bladder and prostate. It communicates with the vesical plexus and with the internal pudendal vein and drains into the vesical and hypogastric veins.

UBERON:0009050.name: nucleus of solitary tract
UBERON:0009050.def: A neural nucleus that is part of the solitary tract nuclear complex. The solitary tract and nucleus are structures in the brainstem that carry and receive visceral sensation and taste from the facial (VII), glossopharyngeal (IX) and vagus (X) cranial nerves. [WP,unvetted].

UBERON:0009056.name: two-pass circulatory system
UBERON:0009056.def: A closed circulatory system in which blood passes twice through the heart to supply the body once.

UBERON:0009057.name: one-pass circulatory system
UBERON:0009057.def: A closed circulatory system in which blood passes once through the heart to supply the body once.

UBERON:0009058.name: faveolus
UBERON:0009058.def: A bellows-shaped respiratory unit extending from the outer wall of the lung into a central air space.

UBERON:0009060.name: air sac
UBERON:0009060.def: Any of the membranous air-filled extensions of the lungs of birds, which increase the efficiency of gaseous exchange in the lungs.

UBERON:0009074.name: syrinx organ
UBERON:0009074.def: Vocal organ of birds, located at the base of a trachea.

UBERON:0009075.name: membrana tympaniformis
UBERON:0009075.def: An anatomical wall that is part of a syrinx organ.

UBERON:0009078.name: pessulus
UBERON:0009078.def: A delicate bar of cartilage connecting the dorsal and ventral extremities of the first pair of bronchial cartilages in the syrinx of birds.

UBERON:0009097.name: gravid organism
UBERON:0009097.def: An organism containing a developing embryo, fetus, or unborn offspring within the body.

UBERON:0009099.name: typhlosole
UBERON:0009099.def: An invagination of the intestinal epithelium that emanates from a lamina of mesenchymal cells located between the dorsal aorta and the upper intestine and constitute one of the two principal hematopoietic organs at the ammocoete stage of development.

UBERON:0009100.name: nephric fold
UBERON:0009100.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0009100. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0009102.name: supraneural body
UBERON:0009102.def: One of the primary immunological organs of the adult lamprey is the supraneural body. This structure lies dorsal to spinal column and becomes heavily populated with lymphocytes following after immune challenge.

UBERON:0009114.name: cervical thymus
UBERON:0009114.def: A mature thymus that is entirely part of the cervical region.

UBERON:0009115.name: thoracic thymus
UBERON:0009115.def: A mature thymus that is entirely part of thoracic region.

UBERON:0009116.name: thymoid
UBERON:0009116.def: A thymus-like lympho-epithelial structures, in the tips of the gill filaments and the neighbouring secondary lamellae (both within the gill basket) of lamprey larvae.

UBERON:0009117.name: indifferent gonad
UBERON:0009117.def: A gonad prior to differentiating into a definitive testis or ovary.

UBERON:0009119.name: branchial basket
UBERON:0009119.def: The network-like non-segmented cartilaginous skeleton of the gill region of Petromyzontiformes and Holocephali, connected to the heart and surrounding respiratory tissue.

UBERON:0009120.name: gill filament
UBERON:0009120.def: Portion of tissue that projects outward from the gill and is a thread-like, soft, red respiratory and excretory structure.

UBERON:0009121.name: vomeronasal nerve
UBERON:0009121.def: Nerve carrying fibers from the vomeronasal organ epithelium to the accessory olfactory bulb.

UBERON:0009122.name: adenohypophyseal placode
UBERON:0009122.def: The adenohypophyseal placode forms the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland and gives rise to the endocrine secretory cells of the pituitary.

UBERON:0009124.name: geniculate placode
UBERON:0009124.def: Rostralmost epibranchial placode. Associated with 1st branchial cleft.

UBERON:0009125.name: petrosal placode
UBERON:0009125.def: Epibranchial placode between geniculate and nodose. Associated with 2nd branchial cleft.

UBERON:0009126.name: nodosal placode
UBERON:0009126.def: Caudalmost epibranchial placode. Associated with 3rd branchial cleft.

UBERON:0009127.name: epibranchial ganglion
UBERON:0009127.def: Cranial ganglion which develops from an epibranchial placode.

UBERON:0009128.name: lateral line placode
UBERON:0009128.def: An ectodermal placode that will develop into the components of the lateral line system.

UBERON:0009129.name: right atrium endocardium
UBERON:0009129.def: Endocardium that is part of the right atrium.

UBERON:0009132.name: peroneus
UBERON:0009132.def: One of a group of three muscles fibularis (peronæus) longus, brevis, and tertius originating on the fibula and inserting on the metatarsals.

UBERON:0009133.name: pleuroperitoneal membrane
UBERON:0009133.def: A fold of tissue which extends into the peritoneal cavity of the developing embryo and participates in the separation of the pleural and peritoneal cavities.

UBERON:0009139.name: right posterior cardinal vein
UBERON:0009139.def: A posterior cardinal vein that is in_the_right_side_of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0009140.name: right subcardinal vein
UBERON:0009140.def: A subcardinal vein that is in_the_right_side_of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0009141.name: craniocervical region vein
UBERON:0009141.def: A vein that is part of a craniocervical region.

UBERON:0009142.name: entire embryonic mesenchyme
UBERON:0009142.def: Sum total of mesenchyme in the embryo.

UBERON:0009149.name: foramen primum
UBERON:0009149.def: Opening in the septum primum between the two atria of the embryonic heart[TMD].

UBERON:0009191.name: sphenoid bone pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0009191.def: A sphenoid endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0009193.name: sphenoid cartilage element
UBERON:0009193.def: A sphenoid endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0009195.name: anal membrane
UBERON:0009195.def: The dorsal part of the cloacal membrane following its partition by the urorectal septum.

UBERON:0009197.name: basioccipital pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0009197.def: A basioccipital endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0009198.name: craniofacial suture
UBERON:0009198.def: Any suture between cranial and/or facial bones.

UBERON:0009200.name: limb epidermis
UBERON:0009200.def: The limb epidermis is the outer epithelial layer of the limb, it is a complex stratified squamous epithelium.

UBERON:0009201.name: nephric duct
UBERON:0009201.def: A nephric duct is a tube that drains a primitive kidney[GO].

UBERON:0009203.name: internasal suture
UBERON:0009203.def: A suture joining the nasal bones.

UBERON:0009204.name: medial nasal process mesenchyme
UBERON:0009204.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a medial nasal prominence.

UBERON:0009205.name: lateral nasal process mesenchyme
UBERON:0009205.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a lateral nasal prominence.

UBERON:0009206.name: lateral nasal process surface ectoderm
UBERON:0009206.def: An ectoderm that is part of a lateral nasal prominence.

UBERON:0009207.name: geschmacksstreifen
UBERON:0009207.def: Area on the rostral portion of the soft palate rich in tastebuds (Miller and Spangler 1982).

UBERON:0009210.name: pharyngeal membrane
UBERON:0009210.def: A thin fold of ectoderm and endoderm that separates the pharyngeal pouches from the pharyngeal clefts in a developing embryo.

UBERON:0009213.name: pharyngeal membrane of 1st arch
UBERON:0009213.def: A pharyngeal membrane that separates the first pharyngeal cleft from the first pharyngeal pouch.

UBERON:0009215.name: pharyngeal membrane of 2nd arch
UBERON:0009215.def: A pharyngeal membrane that separates the second pharyngeal cleft from the second pharyngeal pouch.

UBERON:0009216.name: pharyngeal membrane of 3rd arch
UBERON:0009216.def: A pharyngeal membrane that separates the third pharyngeal cleft from the third pharyngeal pouch.

UBERON:0009217.name: pharyngeal membrane of 4th arch
UBERON:0009217.def: A pharyngeal membrane that separates the fourth pharyngeal cleft from the fourth pharyngeal pouch.

UBERON:0009291.name: cartilaginous vertebral centrum
UBERON:0009291.def: Cartilaginous form of a vertebral centrum, a skeletal element that functionally replaces the notochord[VSAP,modified].

UBERON:0009468.name: basiotic bone
UBERON:0009468.def: A small bone in the fetus between the basilar process and the basisphenoid.

UBERON:0009470.name: postsphenoidal bone
UBERON:0009470.def: The posterior portion of the sphenoid bone developed in five separate parts consisting of a central basisphenoid, the two alisphenoids, and the two medial pterygoid laminae.

UBERON:0009471.name: dorsum of tongue
UBERON:0009471.def: The superior surface of the tongue divided by the sulcus terminalis into an anterior two-thirds, the presulcal part (pars presulcalis). and a posterior one-third, the postsulcal part (pars postsulcalis).

UBERON:0009472.name: axilla
UBERON:0009472.def: The axilla is the area directly under the joint where the forelimb connects to the shoulder.

UBERON:0009473.name: parapodium
UBERON:0009473.def: Either of a pair of fleshy lateral processes borne by most segments of a polychaete worm.

UBERON:0009476.name: madreporite
UBERON:0009476.def: The madreporite is an opening used to filter water into the water vascular system of echinoderms. It is visible as a small red or yellow button-like structure, looking like a small wart, on the aboral surface of the central disk of a sea star. Close up, it is visibly structured, resembling a 'madrepore' colony. From this, it derives its name. The water vascular system of the sea star consists of a series of seawater-filled ducts that function in locomotion and feeding and respiration. Its main parts are the madreporite, the stone canal, the ring canal, the radial canals, the lateral canals, and the tube feet. The sieve-like madreporite allows entry of seawater into the stone canal, which connects to the ring canal around the mouth. Five or more radial canals extend from the ring canal, one in each arm above the ambulacral groove. From the radial canals extend many lateral canals, each of which leads to a tube foot. Each tube foot is a closed cylinder with muscular walls, having a sucker at the outer end and a bulb-like ampulla at its inner end within the body cavity.

UBERON:0009477.name: associated mesenchyme of otic placode
UBERON:0009477.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a otic placode.

UBERON:0009478.name: associated mesenchyme of midgut
UBERON:0009478.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing midgut.

UBERON:0009479.name: ectoderm of buccopharyngeal membrane
UBERON:0009479.def: An ectoderm that is part of a buccopharyngeal membrane.

UBERON:0009480.name: endoderm of buccopharyngeal membrane
UBERON:0009480.def: An endoderm that is part of a buccopharyngeal membrane.

UBERON:0009481.def: A tube lumen that is part of a pericardio-peritoneal canal.

UBERON:0009482.name: associated mesenchyme of foregut-midgut junction
UBERON:0009482.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a foregut-midgut junction.

UBERON:0009483.def: A mesentery that is part of a foregut-midgut junction.

UBERON:0009494.def: A portion of mesenchymal tissue associated with an individual pharyngeal arch.

UBERON:0009497.name: epithelium of foregut-midgut junction
UBERON:0009497.def: An epithelium that is part of a foregut-midgut junction.

UBERON:0009499.name: parietal of mesothelium of pericardio-peritoneal canal

UBERON:0009500.name: periotic mesenchyme
UBERON:0009500.def: Anatomical region that surrounds the otic vesicle.

UBERON:0009501.name: mesenchyme of fronto-nasal process
UBERON:0009501.def: The embryonic connective tissue made up of loosely aggregated mesenchymal cells, supported by interlaminar jelly, that gives rise to the frontonasal region of the head.

UBERON:0009502.name: ventral mesentery of mesentery of foregut-midgut junction

UBERON:0009503.name: mesenchyme of hindgut
UBERON:0009503.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing hindgut.

UBERON:0009504.name: mesenchyme of main bronchus
UBERON:0009504.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing main bronchus.

UBERON:0009505.name: mesenchyme of trachea
UBERON:0009505.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing trachea.

UBERON:0009506.name: mesenchyme of middle ear
UBERON:0009506.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing middle ear.

UBERON:0009521.name: anal membrane endodermal component
UBERON:0009521.def: An endoderm that is part of a anal region.

UBERON:0009522.name: lateral lingual swelling epithelium
UBERON:0009522.def: An epithelium that is part of a lateral lingual swelling.

UBERON:0009523.name: mesenchyme of handplate
UBERON:0009523.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a handplate.

UBERON:0009526.name: maxillary process mesenchyme
UBERON:0009526.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a maxillary prominence.

UBERON:0009536.name: vascular element of left lung
UBERON:0009536.def: A vascular plexus that is part of a left lung.

UBERON:0009537.name: vascular element of right lung
UBERON:0009537.def: A vascular plexus that is part of a right lung.

UBERON:0009538.name: mesenchyme of sublingual gland primordium
UBERON:0009538.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a sublingual gland primordium.

UBERON:0009539.name: mesenchyme of submandibular gland primordium
UBERON:0009539.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a submandibular gland primordium.

UBERON:0009548.name: hepatic sinusoid of left of lobe of liver
UBERON:0009548.def: A hepatic sinusoid that is part of a left lobe of liver.

UBERON:0009549.name: hepatic sinusoid of right of lobe of liver
UBERON:0009549.def: A hepatic sinusoid that is part of a right lobe of liver.

UBERON:0009550.name: endoderm of foregut-midgut junction
UBERON:0009550.def: An endoderm that is part of a foregut-midgut junction.

UBERON:0009551.name: distal segment of digit
UBERON:0009551.def: A segment of a digit containing the distal phalanx, and overlapping the distal interphalangeal joint[CJM]. The digit tip is derived from multiple and distinct embryonic origins, and includes the distal bone with associated marrow cavity and haematopoietic cells, ventral (flexor) and dorsal (extensor) tendons, sweat glands with myoepithelial and luminal secreting cells and associated neurons for innervation, dermis with resident melanocytes and dendritic cells, mesenchyme with resident fibroblasts, skin epidermis with hair follicles, a nail organ composed of six specific parts (the root, nail bed, nail plate, eponychium (cuticle), perionychium and hyponychium).

UBERON:0009552.name: distal segment of manual digit
UBERON:0009552.def: A segment of the manual digit containing the distal phalanx.

UBERON:0009553.name: distal segment of pedal digit
UBERON:0009553.def: A segment of the pedal digit containing the distal phalanx. Note this class represents a digit segment and thus includes tissues in addition to bone.

UBERON:0009554.name: obsolete coffin bone
UBERON:0009554.def: The bottommost bone in the equine leg and is encased by the hoof capsule. The distal phalanx articulates with both the middle phalanx and the distal sesamoid, forming the distal interphalangeal joint.

UBERON:0009555.name: short pastern bone
UBERON:0009555.def: The middle phalanx of digit 3 in a horse.

UBERON:0009556.name: long pastern bone
UBERON:0009556.def: The proximal phalanx of digit 3 in a horse.

UBERON:0009558.name: pastern bone
UBERON:0009558.def: A bone that is part of the pastern region of a horse limb. i.e. proximal or middle (P1 or P2) phalanges in digit 3.

UBERON:0009559.name: metacarpal/tarsal-phalangeal joint
UBERON:0009559.def: A skeletal joint that connects a mesopodium bone and connects a proximal phalanx.

UBERON:0009563.name: pastern region of limb
UBERON:0009563.def: A part of the leg of a horse between the fetlock and the top of the hoof. It incorporates the long pastern bone (proximal phalanx) and the short pastern bone (middle phalanx), which are held together by two sets of paired ligaments to form the pastern joint (proximal interphalangeal joint).

UBERON:0009565.name: nail of manual digit
UBERON:0009565.def: A nail that is part of a manual digit.

UBERON:0009566.name: intestinal submucosa
UBERON:0009566.def: A submucosa that is part of a intestine.

UBERON:0009567.name: nail of pedal digit
UBERON:0009567.def: A nail that is part of a pedal digit.

UBERON:0009568.name: trunk region of vertebral column
UBERON:0009568.def: Subdivision of vertebral column that corresponds to the trunk of the body, containing the trunk/presacral vertebrae. In organisms that have a thoracic and lumbar distinction, this corresponds to the sum of both of these regions.

UBERON:0009570.name: spinal cord sulcus limitans
UBERON:0009570.def: A sulcus limitans of neural tube that is part of a future spinal cord.
UBERON:0009570.synonym: spinal cord lateral wall sulcus limitans

UBERON:0009571.name: ventral midline
UBERON:0009571.def: In protostomes (such as insects, snails and worms) as well as deuterostomes (vertebrates), the midline is an embryonic region that functions in patterning of the adjacent nervous tissue. The ventral midline in insects is a cell population extending along the ventral surface of the embryo and is the region from which cells detach to form the ventrally located nerve cords. In vertebrates, the midline is originally located dorsally. During development, it folds inwards and becomes the ventral part of the dorsally located neural tube and is then called the ventral midline, or floor plate.

UBERON:0009572.name: lumen of central canal of spinal cord
UBERON:0009572.def: A cerebrospinal fluid-filled space that runs longitudinally through the length of the entire spinal cord. The central canal is contiguous with the ventricular system of the brain. The central canal represents the adult remainder of the neural tube.
synonym: cavity of central canal of spinal cord

UBERON:0009573.name: sulcus limitans of fourth ventricle
UBERON:0009573.def: In the floor of the fourth ventricle, the sulcus limitans separates the cranial nerve motor nuclei (medial) from the sensory nuclei (lateral). In the superior part of the rhomboid fossa, it corresponds with the lateral limit of the fossa and presents a bluish-gray area, the locus ceruleus (which owes its color to an underlying patch of deeply pigmented nerve cells, termed the substantia ferruginea). [WP].

UBERON:0009576.name: medulla oblongata sulcus limitans
UBERON:0009576.def: A sulcus limitans of neural tube that is part of a future medulla oblongata.

UBERON:0009577.name: metencephalon sulcus limitans
UBERON:0009577.def: A sulcus limitans of neural tube that is part of a future metencephalon.

UBERON:0009578.name: myelencephalon sulcus limitans
UBERON:0009578.def: A sulcus limitans of neural tube that is part of a future myelencephalon.

synonym: mantle layer lateral wall spinal cord
spinal cord lateral wall mantle layer

UBERON:0009584.name: 1st arch mandibular mesenchyme
UBERON:0009584.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a 1st arch mandibular component.
synonym: mesenchymal region of mandibular component of first pharyngeal arch

UBERON:0009585.name: interdigital region mesenchyme
UBERON:0009585.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing interdigital region.

mesenchyme of interdigital region between manual digits I and II

mesenchyme of interdigital region between manual digits II and III

UBERON:0009592.def: An interdigital region mesenchyme that is part of a interdigital region between pedal digits 3 and 4.

mesenchyme of interdigital region between pedal digits III and IV

UBERON:0009593.def: An interdigital region mesenchyme that is part of a interdigital region between pedal digits 4 and 5.
synonym: interdigital region between toes 4 and 5 mesenchyme
mesenchyme of interdigital region between pedal digits IV and V

UBERON:0009596.def: An interdigital region mesenchyme that is part of a interdigital region between digits 1 and 2.

UBERON:0009597.def: An interdigital region mesenchyme that is part of a interdigital region between digits 2 and 3.

UBERON:0009599.def: An interdigital region mesenchyme that is part of a interdigital region between digits 4 and 5.

UBERON:0009600.name: mesenchyme of interdigital region of manus
UBERON:0009600.def: An interdigital region mesenchyme that is part of a manus.

UBERON:0009601.def: An interdigital region mesenchyme that is part of a pes.

UBERON:0009617.name: head paraxial mesoderm
UBERON:0009617.def: Bilateral mesenchymal mesoderm parallel and immediately adjacent to the neural tube/notochord; it generates a subset of extra-ocular, and other head, muscles.

UBERON:0009621.name: tail somite
UBERON:0009621.def: A somite that is part of a tail.

UBERON:0009622.name: pronephric proximal straight tubule
UBERON:0009622.def: A proximal straight tubule that is part of a pronephros.

UBERON:0009623.name: spinal nerve root
UBERON:0009623.def: The paired bundles of nerve fibers entering and leaving the spinal cord at each segment. The dorsal and ventral nerve roots join to form the mixed segmental spinal nerves. The dorsal roots are generally afferent, formed by the central projections of the spinal (dorsal root) ganglia sensory cells, and the ventral roots efferent, comprising the axons of spinal motor and autonomic preganglionic neurons. There are, however, some exceptions to this afferent/efferent rule.

UBERON:0009624.name: lumbar nerve
UBERON:0009624.def: The lumbar nerves are the five spinal nerves emerging from the lumbar vertebrae. They are divided into posterior and anterior divisions.

UBERON:0009625.name: sacral nerve
UBERON:0009625.def: The five sacral nerves emerge from the sacrum. Although the vertebral components of the sacrum are fused into a single bone, the sacral vertebrae are still used to number the sacral nerves. Posteriorly, they emerge from the posterior sacral foramina, and form the posterior branches of sacral nerves. Anteriorly, they emerge from the anterior sacral foramina, and contribute to the sacral plexus (S1-S4) and coccygeal plexus.

UBERON:0009629.name: coccygeal nerve
UBERON:0009629.def: The coccygeal nerve is the spinal nerve that corresponds to the coccyx bone.

UBERON:0009630.name: root of thoracic nerve
UBERON:0009630.def: A spinal nerve root that is part of a thoracic nerve.
synonym: nerve root part of thoracic spinal cord

UBERON:0009631.name: root of lumbar spinal nerve
UBERON:0009631.def: A spinal nerve root that is part of a lumbar nerve.
synonym: nerve root part of lumbar spinal cord

UBERON:0009632.name: root of cervical nerve
synonym: nerve root part of cervical spinal cord

UBERON:0009633.name: root of sacral nerve
UBERON:0009633.def: A spinal nerve root that is part of a sacral nerve.
synonym: nerve root part of sacral spinal cord

UBERON:0009634.name: root of coccygeal nerve
UBERON:0009634.def: A spinal nerve root that is part of a coccygeal nerve.

UBERON:0009635.name: parachordal cartilage
UBERON:0009635.def: Chondrocranium chondrification center that fuses with cartilages derived from sclerotome region of occipital somites forming occipital bone, hypoglossal canals and foramen magnum.

UBERON:0009636.name: prechordal cartilage
UBERON:0009636.def: Chondrocranium chondrification center that that forms anterior body of sphenoid, containing the sella turcica and posterior body of sphenoid.

UBERON:0009639.name: body of sphenoid
UBERON:0009639.def: The body of the sphenoid bone, more or less cubical in shape, is hollowed out in its interior to form two large cavities, the sphenoidal air sinuses, which are separated from each other by a septum.

UBERON:0009640.name: hypophyseal cartilage
UBERON:0009640.def: Forms around the developing pituitary, and together with prechordal cartilages creates body of sphenoid bone.

UBERON:0009641.name: ansa lenticularis
UBERON:0009641.def: The ansa lenticularis (ansa lentiformis in older texts) is a part of the brain, making up the superior layer of the substantia innominata of Meynert. Its fibers, derived from the medullary lamina of the lentiform nucleus, pass medially to end in the thalamus and subthalamic region, while others are said to end in the tegmentum and red nucleus. It is classified by NeuroNames as part of the subthalamus.
synonym: ventral peduncle of lateral forebrain bundle

UBERON:0009643.name: central tegmental tract
UBERON:0009643.def: A pathway containing fibers from midbrain nuclei that project to the inferior olivary complex, as well as fibers originating in the pontine reticular formation and the medullary reticular formation that project to several nuclei of the thalamus. It can be identified in the midbrain and the pons (Adapted from Brain Info).

UBERON:0009645.name: ampullary gland
UBERON:0009645.def: A paired accessory, glandular, androgen-dependent outpouchings of the proximal ductus deferens, one on each side, that produce and secrete lipids and glycogen, components of the seminal fluid; they open into the ampullae at the level of the colliculus seminalis, are lined by simple columnar epithelium with large, oval nuclei, and may be distinguished from those of the prostate as they are surrounded by a characteristic, dense, fibromuscular stroma.

UBERON:0009646.name: lumbar sympathetic nerve trunk
UBERON:0009646.def: A sympathetic nerve trunk that is part of a lower back.

UBERON:0009647.name: tympanic membrane epithelium
UBERON:0009647.def: One of the two epithelia which make up the tympanic membrane (along with the fibrous layer).

UBERON:0009648.name: eyelid subcutaneous connective tissue
UBERON:0009648.def: An eyelid connective tissue that is part of a hypodermis.

UBERON:0009650.name: cortical arch of kidney
UBERON:0009650.def: The portions of renal substance (cortex) intervening between the bases of the pyramids and the capsule of the kidney.

UBERON:0009651.name: nephron tubule basement membrane
UBERON:0009651.def: A basement membrane that is part of a nephron tubule.

UBERON:0009652.name: bronchus basement membrane
UBERON:0009652.def: A basement membrane that is part of a bronchus.

UBERON:0009653.name: trachea basement membrane
UBERON:0009653.def: A basement membrane that is part of a trachea.

UBERON:0009654.name: alveolar artery
UBERON:0009654.def: A branch of the maxillary artery that is found in the gingiva, premolars, and molars.

UBERON:0009655.name: auricular artery
UBERON:0009655.def: An artery that supplies oxygenated blood to the ear.

UBERON:0009659.name: spermatic artery
UBERON:0009659.def: A branch of the abdominal aorta that supplies oxygenated blood to the testis.

UBERON:0009663.name: telencephalic nucleus
UBERON:0009663.def: A nucleus of brain that is part of a telencephalon.

UBERON:0009668.name: ventral mesentery
UBERON:0009668.def: Ventral mesentery is the part of the peritoneum closest to the navel.

UBERON:0009669.name: embryonic cloacal lumen
UBERON:0009669.def: An anatomical space that surrounded_by a embryonic cloaca.

UBERON:0009670.name: rectal lumen
UBERON:0009670.def: An anatomical space that surrounded_by a rectum.

UBERON:0009671.name: nasal fin
UBERON:0009671.def: The nasal fin is an epithelial seam that develops by fusion between the epithelial linings of the medial and lateral nasal swellings. Shortly after its formation the nasal fin regresses and is replaced by mesenchyme, with exception of its most posterior portion which remains as the bucconasal membrane.

UBERON:0009672.name: oronasal membrane
UBERON:0009672.def: The oronasal membrane separates the oral cavity and nasal cavity.

UBERON:0009674.name: accessory XI nerve spinal component
UBERON:0009674.def: The spinal root of accessory nerve (or part) is firm in texture, and its fibers arise from the motor cells in the lateral part of the anterior column of the gray substance of the medulla spinalis as low as the fifth cervical nerve. Passing through the lateral funiculus of the medulla spinalis, they emerge on its surface and unite to form a single trunk, which ascends between the ligamentum denticulatum and the posterior roots of the spinal nerves; enters the skull through the foramen magnum, and is then directed to the jugular foramen, through which it passes, lying in the same sheath of dura mater as the vagus, but separated from it by a fold of the arachnoid. In the jugular foramen, it receives one or two filaments from the cranial part of the nerve, or else joins it for a short distance and then separates from it again. As its exit from the jugular foramen, it runs backward in front of the internal jugular vein in 66.6 per cent. of cases, and behind in it 33.3 per cent. The nerve then descends obliquely behind the Digastricus and Stylohyoideus to the upper part of the Sternocleidomastoideus; it pierces this muscle, and courses obliquely across the posterior triangle of the neck, to end in the deep surface of the Trapezius. As it traverses the Sternocleidomastoideus it gives several filaments to the muscle, and joins with branches from the second cervical nerve. In the posterior triangle it unites with the second and third cervical nerves, while beneath the Trapezius it forms a plexus with the third and fourth cervical nerves, and from this plexus fibers are distributed to the muscle.
UBERON:0009674.synonym: spinal part of the accessory nerve

UBERON:0009675.name: chorda tympani branch of facial nerve
UBERON:0009675.def: The chorda tympani is a nerve that branches from the facial nerve (cranial nerve VII) inside the facial canal, just before the facial nerve exits the skull via the stylomastoid foramen. Chorda tympani is a branch of the facial nerve (the seventh cranial nerve) that serves the taste buds in the front of the tongue, runs through the middle ear, and carries taste messages to the brain. The chorda tympani is part of one of three cranial nerves that are involved in taste. The taste system involves a complicated feedback loop, with each nerve acting to inhibit the signals of other nerves. The chorda tympani appears to exert a particularly strong inhibitory influence on other taste nerves, as well as on pain fibers in the tongue. When the chorda tympani is damaged, its inhibitory function is disrupted, leading to less inhibited activity in the other nerves.
synonym: facial VII nerve chorda tympani branch

UBERON:0009678.name: tooth row
UBERON:0009678.def: Anatomical cluster consisting of adjacent teeth constituting a row.

UBERON:0009679.name: set of lower jaw teeth
UBERON:0009679.def: A tooth row that is part of a skeleton of lower jaw.

UBERON:0009680.name: set of upper jaw teeth
UBERON:0009680.def: A tooth row that is part of a skeleton of upper jaw.

UBERON:0009687.name: middle cardiac vein
UBERON:0009687.def: The middle cardiac vein commences at the apex of the heart, ascends in the posterior longitudinal sulcus, and ends in the coronary sinus near its right extremity.

UBERON:0009688.name: posterior inferior cerebellar artery
UBERON:0009688.def: The posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA), the largest branch of the vertebral, is one of the three main arterial blood supplies for the cerebellum.

UBERON:0009689.name: anterior inferior cerebellar artery
UBERON:0009689.def: A basilar artery branch that supplies the anterior portion of the inferior surface of the cerebellum.

UBERON:0009692.name: lumen of pharyngotympanic tube
UBERON:0009692.def: An organ cavity that is part of a pharyngotympanic tube.

UBERON:0009695.name: epithelium of laryngopharynx
UBERON:0009695.def: An epithelium that is part of a hypopharynx.

UBERON:0009697.name: epithelium of appendix
UBERON:0009697.def: An epithelium that is part of a vermiform appendix.

UBERON:0009712.name: endocardium of right ventricle
UBERON:0009712.def: Any endocardium that is part of the right ventricle of the heart.

UBERON:0009713.name: endocardium of left ventricle
UBERON:0009713.def: Any endocardium that is part of the left ventricle of the heart.

UBERON:0009714.name: intermaxillary process
UBERON:0009714.def: The primordial mass of tissue formed by the merging of the medial nasal prominences of the embryo; it contributes to the intermaxillary portion of the upper jaw, the prolabial portion of the upper lip, and the primary palate.

UBERON:0009715.name: stomodeal lumen
UBERON:0009715.def: An anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a stomodeum.

UBERON:0009716.name: cupular organ
UBERON:0009716.def: Epithelial sense organ containing the cupula housing a gelatinous material elongated from the basement of the organ toward the atrial cavity. The basement of the cupular organ consists of two cell types: sensory cells and support cell.

UBERON:0009717.name: coronal organ
UBERON:0009717.def: Mechanoreceptor organ found in oral siphon of botryllid ascidians, made of hair cells, similar to the vertebrate octavolateralis system. A possible candidate of the vertebrate lateral line.

UBERON:0009718.name: neurohypophyseal duct
UBERON:0009718.def: Embryonic duct that is the rudiment of cerebral ganglion and and neural gland of adult in the ascidians.

UBERON:0009719.name: tunicate siphon
UBERON:0009719.def: Tubular appendage for drawing or ejecting fluids.

UBERON:0009731.name: sublaminar layers S3 or S4
UBERON:0009731.def: One of sublaminar layers S3 or S4.

UBERON:0009732.name: sublaminar layers S1 or S2 or S5
UBERON:0009732.def: One of sublaminar layers S1, S2, or S5.

UBERON:0009733.name: sublaminar layers S1 or S2 or S3
UBERON:0009733.def: One of sublaminar layers S1, S2, or S3.

UBERON:0009734.name: sublaminar layers S2 or S3 or S4
UBERON:0009734.def: One of sublaminar layers S2, S3, or S4.

UBERON:0009735.name: sublaminar layers S1 or S3 or S4
UBERON:0009735.def: One of sublaminar layers S1, S3, or S4.

UBERON:0009736.name: sublaminar layers S3 or S4 or S5
UBERON:0009736.def: One of sublaminar layers S3, S4, or S5.

UBERON:0009737.name: sublaminar layers S1 or S2 or S3 or S4
UBERON:0009737.def: One of sublaminar layers S1, S2, S3, or S4.

UBERON:0009738.name: border of sublaminar layers S1 and S2
UBERON:0009738.def: The region extending out from the boundary between layers S1 and S2.

UBERON:0009739.name: border of sublaminar layers S3 and S4
UBERON:0009739.def: The region extending out from the boundary between sublaminar layers S3 and S4.

UBERON:0009740.name: border between sublaminar layers
UBERON:0009740.def: A region of the retina corresponding to a portion of two adjacent substratum layers.

UBERON:0009742.name: proamniotic cavity
UBERON:0009742.def: The cavity of the developing embryo that is formed within the epiblast tissue prior to the closing of the proamniotic canal by the amniotic folds.

UBERON:0009743.name: visceral yolk sac cavity
UBERON:0009743.def: The closed space containing the yolk, formed by the fusion of the edges of the embryonic epiblast (hypoblast) and later surrounded by the visceral yolk sac (hypoblast and visceral yolk sac mesoderm).

UBERON:0009744.name: lymph node medullary sinus
UBERON:0009744.def: The channels in the lymph node medulla that separate the medullary cords and are crossed by a reticulum of cells and fibers and bounded by littoral cells; lymph flows through the medullary sinus from the cortical sinuses and into the efferent lymphatic vessels.

UBERON:0009745.name: lymph node medullary cord
UBERON:0009745.def: The dense rope-like structures of lymphatic tissue located between the medullary sinuses in the medulla of a lymph node.

UBERON:0009746.name: head fold of embryonic disc
UBERON:0009746.def: The crescent-shaped, ventrally located fold of the embryonic disc at the future cephalic end of the developing embryo.

UBERON:0009747.name: tail fold of embryonic disc
UBERON:0009747.def: The crescent-shaped, ventrally located fold of the embryonic disc at the future caudal end of the developing embryo.

UBERON:0009748.name: cephalic neural fold
UBERON:0009748.def: The elevated margins of the neural groove that are located in the future cephalic region of the embryo.

UBERON:0009749.name: limb mesenchyme
UBERON:0009749.def: The primordial embryonic connective tissue of the developing limbs, autopods and digits, consisting of mesenchymal cells supported in interlaminar jelly, that derive mostly from the mesoderm and contribute to limb connective tissue, bone and musculature in conjunction with myotome cells.

UBERON:0009751.name: cardiac mesenchyme
UBERON:0009751.def: The embryonic connective tissue made up of loosely aggregated mesenchymal cells, supported by interlaminar jelly, that gives rise to the developing cardiac structures.

UBERON:0009752.name: pancreas mesenchyme
UBERON:0009752.def: The embryonic connective tissue made up of loosely aggregated mesenchymal cells, supported by interlaminar jelly, that gives rise to the developing pancreas.

UBERON:0009754.name: blubber
UBERON:0009754.def: A thick layer of vascularized adipose tissue found under the skin of all cetaceans, pinnipeds and sirenians.

UBERON:0009755.name: spermaceti
UBERON:0009755.def: Wax present in the head cavities of the sperm whale.

UBERON:0009757.name: ambergris
UBERON:0009757.def: A biliary secretion of the intestines of the sperm whale.

UBERON:0009758.name: abdominal ganglion
UBERON:0009758.def: A ganglion that is part of a abdominal segment of trunk.

UBERON:0009767.name: proximal interphalangeal joint
UBERON:0009767.def: An inter-phalangeal joint that connects a proximal phalanx to either a medial or distal phalanx.

UBERON:0009768.name: distal interphalangeal joint
UBERON:0009768.def: An inter-phalangeal joint that connects a distal phalanx to either a medial or proximal phalanx.

UBERON:0009771.name: left anterior cardinal vein
UBERON:0009771.def: An anterior cardinal vein that is in_the_left_side_of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0009772.name: right anterior cardinal vein
UBERON:0009772.def: An anterior cardinal vein that is in_the_right_side_of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0009773.name: renal tubule
UBERON:0009773.def: A renal tubule is a tube that filters, re-absorbs and secretes substances to rid an organism of waste and to play a role in fluid homeostasis.

UBERON:0009775.name: lateral medullary reticular complex
UBERON:0009775.def: A nuclear complex of the medullary reticular formation that can be divided into three subnuclei: the parvocellular, magnocellular and the subtrigeminal[WP,modified].
synonym: lateral group of medullary reticular formation
lateral reticular formation of the medulla oblongata

UBERON:0009777.name: intermediate reticular nucleus
UBERON:0009777.def: A nucleus of brain that is part of a intermediate reticular formation.

UBERON:0009778.name: pleural sac
UBERON:0009778.def: A serous sac that has the pleura and the pleural cavity as parts.

UBERON:0009779.name: cardiac muscle tissue of right auricle
UBERON:0009779.def: A cardiac muscle tissue that is part of a right atrium auricular region.
synonym: cardiac muscle of right auricular region
right atrium auricular region heart muscle

UBERON:0009780.name: cardiac muscle tissue of left auricle
UBERON:0009780.def: A cardiac muscle tissue that is part of a left atrium auricular region.
synonym: cardiac muscle of left auricular region
left atrium auricular region heart muscle

UBERON:0009834.name: dorsolateral prefrontal cortex
UBERON:0009834.def: The dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DL-PFC or DLPFC), according to a more restricted definition, is roughly equivalent to Brodmann areas 9 and 46.[1] According to a broader definition DL-PFC consists of the lateral portions of Brodmann areas 9 - 12, of areas 45, 46, and the superior part of area 47.[2] These regions mainly receive their blood supply from the middle cerebral artery. With respect to neurotransmitter systems, there is evidence that dopamine plays a particularly important role in DL-PFC.[2]DL-PFC is connected to the orbitofrontal cortex, and to a variety of brain areas, which include the thalamus, parts of the basal ganglia (the dorsal caudate nucleus), the hippocampus, and primary and secondary association areas of neocortex, including posterior temporal, parietal, and occipital areas.

UBERON:0009835.name: anterior cingulate cortex
UBERON:0009835.def: The frontal part of the cingulate cortex that resembles a collar form around the corpus callosum. It includes both the ventral and dorsal areas of the cingulate cortex. Wikipedia:File:Gray727.svg.

UBERON:0009840.name: lower rhombic lip
UBERON:0009840.def: Posterior portion of the rhombic lip contained within rhombomeres 2-8. Gives rise to several brainstem nuclei and choroid plexus.

UBERON:0009841.name: upper rhombic lip
UBERON:0009841.def: Anterior-most region of dorsal hindbrain within rhombomere 1, adjacent the midbrain-hindbrain boundary.

UBERON:0009842.name: glandular acinus
UBERON:0009842.def: The many-lobed berry cluster of cells that is the terminous of a gland where the secretion is produced is acinar in form.

UBERON:0009843.name: prostate epithelial cord
UBERON:0009843.def: A solid cord of prostate epithelium.

UBERON:0009844.name: urogenital sinus lumen
UBERON:0009844.def: An anatomical space that surrounded_by a primitive urogenital sinus.

UBERON:0009845.name: urogenital sinus mesenchyme
UBERON:0009845.def: Mesenchyme that surrounds primitive urogenital sinus.

UBERON:0009846.name: embryonic cloacal epithelium
UBERON:0009846.def: An epithelium that is part of a embryonic cloaca.

UBERON:0009847.name: prostate field
UBERON:0009847.def: A specific region of the urogenital sinus epithelium into the area in which the prostate gland will develop.

UBERON:0009848.name: zona limitans intrathalamica
UBERON:0009848.def: A narrow stripe of cells that lies between the prospective dorsal and ventral thalami. This boundary contains signals that pattern the prethalamic and thalamic territories of the future mid-diencephalon.

UBERON:0009849.name: tadpole stage
UBERON:0009849.def: Wholly aquatic larval stage in the life cycle of an amphibian, particularly of a frog or toad[WP]. XAO: The stages from feeding to the end of metamorphosis. Encompasses Weisz's first-form tadpole (equivalent to NF stages 45 to 49), second-form tadpole (NF 49 to 56) and third-form tadpole (NF 56 to 60-plus) stages.

UBERON:0009850.name: nematode larva
UBERON:0009850.def: A multicellular organism that existence_starts_and_ends_during a nematode larval stage.

UBERON:0009851.name: border of sublaminar layers S4 and S5
UBERON:0009851.def: The intersection of sublaminar layers S4 and S5.

UBERON:0009852.name: border of sublaminar layers S2 and S3
UBERON:0009852.def: The intersection of sublaminar layers S2 and S3.

UBERON:0009853.name: body of uterus
UBERON:0009853.def: The part of the uterus above the isthmus and below the orifices of the uterine tubes.

UBERON:0009854.name: digestive tract diverticulum
UBERON:0009854.def: Branch or outpocketing of the digestive tract.

UBERON:0009855.name: echinoderm gastric caecum
UBERON:0009855.def: Non-contractile pouch that is connected to the anterior stomach through a slit-like opening. This pouch is also well-connected to the haemal system through numerous haemal ducts within its connective tissue layer.

UBERON:0009857.name: cavum septum pellucidum
UBERON:0009857.def: A space enclosed within the laminae of the septum pelludicum, the membranous partition that seperates the frontal horns of the ventricle. contains cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that filters from the ventricles through the septal laminae. bounded anteriorly by the genu of the corpus callosum; superiorly by the body of the corpus callosum; posteriorly by the anterior limb and pillars of the fornix; inferiorly by the anterior commissure and the rostrum of the corpus callosum; and laterally by the leaflets of the septum pellucidum.

UBERON:0009859.name: endosteum
UBERON:0009859.def: A thin layer of connective tissue that lines the surface of the bony tissue that forms the medullary cavity of long bones.

UBERON:0009861.name: ascidian neural complex
UBERON:0009861.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0009861. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0009862.name: ascidian cerebral ganglion
UBERON:0009862.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0009862. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0009863.name: ascidian ciliated funnel
UBERON:0009863.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0009863. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0009864.name: ascidian neural gland
UBERON:0009864.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0009864. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0009865.name: Hatschek's pit
UBERON:0009865.def: A deep ciliated fossa on the dorsal midline of the buccal cavity (the region of the gut behind the mouth). Among other things, it secrets mucus which entraps food particles from the water[WP].

UBERON:0009866.name: Hatschek's nephridium
UBERON:0009866.def: An unpaired kidney whose duct opens into the anterior pharynx. It can be seen as a deep ciliated fossa on the dorsal midline of the buccal cavity (mouth). Among other things, it secrets mucus which entraps food particles from the water[WP].

UBERON:0009868.name: Hatschek's left diverticulum
UBERON:0009868.def: A Hatschek's diverticulum that is in the left side of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0009869.name: Hatschek's right diverticulum
UBERON:0009869.def: A Hatschek's diverticulum that is in the right side of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0009870.name: zone of stomach
UBERON:0009870.def: A division of the stomach. The stomach can be divided based on mucosal histology (glandular epithelium and gastric glands) and the relative position and type of gastric gland.

UBERON:0009871.name: nephrogenic zone
UBERON:0009871.def: Outer portion of the renal cortex. Site of formation of medullary and cortical elements.

UBERON:0009877.name: metapodium region
UBERON:0009877.def: Intermediate segment of the autopod, between the mesopodial region and and acropodial region. Examples: metacarpal region, metatarsal region.
synonym: metacarpal or metatarsal part of limb

UBERON:0009878.name: mesopodial skeleton
UBERON:0009878.def: The collection of all skeletal elements in a mesopodium. Examples: the tarsal skeleton, the carpal skeleton.

UBERON:0009879.name: tarsal skeleton
UBERON:0009879.def: Subdivision of skeleton that consists of endochondral elements distal to the zeugopodial skeletal elements which constitute the proximal region of the posterior autopod skeleton[PHENOSCAPE:ad].

UBERON:0009880.name: carpal skeleton
UBERON:0009880.def: Subdivision of skeleton that consists of the endochondral elements distal to the anterior limb/fin zeugopodial skeletal elements which constitute the proximal region of the anterior autopod skeleton[PHENOSCAPE:ad].

UBERON:0009882.name: anal column
UBERON:0009882.def: One of a number of vertical folds, produced by an infolding of the mucous membrane and some of the muscular tissue in the upper half of the lumen of the anal canal[WP].

UBERON:0009883.name: medullary ray
UBERON:0009883.def: A renal, cortical lobule, consisting of the ascending or descending limbs of the loop of Henle or of the collecting tubules; medullary rays are regions where parallel arrays of straight tubules travel perpendicular to the capsule and extend from the cortex to the medulla.

UBERON:0009885.name: interlobar artery
UBERON:0009885.def: An artery that supplies a renal lobe.
synonym: set of interlobar arteries of kidney

UBERON:0009887.name: interlobar vein
UBERON:0009887.def: The interlobar veins are veins of the renal circulation which drain the renal lobes.
synonym: set of interlobar veins of kidney

UBERON:0009888.name: Koller's sickle
UBERON:0009888.def: A local thickening of cells that acts as a margin separating sheets of cells from posterior margin of avian blastoderms from hypoblasts as they migrate anteriorly to push primary hypoblast cells anteriorly to form a secondary hypoblast known as the endoblast.

UBERON:0009889.name: secondary heart field
