UBERON:0009889.def: A specific region of the lateral mesoderm that will form the majority of the mesodermal component of the right ventricle, arterial pole (outflow tract) and venous pole (inflow tract).

UBERON:0009890.name: anterior intestinal portal
UBERON:0009890.def: Opening of the foregut into the midgut.

UBERON:0009891.name: facial mesenchyme
UBERON:0009891.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing face.

UBERON:0009897.name: right auditory cortex
UBERON:0009897.def: An auditory cortex that is in the left side of a brain.

UBERON:0009898.name: left auditory cortex
UBERON:0009898.def: An auditory cortex that is in the right side of a brain.

UBERON:0009899.name: pole of cerebral hemisphere
UBERON:0009899.def: The anterior end of the hemisphere is named the frontal pole. The posterior end is named the occipital pole. The anterior end of the temporal lobe, the temporal pole.

UBERON:0009906.name: root of optic nerve
UBERON:0009906.def: A nerve root that extends_fibers_into a nerve connecting eye with brain.

UBERON:0009907.name: sensory root of trigeminal nerve
synonym: sensory root of the trigeminal nerve

UBERON:0009912.name: anatomical lobe
UBERON:0009912.def: A portion of an organ, such as the liver, lung, breast, or brain.

UBERON:0009913.name: renal lobe
UBERON:0009913.def: The portion of a kidney consisting of a renal medullary pyramid and the renal cortex above it[MP]. It is composed of many renal lobules[WP].

UBERON:0009914.name: renal lobule
UBERON:0009914.def: The portion of a renal lobe consisting of nephrons grouped around a single medullary ray and draining into a single collecting duct; human kidneys have multilobular, multipapillary architecture while mice and rats have unilobular, unipapillary kidneys.

UBERON:0009916.name: wall of ureter
UBERON:0009916.def: An anatomical wall that is part of a ureter.

UBERON:0009917.name: kidney corticomedullary boundary
UBERON:0009917.def: The region demarcating the renal medulla from the surrounding cortex; end-stage renal failure may be associated with loss of the normal corticomedullary boundary.

UBERON:0009918.name: retrotrapezoid nucleus
UBERON:0009918.def: The loose collection of neurons that reside in the rostral medulla close to the medullary surface, ventral and immediately caudal of nVII, that are crucial for CO2 sensing in the brain.

UBERON:0009919.name: ureter smooth muscle
UBERON:0009919.def: The smooth muscle tissue surrounding the epithelium of the ureter.

UBERON:0009949.name: humeral diverticulum of clavicular air sac

UBERON:0009951.name: main olfactory bulb
UBERON:0009951.def: The main olfactory bulb has a multi-layered cellular architecture. In order from surface to the center the layers are: Glomerular layer, External plexiform layer, Mitral cell layer, Internal plexiform layer, Granule cell layer[WP].

UBERON:0009952.name: dentate gyrus subgranular zone
UBERON:0009952.def: A narrow layer of cells located between the granule cell layer and hilus of the dentate gyrus, where adult neurogenesis occurs.

UBERON:0009953.name: post-embryonic organism
UBERON:0009953.def: A multicellular organism that existence_starts_with a post-embryonic stage.

UBERON:0009954.name: vomeronasal system
UBERON:0009954.def: A vertebrate nasal chemosensory system that is responsible for detecting intraspecific pheromonal cues as well as environmental odorants.

UBERON:0009955.name: neurogenic placode
UBERON:0009955.def: Cranial ectodermal placode with potential to develop into a component of the nervous system, such as nerves or ganglia.

UBERON:0009956.name: corpuscle of de Quatrefage
UBERON:0009956.def: A specialised sensory organ located in the subepidermal connective tissue at the rostral end of late larval and adult amphioxus. They consist of between 1 and 4 nerve cells with axons, each with 2 cilia, surrounded by up to 7 sheath cells. The cilia extend into a protrusion of the basal lamina which surrounds each corpuscle. The axonal process contributes to the rostral nerve.

UBERON:0009958.name: bladder lumen
UBERON:0009958.def: An anatomical space that is enclosed by a urinary bladder.

UBERON:0009959.name: lumen of oropharynx
UBERON:0009959.def: An anatomical space that is enclosed by a oropharynx.

UBERON:0009960.name: esophagus smooth muscle circular layer
UBERON:0009960.def: A circular muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a esophagus.
synonym: inner circular muscle layer of esophagus

UBERON:0009961.name: esophagus smooth muscle longitudinal layer
synonym: outer longitudinal muscle layer of esophagus

UBERON:0009962.name: excretory gland
UBERON:0009962.def: A gland that discharges its secretion through a duct opening on an internal or external surface of the body, as a lacrimal gland.

UBERON:0009963.name: antennal gland
UBERON:0009963.def: Excretory gland situated in the basal article of the antennal peduncle. It functions to rehulate ionic balance.

UBERON:0009964.name: crustacean maxillary gland
UBERON:0009964.def: Excretory organ in maxillary segment with duct opening on maxilla.

UBERON:0009965.name: coxal gland
UBERON:0009965.def: A gland found in some arthropods, for collecting and excreting urine. The gland comprises an end sac (saccule), a long duct (labyrinth) and a terminal bladder (reservoir). There is generally only one pair (two in some spiders), and they open on the coxae of the walking legs[WP].

UBERON:0009966.name: internodal tract
UBERON:0009966.def: A conducting pathway in the conducting tissue of heart through which electrical activity spreads from the SA node to the AV node.

UBERON:0009967.name: spleen venous sinus
synonym: venous sinus of red pulp of spleen

UBERON:0009970.name: epithelium of pancreatic duct
UBERON:0009970.def: An epithelium that is part of a pancreatic duct.

UBERON:0009971.name: principal gastric gland
UBERON:0009971.def: One of the gastric glands that secretes the hydrochloric acid of the gastric juice[Stedman's].
synonym: principal gland of fundus of stomach

UBERON:0009972.name: ureteropelvic junction
UBERON:0009972.def: The junction between the ureter and the renal pelvis of the kidney.

UBERON:0009973.name: ureterovesical junction
UBERON:0009973.def: The valve-like structure found at the site of entry of the ureter into the urinary bladder, normally displays an oblique angulation through the detrusor to avoid reflux of urine up the ureters and the kidney.

UBERON:0009974.name: lumen of Rathke's pouch
UBERON:0009974.def: An anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a Rathke's pouch.

UBERON:0009975.name: remnant of lumen of Rathke's pouch

UBERON:0009976.name: hypothalamo-hypophyseal system
UBERON:0009976.def: An intrinsic circulatory network that transports hormones from the median eminence of the hypothalamus to the adenohypophysis.
synonym: set of portal veins of hypophysis

UBERON:0009977.name: natal tooth
UBERON:0009977.def: Predeciduous teeth present at birth. They may be well formed and normal or may represent hornified epithelial structures without roots. They are found on the gingivae over the crest of the ridge and arise from accessory buds of the dental lamina ahead of the deciduous buds or from buds of the accessory dental lamina. (From Jablonski, Dictionary of Dentistry, 1992).

UBERON:0009979.name: condyle
UBERON:0009979.def: An articular prominence of a bone, typically present in pairs, resembling a pair of knuckles. Examples: Condyle of humerus, condyle of femur.

UBERON:0009980.name: condyle of femur
UBERON:0009980.def: A condyle that is part of a distal epiphysis of femur.

UBERON:0009984.name: medial condyle of femur
UBERON:0009984.def: The medial condyle is one of the two projections on the lower extremity of femur. The medial condyle is larger than the lateral (outer) condyle due to more weight bearing caused by the center of gravity being medial to the knee. On the posterior surface of the condyle the linea aspera (a ridge running down the posterior shaft of the femur) turns into the medial supracondylar ridge. The outermost protrusion on the medial surface of the medial condyle is referred to as the 'medial epicondyle' and can be palpated by running fingers medially from the patella with the knee in flexion.

UBERON:0009985.name: lateral condyle of femur
UBERON:0009985.def: The lateral condyle is one of the two projections on the lower extremity of femur. It is the more prominent and is the broader both in its antero-posterior and transverse diameters.

UBERON:0009986.name: lateral epicondyle of femur
UBERON:0009986.def: The lateral epicondyle of the femur, smaller and less prominent than the medial epicondyle, gives attachment to the fibular collateral ligament of the knee-joint. Directly below it is a small depression from which a smooth well-marked groove curves obliquely upward and backward to the posterior extremity of the condyle.

UBERON:0009987.name: medial epicondyle of femur
UBERON:0009987.def: The medial epicondyle of the femur is a bony protrusion located on the medial side of the bone's distal end. Located above the medial condyle, it bears an elevation, the adductor tubercle, which serves for the attachment of the superficial part, or 'tendinous insertion', of the adductor magnus. This tendinous part here forms an intermuscular septum which forms the medial separation between the thigh's flexors and extensors. Behind it, and proximally to the medial condyle is a rough impression which gives origin to the medial head of the Gastrocnemius.

UBERON:0009988.name: condyle of humerus
UBERON:0009988.def: The distal end of the humerus, including the trochlea, capitulum and the olecranon, coronoid and radial fossae.

UBERON:0009989.name: condyle of tibia
UBERON:0009989.def: One of the lateral or medial condyles of the tibia.

UBERON:0009990.name: medial condyle of tibia
UBERON:0009990.def: The medial condyle is the medial portion of the upper extremity of tibia. It is the site of insertion for the Semimembranosus muscle[WP].

UBERON:0009991.name: lateral condyle of tibia
UBERON:0009991.def: The lateral condyle is the lateral portion of the upper extremity of tibia. It serves as the insertion for the Biceps femoris muscle[WP].

UBERON:0009992.name: cranial sensory ganglion
UBERON:0009992.def: The ganglion found on the root of each cranial nerve, containing the cell bodies of afferent (sensory) neurons.

UBERON:0009993.name: primary chorionic villus
UBERON:0009993.def: A chorionic villus that is a solid outgrowth of the cytotrophoblast that protrudes into the syncytiotrophoblast.

UBERON:0009994.name: secondary chorionic villus
UBERON:0009994.def: A chorionic villus that is has a core of loose connective tissue, which in humans grows into the primary villi about the third week of development.

UBERON:0009995.name: tertiary chorionic villus
UBERON:0009995.def: Tertiary chorionic villi contain embryonic blood vessels that develop from mesenchymal cells in the loose connective tissue core. These blood vessels connect up with vessels that develop in the chorion and connecting stalk and begin to circulate embryonic blood about the third week of development in humans.

UBERON:0010000.name: multicellular anatomical structure
UBERON:0010000.def: An anatomical structure that has more than one cell as a part.

UBERON:0010001.name: cell cluster organ
UBERON:0010001.def: A small cluster of cells of various types which form a discrete structure, largely delimited by a morphological boundary and whose components work together to make the whole structure capable of a specific function.

UBERON:0010002.name: pulmonary neuroendocrine body
UBERON:0010002.def: Corpuscular, organoid structures composed of PNECs, found as distinctive innervated clusters only within intrapulmonary airways, where they appear concentrated at airway branch points; NEBs reach from the basement membrane to the airway lumen and are thought to function as oxygen sensors.

UBERON:0010005.name: placental labyrinth villous
UBERON:0010005.def: The vascularized and branched structures arising from the rodent trophoblast-derived epithelium that allow an increase its surface area for the efficient exchange of nutrients and wastes between the maternal and fetal circulation.

UBERON:0010006.name: placenta intervillous maternal lacunae
UBERON:0010006.def: The spaces of the placenta occupied by maternal blood, into which the fetal labyrinth villi project.

UBERON:0010007.name: placenta fetal blood space
UBERON:0010007.def: The spaces of the placenta occupied by fetal blood, primarily within the fetal labyrinth villi.

UBERON:0010008.name: placental cotyledon
UBERON:0010008.def: Round structure consisting of chorionic villi[PMID]. A separation of the decidua basalis of the placenta, separated by placental septa. Each cotyledon consists of a main stem of a chorionic villus as well as its branches and subbranches. The cotyledons receive fetal blood from chorionic vessels, which branch off cotyledon vessels into the cotyledons, which, in turn, branch into capillaries. The cotyledons are surrounded by maternal blood, which can exchange oxygen and nutrients with the fetal blood in the capillaries[WP].

UBERON:0010009.name: aggregate regional part of brain
UBERON:0010009.def: A regional part of brain consisting of multiple brain regions that are not related through a simple volummetric part of hierarchy, e.g., basal ganglia[NIF].

UBERON:0010010.name: basal nucleus of telencephalon
UBERON:0010010.def: A group of neurons in the basal forebrain that has wide projections to the neocortex and is rich in acetylcholine and choline acetyltransferase. It undergoes degeneration in paralysis agitans and Alzheimer's disease.
synonym: nucleus of the horizontal limb of the diagonal band (Price-Powell)

UBERON:0010011.name: collection of basal ganglia
UBERON:0010011.def: Subcortical masses of gray matter in the forebrain and midbrain that are richly interconnected and so viewed as a functional system. The nuclei usually included are the caudate nucleus (caudoputamen in rodents), putamen, globus pallidus, substantia nigra (pars compacta and pars reticulata) and the subthalamic nucleus. Some also include the nucleus accumbens and ventral pallidum.

UBERON:0010014.name: epigonal organ
UBERON:0010014.def: An elongate paired tissue ventral to the kidneys and partialy enveloping the anterior gonads in Elasmobranchii. Apparently important to the immune system.

UBERON:0010015.name: ventral patch of Leydig's organ
UBERON:0010015.def: The ventralmost of the two bodies of the elasmopbranch hemopoietic organ betweean the esophageal mucosa and muscularis.

UBERON:0010016.name: spiral valve of intestine
UBERON:0010016.def: Coiled structure in the lumen of the small intestine that increases the length of the route through the digestive tract.[WP,cjm,Kardong].

UBERON:0010017.name: spiral valve of cystic duct
UBERON:0010017.def: A series of crescentic folds of mucous membrane somewhat spirally arranged on the interior of the gallbladder and continuing into the cystic duct.

UBERON:0010018.name: spiral valve of conus arteriosus
UBERON:0010018.def: The spiral valve alternately blocks & unblocks the entrances to the left and right pulmonary arches (sending unoxygenated blood to the skin & lungs).

UBERON:0010019.name: spiracle (sensu Vertebrata)
UBERON:0010019.def: A small hole behind each eye that opens to the mouth in some fish. In the primitive jawless fish the first gill opening immediately behind the mouth is essentially similar to the other gill openings.

UBERON:0010020.name: tubotympanic recess epithelium
UBERON:0010020.def: The dorsal portion of the embryonic first endodermal pharyngeal pouch; it develops into the middle ear cavity.

UBERON:0010021.name: dorsal part of pharyngeal pouch 1
synonym: dorsal elongation of first pouch endoderm

UBERON:0010022.name: ventral part of pharyngeal pouch 1
synonym: ventral elongation of first pouch endoderm

UBERON:0010023.name: dorsal part of pharyngeal pouch 2
synonym: dorsal elongation of second pouch endoderm

UBERON:0010024.name: ventral part of pharyngeal pouch 2
synonym: ventral elongation of second pouch endoderm

UBERON:0010025.name: dorsal part of pharyngeal pouch 3
synonym: cranial dorsal aspect of third dorsal pharyngeal pouch

UBERON:0010026.name: ventral part of pharyngeal pouch 3
synonym: caudal ventral aspect of third dorsal pharyngeal pouch

UBERON:0010031.name: 6th arch mesenchyme
UBERON:0010031.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a pharyngeal arch 6.

UBERON:0010032.name: anterior part of tongue
UBERON:0010032.def: The portion of the tongue in front of the terminal sulcus. At the apex, thin and narrow, it is directed forward against the lingual surfaces of the lower incisor teeth. It is derived primarily from the first pharyngeal arch.
synonym: anterior two thirds of the tongue

UBERON:0010033.name: posterior part of tongue
UBERON:0010033.def: The Posterior tongue, or pharyngeal part, is the part of the tongue behind the terminal sulcus. At its root, it is directed backward, and connected with the hyoid bone by the Hyoglossi and Genioglossi muscles and the hyoglossal membrane; with the epiglottis by three folds (glossoepiglottic) of mucous membrane; with the soft palate by the glossopalatine arches; and with the pharynx by the Constrictores pharyngis superiores and the mucous membrane. It is derived primarily from the third pharyngeal arch. (The second arch has a substantial contribution during fetal development, but this later atrophies. The fourth arch may also contribute, depending upon how the boundaries of the tongue are defined.).
synonym: pharyngeal portion of dorsum of tongue
posterior part of dorsum of tongue
postsulcal part of dorsum of tongue

UBERON:0010034.name: copula linguae
UBERON:0010034.def: A single midventral prominence deriving from the ventral bases of pharyngeal arches 2, 3 and 4 - provides the covering of the posterior of the tongue //The furcula is at first separated from the tuberculum impar by a depression, but later by a ridge, the copula, formed by the forward growth and fusion of the ventral ends of the second, third, and part of the fourth branchial arches[WP].

UBERON:0010036.name: anterior tegmental nucleus
UBERON:0010036.def: A group of cells located ventral to the decussation of the superior cerebellar peduncle in the mouse ( Paxinos-2001 ) and rat ( Swanson-1998 ).

UBERON:0010038.name: fundic gastric gland
UBERON:0010038.def: The fundus glands (or fundic glands, or gastric glands) are found in the body and fundus of the stomach. They are simple tubes, two or more of which open into a single duct.
synonym: gastric gland of fundus of stomach

UBERON:0010039.name: food storage organ
UBERON:0010039.def: An organ of the digestive tract that is capable of retaining and storing food.

UBERON:0010040.name: stomach non-glandular epithelium
UBERON:0010040.def: Am epithelium that lines the stomach which lacks glands. In addition to a glandular epithelium, the stomachs of some vertebrates also has a second region characterized by a nonglandular epithelium, devoid of gastric glands.

UBERON:0010042.name: 1st arch mesenchyme
UBERON:0010042.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a pharyngeal arch 1.

UBERON:0010045.name: 1st arch maxillary mesenchyme
UBERON:0010045.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a 1st arch maxillary component.

UBERON:0010046.name: entire pharyngeal arch associated mesenchyme
UBERON:0010046.def: The sum total of mesenchymal tissue in the pharyngeal arch region. Pharyngeal mesenchyme is undifferentiated, loose connective tissue derived mostly from mesoderm, and also contains ectodermally derived neural crest cells.

UBERON:0010047.name: oral gland
UBERON:0010047.def: Gland of the epithelium lining the oral cavity. The most common are the salivary glands.

UBERON:0010048.name: Duvernoy's gland
UBERON:0010048.def: A gland situated on the upper lip posterior to the eye, found in non-venomous snakes. Releases secretion via duct adjacent to posterior maxillary teeth.

UBERON:0010049.name: supralabial gland
UBERON:0010049.def: Oral gland in reptiles situated immediately above the lip.

UBERON:0010050.name: infralabial gland
UBERON:0010050.def: Oral gland in reptiles situated immediately below the lip.

UBERON:0010051.name: dorsal patch of Leydig's organ
UBERON:0010051.def: The dosralmost of the two bodies of the elasmopbranch hemopoietic organ betweean the esophageal mucosa and muscularis.

UBERON:0010052.name: mucosa of dorsum of tongue
UBERON:0010052.def: A mucosa that is part of a dorsum of tongue.
UBERON:0010052.synonym: mucosa of dorsal surface of tongue

UBERON:0010053.name: echolocation organ
UBERON:0010053.def: Any organ that plays a role in the process of echolocation.

UBERON:0010054.name: malleus cartilage element
UBERON:0010054.def: A malleus endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010055.name: stapes cartilage element
UBERON:0010055.def: A stapes endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010056.name: future tongue
UBERON:0010056.def: A compound organ that has the potential to develop into a tongue.

UBERON:0010060.name: pharyngeal opening of pharyngotympanic tube
UBERON:0010060.def: On the lateral wall of the nasal part of the pharynx is the pharyngeal opening of auditory tube (pharyngeal ostium), somewhat triangular in shape, and bounded behind by a firm prominence, the torus or cushion, caused by the medial end of the cartilage of the tube which elevates the mucous membrane.

UBERON:0010064.name: open anatomical space
UBERON:0010064.def: An anatomical space with at least one opening to another space or the exterior.

UBERON:0010066.name: tympanic plate
UBERON:0010066.def: The tympanic part of the temporal bone is a curved plate of bone lying below the squama and in front of the mastoid process.

UBERON:0010069.name: outer epithelial layer of tympanic membrane
UBERON:0010069.def: A portion of the external acoustic meatus epithelium which makes up the outer (cuticular) layer of the tympanic membrane.
synonym: outer cuticular layer of tympanic membrane
tympanic membrane external acoustic meatus epithelial component

UBERON:0010070.name: intermediate layer of tympanic membrane
UBERON:0010070.def: The intermediate fibrous layer of the tympanic membrane.
synonym: connective tissue layer of tympanic membrane
intermediate fibrous layer of tympanic membrane

UBERON:0010074.name: chromaffin system
UBERON:0010074.def: Organ system subdivision that consists primarily of chromaffin cells and their supporting structures.

UBERON:0010075.name: sacral neural crest
UBERON:0010075.def: One of the 5 distinct and partially overlapping functional domains of the premigratory neural crest. The vagal and sacral neural crest cells develop into the ganglia of the enteric nervous system, also known as the parasympathetic ganglia.

UBERON:0010076.name: network of trabecular spaces in bone tissue
UBERON:0010076.def: Tissue cavity consisting of intercommunicating trabecular spaces in the cancellous bone.

UBERON:0010077.name: cuboidal epithelium
UBERON:0010077.def: An epithelium consisting of cuboidal epithelial cells.

UBERON:0010081.name: future common hepatic duct
UBERON:0010081.def: An extrahepatic bile duct that has the potential to develop into a common hepatic duct.

UBERON:0010083.name: future dermis
UBERON:0010083.def: Mesenchyme that has the potential to develop into a dermis.

UBERON:0010084.name: future diaphragm
UBERON:0010084.def: A structure that will develop into a diaphragm.

UBERON:0010090.name: future falx cerebri
UBERON:0010090.def: A developing anatomical structure that has the potential to develop into a falx cerebri.

UBERON:0010091.name: future hindbrain meninx
UBERON:0010091.def: A multi-tissue structure that has the potential to develop into a meninx of hindbrain.

UBERON:0010092.name: future metencephalon
UBERON:0010092.def: A developing anatomical structure that has the potential to develop into a metencephalon.

UBERON:0010096.name: future myelencephalon
UBERON:0010096.def: A developing anatomical structure that has the potential to develop into a myelencephalon.

UBERON:0010123.name: future facial nucleus
UBERON:0010123.def: A gray matter that has the potential to develop into a facial nucleus.

UBERON:0010124.name: future inferior salivatory nucleus
UBERON:0010124.def: A gray matter that has the potential to develop into a inferior salivatory nucleus.

UBERON:0010125.name: future superior salivatory nucleus
UBERON:0010125.def: A gray matter that has the potential to develop into a superior salivatory nucleus.

UBERON:0010126.name: future nucleus ambiguus
UBERON:0010126.def: A gray matter that has the potential to develop into a nucleus ambiguus.

UBERON:0010127.name: future dorsal motor nucleus of vagus
UBERON:0010127.def: A gray matter that has the potential to develop into a dorsal motor nucleus of vagus nerve.

UBERON:0010128.name: future pterygopalatine ganglion
UBERON:0010128.def: A ganglion that has the potential to develop into a pterygopalatine ganglion.

UBERON:0010129.name: femur cartilage element
UBERON:0010129.def: A femur endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010130.name: embryonic autopod plate
UBERON:0010130.def: The distal elements of the developing limb of vertebrates that will give rise to the autopod (e.g. manus, pes, paw).

UBERON:0010131.name: conducting tissue of heart
UBERON:0010131.def: Any portion of cardiac muscle tissue that is part of the conducting system of heart or the Purkinje fibers.

UBERON:0010132.name: gastroduodenal artery
UBERON:0010132.def: A small blood vessel in the abdomen that supplies blood directly to the pylorus (distal part of the stomach) and proximal part of the duodenum, and indirectly to the pancreatic head (via the anterior and posterior superior pancreaticoduodenal arteries).

UBERON:0010133.name: neuroendocrine gland
UBERON:0010133.def: Any of the organized aggregations of cells that function as secretory or excretory organs and that release hormones in response to neural stimuli.

UBERON:0010134.name: secretory circumventricular organ
UBERON:0010134.def: A circumventricular organ that is capable of secreting substances into the cerebrospinal fluid.

UBERON:0010135.name: sensory circumventricular organ
UBERON:0010135.def: A circumventricular organ that is capable of monitoring the levels of substances to the cerebrospinal fluid.

UBERON:0010136.name: epithelial sheet
UBERON:0010136.def: An epithelial sheet is a flat surface consisting of closely packed epithelial cells.

UBERON:0010137.name: polarized epithelium
UBERON:0010137.def: A polarized epithelium is an epithelium where the epithelial sheet is oriented with respect to the planar axis.

UBERON:0010141.name: primitive sex cord of indifferent gonad
UBERON:0010141.def: A sex cord that is part of a indifferent gonad.

UBERON:0010143.name: seminal vesicle fluid
UBERON:0010143.def: A bodily secretion that is produced by a seminal vesicle.

UBERON:0010145.name: paraurethral gland
UBERON:0010145.def: The numerous mucous-secreting glands found in several female mammalian species (including rodents and humans) on the anterior wall of the vagina, around the lower end of the urethra, and possessing a common paraurethral duct which opens (on each side) near the external urethral orifice; they are homologous with the prostate gland in males, have highly variable anatomy, and are believed to be the source of the female ejaculate, a lubricating fluid with a similar consistency to male prostatic fluid that is expelled through the urethra during sexual stimulation; like the male prostate, these glands are susceptible to infection (skenitis), cyst development, and cancer.

UBERON:0010146.name: paraurethral duct
UBERON:0010146.def: The Skene's ducts are a pair of ducts leading from the Skene's glands to the surface of the vulva, to the left and right of the urethral opening.

UBERON:0010147.name: male accessory sex gland
UBERON:0010147.def: Any gland, other than the gonad, associated with the genital tract, such as the ampulla of the ductus deferens and the bulbourethral, prostate and vesicular glands of the male.

UBERON:0010148.name: mating plug
UBERON:0010148.def: A gelatinous secretion used in the mating of some species. It is deposited by a male into a female genital tract and later hardens into a plug or glues the tract together.

UBERON:0010150.name: duct of major vestibular gland
UBERON:0010150.def: One of a pair of ducts leading from the Bartholin's glands to the surface of the vulva.

UBERON:0010151.name: duct of bulbourethral gland
UBERON:0010151.def: A duct that is part of a bulbo-urethral gland.

UBERON:0010152.name: skin mucus
UBERON:0010152.def: A mucous secretion that is produced by glands in the epidermis.

UBERON:0010154.name: inner lining mucosa of the abomasum
UBERON:0010154.def: The inner mucosa of the fourth stomach chamber of a ruminant produces rennet.

UBERON:0010155.name: parietomastoid suture
UBERON:0010155.def: Unites the mastoid process of the temporal with the region of the mastoid angle of the parietal[WP:Squamosal_suture].

UBERON:0010156.name: sphenofrontal suture
UBERON:0010156.def: The Sphenofrontal suture is the cranial suture between the sphenoid bone and the frontal bone.

UBERON:0010157.name: sphenoparietal suture
UBERON:0010157.def: The Sphenoparietal suture is the cranial suture between the sphenoid bone and the parietal bone.

UBERON:0010158.name: sphenozygomatic suture
UBERON:0010158.def: The Sphenozygomatic suture is the cranial suture between the sphenoid bone and the zygomatic bone.

UBERON:0010159.name: occipitomastoid suture
UBERON:0010159.def: The occipitomastoid suture is the cranial suture between the occipital bone and the mastoid portion of the temporal bone. It is continuous with the lambdoidal suture.

UBERON:0010160.name: lumen of lymphatic vessel
UBERON:0010160.def: An anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a lymphatic vessel.

UBERON:0010161.name: lumen of blood vessel
UBERON:0010161.def: An anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a blood vessel.

UBERON:0010162.name: post-anal tail tip
UBERON:0010162.def: The distal end of the tail.

UBERON:0010163.name: eyebrow
UBERON:0010163.def: The eyebrow is an area of thick, delicate hairs above the eye that follows the shape of the lower margin of the brow ridges. Their main function is to protect the eye, but they are also important to human communication and facial expression. It is not uncommon for people to modify their eyebrows by means of hair addition or removal, make up, or piercings.

UBERON:0010164.name: collection of hairs
UBERON:0010164.def: An anatomical cluster that composed_primarily_of a strand of hair.

UBERON:0010165.name: collection of hair on face
UBERON:0010165.def: A collection of hairs that is part of a face.

UBERON:0010167.name: beard
UBERON:0010167.def: The collection of hair that grows on the chin, cheeks and neck of human beings. Usually, only pubescent or adult males are able to grow beards. However, women with hirsutism may develop a beard. When differentiating between upper and lower facial hair, a beard specifically includes the moustache, which refers to hair above the upper lip and around it.

UBERON:0010168.name: collection of eyelashes
UBERON:0010168.def: A collection of hair on face that is part of a eyelash.

UBERON:0010169.name: moustache
UBERON:0010169.def: Facial hair grown on the outer surface of the upper lip. It may or may not be accompanied by a type of beard, a facial hair style grown and cropped to cover most of the lower half of the face.
synonym: set of hair of upper lip proper

UBERON:0010171.name: strand of hair of face
UBERON:0010171.def: A strand of hair that is part of a face.

UBERON:0010172.name: bulb of aorta
UBERON:0010172.def: The portion of the left ventricular outflow tract delineated by the sinotubular ridge superiorly and the bases of the valve leaflets inferiorly; it comprises the aortic sinuses, the aortic valve leaflets, the commissures, and the interleaflet triangles.

UBERON:0010173.name: sinotubular junction
UBERON:0010173.def: The point in the ascending aorta where the aortic sinuses end and the aorta becomes a tubular structure.

UBERON:0010174.name: Schweigger-Seidel sheath
UBERON:0010174.def: A phagocytic sleeve that is part of a sheathed arteriole of the spleen, and is sometimes referred to as a splenic ellipsoid. It is a spindle-shaped thickening in the walls of the second part of the arterial branches forming the penicilli in the spleen.

UBERON:0010175.name: nutrient foramen vein
UBERON:0010175.def: A vein or veins draining a bone and emerging from a nutrient foramen.

UBERON:0010176.name: nutrient foramen artery
UBERON:0010176.def: The medullary or nutrient artery, usually accompanied by one or two veins, sends branches upward and downward to the bone marrow, which ramify in the medullary membrane, and give twigs to the adjoining canals.

UBERON:0010181.name: straight venules of kidney
UBERON:0010181.def: The straight venules of kidney are branches from the plexuses at the apices of the medullary pyramids, formed by the terminations of the arteriae rectae. They run outward in a straight course between the tubes of the medullary substance, and joining, as above stated, the interlobular veins, form venous arcades; these in turn unite and form veins which pass along the sides of the pyramids. Contains fenestrated capillaries.
synonym: set of straight venules of kidney

UBERON:0010183.name: liver trabecula
UBERON:0010183.def: A trabecula that is part of a liver.

UBERON:0010185.name: rete ovarii
UBERON:0010185.def: A structure formed from the primary sex cords in females, counterpart of the rete testis in males.

UBERON:0010186.name: male urethral gland
UBERON:0010186.def: Any of the numerous small mucous-secreting glands located in the wall of the penile urethra.

UBERON:0010187.name: female urethral gland
UBERON:0010187.def: An urethral gland that is part of a female urethra.

UBERON:0010188.name: protuberance
UBERON:0010188.def: A roughly circular bulge in a surface.

UBERON:0010190.name: pair of dorsal aortae
UBERON:0010190.def: The paired arterial structures of the embryo that supplies each developing somite via efferent segmental arteries; the dorsal aortae articulate with the umbilical arteries, which return mixed blood to the villi of the chorion for reoxygenation.

UBERON:0010192.name: genital artery
UBERON:0010192.def: One of the laterally paired arteries that supply the gonads.

UBERON:0010193.name: renal portal vein
UBERON:0010193.def: A portal vein that empties into capillaries within the kidneys.

UBERON:0010194.name: hepatic portal system
UBERON:0010194.def: A portal system that begins in capillaries in the wall of the digestive tract and and runs as the hepatic portal vein to the liver.

UBERON:0010195.name: renal portal system
UBERON:0010195.def: A portal system that transports blood returning from capillary beds within tail or hindlimbs through paired renal portal veins that empty into capillaries within the kidneys.

UBERON:0010197.name: trunk of common carotid artery
UBERON:0010197.def: The initial part of the entire common carotid artery ending with the point where the artery bifurcates into an external carotid artery and an internal carotid artery.

UBERON:0010198.name: carotid duct
UBERON:0010198.def: A segment of the embryonic dorsal aorta between points of juncture with the third and fourth arch arteries; it regresses early in development to allow the carotid axis to take its definitive appearance.

UBERON:0010199.name: bona-fide anatomical boundary
UBERON:0010199.def: An anatomical boundary that corresponds to some physical discontinuity.

UBERON:0010202.name: lateral line
UBERON:0010202.def: The lateral line consists of small sensory patches (neuromasts) located superficially on the skin or just under the skin in fluid-filled canals on the head and body of all fishes and most amphibians. The lateral line develops from cranial ectodermal placodes situated behind the ear and between the eye and ear.

UBERON:0010204.name: tail vasculature
UBERON:0010204.def: A vasculature that is part of a post-anal tail.

UBERON:0010205.name: mesencephalic vein
UBERON:0010205.def: One of the several veins that drain the mesencephalon; the posterior ones are tributaries to the great cerebral vein; the lateral ones are tributaries to the basal vein. The main veins are: pontomesencephalic vein [TA] (vena pontomesencephalica [TA]), interpeduncular veins [TA] (venae interpedunculares [TA]), intercollicular vein [TA] (vena intercollicularis [TA]), and lateral mesencephalic vein [TA] (vena mesencephalica lateralis [TA])[MedLex]. The major vein of the midbrain, which crosses the midbrain medially to meet it's partner the mesencephalic artery[XAO].

UBERON:0010207.name: nictitating membrane
UBERON:0010207.def: A fold of the mucous membrane of the conjunctiva in many animals. At rest, it is hidden in the medial canthus. It can extend to cover part or all of the cornea to help clean the cornea.

UBERON:0010209.name: plica semilunaris of conjunctiva
UBERON:0010209.def: The plica semilunaris is a small fold of bulbar conjunctiva on the medial canthus of the eye. It is loose, so that eye movements are not restricted.

UBERON:0010210.name: blood clot
UBERON:0010210.def: A semisolid gelatinous mass of coagulated blood that consists of red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets entrapped in a fibrin network.

UBERON:0010211.name: granulation tissue
UBERON:0010211.def: Highly vascularized tissue that replaces the initial fibrin clot in a wound. Vascularization is by ingrowth of capillary endothelium from the surrounding vasculature. The tissue is also rich in fibroblasts (that will eventually produce the fibrous tissue) and leucocytes.

UBERON:0010212.name: laryngeal apparatus
UBERON:0010212.def: Apparatus located between the lungs and the buccal cavity. This apparatus is composed of a pair of arytenoid cartilages that are supported by the cricoid ring.

UBERON:0010215.name: arytenoid swellings
UBERON:0010215.def: Paired primordial elevations, on either side of the embryonic larynx, within which the arytenoid cartilages are formed.

UBERON:0010223.name: left pupil
UBERON:0010223.def: A pupil that is part of a left eye.

UBERON:0010224.name: right pupil
UBERON:0010224.def: A pupil that is part of a right eye.

UBERON:0010225.name: thalamic complex
UBERON:0010225.def: A nuclear complex which in mammals consists of four parts, the hypothalamus, epithalamus, ventral thalamus, and dorsal thalamus[WP,modified].

UBERON:0010227.name: future cardiac atrium
UBERON:0010227.def: Multi-tissue structure that is part of the heart tube and will become the cardiac atrium.

UBERON:0010228.name: ruminal fluid
UBERON:0010228.def: A portion of organism substance that is produced a rumen.

UBERON:0010229.name: ruminant esophageal groove
UBERON:0010229.def: A muscular structure at the lower end of the esophagus that, when closed, forms a tube allowing milk to go directly into the abomasum. (This prevents milk from being fermented or soured by the ruminal microorganisms).

UBERON:0010230.name: eyeball of camera-type eye
UBERON:0010230.def: The core globe-shaped component of the camera-type eye.

UBERON:0010233.name: stroma of thyroid gland
UBERON:0010233.def: The connective tissue that supports the lobules and follicles of the thyroid gland.

UBERON:0010234.name: palatopharyngeus muscle
UBERON:0010234.def: The palatopharyngeus or palatopharyngeal or pharyngopalatinus muscle is a long, fleshy fasciculus, narrower in the middle than at either end, forming, with the mucous membrane covering its surface, the palatopharyngeal arch.

UBERON:0010235.name: uvular muscle
UBERON:0010235.def: The musculus uvulae (azygos uvulae) is a muscle of the soft palate. It arises from the posterior nasal spine of the palatine bones and from the palatine aponeurosis. It descends to be inserted into the uvula and functions to move and shape it. It is innervated by the pharyngeal branch of the vagus nerve via the pharyngeal plexus[WP].

UBERON:0010238.name: torus pylorus
UBERON:0010238.def: A fleshy protuberance at the pylorus of some species such as ruminants and pigs, that projects into the lumen of the pyloric canal.

UBERON:0010239.name: spiral colon
UBERON:0010239.def: A variant of the ascending colon in ruminants and pigs.

UBERON:0010240.name: zygomatic gland
UBERON:0010240.def: A salivary gland best developed in carnivores; located above the zygomatic arch and below the eye. Enlargement or mucocele of the gland causes exophthalmos.

UBERON:0010242.name: anterior buccal gland
UBERON:0010242.def: The racemose, mucous or serous glands in the submucous tissue of the cheeks.

UBERON:0010243.name: merocrine gland
UBERON:0010243.def: An exocrine gland whose secretions are excreted via exocytosis from secretory cells into an epithelial-walled duct or ducts and thence onto a bodily surface or into the lumen; the gland releases its product and no part of the gland is lost or damaged.

UBERON:0010244.name: choroid tapetum lucidum
UBERON:0010244.def: A tapetum lucidum that is part of the choroid. The choroidal tapetum lucidum lies immediately adjacent to the choriocapillaris and external to the retinal epithelium.

UBERON:0010245.name: retinal tapetum lucidum
UBERON:0010245.def: A tapetum lucidum that is part of the retina, within the cytoplasm of the retinal epithelium.

UBERON:0010246.name: choroidal guanine tapetum
UBERON:0010246.def: A choroid tapetum lucidum that is made of a palisade of cells containing stacks of flat hexagonal crystals of guanine.

UBERON:0010247.name: choroidal tapetum cellulosum
UBERON:0010247.def: A choroid tapetum lucidum that consists of layers of cells containing organized, highly refractive crystals. These crystals are diverse in shape and makeup.

UBERON:0010248.name: choroidal tapetum fibrosum
UBERON:0010248.def: A choroid tapetum lucidum that is an array of extracellular fibers.

UBERON:0010249.name: posterior meningeal artery
UBERON:0010249.def: The posterior meningeal artery are small vessels which are branches of the ascending pharyngeal artery which supply the dura mater. It passes through the mastoid foramen before entering the cranium via the jugular foramen.
synonym: meningeal branches of the ascending pharyngeal artery
terminal branch of ascending pharyngeal artery

UBERON:0010250.name: middle meningeal artery
UBERON:0010250.def: The middle meningeal artery is typically the third branch of the first part (retromandibular part) of the maxillary artery; one of the two terminal branches of the external carotid artery. After branching off the maxillary artery in the infratemporal fossa, it runs through the foramen spinosum to supply the dura mater and the calvaria. The middle meningeal artery is the largest of the three (paired) arteries which supply the meninges, the others being the anterior meningeal artery and the posterior meningeal artery. In approximately half of subjects it branches into an accessory meningeal artery. The middle meningeal artery runs beneath the pterion. It is vulnerable to injury at this point, where the skull is thin. Rupture of the artery may give rise to an epidural hematoma.

UBERON:0010251.name: anterior meningeal artery
UBERON:0010251.def: A meningeal branch to the dura mater arising from the anterior ethmoidal artery.
synonym: anterior meningeal branch of anterior ethmoidal artery

UBERON:0010252.name: 1st arch mandibular mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010252.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a 1st arch mandibular mesenchyme.

UBERON:0010253.name: 1st arch maxillary mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010253.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a 1st arch maxillary mesenchyme.

UBERON:0010254.name: 2nd arch mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010254.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a 2nd arch mesenchyme.
synonym: branchial arch 2 mesenchyme from neural crest
pharyngeal arch 2 mesenchyme from neural crest

UBERON:0010255.name: 3rd arch mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010255.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a 3rd arch mesenchyme.
synonym: 3rd pharyngeal arch mesenchyme derived from neural crest
branchial arch 3 mesenchyme from neural crest
mesenchyme derived from neural crest of mesenchyme of 3rd arch
pharyngeal arch 3 mesenchyme from neural crest

UBERON:0010256.name: 4th arch mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010256.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a 4th arch mesenchyme.
synonym: 4th pharyngeal arch mesenchyme derived from neural crest
branchial arch 4 mesenchyme from neural crest
mesenchyme derived from neural crest of mesenchyme of 4th arch
pharyngeal arch 4 mesenchyme from neural crest

UBERON:0010257.name: 6th arch mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010257.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a 6th arch mesenchyme.
synonym: branchial arch 6 mesenchyme from neural crest
pharyngeal arch 6 mesenchyme from neural crest

UBERON:0010258.name: mesenchyme from rhombencephalic neural crest
UBERON:0010258.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a rhombencephalon neural crest.

UBERON:0010259.name: 1st arch mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010259.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a 1st arch mesenchyme.
synonym: branchial arch 1 mesenchyme from neural crest
mesenchyme derived from neural crest of mesenchyme of 1st arch
pharyngeal arch 1 mesenchyme from neural crest

UBERON:0010260.name: umbilical blood vessel
UBERON:0010260.def: One of the three blood vessels, usually one large umbilical vein and two small umbilical arteries, buried within Wharton's jelly, that transport blood to and from the placenta, where exchange between the mother and fetus takes place; the umbilical vein carries oxygenated, nutrient-rich blood from the placenta to the fetus, and the umbilical arteries carry deoxygenated, nutrient-depleted blood from the fetus to the placenta.

UBERON:0010262.name: operculum of brain
UBERON:0010262.def: The most posterior portion of the inferior frontal gyrus of the frontal lobe in the brain. In an axial plane, the Sylvian fissure extends from the operculum posteriorly to divide the frontal from the temporal lobe. Broca's area is a notable part of the operculum, which plays a key role in conversation or speech production, reading and writing. Its vascular supply comes from the M3 branches of the middle cerebral artery[WP].

UBERON:0010263.name: obsolete embryoid body
UBERON:0010263.def: Embryoid bodies are structures resembling embryos, occurring in several types of germ cell tumors.

UBERON:0010264.name: hepatopancreas
UBERON:0010264.def: An organ of the digestive tract of arthropods and molluscs. It provides the functions which in mammals are provided separately by the liver and pancreas, including the production of digestive enzymes, and absorption of digested food.

UBERON:0010266.name: arthropod hepatopancreas
UBERON:0010266.def: Digestive gland of crustaceans with functions approximately analogous to liver and pancreas of vertebrates - enzyme secretion, food absorption and storage.

UBERON:0010267.name: obsolete inferior reticular formation
UBERON:0010267.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0010267. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0010268.name: obsolete superior reticular formation
UBERON:0010268.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0010268. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0010271.name: musculus retractor bulbi
UBERON:0010271.def: Cranial nerve VI innervated; ventral and posterior to the eye.

UBERON:0010272.name: hyoid apparatus
UBERON:0010272.def: A group of bones comprised of hyoid body and two pairs of cornua (i.e. greater cornua and lesser cornua), and lies just below the tongue, above the thyroid cartilage.

UBERON:0010273.name: zone of hyoid bone
UBERON:0010273.def: A zone of bone organ that is part of a hyoid bone.

UBERON:0010276.name: space in vertebral column
UBERON:0010276.def: Any anatomical space that is part of a vertebral column.

UBERON:0010277.name: mesocardium
UBERON:0010277.def: The part of the embryonic mesentery which connects the embryonic heart with the body wall in front and the foregut behind.

UBERON:0010279.name: pericardial sinus
UBERON:0010279.def: There are two Pericardial sinuses: transverse and oblique. The cul-de-sac enclosed between the limbs of the inverted U of the venous mesocardium lies behind the left atrium and is known as the oblique sinus. The passage between the venous and arterial mesocardiabi.e. , between the aorta and pulmonary artery in front and the superior vena cava behindbis termed the transverse sinus. Also, the sinus that forms in the pericardial cavity where the dorso-mesentary pericardium reside. Can be used to pass ligature during cardiac surgery.

UBERON:0010283.name: oblique pericardial sinus
UBERON:0010283.def: The cul-de-sac enclosed between the limbs of the inverted U of the venous mesocardium lies behind the left atrium.[WP,unvetted].

UBERON:0010284.name: lacrimal punctum
UBERON:0010284.def: A minute orifice on the summit of the papillae lacrimales, which is the commencement point of the lacrimal canaliculi.

UBERON:0010285.name: midbrain basal plate
UBERON:0010285.def: Portion of tissue that is dorsolateral to the floor plate and part of the midbrain.

UBERON:0010286.name: midbrain neural tube
UBERON:0010286.def: Portion of neural tube that gives rise to the midbrain.

UBERON:0010287.name: motor root of facial nerve
synonym: motor component of the VIIth (facial) nerve

UBERON:0010289.name: scleral cartilage
UBERON:0010289.def: Circular cartilage ringing the posterior portion of the eye in the sclera. Supports the eye.

UBERON:0010290.name: scleral ossicle
UBERON:0010290.def: A bony plate around the eyes, are situated at the corneal-scleral limbus. They do not articulate with other elements of the skull. Typically, the scleral ossicles overlap the rim of a cup of scleral cartilage that supports the eyeball. Situated near the equator of the eye and may slightly overlap the rim of scleral cartilage.

UBERON:0010292.name: episcleral layer of eyeball
UBERON:0010292.def: The episclera is the outermost layer of the sclera. It is composed of loose, fibrous, elastic tissue and attaches to Tenon's capsule. A vascular plexus is found between the conjunctiva and the sclera consisting of two layers of vessels, the superficial episcleral vessels and the deep episcleral vessels.

UBERON:0010293.name: suprachoroid lamina
UBERON:0010293.def: On the external surface of the optic choroid is a thin membrane, the suprachoroid lamina, composed of delicate non-vascular lamellae-each lamella consisting of a network of fine elastic fibers among which are branched pigment cells.

UBERON:0010294.name: scleral endothelium
UBERON:0010294.def: An endothelium that is part of a sclera.

UBERON:0010295.name: substantia propria of sclera
UBERON:0010295.def: A stroma that is part of a sclera.

UBERON:0010299.name: scleral mesenchyme
UBERON:0010299.def: Mesenchyme surrounding the developing optic cup which develops into the sclera.

UBERON:0010302.name: amnioserosa
UBERON:0010302.def: A single extraembryonic epithelium, which closes the germband dorsally.

UBERON:0010303.name: extraembryonic epithelium
UBERON:0010303.def: An epithelium that is part of a extraembryonic structure.

UBERON:0010304.name: non-keratinized stratified squamous epithelium
UBERON:0010304.def: Stratified squamous epithelium is a stratified squamous epithelium, the cells of which synthesizes but does not accumulate keratin. Examples: epithelium of vagina, epithelium of wall of esophagus.

UBERON:0010305.name: subdivision of conjunctiva
UBERON:0010305.def: One of the three major regions of the conjunctiva.

UBERON:0010306.name: bulbar conjunctiva
UBERON:0010306.def: The conjunctiva covering the anterior surface of the sclera and the surface epithelium of the cornea.

UBERON:0010307.name: conjunctival fornix
UBERON:0010307.def: The space formed by the junction of the bulbar and palpebral portions of the conjunctiva, that of the upper lid being the superior conjunctival fornix (fornix conjunctivae superior) and that of the lower lid, the inferior conjunctival fornix (fornix conjunctivae inferior); the fornix is loose and flexible, allowing the free movement of the lids and eyeball.

UBERON:0010308.name: os opticus
UBERON:0010308.def: Scleral element located at the posterior pole of the scleral cartilage surrounding the foramen through which the optic nerve fibers pass. the internal architecture of this bone reveals a cancellous marrow cavity with fatty tissue.

UBERON:0010309.name: palpebral bone
UBERON:0010309.def: An ossified element investing the upper eyelid.

UBERON:0010310.name: nictitating membrane lamina
UBERON:0010310.def: Thin cartilage element that stiffens the nictitating membrane.

UBERON:0010311.name: scleral sesamoid bone
UBERON:0010311.def: A sesamoid bone that lies adjacent to the tendon of one of the muscles responsible for adducting the nictitating membrane (the pyramidal nictitating muscle).

UBERON:0010312.name: immature eye
UBERON:0010312.def: Developing anatomical structure that develops into the eyeball and associated structures.

UBERON:0010313.name: neural crest-derived structure
UBERON:0010313.def: An anatomical structure that develops from the neural crest.

UBERON:0010314.name: structure with developmental contribution from neural crest
UBERON:0010314.def: An anatomical structure that has some part that develops from the neural crest.

UBERON:0010317.name: obsolete germ layer / neural crest derived structure

UBERON:0010321.name: skeletal element of eye region
UBERON:0010321.def: A skeletal element that is part of a orbital region.

UBERON:0010323.name: cranial skeletal system
UBERON:0010323.def: Skeletal subdivision of the head including skull (cranium plus mandible), pharyngeal and/or hyoid apparatus.

UBERON:0010325.name: obsolete craniofacial skeleton
UBERON:0010325.def: Cranial skeleton derived from neural crest cells.

UBERON:0010326.name: optic pedicel
UBERON:0010326.def: Permanent cartilage structure projecting from the site of origin of the recti muscles. Supports eyeball and aids rotation.

UBERON:0010327.name: obsolete early digestive tract associated mesenchyme

UBERON:0010328.name: limb bud mesenchyme
UBERON:0010328.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a limb bud.

UBERON:0010329.name: paired limb/fin bud mesenchyme
UBERON:0010329.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a limb/fin bud.

UBERON:0010330.name: eyelid mesenchyme
UBERON:0010330.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing eyelid.

UBERON:0010332.name: epithelium of handplate
UBERON:0010332.def: An epithelium that is part of a handplate.

UBERON:0010333.name: extraembryonic membrane mesenchyme
UBERON:0010333.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a extraembryonic membrane.

UBERON:0010334.name: maxillary process mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010334.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a maxillary process mesenchyme.

UBERON:0010335.name: maxillary process mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010335.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a maxillary process mesenchyme.

UBERON:0010336.name: mandibular process mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010336.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a mandibular process mesenchyme.

UBERON:0010337.name: mandibular process mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010337.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a mandibular process mesenchyme.

UBERON:0010338.name: 1st arch maxillary mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010338.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a 1st arch maxillary mesenchyme.

UBERON:0010339.name: 1st arch mandibular mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010339.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a 1st arch mandibular mesenchyme.

UBERON:0010341.name: 1st arch mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010341.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a 1st arch mesenchyme.
UBERON:0010341.synonym: mesenchyme derived from head mesoderm of mesenchyme of 1st arch

UBERON:0010343.name: 2nd arch mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010343.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a 2nd arch mesenchyme.
synonym: branchial arch 2 mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
mesenchyme derived from head mesoderm of mesenchyme of 2nd arch
pharyngeal arch 2 mesenchyme from head mesenchyme

UBERON:0010344.name: 3rd arch mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010344.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a 3rd arch mesenchyme.
synonym: branchial arch 3 mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
mesenchyme derived from head mesoderm of mesenchyme of 3rd arch
pharyngeal arch 3 mesenchyme from head mesenchyme

UBERON:0010345.name: 4th arch mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010345.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a 4th arch mesenchyme.
synonym: branchial arch 4 mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
mesenchyme derived from head mesoderm of mesenchyme of 4th arch
pharyngeal arch 4 mesenchyme from head mesenchyme

UBERON:0010347.name: 6th arch mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010347.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a 6th arch mesenchyme.
synonym: branchial arch 6 mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
pharyngeal arch 6 mesenchyme from head mesenchyme

UBERON:0010349.name: otic capsule pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010349.def: An otic capsule endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0010355.name: ossification center
UBERON:0010355.def: The first step in ossification of the cartilage is that the cartilage cells, at the point where ossification is commencing and which is termed a ossification center, enlarge and arrange themselves in rows. The matrix in which they are imbedded increases in quantity, so that the cells become further separated from each other. A deposit of calcareous material now takes place in this matrix, between the rows of cells, so that they become separated from each other by longitudinal columns of calcified matrix, presenting a granular and opaque appearance. Here and there the matrix between two cells of the same row also becomes calcified, and transverse bars of calcified substance stretch across from one calcareous column to another. Thus there are longitudinal groups of the cartilage cells enclosed in oblong cavities, the walls of which are formed of calcified matrix which cuts off all nutrition from the cells; the cells, in consequence, atrophy, leaving spaces called the primary areolC&.

UBERON:0010356.name: primary ossification center
UBERON:0010356.def: A primary ossification center is the first area of a bone to start ossifying. It usually appears during prenatal development in the central part of each developing bone. In long bones the primary centers occur in the diaphysis/shaft and in irregular bones the primary centers occur usually in the body of the bone. Most bones have only one primary center (e.g. all long bones) but some irregular bones such as the os coxa (hip) and vertebrae have multiple primary centers.

UBERON:0010357.name: secondary ossification center
UBERON:0010357.def: A secondary ossification center is the area of ossification that appears after the primary ossification center has already appeared - most of which appear during the postnatal and adolescent years. Most bones have more than one secondary ossification center. In long bones, the secondary centres appear in the epiphyses.

UBERON:0010358.name: arch of centrum of vertebra
UBERON:0010358.def: An arch-shaped structure of the vertebra that extends dorsally (neural arch) or ventrally (hemal arch) from the vertebral centrum.

UBERON:0010359.name: pharyngeal arch mesenchyme from neural crest
UBERON:0010359.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a neural crest and is part of a entire pharyngeal arch associated mesenchyme.
synonym: branchial arch mesenchyme from neural crest

UBERON:0010360.name: pharyngeal arch mesenchyme from head mesenchyme
UBERON:0010360.def: Mesenchyme that develops_from a head mesenchyme from mesoderm and is part of a entire pharyngeal arch associated mesenchyme.
synonym: branchial arch mesenchyme from head mesenchyme

UBERON:0010361.name: synostosis
UBERON:0010361.def: Nonsynovial joint in which the articulating bones are connected by bone. Examples: epiphyseal junction, manubriosternal synostosis.

UBERON:0010362.name: endoskeleton
UBERON:0010362.def: Skeletal subdivision that undergoes indirect development and includes elements that develop as a replacement or substitution of other elements or tissues.

UBERON:0010363.name: endochondral element
UBERON:0010363.def: A skeletal element that has the potential to participate in endochondral ossification, and may participate in intramembranous ossification.

UBERON:0010364.name: dermal skeleton
UBERON:0010364.def: Skeletal subdivision that undergoes direct development and includes elements that either develop in association with the basement membrane of the ectoderm or are homologous with such elements; includes dermatocranium, components of the appendicular skeleton, teeth and tooth-like elements of the oropharynx, and integumentary elements.

UBERON:0010365.name: odontoid tissue
UBERON:0010365.def: Skeletal tissue that is part of the exoskeleton and derived from an odontogenic papilla.

UBERON:0010366.name: conjunctival vasculature
UBERON:0010366.def: A vasculature that is part of a conjunctiva.

UBERON:0010367.name: conjunctival vein
UBERON:0010367.def: A vein that is part of a conjunctiva.

UBERON:0010368.name: pulmonary lobule
UBERON:0010368.def: The smallest anatomical unit of the lung, measuring 0.50 to 2.00 cm in diameter. Each lobule is composed of 4-8 terminal bronchioles and their distal alveolar ducts and sacs. The lobules are separated by fibrous interlobular septa.

UBERON:0010369.name: secondary pulmonary lobule
UBERON:0010369.def: A unit of lung supplied by three to five terminal bronchioles and contained by fibrous septa.

UBERON:0010370.name: tibial vein
UBERON:0010370.def: One of the veins of the lower leg; empty into the popliteal vein.

UBERON:0010371.name: ecto-epithelium
UBERON:0010371.def: Epithelium composed of cells that develops from the ectoderm[FMA,modified].

UBERON:0010372.name: uncinate process of ethmoid
UBERON:0010372.def: In the ethmoid bone, a curved lamina, the uncinate process, projects downward and backward from this part of the labyrinth; it forms a small part of the medial wall of the maxillary sinus, and articulates with the ethmoidal process of the inferior nasal concha.
synonym: uncinate process of the ethmoid bone

UBERON:0010373.name: uncinate process of pancreas
UBERON:0010373.def: In the head of the pancreas, the angle of junction of the lower and left lateral borders forms a prolongation, termed the uncinate process. During the embryonic development of the distal foregut, the duodenum c-shape is formed while rotating the ventral pancreatic bud into the dorsal bud. The dorsal and ventral pancreatic buds fuse. The dorsal pancreatic bud becomes the body, tail, and isthmus of the pancreas and the ventral pancreatic bud forms the pancreatic head and uncinate process[WP].

UBERON:0010379.name: superior tarsal muscle
UBERON:0010379.def: The superior tarsal muscle is a smooth muscle adjoining the levator palpebrae superioris muscle that helps to raise the upper eyelid.

UBERON:0010380.name: enteric nerve
UBERON:0010380.def: The neurons that innervate the esophagus, stomach, small and large bowel.

UBERON:0010384.name: lumen of laryngopharynx
UBERON:0010384.def: An anatomical space that is enclosed by a hypopharynx.

UBERON:0010386.name: Peyer's patch follicle
UBERON:0010386.def: A lymphoid follicle that is part of a Peyer's patch.

UBERON:0010387.name: Peyer's patch T cell area
UBERON:0010387.def: The Peyer's patch area normally occupied by T lymphocytes.

UBERON:0010388.name: proximal segment of rib
UBERON:0010388.def: The segment of the rib that connects to a vertebra[MP]. a small part of the rib composed of the head, neck, tuberculum and a short proximal part of the body[PMID].

UBERON:0010389.name: pterygoid bone
UBERON:0010389.def: A bone which corresponds to the inner plate of the pterygoid process of the human skull, but which, in all vertebrates below mammals, is not connected with the posterior nares, but serves to connect the palatine bones with the point of suspension of the lower jaw.
synonym: lamina lateralis processi pterygoideus ossis sphenoidalis

UBERON:0010390.name: lumen of urethra
UBERON:0010390.def: An organ cavity that is part of a urethra.

UBERON:0010391.name: parametrium
UBERON:0010391.def: The subserous connective tissue of the pelvic floor of the supracervical portion of the uterus. The parametrium extends laterally between the layers of the broad ligament.

UBERON:0010395.name: lymph node primary follicle
UBERON:0010395.def: An unstimulated network of follicular dendritic cells and small resting B cells in the lymph node cortex.

UBERON:0010396.name: afferent lymphatic vessel
UBERON:0010396.def: Lymphatic vessel that enters the lymph node. The afferent lymph vessels enter at all parts of the periphery of the lymph node, and after branching and forming a dense plexus in the substance of the capsule, open into the lymph sinuses of the cortical part. In doing this they lose all their coats except their endothelial lining, which is continuous with a layer of similar cells lining the lymph paths.

UBERON:0010397.name: efferent lymphatic vessel
UBERON:0010397.def: Lymphatic vessel that exits the lymph node. The efferent lymphatic vessel commences from the lymph sinuses of the medullary portion of the lymph nodes and leave the lymph nodes either to veins or greater nodes. Efferent lymphatic vessels are also found in the thymus and spleen. This is in contrast to afferent lymphatic vessels, which are found only in lymph nodes.

UBERON:0010398.name: spleen marginal sinus
UBERON:0010398.def: The border region surrounding the spleen B cell follicles and the periarteriolar lymphoid sheath that separates it from the marginal zone that mediates lymphocyte entry into the white pulp from the blood.

UBERON:0010399.name: spleen trabecular artery
UBERON:0010399.def: One of the branches of the splenic artery[MP].

UBERON:0010400.name: spleen trabecular vein
UBERON:0010400.def: One of the veins that feed the splenic vein.

UBERON:0010401.name: spleen central arteriole
UBERON:0010401.def: A blood vessel surrounded by the periarteriolar lymphoid sheath that connects the trabecular artery to the trabecular vein.

UBERON:0010402.name: epidermis suprabasal layer
UBERON:0010402.def: Any layer of the epidermis that is superior to the stratum basale.

UBERON:0010403.name: brain marginal zone
UBERON:0010403.def: The part of the future brain that is derived from the mantle layer of the neural tube.

UBERON:0010404.name: lateral ventricle subependymal layer
UBERON:0010404.def: A cell layer below the ependyma in the lateral ventricles of the brain. This region contains adult neural stem cells which have the potential to generate new neurons and glial cells via neurogenesis. It is an adult version of the embryonic forebrain germinal zone.

UBERON:0010405.name: spinal cord lateral motor column
UBERON:0010405.def: Column of motor neurons which innervate muscles in the limb; motor neurons in the lateral motor column are further organized into pools, each of which innervates a specific muscle in the limb.

UBERON:0010406.name: cholinergic enteric nerve
UBERON:0010406.def: Nerve fibers that utilize acetylcholine as a neurotransmitter to the intestinal system.

UBERON:0010408.name: ocular angle artery
UBERON:0010408.def: The angular artery is the terminal part of the facial artery; it ascends to the medial angle of the eye's orbit, imbedded in the fibers of the angular head of the Quadratus labii superioris, and accompanied by the angular vein.

UBERON:0010409.name: ocular surface region
UBERON:0010409.def: The integrated unit (of the eye) that consists of the conjunctiva, the corneal surface, and the ocular mucosal adnexa including the lid margins and the meibomian gland openings, the lacrimal glands and the lacrimal drainage system, all which are critical to maintain ocular surface integrity and provide protection from external antigens and pathogenic microorganisms.

UBERON:0010410.name: inguinal fat pad
UBERON:0010410.def: Encapsulated adipose tissue found in the groin.

UBERON:0010411.name: retroperitoneal fat pad
UBERON:0010411.def: Encapsulated adipose tissue found on the dorsal side of the peritoneum.

UBERON:0010412.name: epididymal fat pad
UBERON:0010412.def: Encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the epididymis.

UBERON:0010413.name: parametrial fat pad
UBERON:0010413.def: Encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the extension of the subserous coat of the uterus laterally between the layers of the broad ligament.

UBERON:0010414.name: omental fat pad
UBERON:0010414.def: Encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the fold of peritoneal tissue that extends from the stomach to the posterior abdominal wall after associating with the transverse colon.

UBERON:0010415.name: barrel cortex
UBERON:0010415.def: One of the discrete functional units of the somatosensory cortex that processes tactile information derived from the vibrissae.
synonym: barrel field of the primary somatosensory area

UBERON:0010416.name: lymph node B cell domain
UBERON:0010416.def: A part of the lymph node cortex in which B lymphocytes home to primary follicles to survey follicular dendritic cells (FDCs); antigen stimulated B cells proliferate and differentiate within the follicles forming distinctive germinal centers.
synonym: lymph node B cell dependent cortex

UBERON:0010417.name: lymph node T cell domain
UBERON:0010417.def: The paracortex and interfollicular cortex of the lymph node in which T lymphocytes home to survey dendritic cells.
synonym: lymph node T cell dependent paracortex
T cell zone of lymph node

UBERON:0010418.name: urethral opening
UBERON:0010418.def: An orifice that is part of a lower urinary tract.

UBERON:0010419.name: vibrissa follicle
UBERON:0010419.def: One of the tubular invaginations of the epidermis enclosing the hair roots and from which grow the vibrissae located on the muzzle and face of many species.

UBERON:0010420.name: lymph node germinal center mantle zone
UBERON:0010420.def: A part of the secondary follicle in which naive B cells reside along with some helper T cells, macrophages and follicular dendritic cells; these are displaced by the expanding germinal centre and form a 'mantle' around it.
synonym: mantle zone of lymph node germinal center

UBERON:0010421.name: spleen B cell corona
UBERON:0010421.def: The area of the (spleen) secondary B follicle that surrounds the germinal center and harbors the small recirculating B lymphocytes.
synonym: B cell domain of the spleen
B lymphocyte domain of the spleen

UBERON:0010422.name: primary nodular lymphoid tissue
UBERON:0010422.def: A lymphoid follicle containing naive B cells.

UBERON:0010423.name: primary lymphoid nodule of tonsil
UBERON:0010423.def: A primary nodular lymphoid tissue that is part of a tonsil.

UBERON:0010425.name: internal naris
UBERON:0010425.def: A naris that is located inside the nasal cavity and connects to the pharynx.

UBERON:0010426.name: oropharyngeal choana
UBERON:0010426.def: Opening/conduit between the nasal cavity and the oropharynx via the roof of the mouth.

UBERON:0010427.name: ciliary processes
UBERON:0010427.def: The ciliary processes are formed by the inward folding of the various layers of the choroid, i.e. , the choroid proper and the lamina basalis, and are received between corresponding foldings of the suspensory ligament of the lens.

UBERON:0010428.name: flat bone
UBERON:0010428.def: A bone that is shaped as a broad flat plate and composed of two thin layers of compact tissue enclosing between them a variable quantity of cancellous tissue, which is the location of red bone marrow.

UBERON:0010437.name: zygomaticus muscle
UBERON:0010437.def: One of: zygomaticus major, zygomaticus minor.

UBERON:0010496.name: teres minor muscle
UBERON:0010496.def: A narrow, elongated muscle of the rotator cuff.

UBERON:0010498.name: pseudostratified columnar epithelium
UBERON:0010498.def: A simple columnar epithelium that looks stratified but is not, because its cells are arranged with their nuclei at different levels.

UBERON:0010499.name: pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium
UBERON:0010499.def: Epithelium composed of a single layer of cells, appearing as layered because the column-shaped cells vary in height so the nuclei are at different levels. The basal portions of all the cells are in contact with the basement membrane. It lines the respiratory system and the male reproductive tract. The cilia in the respiratory tract are motile, while the stereocilia in the male reproductive tract are immobile.
UBERON:0010499.synonym: epithelium pseudostratificatum columnare ciliatum (trachea et bronchi)

UBERON:0010505.name: periosteal dura mater
UBERON:0010505.def: The outermost of the two layers of the cranial dura mater which normally always adheres to the periosteum of the bones of the cranial vault.
synonym: outer periosteal layer of dura mater

UBERON:0010506.name: meningeal dura mater
UBERON:0010506.def: The inner layer of the dura mater surrounding the brain. It is mostly fused with the outer layer, the endocranium that is adherent to the inner aspect of the cranial bones. These two layers form the dura mater. The latter covers and protects the brain and the spinal cord.

UBERON:0010507.name: layer of dura mater
UBERON:0010507.def: The intracranial dura mater, consisting of two layers: the outer periosteal layer which normally always adheres to the periosteum of the bones of the cranial vault; and the inner meningeal layer which in most places is fused with the outer. The two layers separate to accommodate meningeal vessels and large venous (dural) sinuses. The meningeal layer is also involved in the formation of the various dural folds, such as the falx cerebri and tentorium cerebelli and is comparable to and continuous with the dural mater of the spinal cord. The cranial epidural space is then a potential space between the bone and the combined periosteum/periosteal layer of the dura mater realised only pathologically and is neither continuous with or comparable to the vertebral epidural space.

UBERON:0010509.name: strand of pelage hair
UBERON:0010509.def: A strand of hair that is part of a coat of hair.

UBERON:0010510.name: strand of auchene hair
UBERON:0010510.def: A truncal hair that has a single constriction and bend about midway along the hair shaft, and contains two or more air cells in the medulla.

UBERON:0010511.name: strand of awl hair
UBERON:0010511.def: A truncal hairs that is straight, but shorter than a guard hair, and contain two or more air cells in the medulla.

UBERON:0010512.name: strand of guard hair
UBERON:0010512.def: A long, straight truncal hair that contains two air cells in the medulla[MP]. A strand of hair from the top layer consisting of longer, often coarser, straight shafts of hair that stick out through the underfur. This is usually the visible layer for most mammals and contains most of the pigmentation.

UBERON:0010513.name: strand of zigzag hair
UBERON:0010513.def: A truncal hair that has two or more sharp bends with diameter constrictions at the bends, and contain one air cell in the medulla.

UBERON:0010514.name: strand of duvet hair
UBERON:0010514.def: A strand of hair from the fine underhair of the coat.

UBERON:0010515.name: brille
UBERON:0010515.def: A layer of transparent, immovable disc-shaped skin or scale covering the eyes of some animals for protection, especially in animals without eyelids. The brille has evolved from a fusion of the upper and lower eyelids.

UBERON:0010516.name: clasper
UBERON:0010516.def: A male anatomical structure found some groups of animals, used in mating. Male cartilaginous fish have claspers formed from the posterior portion of their pelvic fin which serve as intromittent organs used to channel semen into the female's cloaca during mating. The act of mating in some fish including sharks usually includes one of the claspers raised to allow water into the siphon through a specific orifice. The clasper is then inserted into the vagina, where it opens like an umbrella to anchor its position. The siphon then begins to contract expelling water and sperm. Male chimaeras have cephalic claspers on their heads, which are thought to aid in holding the female during mating.

UBERON:0010517.name: cephalic clasper
UBERON:0010517.def: A mace-like spiny-headed rod found on the mid-dorsal surface of heads of male Holocephali. Thought to aid in holding the female during copulation.

UBERON:0010518.name: pelvic fin clasper
UBERON:0010518.def: The rod-like extension of the medial portion of the pelvic fin in male Elasmobranchii and Holocephali. Claspers are used as intromittent organs (not in clasping), the grooves on their facing surfaces together forming a tube for the transmission of sperm when the claspers are held together. The anterior proximal opening is called the apopyle, the posterior distal opening the rhipidion.

UBERON:0010519.name: tail electric organ
UBERON:0010519.def: An electric organ that is part of a tail.

UBERON:0010520.name: head electric organ
UBERON:0010520.def: An electric organ that is part of a head.

UBERON:0010521.name: electroreceptor organ
UBERON:0010521.def: An organ that is capable of detecting electrical stimulus.

UBERON:0010522.name: replacement element
UBERON:0010522.def: Skeletal element that forms as a replacement or substitution of another element or tissue.

UBERON:0010523.name: microcirculatory vessel
UBERON:0010523.def: A vessel of the microcirculature, lying between the arterioles and venules; includes capillaries (blood and lymphatic), metarterioles and arteriovenous anastomoses.

UBERON:0010524.name: fibularis tertius
UBERON:0010524.def: A muscle located in the lower limb that arises from the lower third of the anterior surface of the fibula; from the lower part of the interosseous membrane; and from an intermuscular septum between it and the peroneus brevis and inserted into the dorsal surface of the base of the metatarsal bone of the 5th digit. It is innervated by the deep fibular nerve. Its action is that of weak dorsiflexion of the ankle joint and to evert the foot at the ankle joint.

UBERON:0010526.name: fibularis brevis
UBERON:0010526.def: The peroneus brevis muscle (or fibularis brevis) lies under cover of the peroneus longus, and is a shorter and smaller muscle.

UBERON:0010527.name: cavity of bone organ
UBERON:0010527.def: An organ cavity that surrounded_by a bone.

UBERON:0010531.name: metanephros induced blastemal cells
synonym: cap mesenchyme of metanephros of urinary system

UBERON:0010532.name: primitive nephron
UBERON:0010532.def: An epithelial tube that is fated to become a nephron.

UBERON:0010533.name: metanephros cortex
UBERON:0010533.def: The metanephric cortex is the outer region of the metanephros[GO].

UBERON:0010534.name: primitive mesonephric nephron
