UBERON:0010534.def: Anatomical cluster which give rise to mature mesonephric nephrons. Zebrafish continously generate new mesonephric nephrons.

UBERON:0010535.name: primitive metanephric nephron
UBERON:0010535.def: A primitive nephron that is part of a metanephros.

UBERON:0010537.name: mesonephric nephron progenitor
UBERON:0010537.def: Cluster of cells comprising a portion of tissue which gives rise to new mesonephric nephrons. The cluster contains self-renewing stem cells.

UBERON:0010538.name: paired limb/fin segment
UBERON:0010538.def: An appendage segment that is part of a limb/fin.

UBERON:0010540.name: tarsus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010540.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a tarsal bone.

UBERON:0010541.name: tarsus cartilage element
UBERON:0010541.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a tarsal bone.

UBERON:0010543.name: acropodial skeleton
UBERON:0010543.def: The subdivision of the skeleton that consists of all the skeletal elements at the distalmost end of the autopodium - i.e. the bones of the digits or their cartilaginous precursors[VSAO,modified].

UBERON:0010544.name: metacarpus skeleton
UBERON:0010544.def: The metacarpus is the intermediate part of the manus skeleton that is located between the phalanges (bones of the fingers) distally and the carpus which forms the connection to the forearm. The metacarpus consists of metacarpal bones. The metacarpals form a transverse arch to which the rigid row of distal carpal bones are fixed. The peripheral metacarpals (those of the thumb and little finger) form the sides of the cup of the palmar gutter and as they are brought together they deepen this concavity. The index metacarpal is the most firmly fixed, while the thumb metacarpal articulates with the trapezium and acts independently from the others. The middle metacarpals are tightly united to the carpus by intrinsic interlocking bone elements at their bases. The ring metacarpal forms a transitional element of the semi-independent last metacarpal. [WP,unvetted].

UBERON:0010545.name: metatarsus skeleton
UBERON:0010545.def: Limb segment that consists of the long bones of the pes. The metatarsals are analogous to the metacarpal bones of the manus.

UBERON:0010546.name: metapodial skeleton
UBERON:0010546.def: Subdivision of skeleton that corresponds to metapodium region, between acropodial skeleton and mesopdoial skeleton.

UBERON:0010547.name: pedal digit 1 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010547.def: A pedal digit metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a pedal digit 1 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 1 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
pedal digit I metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010548.name: pedal digit 2 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010548.def: A pedal digit metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a pedal digit 2 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 2 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
pedal digit II metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010549.name: pedal digit 3 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010549.def: A pedal digit metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a pedal digit 3 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 3 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
pedal digit III metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010550.name: pedal digit 4 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010550.def: A pedal digit metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a pedal digit 4 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 4 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
pedal digit IV metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010551.name: pedal digit 5 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010551.def: A pedal digit metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a pedal digit 5 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 5 metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation
pedal digit V metatarsal pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010557.name: pedal digit 1 metatarsal cartilage element
UBERON:0010557.def: A pedal digit metatarsal cartilage condensation that is part of a pedal digit 1 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 1 metatarsal cartilage condensation
pedal digit I metatarsal cartilage element

UBERON:0010558.name: pedal digit 2 metatarsal cartilage element
UBERON:0010558.def: A pedal digit metatarsal cartilage element that is part of a pedal digit 2 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 2 metatarsal cartilage condensation
pedal digit II metatarsal cartilage element

UBERON:0010559.name: pedal digit 3 metatarsal cartilage element
UBERON:0010559.def: A pedal digit metatarsal cartilage element that is part of a pedal digit 3 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 3 metatarsal cartilage condensation
pedal digit III metatarsal cartilage element

UBERON:0010560.name: pedal digit 4 metatarsal cartilage element
UBERON:0010560.def: A pedal digit metatarsal cartilage element that is part of a pedal digit 4 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 4 metatarsal cartilage condensation
pedal digit IV metatarsal cartilage element

UBERON:0010561.name: pedal digit 5 metatarsal cartilage element
UBERON:0010561.def: A pedal digit metatarsal cartilage element that is part of a pedal digit 5 mesenchyme.
synonym: hind limb digit 5 metatarsal cartilage element
pedal digit V metatarsal cartilage element

UBERON:0010562.name: pedal digit 1 mesenchyme
UBERON:0010562.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing pedal digit 1.

UBERON:0010564.name: manual digit 1 mesenchyme
UBERON:0010564.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing manual digit 1.

UBERON:0010565.name: manual digit 1 metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010565.def: A manual digit metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a manual digit 1 mesenchyme.
synonym: fore limb digit 1 metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation
manual digit I metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010566.name: manual digit 2 metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010566.def: A manual digit metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a manual digit 2 mesenchyme.
synonym: fore limb digit 2 metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation
manual digit II metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010567.name: manual digit 3 metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010567.def: A manual digit metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a manual digit 3 mesenchyme.
synonym: fore limb digit 3 metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation
manual digit III metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010568.name: manual digit 4 metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010568.def: A manual digit metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a manual digit 4 mesenchyme.
synonym: fore limb digit 4 metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation
manual digit IV metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010688.name: skeleton of manual acropodium
UBERON:0010688.def: The subdivision of the skeleton that consists of all the skeletal elements at the distalmost end of the manual autopodium - i.e. the bones of the hands or their cartilaginous precursors[VSAO,modified].

UBERON:0010690.name: manual digit 1 epithelium
UBERON:0010690.def: An epithelium that is part of a manual digit 1.

UBERON:0010693.name: pedal digit 1 epithelium
UBERON:0010693.def: An epithelium that is part of a pedal digit 1.

UBERON:0010695.name: mesenchyme of tarsal region
UBERON:0010695.def: Mesenchyme of the carpal region that contributes to the tarsal skeleton.

UBERON:0010696.name: skeleton of pedal acropodium
UBERON:0010696.def: The subdivision of the skeleton that consists of all the skeletal elements at the distalmost end of the pedal autopodium - i.e. the bones of the foot or their cartilaginous precursors[cjm].

UBERON:0010697.name: pedal digit metatarsal cartilage element
synonym: hind limb digit metatarsal cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010698.name: manual digit metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation
synonym: fore limb digit metacarpus pre-cartilage condensation

UBERON:0010699.name: manual digit metacarpus cartilage element
synonym: fore limb digit metacarpus cartilage element

UBERON:0010703.name: forelimb zeugopod skeleton
UBERON:0010703.def: The collection of all skeletal elements in an forelimb zeugopod region.

UBERON:0010704.name: parenchyma of quadrate lobe of liver
UBERON:0010704.def: A liver parenchyma that is part of a quadrate lobe of liver.

UBERON:0010706.name: parenchyma of caudate lobe of liver
UBERON:0010706.def: A liver parenchyma that is part of a caudate lobe of liver.

UBERON:0010707.name: appendage girdle complex
UBERON:0010707.def: An organism subdivision that includes both an appendage and its associated girdle region. Note that this includes both the skeletal elements and associated tissues (integument, muscle, etc).

UBERON:0010708.name: pectoral complex
UBERON:0010708.def: Appendage girdle complex that when present, encompasses the pectoral appendicular skeleton and the pectoral girdle.
synonym: pectoral girdle plus anterior limb or fin
pectoral girdle plus pectoral limb or fin

UBERON:0010709.name: pelvic complex
UBERON:0010709.def: Appendage girdle complex that when present, encompasses the pelvic appendicular skeleton and the pelvic girdle.
synonym: pelvic girdle plus pelvic limb or fin
pelvic girdle plus posterior limb or fin

UBERON:0010710.name: pectoral fin skeleton
UBERON:0010710.def: Paired fin skeleton that consists of the supporting endochondral proximal and distal radials and the dermal fins rays or lepidotrichia. The pectoral fin skeleton is located in the thoracic region of the body and articulates with the scapula and coracoid.

UBERON:0010711.name: pelvic fin skeleton
UBERON:0010711.def: Paired fin skeleton located in the abdominal position that consists of supporting endochondral radialsB and dermal fin rays or lepidotrichia.

UBERON:0010712.name: limb skeleton subdivision
UBERON:0010712.def: Skeletal subdivision that is a segment of the limb skeleton.

UBERON:0010713.name: paired fin skeleton
UBERON:0010713.def: The collection of all skeletal elements in a single paired fin.

UBERON:0010714.name: iliac cartilage element
UBERON:0010714.def: An iliac endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010718.name: pubic cartilage element
UBERON:0010718.def: A pubic endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010719.name: girdle skeleton
UBERON:0010719.def: The subdivision of the skeleton of either the pectoral or pelvic girdle.

UBERON:0010720.name: hindlimb zeugopod skeleton
UBERON:0010720.def: Subdivision of skeleton consisting of all skeletal elements in an hindlimb zeugopod region. Typically consists of the tibia and the fibula.

UBERON:0010721.name: distal tarsal bone
UBERON:0010721.def: There are three cuneiform bones in the human foot: the medial cuneiform the intermediate cuneiform also known as the middle the lateral cuneiform. They are located between the navicular bone and the first, second and third metatarsal bones and are medial to the cuboid bone[WP, unvetted, human specific].

UBERON:0010722.name: accessory bone
UBERON:0010722.def: A bone which does not occur frequently in the body but is still present in a significantly large number of organisms.

UBERON:0010723.name: os vesalianum pedis
UBERON:0010723.def: An accessory bone located proximal to the base of the fifth metatarsal. Its prevalence has been reported to be from 0.1% to 1.0%. This bone is found within the peroneus brevis tendon and is considered to be asymptomatic in the majority of people.

UBERON:0010724.name: lateral tubercle of talus
UBERON:0010724.def: An accessory bone tubercle which if present lies posterior to the talus.

UBERON:0010725.name: accessory navicular bone
UBERON:0010725.def: An accessory bone of the pes that occasionally develops abnormally in front of the ankle towards the inside of the pes. This bone may be present in approximately 2.5% of the general population and is usually asymptomatic.

UBERON:0010727.name: sutural bone
UBERON:0010727.def: A piece of bone that is located within a suture in the cranium.

UBERON:0010728.name: sphenoid lesser wing pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010728.def: An orbitosphenoid endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0010732.name: alisphenoid pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010732.def: An alisphenoid endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0010733.name: alisphenoid cartilage element
UBERON:0010733.def: An alisphenoid endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010737.name: distal tarsal bone 4
UBERON:0010737.def: Endochondral tarsal bone articulating with centralia and metatarsal 4.

UBERON:0010738.name: distal tarsal bone 5
UBERON:0010738.def: Endochondral tarsal bone articulating with centralia and metatarsal 5.

UBERON:0010739.name: distal carpal bone 5
UBERON:0010739.def: Endochondral carpal bone similar to distal carpal 4, but lost in most reptiles and mammals.

UBERON:0010740.name: bone of appendage girdle complex
UBERON:0010740.def: A bone that is part of an appendage girdle complex (i.e. any bone in a limb, fin or girdle).

UBERON:0010741.name: bone of pectoral complex
UBERON:0010741.def: A bone that is part of a pectoral complex. Examples: scapula, manus phalanx, any carpal bone, any bone of the pectoral fin.
synonym: bone of forelimb or pectoral fin or pectoral girdle

UBERON:0010742.name: bone of pelvic complex
UBERON:0010742.def: A bone that is part of a pelvic complex. Examples: pubis, ischium, fot phalanx, any tarsal bone, any bone of the pelvic fin or girdle.

UBERON:0010743.name: meningeal cluster
UBERON:0010743.def: The collection of all meningeal layers that line a central nervous system.

UBERON:0010744.name: sacral vertebra pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010744.def: A sacral vertebra endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0010745.name: sacral vertebra cartilage element
UBERON:0010745.def: A sacral vertebra endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010746.name: iliac blade
UBERON:0010746.def: The extension of the ilium above the level of the acetabulum. Attachment site for both hindlimb and caudal musculature. Medially is the site of attachment of the sacral ribs, where these exist[PHENOSCAPE:ad].

UBERON:0010747.name: body of ilium
UBERON:0010747.def: The body of ilium enters into the formation of the acetabulum, of which it forms rather less than two-fifths. Its external surface is partly articular, partly non-articular; the articular segment forms part of the lunate surface of the acetabulum, the non-articular portion contributes to the acetabular fossa. The internal surface of the body is part of the wall of the lesser pelvis and gives origin to some fibers of the Obturator internus. Below, it is continuous with the pelvic surfaces of the ischium and pubis, only a faint line indicating the place of union.

UBERON:0010748.name: lymph node follicle
UBERON:0010748.def: A lymphoid follicle that is part of a lymph node.

UBERON:0010749.name: middle pharyngeal constrictor
UBERON:0010749.def: The middle pharyngeal constrictor is a fanshaped muscle, smaller than the Inferior pharyngeal constrictor muscle.

UBERON:0010750.name: prefrontal bone
UBERON:0010750.def: A bone separating the lacrimal and frontal bones in many tetrapod skulls.

UBERON:0010751.name: squamous part of temporal bone primordium

UBERON:0010752.name: exoccipital cartilage element
UBERON:0010752.def: An exoccipital endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010753.name: lymph node secondary follicle
UBERON:0010753.def: A secondary follicle that is located in a lymph node.

UBERON:0010754.name: germinal center
UBERON:0010754.def: A collection of activated B cells at the center of a secondary follicle, formed after B cells become activated and migrate to the center.

UBERON:0010755.name: secondary follicle corona
UBERON:0010755.def: The part of the secondary follicle that surrounds the germinal center.

UBERON:0010756.name: spleen follicular dendritic cell network
UBERON:0010756.def: The enmeshed group of antigen presenting cells with extensive dendritic processes in the spleen B cell follicle that present antigen to B cells during an immune response.

UBERON:0010757.name: rib 8
UBERON:0010757.def: The eighth rib counting from the top of the rib cage down. Note that members of this class are not necessarily homologous[ncit,modified].

UBERON:0010758.name: subdivision of organism along appendicular axis
UBERON:0010758.def: A major subdivision of an organism that divides an organism along an axis perpedicular to the main body anterior-posterior axis. In vertebrates, this is typically a fin or limb segment. In insects, this includes segments of appendages such as antennae, as well as segments of the insect leg.

UBERON:0010759.name: equine distal sesamoid
UBERON:0010759.def: Lies on the palmar aspect of the coffin joint between the second phalanx and third phalanx. articulates closely with the distal phalanx, to which it is connected by the impar ligament of the navicular bone. The impar ligament is very strong and permits relatively little motion between the navicular bone and the distal phalanx.

UBERON:0010760.name: supraglenoid tubercle
UBERON:0010760.def: The supraglenoid tubercle is a region of the scapula to which the long head of the biceps brachii muscle attaches.

UBERON:0010801.name: calcaneum pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010801.def: A calcaneum endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0010842.name: calcaneum cartilage element
UBERON:0010842.def: A calcaneum endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010843.name: clavicle cartilage element
UBERON:0010843.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a clavicle.

UBERON:0010844.name: clavicle pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010844.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a clavicle.

UBERON:0010846.name: radius pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010846.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a radius bone.

UBERON:0010847.name: ulna pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010847.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a ulna.

UBERON:0010848.name: radius-ulna cartilage element
UBERON:0010848.def: A radius-ulna endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010849.name: tibia cartilage element
UBERON:0010849.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a tibia.

UBERON:0010850.name: tibia pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010850.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a tibia.

UBERON:0010851.name: fibula cartilage element
UBERON:0010851.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a fibula.

UBERON:0010852.name: fibula pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010852.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a fibula.

UBERON:0010853.name: capitulum of humerus
UBERON:0010853.def: A smooth, rounded eminence on the lateral portion of the articular surface of the humerus. It articulates with the cupshaped depression on the head of the radius, and is limited to the front and lower part of the bone.

UBERON:0010854.name: skin of front of neck
UBERON:0010854.def: A skin of neck that is part of a throat.
synonym: skin of anterior part of neck
skin of anterior portion of neck

UBERON:0010855.name: skin of forelimb wing
UBERON:0010855.def: A zone of skin that is part of a forelimb wing.

UBERON:0010856.name: patagium
UBERON:0010856.def: A membranous extension of skin that forms the wing material in animals such as bats. It typically comprises a number of patagial segments, stretching from the side of the body between the forelimb digits and sometimes the hindlimbs.

UBERON:0010861.name: propatagium
UBERON:0010861.def: In bats and pterosaurs, thin web of skin that extends from the shoulder to the wrist anterior to the upper arm and forearm, and is fixed on the neck or skull.

UBERON:0010862.name: dactylopatagium
UBERON:0010862.def: An interdigital region that is part of a patagium.

UBERON:0010863.name: dactylopatagium brevis
UBERON:0010863.def: A dactylopatagium that is connected_to a manual digit 1 and connected_to a manual digit 2.

UBERON:0010864.name: dactylopatagium minus
UBERON:0010864.def: A dactylopatagium that is connected_to a manual digit 2 and connected_to a manual digit 3.

UBERON:0010865.name: dactylopatagium medius
UBERON:0010865.def: A dactylopatagium that is connected_to a manual digit 3 and connected_to a manual digit 4.

UBERON:0010866.name: dactylopatagium major
UBERON:0010866.def: A dactylopatagium that is connected_to a manual digit 4 and connected_to a manual digit 5.

UBERON:0010867.name: plagiopatagium
UBERON:0010867.def: A flight membrane running between the body and the limb or digits.

UBERON:0010868.name: uropropatagium
UBERON:0010868.def: The membrane that is stretches between the legs of bats, used for flight, and in the case of insect-eating bats, for catching prey.

UBERON:0010869.name: calcar
UBERON:0010869.def: A spur of cartilage arising from inner side of ankle and running along part of outer interfemoral membrane in bats.

UBERON:0010879.name: tusk
UBERON:0010879.def: A calcareous tooth that is elongated and protrudes from the mouth.

UBERON:0010880.name: gular fold
UBERON:0010880.def: A transverse fold of skin across the throat (Peters 1964).

UBERON:0010881.name: limb cartilage element
UBERON:0010881.def: A skeletal element that is part of a limb and composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010882.name: limb bone pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010882.def: A skeletal element that is part of a limb and composed of pre-cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0010883.name: forelimb cartilage element
UBERON:0010883.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a forelimb bone.

UBERON:0010884.name: forelimb bone pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010884.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a forelimb bone.

UBERON:0010885.name: hindlimb cartilage element
UBERON:0010885.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a hindlimb bone.

UBERON:0010886.name: hindlimb pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010886.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a hindlimb bone.

UBERON:0010887.name: tragus
UBERON:0010887.def: A small pointed eminence of the external ear, situated in front of the concha, and projecting backward over the meatus.

UBERON:0010888.name: obsolete seta
UBERON:0010888.def: A hair-like unicellular external process of the body wall or any derivative of the latter; a hair; a bristle.

UBERON:0010889.name: ectethmoid
UBERON:0010889.def: Either of two lateral parts of the ethmoid bone that form part of the anterior wall of the orbit.

UBERON:0010890.name: pelvic complex muscle
UBERON:0010890.def: Muscles of the pelvic girdle, hindlimb or pelvic fin.
synonym: muscle of pelvic girdle and leg
pelvic girdle and hind limb muscles
pelvic girdle or hind limb muscle
pelvic girdle or posterior limb muscle

UBERON:0010891.name: pectoral complex muscle
UBERON:0010891.def: A muscle of a pectoral girdle, pectoral fin or anterior limb.
synonym: muscle of pectoral girdle and limb
muscle of pectoral girdle and wing
pectoral girdle and fore limb muscles

UBERON:0010892.name: mesethmoid element
UBERON:0010892.def: An endochondral element of the nasal capsule that forms septum between nasal capsules and usually remains unossified in mammals.

UBERON:0010893.name: median external naris
UBERON:0010893.def: Am unpaired external naris that lies in the midline of the head.

UBERON:0010895.name: sequential hermaphroditic organism
UBERON:0010895.def: Hermaphroditic organism that produces gametes first of one sex, and then later of the other sex.

UBERON:0010898.name: gastralium
UBERON:0010898.def: Dermal element that arises via intramembranous ossification and are developmentally distinct from true ribs that articulate with the vertebral column.

UBERON:0010899.name: synchronous hermaphroditic organism
UBERON:0010899.def: Hermaphroditic organism that produces both male and female gametes at the same time.

UBERON:0010900.name: tarsometatarsus cartilage element
UBERON:0010900.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a tarsometatarsus.

UBERON:0010901.name: tarsometatarsus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010901.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a tarsometatarsus.

UBERON:0010902.name: tibiotarsus cartilage element
UBERON:0010902.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a tibiotarsus.

UBERON:0010903.name: tibiotarsus pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0010903.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a tibiotarsus.

UBERON:0010905.name: clavicle bone primordium
UBERON:0010905.def: A primordium that develops into a clavicle bone.

UBERON:0010907.name: parafibula
UBERON:0010907.def: Third bone of the lower leg, normally restricted to the area of the knee, in multuberculates, monotremes and some therians.

UBERON:0010908.name: paraglossale
UBERON:0010908.def: An arrowhead-shaped bone in the avian hyoid apparatus which forms the base of the tongue.

UBERON:0010910.name: opisthotic
UBERON:0010910.def: Posterior ossification of the otic capsule.

UBERON:0010911.name: ossicle
UBERON:0010911.def: Skeletal element that is often isolated, small, and variable in composition.

UBERON:0010912.name: subdivision of skeleton
UBERON:0010912.def: Anatomical cluster consisting of the skeletal elements (i.e. bone elements, cartilage elements, cartilage condensations) that are part of an individual subdivision of the organism. Excludes joints.

UBERON:0010913.name: vertebral element
UBERON:0010913.def: Skeletal element that forms around the notochord and is part of the vertebral column.

UBERON:0010925.name: median thyrohyoid ligament
UBERON:0010925.def: The middle thicker part of the thyrohyoid membrane is termed the median thyrohyoid ligament (middle hyothyroid ligament, middle thyrohyoid ligament), its lateral thinner portions are pierced by the superior laryngeal vessels and the internal branch of the superior laryngeal nerve. Its anterior surface is in relation with the Thyreohyoideus, Sternohyoideus, and Omohyoideus, and with the body of the hyoid bone.

UBERON:0010926.name: lateral thyrohyoid ligament
UBERON:0010926.def: The lateral thyrohyoid ligament (lateral hyothyroid ligament) is a round elastic cord, which forms the posterior border of the hyothyroid membrane and passes between the tip of the superior cornu of the thyroid cartilage and the extremity of the greater cornu of the hyoid bone. The recurrent laryngeal nerve typical lies lateral to this ligament.

UBERON:0010927.name: thyroepiglotticus muscle
UBERON:0010927.def: Fibers of the thyroarytenoid muscle that continue to the margin of the epiglottis; it closes the inlet to the larynx.

UBERON:0010928.name: cricopharyngeus muscle
UBERON:0010928.def: The cricopharyngeus is a pharyngeal arch 4/6 muscle that participates in oral/pharyngeal behaviors and is innervated by the pharyngeal plexus and the recurrent laryngeal n. (from Vagus, CN X), and is an integral part of the pharyngeal tube, and attaches to the cricoid cartilage and the midline raphe. It acts as a sphincter between the pharynx and esophagus.
synonym: cricopharyngeal part of inferior constrictor pharyngeus
cricopharyngeal part of inferior pharyngeal constrictor
cricopharyngeal part of inferior pharyngeal constrictor muscle
cricopharyngeus portion of the inferior pharyngeal constrictor
pars cricopharyngea musculus constrictoris pharyngis inferioris

UBERON:0010931.name: intermandibularis
UBERON:0010931.def: Is a mandibular muscle that develops into the ventral intermandibularis anterior and posterior muscles.

UBERON:0010932.name: crico-arytenoid muscle
UBERON:0010932.def: Cricoarytenoid muscles are muscles that connect the cricoid cartilage and arytenoid cartilage. More specifically, it can refer to: Posterior cricoarytenoid muscle Lateral cricoarytenoid muscle.

UBERON:0010933.name: orbicularis oris muscle
UBERON:0010933.def: The orbicularis oris is a superficial facial muscle with fibers that encircle the opening of the oral cavity that attaches to the maxilla, mandible, skin and modiolus, and that participates in oral/pharyngeal behaviors, and is innervated by the facial nerve (CN VII).

UBERON:0010936.name: thyropharyngeus muscle
synonym: pars thyropharyngea musculus constrictoris pharyngis inferioris
thyropharyngeal part of inferior constrictor pharyngeus
thyropharyngeal part of inferior constrictor pharyngeus muscle
thyropharyngeal part of inferior pharyngeal constrictor

UBERON:0010937.name: salpingopharyngeus muscle
UBERON:0010937.def: The salpingopharyngeus muscle arises from the inferior part of the cartilage of the pharyngotympanic tube (Eustachian tube) in the nasal cavity; it passes downward and blends with the posterior fasciculus of the palatopharyngeus muscle. The salpingopharyngeus is known to raise the pharynx and larynx during deglutition (swallowing) and laterally draws the pharyngeal walls up. In addition, it opens the pharyngeal orifice of the pharyngotympanic tube during swallowing. This allows for the equalization of pressure between the auditory canal and the pharynx. The salpingopharyngeus is innervated by the vagus nerve (CN X) via the pharyngeal plexus.

UBERON:0010940.name: muscle of digastric group
UBERON:0010940.def: Either of the two muscles that comprise the digastric group (anterior or posterior).

UBERON:0010943.name: anterior digastric muscle
UBERON:0010943.def: The anterior digastric is a pharyngeal arch I muscle that participates in oral/pharygeal behaviors and is innervated by the nerve to mylohyoid (a branch of the third division of the trigeminal nerve), is attached to the mandible and to the hyoid apparatus, and it is superficial to mylohyoid muscle.

UBERON:0010944.name: posterior digastric muscle
UBERON:0010944.def: The posterior digastric is a pharyngeal arch II muscle that participates in oral pharyngeal behavior, is innervated by the digastric branch of facial nerve and attaches to the posterior cranial base and the hyoid apparatus. It is found superficial to the mylohyoid muscle.

UBERON:0010945.name: jugulohyoideus muscle
UBERON:0010945.def: Runs from the processus jugularis to the os stylohyoideum; innervated with the ramus jugulohyoideus from the nervus facialis.

UBERON:0010946.name: occipitofrontalis muscle
UBERON:0010946.def: The occipitofrontalis or epicranius is a muscle which covers parts of the skull. It consists of two parts or bellies: The occipital belly, near the occipital bone, and the frontal belly, near the frontal bone.

UBERON:0010947.name: occipitalis
UBERON:0010947.def: A belly of the occipitofrontalis muscle that is near the occipital bone.

UBERON:0010948.name: cleidooccipital muscle
UBERON:0010948.def: A muscle organ that attaches_to a clavicle and attaches_to a occipital bone.

UBERON:0010949.name: sternooccipital muscle
UBERON:0010949.def: A muscle organ that has_muscle_insertion a occipital bone and has_muscle_origin a sternum.

UBERON:0010950.name: styloauricular muscle
UBERON:0010950.def: An occasional small muscle extending from the root of the styloid process to the cartilage of the meatus of the ear.

UBERON:0010951.name: interscutular muscle
UBERON:0010951.def: A muscle that attaches to the base of the ear and to the middle of the skull.

UBERON:0010952.name: frontalis muscle belly
UBERON:0010952.def: A belly of the occipitofrontalis muscle that is near the frontal bone.

UBERON:0010953.name: nasalis muscle
UBERON:0010953.def: The nasalis (compressor naris) is a sphincter-like muscle of the nose whose function is to compress the nasal cartilage. It consists of two parts, transverse and alar: The transverse part arises from the maxilla, above and lateral to the incisive fossa; its fibers proceed upward and medially, expanding into a thin aponeurosis which is continuous on the bridge of the nose with that of the muscle of the opposite side, and with the aponeurosis of the Procerus. The alar part is attached at one end to the greater alar cartilage, and at the other to the integument at the point of the nose. Other sources divide it into 'Compressor nasalis' and 'Dilator nasalis'.

UBERON:0010954.name: ceratohyoideus muscle
UBERON:0010954.def: The ceratohyoideus is a muscle of Pharyngeal Arch III that participates in oral/pharyngeal behaviors and is innervated by the glossopharyngeal n. , and attaches to the ceratohyal part of the hyoid apparatus and also to a non-ceratohyal part of the hyoid apparatus.[FEED].

UBERON:0010956.name: pterygopharyngeal part of superior pharyngeal constrictor
synonym: pars pterygopharyngea musculus constrictoris pharyngis superioris
pterygopharyngeal part of superior constrictor pharyngeus

UBERON:0010958.name: arytenoid muscle
UBERON:0010958.def: A single muscle, filling up the posterior concave surfaces of the arytenoid cartilages. It arises from the posterior surface and lateral border of one arytenoid cartilage, and is inserted into the corresponding parts of the opposite cartilage. It consists of oblique and transverse parts.

UBERON:0010959.name: craniocervical muscle
UBERON:0010959.def: Any muscle organ that is part of either the head or the neck.

UBERON:0010989.name: transverospinalis pre-muscle mass
UBERON:0010989.def: A pre-muscle condensation that will develop into a transverospinalis muscle.

UBERON:0010990.name: transversospinales muscle
UBERON:0010990.def: The transversospinal muscles are a group of muscles of the human back. Their combined action is rotation and extension of the vertebral column. They include: semispinalis, spanning 4-6 vertebral segments semispinalis dorsi semispinalis cervicis semispinalis capitis multifidus, spanning 2-4 vertebral segments rotatores, spanning 1-2 vertebral segments rotatores cervicis rotatores thoracis rotatores lumborum.

UBERON:0010994.name: coronoid process of ulna
UBERON:0010994.def: A triangular eminence projecting forward from the proximal epiphysis of the ulna[WP,modified].

UBERON:0010996.name: articular cartilage of joint
UBERON:0010996.def: A thin layer of cartilage, usually hyaline, on the articular surface of bones in synovial joints.

UBERON:0011002.name: articular cartilage element
UBERON:0011002.def: Cartilage of the lower jaw that give rise to a portion of the anguloarticular compound bone.

UBERON:0011004.name: pharyngeal arch cartilage
UBERON:0011004.def: A cartilage element that is part of a splanchnocranium.

UBERON:0011005.name: endocardium of auricle
UBERON:0011005.def: An endocardium that is part of a atrium auricular region.

UBERON:0011006.name: endocardium of left auricle
UBERON:0011006.def: An endocardium that is part of a left atrium auricular region.

UBERON:0011007.name: endocardium of right auricle
UBERON:0011007.def: An endocardium that is part of a right atrium auricular region.

UBERON:0011011.name: brachioradialis
UBERON:0011011.def: Brachioradialis is a muscle of the forearm that acts to flex the forearm at the elbow. It is also capable of both pronation and supination, depending on the position of the forearm. It is attached to the distal styloid process of the radius by way of the brachioradialis tendon, and to the lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus.

UBERON:0011012.name: flexor pollicis brevis muscle
UBERON:0011012.def: The flexor pollicis brevis is a muscle in the hand that flexes the thumb. It is one of three thenar muscles. It has both a superficial part and a deep part.

UBERON:0011013.name: spinalis muscle
UBERON:0011013.def: The spinalis is the portion of the erector spinae, a bundle of muscles and tendons, located nearest to the spine. It is divided into three parts. [WP,unvetted].

UBERON:0011014.name: spinalis capitis muscle
UBERON:0011014.def: Origin: spines of upper thoracic and lower cervical vertebrae; insertion: occipital bone; innervation: spinal nerves; action, extends head.

UBERON:0011016.name: pyramidalis
UBERON:0011016.def: The pyramidalis is a small and triangular muscle, anterior to the Rectus abdominis, and contained in the rectus sheath.

UBERON:0011017.name: semispinalis muscle
UBERON:0011017.def: A transversospinalis muscle of the human body.

UBERON:0011022.name: flexor hallucis brevis muscle
UBERON:0011022.def: A muscle that originates from the cuboid bone and divides into two portions, which are inserted into the medial and lateral sides of the base of the first phalanx of the great toe, a sesamoid bone being present in each tendon at its insertion.

UBERON:0011024.name: extrinsic extensor muscle of manus
UBERON:0011024.def: The extrinsic extensor muscles of the hand are located in the back of the forearm and have long tendons connecting them to bones in the hand, where they exert their action.

UBERON:0011025.name: aryepiglotticus muscle
UBERON:0011025.def: The aryepiglotticus is a muscle of the larynx running in the aryepiglottic fold from the arytenoid cartilage to the epiglottis.

UBERON:0011043.name: obturator muscle
UBERON:0011043.def: One of: obturator externus or obturator internus.

UBERON:0011048.name: obturator internus
UBERON:0011048.def: The obturator internus muscle originates on the medial surface of the obturator membrane, the ischium near the membrane, and the rim of the pubis. It exits the pelvic cavity through the lesser sciatic foramen. The obturator internus is situated partly within the lesser pelvis, and partly at the back of the hip-joint. It functions to help laterally rotate extended thigh and abduct flexed thigh, as well as to steady the femoral head in the acetabulum.

UBERON:0011049.name: uterovesical pouch
UBERON:0011049.def: The peritoneum over the rectum and the bladder is continued over the intestinal surface and fundus of the uterus on to its vesical surface, which it covers as far as the junction of the body and cervix uteri, and then to the bladder, forming here a second, but shallower, pouch, the vesicouterine excavation (or uterovesical pouch). The vesicouterine excavation is close to the anterior fornix of the vagina.

UBERON:0011050.name: thoracic vertebra 8
UBERON:0011050.def: The eighth thoracic vertebra counting from the top down. Note that members of this class are not necessarily homologous[ncit,modified].

UBERON:0011060.name: perilymphatic channel
UBERON:0011060.def: A channel containing perilymph passing through the temporal bone, connecting the scala tympani of the cochlea to the subarachnoid space.

UBERON:0011078.name: endolymphatic space
UBERON:0011078.def: Endolymph-filled space contained by the membranous labyrinth.

UBERON:0011079.name: angular bone
UBERON:0011079.def: Dermal bone that is located posterior to the dentary and lateral to the articular and retroarticular bones of the lower jaw. The angular forms the outer dermal sheet of the posterior part of the lower jaw. The angular bears a portion of the mandibular sensory canal. The angular is a paired bone.

UBERON:0011085.name: palatoquadrate arch
UBERON:0011085.def: The dorsal portion of the first pharyngeal arch, comprising the upper jaw[ZFIN,VHOG].

UBERON:0011088.name: ligament of knee joint
UBERON:0011088.def: A ligament that is part of a knee joint.

UBERON:0011090.name: skeleton of right pelvic girdle
UBERON:0011090.def: A skeleton of pelvic girdle that is part of a right pelvic girdle region.

UBERON:0011091.name: skeleton of left pelvic girdle
UBERON:0011091.def: A skeleton of pelvic girdle that is part of a left pelvic girdle region.

UBERON:0011092.name: right pelvic girdle region
UBERON:0011092.def: A pelvic girdle region that is in the right side of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0011093.name: left pelvic girdle region
UBERON:0011093.def: A pelvic girdle region that is in the left side of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0011094.name: vertebra cartilage element
UBERON:0011094.def: The cartilaginous form of a vertebral element, a skeletal element that forms around the notochord and is part of the vertebral column.

UBERON:0011095.name: vertebra pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0011095.def: The pre-cartilaginous form of a vertebral element, a skeletal element that forms around the notochord and is part of the vertebral column.

UBERON:0011096.name: lacrimal nerve
UBERON:0011096.def: The lacrimal nerve is the smallest of the three branches of the ophthalmic division of the trigeminal nerve.

UBERON:0011104.name: epiphysis of fifth metacarpal bone
UBERON:0011104.def: An epiphysis that is part of a metacarpal bone of digit 5.

UBERON:0011106.name: cruciate ligament of atlas
UBERON:0011106.def: A cruciate ligament in the neck forming part of the atlanto-axial joint. It consists of the transverse ligament of the atlas, along with additional fibers above and below.

UBERON:0011107.name: synovial joint of pelvic girdle
UBERON:0011107.def: A synovial joint that is part of a pelvic girdle region.

UBERON:0011108.name: synovial joint of pectoral girdle
UBERON:0011108.def: A synovial joint that is part of a pectoral girdle region.

UBERON:0011110.name: humeroulnar joint
UBERON:0011110.def: The humeroulnar joint, is part of the elbow-joint or the Olecron Joint, between the ulna and humerus bones is the simple hinge-joint, which allows for movements of flexion, extension and circumduction. The Humero-Ulnar Joint is the junction of trochlear notch of the ulna and the trochlea of the humerus. Owing to the obliquity of the trochlea of the humerus, this movement does not take place in the antero-posterior plane of the body of the humerus. When the forearm is extended and supinated, the axis of the arm and forearm are not in the same line; the arm forms an obtuse angle with the forearm. During flexion, however, the forearm and the hand tend to approach the middle line of the body, and thus enable the hand to be easily carried to the face. The accurate adaptation of the trochlea of the humerus, with its prominences and depressions, to the semilunar notch of the ulna, prevents any lateral movement. Flexion is produced by the action of the Biceps brachii and Brachialis, assisted by the Brachioradialis, with a tiny contribution from the muscles arising from the medial epicondyle of the humerus. Extension is produced by the Triceps brachii and AnconC&us, with a tiny contribution from the muscles arising from the lateral epicondyle of the humerus, such as the Extensor digitorum communis.

UBERON:0011111.name: humeroradial joint
UBERON:0011111.def: A hinge joint between the head of the radius and the capitulum of the humerus.

UBERON:0011112.name: tibiofibular joint
UBERON:0011112.def: A joint that connects the tibia and the fibula.

UBERON:0011113.name: inferior tibiofibular joint
UBERON:0011113.def: The inferior tibiofibular articulation (tibiofibular syndesmosis) is formed by the rough, convex surface of the medial side of the lower end of the fibula, and a rough concave surface on the lateral side of the tibia. Below, to the extent of about 4 mm. these surfaces are smooth, and covered with cartilage, which is continuous with that of the ankle-joint. The ligaments are: Anterior ligament of the lateral malleolus, Posterior ligament of the lateral malleolus, Inferior transverse ligament of the tibiofibular syndesmosis, Interosseous ligament.

UBERON:0011117.name: superior tibiofibular joint
UBERON:0011117.def: The superior tibiofibular articulation is an arthrodial joint between the lateral condyle of the tibia and the head of the fibula. The contiguous surfaces of the bones present flat, oval facets covered with cartilage and connected together by an articular capsule and by anterior and posterior ligaments. When the term 'tibiofibular articulation' is used without a modifier, it refers to the superior, and not the inferior tibiofibular articulation.

UBERON:0011118.name: tarsometatarsal joint
UBERON:0011118.def: The tarsometatarsal articulations are arthrodial joints in the pes.

UBERON:0011119.name: carpometacarpal joint
UBERON:0011119.def: The carpometacarpal joints (CMC) are joints in the wrist that articulates the distal row of carpal bones and the proximal bases of the metacarpal bones.

UBERON:0011120.name: laryngeal joint
UBERON:0011120.def: A skeletal joint that connects a laryngeal cartilage.

UBERON:0011121.name: cricothyroid joint
UBERON:0011121.def: The cricoarytenoid articulation (or joint) is a joint connecting the cricoid cartilage and the thyroid cartilage.

UBERON:0011122.name: cricoarytenoid joint
UBERON:0011122.def: The cricoarytenoid articulation (or joint) is a joint connecting the cricoid cartilage and the arytenoid cartilage.

UBERON:0011123.name: stifle joint
UBERON:0011123.def: A complex joint in the hind limbs of quadruped mammals such as the sheep, horse or dog. It is the equivalent joint to the human knee. It is often the largest synovial joint in the body.

UBERON:0011124.name: xiphisternal joint
UBERON:0011124.def: The xiphisternal joint (or xiphisternal synchondrosis) is a location near the bottom of the sternum, where the body of the sternum and the xiphoid process.

UBERON:0011131.name: intermetacarpal joint
UBERON:0011131.def: A skeletal joint that connects two adjacent metacarpals[FMA,modified].

UBERON:0011132.name: intercarpal joint
UBERON:0011132.def: A skeletal joint that connects two carpal bones.

UBERON:0011133.name: intermetatarsal joint
UBERON:0011133.def: A joint that connects two adjacent metatarsals.

UBERON:0011134.name: nonsynovial joint
UBERON:0011134.def: Joint in which the articulating bones or cartilages are connected by ligaments or fibrocartilage without an intervening synovial cavity. Examples: sagittal suture, inferior tibiofibular syndesmosis, costochondral joint, pubic symphysis.

UBERON:0011135.name: intervertebral cartilage
UBERON:0011135.def: A cartilage element that lies between two successive vertebral centra.

UBERON:0011136.name: ligament of vertebral column
UBERON:0011136.def: Ligament that joins successive centra. Important in controlling the stiffness of the vertebral column when it flexes.

UBERON:0011137.name: axial skeletal system
UBERON:0011137.def: Subdivision of the skeletal system which consists of the axial skeleton plus associated joints.

UBERON:0011138.name: postcranial axial skeletal system
UBERON:0011138.def: Subdivision of the skeletal system which consists of the postcranial axial skeleton plus associated joints.

UBERON:0011139.name: synovial limb joint
UBERON:0011139.def: Any synovial joint that is part of a (free) limb.
UBERON:0011139.synonym: synovial joint of free limb segment

UBERON:0011141.name: appendicular ossicle
UBERON:0011141.def: Ossicle that is part of the appendicular skeleton.

UBERON:0011142.name: axial ossicle
UBERON:0011142.def: Ossicle that is part of the axial skeleton.

UBERON:0011143.name: upper urinary tract
UBERON:0011143.def: Subdivision of urinary system which consists of the kidney and the ureters.

UBERON:0011145.name: adductor muscle
UBERON:0011145.def: A muscle capable of adduction. Adduction is a movement which brings a part of the anatomy closer to the middle sagittal plane of the body. It is opposed to abduction.

UBERON:0011146.name: silk gland
UBERON:0011146.def: Any of the glands in silk-spinning insects and spiders that secrete a protein liquid that hardens into silk on exposure to air.

UBERON:0011147.name: Verson's gland
UBERON:0011147.def: A gland found in the larvae of lepidoptera. Each gland is made of three cells: the secretory cell, the reservoir cell and the canal cell.

UBERON:0011148.name: submucosal gland
UBERON:0011148.def: Gland of the lamina epithelialis mucosae which perforate the lamina muscularis, with their adenomeres located in the submucosal connective tissue.

UBERON:0011149.name: Marshall's gland
UBERON:0011149.def: A paired hollow organ in the genito-urinary apparatus of Raja (and probably other skates and rays) whose cavity is fluid filled.

UBERON:0011150.name: pharyngeal arch derived gill
UBERON:0011150.def: A gill that develops_from a pharyngeal gill precursor.

UBERON:0011151.name: jaw depressor muscle
UBERON:0011151.def: A muscle whose action is to depress the lower jaw.

UBERON:0011154.name: gular region
UBERON:0011154.def: Surface structure that extends from the chin covering pharynx and larynx.

UBERON:0011155.name: Sylvian cistern
UBERON:0011155.def: The subarachnoid space associated with the lateral cerebral sulcus (Sylvian fissure); contains the M1 segment of the middle cerebral artery and the origin of lenticulostriate arteries, and proximal parts of the middle cerebral artery.

UBERON:0011156.name: facial skeleton
UBERON:0011156.def: Subdivision of skull that consists of the facial bones.

UBERON:0011157.name: cuneiform cartilage
UBERON:0011157.def: The cuneiform cartilages of the larynx are two small, elongated pieces of yellow elastic cartilage, placed one on either side, in the aryepiglottic fold, where they give rise to small whitish elevations on the surface of the mucous membrane, just in front of the arytenoid cartilages.

UBERON:0011158.name: primary subdivision of skull
UBERON:0011158.def: The skull can be divided into two: the neurocranium and the facial skeleton.

UBERON:0011159.name: primary subdivision of cranial skeletal system

UBERON:0011160.name: nasal suture
UBERON:0011160.def: A suture joining a nasal bone to another bone.

UBERON:0011161.name: spheno-occipital synchondrosis
UBERON:0011161.def: The cartilaginous junction between the basisphenoid and basioccipital bones of the mammalian skull.

UBERON:0011162.name: supraoccipital cartilage element
UBERON:0011162.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a supraoccipital bone.

UBERON:0011163.name: supraoccipital pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0011163.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a supraoccipital bone.

UBERON:0011164.name: neurocranium bone
UBERON:0011164.def: A bone that is part of a neurocranium [Automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0011165.name: crico-esophageal tendon
UBERON:0011165.def: Longitudinal fibers of the esophagus that attaches to the posterior aspect of the cricoid cartilage of the larynx.

UBERON:0011167.name: septomaxilla bone
UBERON:0011167.def: Paired, intramembranous bones located within the nasal capsules and embedded in the nasal cartilages; it is pierced by the ductus nasolacrimalis.

UBERON:0011168.name: postfrontal bone
UBERON:0011168.def: A bone behind and above the orbit of which it commonly forms part of the border that is present in many vertebrates and corresponds to the postorbital process of the frontal bone of various birds and mammals.

UBERON:0011169.name: postorbital bone
UBERON:0011169.def: The postorbital is one of the bones in vertebrate skulls which forms a portion of the dermal skull roof and, sometimes, a ring about the orbit. Generally, it is located behind the postfrontal and posteriorly to the orbital fenestra. In some vertebrates, the postorbital is fused with the postfrontal to create a postorbitofrontal.

UBERON:0011170.name: quadrate-articular joint
UBERON:0011170.def: A skeletal joint that connects quadrate and articular bones.

UBERON:0011171.name: joint connecting upper and lower jaws
UBERON:0011171.def: Synovial joint that articulates bones of upper and lower jaw.

UBERON:0011172.name: retrorubral area of midbrain reticular nucleus
UBERON:0011172.def: The term retrorubral area of the midbrain reticular nucleus refers to a region of the rat brain caudal and dorsal to the ventral tegmental area. It is one of three parts of the midbrain reticular nucleus; the other two are the magnocellular part of the midbrain reticular nucleus and the parvicellular part of the midbrain reticular nucleus (Swanson-2004). BrainInfo distinguishes between the Retrorubral area of the midbrain reticular formation and the retrorubral nucleus.

UBERON:0011173.name: anterior division of bed nuclei of stria terminalis
UBERON:0011173.def: One of two divisions of the nuclei of stria terminalis based on topology, connectivity and multiple stains in the rat ( Swanson-2004 ) and the mouse ( Dong-2004 ). The other division consists of the posterior nuclei of stria terminalis. The anterior division includes the anterolateral area of stria terminalis, anteromedial area of stria terminalis, oval nucleus of stria terminalis, juxtacapsular nucleus of stria terminalis, rhomboid nucleus of stria terminalis, dorsomedial nucleus of stria terminalis, fusiform nucleus of stria terminalis, ventral nucleus of stria terminalis, and the magnocellular nucleus of stria terminalis.
synonym: anterior part of the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis
bed nuclei of the stria terminalis anterior division
bed nuclei of the stria terminalis, anterior division
bed nuclei of the stria terminals anterior division
bed nucleus of the stria terminalis anterior division
bed nucleus of the stria terminalis anterior part
bed nucleus of thestria terminalis anterior division

UBERON:0011175.name: fusiform nucleus of stria terminalis
UBERON:0011175.def: A component of the nuclei of stria terminalis defined on the basis of topology, connectivity and multiple stains in the rat. It is one of nine components of the anterior nuclei of stria terminalis in the Functional CNS Model -Rat ( Swanson-2004 ).
synonym: bed nuclei of the stria terminalis anterior division fusiform nucleus
bed nuclei of the stria terminalis fusiform nucleus
bed nuclei of the stria terminalis, anterior division, fusiform nucleus
bed nuclei of the stria terminals anterior division fusiform nucleus
bed nucleus of the stria terminalis fusiform nucleus
bed nucleus of the stria terminalis fusiform part

UBERON:0011176.name: oval nucleus of stria terminalis
UBERON:0011176.def: A component of the nuclei of stria terminalis defined on the basis of topology, connectivity and multiple stains in the rat. It is one of nine components of the anterior nuclei of stria terminalis in the Functional CNS Model - Rat (Swanson-2004).
synonym: bed nuclei of the stria terminalis, anterior division, oval nucleus

UBERON:0011177.name: posterior division of bed nuclei of stria terminalis
UBERON:0011177.def: One of two divisions of the nuclei of stria terminalis based on topology, connectivity and multiple stains in the rat ( Swanson-2004 ) and the mouse ( Dong-2004 ). The other division consists of the anterior nuclei of stria terminalis. The posterior division includes the principal nucleus of stria terminalis, interfascicular nucleus of stria terminalis, transverse nucleus of stria terminalis, premedullary nucleus of stria terminalis, dorsal nucleus of stria terminalis, the strial extension of stria terminalis, and the cell sparse zone of stria terminalis.
synonym: bed nuclei of the stria terminalis posterior division
bed nuclei of the stria terminalis, posterior division
bed nucleus of stria terminalis posterior part
bed nucleus of the stria terminalis posterior division
posterior part of the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis

UBERON:0011178.name: principal nucleus of stria terminalis
UBERON:0011178.def: A component of the nuclei of stria terminalis defined on the basis of topology, connectivity and multiple stains in the rat. It is one of seven components of the posterior nuclei of stria terminalis in the Functional CNS Model - Rat ( Swanson-2004 ).
synonym: bed nuclei of the stria terminalis posterior division principal nucleus
bed nuclei of the stria terminalis principal nucleus
bed nuclei of the stria terminalis, posterior division, principal nucleus
bed nucleus of the stria terminalis principal (encapsulated) nucleus

UBERON:0011179.name: transverse nucleus of stria terminalis
UBERON:0011179.def: A component of the nuclei of stria terminalis defined on the basis of topology, connectivity and multiple stains in the rat. It is one of seven components of the posterior nuclei of stria terminalis in the Functional CNS Model - Rat (Swanson-2004).
synonym: bed nuclei of the stria terminalis posterior division transverse nucleus
bed nuclei of the stria terminalis transverse nucleus
bed nuclei of the stria terminalis, posterior division, transverse nucleus
bed nucleus of the stria terminalis transverse nucleus

UBERON:0011183.name: corpus spongiosum of penis
UBERON:0011183.def: Corpus spongiosum (also known as corpus cavernosum urethrae in older texts) is the mass of spongy tissue surrounding the male urethra within the penis.

UBERON:0011184.name: epithelium of crypt of Lieberkuhn
UBERON:0011184.def: An epithelium that is part of a crypt of Lieberkuhn.

UBERON:0011185.name: gastrointestinal sphincter
UBERON:0011185.def: A sphincter muscle that is part of the gastrointestinal system.

UBERON:0011186.name: Krause's gland
UBERON:0011186.def: Small, mucous accessory lacrimal glands that are found underneath the eyelid where the upper and lower conjuctivae meet. Their ducts unite into a rather long sinus which open into the fornix conjunctiva. There are approximately forty Krause glands in the region of the upper eyelid, and around 6 to 8 in the region of the lower lid. The function of these glands are to produce tears which are secreted onto the surface of the conjuctiva.

UBERON:0011187.name: ventral tubercle of humerus
UBERON:0011187.def: The greater tubercle of the humerus is situated lateral to the head of the humerus and posteriolateral to the lesser tubercle. Its upper surface is rounded and marked by three flat impressions. the highest of these gives ('superior facet') insertion to the Supraspinatus the middle ('middle facet') to the Infraspinatus. the lowest one ('inferior facet'), and the body of the bone for about 2.5 cm. below it, to the Teres minor. The lateral surface of the greater tubercle is convex, rough, and continuous with the lateral surface of the body. Between the greater tubercle and the lesser tubercle is the intertubercular sulcus (bicipital groove).

UBERON:0011188.name: lesser tubercle of humerus
UBERON:0011188.def: The lesser tubercle of the humerus, although smaller, is more prominent than the greater tubercle: it is situated in front, and is directed medially and anteriorly. Above and in front it presents an impression for the insertion of the tendon of the Subscapularis.

UBERON:0011189.name: lamina propria of large intestine
UBERON:0011189.def: A lamina propria that is part of a large intestine.
synonym: lamina propria of mucosa of large intestine

UBERON:0011190.name: lunule of nail
UBERON:0011190.def: A crescent-shaped whitish area of the bed of a fingernail or toenail. The lunula is the visible part of the nail matrix (i.e. the root of the nail).

UBERON:0011191.name: ophthalmic vein
UBERON:0011191.def: Ophthalmic veins are veins which drain the eye. More specifically, they can refer to: Superior ophthalmic vein Inferior ophthalmic vein.

UBERON:0011192.name: superior ophthalmic vein
UBERON:0011192.def: The superior ophthalmic vein begins at the inner angle of the orbit in a vein named the nasofrontal which communicates anteriorly with the angular vein; it pursues the same course as the ophthalmic artery, and receives tributaries corresponding to the branches of that vessel. Forming a short single trunk, it passes between the two heads of the Rectus lateralis and through the medial part of the superior orbital fissure, and ends in the cavernous sinus. The ethmoidal veins drain into the superior ophthalmic vein. Vorticose veins also drain into the superior ophthalmic vein.

UBERON:0011193.name: inferior ophthalmic vein
UBERON:0011193.def: The inferior ophthalmic vein begins in a venous net-work at the forepart of the floor and medial wall of the orbit; it receives some vorticose veins and other veins from the Rectus inferior, Obliquus inferior, lacrimal sac and eyelids, runs backward in the lower part of the orbit and divides into two branches. One of these passes through the inferior orbital fissure and joins the pterygoid venous plexus, while the other enters the cranium through the superior orbital fissure and ends in the cavernous sinus, either by a separate opening, or more frequently in common with the superior ophthalmic vein.

UBERON:0011194.name: ophthalmic plexus
UBERON:0011194.def: An autonomic plexus, entering the orbit in company with the ophthalmic artery, derived from the internal carotid plexus.

UBERON:0011195.name: inferior parathyroid epithelium
UBERON:0011195.def: An epithelium that is part of a inferior parathyroid gland.

UBERON:0011196.name: superior parathyroid epithelium
UBERON:0011196.def: An epithelium that is part of a superior parathyroid gland.

UBERON:0011197.name: parathyroid epithelium
UBERON:0011197.def: An epithelium that is part of a parathyroid gland.

UBERON:0011198.name: muscle layer of large intestine
UBERON:0011198.def: A muscle layer that is part of a large intestine.

UBERON:0011199.name: prostatic utricle
UBERON:0011199.def: A small indentation located in the prostatic urethra, at the apex of the urethral crest, on the seminal colliculus (verumontanum), laterally flanked by openings of the ejaculatory ducts.

UBERON:0011200.name: sacrococcygeal symphysis
UBERON:0011200.def: The sacrococcygeal symphysis (sacrococcygeal articulation, articulation of the sacrum and coccyx) is an amphiarthrodial joint, formed between the oval surface at the apex of the sacrum, and the base of the coccyx. It is a slightly moveable joint which is frequently, partially or completely, obliterated in old age, homologous with the joints between the bodies of the vertebrae.

UBERON:0011201.name: muscle layer of small intestine
UBERON:0011201.def: A muscle layer that is part of a small intestine.

UBERON:0011202.name: urachus epithelium
UBERON:0011202.def: An epithelium that is part of a urachus.

UBERON:0011203.name: urachus mesenchyme
UBERON:0011203.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a developing urachus.

UBERON:0011204.name: rectovesical pouch
UBERON:0011204.def: Between the rectum and the bladder the peritoneal cavity forms, in the male, a pouch, the rectovesical excavation (or rectovesical pouch), the bottom of which is slightly below the level of the upper ends of the vesiculae seminalesbi. e. , about 7.5 cm. from the orifice of the anus. its lowest part membranous partition called Rectoprostatic fascia. The corresponding structure in women is the rectouterine pouch.

UBERON:0011205.name: carpometacarpus
UBERON:0011205.def: The carpometacarpus is the fusion of the carpal and metacarpal bone, essentially a single fused bone between the wrist and the knuckles. It is a smallish bone in most birds, generally flattened and with a large hole in the middle. In flightless birds, however, its shape may be slightly different, or it might be absent entirely.

UBERON:0011206.name: hinge joint
UBERON:0011206.def: A joint that allows motion around an axis.

UBERON:0011207.name: iliocostalis lumborum
UBERON:0011207.def: The iliocostalis lumborum (iliocostalis muscle; sacrolumbalis muscle) is inserted, by six or seven flattened tendons, into the inferior borders of the angles of the lower six or seven ribs.

UBERON:0011213.name: root of vagus nerve
UBERON:0011213.def: A root of cranial nerve that is part of a vagus nerve.

UBERON:0011214.name: nucleus of midbrain tectum
UBERON:0011214.def: A neural nucleus that is part of a midbrain tectum.

UBERON:0011215.name: central nervous system cell part cluster
UBERON:0011215.def: A multi cell part structure that is part of a central nervous system.

UBERON:0011216.name: organ system subdivision
UBERON:0011216.def: A subdivision of an anatomical system.

UBERON:0011218.name: spinalis cervicis muscle
UBERON:0011218.def: Origin: spinous processes of seventh cervical and sometimes two upper thoracic vertebrae; insertion: spinous processes of axis and sometimes of second to fourth cervical vertebrae; innervation: branches of cervical; action: extends vertebral column.

UBERON:0011219.name: longissimus lumborum muscle
UBERON:0011219.def: Lumbar muscle that extends and rotates the vertebral column.

UBERON:0011220.name: mastoid process of temporal bone
UBERON:0011220.def: The mastoid process is a conical prominence projecting from the undersurface of the mastoid portion of the temporal bone. It is located just behind the external acoustic meatus, and lateral to the styloid process. Its size and form vary somewhat; it is larger in the male than in the female. This process serves for the attachment of the posterior belly of the digastric, sternocleidomastoid, splenius capitis, and longissimus capitis muscles. The word is derived from the Greek 'masto-', alluding to its resemblance to the breast.

UBERON:0011221.name: ora serrata of retina
UBERON:0011221.def: The ora serrata is the serrated junction between the retina and the ciliary body. This junction marks the transition from the simple non-photosensitive area of the retina to the complex, multi-layered photosensitive region. In animals in which the region does not have a serrated appearance, it is called the ora ciliaris retinae.

UBERON:0011233.name: synovial membrane of synovial tendon sheath
UBERON:0011233.def: Synovial sac which surrounds parts of one or more tendons. Examples: synovial tendon sheath of manual digit 2, radial bursa.

UBERON:0011234.name: fibrous membrane of synovial tendon sheath

UBERON:0011236.name: deep fascia
UBERON:0011236.def: Deep fascia (or 'investing fascia') is a layer of fascia which can surround individual muscles, and divide groups of muscles into compartments. This is the dense fibrous connective tissue that interpenetrates and surrounds the muscles, bones, nerves and blood vessels of the body. It provides connection and communication in the form of aponeuroses, ligaments, tendons, retinacula, joint capsules, and septa. The deep fasciae envelop all bone; cartilage, and blood vessels and become specialized in muscles and nerves. The high density of collagen fibers is what gives the deep fascia its strength and integrity. The amount of elastin fiber determines how much extensibility and resilience it will have.

UBERON:0011237.name: visceral fascia
UBERON:0011237.def: Fascia that suspends a visceral organ.

UBERON:0011241.name: ethmoid region
UBERON:0011241.def: The most anterior region of the braincase. Provides structural support for peripheral olfactory organ.

UBERON:0011242.name: ethmoid cartilage
UBERON:0011242.def: Region between capsules formed by anterior tips of neurocranial trabeculae.

UBERON:0011244.name: perpendicular plate of ethmoid
UBERON:0011244.def: The perpendicular plate of the ethmoid bone (vertical plate) is a thin, flattened lamina, polygonal in form, which descends from the under surface of the cribriform plate, and assists in forming the septum of the nose; it is generally deflected a little to one or other side. The anterior border articulates with the spine of the frontal bone and the crest of the nasal bones. The posterior border articulates by its upper half with the sphenoidal crest, by its lower with the vomer. The inferior border is thicker than the posterior, and serves for the attachment of the septal cartilage of the nose. The surfaces of the plate are smooth, except above, where numerous grooves and canals are seen; these lead from the medial foramina on the cribriform plate and lodge filaments of the olfactory nerves.
synonym: perpendicular plate of the ethmoid bone
vertical plate of the ethmoid bone

UBERON:0011245.name: infra-orbital canal of maxilla
UBERON:0011245.def: A canal through the maxilla that is connects the infra-orbital groove and foramen and is the conduit for the passage of the infraorbital nerve and artery.

UBERON:0011248.name: procoracoid element
UBERON:0011248.def: Endochondral element of pectoral girdle, positioned posterior to the clavicle and anterior to the coracoid.

UBERON:0011249.name: appendicular skeletal system
UBERON:0011249.def: Subdivision of the skeletal system which consists of the appendicular skeleton plus associated joints.

UBERON:0011250.name: autopod bone
UBERON:0011250.def: A bone that is part of a autopod region. Note that this incudes the carpal and tarsal bones.

UBERON:0011251.name: levator claviculae muscle
UBERON:0011251.def: A skeletal muscle in the posterior triangle of the neck. It originates on the transverse processes of the upper cervical vertebrae and is inserted in the lateral half of the clavicle.

UBERON:0011252.name: scent gland
UBERON:0011252.def: Scent glands are exocrine glands found in most mammals. They produce semi-viscous secretions which contain pheromones and other semiochemical compounds. These odor-messengers indicate information such as status, territory marking, mood, and sexual power. The odor may be subliminal-not consciously detectable. Though it is not their primary function, the salivary glands may also function as scent glands in some animals.

UBERON:0011255.name: Eimer's organ
UBERON:0011255.def: A sensory organ in which the epidermis is modified to form bulbous papillae. The organs are formed from a stack of epidermal cells, which is innervated by nerve processes from myelinated fibers in the dermis, which form terminal swellings just below the outer keratinized layer of epidermis. They contain a Merkel cell-neurite complex in the epidermis and a lamellated corpuscle in the dermal connective tissue.

UBERON:0011256.name: rhinarium
UBERON:0011256.def: Moist, hairless, crenelated area around nostrils of some mammals.

UBERON:0011263.name: femoral gland
UBERON:0011263.def: A gland arranged along a row on the underside of the hindlimb in some lizards[Kardong].

UBERON:0011264.name: femoral pore
UBERON:0011264.def: Femoral pores are a part of a holocrine secretory gland found on the inside of the thighs of certain lizards and amphisbaenians which releases pheromones to attract mates or mark territory. In certain species only the male has these pores and in other species, both sexes have them, with the males being larger.[1] Femoral pores appear as a series of pits or holes within a row of scales on the ventral portion of the animal's thigh.

UBERON:0011265.name: carpometacarpal joint of digit 1
UBERON:0011265.def: A carpometacarpal joint that connects to metacarpal 1.

UBERON:0011267.name: quadratojugal bone
UBERON:0011267.def: The quadratojugal is a small jaw bone that is present in most amphibians, reptiles, and birds, but has been lost in mammals. It is connected to the jugal as well as other bones, though these may vary with species. The quadratojugal bone is a small bone between the cheek and otic notch (Lecointre 380). Squamates (lizards and snakes) lack a quadratojugal bone (Schwenk 193).

UBERON:0011268.name: sublingua
UBERON:0011268.def: A secondary tongue located below the primary tongue in prosimian primates and some primitive mammals. This structure does not have taste buds or salivary glands.

UBERON:0011270.name: dorsal trunk
UBERON:0011270.def: The part of the trunk that is in the dorsum[cjm].

UBERON:0011271.name: caudal-sacral region of vertebral column
UBERON:0011271.def: Subdivision of vertebral column that is posterior to the sacral region and anterior to the caudal region.

UBERON:0011273.name: nail of manual digit 1
UBERON:0011273.def: A nail that is part of a manual digit 1.

UBERON:0011274.name: nail of manual digit 2
UBERON:0011274.def: A nail that is part of a manual digit 2.

UBERON:0011275.name: nail of manual digit 3
UBERON:0011275.def: A nail that is part of a manual digit 3.

UBERON:0011276.name: nail of manual digit 4
UBERON:0011276.def: A nail that is part of a manual digit 4.

UBERON:0011277.name: nail of manual digit 5
UBERON:0011277.def: A nail that is part of a manual digit 5.

UBERON:0011278.name: nail of pedal digit 1
UBERON:0011278.def: A nail that is part of a pedal digit 1.

UBERON:0011279.name: nail of pedal digit 2
UBERON:0011279.def: A nail that is part of a pedal digit 2.

UBERON:0011280.name: nail of pedal digit 3
UBERON:0011280.def: A nail that is part of a pedal digit 3.

UBERON:0011281.name: nail of pedal digit 4
UBERON:0011281.def: A nail that is part of a pedal digit 4.

UBERON:0011282.name: nail of pedal digit 5
UBERON:0011282.def: A nail that is part of a pedal digit 5.

UBERON:0011283.name: epoophoron
UBERON:0011283.def: A remnant of the Mesonephric duct that can be found next to the ovary and fallopian tube.

UBERON:0011287.name: rostral organ
UBERON:0011287.def: A putative electroreceptor organ located in the medial rostral cavity in the ethmoid portion of the chondrocranium of Coelacanths. It is surrounded by an insulating layer of adipose tissue and innervated by the superficial ophthalmic nerve.

UBERON:0011288.name: stomochord
UBERON:0011288.def: A flexible, unpaired, hollow tube found in hemichordates that arises in embryonic development as an outpocketing from the roof of the embryonic gut anterior to the pharynx. In adults, they extend dorsally from the pharynx into the probiscis, and serve to communicate with the oral cavity.

UBERON:0011289.name: pharyngobasilar fascia
UBERON:0011289.def: The pharyngeal aponeurosis (or pharyngobasilar fascia, or fibrous coat), is situated between the mucous and muscular layers. It is thick above where the muscular fibers are wanting, and is firmly connected to the basilar portion of the occipital and the petrous portions of the temporal bones. As it descends it diminishes in thickness, and is gradually lost. It is strengthened posteriorly by a strong fibrous band, which is attached above to the pharyngeal spine on the under surface of the basilar portion of the occipital bone, and passes downward, forming a median raphe, which gives attachment to the Constrictores pharyngis.

UBERON:0011298.name: submucosa of fallopian tube
UBERON:0011298.def: The submucous layer of the wall of the uterine tube.

UBERON:0011299.name: white matter of telencephalon
UBERON:0011299.def: A partion of white matter that is part of a telencephalon. This can be further subdivided in some species, for example, into hemisphere white matter and the corpus callosum.
synonym: predominantly white regional part of telencephalon

UBERON:0011300.name: gray matter of telencephalon
UBERON:0011300.def: A portion of gray matter that is part of a telencephalon.
UBERON:0011300.synonym: predominantly gray regional part of telencephalon

UBERON:0011302.name: tunicate tunic
UBERON:0011302.def: Outer covering of an animal typically consisting primarily of cellulose (tunicin) in addition to varying amounts of water, protein and carbohydrates. The tunicate is a characteristic feature of Tunicata.

UBERON:0011304.name: tunicate postabdomen
UBERON:0011304.def: Basalmost subdivision of a tunicate containing the heart and reproductive organs.

UBERON:0011305.name: superficial part of temporalis
UBERON:0011305.def: The superficial temporalis muscle is a separable part of the temporalis muscle that attaches to the temporalis fascia.

UBERON:0011306.name: deep part of temporalis
UBERON:0011306.def: The deep temporalis muscle is a separable part of the temporalis muscle that that attaches to the bony wall of the braincase and is deep to the superficial temporalis.

UBERON:0011307.name: suprazygomatic part of temporalis
UBERON:0011307.def: The suprazygomatic part of the temporalis muscle is a separable part of the deep temporalis that attaches to the superior surface of the temporal root of the zygomatic arch.

UBERON:0011308.name: pars reflexa of masseter
UBERON:0011308.def: The pars reflexa is a separable part of the superficial masseter muscle that attaches to the medial surface of the mandible.

UBERON:0011309.name: body of mandible
UBERON:0011309.def: The zone of the mandible that carries the teeth.

UBERON:0011310.name: masseteric fossa
UBERON:0011310.def: .The fossa for the masseter. In some therapsids, the coronoid process of the dentary bears a large external depression which accommodates the masseter -- an important muscle in closing and in grinding motions of the jaw.

UBERON:0011311.name: hyoepiglottic ligament
UBERON:0011311.def: An elastic band connecting the anterior surface of the epiglottis to the upper border of the body of the hyoid bone.

UBERON:0011315.name: digastric branch of facial nerve
UBERON:0011315.def: The digastric branch of facial nerve arises close to the stylomastoid foramen, and divides into several filaments, which supply the posterior belly of the Digastricus; one of these filaments joins the glossopharyngeal nerve.
synonym: branch of facial nerve to posterior belly of digastric
digastric branch of facial nerve (CN VII)
nerve to posterior belly of digastric

UBERON:0011316.name: nerve to stylohyoid from facial nerve
UBERON:0011316.def: The stylohyoid branch of facial nerve frequently arises in conjunction with the digastric branch; it is long and slender, and enters the Stylohyoideus about its middle.

UBERON:0011317.name: nerve to stylopharyngeus from glossopharyngeal nerve
UBERON:0011317.def: The stylopharyngeal branch of glossopharyngeal nerve is distributed to the Stylopharyngeus.
synonym: branch of glossopharyngeal nerve to stylopharyngeus

UBERON:0011318.name: capsule of temporomandibular joint
UBERON:0011318.def: The articular capsule (capsular ligament) is a thin, loose envelope, attached above to the circumference of the mandibular fossa and the articular tubercle immediately in front; below, to the neck of the condyle of the mandible.

UBERON:0011319.name: disk of temporomandibular joint
UBERON:0011319.def: The fibrocartilaginous plate that separates the joint into upper and lower cavities.

UBERON:0011321.name: masseteric nerve
UBERON:0011321.def: A muscular branch of the mandibular nerve passing to the medial surface of the masseter muscle, which it innervates.

UBERON:0011322.name: mylohyoid nerve
UBERON:0011322.def: A nerve that innervates the mylohyoid muscle and the anterior belly of the digastric muscle.
synonym: branch of inferior alveolar nerve to mylohyoid
mylohyoid branch of inferior alveolar nerve

UBERON:0011325.name: pharyngeal nerve plexus
UBERON:0011325.def: The pharyngeal plexus is a network of nerve fibers innervating most of the palate, larynx, and pharynx. It is located on the surface of the middle pharyngeal constrictor muscle.

UBERON:0011326.name: superior laryngeal nerve
UBERON:0011326.def: The superior laryngeal nerve is a branch of the vagus nerve. It arises from the middle of the ganglion nodosum and in its course receives a branch from the superior cervical ganglion of the sympathetic. It descends, by the side of the pharynx, behind the internal carotid artery, and divides into two branches: external laryngeal nerve internal laryngeal nerve A superior laryngeal nerve palsy changes the pitch of the voice and causes an inability to make explosive sounds. If no recovery is evident three months after the palsy initially presents, the damage is most likely to be permanent. A bilateral palsy presents as a tiring and hoarse voice.
synonym: superior laryngeal branch of inferior vagal ganglion

UBERON:0011327.name: deep temporal nerve
UBERON:0011327.def: The deep temporal nerves, branches of the mandibular division of the trigeminal nerve, are two in number, anterior and posterior. They pass above the upper border of the pterygoideus externus and enter the deep surface of the temporalis.

UBERON:0011342.name: surface of mandible
