UBERON:0011342.def: An anatomical surface that is part of a mandible.

UBERON:0011343.name: medial surface of mandible
synonym: internal surface of ramus of mandible
medial surface of ramus of mandible

UBERON:0011344.name: lateral surface of mandible
synonym: external surface of ramus of mandible
lateral surface of ramus of mandible

UBERON:0011345.name: pharyngeal raphe
UBERON:0011345.def: The Pharyngeal raphe is a raphe that serves as the origin and insertion for several of the pharyngeal constrictors.

UBERON:0011346.name: palatine raphe
UBERON:0011346.def: A raphe running across the palate, from the palatine uvula to the incisive papilla.

UBERON:0011347.name: raphe of hard palate
UBERON:0011347.def: A palatine raphe that is part of a hard palate.

UBERON:0011348.name: raphe of soft palate
UBERON:0011348.def: A palatine raphe that is part of a soft palate.

UBERON:0011349.name: pterygomandibular raphe
UBERON:0011349.def: The pterygomandibular raphe (pterygomandibular ligament) is a tendinous band of the buccopharyngeal fascia, attached by one extremity to the hamulus of the medial pterygoid plate, and by the other to the posterior end of the mylohyoid line of the mandible. Its medial surface is covered by the mucous membrane of the mouth. Its lateral surface is separated from the ramus of the mandible by a quantity of adipose tissue. Its posterior border gives attachment to the superior pharyngeal constrictor muscle. Its anterior border attaches to the posterior edge of the buccinator.

UBERON:0011357.name: Reissner's fiber
UBERON:0011357.def: An acellular strand that runs from subcommissural organ caudally through the ventricular system and central canal to the ampulla caudalis. Develops from glycoproteins secreted into CSF.

UBERON:0011359.name: urophysis
UBERON:0011359.def: This is a neurosecretory organ rostral to the ampulla caudalis on the ventral surface of the distal end of the spinal cord. Receives axons from caudal neurosecretory nucleus, which contains Dahlgren cells that secrete urotensin I and II, implicated in osmotic regulation, cardiovascular function and reproduction[Butler].

UBERON:0011360.name: ampulla caudalis
UBERON:0011360.def: A ventricle-like space at the end of the central canal.

UBERON:0011362.name: cranial blood vasculature
UBERON:0011362.def: A blood vasculature that is part of a head.
synonym: set of blood vessels of head

UBERON:0011363.name: cranial lymph vasculature
UBERON:0011363.def: A lymph vasculature that is part of a head.
synonym: set of lymphatic vessels of head

UBERON:0011364.name: cleidocephalicus muscle
UBERON:0011364.def: The cleidomastoideus is a thick, strap-like muscle that together with the cleidocervicalis forms the proximal part of the brachiocephalicus. It lies beneath the cleidocervicalis. Its origin is the clavicular tendon with its insertion being at the mastoid process of the temporal bone. It is distinctly narrow and is united with the cleidocervicalis and cleidobrachialis by the clavicular tendon. Together with the other two components of the brachiocephalicus muscle, its primary function is to advance the free limb, however, it can also act as an shoulder extensor. Acting bilaterally, it fixes and depresses the neck, while by its unilateral action, it allows the head and neck to be drawn to the side. Its blood supply is the inferior cervical, carotid and vertebral arteries and its nerve supply is the spinal accessory, cervical and axillary nerves.

UBERON:0011366.name: cleidobrachialis muscle
UBERON:0011366.def: This muscle makes up the distal segment of the brachiocephalicus. It originates at the clavicular tendon but functionally, from the head and neck through the cleidocervicalis. It inserts at the distal end of the cranial border of the humerus, where it lies between the biceps brachii medially and the brachialis laterally. The muscle partly covers the pectoral muscles at their insertions. In conjunction with the cleidocervicalis, it advances the limb, extends the shoulder and causes lateral movement of the head and neck.

UBERON:0011368.name: brachiocephalic muscle
UBERON:0011368.def: The brachiocephalicus is a long and flat, complex of muscles that extends from the lower half of the humeral shaft to the head and neck. The muscle divides into two parts at the clavicular intersection. This is also the point of origin for all the muscles that make up the brachiocephalicus. This point is situated just cranial to the shoulder. The two main sections are the cleidobrachialis which is distal to the clavicular intersection and the cleidocephalicus which extends proximally to the clavivular intersection. The cleidocephalicus can also be divided into the pars cervicalis, which inserts on the broad aponeurosis, over the fibrous raphe of the cranial half of the neck. The other part, the pars mastoideus inserts on the mastoid process of the temporal bone via a strong tendon. The cleidobrachialis extends distally from the clavicular intersection and inserts on the cranial edge of the distal half of the humerus. The tendon that inserts the cleidobrachialis lies between the brachialis muscle and the biceps brachii. As a result of the brachiocephalicus spanning a large region it has the ability to provide a number of actions. These include extending the shoulder joint, protracts the limb, provides lateral movement of the head and allows the neck to be depressed.

UBERON:0011369.name: omotransversarius muscle
UBERON:0011369.def: The omotransversarius is a straplike muscle, which advances and adducts the forelimb, as well as flexes the neck laterally. It covers the transverse processes of the cervical vertebrae, lying to their side. The omotransversarius lies ventral to the trapezius, cranial to the deltoid muscle and is covered cranially by the cleidocervicalis. It extends from the atlas to the spine of the scapula, with its origin on the transverse process of the atlas and its insertion in the distal end of the spine of the scapula. Its name can be split into omo, which is Greek for shoulder, and tranversarius which relates to its attachment to the transverse process of the atlas. This muscle is innervated by the accessory nerve.

UBERON:0011370.name: transverse process of atlas
UBERON:0011370.def: A transverse process of vertebra that is part of a vertebral bone 1.

UBERON:0011371.name: sternocephalicus muscle
UBERON:0011371.def: The sternocephalicus is a flat muscle and its caudal border is adjacent to the ventral border of the brachiocephalicus. The lateral aspect of this muscle is crossed obliquely by the external jugular vein. It originates as a unit on the first sternebrae. The cranial portion of the muscle divides into two separate sections with different insertion points. These are the sternomastoideus and the sterno-occipitalis. The ventral portion, the sternomastiodeus is the stronger and main continuation of the sternocephalicus, which inserts on the mastoid part of the temporal bone. The thin but wide dorsal segment, the sterno-occipitalis attaches to the dorsal nuchal crest by a thin aponeurosis. The main action provided by the sternocephalicus is movement of the head and neck to the side. Ventral branches of the cervical nerves are attached to this muscle.

UBERON:0011374.name: prepuce
UBERON:0011374.def: A retractable double-layered fold of skin and mucous membrane that covers the glans penis or clitoris. Glands may also be present.

UBERON:0011375.name: skin of prepuce of clitoris
UBERON:0011375.def: A zone of skin that is part of a prepuce of clitoris.

UBERON:0011376.name: iliothoracic muscle
UBERON:0011376.def: The iliothoracic group is made up of the abdominal wall muscles: rectus abdominis, external abdominal oblique, internal abdominal obliquus, and the transversus abdominis.

UBERON:0011377.name: femorothoracic muscle
UBERON:0011377.def: The femorospinal group is made up of the psoas major and iliacus muscles.

UBERON:0011379.name: male external urethral sphincter
UBERON:0011379.def: The external sphincter muscle of urethra (or sphincter urethrae membranaceae) surrounds the whole length of the membranous portion of the urethra, and is enclosed in the fasciæ of the urogenital diaphragm. They arch across the front of the urethra and bulbourethral glands, pass around the urethra, and behind it unite with the muscle of the opposite side, by means of a tendinous raphé.
synonym: external urethral sphincter of male urethra
musculus sphincter urethrae externus urethrae masculinae

UBERON:0011380.name: female external urethral sphincter
UBERON:0011380.def: The external sphincter muscle of female urethra is a muscle which controls urination.
synonym: external urethral sphincter of female urethra
musculus sphincter urethrae externus urethrae femininae
outer muscle layer of female urethra
striated muscle layer of female urethra

UBERON:0011383.name: inferior pancreaticoduodenal vein
UBERON:0011383.def: A blood vessel running parallel to the inferior pancreatico-duodenal artery that drains blood from the pancreas and duodenum into the splenic vein.

UBERON:0011385.name: parotidoauricular muscle
UBERON:0011385.def: Is one of the numerus muscles of the external ear and is of importance since it is encountered in the operation for drainage of infections of the external ear of the dog. As its name suggests, it arises from the fascia over the parotid gland and approaches the auricle from the ventrolateral direction. This muscle is supplied by the facial nerve.The muscles of the external ear with their scattered origins and precisely located insertions provide for displacement and rotation of the ear in all directions. These muscles also have a collective function in communication both within and between species.

UBERON:0011386.name: facial modiolus
UBERON:0011386.def: A chiasma of facial muscles held together by fibrous tissue, located lateral and slightly superior to each angle of the mouth. It is important in moving the mouth, facial expression and in dentistry. It derives its motor nerve supply from the facial nerve, and its blood supply from labial branches of the facial artery. It is contributed to by the following muscles: orbicularis oris, buccinator, levator anguli oris, depressor anguli oris, zygomaticus major, risorius quadratus labii superioris, quadratus labii inferioris.

UBERON:0011388.name: male bulbospongiosus muscle
UBERON:0011388.def: A bulbospongiosus muscle that is part of a male reproductive system.

UBERON:0011389.name: bulbospongiosus muscle
UBERON:0011389.def: The bulbospongiosus is the thick extrapelvic continuation of the urethralis. It originates from the perineal body (and midline raphe over corpus spongiosum in male) and inserts at the superficial perineal membrane and dorsal penile or clitoral aponeurosis. In males, the bulbospongiosus muscles are united and surround the base of the penis. They aid in emptying of urine and ejaculate from urethra. In females, these muscles are separated in the middle by the vagina and act to constrict the vaginal introitus. They can also stop the flow of blood into veins, which maintains an erection in the penis of the male and the clitoris of the female. Its nerve connection is the perineal branch of the pudendal nerve (S2, 3, 4).

UBERON:0011390.name: pudendal nerve
UBERON:0011390.def: The pudendal nerve is a somatic nerve in the pelvic region that innervates the external genitalia of both sexes, as well as sphincters for the bladder and the rectum. It originates in Onuf's nucleus in the sacral region of the spinal cord.

UBERON:0011391.name: perineal nerve
UBERON:0011391.def: A nerve arising from the pudendal nerve that supplies the perineum.

UBERON:0011392.name: blood vessel internal elastic membrane
UBERON:0011392.def: A layer of elastic tissue that forms the outermost part of the tunica intima of blood vessels.

UBERON:0011415.name: cutaneous trunci muscle
UBERON:0011415.def: Lying just below the skin, cutaneus trunci is one of very few cutaneus muscles. It composes of a thin sheets of muscle that spred over the body in the superficial fasciae. Their role is to twich the skin to rid of pests etc. Cuteneus muscles are found in all domestic species.

UBERON:0011464.name: levator nasolabialis muscle
UBERON:0011464.def: Is a principal muscle of the lips which arises over the dorsum of the nose. It runs cranioventrally to insert partly on the wing of the nostril and partly into the lateral part of the upper lip. This muscles function includes dilation of the nostril, elevation and retraction of the upper lip. Branches of the facial nerve supply innervation to this muscle.

UBERON:0011465.name: longissimus atlantis muscle
UBERON:0011465.def: A muscle that runs beneath the longissimus capitis and inserts on the wing of the atlas.

UBERON:0011472.name: ventral lateral sacrocaudal muscle
UBERON:0011472.def: The ventral lateral sacrocaudal is a long strong muscle consisting of numerous individual parts. Its first segment originates from the last lumbar vertebrae and the remainder from the transverse processes of the caudal vertebrae. From the segmented bellies arise long tendons which are embedded in caudal fascia. The first of these tendons inserts onto the sixth caudal vertebrae, the second onto the seventh and so on until the last caudal vertebrae. The ventral lateral sacrocaudal acts to flex the tail and occasionally assists with lateral movement.

UBERON:0011495.name: rectus thoracis muscle
UBERON:0011495.def: Rectus thoracis is a very small quadrilateral muscle sheet from the lateral thorax runs from the 3rd-1st rib that is in continuation with rectus abdominis. Its functioning muscle in respiration.

UBERON:0011508.name: sphincter colli superficialis muscle
UBERON:0011508.def: The sphincter colli superficialis is composed of transverse muscle fibers, and covers the entire area between the lower jaw and chest. The muscle is used to tighten the skin on the underside of the throat.

UBERON:0011509.name: sphincter colli profundus muscle
UBERON:0011509.def: The sphincter colli profundus lies below the platysma in the area of the parotid gland (gland regions).

UBERON:0011510.name: cloacal bursa
UBERON:0011510.def: An evagination of the cloaca. In Testudines these are hypothesized to function in different physiological roles, primarily in respiration.

UBERON:0011511.name: iliococcygeus muscle
UBERON:0011511.def: The Iliococcygeus arises from the ischial spine and from the posterior part of the tendinous arch of the obturator fascia, and is attached to the coccyx and anococcygeal raphC); it is usually thin, and may fail entirely, or be largely replaced by fibrous tissue. It is part of the levator ani group of muscles. An accessory slip at its posterior part is sometimes named the Iliosacralis.

UBERON:0011512.name: puborectalis muscle
UBERON:0011512.def: The fibers which form a sling for the rectum are named the Puborectalis or Sphincter recti. They arise from the lower part of the symphysis pubis, and from the superior fascia of the urogenital diaphragm. They meet with the corresponding fibers of the opposite side around the lower part of the rectum, and form for it a strong sling. Relaxation reduces the angle between rectum and anus, allowing defecation in conjunction with relaxation of the internal and external sphincters. Puborectalis is part of the levator ani group of muscles.

UBERON:0011528.name: pubococcygeus muscle
UBERON:0011528.def: The pubococcygeus muscle or PC muscle is a hammock-like muscle, found in both sexes, that stretches from the pubic bone to the coccyx (tail bone) forming the floor of the pelvic cavity and supporting the pelvic organs. It is part of the levator ani group of muscles.

UBERON:0011531.name: male pubococcygeus muscle
UBERON:0011531.def: A pubococcygeus muscle that is part of a male organism.

UBERON:0011532.name: female pubococcygeus muscle
UBERON:0011532.def: Pubovaginalis in the female is the equivalent of levator prostatae in the male.

UBERON:0011533.name: abductor pollicis, radioulna-prepollox
UBERON:0011533.def: Originates on the distal radioulna and inserts on the palmar prepollex.

UBERON:0011535.name: chondroglossus muscle
UBERON:0011535.def: The Chondroglossus is sometimes described as a part of the Hyoglossus, but is separated from it by fibers of the Genioglossus, which pass to the side of the pharynx. It is about 2 cm. long, and arises from the medial side and base of the lesser cornu and contiguous portion of the body of the hyoid bone, and passes directly upward to blend with the intrinsic muscular fibers of the tongue, between the Hyoglossus and Genioglossus.

UBERON:0011564.name: adductor pollicis muscle of prepollex
UBERON:0011564.def: Originates from the distal carpal 5-4-3 and inserts on the palmar prepollex.

UBERON:0011566.name: lumen of esophagus
UBERON:0011566.def: An anatomical cavity that is part of a esophagus.

UBERON:0011574.name: mesonephric duct lumen
UBERON:0011574.def: A tube lumen that is part of a mesonephric duct.

UBERON:0011575.name: styloid process of ulna
UBERON:0011575.def: The styloid process of the ulna projects from the medial and back part of the bone; it descends a little lower than the head, and its rounded end affords attachment to the ulnar collateral ligament of the wrist[WP,unvetted].

UBERON:0011576.name: supraorbital ridge
UBERON:0011576.def: The superior half of the orbital rim, which constitutes the curved superior border of the orbital opening, formed by the frontal bone.

UBERON:0011577.name: flexural organ
UBERON:0011577.def: A portion of tissue that is the most anterior portion of the notochord. The flexural organ secretes Reissner's fiber-related proteins, including F-spondin.

UBERON:0011580.name: platypus crural gland
UBERON:0011580.def: A kidney-shaped alveolar glands located in the upper thigh connected by a thin-walled duct to a calcaneus spur, or calcar, on each hind limb.

UBERON:0011582.name: paired limb/fin skeleton
UBERON:0011582.def: The collection of all skeletal elements in an individual limb or fin.

UBERON:0011583.name: stylopodial skeleton
UBERON:0011583.def: Proximal element of a free limb skeleton consisting of the femur and humerus in the forelimb stylopodium and hindlimb stylopodium respectively[VSAO, modified].

UBERON:0011584.name: zeugopodial skeleton
UBERON:0011584.def: Section of the forelimb skeleton located between the stylopodium and the autopodium.

UBERON:0011585.name: cell condensation
UBERON:0011585.def: Anatomical structure that is an aggregation of similar cells from which cartilages and bones form, and from which chondrogenesis and osteogenesis are initiated during repair and/or regeneration. (Hall and Miyake 1995).

UBERON:0011587.name: pre-dentine
UBERON:0011587.def: Odontogenic tissue that is collagen-rich and characteristic of vertebrate teeth and tooth-like structures (e.g., odontodes) deposited by preodontoblasts and odontoblasts that are typically excluded from the matrix.

UBERON:0011588.name: pre-enamel
UBERON:0011588.def: Odontogenic tissue that is avascular non-mineralized matrix that is deposited by preameloblast and ameloblasts that are excluded from the matrix.

UBERON:0011589.name: non-mineralized cartilage tissue
UBERON:0011589.def: Cartilage tissue that is not mineralized.

UBERON:0011590.name: commissure of diencephalon
UBERON:0011590.def: A commissure that is part of a diencephalon.

UBERON:0011591.name: tract of diencephalon
UBERON:0011591.def: An axon tract that is part of a diencephalon.

UBERON:0011593.name: maxillary tooth
UBERON:0011593.def: A tooth that is attached to a maxilla[TAO,modified].

UBERON:0011594.name: dentary tooth
UBERON:0011594.def: Tooth that is attached to a dentary/mandible[TAO,modified].

UBERON:0011595.name: jaw region
UBERON:0011595.def: A subdivision of the head that corresponds to the jaw skeleton, containing both soft tissue, skeleton and teeth (when present). The jaw region is divided into upper and lower regions.

UBERON:0011597.name: bone of upper jaw
UBERON:0011597.def: Any bone that is part of the upper jaw skeleton. This includes (when present): the maxilla, the quadrate (in some species).

UBERON:0011599.name: lenticular process of incus bone
UBERON:0011599.def: The long ventral process of the incus bone which articulates with the stapes.

UBERON:0011601.name: gingiva of upper jaw
UBERON:0011601.def: A gingiva that is part of a upper jaw region.

UBERON:0011602.name: gingiva of lower jaw
UBERON:0011602.def: A gingiva that is part of a lower jaw region.

UBERON:0011603.name: coronoid tooth
UBERON:0011603.def: Tooth that is attached to a coronoid bone.

UBERON:0011604.name: carina of sternum
UBERON:0011604.def: An extension of the sternum (breastbone) which runs axially along the midline of the sternum and extends outward, perpendicular to the plane of the ribs[WP].

UBERON:0011605.name: supracoracoideus muscle of wing
UBERON:0011605.def: A muscle in the bird's thorax region that originates from carina of the sternum, furcula, and sternal ribs and inserts onto proximal dorsal surface of the humerus. It acts as a primary elevator of the wing in upstroke. [Manual of Ornithology: Avian Structure and Function, by Proctor and Lynch, 1998].

UBERON:0011606.name: hyomandibular bone
UBERON:0011606.def: Replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and (in teleosts) articulates with the neurocranium dorsally and the opercle posteriorly[TAO,modified].

UBERON:0011607.name: hyomandibular cartilage
UBERON:0011607.def: Cartilage form of the hyomandibular element.

UBERON:0011608.name: hyomandibular element
UBERON:0011608.def: The upper paired deep bone or cartilage of the hyoid region, sometimes taking part in jaw suspension and which supports the opercle. Dorsally it articulates with the otic capsule at the hyomandibular fossa, ventrally with the quadrate and symplectic. In most Teleostei it has a foramen for the hyomandibular branch of the facial nerve (VII).

UBERON:0011613.name: hypohyal element
UBERON:0011613.def: The hypohyal is a ventral element of the hyoid arch which links the ceratohyal and the basihyal.

UBERON:0011614.name: basihyal element
UBERON:0011614.def: Skeletal element that is median and is the anterior-most element of the ventral hyoid arch.

UBERON:0011615.name: basihyal cartilage
UBERON:0011615.def: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is median and is the anterior-most cartilage of the ventral hyoid arch.

UBERON:0011618.name: basihyal bone
UBERON:0011618.def: Replacement bone that is median and is the anterior-most bone of the ventral hyoid arch.

UBERON:0011619.name: stylohyoid bone
UBERON:0011619.def: This is the paired bone that makes up the segment of the mammalian hyoid apparatus connecting the epihyoids with the skull via the tympanohyoid cartilages on each side. Ventrally, it defines the medial and lateral compartments of the guttural pouch in the horse.

UBERON:0011620.name: basihyal lingual process
UBERON:0011620.def: A projection on the basihyal bone. Laterally the lingual process is compressed. It has a blunt pointed free end, and its lateral surfaces are slightly concave. The dorsal border is thin and irregular, and the ventral border is thick and rough. In the living animal the lingual process is embedded within the root of the tongue.

UBERON:0011621.name: thyrohyoid cartilage
UBERON:0011621.def: This small finger of cartilage completes the connection between the thyrohyoid bone and the thyroid cartilage (rostral cornu).

UBERON:0011622.name: thyrohyoid bone
UBERON:0011622.def: Is a laterally bowed, sagittally compressed, slender element that extends from dorsocaudally from the lateral parts of the basihyoid. It connects the basiohyoid with the rostral corner of the thyroid cartlilage of the larynx.

UBERON:0011624.name: superior horn of thyroid cartilage
UBERON:0011624.def: The superior horn of thyroid cartilage is long and narrow, directed upward, backward, and medialward, and ends in a conical extremity, which gives attachment to the lateral hyothyroid ligament.

UBERON:0011625.name: inferior horn of thyroid cartilage
UBERON:0011625.def: The inferior horn of thyroid cartilage is short and thick; it is directed downward, with a slight inclination forward and medialward, and presents, on the medial side of its tip, a small oval articular facet for articulation with the side of the cricoid cartilage.

UBERON:0011626.name: tympanohyoid cartilage
UBERON:0011626.def: The terminal segment in the chain of skeletal elements of the hyoid apparatus. One of a pair of rods of cartilage that connect the hyoid bone to the styloid process of the petrous part of the temporal bone.

UBERON:0011627.name: orbital part of frontal bone
UBERON:0011627.def: A zone of the frontal bone that consists of two thin triangular plates, the orbital plates, which form the vaults of the orbits, and are separated from one another by a median gap, the ethmoidal notch.

UBERON:0011634.name: ectopterygoid bone
UBERON:0011634.def: A palatal bone which -- like many palatal bones -- may originally have developed as a dermal bone replacing part of the palatoquadrate, the primitive upper jaw. Like the palatine (also called dermopalatine), the ectopterygoid replaces the middle part of the autopalatine. It may be serially homologous with the palatine(s), but is somewhat specialized, being the last (most posterior in palatal view) of the series and bordering the fossa for the jaw muscles. In a typical tetrapod it abuts the palatine anteriorly, the maxilla laterally, the pterygoid or the fossa mandubuaris medially, and the fossa posteriorly.

UBERON:0011635.name: splenial bone
UBERON:0011635.def: The splenial is a small bone in the lower jaw of reptiles, amphibians and birds, usually located on the lingual side (closest to the tongue) between the angular and suprangular.

UBERON:0011636.name: surangular bone
UBERON:0011636.def: The surangular is a dermal bone of the lower jaw. It typically covers much of the dorsal and lateral surface of the posterior jaw and variably extends onto the medial (inside) surface. The surangular articulates with and supports the articular, which forms the jaw joint with the quadrate in most vertebrates, and is in turn supported by the angular. More distally, the surangular bridges the mandibular fenestra, if one is present. It may also bear a raised dorsal coronoid process, an important attachment site for the mandibular adductors. At its distal (or rostral) end, the surangular meets the dentary, the main tooth-bearing bone of the lower jaw in most vertebrates.

UBERON:0011637.name: prearticular bone
UBERON:0011637.def: Osseous element of intramembranous origin that extends along the lingual margin of Meckel's cartilage.

UBERON:0011639.name: frontoparietal bone
UBERON:0011639.def: An anuran dermal bone that usually is paired and roofs the braincase.

UBERON:0011640.name: palatoglossal arch
UBERON:0011640.def: A fold that lies between the mouth and pharynx and marks the posterior border of the mouth.

UBERON:0011641.name: odontogenic mesenchyme of molar
UBERON:0011641.def: An odontogenic papilla that is part of a molar tooth [Automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0011642.name: oral epithelium from ectoderm
UBERON:0011642.def: An epithelium that develops_from a ectoderm and is part of a oral epithelium.

UBERON:0011643.name: puboischiofemoralis internus muscle
UBERON:0011643.def: A single large dorsal limb rotator muscle in lower tetrapods that runs from the lumber region and girdle to the femur.

UBERON:0011644.name: puboischiofemoralis externus muscle
UBERON:0011644.def: A single large ventral muscle in lower tetrapods that runs from the pubis and ischium to the femur.

UBERON:0011645.name: iliofemoralis muscle
UBERON:0011645.def: Limb extensor that runs from ilium to femur.

UBERON:0011646.name: patagialis muscle
UBERON:0011646.def: A muscle of the patagium that attaches to the clavicle and the metacarpal.

UBERON:0011649.name: levator operculi
UBERON:0011649.def: Hyoid muscle that originates at the ventrolateral margin of the pterotic and inserts in the dorsomesial edge of the opercle. The levator operculi is responible for jaw depression, its force of contraction is transmitted through the opercular series and the interoperculo-mandibular ligament to the lower jaw.

UBERON:0011651.name: ventral head of rib
UBERON:0011651.def: Ventral head of a bicapitate rib. It articulates with the parapophysis[AAO].

UBERON:0011652.name: dorsal head of rib
UBERON:0011652.def: Dorsal head of a bicapitate rib. It articulates with the diapophysis[AAO].

UBERON:0011653.name: diapophysis of neural arch
UBERON:0011653.def: Paired processes that arise near the midpoint of the neural arch lamina, for the attachment of the tuberculum of two-headed ribs. Also called transverse processes. In anurans, the term diapophysis is used in reference to the modified transverse processes of the sacral vertebra elaborated for support of the pelvic girdle.

UBERON:0011655.name: interclavicle
UBERON:0011655.def: Dermal bone of pectoral girdle that is median and ventral in position.

UBERON:0011657.name: dermal element of plastron
UBERON:0011657.def: Fused ventral dermal element constituting the plastron.

UBERON:0011658.name: epiplastron
UBERON:0011658.def: Paired dermal bone that is part of the anterior region of the plastron. The epiplastron is found only in turtles. [PHENOSCAPE:ad].

UBERON:0011659.name: entoplastron
UBERON:0011659.def: A median bone at the anterior margin of the plastron.

UBERON:0011660.name: hypoplastron
UBERON:0011660.def: A paired plastron element that is in the posterior part of the plastron, anterior to the xiphiplastron and posterior to the hyoplastron.

UBERON:0011661.name: xiphiplastron
UBERON:0011661.def: A paired plastron element that is in the posterior part of the plastron, posterior to the hypoplastron.

UBERON:0011665.name: carapace bone
UBERON:0011665.def: Fused dorsal element constituting the carapace of a turtle shell.

UBERON:0011666.name: peripheral plate of carapace
UBERON:0011666.def: One of a series of bones around the edge of the carapace.

UBERON:0011667.name: pleural plate of carapace
UBERON:0011667.def: One of eight pairs of plates on the carapace, forming two rows adjacent to the peripheral plates.

UBERON:0011669.name: neural plate of carapace
UBERON:0011669.def: One of a series of plates on the dorsal midline of the turtle shell, posterior to the nuchal bone.

UBERON:0011670.name: pygal plate of carapace
UBERON:0011670.def: One of three plates on the posterior end of the carapace, posterior to the neural plates.

UBERON:0011671.name: nuchal plate of carapace
UBERON:0011671.def: The anteriormost plate of the carapace.

UBERON:0011672.name: suprapygal plate of carapace
UBERON:0011672.def: A plate that lies between the posteriormost neural plate and the pygal plate.

UBERON:0011673.name: plastron scute
UBERON:0011673.def: A scute that is part of a plastron.

UBERON:0011674.name: carapace scute
UBERON:0011674.def: A scute that is part of a carapace.

UBERON:0011675.name: perichordal ring
UBERON:0011675.def: Enlarged section of perichordal tube that is arranged serially but out of phase with segmental musculature.

UBERON:0011676.name: subdivision of organism along main body axis
UBERON:0011676.def: A major subdivision of an organism that divides an organism along its main body axis (typically anterio-posterior axis). In vertebrates, this is based on the vertebral column.

UBERON:0011677.name: trunk vertebra
UBERON:0011677.def: A vertebra in the trunk region. For tetrapods, includes lumbar and thoracic vertebrae. Excludes caudal/coccygeal vertebra, which are located posteriorly. In tetrapods this includes thoracic, lumbar and sacral vertebrae, and excludes the cervical vertebrae, which are located anteriorly.

UBERON:0011678.name: hindlimb intermedium bone
UBERON:0011678.def: A proximal tarsal bone that articulates with the fibula.

UBERON:0011679.name: proximal tarsal bone
UBERON:0011679.def: A tarsal bone that connected_to a hindlimb zeugopod skeleton.

UBERON:0011683.name: adductor mandibulae
UBERON:0011683.def: An adductor muscle that acts on the jaw. In some species, this is subdivided into segments based on attachment.

UBERON:0011684.name: levator palatoquadrati
UBERON:0011684.def: A muscle derivative of the mandibular levator that runs from the chondrocranium to the palatoquadrate cartilage. Found in sharks.

UBERON:0011685.name: preorbitalis muscle
UBERON:0011685.def: A jaw muscle arises near the orbit and tapers as it passes posteriorly to its insertion on the adductor mandibulae. Found in sharks.

UBERON:0011688.name: pre-enameloid
UBERON:0011688.def: Odontoid tissue that is avascular non-mineralized matrix that is deposited by odontoblasts and ameloblasts that are excluded from the matrix.

UBERON:0011692.name: enameloid
UBERON:0011692.def: Skeletal tissue that is hypermineralized and aprismatic and deposited by a combination of ameloblasts and odontoblasts that are excluded from the matrix. Enameloid develops from pre-enameloid tissue.

UBERON:0011694.name: embryo portion of umbilical artery
UBERON:0011694.def: Each of the two arteries arising from the hypogastric arteries of the fetus and passing throught the umbilical cord to the placenta.

UBERON:0011695.name: embryonic cardiovascular system
UBERON:0011695.def: A cardiovascular system that is part of a conceptus.

UBERON:0011698.name: midgut loop
UBERON:0011698.def: Portion of midgut after it bends around the superior mesenteric artery.

UBERON:0011737.name: caudate lobe hepatic sinusoid
UBERON:0011737.def: A hepatic sinusoid that is part of a caudate lobe of liver.
UBERON:0011737.synonym: liver right caudate lobe hepatic sinusoids

UBERON:0011738.name: quadrate lobe hepatic sinusoid
UBERON:0011738.def: A hepatic sinusoid that is part of a quadrate lobe of liver.
UBERON:0011738.synonym: liver right quadrate lobe hepatic sinusoids

UBERON:0011742.name: aortic valve leaflet
UBERON:0011742.def: A cardiac valve leaflet that is part of a aortic valve.

UBERON:0011745.name: pulmonary valve leaflets
UBERON:0011745.def: A cardiac valve leaflet that is part of a pulmonary valve.

UBERON:0011754.name: genital swelling
UBERON:0011754.def: Paired structures in the embryo that represent the final stage of development of the caudal end of the external genitals before sexual differentiation. In both males and females the two swellings merge: in the female, they become the posterior labial commissure; In the male, they become the scrotum.

UBERON:0011755.name: female labial swelling
UBERON:0011755.def: A genital swelling that is part of a female reproductive system.

UBERON:0011756.name: male genital swelling
UBERON:0011756.def: A genital swelling that is part of a male reproductive organ.

UBERON:0011765.name: jugular lymph sac
UBERON:0011765.def: An embryonic lymph sac that forms at the junction of the future internal jugular/anterior cardinals and subclavian veins.

UBERON:0011766.name: left recurrent laryngeal nerve
synonym: vagus X nerve left recurrent laryngeal branch

UBERON:0011767.name: right recurrent laryngeal nerve
synonym: vagus X nerve right recurrent laryngeal branch

UBERON:0011769.name: cartilaginous projection
UBERON:0011769.def: Anatomical projection that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0011770.name: mentomeckelian
UBERON:0011770.def: Paired, cylindrical, and small bones of endochondral origin that lie anteromedial to the anterior end of Meckel's cartilage. The precursors of the mentomeckelian bones are the larval infrarostral cartilages.

UBERON:0011771.name: obsolete larval structure
UBERON:0011771.def: Anatomical structure that is part of the larva.

UBERON:0011772.name: lower jaw opening
UBERON:0011772.def: An anatomical space that is part of a bone of lower jaw.

UBERON:0011773.name: upper jaw opening
UBERON:0011773.def: An anatomical space that is part of a bone of upper jaw.

UBERON:0011774.name: utriculosaccular duct
UBERON:0011774.def: A duct connecting the the utricle to the saccule in the membranous labyrinth of the ear.

UBERON:0011775.name: vagus nerve nucleus
UBERON:0011775.def: A cranial nerve nucleus that is associated with a vagus nerve.

UBERON:0011776.name: dorsal commissural nucleus of spinal cord
UBERON:0011776.def: A continuous column of gray matter along the midline in the dorsal gray commissure that sends fibers to the hypogastric nerve.

UBERON:0011777.name: nucleus of spinal cord
UBERON:0011777.def: A neural nucleus that is part of the spinal cord.

UBERON:0011779.name: nerve of head region
UBERON:0011779.def: A nerve that is part of a head.

UBERON:0011782.name: feather follicle
UBERON:0011782.def: A small tubular invagination of the skin with a fleshy dermal papilla at the bottom from which the feather grows. The papilla is inserted in the opening at the end of the quill[TMD]. Forms by invagination of cylinder of epidermal tissue at base of feather bud.

UBERON:0011783.name: feather follicle placode
UBERON:0011783.def: An epidermal thickening above a condensation of dermal cells that will give rise to a feather follicle.

UBERON:0011784.name: feather shaft
UBERON:0011784.def: The combination of the rachis and the calamus.

UBERON:0011792.name: feather muscle
UBERON:0011792.def: Similar to erector pili muscles of mammals; attached to the sides of the follicle; capable of elevating or lowering entire groups of feathers.

UBERON:0011794.name: rectrix feather
UBERON:0011794.def: A flight feather that lies along a single horizontal row on the rear margin of the anatomical tail. Only the central pair are attached (via ligaments) to the tail bones; the remaining rectrices are embedded into the rectricial bulbs, complex structures of fat and muscle that surround those bones. Rectrices are always paired, with a vast majority of species having six pairs. They are absent in grebes and some ratites, and greatly reduced in size in penguins.

UBERON:0011795.name: remex feather
UBERON:0011795.def: A flight feather located on the posterior side of the wing.

UBERON:0011796.name: primary remex feather
UBERON:0011796.def: A remex feather that is connected to the manus.

UBERON:0011797.name: secondary remex feather
UBERON:0011797.def: A remex feather that is connected to the ulna.

UBERON:0011798.name: tertial remex feather
UBERON:0011798.def: A remex feather that is connected to the humerus.

UBERON:0011799.name: cavity of feather shaft
UBERON:0011799.def: An anatomical cavity that is part of a feather shaft.

UBERON:0011800.name: dermal pulp of feather shaft
UBERON:0011800.def: A tissue that is part of a cavity of feather shaft.

UBERON:0011801.name: dermal condensation of feather follicle
UBERON:0011801.def: A suprabasal cell population which together with the feather follicle placode develops into the feather follicle.

UBERON:0011803.name: feather bud, dermal component
UBERON:0011803.def: The part of the feather bud formed by a proliferation of dermal cells.

UBERON:0011804.name: feather bud, epidermal component
UBERON:0011804.def: An epithelial bud that is part of a feather bud.

UBERON:0011806.name: dermis of feather follicle
UBERON:0011806.def: A tissue that is part of a dermis and is part of a feather follicle.

UBERON:0011807.name: epidermis of feather follicle
UBERON:0011807.def: A tissue that is part of a epidermis and is part of a feather follicle.

UBERON:0011808.name: outer epidermal layer of feather follicle

UBERON:0011809.name: inner epidermal layer of feather follicle

UBERON:0011810.name: collection of feathers
UBERON:0011810.def: An anatomical cluster that consists of feathers.

UBERON:0011814.name: non-neurogenic ectodermal placode
UBERON:0011814.def: Ectodermal placode that does not develop into a component of the nervous system.

UBERON:0011817.name: skin appendage placode
UBERON:0011817.def: An ectodermal placode that gives rise to any of the cutaneous appendages that protrude from the skin epidermis (heair, feathers, epidermal scales).

UBERON:0011818.name: superficial fascia
UBERON:0011818.def: Superficial fascia is found in the subcutis in most regions of the body, blending with the reticular layer of the dermis. It is present on the face, over the upper portion of the sternocleidomastoid, at the nape of the neck, and overlying the sternum. It is comprised mainly of loose areolar connective tissue and adipose and is the layer that primarily determines the shape of a body. In addition to its subcutaneous presence, this type of fascia surrounds organs and glands, neurovascular bundles, and is found at many other locations where it fills otherwise unoccupied space. It serves as a storage medium of fat and water; as a passageway for lymph, nerve and blood vessels; and as a protective padding to cushion and insulate. Superficial fascia is present, but does not contain fat, in the eyelids, ear, scrotum, penis and clitoris.

UBERON:0011819.name: lumen of atrioventricular canal
UBERON:0011819.def: A tube lumen that is part of a atrioventricular canal.

UBERON:0011820.name: atrioventricular region
UBERON:0011820.def: An anatomical junction that divides and overlaps with and atrium and a ventricle in the heart.

UBERON:0011821.name: irregular connective tissue
UBERON:0011821.def: Connective tissue, which consists of a population of connective tissue cells, the intercellular matrix of which contains an irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: areolar tissue, mucoid tissue, connective tissue of peritoneum, connective tissue of fibrous pericardium.

UBERON:0011822.name: dense irregular connective tissue
UBERON:0011822.def: Irregular connective tissue is an irregular connective tissue, the intercellular matrix of which contains a dense irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: connective tissue of peritoneum, connective tissue of fibrous pericardium.

UBERON:0011823.name: dense connective tissue
UBERON:0011823.def: Dense connective tissue is mainly composed of collagen type I. Crowded between the collagen fibers are rows of fibroblasts, fiber-forming cells, that manufacture the fibers. Dense connective tissue forms strong, rope-like structures such as tendons and ligaments. Tendons attach skeletal muscles to bones; ligaments connect bones to bones at joints. Ligaments are more stretchy and contain more elastic fibers than tendons. Dense connective tissue also make up the lower layers of the skin (dermis), where it is arranged in sheets.

UBERON:0011825.name: loose connective tissue
UBERON:0011825.def: Irregular connective tissue, the intercellular matrix of which contains a sparse irregular network of collagen and elastic fiber bundles. Examples: areolar tissue, neuroglial tissue, mucoid tissue.

UBERON:0011826.name: vestibular gland
UBERON:0011826.def: Lobular organ the parenchyma of which consists of glandular acini which communicate with the vestibule of vagina. Examples: right vestibular gland, lesser vestibular gland.

UBERON:0011827.name: areolar gland
UBERON:0011827.def: A sebaceous glands in the areola surrounding the nipple.

UBERON:0011830.name: duct of lesser vestibular gland
UBERON:0011830.def: A duct that is part of a minor vestibular gland.

UBERON:0011831.name: duct of vestibular gland
UBERON:0011831.def: A duct that is part of a vestibular gland.

UBERON:0011845.name: duct of sebaceous gland
UBERON:0011845.def: A duct that is part of a sebaceous gland.

UBERON:0011846.name: acinus of sebaceous gland
UBERON:0011846.def: An acinus that is part of a sebaceous gland.

UBERON:0011847.name: acinus of parotid gland
UBERON:0011847.def: An acinus that is part of a parotid gland.

UBERON:0011850.name: acinus of salivary gland
UBERON:0011850.def: An acinus that is part of a salivary gland.

UBERON:0011854.name: acinus of areolar gland
UBERON:0011854.def: An acinus that is part of a areolar gland.

UBERON:0011856.name: acinus of lactiferous gland
UBERON:0011856.def: An acinus that is part of a mammary gland.

UBERON:0011857.name: acinus of lacrimal gland
UBERON:0011857.def: An acinus that is part of a lacrimal gland.

UBERON:0011858.name: acinus of exocrine gland
UBERON:0011858.def: An acinus that is part of a exocrine gland.

UBERON:0011859.name: internal acoustic meatus
UBERON:0011859.def: The internal auditory meatus (also internal acoustic meatus, internal auditory canal, and internal acoustic canal) is a canal in the petrous bone of the temporal bone of the skull that carries nerves from inside the cranium towards the middle and inner ear compartments namely cranial nerve VII and cranial nerve VIII.

UBERON:0011861.name: aorta collagen fibril
UBERON:0011861.def: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of aorta tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

UBERON:0011862.name: pulmonary collagen fibril
UBERON:0011862.def: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of pulmonary tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

UBERON:0011863.name: bone collagen fibril
UBERON:0011863.def: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of bone tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

UBERON:0011864.name: tendon collagen fibril
UBERON:0011864.def: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of tendon tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

UBERON:0011865.name: corneal stroma collagen fibril
UBERON:0011865.def: The connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of corneal stroma that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

UBERON:0011866.name: condylar joint
UBERON:0011866.def: In a condyloid joint (condyloid articulation, ellipsoidal joint) an ovoid articular surface, or condyle, is received into an elliptical cavity. This permits movement in two planes, allowing flexion, extension, adduction, abduction, and circumduction.

UBERON:0011868.name: midcarpal joint
UBERON:0011868.def: An intercarpal that connects a proximal and distal carpal bone.

UBERON:0011869.name: pisiform joint
UBERON:0011869.def: It is a joint between the pisiform and triquetrum.

UBERON:0011871.name: nasomaxillary suture
UBERON:0011871.def: A cranial suture that connects a nasal bone and connects a maxilla.
synonym: articulation of the nasal bone with maxilla

UBERON:0011873.name: synarthrosis
UBERON:0011873.def: A synarthrosis is a type of joint which permits very little or no movement under normal conditions. Most synarthrosis joints are fibrous. Suture joints and synchondroses are synarthroses.

UBERON:0011874.name: amphiarthrosis
UBERON:0011874.def: Amphiarthrosis is a type of continuous, slightly movable joint.

UBERON:0011875.name: ligament of sternoclavicular joint
UBERON:0011875.def: A skeletal ligament that is part of a sternoclavicular joint.

UBERON:0011876.name: body of tongue
UBERON:0011876.def: The oral part of the tongue anterior to the terminal sulcus.

UBERON:0011877.name: margin of tongue
UBERON:0011877.def: The lateral border that separates the dorsum from the inferior surface of the tongue on each side, the two borders meeting anteriorly at the apex..

UBERON:0011878.name: muscle layer of esophagus
UBERON:0011878.def: A muscle layer that is part of a wall of esophagus.

UBERON:0011879.name: mesorchium
UBERON:0011879.def: The testes, at an early period of fetal life, are placed at the back part of the abdominal cavity, behind the peritoneum, and each is attached by a peritoneal fold, the mesorchium, to the mesonephros.

UBERON:0011892.name: anterior uvea
UBERON:0011892.def: Front (ventral) portion of the vascular, pigmentary, or middle coat of the eye, including the ciliary body and the iris.
synonym: anterior vascular layer of the eyeball
anterior vascular tunic of the eye

UBERON:0011893.name: endoneurial fluid
UBERON:0011893.def: Fluid of the ganglia and peripheral nerves that lie outside the brain and spinal cord.

UBERON:0011894.name: lumen of vagina
UBERON:0011894.def: An organ cavity that is part of a vagina.

UBERON:0011895.name: endomysium
UBERON:0011895.def: A layer of connective tissue that ensheaths a muscle fiber and is composed mostly from reticular fibers. It also contains capillaries, nerves and lymphatics. The term cardiac skeleton is sometimes considered synonymous with endomysium, but sometimes it refers to the combination of the endomysium and perimysium.

UBERON:0011896.name: smooth muscle endomysium
UBERON:0011896.def: Reticular tissue which surrounds a smooth muscle cell.

UBERON:0011897.name: cardiac endomysium
UBERON:0011897.def: Reticular tissue which surrounds a cardiac myocyte.
synonym: fibrocollagenous sheath of cardiac muscle cell

UBERON:0011898.name: skeletal muscle endomysium
UBERON:0011898.def: Reticular tissue which surrounds a skeletal muscle cell.

UBERON:0011899.name: epimysium
UBERON:0011899.def: Epimysium is a layer of connective tissue which ensheaths the entire muscle. It is composed of dense irregular connective tissue. It is continuous with fascia and other connective tissue wrappings of muscle including the endomysium, and perimysium. It is also continuous with tendons where it becomes thicker and collagenous.

UBERON:0011900.name: perimysium
UBERON:0011900.def: The fibrous sheath enveloping each of the primary bundles of skeletal muscle fibers.

UBERON:0011903.name: gizzard smooth muscle
UBERON:0011903.def: A smooth muscle tissue that is part of a gizzard.

UBERON:0011904.name: gastrolith
UBERON:0011904.def: A rock held inside a gastrointestinal tract.

UBERON:0011905.name: plantaris
UBERON:0011905.def: Plantaris is a vestigial structure and one of the superficial muscles of the posterior crural compartment of the leg. It is innervated by the tibial nerve (S1, S2) . It is composed of a thin muscle belly and a long thin tendon. It is approximately 2-4 inches long, and is absent in 7 - 10% of the human population. It is one of the plantar flexors in the superior compartment of the leg along with the gastrocnemius, and soleus. The plantaris is considered an unimportant muscle, it mainly acts with gastrocnemius[WP].

UBERON:0011906.name: muscle head
synonym: proximal myotendinous region of muscle organ

UBERON:0011907.name: gastrocnemius medialis
UBERON:0011907.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0011907. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0011908.name: gastrocnemius lateralis
UBERON:0011908.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0011908. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0011909.name: gastrocnemius internus
UBERON:0011909.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0011909. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0011910.name: gastrocnemius externus
UBERON:0011910.def: Missing definition for term UBERON:0011910. Please replace it using linked reference.

UBERON:0011915.name: cerebellar glomerulus
UBERON:0011915.def: An intertwined cluster of nerve fibers surrounded by glia where mossy fibers from the pontine nuclei in the white matter synapse with granule cell axons, Golgi cell axons and unipolar brush interneuron axons.

UBERON:0011917.name: thalamic glomerulus
UBERON:0011917.def: Synaptic structure found in thalamic relay nuclei consising of a complex of afferent terminals, relay cell dendrites, interneuron dendrites and other processes. These complexes are surrounded by astrocytic processes.

UBERON:0011918.name: line of Schwalbe
UBERON:0011918.def: The thickened peripheral margin of the vitreous membrane of the cornea.

UBERON:0011919.name: yolk sac blood island
UBERON:0011919.def: Masses of developing blood cells attached to endothelium in the yolk sac.

UBERON:0011922.name: cochlear basement membrane
UBERON:0011922.def: The the continuous basement membrane found within the membranous labyrinth of the cochlea, known to extend from the limbus, down to the inner sulcus, across the basilar membrane, up to the external sulcus to the spiral prominence and radiating into the spiral ligament ensheathing the root cell processes.

UBERON:0011924.name: postganglionic autonomic fiber
UBERON:0011924.def: Nerve fibers which project from cell bodies of autonomic ganglia to synapses on target organs.

UBERON:0011925.name: preganglionic autonomic fiber
UBERON:0011925.def: Nerve fibers which project from the central nervous system to autonomic ganglia. In the sympathetic division most preganglionic fibers originate with neurons in the intermediolateral column of the spinal cord, exit via ventral roots from upper thoracic through lower lumbar segments, and project to the paravertebral ganglia; there they either terminate in synapses or continue through the splanchnic nerves to the prevertebral ganglia. In the parasympathetic division the fibers originate in neurons of the brain stem and sacral spinal cord. In both divisions the principal transmitter is acetylcholine but peptide cotransmitters may also be released.

UBERON:0011926.name: postganglionic sympathetic fiber
UBERON:0011926.def: A noradrenergic or adrenergic axonal fiber projecting from a sympathetic ganglion to an effector organ.

UBERON:0011927.name: preganglionic sympathetic fiber
UBERON:0011927.def: A cholinergic axonal fiber projecting from the CNS to a sympathetic ganglion.

UBERON:0011929.name: postganglionic parasympathetic fiber
UBERON:0011929.def: A cholinergic axonal fiber projecting from a parasympathetic ganglion to an effector organ.

UBERON:0011930.name: preganglionic parasympathetic fiber
UBERON:0011930.def: A cholinergic axonal fibers projecting from the CNS to a parasympathetic ganglion.

UBERON:0011931.name: nasal hair
synonym: hair of vestibular part of nose

UBERON:0011932.name: pilosebaceous unit
UBERON:0011932.def: An epidermal invagination that has as parts a hair follicle, a sebaceous gland, and arrector pili muscle.

UBERON:0011933.name: vibrissa unit
UBERON:0011933.def: A pilosebaceous unit that contains a strand of vibrissa hair (a specialized tactile hair) with the follicle incorporating a blood sinus, heavily innervated by sensory nerves.

UBERON:0011936.name: vibrissa hair bulb
UBERON:0011936.def: A bulb of hair follicle that is part of a vibrissa unit.

UBERON:0011937.name: vibrissa root sheath
UBERON:0011937.def: A hair root sheath that is part of a vibrissa unit.

UBERON:0011938.name: vibrissa inner root sheath
UBERON:0011938.def: A hair inner root sheath that is part of a vibrissa unit.

UBERON:0011939.name: vibrissa outer root sheath
UBERON:0011939.def: A hair outer root sheath that is part of a vibrissa unit.

UBERON:0011940.name: arrector pili muscle of vibrissa
UBERON:0011940.def: An arrector muscle of hair that is part of a vibrissa hair.

UBERON:0011941.name: lateral angle of scapula
UBERON:0011941.def: An angle of the scapula that is broad and bears the glenoid cavity or fossa[WP,unvetted].

UBERON:0011947.name: ureter luminal urothelium
UBERON:0011947.def: A luminal layer of epithelium that is part of a ureter.

UBERON:0011949.name: endometrium luminal epithelium
UBERON:0011949.def: A luminal layer of epithelium that is part of a endometrium epithelium.

UBERON:0011950.name: mammary gland luminal epithelium
UBERON:0011950.def: The inner cell layer of the mammary epithelium bilayer that lines the luminal surface of mammary gland ducts and alveoli; luminal cells have only limited contact with the underlying basement membrane and surrounding connective tissue; they are secretory epithelial cells characterized by the expression of the receptors for systemic hormones, i.e. estrogens, progesterone and prolactin.
UBERON:0011950.synonym: lumina layer of epithelium of lactiferous gland

UBERON:0011951.name: prostate luminal epithelium
UBERON:0011951.def: A luminal layer of epithelium that is part of a prostate gland.
UBERON:0011951.synonym: subdivision of luminal layer of epithelium of prostatic gland

UBERON:0011953.name: stomach glandular region
UBERON:0011953.def: A region of the stomach that is lined with glandular epithelium.

UBERON:0011954.name: stomach non-glandular region
UBERON:0011954.def: A region of the stomach is lined with non-glandular epithelium. Examples of a stomach non-glandular region are found in rodents.

UBERON:0011955.name: left hepatic vein
UBERON:0011955.def: A hepatic vein that is part of a left lobe of liver.

UBERON:0011956.name: right hepatic vein
UBERON:0011956.def: A hepatic vein that is part of a right lobe of liver.

UBERON:0011958.name: acetabular labrum
UBERON:0011958.def: A ring of cartilage that surrounds the acetabulum[WP,unvetted].

UBERON:0011959.name: glenoid labrum of scapula
UBERON:0011959.def: A ring of fibrocartilage attached to the margin of the glenoid cavity of the scapula.

UBERON:0011960.name: articular capsule of glenohumeral joint
UBERON:0011960.def: An articular capsule that is part of the glenohumeral joint.

UBERON:0011961.name: articular capsule of hip joint
UBERON:0011961.def: An articular capsule that is part of the hip joint.

UBERON:0011962.name: transverse tarsal joint
UBERON:0011962.def: The transverse tarsal joint is formed by the articulation of the calcaneus with the cuboid, and the articulation of the talus with the navicular. The movement which takes place in this joint is more extensive than that in the other tarsal joints, and consists of a sort of rotation by means of which the foot may be slightly flexed or extended, the sole being at the same time carried medially (inverted) or laterally.

UBERON:0011963.name: talocalcaneonavicular joint
UBERON:0011963.def: The talocalcaneonavicular articulation is an arthrodial joint: the rounded head of the talus being received into the concavity formed by the posterior surface of the navicular, the anterior articular surface of the calcaneus, and the upper surface of the plantar calcaneonavicular ligament. There are two ligaments in this joint: the articular capsule and the dorsal talonavicular.

UBERON:0011964.name: calcaneocuboid joint
UBERON:0011964.def: Calcaneocuboid Articulation (articulation of the calcaneus with the cuboid). The ligaments connecting the calcaneus with the cuboid are five in number, viz. , the articular capsule, the dorsal calcaneocuboid, part of the bifurcated, the long plantar, and the plantar calcaneocuboid.

UBERON:0011965.name: saddle joint
UBERON:0011965.def: In a saddle joint (sellar joint, articulation by reciprocal reception) the opposing surfaces are reciprocally concave-convex.

UBERON:0011966.name: manubriosternal joint
UBERON:0011966.def: The early union, by hyaline cartilage, of the manubrium and the body of the sternum, which later becomes a symphysial type of joint.

UBERON:0011967.name: costotransverse joint
UBERON:0011967.def: The facet of the tubercle of the rib forms an articulation with the adjacent transverse process of a thoracic vertebra. This is a plane type synovial joint called the costotransverse joint. This articulation is present in all but the eleventh and twelfth ribs. Ribs 1 to 10 have two joints in close proximity posteriorly; the costovertebral joints and the costotranseverse joints. This arrangement restrains the motion of the ribs allowing them to work in a parallel fashion during breathing. If a typical rib had only one joint posteriorly the resultant swivel action would allow a rib to be non-parallel with respect to the neighboring ribs making for a very inefficient respiratory mechanism. The ventral rami innervate the costotransverse joints. Therefore, therapeutic medial branch blocks are ineffectual. The ligaments of the joint are: Articular capsule Posterior costotransverse Anterior costotransverse Ligament of the neck of the rib Ligament of the tubercle of the rib.

UBERON:0011968.name: radio-carpal joint
UBERON:0011968.def: A skeletal joint that connects a radius bone and connects a carpal skeleton.

UBERON:0011969.name: mesotarsal joint
UBERON:0011969.def: An ankle joint that passes between the proximal and distal tarsals.

UBERON:0011970.name: talofibular ligament
UBERON:0011970.def: A skeletal ligament that connects the fibula to the talus. Examples: anterior and posterior talofibular ligament.

UBERON:0011971.name: calcaneofibular ligament
UBERON:0011971.def: A skeletal ligament that connects the fibula to the calcaneus.

UBERON:0011972.name: medial ligament of ankle joint
UBERON:0011972.def: A skeletal ligament that connects a tibia and connects a tarsal skeleton.
synonym: deltoid collateral ligament of ankle joint
medial collateral ligament of ankle joint

UBERON:0011973.name: epiphysis of phalanx of pes
UBERON:0011973.def: An epiphysis that is part of a phalanx of a pes [Automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0011974.name: epiphysis of proximal phalanx of pes
UBERON:0011974.def: An epiphysis that is part of a proximal phalanx of pes.
UBERON:0011974.synonym: epiphysis of proximal phalanx of toe

UBERON:0011975.name: epiphysis of middle phalanx of pes
UBERON:0011975.def: An epiphysis that is part of a middle phalanx of pes.
UBERON:0011975.synonym: epiphysis of middle phalanx of toe

UBERON:0011976.name: epiphysis of distal phalanx of pes
UBERON:0011976.def: An epiphysis that is part of a distal phalanx of pes.
UBERON:0011976.synonym: epiphysis of distal phalanx of toe

UBERON:0011977.name: epiphysis of proximal phalanx of manus
UBERON:0011977.def: An epiphysis that is part of a proximal phalanx of manus.
UBERON:0011977.synonym: epiphysis of proximal phalanx of finger

UBERON:0011978.name: epiphysis of middle phalanx of manus
UBERON:0011978.def: An epiphysis that is part of a middle phalanx of manus.
UBERON:0011978.synonym: epiphysis of middle phalanx of finger

UBERON:0011979.name: epiphysis of distal phalanx of manus
UBERON:0011979.def: An epiphysis that is part of a distal phalanx of manus.
UBERON:0011979.synonym: epiphysis of distal phalanx of finger

UBERON:0011980.name: crurotarsal joint
UBERON:0011980.def: A joint that connects the bones of the crus to the proximal tarsal bones.

UBERON:0011985.name: infraorbital sinus
UBERON:0011985.def: An air-filled recess in the head of birds which lies lateral to the nasal cavity into which it opens.

UBERON:0011986.name: mucosa of infraorbital sinus
UBERON:0011986.def: A mucosa that adjacent_to a infraorbital sinus.

UBERON:0011997.name: coelom
UBERON:0011997.def: The aggregate of the coelemic cavity lumen plus the membranes that line the lumen.

UBERON:0012055.name: left lung lower lobe bronchiole
UBERON:0012055.def: A bronchiole that is part of a lower lobe of left lung.
synonym: bronchiole of left lower lobe of lung

UBERON:0012056.name: left lung upper lobe bronchiole
UBERON:0012056.def: A bronchiole that is part of a upper lobe of left lung.
synonym: bronchiole of left upper lobe of lung

UBERON:0012059.name: right lung lower lobe bronchiole
UBERON:0012059.def: A bronchiole that is part of a lower lobe of right lung.
synonym: bronchiole of right lower lobe of lung

UBERON:0012063.name: lobar bronchus of right lung middle lobe
UBERON:0012063.def: A lobar bronchus that is part of a middle lobe of right lung.

UBERON:0012065.name: lobar bronchus of left lung upper lobe
UBERON:0012065.def: A lobar bronchus that is part of a upper lobe of left lung.

UBERON:0012066.name: lobar bronchus of left lung lower lobe
UBERON:0012066.def: A lobar bronchus that is part of a lower lobe of left lung.

UBERON:0012067.name: primary bronchiole
UBERON:0012067.def: A bronchiole that arises from a segmental bronchus and does not contain cartilage.

UBERON:0012068.name: right lung middle lobe bronchiole
UBERON:0012068.def: A bronchiole that is part of a middle lobe of right lung.
synonym: bronchiole of right middle lobe of lung

UBERON:0012070.name: palatal tooth
UBERON:0012070.def: A tooth that is on the roof of the mouth.

UBERON:0012071.name: palate bone
UBERON:0012071.def: Any bone that is part of a palate.

UBERON:0012073.name: tooth of palatine bone
UBERON:0012073.def: A tooth that is attached to a palatine bone.

UBERON:0012074.name: bony part of hard palate
UBERON:0012074.def: A subdivision of skeletal system that subdivision_of a hard palate.

UBERON:0012075.name: replacement bone
UBERON:0012075.def: Bone that forms as a replacement of another structural tissue.

UBERON:0012076.name: tibiotalar joint
UBERON:0012076.def: A skeletal joint that connects a tibia and connects a talus.

UBERON:0012078.name: fovea capitis of femur
UBERON:0012078.def: The surface of the head of the femur is smooth, coated with cartilage in the fresh state, except over an ovoid depression, the fovea of head of femur, which is situated a little below and behind the center of the head, and gives attachment to the ligamentum teres.
synonym: fovea for ligament of head of femur

UBERON:0012080.name: patella cartilage element
UBERON:0012080.def: A cartilaginous condensation that has the potential to develop into a patella.

UBERON:0012081.name: patella pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0012081.def: A pre-cartilage condensation that has the potential to develop into a patella.

UBERON:0012082.name: bronchial lumen
UBERON:0012082.def: An anatomical cavity that is part of a bronchus.

UBERON:0012083.name: lumen of primary bronchus
UBERON:0012083.def: An anatomical cavity that is part of a main bronchus.

UBERON:0012084.name: lumen of secondary bronchus
UBERON:0012084.def: An anatomical cavity that is part of a lobar bronchus.

UBERON:0012085.name: lumen of tertiary bronchus
UBERON:0012085.def: An anatomical cavity that is part of a segmental bronchus.

UBERON:0012086.name: lumen of parabronchus
UBERON:0012086.def: An anatomical cavity that is part of a parabronchus.

UBERON:0012087.name: air capillary of parabronchus
UBERON:0012087.def: An extension of the parabronchus, the walls of which are the site of gas exchange.

UBERON:0012100.name: appendicocostalis muscle
UBERON:0012100.def: One of of three muscles associated with the uncinate processes.

UBERON:0012101.name: perinatal stage
UBERON:0012101.def: The period spanning the range immediately before and after birth.

UBERON:0012102.name: buccal salivary gland
UBERON:0012102.def: A salivary gland that is part of a cheek.

UBERON:0012103.name: suspensory ligament of breast
UBERON:0012103.def: Cooper's ligaments (also known as the suspensory ligaments of Cooper and the fibrocollagenous septa) are connective tissue in the breast that helps maintain structural integrity. Transmission diffraction tomography can reveal the anatomy. Cooper's Suspensory Ligament should not be confused with the pectineal ligament (sometimes called the inguinal ligament of Cooper) which shares the same eponym.

UBERON:0012104.name: sesamoid bone of the peroneus longus muscle

UBERON:0012105.name: baleen plate
UBERON:0012105.def: A keratinous sieve composed of bristles that enables filter feeding in the mouth of mysticete whales.

UBERON:0012106.name: baleen plate bristle
UBERON:0012106.def: A keratinous bristle that enables filter feeding in the mouth of mysticete whales.

UBERON:0012108.name: postorbital bar
UBERON:0012108.def: A strut formed from the union of the zygomatic process of the frontal bone with the frontal process of the zygomatic bone.

UBERON:0012109.name: zygomatic process of frontal bone
UBERON:0012109.def: The part of the zygomatic process consisting of the frontal bone[WP].

UBERON:0012111.name: diastema
UBERON:0012111.def: A space or gap between two teeth.

UBERON:0012112.name: ingested food
UBERON:0012112.def: A substance that is consumed by the organism for food.

UBERON:0012113.name: bolus of food
UBERON:0012113.def: Ingested food has been chewed at the point of swallowing.

UBERON:0012114.name: cud
UBERON:0012114.def: A bolus of semi-degraded food regurgitated from the reticulorumen of a ruminant, produced during the physical digestive process of rumination.

UBERON:0012115.name: dental comb
UBERON:0012115.def: A dental structure found in some mammals, comprising a group of front teeth arranged in a manner that facilitates grooming.

UBERON:0012116.name: nutrient foramen conduit
UBERON:0012116.def: Any of the passages admitting nutrient vessels to the medullary cavity of bone.

UBERON:0012117.name: lumen of nutrient foramen
UBERON:0012117.def: An anatomical space that is part of a nutrient foramen conduit, leading to the medullary cavity of the bone.

UBERON:0012118.name: infraspinatus tendon
UBERON:0012118.def: The infraspinatus muscle inserts at this tendon to the distal greater tubercle of the humerus. This tendon stretches across the shoulder joint to attach to the humerus and in doing so acts as a very strong ligament to hold the joint surface in apposition. This structure restricts the movement of the shoulder joint to flexion and extension (together with the suscapularis tendon and the supraspinatus tendon). A bursa lies under this tendon at the greater tubercle of the humerus. The bursa is lined by a synovial membrance and filled with synovial fluid and protects the infraspinatus tendon and the shoulder joint by allowing the transmissions of tension and sheer forces around an angle.

UBERON:0012119.name: vinculum tendon of wing
UBERON:0012119.def: A tendon which emerges from the distal end of the humerus and follows the posterior margin of the wing, attaching at the distal end of digit 2. The raches of the remiges (i.e., the stems of the flight feathers) are stabilized by passing through the vinculum.

UBERON:0012120.name: vinculum of tendon
UBERON:0012120.def: A tendinous band that connects the phalanges and the flexor muscles of the autopods.

UBERON:0012121.name: respiratory velum
UBERON:0012121.def: A respiratory pump found in basal craniates.

UBERON:0012125.name: dermatological-muscosal system
UBERON:0012125.def: Anatomical system that consists of the integumental system plus all mucosae and submucosae.

UBERON:0012126.name: fibulare
UBERON:0012126.def: One of two elements that constitute the basal row of tarsals. The fibulare constitutes the preaxial element[AAO].

UBERON:0012127.name: feather barbicel
UBERON:0012127.def: A minute hook that projects off of a feather barbule, holding barbules together.

UBERON:0012128.name: nose tip
UBERON:0012128.def: Outermost point on an external nose or snout.

UBERON:0012129.name: radial head of humerus
UBERON:0012129.def: Hemispherical ball located at the lower end of the humerus that stands out prominently from the surrounding structures toward the flexor surface of the forelimb.

UBERON:0012130.name: olecranon fossa
UBERON:0012130.def: A deep evacuation in the bone, into which the anconeal process of the ulna passes when the elbow joint is extended.

UBERON:0012131.name: centrale
UBERON:0012131.def: Endochondral bone located between the proximal and distal rows of carpals or tarsals and thus representing the central carpals or tarsals[PHENOSCAPE].

UBERON:0012132.name: intercuneiform joint
UBERON:0012132.def: The intercuneiform articulations are articulations among the cuneiform bones[WP,unverified].

UBERON:0012140.name: digitopodium region
UBERON:0012140.def: A segment of the autopod consisting of both acropodial region and metapodial region, but excluding the mesopodial/basopodial region.

UBERON:0012141.name: manual digitopodium region
UBERON:0012141.def: A digitopodium region that is part of a manus[Obol]. This includes the fingers and metacarpal region, but excludes the carpal region.

UBERON:0012142.name: pedal digitopodium region
UBERON:0012142.def: A digitopodium region that is part of a pes[Obol]. This includes the toes and metatarsal region, but excludes the tarsals region.

UBERON:0012150.name: skeleton of digitopodium
UBERON:0012150.def: A subdivision of the autopod skeleton consisting of both acropodial skeleon and metapodial skeleton, but excluding the mesopodial/basopodial skeleton.

UBERON:0012151.name: skeleton of manual digitopodium
UBERON:0012151.def: A subdivision of the manus skeleton consisting of both manual acropodial skeleton and metacarpal skeleton, but excluding the carpal skeleton.

UBERON:0012152.name: skeleton of pedal digitopodium
UBERON:0012152.def: A subdivision of the pes skeleton consisting of both pedal acropodial skeleton and metatarsal skeleton, but excluding the tarsal skeleton.

UBERON:0012167.name: buccal fat pad
UBERON:0012167.def: The Buccal fat pad is one of several encapsulated fat masses in the cheek. It is a deep fat pad located on either side of the face between the buccinator muscle and several more superficial muscles. It should not be confused with the malar fat pad, which is directly below the skin of the cheek. It should also not be confused with jowl fat pads. It is implicated in the formation of hollow cheeks and the nasolabial fold, but not in the formation of jowls.

UBERON:0012168.name: umbilical cord blood
UBERON:0012168.def: Blood that remains in the placenta and in the attached umbilical cord after childbirth[WP].

UBERON:0012171.name: shell of nucleus accumbens
UBERON:0012171.def: Crescent shaped outer zone of the nucleus accumbens, defined by a combination of chemoarchitecture and afferent and efferent connections. The shell is distinguished from the more centrally located core through the notable reduction in staining for the calcium-binding protein calbindin D28K, which is dense in the core and virtually absent in the shell.

UBERON:0012172.name: stomach primordium
UBERON:0012172.def: A primordium that has the potential to develop into a stomach.

UBERON:0012173.name: middle suprarenal artery
UBERON:0012173.def: The middle suprarenal arteries (middle capsular arteries; suprarenal arteries) are two small vessels which arise, one from either side of the abdominal aorta, opposite the superior mesenteric artery. They pass laterally and slightly upward, over the crura of the diaphragm, to the suprarenal glands, where they anastomose with suprarenal branches of the inferior phrenic and renal arteries. In the fetus these arteries are of large size.

UBERON:0012176.name: comb
UBERON:0012176.def: A vascular, red cutaneous structure attached in a sagittal plane to the dorsum of the skull of domestic fowl. It consists of a base attached to the skull, a central mass called the body, a backward projecting blade and upward projecting points.

UBERON:0012177.name: skin apocrine gland
UBERON:0012177.def: An apocrine gland that is part of a skin of body.

UBERON:0012180.name: head or neck skin
UBERON:0012180.def: A zone of skin that is part of a craniocervical region.

UBERON:0012181.name: tonsil crypt
UBERON:0012181.def: Tonsils consist of an extensive system of crypts, which result in a large internal surface. The tonsils contain four lymphoid compartments that influence immune functions, namely the reticular crypt epithelium, the extrafollicular area, the mantle zones of lymphoid follicles, and the follicular germinal centers. In human palatine tonsils, the very first part exposed to the outside environment is tonsillar epithelium.

UBERON:0012187.name: frontal artery
UBERON:0012187.def: The supratrochlear artery (or frontal artery), one of the terminal branches of the ophthalmic artery, branches off where the ophthalmic travels posterior to the trochlea.

UBERON:0012193.name: phrenic vein
UBERON:0012193.def: The veins that run parallel to the phrenic arteries which include the two superior and two inferior phrenic veins.

UBERON:0012194.name: superior intercostal vein
UBERON:0012194.def: The superior intercostal veins are two veins that drain the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th intercostal spaces, one vein for each side of the body.

UBERON:0012197.name: intercostal vein
UBERON:0012197.def: The intercostal veins are a group of veins which drain the area between the ribs.

UBERON:0012198.name: intercostal space
UBERON:0012198.def: A space in the rib cage between two successive ribs.

UBERON:0012199.name: posterior intercostal vein
UBERON:0012199.def: The posterior intercostal veins are veins that drain the intercostal spaces posteriorly. They run with their corresponding posterior intercostal artery on the underside of the rib, the vein superior to the artery. Each vein also gives off a dorsal branch that drains blood from the muscles of the back. There are eleven posterior intercostal veins on each side. Their patterns are variable, but they are commonly arranged as: The 1st posterior intercostal vein, supreme intercostal vein, drains into the brachiocephalic vein or the vertebral vein. The 2nd and 3rd (and often 4th) posterior intercostal veins drain into the superior intercostal vein. The remaining posterior intercostal veins drain into the azygos vein on the right, or the hemiazygos vein on the left.

UBERON:0012200.name: anterior intercostal vein
UBERON:0012200.def: The anterior intercostal veins are the veins which drain the anterior intercostal space.

UBERON:0012236.name: intercostal lymph node
UBERON:0012236.def: The intercostal lymph nodes (intercostal glands ) occupy the posterior parts of the intercostal spaces, in relation to the intercostal vessels. They receive the deep lymphatics from the postero-lateral aspect of the chest; some of these vessels are interrupted by small lateral intercostal glands.

UBERON:0012237.name: superior phrenic vein
UBERON:0012237.def: The superior phrenic vein, i.e. , the vein accompanying the pericardiacophrenic artery, usually opens into the internal mammary vein.

UBERON:0012238.name: ureteric bud trunk
UBERON:0012238.def: Ureteric bud cells that elongate to form a rigid structure (stalk) consisting of polarized epithelial cells without branching; the stalks differentiate into the collecting system of the mature kidney, while the tip cells interact with the adjacent cells of the metanephric mesenchyme, inducing their conversion into nephrons.

UBERON:0012239.name: urinary bladder vasculature
UBERON:0012239.def: Network of tubes that carries blood through the distensible musculomembranous organ that serves to collect and store urine excreted by the kidneys[MP].
synonym: set of urinary bladder blood vessels

UBERON:0012240.name: urethral meatus
UBERON:0012240.def: External opening or orifice of the urethra through which urine and seminal fluid (in males only) leave the body; in males the meatus presents as a vertical slit normally positioned at the tip of glans penis; in females the meatus is located between the clitoris and the vagina in the vulvular vestibule of the female genitalia[MP].

UBERON:0012241.name: male urethral meatus
UBERON:0012241.def: A urethral meatus that is part of a male urethra[Automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0012242.name: internal urethral orifice
UBERON:0012242.def: The usually crescent-shaped opening of the urinary bladder into the urethra, placed at the anteroinferior angle (apex) of the urinary bladder trigone.
synonym: internal urethral orifice of urinary bladder

UBERON:0012243.name: nuptial pad
UBERON:0012243.def: Raised calluses of cornified epidermis used by the male to hold the female during mating.

UBERON:0012244.name: stratum intermedium of epidermis
UBERON:0012244.def: A temporary layer between old and new skin that is invalided by white blood cells[Kardong].

UBERON:0012245.name: silk
UBERON:0012245.def: A protein fiber composed mainly of fibroin and produced by certain arthropods[WP,modified].

UBERON:0012246.name: thyroid follicular lumen
UBERON:0012246.def: A follicular lumen is the closed cavity within a follicle of the thyroid gland. It is surrounded by follicular cells and filled with colloid, a concentrated solution of thyroglobulin.

UBERON:0012247.name: cervical gland
UBERON:0012247.def: Mucus-secreting glands in the mucosa of the uterine cervix.

UBERON:0012248.name: cervical mucosa
UBERON:0012248.def: Lining of the head of the uterus (cervix); contains large branched glands; does not undergo sloughing.

UBERON:0012249.name: ectocervix
