UBERON:0014682.name: tooth whorl
UBERON:0014682.def: A spirally arranged cluster of teeth.

UBERON:0014683.name: parasymphisial tooth whorl
UBERON:0014683.def: A tooth whorl located at or near the mandibular symphysis.

UBERON:0014684.name: Helicoprion tooth whorl
UBERON:0014684.def: A tooth whorl found in extinct holocephalids, in which the teeth in the center of the spiral are smallest and oldest, probably occupying the entire mandibular arch.

UBERON:0014685.name: pterygoid plexus
UBERON:0014685.def: The pterygoid plexus is a venous plexus of considerable size, and is situated between the temporalis muscle and lateral pterygoid muscle, and partly between the two pterygoid muscles.

UBERON:0014686.name: angular vein
UBERON:0014686.def: The angular vein formed by the junction of the frontal vein and supraorbital vein, runs obliquely downward, on the side of the root of the nose, to the level of the lower margin of the orbit, where it becomes the anterior facial vein. It receives the external nasal veins of the ala nasi, and communicates with the superior ophthalmic vein through the nasofrontal vein, thus establishing an important anastomosis between the anterior facial vein and the cavernous sinus.

UBERON:0014687.name: temporal sulcus
UBERON:0014687.def: Any of three grooves in the temporal lobe including the inferior, middle, and superior temporal sulci.

UBERON:0014689.name: middle temporal sulcus
UBERON:0014689.def: A groove or cleft that divides the outer surface of the temporal lobe running in the same direction but at a lower level to the superior temporal sulcus.

UBERON:0014690.name: left gastric vein
UBERON:0014690.def: The Left gastric vein (or coronary vein) carries blood low in Oxygen, tributaries derived from both surfaces of the stomach; it runs from right to left along the lesser curvature of the stomach, between the two layers of the lesser omentum, to the esophageal opening of the stomach, where it receives some esophageal veins. It then turns backward and passes from left to right behind the omental bursa and drains into the portal vein. Esophageal and paraesophageal varices are primarily supplied by the left gastric vein and typically drain into the azygos/hemiazygos venous system.

UBERON:0014691.name: right gastric vein
UBERON:0014691.def: The right gastric vein, also known as the pyloric vein, drains blood from the lesser curvature of the stomach into the hepatic portal vein. It is part of the portal circulation.

UBERON:0014692.name: superficial epigastric vein
UBERON:0014692.def: The superficial epigastric vein is a vein which travels with the superficial epigastric artery. It joins the accessory saphenous vein near the fossa ovalis.

UBERON:0014694.name: posterior auricular artery
UBERON:0014694.def: The posterior auricular artery is a small artery and arises from the external carotid artery, above the Digastric muscle and Stylohyoid muscle, opposite the apex of the styloid process. It ascends posteriorly beneath the parotid gland, along the styloid process of the temporal bone, between the cartilage of the ear and the mastoid process of the temporal bone along the lateral side of the head. The posterior auricular artery supplies blood to the scalp posterior to the auricle and to the auricle itself.

UBERON:0014695.name: deep auricular artery
UBERON:0014695.def: The deep auricular artery often arises in common with the anterior tympanic artery. It ascends in the substance of the parotid gland, behind the temporomandibular articulation, pierces the cartilaginous or bony wall of the external acoustic meatus, and supplies its cuticular lining and the outer surface of the tympanic membrane. It gives a branch to the temporomandibular joint.

UBERON:0014696.name: anterior choroidal artery
UBERON:0014696.def: The anterior choroidal artery originates from the internal carotid artery, though it also rarely arises from the middle cerebral artery.

UBERON:0014699.name: extraembryonic venous system
UBERON:0014699.def: A venous system that overlaps a umbilical cord and is part of a entire extraembryonic component.

UBERON:0014701.name: extraembryonic vascular system
UBERON:0014701.def: A vascular system that overlaps a umbilical cord and is part of a entire extraembryonic component.

UBERON:0014702.name: frontonasal process epithelium
UBERON:0014702.def: An epithelium that is part of a frontonasal prominence.

UBERON:0014703.name: anal membrane ectodermal component
UBERON:0014703.def: A unilaminar epithelium that develops_from a ectoderm and is part of a anal region.

UBERON:0014704.name: pleuroperitoneal canal lumen
UBERON:0014704.def: An anatomical space that is enclosed by a pleuroperitoneal canal.

UBERON:0014705.name: median lingual swelling epithelium
UBERON:0014705.def: An epithelium that is part of a median lingual swelling.

UBERON:0014707.name: hyoplastron
UBERON:0014707.def: A paired plastron element that is in the anterior part of the plastron, anterior to the hypoplastron, posterior to the epiplastron and adjacent to the median entoplastron.

UBERON:0014708.name: costal plate of carapace
UBERON:0014708.def: One of a series of plates on each side of the carapace, forming two rows between the peripheral plates and the median neural plates.

UBERON:0014709.name: carapace primordium
UBERON:0014709.def: A primordium that gives rise to a carapace.

UBERON:0014710.name: carapacial ridge
UBERON:0014710.def: A longitidunial ridge on the lateral aspect of the flank that appears in the late pharyngula stage of chelonians. It forms the leading edge of the laterally expanding carapacial primordium.

UBERON:0014711.name: carapacial ridge mesenchyme
UBERON:0014711.def: A mesenchyme that is part of a carapacial ridge.

UBERON:0014712.name: carapacial ridge ectoderm
UBERON:0014712.def: An epithelium that is part of a carapacial ridge.

UBERON:0014716.name: interlobular duct
UBERON:0014716.def: A duct that is located between lobules, within the thin connective tissue septa that separate lobules. All interlobular ducts are excretory.

UBERON:0014717.name: mucous acinus
UBERON:0014717.def: The secretory unit of a mucous gland. The acinar portion is composed of mucous secreting cells.

UBERON:0014719.name: intralobular duct
UBERON:0014719.def: A duct that is located within a lobule, with no more connective tissue intervening between ducts and secretory units (i.e., acini or tubules) than between adjacent secretory units. Intercalated and striated ducts are intralobular.

UBERON:0014720.name: interlobar duct
UBERON:0014720.def: A duct that is located between lobes, within conspicuous, thick connective tissue septa that separate lobes. All interlobar ducts are excretory.

UBERON:0014725.name: intercalated duct
UBERON:0014725.def: A small duct which drains individual secretory units. These are usually inconspicuous, lined by a simple epithelium consisting of low cuboidal cells.

UBERON:0014726.name: intercalated duct of pancreas
UBERON:0014726.def: An intercalated duct that is part of a pancreas.

UBERON:0014727.name: intercalated duct of salivary gland
UBERON:0014727.def: The tiny tubules with a very thin epithelial layer in the salivary glands running from the salivary acini into the striated duct.

UBERON:0014729.name: striated duct of salivary gland
UBERON:0014729.def: Gland duct which connects an intercalated duct to an interlobular duct in a salivary gland.

UBERON:0014730.name: osteon
UBERON:0014730.def: A circular structural unit of bone tissue. It consists of a central hole, the Haversian canal through which blood vessels run, surrounded by concentric rings, called lamellae.

UBERON:0014731.name: haversian canal
UBERON:0014731.def: Haversian canals are a series of tubes around narrow channels formed by lamellae. This is the region of bone called compact bone. Osteons are arranged in parallel to the long axis of the bone. The Haversian canals surround blood vessels and nerve cells throughout the bone and communicate with osteocytes in lacunae (spaces within the dense bone matrix that contain the living bone cells) through canaliculi. This unique arrangement is conducive to mineral salt deposits and storage which gives bone tissue its strength.

UBERON:0014732.name: compound cell cluster organ
UBERON:0014732.def: An anatomical structure consisting of multiple cell cluster organs, that has a largely bona-fide boundary and that does not contain portions of tissue.

UBERON:0014733.name: dorsal ventricular ridge of pallium
UBERON:0014733.def: A large expansion of the lateral wall of the telencephalon, located in the pallium. Found in reptiles and birds.

UBERON:0014734.name: allocortex
UBERON:0014734.def: One of two types of cerebral cortex defined on the basis of cytoarchitecture and fetal development. The other is neocortex. Allocortex does not pass through a prenatal phase of six-layered structure and has three or four layers in the mature brain ( Schiebler-1999 ). Allocortex has three subtypes: paleocortex, archicortex and periallocortex. This definition differs from that in some older sources, which excluded the olfactory bulb and the accessory olfactory bulb ( Carpenter-1983 ).

UBERON:0014735.name: paleocortex
UBERON:0014735.def: Part of the allocortex defined on the basis of cytoarchitecture. The other two are archicortex and periallocortex. It consists of very thin, primitive cortex with few clearly defined layers. It is distinguished ontogenetically by the fact that it does not develop through a cortical plate. It includes the olfactory bulb, accessory olfactory bulb, olfactory tubercle, septum, prepyriform area and periamygdalar area ( Stephan-1975 ). (adapted from Brain Info).

UBERON:0014736.name: periallocortex
UBERON:0014736.def: Agranular cortical structures located next to the allocortex.

UBERON:0014738.name: medial pallium
UBERON:0014738.def: Subdivision of pallium that is located is the medial position in vertebrates with an evaginated brain and in the distal position in vertebrates with an everted brain.
synonym: medial zone of dorsal telencephalic area

UBERON:0014740.name: dorsal pallium
UBERON:0014740.def: Subdivision of pallium that is located dorsally.
synonym: dorsal zone of dorsal telencephalic area

UBERON:0014741.name: lateral pallium
UBERON:0014741.def: Subdivision of pallium that is located laterally.
synonym: lateral zone of dorsal telencephalic area

UBERON:0014742.name: central nucleus of pallium
UBERON:0014742.def: A nucleus located in the dorsal pallium that is present in sharks, skates and rays and extends at some levels to the midline..

UBERON:0014751.name: P1 area of pallium (Myxiniformes)
UBERON:0014751.def: Most superficial of the areas of the pallium in the enlarged evaginated telencephalon of hagfishes.

UBERON:0014752.name: P2 area of pallium (Myxiniformes)
UBERON:0014752.def: Area directly deep to the P1 area of pallium in hagfishes.

UBERON:0014753.name: P3 area of pallium (Myxiniformes)
UBERON:0014753.def: Area directly deep to the P2 area of pallium in hagfishes.

UBERON:0014754.name: P4 area of pallium (Myxiniformes)
UBERON:0014754.def: Area directly deep to the P3 area of pallium in hagfishes.

UBERON:0014755.name: P5 area of pallium (Myxiniformes)
UBERON:0014755.def: Most deep of the areas of the pallium in the enlarged evaginated telencephalon of hagfishes.

UBERON:0014756.name: Wulst
UBERON:0014756.def: A nuclear complex in the avian telecephalon dorsal to the DVR. The Wulst has telencephalic circuitry similar to the DVR.

UBERON:0014757.name: hyperpallium apicale

UBERON:0014759.name: entopallium
UBERON:0014759.def: The major telecephalic thalamorecipient zone of the tectofugal visual system in Aves.

UBERON:0014760.name: gustatory nucleus
UBERON:0014760.def: The gustatory nucleus is the enlarged rostral portion of the solitary nucleus, which receives taste afferents from the glossopharyngeal nerve and the intermediate nerve ( Carpenter-1983 ).

UBERON:0014761.name: spinal trigeminal tract
UBERON:0014761.def: Brainstem tract formed by the central processes of first-order, trigeminal ganglion neurons that extends from the caudal medulla to the midpons. This tract conveys nociceptive and thermal information from the face to second-order neurons in the spinal nucleus of the trigeminal complex.
synonym: spinal tract of the trigeminal nerve
tract of descending root of trigeminal

UBERON:0014762.name: fused metapodial bones 2-4
UBERON:0014762.def: An element formed from the fusion of metapodium bones 2, 3 and 4 (i.e. either metatarsals 2-4 or metacarpals 3-4).

UBERON:0014763.name: fused metatarsal bones 2-4
UBERON:0014763.def: An element formed from the fusion of metapodium bones 2, 3 and 4 in the pedal autopod.

UBERON:0014764.name: anatomical line along groove
UBERON:0014764.def: Anatomical line that delineates a furrow or depression in an organ or tissue.

UBERON:0014765.name: crus of diaphragm
UBERON:0014765.def: The domain of the diaphragm that is located dorsally and attaches to the vertebrae and surrounds the esophagus and aorta.

UBERON:0014766.name: right crus of diaphragm
UBERON:0014766.def: A crus of diaphragm that is in_the_right_side_of a diaphragm.
synonym: right crus of lumbar part of diaphragm

UBERON:0014767.name: left crus of diaphragm
UBERON:0014767.def: A crus of diaphragm that is in_the_left_side_of a diaphragm.
synonym: left crus of lumbar part of diaphragm

UBERON:0014768.name: superior palpebral vein
UBERON:0014768.def: A blood vessel that drains from from an upper eyelid.

UBERON:0014769.name: palpebral vein
UBERON:0014769.def: A blood vessel that drains from from an eyelid.

UBERON:0014770.name: palpebral artery
UBERON:0014770.def: An artery that supplies blood to an eyelid.

UBERON:0014772.name: lateral palpebral artery
UBERON:0014772.def: The lateral palpebral arteries are small arteries which supply the eyelid.
synonym: lateral palpebral branch of ophthalmic artery

UBERON:0014773.name: medial palpebral artery
UBERON:0014773.def: The medial palpebral arteries (internal palpebral arteries) are arteries of the head. They are two in number, superior and inferior, arise from the ophthalmic, opposite the pulley of the Obliquus superior.
synonym: medial palpebral branch of ophthalmic artery

UBERON:0014775.name: prosomere
UBERON:0014775.def: A neuromere that is part of the presumptive forebrain.

UBERON:0014776.name: midbrain neuromere
UBERON:0014776.def: A neuromere that is part of the presumptive midbrain.

UBERON:0014777.name: spinal neuromere
UBERON:0014777.def: A neuromere that is part of the presumptive spinal cord.

UBERON:0014778.name: cell group
UBERON:0014778.def: A group of cells that may not be contained within macroscopic anatomical boundaries, e.g., A9 dopaminergic cell group; massa intercalata of the amygdala (CUMBO).

UBERON:0014779.name: liver reticuloendothelial system
UBERON:0014779.def: A reticuloendothelial system that is part of a liver.

UBERON:0014780.name: palatine aponeurosis
UBERON:0014780.def: Attached to the posterior border of the hard palate is a thin, firm fibrous lamella called the palatine aponeurosis, which supports the muscles and gives strength to the soft palate. It is thicker above than below, where it becomes very thin and difficult to define. Laterally it is continuous with the pharyngeal aponeurosis. It serves as the insertion for the Tensor veli palatini and Levator veli palatini, and the origin for the Musculus uvulae, Palatopharyngeus, and Palatoglossus. It provides support for the soft palate.

UBERON:0014783.name: cloacal muscle
UBERON:0014783.def: Any muscle organ that is part of a cloaca.

UBERON:0014784.name: transverse cloacal muscle
UBERON:0014784.def: A very prominent superficial muscle and with its almost transverse course it forms the boundary between the abdomen and the tail.

UBERON:0014785.name: levator cloacae
UBERON:0014785.def: A long narrow muscle arising from the underside of feather bulge of the lateral rectrices, inserting near the midline of the cloacal tubercle - phallus.

UBERON:0014786.name: extraembryonic umbilical vein
UBERON:0014786.def: Extraembryonic part of the vein passing through the umbilical cord to the fetus and returning the purified and nutrient blood from the placenta.

UBERON:0014787.name: left extraembryonic umbilical vein
UBERON:0014787.def: An extraembryonic umbilical vein that is in_the_left_side_of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0014788.name: right extraembryonic umbilical vein
UBERON:0014788.def: An extraembryonic umbilical vein that is in_the_right_side_of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0014790.name: lingual septum
UBERON:0014790.def: The lingual septum consists of a vertical layer of fibrous tissue, extending throughout the entire length of the median plane of the tongue, though not quite reaching the dorsum. It is thicker behind than in front, and occasionally contains a small fibrocartilage, about 6 mm. in length. It is well displayed by making a vertical section across the organ.

UBERON:0014791.name: musculature of forelimb stylopod
UBERON:0014791.def: Any collection of muscles that is part of the forelimb stylopod region [Automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0014792.name: musculature of pelvic complex
UBERON:0014792.def: Any collection of muscles that is part of a pelvic complex. The pelvic complex comprises the pelvic girdle and the associated limb or fin.

UBERON:0014793.name: musculature of pectoral complex
UBERON:0014793.def: Any collection of muscles that is part of a pectoral complex. The pectoral complex comprises the pectoral girdle and the associated limb or fin.
synonym: set of muscles of upper limb

UBERON:0014794.name: pectoral appendage muscle
UBERON:0014794.def: Any muscle organ that is part of a pectoral appendage (forelimb or pectoral fin).

UBERON:0014795.name: pelvic appendage muscle
UBERON:0014795.def: Any muscle organ that is part of a pelvic appendage (hindlimb or pelvic fin).

UBERON:0014796.name: common tendinous ring
UBERON:0014796.def: A ring of fibrous tissue surrounding the optic nerve at its entrance at the apex of the orbit.

UBERON:0014797.name: hypobranchial group muscle
UBERON:0014797.def: A jaw muscle that arises from trunk somites and is innervated by spinal nerves.

UBERON:0014798.name: clavotrapezius muscle
UBERON:0014798.def: The most anterior of the trapezius muscles, found in felids, it is also the largest. Its fibers run obliquely to the ventral surface. Its origin is the superior nuchal line and median dorsal line and its insertion is the clavicle. Its action is to draw the clavicle dorsally and towards the head.

UBERON:0014799.name: acromiotrapezius muscle
UBERON:0014799.def: Acromiotrapezius is the middle trapezius muscle. It covers the dorsal and lateral surfaces of the scapula. Its origin is the neural spines of the cervical vertebrae and its insertion is in the metacromion process and fascia of the clavotrapezius. Its action is to draw the scapula to the dorsal, and hold the two scapula together.

UBERON:0014800.name: spinotrapezius muscle
UBERON:0014800.def: Spinotrapezius, also called thoracic trapezius, is the most posterior of the three trapezius muscles. It is triangular shaped. Posterior to the acromiotrapezius and overlaps latissimus dorsi on the front. Its origin is the neural spines of the thoracic vertebrae and its insertion is the scapular fascia. Its action is to draw the scapula to the dorsal and caudal regions.

UBERON:0014801.name: nuchal line attachment site
UBERON:0014801.def: Any of the four curved lines on the external surface of the occipital bone that serves as an attachment site for a muscle.

UBERON:0014802.name: highest nuchal line attachment site
UBERON:0014802.def: Of the nuchal lines, the upper, often faintly marked, is named the highest nuchal line, but is sometimes referred to as the Mempin Line, and to it the galea aponeurotica is attached.

UBERON:0014803.name: superior nuchal line attachment site
UBERON:0014803.def: Of the nuchal lines, the one below the highest nuchal line is the superior nuchal line. To it is attached the Occipitalis muscle, the Splenius capitis muscle, the trapezius muscle, and the Sternocleidomastoid muscle.

UBERON:0014804.name: median nuchal line attachment site
UBERON:0014804.def: Of the nuchal lines, the one that runs from the external occipital protuberance a ridge or crest is the median nuchal line, often faintly marked, descends to the foramen magnum, and affords attachment to the ligamentum nuchae.

UBERON:0014805.name: inferior nuchal line attachment site
UBERON:0014805.def: Of the nuchal lines, the one running from the middle of the median line is the inferior nuchal line. Attached are the Obliquus capitis superior muscle, Rectus capitis posterior major muscle, and Rectus capitis posterior minor muscle.

UBERON:0014837.name: pectoantebrachialis
UBERON:0014837.def: The most superficial of pectoral muscles, found in some mammals.

UBERON:0014838.name: xiphihumeralis
UBERON:0014838.def: The most deep of pectoral muscles, found in some mammals.

UBERON:0014840.name: supracoracoideus muscle
UBERON:0014840.def: A muscle that is important to the body support of limbed reptiles, underlies the front part of the pectoral muscle, arises from the coracoid, and passes to the underpart of the humerus.

UBERON:0014842.name: puboischiofemoralis muscle
UBERON:0014842.def: A dorsal muscle of lower tetrapods.

UBERON:0014847.name: vastus intermedius
UBERON:0014847.def: The Vastus intermedius (Cruraeus) arises from the front and lateral surfaces of the body of the femur in its upper two-thirds, sitting under Rectus Femoris and from the lower part of the lateral intermuscular septum. Its fibers end in a superficial aponeurosis, which forms the deep part of the Quadriceps femoris tendon. The Vastus medialis and Vastus intermedius appear to be inseparably united, but when the Rectus femoris has been reflected a narrow interval will be observed extending upward from the medial border of the patella between the two muscles, and the separation may be continued as far as the lower part of the intertrochanteric line, where, however, the two muscles are frequently continuous.

UBERON:0014848.name: tendon of quadriceps femoris
synonym: common tendon of quadriceps femoris muscle complex

UBERON:0014849.name: hemotrichorial placental membrane
UBERON:0014849.def: A placental membrane that consists of three trophoblast cell layers.

UBERON:0014850.name: hemomonochorial placental membrane
UBERON:0014850.def: A placental membrane that consists of a single layer of syncytiotrophoblast at term.

UBERON:0014851.name: chorda tendinea of left ventricle
UBERON:0014851.def: Chorda tendinea which is attached to the leaflet of mitral valve and is continuous with the endocardium of papillary muscle of left ventricle.

UBERON:0014852.name: chorda tendinea of right ventricle
UBERON:0014852.def: Chorda tendinea which is attached to the leaflet of tricuspid valve and is continuous with the endocardium of papillary muscle of right ventricle.

UBERON:0014853.name: commissural leaflet of mitral valve
UBERON:0014853.def: Leaflet of mitral valve which is attached to the commissural chorda tendinea of left ventricle.

UBERON:0014854.name: anterior leaflet of mitral valve
UBERON:0014854.def: Leaflet of mitral valve which is attached to the anterior head of the posterior papillary muscle of left ventricle through the chorda tendinea of the left ventricle.
synonym: aortic leaflet of the left-sided mitral valve

UBERON:0014855.name: posterior leaflet of mitral valve
UBERON:0014855.def: Leaflet of mitral valve which is attached to the posterior head of the lateral papillary muscle of left ventricle through the chorda tendinea of the left ventricle.

UBERON:0014856.name: cysticercus stage
UBERON:0014856.def: The larval form of any of the Taenia tapeworms.

UBERON:0014857.name: zoea stage
UBERON:0014857.def: A crustacean larval stage characterised by the use of the thoracic appendages for swimming.

UBERON:0014858.name: crustacean post-larval stage
UBERON:0014858.def: A crustacean larval stage characterised by the use of abdominal appendages (pleopods) for propulsion.

UBERON:0014859.name: megalopa stage
UBERON:0014859.def: The crustacean post-larval stage of a crab.

UBERON:0014860.name: copepodite stage
UBERON:0014860.def: A development stage of copepods which follows the nauplius stage. It is segmented with more than 3 pairs of appendages.

UBERON:0014861.name: glaucothoe stage
UBERON:0014861.def: A developmental stage in a hermit crab that has completed the swimming larval stages.

UBERON:0014862.name: trochophore stage
UBERON:0014862.def: A larval stage of a trochozoan in which the organism is in free-swimming planktonic form with several bands of cilia[WP,modified].

UBERON:0014863.name: veliger stage
UBERON:0014863.def: The characteristic larval stage of the gastropod, bivalve and scaphopod taxonomic classes. It is produced following either the embryonic or trochophore larval stage of development.

UBERON:0014864.name: caterpillar stage
UBERON:0014864.def: The larval stage of members of the order Lepidoptera.

UBERON:0014870.name: inferior orbital fissure
UBERON:0014870.def: The orbital fissure that is situated inferiorly between the greater wing of the sphenoid bone and the maxilla.

UBERON:0014871.def: A distal epiphysis that is part of a distal phalanx of pedal digit 1.

UBERON:0014888.name: iliotibialis muscle
UBERON:0014888.def: A muscle in amphibians that connects originates in the ilium and inserts in the tibia.

UBERON:0014889.name: left hemisphere of cerebellum
UBERON:0014889.def: A cerebellar hemisphere that is in_the_left_side_of a cerebellum.

UBERON:0014890.name: right hemisphere of cerebellum
UBERON:0014890.def: A cerebellar hemisphere that is in_the_right_side_of a cerebellum.

UBERON:0014891.name: brainstem white matter
UBERON:0014891.def: White matter that is part of a brainstem [Automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0014892.name: skeletal muscle organ, vertebrate
UBERON:0014892.def: A muscle organ that consists of skeletal muscle tissue ensheathed in epimysium, that develops from myotome and that is innervated by some somatic motor neuron. Skeletal muscles are typically attached (via a tendon) to a bone but there are exceptions (e.g. intrinsic tongue muscles).

UBERON:0014895.name: somatic muscle, invertebrate
UBERON:0014895.def: A muscle structure of invertebrates whose origin and insertion sites are in basal side of the epidermis or structures derived from it. The simplest somatic muscles consist of a single cell and associated extracellular structures.

UBERON:0014896.name: transversely striated somatic muscle
UBERON:0014896.def: A somatic muscle that consists of one or more somatic muscle myotubes and any associated extracellular structures.

UBERON:0014897.name: obliquely striated somatic muscle
UBERON:0014897.def: A somatic muscle that consists of one or more obliquely striated muscle cells and any associated extracellular structures.

UBERON:0014898.name: lamina terminalis of ischium
UBERON:0014898.def: In those cases in which the interilial region is broadly expanded and the pubis is extremely reduced, the anterior margin of the ischium forms an expanded area.

UBERON:0014899.name: anterolateral ligament of knee
UBERON:0014899.def: A ligament on the lateral aspect of the human knee, anterior to the fibular collateral ligament.
synonym: capsulo-osseous layer of the iliotibial band

UBERON:0014903.name: primordial vasculature
UBERON:0014903.def: A portion of tissue that will develop into vasculature.

UBERON:0014904.name: intersegmental pulmonary vein
UBERON:0014904.def: A vein receiving blood from adjacent bronchopulmonary segments; it emerges from the inferior margin of a segment to become a tributary of a branch of a pulmonary vein.

UBERON:0014907.name: intersomitic vessel
UBERON:0014907.def: One of the primary blood vessel sprouts that originate from the dorsal aorta and posterior cardinal vein and align dorsoventrally at the myotomal boundaries between somites.

UBERON:0014908.name: cerebellopontine angle
UBERON:0014908.def: Junction between the cerebellum and the pons.

UBERON:0014913.name: ventral pallium
UBERON:0014913.def: The pallial region located next to the pallium-subpallium boundary.

UBERON:0014914.name: haemolymphatic fluid-testis barrier
UBERON:0014914.def: A barrier between the blood or haemolymphatic fluid and the testes.

UBERON:0014915.name: genu of facial nerve
UBERON:0014915.def: The bend in the facial nerve at the lateral end of the internal acoustic meatus.
synonym: internal genu of the facial nerve

UBERON:0014916.name: velar vocal fold
UBERON:0014916.def: On of a pair of medial protrusions of the intra-pharyngeal ostium (an oval opening within the soft palate that connects the oral and nasal portions of the pharynx), used in vocalization in Koalas.

UBERON:0014917.name: pouch sphincter
UBERON:0014917.def: A sphincter muscle that is part of a pouch. The pouch sphincter serves to keep the young from falling out.

UBERON:0014918.name: retrosplenial granular cortex
synonym: ventral part of the retrosplenial area

UBERON:0014930.name: perivascular space
UBERON:0014930.def: The space between a blood vessel and the pia mater.

UBERON:0014931.name: periungual skin
UBERON:0014931.def: A zone of skin adjacent to a nail or claw.

UBERON:0014935.name: cerebral cortex marginal layer
UBERON:0014935.def: Developing superficial cortical layer located just under the pia matter, develops from the marginal layer of the neural tube and becomes cortical layer I.

UBERON:0014951.name: proisocortex
UBERON:0014951.def: The part of the neocortex hich mainly consists of parts of cingulate, parahippocampal and temporopolar cortice. As distinct from isocortex (typical neocortex) which contains other regions.

UBERON:0015001.name: radius endochondral element
UBERON:0015001.def: The major preaxial endrochondral skeletal element in the anterior zeugopod.

UBERON:0015002.name: radius-ulna endochondral element
UBERON:0015002.def: A radius-ulna bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015003.name: ulna endochondral element
UBERON:0015003.def: Major postaxial endrochondral skeletal element in the anterior zeugopod.

UBERON:0015004.name: tibia endochondral element
UBERON:0015004.def: The major preaxial endochondral element in the posterior zeugopod[Phenoscape].

UBERON:0015007.name: cervical vertebra endochondral element
UBERON:0015007.def: A vertebral endochondral element in the cervical region of the vertebral column.

UBERON:0015008.name: thoracic vertebra endochondral element
UBERON:0015008.def: A vertebral endochondral element in the thoracic region of the vertebral column.

UBERON:0015009.name: lumbar vertebra endochondral element
UBERON:0015009.def: A lumbar vertebra bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015010.name: sacral vertebra endochondral element
UBERON:0015010.def: A vertebra endochondral element that is part of the sacral region of the vertebral column.

UBERON:0015011.name: tibiotarsus endochondral element
UBERON:0015011.def: A tibiotarsus bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015012.name: tarsometatarsus endochondral element
UBERON:0015012.def: A tarsometatarsus bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015013.name: fibula endochondral element
UBERON:0015013.def: The major postaxial endochondral element in the posterior zeugopod[Phenoscape].

UBERON:0015014.name: calcaneum endochondral element
UBERON:0015014.def: A calcaneum bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015015.name: supraoccipital endochondral element
UBERON:0015015.def: A supraoccipital bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015016.name: stapes endochondral element
UBERON:0015016.def: A stapes bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015017.name: incus endochondral element
UBERON:0015017.def: An incus bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015018.name: malleus endochondral element
UBERON:0015018.def: A malleus bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015019.name: rib endochondral element
UBERON:0015019.def: A rib bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015021.name: forelimb endochondral element
UBERON:0015021.def: A forelimb bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015022.name: hindlimb endochondral element
UBERON:0015022.def: A hindlimb bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015023.name: phalanx endochondral element
UBERON:0015023.def: A phalanx bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015024.name: manual digit phalanx endochondral element
UBERON:0015024.def: A manual digit phalanx bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015025.name: manual digit 1 phalanx endochondral element
UBERON:0015025.def: A manual digit 1 phalanx bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.
synonym: manual digit I phalanx endochondral element

UBERON:0015026.name: manual digit 2 phalanx endochondral element
UBERON:0015026.def: A manual digit 2 phalanx bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.
synonym: manual digit II phalanx endochondral element

UBERON:0015027.name: manual digit 3 phalanx endochondral element
UBERON:0015027.def: A manual digit 3 phalanx bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.
synonym: manual digit III phalanx endochondral element

UBERON:0015028.name: manual digit 4 phalanx endochondral element
UBERON:0015028.def: A manual digit 4 phalanx bone or its cartilage or pre-cartilage precursor.

UBERON:0015117.name: lamina terminalis of cerebral hemisphere
UBERON:0015117.def: The remnant of the lamina terminalis in the developed brain.

UBERON:0015118.name: obsolete neocortical column
UBERON:0015118.def: A group of neurons in the cortex of the brain which can be successively penetrated by a probe inserted perpendicularly to the cortical surface, and which have nearly identical receptive fields.

UBERON:0015119.name: scolex
UBERON:0015119.def: The anterior organ of a tapeworm used for attachment to the host intestine.

UBERON:0015120.def: An outer canthus that is in_the_right_side_of a head.

UBERON:0015121.def: An outer canthus that is in_the_left_side_of a head.

UBERON:0015122.name: anatomical line between outer canthi
UBERON:0015122.def: An anatomical line of the face that connects the two outer (lateral) canthi of the eye. The length of this line is known as the outer canthal distance.

UBERON:0015125.name: anterior internodal tract
UBERON:0015125.def: Internodal tract which consists of the atrial and atrial septal branches.

UBERON:0015129.name: epicardial fat
UBERON:0015129.def: Visceral intrapericardial fat contiguous with the myocardial surface.

UBERON:0015130.name: connective tissue of prostate gland
UBERON:0015130.def: A portion of connective tissue that is part of a prostate gland.

UBERON:0015131.name: subepithelial connective tissue of prostatic gland

UBERON:0015139.name: infundibulum of gallbladder
UBERON:0015139.def: The tapering portion of the gall bladder that narrows to form the neck and cystic duct.

UBERON:0015142.name: falciform fat
UBERON:0015142.def: A large fat pad that is located at the base of the abdominal wall, in the falciform ligament of the liver.

UBERON:0015143.name: mesenteric fat pad
UBERON:0015143.def: Encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the mesentery.

UBERON:0015144.def: A strand of hair that is part of a autopod region.

UBERON:0015145.name: pes hair
UBERON:0015145.def: A strand of hair that is part of a pes.

UBERON:0015146.name: manus hair
UBERON:0015146.def: A strand of hair that is part of a manus.

UBERON:0015147.name: pinna hair
UBERON:0015147.def: A strand of hair that is part of a pinna.

UBERON:0015148.name: tail hair
UBERON:0015148.def: A strand of hair that is part of a tail.

UBERON:0015149.name: ventral hair
UBERON:0015149.def: A strand of hair that is part of a ventrum.

UBERON:0015150.name: dorsal hair
UBERON:0015150.def: A strand of hair that is part of a dorsum.

UBERON:0015151.name: Harderian gland duct
UBERON:0015151.def: A duct that is part of a Harderian gland. opens into the conjunctival sac at the base of the nictitating membrane.

UBERON:0015152.name: gland of ocular region
UBERON:0015152.def: A gland that is typically found in or near the orbital region, in or around either the medial or lateral canthi, and is typically associated with secretions onto the eyeball or associated ducts. Includes the Harderian, nictitans and lacrimal glands.

UBERON:0015153.name: medial gland of ocular region
UBERON:0015153.def: A gland that is located in the ocular region, nearer the inner canthi. Typically associated with or part of the nictitating membrane, when present.

UBERON:0015154.name: lateral gland of orbital region
UBERON:0015154.def: A gland that is located in or around the ocular region, nearer the outer canthi.

UBERON:0015155.name: conjunctival space
UBERON:0015155.def: An anatomical space that is enclosed by a conjunctiva.

UBERON:0015156.name: terminal branch of ophthalmic artery
UBERON:0015156.def: The two terminal branches of the ophthalmic artery in humans are the dorsal nasal artery and the supratrochlear artery.

UBERON:0015157.name: zygomatico-orbital artery
UBERON:0015157.def: The middle temporal artery occasionally gives off a zygomatico-orbital branch, which runs along the upper border of the zygomatic arch, between the two layers of the temporal fascia, to the lateral angle of the orbit. This branch, which may arise directly from the superficial temporal artery, supplies the Orbicularis oculi, and anastomoses with the lacrimal and palpebral branches of the ophthalmic artery.

UBERON:0015158.name: ophthalmotemporal branch of external ophthalmic artery

UBERON:0015160.name: supraorbital artery
UBERON:0015160.def: The supraorbital artery is an artery of the head. It springs from the ophthalmic artery as that vessel is crossing over to the medial side of the optic nerve.
synonym: supraorbital branch of external ophthalmic artery

UBERON:0015161.name: inferior branch of oculomotor nerve
UBERON:0015161.def: The inferior branch of the oculomotor nerve or the inferior division, the larger, divides into three branches. One passes beneath the optic nerve to the medial rectus. Another, to the inferior rectus. The third and longest runs forward between the inferior recti and lateralis to the inferior oblique. From the last a short thick branch is given off to the lower part of the ciliary ganglion, and forms its short root. All these branches enter the muscles on their ocular surfaces, with the exception of the nerve to the inferior oblique, which enters the muscle at its posterior border.

UBERON:0015162.name: superior branch of oculomotor nerve
UBERON:0015162.def: The superior branch of the oculomotor nerve or the superior division, the smaller, passes medialward over the optic nerve. It supplies the Superior rectus and Levator palpebrae superioris.

UBERON:0015165.name: multi-unit eye
UBERON:0015165.def: An eye consisting of multiple light-sensing organs.

UBERON:0015169.name: tapetum
UBERON:0015169.def: Light reflecting layer found in a variety of different types of eye.

UBERON:0015170.name: nauplius eye
UBERON:0015170.def: An eye that consists of a cluster of three or four median eyes that form a single structural unit but are separated from one another by pigment layers.

UBERON:0015171.name: uterine spiral artery
UBERON:0015171.def: A corkscrew-like artery in premenstrual or progestational endometrium; uterine spiral arteries play a vital role in supplying nutrients to the placenta and fetus, and are thus remodeled into highly dilated inelastic vessels by the action of invading trophoblast (physiological change).

UBERON:0015172.name: endometrial blood vessel
UBERON:0015172.def: A blood vessel that is part of a endometrium.

UBERON:0015173.name: helicine branch of uterine artery
UBERON:0015173.def: The helicine branches of uterine artery (or helicine arterioles, or spiral arteries) are small arteries which temporarily supply the endometrium of the uterus during the luteal phase of the menstrual cycle. In histology, identifying the presence of these arteries is one of the most useful techniques in identifying the phase of the cycle.

UBERON:0015174.name: helicine artery of penis
UBERON:0015174.def: The helicine arteries of penis are arteries in the penis. They are found in the corpora cavernosa penis. They are involved in the process of erection.

UBERON:0015177.name: helicine artery
UBERON:0015177.def: Either the helicine artery of the penis or the helicine artery of the uterus.

UBERON:0015178.name: somite border
UBERON:0015178.def: A region of somite adjacent to presomitic mesoderm.

UBERON:0015179.name: somite boundary epithelium
UBERON:0015179.def: Epithelium located in the intersomitic region.

UBERON:0015180.name: neck of talus
UBERON:0015180.def: The neck of talus is directed forward and medialward, and comprises the constricted portion of the bone between the body and the oval head. Its upper and medial surfaces are rough, for the attachment of ligaments; its lateral surface is concave and is continuous below with the deep groove for the interosseous talocalcaneal ligament.

UBERON:0015181.name: neck of tooth
UBERON:0015181.def: The slightly constricted part of a tooth, between the crown and the root.

UBERON:0015189.name: perineural vascular plexus
UBERON:0015189.def: The capillary bed that initially surrounds the relative avascular brain and spinal cord; the perineural vascular plexus (PNVP) is the precursor to the blood brain barrier formed by angioblasts which migrate away from somites and is recruited to surround the neural tube in response to VEGF; vascularization of the brain and spinal cord occurs via angiogenesis as sprouting vessels from the PNVP invade the neuroepithelium and grow inward toward the ventricular lumen[MP].

UBERON:0015202.name: lymph heart
UBERON:0015202.def: A circulatory organ that is reponsible for pumping lymph throughout the body.

UBERON:0015203.name: non-connected functional system
UBERON:0015203.def: An anatomical group whose component structures share a common function.

UBERON:0015204.name: glandular system
UBERON:0015204.def: A non-connected functional system that is composed primarily of a gland.

UBERON:0015212.name: lateral structure
UBERON:0015212.def: Any structure that is placed on one side of the left-right axis of a bilaterian.

UBERON:0015213.name: barnacle cement gland
UBERON:0015213.def: Typical barnacles, common name of the sedentary crustacean marine animals constituting the subclass Cirripedia, attach to the substrate by means of an exceedingly adhesive cement, produced by a cement gland, and secrete a shell, or carapace, of calcareous (limestone) plates, around themselves.

UBERON:0015214.name: arcuate ligament
UBERON:0015214.def: A ligament that is part of a diaphragm.

UBERON:0015215.name: median arcuate ligament
UBERON:0015215.def: The median arcuate ligament is a ligament under the diaphragm that connects the right and left crura of diaphragm.

UBERON:0015219.name: middle nasal meatus
UBERON:0015219.def: The middle meatus is a nasal opening or canal situated between the middle and inferior conchae, and extends from the anterior to the posterior end of the latter. The lateral wall of this meatus can be satisfactorily studied only after the removal of the middle concha. On it is a curved fissure, the hiatus semilunaris, limited below by the edge of the uncinate process of the ethmoid and above by an elevation named the bulla ethmoidalis; the middle ethmoidal cells are contained within this bulla and open on or near to it. Through the hiatus semilunaris the meatus communicates with a curved passage termed the infundibulum, which communicates in front with the anterior ethmoidal cells and in rather more than fifty percent of skulls is continued upward as the frontonasal duct into the frontal air-sinus; when this continuity fails, the frontonasal duct opens directly into the anterior part of the meatus. Below the bulla ethmoidalis and hidden by the uncinate process of the ethmoid is the opening of the maxillary sinus (ostium maxillare); an accessory opening is frequently present above the posterior part of the inferior nasal concha.

UBERON:0015220.name: inferior nasal meatus
UBERON:0015220.def: The inferior meatus, the largest of the three meatuses of the nose, is the space between the inferior concha and the floor of the nasal cavity. It extends almost the entire length of the lateral wall of the nose, is broader in front than behind, and presents anteriorly the lower orifice of the nasolacrimal canal.

UBERON:0015222.name: ventral nasal meatus
UBERON:0015222.def: The ventral nasal meatus is found between the ventral nasal concha and the dorsal surface of the hard palate.It connects the nasal vestibule with the nasopharynx. Rostrally it is narrow at the nasal vestibule and widens caudally towards the nasopharyngeal meatus. The ventral nasal meatus is the main passage for air. Apart from olfaction, the nasal cavity functions to warm the inhaled air as it passes through the meatuses over the vascular beds of the mucosa. The air is humidified by the vaporization of tears and serous nasal secretion. The air is cleaned throughout the scattered mucous glands. These glands secrete mucous through the nasal cavity and the mucous serves to trap the large particles that come into contact with it. Clinically in the horse the ventral nasal meatus is the main passage through which a stomach tube can be passed to the pharynx and oesophagus and then to the stomach. This kind of a tube is commonly used when drenching a horse for colic, as well as having many other veterinary applications. The tube has to pass through the ventral nasal meatus to the nasopharyngeal meatus and the caudal nares to reach the pharynx and oesophagus. If the tube is accidentally passed into the dorsal or middle nasal meatuses it would pass to the ethmotubinates and cause massive haemorrhage.

UBERON:0015223.name: dorsal nasal meatus
UBERON:0015223.def: The dosal nasal meatus is a narrow passage bounded dorsally by the roof of the nasal cavity and ventrally by the dorsal concha. It terminates caudally at the junction of the inner plate of the frontal bone with the cribiform plate and lateral mass of the ethmoid bone. It is the shortest and shallowest of the three meatuses.

UBERON:0015224.name: interventricular foramen intermedium
UBERON:0015224.def: An anatomical conduit that is part of a ventricular septum intermedium.

UBERON:0015225.name: atrial foramen intermedium
UBERON:0015225.def: An anatomical conduit that is part of a atrial septum intermedium.

UBERON:0015227.name: peristaltic circulatory vessel
UBERON:0015227.def: A vessel down which passes a wave of muscular contraction, that forces the flow of haemolymphatic fluid.

UBERON:0015228.name: circulatory organ
UBERON:0015228.def: A hollow, muscular organ, which, by contracting rhythmically, contributes to the circulation of lymph, blood or analogs. Examples: a chambered vertebrate heart; the tubular peristaltic heart of ascidians; the dorsal vessel of an insect; the lymoh heart of a reptile.

UBERON:0015229.name: accessory circulatory organ
UBERON:0015229.def: A circulatory organ that is not responsible for primary circulation.

UBERON:0015230.name: dorsal vessel heart
UBERON:0015230.def: The caudal, pulsatile region of the dorsal vessel of the arthropod circulatory system.

UBERON:0015231.name: circulatory system dorsal vessel
UBERON:0015231.def: A tube that runs longitudinally through the thorax and abdomen, along the inside of the dorsal body wall and that forms the major structural component of the open circulatory system of arthropods.

UBERON:0015232.name: nematode pharynx
UBERON:0015232.def: The feeding organ, a neuro-muscular pump in the head of the animal, used to ingest food, bacteria suspended in liquid, filter them out, grind them up and transport posteriorly into the instestine.

UBERON:0015233.name: nucleus of dorsal thalamus
UBERON:0015233.def: A nucleus of brain that is part of a dorsal thalamus.

UBERON:0015234.name: nucleus of ventral thalamus
UBERON:0015234.def: A nucleus of brain that is part of a ventral thalamus.

UBERON:0015238.name: pineal complex
UBERON:0015238.def: A cluster in the epithalamus that consists of the pineal body and any associated structures, such as the parapineal gland or the parietal organ. The complex is poorly developed in mammals.

UBERON:0015243.name: lower part of vagina
UBERON:0015243.def: The lower third of the vagina.

UBERON:0015244.name: accessory olfactory bulb granule cell layer

UBERON:0015245.name: septal olfactory organ
UBERON:0015245.def: A spatially segregated cluster of sensory cells in the nasal cavity.

UBERON:0015246.name: septal organ of Masera
UBERON:0015246.def: A small island of olfactory neuroepithelium lying bilaterally at the ventral base of the nasal septum near the entrance of the nasopharynx.

UBERON:0015247.name: bifurcation of trachea
UBERON:0015247.def: This is the point at which the trachea splits into two (left and right) principal bronchi. It is located in the region of the fourth to sixth intercostal space, though this varies with species and with respiratory phase. This position closely associates the bifurcation with the heart base. The thickened median crest initiating the bifurcation is called the tracheal carina .

UBERON:0015249.name: digit skin
UBERON:0015249.def: A zone of skin that is part of a digit [Automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0015252.name: coat hair follicle
UBERON:0015252.def: A hair follicle that is part of a coat of hair.

UBERON:0015280.name: pancreas left lobe
UBERON:0015280.def: A pancreatic lobule that is in_the_left_side_of a exocrine pancreas.

UBERON:0015281.name: pancreas right lobe
UBERON:0015281.def: A pancreatic lobule that is in_the_right_side_of a exocrine pancreas.

UBERON:0015329.name: respiratory system basement membrane
UBERON:0015329.def: A basement membrane of epithelium that is part of a respiratory system.

UBERON:0015350.name: saphenous artery
UBERON:0015350.def: A branch of the descending genicular artery, the last branch (most distal) of the femoral, the saphenous is also variable. It usually lies between the sartorius and the garcilis muscles and supplies their distal ends. The artery accompanies the saphenous nerve. It usually supplies the skin on the medial and proximal part of the leg. The artery may continue to join, in varying degrees, the dorsalis pedis artery and plantaris pedis arteries.

UBERON:0015418.name: urethra mesenchymal layer
UBERON:0015418.def: A mesenchyme that is part of a urethra.

UBERON:0015420.name: ureteral valve
UBERON:0015420.def: A valve that is part of a ureter.

UBERON:0015423.name: hilar portion of hepatic duct
UBERON:0015423.def: The segment of either hepatic duct located in the hilum of the liver.

UBERON:0015430.name: levator auris longus muscle
UBERON:0015430.def: Muscle organ located on the dorsal surface of the head innervated by the facial nerve.

UBERON:0015432.name: accessory olfactory bulb mitral cell layer

UBERON:0015433.name: blood vessel external elastic membrane
UBERON:0015433.def: A thin layer of fibrous tissue capable of stretching and contracting. It is part of the tunica media of the blood vessels.

UBERON:0015445.name: anterior lingual gland duct
UBERON:0015445.def: A duct that is part of a anterior lingual gland.

UBERON:0015453.name: subcutaneous lymph node
UBERON:0015453.def: A lymph node that is part of a hypodermis.

UBERON:0015454.name: pancreatic fat pad
UBERON:0015454.def: A fat pad that is part of a pancreas.

UBERON:0015458.name: mediastinal fat pad
UBERON:0015458.def: A fat pad that is part of a mediastinum.

UBERON:0015469.name: splenic lymph node
UBERON:0015469.def: The splenic lymph nodes (or pancreaticolienal) accompany the lienal (splenic) artery, and are situated in relation to the posterior surface and upper border of the pancreas; one or two members of this group are found in the gastrolienal ligament. Their afferents are derived from the stomach, spleen, and pancreas, their efferents join the celiac group of preaortic glands.

UBERON:0015472.name: tracheobronchial lymph node
UBERON:0015472.def: A lymph node located near the bifurcation of the trachea.

UBERON:0015474.name: axilla skin
UBERON:0015474.def: A zone of skin that is part of a axilla.

UBERON:0015476.name: nose skin
UBERON:0015476.def: A zone of skin that is part of a external nose.

UBERON:0015477.name: axillary fat pad
UBERON:0015477.def: A fat pad that is part of a axilla.

UBERON:0015479.name: scrotum skin
UBERON:0015479.def: A zone of skin that is part of a scrotum.

UBERON:0015480.name: proper hepatic artery
UBERON:0015480.def: The hepatic artery proper (also proper hepatic artery), arises from the common hepatic artery and runs alongside the portal vein and the common bile duct to form the portal triad. The hepatic artery proper gives off a small supraduodenal artery to the duodenal bulb. Then the right gastric artery comes off and runs to the left along the lesser curvature of the stomach to meet the left gastric artery, which is a branch of the celiac trunk. It subsequently gives off the cystic artery, which feeds the gallbladder, before bifurcating into the right and left hepatic arteries. Of note, the right and left hepatic arteries may demonstrate variant anatomy. A replaced right hepatic artery may arise from the superior mesenteric artery (SMA) and a replaced left hepatic artery may arise from the left gastric artery.

UBERON:0015481.name: left hepatic artery
UBERON:0015481.def: A hepatic artery that is part of a left lobe of liver.
synonym: left part of hepatic artery proper

UBERON:0015482.name: right hepatic artery
UBERON:0015482.def: A hepatic artery that is part of a right lobe of liver.
synonym: right branch of hepatic artery proper
right part of hepatic artery proper

UBERON:0015484.name: epidermis of metapodial pad
UBERON:0015484.def: A zone of skin that is part of a metapodial pad.

UBERON:0015485.name: choledocho-duodenal junction
UBERON:0015485.def: Hat part of the duodenal wall traversed by the ductus choledochus, ductus pancreaticus, and ampulla.

UBERON:0015488.name: sural nerve
UBERON:0015488.def: The sural nerve (short saphenous nerve), formed by the junction of the medial sural cutaneous with the peroneal anastomotic branch of the lateral sural cutaneous nerve, passes downward near the lateral margin of the tendo calcaneus, lying close to the small saphenous vein, to the interval between the lateral malleolus and the calcaneus. It runs forward below the lateral malleolus, and is continued as the lateral dorsal cutaneous nerve along the lateral side of the foot and little toe (via a dorsal digital nerve), communicating on the dorsum of the foot with the intermediate dorsal cutaneous nerve, a branch of the superficial peroneal. In the leg, its branches communicate with those of the posterior femoral cutaneous.

UBERON:0015510.name: body of corpus callosum
UBERON:0015510.def: An area within the corpus callosum, a white matter structure within the cleft that separates the left and right cerebral hemispheres in the mammalian brain, between the genu (anterior region) and the splenium (posterior region).

UBERON:0015593.name: frontal gyrus
UBERON:0015593.def: A gyrus that is part of a frontal cortex.

UBERON:0015599.name: genu of corpus callosum
UBERON:0015599.def: Part of corpus callosum comprising the 'kneelike' anterior bend (adapted from Nolte, The Human Brain, 6th ed., 2009 pg 664).

UBERON:0015703.name: rostrum of corpus callosum
UBERON:0015703.def: The part of the corpus callosum that projects posteriorly and inferiorly from the anteriormost genu.

UBERON:0015704.name: sagittal sinus
UBERON:0015704.def: Either the inferior or superior sagittal sinus.

UBERON:0015708.name: splenium of the corpus callosum
UBERON:0015708.def: The posterior end of the corpus callosum. It overlaps the tela chorioidea of the third ventricle and the mid-brain, and ends in a thick, convex, free border.

UBERON:0015716.name: anal canal epithelium
UBERON:0015716.def: An epithelium that is part of a anal canal.

UBERON:0015717.name: smooth muscle tissue layer of ejaculatory duct
UBERON:0015717.def: A smooth muscle tissue that is part of a ejaculatory duct.

UBERON:0015751.name: inferior tarsal muscle
UBERON:0015751.def: A smooth muscle tissue that is part of a inferior eyelid tarsus.

UBERON:0015760.name: mixed stratified cuboidal and columnar epithelium
UBERON:0015760.def: Multilaminar epithelium, which consists of more than one layer of cuboidal and columnar cells, only one layer of which is in contact with a basement membrane. Examples: epithelium of wall of pancreatic duct, epithelium of wall of duct of salivary gland.

UBERON:0015764.name: dense regular elastic tissue
UBERON:0015764.def: Regular connective tissue, which consists of fibroblasts and of intercellular matrix, which contains elastic fiber bundles oriented predominantly in definable directions.

UBERON:0015766.name: epithelium of duct of salivary gland
UBERON:0015766.def: An epithelium that is part of a duct of salivary gland.

UBERON:0015783.name: smooth muscle layer in fatty layer of subcutaneous tissue
UBERON:0015783.def: A smooth muscle tissue that is part of a hypodermis.
synonym: muscle layer in fatty layer of subcutaneous tissue
stratum musculosum panniculi adiposi telae subcutaneae

UBERON:0015784.name: duct of olfactory gland
UBERON:0015784.def: A duct that is part of a olfactory gland.

UBERON:0015785.name: acinus of olfactory gland
UBERON:0015785.def: An acinus that is part of a olfactory gland.

UBERON:0015786.name: respiratory segment of nasal mucosa
UBERON:0015786.def: The portion of the nasal mucosa that is part of the respiratory system.

UBERON:0015787.name: upper respiratory conduit
UBERON:0015787.def: Any anatomical conduit which is part of the upper respiratory tract.

UBERON:0015788.name: olfactory apparatus chamber
UBERON:0015788.def: An anatomical chamber that is part of the olfactory apparatus, consisting of cavity walls (nasal epithelium and mucosal layers) and the space bounded anteriorly by the nares and posteriorly by the choanae, when these structures are present.

UBERON:0015790.name: autopod skin
UBERON:0015790.def: A zone of skin that is part of a autopod region.

UBERON:0015791.name: digit connective tissue
UBERON:0015791.def: A portion of connective tissue that is part of a digit.

UBERON:0015793.name: induseum griseum
UBERON:0015793.def: Thin layer of cortex lying on the dorsal surface of the corpus callosum. It has been debated whether it is more related to the hippocampus or the olfactory bulb (Shipley et al., Olfactory System In Paxinos The Rat Nervous System, 2nd ed).

UBERON:0015794.name: left lung lobar bronchus epithelium
UBERON:0015794.def: An epithelium that is part of a lobar bronchus of left lung.

UBERON:0015795.name: right lung lobar bronchus epitheium
UBERON:0015795.def: An epithelium that is part of a lobar bronchus of right lung.

UBERON:0015796.name: liver blood vessel
UBERON:0015796.def: A blood vessel that is part of a liver.

UBERON:0015800.name: taenia tectum of brain
UBERON:0015800.def: A continuation ventrally of the supracallosal gyrus beyond the rostrum of the corpus callosum. It is demonstrated histologically by Nissl stain. In the human ( Anthoney-1994 ) and the macaque ( Paxinos-2004 ) it lies on the rostral surface of the lamina terminalis and is considered identical to or part of the paraterminal gyrus. In the rat ( Swanson-1998 ) and the mouse ( Paxinos-2001 ) it is located similarly in relation to the supracallosal gyrus, however, it is a more prominent layered structure that extends rostrally on the medial surface overlying the anterior olfactory nucleus. It is considered part of the olfactory areas (rodent) of the cerebral cortex. In rodents it consists of two parts, the dorsal tenia tecta and the ventral tenia tecta. Note that some authors use the term 'tenia tecta' or 'taenia tecta' as a synonym for the lateral longitudinal stria ( Riley-1943 ).

UBERON:0015807.name: ear epithelium
UBERON:0015807.def: An epithelium that is part of a ear.

UBERON:0015808.name: eye epithelium
UBERON:0015808.def: An epithelium that is part of a camera-type eye.

UBERON:0015813.name: middle ear epithelium
UBERON:0015813.def: An epithelium that is part of a middle ear.

UBERON:0015814.name: outer ear epithelium
UBERON:0015814.def: An epithelium that is part of a external ear.

UBERON:0015833.name: foregut epithelium
UBERON:0015833.def: An epithelium that is part of a foregut.

UBERON:0015834.name: duodenum lamina propria
UBERON:0015834.def: A lamina propria that is part of a duodenum.

UBERON:0015837.name: incisor dental pulp
UBERON:0015837.def: A dental pulp that is part of a incisor tooth.

UBERON:0015840.name: incisor dental lamina
UBERON:0015840.def: A dental lamina that is part of a incisor tooth.

UBERON:0015842.name: incisor enamel organ
UBERON:0015842.def: A tooth enamel organ that is part of a incisor tooth.

UBERON:0015846.name: incisor mesenchyme
UBERON:0015846.def: An odontogenic mesenchyme that is part of a incisor tooth.

UBERON:0015847.name: upper left incisor tooth
UBERON:0015847.def: A upper jaw incisor that is in_the_left_side_of a dentition.

UBERON:0015848.name: incisor tusk
UBERON:0015848.def: An incisor tooth that protrudes beyond the mouth.

UBERON:0015849.name: canine tusk
UBERON:0015849.def: An cuspid tooth that protrudes beyond the mouth.

UBERON:0015852.name: narwhal tusk
UBERON:0015852.def: A upper jaw incisor that protrudes prominently from the mouth as a single median tusk, found in narwhals.

UBERON:0015853.name: dental pulp of median incisor tusk
UBERON:0015853.def: A dental pulp that is part of a narwhal tusk.

UBERON:0015854.name: interpedicular line
UBERON:0015854.def: An anatomical line that connects two successive vertebral pedicles. The length of this line is known as the interpedicular distance.

UBERON:0015855.name: ventral ectodermal ridge
UBERON:0015855.def: A thickening of the surface ectoderm on the ventral side of the embryonic tail which resembles the apical ectodermal ridge of the limb bud.

UBERON:0015857.name: parotid lymph node
UBERON:0015857.def: A lymph node found near the parotid gland.

UBERON:0015859.name: hepatic lymph node
UBERON:0015859.def: Any of the lymph nodes adjacent to the stomach and duodenum.

UBERON:0015863.name: gastric lymph node
UBERON:0015863.def: A lymph node along the left gastric artery or greater omentum.

UBERON:0015865.name: pancreaticosplenic lymph node
UBERON:0015865.def: Lymph nodes of the pancreatic tail and spleen, receiving afferents from both organs plus the greater curvature of the stomach; they drain to the celiac lymph nodes.

UBERON:0015868.name: lymph node of epiploic foramen
synonym: lymph node of anterior border of epiploic foramen
lymph node of anterior border of omental foramen
node of anterior border of epiploic foramen
node of anterior border of omental foramen

UBERON:0015869.name: retropharyngeal lymph node
UBERON:0015869.def: The retropharyngeal lymph nodes, from one to three in number, lie in the buccopharyngeal fascia, behind the upper part of the pharynx and in front of the arch of the atlas, being separated, however, from the latter by the Longus capitis. Their afferents drain the nasal cavities, the nasal part of the pharynx, and the auditory tubes. Their efferents pass to the superior deep cervical glands. They are in the retropharyngeal space.

UBERON:0015870.name: lymph node of head
UBERON:0015870.def: A lymph node that is part of a head.

UBERON:0015871.name: facial lymph node
UBERON:0015871.def: Any of the lymph nodes that are part of a face.

UBERON:0015872.name: mandibular lymph node
UBERON:0015872.def: The mandibular lymph node is a lymph node found near the jaw.

UBERON:0015873.name: heel skin
UBERON:0015873.def: A zone of skin that is part of a heel.

UBERON:0015875.name: heel
UBERON:0015875.def: The part of the foot that is the projection of the calcaneus.

UBERON:0015876.name: pelvic lymph node
UBERON:0015876.def: Any lymph node within the abdominal pelvic region.

UBERON:0015878.name: common iliac lymph node
UBERON:0015878.def: The external iliac lymph nodes, from eight to ten in number, lie along the external iliac vessels. They are arranged in three groups, one on the lateral, another on the medial, and a third on the anterior aspect of the vessels; the third group is, however, sometimes absent. Their principal afferents are derived from the inguinal lymph nodes, the deep lymphatics of the abdominal wall below the umbilicus and of the adductor region of the thigh, and the lymphatics from the glans penis vel clitoridis, the membranous urethra, the prostate, the fundus of the urinary bladder, the cervix uteri, and upper part of the vagina.

UBERON:0015881.name: internal iliac lymph node
UBERON:0015881.def: The internal iliac lymph nodes (or hypogastric) surround the internal iliac artery and its branches (the hypogastric vessels), and receive the lymphatics corresponding to the distribution of the branches of it, i. e. , they receive lymphatics from all the pelvic viscera, from the deeper parts of the perineum, including the membranous and cavernous portions of the urethra, and from the buttock and back of the thigh. It does not receive lymph from the ovary, testis, or superior half of the rectum; the gonads drain to the paraaortic lymph nodes, while the superior half of the rectum drains to the pararectal lymph nodes.

UBERON:0015886.name: root of nail
UBERON:0015886.def: The part of the nail plate that extends into the dermis (nail matrix).

UBERON:0015895.name: proximal deep inguinal lymph node
UBERON:0015895.def: One of the deep inguinal lymph nodes located in or adjacent to the femoral canal; sometimes mistaken for a femoral hernia when enlarged.

UBERON:0015917.name: superficial lymph node
UBERON:0015917.def: A lymph node that is located close to the surface.

UBERON:0015918.name: deep lymph node
UBERON:0015918.def: A lymph node that is located deeper within the organism, further from the surface.

UBERON:0015919.name: obsolete tonsillar lymph node
UBERON:0015919.def: The term tonsillar node can be inaccurate or ambiguous.

UBERON:0015920.name: obsolete genital lymph node
UBERON:0015920.def: The term tonsillar node can be inaccurate or ambiguous.

UBERON:0015923.name: superficial parotid lymph node
UBERON:0015923.def: A parotid lymph node that is located superficially.

UBERON:0016374.name: sciatic lymph node
UBERON:0016374.def: A lymph node that is medial to the gluteus superficialis m., caudal to gluteus medius m. and sciatic nerve lymph node.

UBERON:0016378.name: ileocolic lymph node
UBERON:0016378.def: One of the lymph nodes that form a chain around the ileocolic artery.

UBERON:0016386.name: paraaortic lymph node
UBERON:0016386.def: The paraaortic lymph nodes (also known as para-aortic, periaortic, and peri-aortic) are a group of lymph nodes that lie in front of the lumbar vertebral bodies near the aorta. These lymph nodes receive drainage from the lower gastrointestinal tract and the pelvic organs.

UBERON:0016392.name: mastoid lymph node
UBERON:0016392.def: The mastoid lymph nodes (retroauricular lymph nodes, posterior auricular glands), usually two in number, are situated on the mastoid insertion of the Sternocleidomastoideus, beneath the Auricularis posterior. Their afferent vessels drain the posterior part of the temporoparietal region, the upper part of the cranial surface of the auricula or pinna, and the back of the external acoustic meatus; their efferents pass to the superior deep cervical glands.

UBERON:0016393.name: deep parotid lymph node
UBERON:0016393.def: The deep parotid lymph nodes are lymph nodes found below the parotid gland. The afferents of the subparotid glands drain the nasal part of the pharynx and the posterior parts of the nasal cavities. Their efferents pass to the superior deep cervical glands.

UBERON:0016394.name: anterior auricular lymph node
UBERON:0016394.def: The preauricular deep parotid lymph nodes (anterior auricular glands or preauricular glands), from one to three in number, lie immediately in front of the tragus. Their afferents drain the lateral surface of the auricula and the skin of the adjacent part of the temporal region; their efferents pass to the superior deep cervical glands.

UBERON:0016395.name: infra-auricular lymph node
UBERON:0016395.def: The infra-auricular deep parotid lymph nodes are a group of lymph nodes found underneath the ear.

UBERON:0016397.name: submental lymph node
UBERON:0016397.def: The submental lymph nodes (or suprahyoid) are situated between the anterior bellies of the Digastrici. Their afferents drain the central portions of the lower lip and floor of the mouth and the apex of the tongue. Their efferents pass partly to the submandibular lymph nodes and partly to a gland of the deep cervical group situated on the internal jugular vein at the level of the cricoid cartilage.

UBERON:0016398.name: lymph node of lower limb
UBERON:0016398.def: A lymph node that is part of a hindlimb.

UBERON:0016399.name: lymph node of upper limb
UBERON:0016399.def: A lymph node that is part of a forelimb.

UBERON:0016400.name: infrapatellar fat pad
UBERON:0016400.def: The infrapatellar fat pad, also known as Hoffa's fat pad, is a cylindrical piece of fat that is situated under and behind the patella bone within the knee.

UBERON:0016403.name: thoracic wall
UBERON:0016403.def: The thoracic wall (or chest wall) is the boundary of the thoracic cavity. The bony portion is known as the thoracic cage. However, the wall also includes muscle, skin, and fascia.

UBERON:0016404.name: cervical vertebral arch joint
UBERON:0016404.def: A vertebral arch joint that is part of a cervical region of vertebral column.
synonym: joint of cervical vertebral articular process

UBERON:0016405.name: pulmonary capillary
UBERON:0016405.def: A capillary that is part of a lung.

UBERON:0016408.name: corona of glans penis
UBERON:0016408.def: The circumference of the base of the glans forms a rounded projecting border, the corona of the glans penis, overhanging a deep retroglandular sulcus, behind which is the neck of the penis.

UBERON:0016410.name: male breast
UBERON:0016410.def: A breast that is part of a male organism.

UBERON:0016412.name: central part of body of bony vertebral centrum
UBERON:0016412.synonym: central part of body of vertebra

UBERON:0016413.name: medullary cavity of long bone
UBERON:0016413.synonym: central medullary cavity of long bone

UBERON:0016416.name: anterior chest
UBERON:0016416.def: Subdivision of thorax which is anterior to the plane of the posterior boundary of the middle mediastinum.

UBERON:0016418.name: nasion
UBERON:0016418.def: The intersection of the frontal and two nasal bones of the human skull. Its manifestation on the visible surface of the face is a distinctly depressed area directly between the eyes, just superior to the bridge of the nose.

UBERON:0016419.name: bony part of vertebral arch
UBERON:0016419.synonym: bony part of arch of vertebra

UBERON:0016422.name: compact bone of long bone
UBERON:0016422.def: A compact bone tissue that is part of a bone tissue of long bone.

UBERON:0016423.name: compact bone of diaphysis
UBERON:0016423.def: A compact bone tissue that is part of a diaphysis.

UBERON:0016425.name: epiphyseal plate of radius
UBERON:0016425.def: An epiphyseal plate that is part of a radius bone.

UBERON:0016426.name: proximal interphalangeal joint of little finger

UBERON:0016430.name: palmar branch of median nerve
UBERON:0016430.def: The palmar branch of the median nerve is a branch of the median nerve which arises at the lower part of the forearm and innervates skin of proximal central palm and thenar eminence.
synonym: palmar branch of anterior interosseous nerve
palmar cutaneous branch of median nerve
ramus palmaris nervus interossei antebrachii anterior

UBERON:0016435.name: chest wall
UBERON:0016435.def: Subdivision of thorax which includes all structures from the skin to the costal pleura. Examples: There is only one chest wall.

UBERON:0016440.name: glabella region of bone
UBERON:0016440.def: A zone of the frontal bone that connects the supraorbital rirdges.

UBERON:0016442.name: median palatine suture
UBERON:0016442.def: The line of junction between the horizontal parts of the palatine bones that extends from both sides of the skull to form the posterior part of the hard palate.

UBERON:0016446.name: hair of head
UBERON:0016446.def: A strand of hair that is part of a head.

UBERON:0016447.name: hair of trunk
UBERON:0016447.def: A strand of hair that is part of a trunk.

UBERON:0016458.name: esophageal hiatus
UBERON:0016458.def: A hole in the diaphragm through which the esophagus passes.

UBERON:0016459.name: posterior pole of lens
UBERON:0016459.def: The central point on the posterior surface of the lens.

UBERON:0016462.name: periorbital skin
UBERON:0016462.def: A zone of skin in the periorbital region of the face.
UBERON:0016462.synonym: skin of orbital part of face

UBERON:0016464.name: dorsum of nose
UBERON:0016464.def: The midline prominence of the nose, extending from the nasal root to the tip.

UBERON:0016466.name: antihelix
UBERON:0016466.def: On the pinna, a curved prominence of cartilage, parallel with and in front of the helix, is called the antihelix, also known as the anthelix; this divides above into two crura, the crura antihelicis, between which is a triangular depression, the fossa triangularis.

UBERON:0016467.name: antitragus
UBERON:0016467.def: The antitragus is a feature of human ear anatomy. It is a small tubercle that points anteriorly. It is separated from the tragus by the intertragic notch.

UBERON:0016475.name: skin of forehead
UBERON:0016475.def: A zone of skin that is part of a forehead.

UBERON:0016476.name: primary incisor tooth
UBERON:0016476.def: An incisor tooth that is part of a primary dentition.

UBERON:0016477.name: zygomatic process of maxilla
UBERON:0016477.def: The zygomatic process of the maxilla (malar process) is a rough triangular eminence, situated at the angle of separation of the anterior, zygomatic, and orbital surfaces. In front it forms part of the anterior surface. Behind it is concave, and forms part of the infratemporal fossa. Above it is rough and serrated for articulation with the zygomatic bone. Below it presents the prominent arched border which marks the division between the anterior and infratemporal surfaces.

UBERON:0016478.name: liver stroma
UBERON:0016478.def: A stroma that is part of a liver.

UBERON:0016479.name: capsule of liver
UBERON:0016479.def: A collagenous capsule covering the external surface of the liver.

UBERON:0016481.name: bronchial lymph node
UBERON:0016481.def: A lymph node that is part of a bronchus.

UBERON:0016482.name: dental plaque
UBERON:0016482.def: A soft, thin film of food debris, mucin, and dead epithelial cells deposited on the teeth, providing the medium for the growth of various bacteria. The main inorganic components are calcium and phosphorus, with small amounts of magnesium, potassium, and sodium; the organic matrix consists of polysaccharides, proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, and other components. Plaque plays an important etiologic role in the development of dental caries and periodontal and gingival diseases and provides the base for the development of materia alba; calcified plaque forms dental calculus.

UBERON:0016486.name: posterior fornix of vagina
UBERON:0016486.def: The vaginal fornix that is behind the cervix. It is close to the recto-uterine pouch.
synonym: posterior part of fornix of vagina

UBERON:0016487.name: anterior fornix of vagina
UBERON:0016487.def: The vaginal fornix that is front of the cervix. It is close to the vesico-uterine pouch.
synonym: anterior part of fornix of vagina

UBERON:0016490.name: auditory system
UBERON:0016490.def: Is the sensory system for the sense of hearing.

UBERON:0016491.name: vertebral centrum element
UBERON:0016491.def: Skeletal element that functionally replaces the notochord[VSAP,modified].

UBERON:0016492.name: foramen spinosum of sphenoid bone
UBERON:0016492.def: A foramen in the sphenoid bone through which the middle meningeal artery, middle meningeal vein, and the meningeal branch of the mandibular nerve pass.

UBERON:0016493.name: palmaris longus muscle
UBERON:0016493.def: The palmaris longus is seen as a small tendon between the flexor carpi radialis and the flexor carpi ulnaris, although it is not always present. The muscle is absent in about 14 percent of the population, however this varies greatly with ethnicity. Absence of palmaris does not have any known effect on grip strength. Palmaris longus can be palpated by touching the pads of the fifth and first fingers and flexing the wrist. The tendon, if present, will be very visible.

UBERON:0016497.name: epicondyle of humerus
UBERON:0016497.def: An epicondyle that is part of a humerus.

UBERON:0016498.name: intestinal-cloacal junction
UBERON:0016498.def: The juncture where the intestine empties into the cloaca.

UBERON:0016499.name: esophageal-pneumatic duct sphincter
UBERON:0016499.def: Sphincter at the junction of the esophagus and pneumatic duct.

UBERON:0016500.name: muscularis mucosa of fundus of urinary bladder
UBERON:0016500.def: A muscularis mucosa that is part of a fundus of urinary bladder.

UBERON:0016501.name: muscularis mucosae of fundus of stomach
UBERON:0016501.def: A muscularis mucosa that is part of a fundus of stomach.

UBERON:0016502.name: stomach fundus lumen
UBERON:0016502.def: An anatomical space that is enclosed by a fundus of stomach.

UBERON:0016504.name: umbilical ring
UBERON:0016504.def: A dense fibrous ring surrounding the umbilicus at birth. At about the sixth week of embryological development, the midgut herniates through the umbilical ring; four weeks later it returns to the abdominal cavity and rotates around the superior mesenteric artery.

UBERON:0016505.name: Mullerian tubercle
UBERON:0016505.def: An elevation on the wall of the embryonic urogenital sinus where the Müllerian ducts enter.

UBERON:0016509.name: cavity of right ventricle
UBERON:0016509.def: Luminal space of the right ventricle of the heart.

UBERON:0016510.name: epithelium of male urethra
UBERON:0016510.def: An epithelium that is part of a male urethra.

UBERON:0016511.name: lamina propria of fundus of stomach
UBERON:0016511.def: A lamina propria that is part of a mucosa of fundus of stomach.
UBERON:0016511.synonym: lamina propria mucosae of fundus of stomach

UBERON:0016512.name: lumen of duodenum
UBERON:0016512.def: An anatomical space that is part of a duodenum.

UBERON:0016513.name: cavity of left atrium
UBERON:0016513.def: Luminal space of the left atrium of the heart.

UBERON:0016514.name: cavity of left ventricle
UBERON:0016514.def: Luminal space of the left ventricle of the heart.

UBERON:0016515.name: muscular layer of prostatic urethra
UBERON:0016515.def: A muscular coat that is part of a prostatic urethra.
synonym: muscle layer of prostatic part of urethra

UBERON:0016516.name: lamina propria of prostatic urethra
UBERON:0016516.def: A lamina propria that is part of a prostatic urethra.
synonym: lamina propria of prostatic part of urethra

UBERON:0016517.name: lumen of jejunum
UBERON:0016517.def: An anatomical space that is part of a jejunum.

UBERON:0016519.name: muscularis mucosae of jejunum
UBERON:0016519.def: A muscularis mucosa that is part of a jejunum.

UBERON:0016520.name: epithelium of female urethra
