UBERON:2001703.def: Infraorbital that is the eighth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001704.name: infraorbital 9
UBERON:2001704.def: Infraorbital that is the ninth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001705.name: infraorbital 10
UBERON:2001705.def: Infraorbital that is the tenth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001706.name: infraorbital 11
UBERON:2001706.def: Infraorbital that is the eleventh bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001707.name: infraorbital 12
UBERON:2001707.def: Infraorbital that is the twelfth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001708.name: dermosphenotic
UBERON:2001708.def: Infraorbital that is the last bone of the infraorbital series, carrying the infraorbital canal, and sometimes also the supraorbital, temporal, and/or preopercular canals. The dermosphenotic is sometimes sutured or fused completely to the skull, e.g. to the autosphenotic.

UBERON:2001709.name: infraorbital series
UBERON:2001709.def: Anatomical cluster that is the series of dermal bones surrounding the orbit and associated with the infraorbital sensory canal.

UBERON:2001710.name: opercle-interopercle joint
UBERON:2001710.def: Joint that articulates the opercle and interopercle. Opercle-interopercle joint is paired.

UBERON:2001711.name: frontal-pterotic joint
UBERON:2001711.def: Joint that articulates the frontal and pterotic. Frontal-pterotic joint is paired.

UBERON:2001713.name: caudal principal ray 1
UBERON:2001713.def: Caudal principal ray that is the dorsalmost caudal principal ray of the caudal fin.

UBERON:2001714.name: caudal principal ray 2
UBERON:2001714.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 1.

UBERON:2001715.name: caudal principal ray 3
UBERON:2001715.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 2.

UBERON:2001716.name: caudal principal ray 4
UBERON:2001716.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 3.

UBERON:2001717.name: caudal principal ray 5
UBERON:2001717.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 4.

UBERON:2001718.name: caudal principal ray 6
UBERON:2001718.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 5.

UBERON:2001719.name: caudal principal ray 7
UBERON:2001719.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 6.

UBERON:2001720.name: caudal principal ray 8
UBERON:2001720.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 7.

UBERON:2001721.name: caudal principal ray 9
UBERON:2001721.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 8.

UBERON:2001722.name: caudal principal ray 10
UBERON:2001722.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 9.

UBERON:2001723.name: caudal principal ray 11
UBERON:2001723.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 10.

UBERON:2001724.name: caudal principal ray 12
UBERON:2001724.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 11.

UBERON:2001725.name: caudal principal ray 13
UBERON:2001725.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 12.

UBERON:2001726.name: caudal principal ray 14
UBERON:2001726.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 13.

UBERON:2001727.name: caudal principal ray 15
UBERON:2001727.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 14.

UBERON:2001728.name: caudal principal ray 16
UBERON:2001728.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 15.

UBERON:2001729.name: caudal principal ray 17
UBERON:2001729.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 16.

UBERON:2001730.name: caudal principal ray 18
UBERON:2001730.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 17.

UBERON:2001731.name: caudal principal ray 19
UBERON:2001731.def: Caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 18.

UBERON:2001732.name: vertebral element 5
UBERON:2001732.def: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 4.

UBERON:2001733.name: mesethmoid ventral diverging lamella
UBERON:2001733.def: Bony projection that is the posterolaterally oriented projection on the ventral region of the mesethmoid. Mesethmoid ventral diverging lamellae are paired and posteriorly contact the lateral ethmoid bones.

UBERON:2001734.name: posterior process of basipterygium
UBERON:2001734.def: Process that is the posteriorly oriented, paired projection of the basipterygium.

UBERON:2001735.name: scapular foramen
UBERON:2001735.def: Foramen that is located in the scapula. The scapular foramen is paired and formed by a ring of bone.

UBERON:2001737.name: coracoid foramen
UBERON:2001737.def: Foramen that is located in the coracoid.

UBERON:2001739.name: anterior cranial fontanel
UBERON:2001739.def: Fontanel that is located between the contralateral frontals and anterior to the epiphyseal bar.

UBERON:2001740.name: posterior cranial fontanel
UBERON:2001740.def: Fontanel that is located posterior to the epiphyseal bar, and typically located between the contralateral frontals and parietals (if present) and bordered posteriorly by the supraoccipital.

UBERON:2001741.name: trigeminofacial foramen
UBERON:2001741.def: Foramen through which branches of cranial nerves V (trigeminal) and VII (facial) exit.

UBERON:2001742.name: auditory foramen
UBERON:2001742.def: Foramen through which cranial nerve VIII (auditory) exits.

UBERON:2001744.name: replacement tooth trench
UBERON:2001744.def: Anatomical space within a bone in which teeth develop.

UBERON:2001745.name: premaxilla replacement tooth trench
UBERON:2001745.def: Replacement tooth trench that is located in the premaxilla.

UBERON:2001746.name: dentary replacement tooth trench
UBERON:2001746.def: Replacement tooth trench that is located in the dentary.

UBERON:2001747.name: lateral mesethmoid wing
UBERON:2001747.def: Bony projection located on the anteroventral region of the mesethmoid which articulates with the premaxilla.

UBERON:2001748.name: superficial ophthalmic nerve foramen
UBERON:2001748.def: Foramen through which the superficial ophthalmic nerve passes.

UBERON:2001749.name: dentary-anguloarticular joint
UBERON:2001749.def: Joint that articulates the dentary and anguloarticular. Dentary-anguloarticular joint is paired.

UBERON:2001750.name: rib of vertebra 6
UBERON:2001750.def: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the sixth centrum.

UBERON:2001751.name: rib of vertebra 5
UBERON:2001751.def: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the fifth centrum.

UBERON:2001752.name: pre-narial cartilage
UBERON:2001752.def: The pre-narial cartilage is a cartilage that is located anterior to the anterior naris.

UBERON:2001753.name: posttemporal fossa
UBERON:2001753.def: Fossa where the exoccipital forms the medial portion and the epioccipital forms the lateral margin. The posttemporal fossa in most species has two openings separated by the epioccipital bridge.

UBERON:2001761.name: pectoral fin ray 1
UBERON:2001761.def: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium 1 is the leading or marginal ray of the fin and articulates with the scapula. Lepidotrichium 1 is commonly segmented but unbranched but occasionally may be a massive strong unsegmented element (e.g., spine).

UBERON:2001762.name: pectoral fin ray 2
UBERON:2001762.def: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the second most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

UBERON:2001763.name: pectoral fin ray 3
UBERON:2001763.def: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the third most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

UBERON:2001764.name: pectoral fin ray 4
UBERON:2001764.def: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the fourth most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

UBERON:2001765.name: pectoral fin ray 5
UBERON:2001765.def: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the fifth most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

UBERON:2001766.name: pectoral fin ray 6
UBERON:2001766.def: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the sixth most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

UBERON:2001767.name: pectoral fin ray 7
UBERON:2001767.def: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that, in a linear sequence, is the seventh most anterior pectoral ray that it is usually branched and segmented.

UBERON:2001768.name: retractor tentaculi
UBERON:2001768.def: Bilaterally paired dorsal hyoid arch muscle that retracts the maxillary barbel.

UBERON:2001783.name: supraoccipital crest
UBERON:2001783.def: Process that is part of the supraoccipital. It is a posteriorly directed and unpaired median projection off the posterior margin of the supraoccipital bone.

UBERON:2001784.name: autopalatine-vomer joint
UBERON:2001784.def: Joint that articulates autopalatine and vomer bones. Autopalatine-vomer joint is paired.

UBERON:2001787.name: pectoral fin spine
UBERON:2001787.def: Pectoral-fin lepidotrichium 1 with mostly co-ossified and unsegmented hemitrichia that form a stiff and usually thick shaft and enlarged basal processes that moveably articulate with the pectoral girdle. The pectoral fin spine may also result from the fusion of several lepidotrichia that form a stiff shaft.

UBERON:2001788.name: pelvic splint
UBERON:2001788.def: Dermal bone that is located near the lateral margin of the pelvic fin, and lateral to pelvic-fin lepidotrichium 1.

UBERON:2001789.name: dorsal fin spine 1
UBERON:2001789.def: Dorsal-fin lepidotrichium 1 with co-ossified and unsegmented hemitrichia that form a stiff shaft and enlarged base that moveably articulates with first (anteriormost) dorsal-fin pterygiophore.

UBERON:2001790.name: dorsal fin spine 2
UBERON:2001790.def: Dorsal-fin lepidotrichium 2 with co-ossified and unsegmented hemitrichia that form a stiff shaft and enlarged base that moveably articulates with second dorsal-fin pterygiophore.

UBERON:2001792.name: pharyngobranchial 3 bone uncinate process
UBERON:2001792.def: Bony projection that is part of the pharyngobranchial 3.

UBERON:2001793.name: pharyngobranchial 4 bone uncinate process
UBERON:2001793.def: Bony projection that is part of the pharyngobranchial 4.

UBERON:2001794.name: orbitosphenoid-prootic joint
UBERON:2001794.def: Joint that articulates orbitosphenoid and prootic bones. Orbitosphenoid-prootic joint is paired.

UBERON:2001795.name: ceratohyal foramen
UBERON:2001795.def: Foramen in the anterior ceratohyal for passage of the hyoidean artery.

UBERON:2001796.name: epibranchial 2 bone uncinate process
UBERON:2001796.def: Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 2 bone.

UBERON:2001797.name: epibranchial 1 bone uncinate process
UBERON:2001797.def: Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 1 bone.

UBERON:2001798.name: epicentral bone
UBERON:2001798.def: Intermuscular bone that articulates with the vertebral centrum.

UBERON:2001799.name: recessus lateralis
UBERON:2001799.def: Intracranial space formed by confluence of supraorbital, infraorbital, preopercular and temporal sensory canals. See also Di Dario (2004).

UBERON:2001800.name: cephalic rib
UBERON:2001800.def: Modified epicentral intermuscular bone that connects the back of the skull with the pectoral girdle.

UBERON:2001801.name: quadrate-hyomandibula joint
UBERON:2001801.def: Joint that articulates quadrate and hyomandibula bones. Quadrate-hyomandibula joint is paired.

UBERON:2001803.name: quadrate-metapterygoid joint
UBERON:2001803.def: Joint that articulates quadrate and metapterygoid bones. Quadrate-metapterygoid joint is paired.

UBERON:2001804.name: olfactory nerve foramen
UBERON:2001804.def: Foramen for the passage of the olfactory nerve or cranial nerve 1.

UBERON:2001805.name: articular bone
UBERON:2001805.def: Endochondral bone that is located posterior to the dentary, medial to the angular and antero-dorsal to the retroarticular forming the lower jaw. The articular bears a dorso-posterior articular facet for the condyle of the quadrate. The articular is a paired bone.

UBERON:2001806.name: intracranial diverticulum of swimbladder
UBERON:2001806.def: An anterior extension of the swimbladder that passes through a foramen in the exoccipital; part of the otophysic connection between swimbladder and inner ear.

UBERON:2001807.name: preepiotic fossa
UBERON:2001807.def: Fossa that is a concavity on the dorsolateral surface of the skull roof found at least partially on the epiotic (epioccipital).

UBERON:2001808.name: facial foramen
UBERON:2001808.def: Foramen through which cranial nerve VII (facial) exits.

UBERON:2001809.name: trigeminal foramen
UBERON:2001809.def: Foramen through which cranial nerve V (trigeminal) exits.

UBERON:2001810.name: supraorbital sensory canal
UBERON:2001810.def: Sensory canal anterior to and in close proximity to the otic and infraorbital sensory canals. The supraorbital sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:2001811.name: infraorbital sensory canal
UBERON:2001811.def: Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity to the otic and supraorbital sensory canals at their union. The infraorbital sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the infraorbital bones.

UBERON:2001812.name: preoperculo-mandibular sensory canal
UBERON:2001812.def: Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity to the otic and post-otic sensory canals at their union. The preoperculo-mandibular sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the preopercle, angular and dentary bones.

UBERON:2001813.name: preopercular sensory canal
UBERON:2001813.def: Sensory canal lateral or ventral to and in close proximity with the otic and post-otic sensory canals at their union, and anteroventrally with the mandibular sensory canal. The preopercular sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the preopercle bone.

UBERON:2001814.name: mandibular sensory canal
UBERON:2001814.def: Sensory canal anterior and ventral to and in close proximity with the preoperculo-mandibular sensory canal. The mandible sensory canal is bilaterally paired and associated with the angular and dentary bones.

UBERON:2001815.name: nuchal plate
UBERON:2001815.def: Dermal bone that is a bony expansion in the integument anterior to or flanking the dorsal fin that is part of and at the distal end of a supraneural or dorsal fin proximal radial.

UBERON:2001816.name: anterior nuchal plate
UBERON:2001816.def: Nuchal plate that is unpaired and part of the supraneural and in contact, or not, with the supraoccipital crest anteriorly and middle nuchal plate posteriorly.

UBERON:2001817.name: middle nuchal plate
UBERON:2001817.def: Nuchal plate that is unpaired and part of dorsal fin proximal radial 1 and usually in contact with the anterior nuchal plate and paired posterior nuchal plates.

UBERON:2001818.name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 1
UBERON:2001818.def: Dorsal fin proximal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001819.name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 2
UBERON:2001819.def: Dorsal fin proximal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001820.name: posterior nuchal plate
UBERON:2001820.def: Paired nuchal plate that is part of dorsal fin proximal radial 2 and usually in contact with the middle nuchal plate.

UBERON:2001821.name: notochord posterior region
UBERON:2001821.def: Portion of tissue that is part of the caudal fin.

UBERON:2001822.name: epibranchial 3 bone uncinate process
UBERON:2001822.def: Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 3 bone.

UBERON:2001823.name: epibranchial 4 bone uncinate process
UBERON:2001823.def: Epibranchial uncinate process that is part of epibranchial 4 bone.

UBERON:2001824.name: lateral line scale
UBERON:2001824.def: Scale that is associated with the lateral line sensory canal.

UBERON:2001825.name: urohyal lateral process
UBERON:2001825.def: Process that is part of the urohyal; it is the posterolaterally directed process located on the ventrolateral margin of urohyal. Urohyal lateral process is paired.

UBERON:2001826.name: urohyal median process
UBERON:2001826.def: Process that is part of the urohyal; it is the posterodorsally directed and median process located on the dorsal margin of the urohyal.

UBERON:2001827.name: premaxillary-maxillary ligament
UBERON:2001827.def: Ligament that connects the premaxilla to the maxilla.

UBERON:2001828.name: primordial ligament
UBERON:2001828.def: Ligament that connects the maxilla with the lower jaw.

UBERON:2001829.name: caudal fin dorsal procurrent ray
UBERON:2001829.def: Caudal procurrent ray that forms part of the anterior dorsal series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin and may be associated with a neural spine or a epural or a uroneural. A pair of hemitrichia forms each ray.

UBERON:2001830.name: caudal fin ventral procurrent ray
UBERON:2001830.def: Caudal procurrent ray that forms part of the anterior ventral series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin that may be associated with a neural spine or a epural or an uroneural (dorsal series) and with a hemal spine of a preural vertebra (ventral series). A caudal procurrent ray is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2001831.name: pterosphenoid-orbitosphenoid joint
UBERON:2001831.def: Joint that articulates the pterosphenoid and orbitosphenoid. Pterosphenoid-orbitosphenoid joint is paired.

UBERON:2001832.name: parasphenoid-basioccipital joint
UBERON:2001832.def: Joint that articulates the parasphenoid and basioccipital. Parasphenoid-basioccipital joint is unpaired.

UBERON:2001833.name: premaxillary tooth row
UBERON:2001833.def: Tooth row that is on the premaxilla.

UBERON:2001840.name: tip
UBERON:2001840.def: Anatomical point that is the apex of a projection or anything long and tapered; can be bony or cartilage.

UBERON:2001841.name: interhyal-epihyal joint
UBERON:2001841.def: Joint that articulates the interhyal and epihyal bones, or interhyal and ceratohyal cartilages. Interhyal-epihyal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001842.name: epihyal-ceratohyal joint
UBERON:2001842.def: Joint that articulates the epihyal and ceratohyal bones. Epihyal-ceratohyal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001843.name: ceratohyal-dorsal hypohyal joint
UBERON:2001843.def: Joint that articulates the ceratohyal and dorsal hypohyal bones. Ceratohyal-dorsal hypohyal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001844.name: ceratohyal-ventral hypohyal joint
UBERON:2001844.def: Joint that articulates the ceratohyal and ventral hypohyal bones. Ceratohyal-ventral hypohyal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001845.name: dorsal hypohyal-ventral hypohyal joint
UBERON:2001845.def: Joint that articulates the dorsal hypohyal and ventral hypohyal bones. Dorsal hypohyal-ventral hypohyal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001846.name: inter-ventral hypohyal joint
UBERON:2001846.def: Joint that articulates the contralateral ventral hypohyal bones or the contralateral ceratobranchial cartilages. Inter-ventral hypohyal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001847.name: dorsal hypohyal-urohyal joint
UBERON:2001847.def: Joint that articulates the dorsal hypohyal and urohyal bones. Dorsal hypohyal-urohyal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001848.name: ventral hypohyal-urohyal joint
UBERON:2001848.def: Joint that articulates the ventral hypohyal and urohyal bones. Ventral hypohyal-urohyal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001849.name: epihyal-branchiostegal ray joint
UBERON:2001849.def: Joint that articulates the epihyal and branchiostegal ray bones. Epihyal-branchiostegal ray joint is paired.

UBERON:2001850.name: ceratohyal-branchiostegal ray joint
UBERON:2001850.def: Joint that articulates the ceratohyal and branchiostegal ray bones. Ceratohyal-branchiostegal ray joint is paired.

UBERON:2001852.name: postcleithrum 1
UBERON:2001852.def: Postcleithrum that anteriorly articulates with the supracleithrum and/or the cleithrum of the pectoral girdle; most dorsal element in a series of postcleithra.

UBERON:2001853.name: postcleithrum 2
UBERON:2001853.def: Postcleithrum that articulates dorsally with postcleithrum 1, ventrally with postcleithrum 3, and anteriorly with cleithrum.

UBERON:2001854.name: postcleithrum 3
UBERON:2001854.def: Postcleithrum that articulates dorsally with postcleithrum 2 and, sometimes, anteriorly with cleithrum.

UBERON:2001855.name: hyomandibular condyle for the opercle
UBERON:2001855.def: Process on the dorso-posterior margin of the hyomandibula cartilage or bone that articulates with a depression on the antero-dorsal margin of the opercle.

UBERON:2001856.name: gill ray
UBERON:2001856.def: Gill ray is a slender, usually rod-like cartilage within a gill filament and ligamentously tied to its associated pharyngeal arch bone or cartilage.

UBERON:2001857.name: hyoidean artery
UBERON:2001857.def: An artery that passes along the ventral portions of the hyoid arch; supplies oxygenated blood to the pseudobranch.

UBERON:2001858.name: suprapharyngobranchial
UBERON:2001858.def: A pharyngobranchial bone that articulates with the neurocranium dorsally and epibranchial 1 and pharyngobranchial 2 ventrally; lies dorsal to other elements of the dorsal portions of the branchial arches.

UBERON:2001859.name: pharyngobranchial 1 tooth plate
UBERON:2001859.def: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 1 bone.

UBERON:2001860.name: epibranchial 4-upper pharyngeal toothplate joint
UBERON:2001860.def: Joint that articulates the epibranchial 4 cartilage or bone and upper pharyngeal toothplate. Epibranchial 4-upper pharyngeal toothplate joint is paired.

UBERON:2001861.name: epibranchial 3-pharyngobranchial 3 joint
UBERON:2001861.def: Joint that articulates the epibranchial 3 cartilage or bone and pharyngobranchial 3 cartilage or bone. Epibranchial 3-pharyngobranchial 3 joint is paired.

UBERON:2001862.name: epibranchial 3-pharyngobranchial 4 joint
UBERON:2001862.def: Joint that articulates the epibranchial 3 cartilage or bone and pharyngobranchial 4 cartilage or bone. Epibranchial 3-pharyngobranchial 4 joint is paired.

UBERON:2001863.name: inter-hypobranchial 3 joint
UBERON:2001863.def: Joint that articulates the left and right hypobranchial 3 cartilages or bones. Inter-hypobranchial 3 joint is unpaired.

UBERON:2001864.name: basibranchial 1 cartilage
UBERON:2001864.def: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 1 (pharyngeal arch 3).

UBERON:2001865.name: basibranchial 4 cartilage
UBERON:2001865.def: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 4 (pharyngeal arch 6).

UBERON:2001866.name: basibranchial 5 cartilage
UBERON:2001866.def: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 5 (pharyngeal arch 7).

UBERON:2001867.name: post-ceratobranchial cartilage
UBERON:2001867.def: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and at or posterior to the juncture of the bilaterally paired ceratobranchial 5 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001869.name: supraneural 2 cartilage
UBERON:2001869.def: Postcranial axial cartilage located dorsal to vertebra 2.

UBERON:2001870.name: supraneural 3 cartilage
UBERON:2001870.def: Postcranial axial cartilage located dorsal to vertebrae 3 and 4.

UBERON:2001871.name: Weberian ossicle set
UBERON:2001871.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of the Weberian ossicles.

UBERON:2001873.name: head sensory canal system
UBERON:2001873.def: Lateral line system on head and pectoral girdle.

UBERON:2001874.name: basibranchial 2 cartilage
UBERON:2001874.def: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 2 (pharyngeal arch 4).

UBERON:2001876.name: basibranchial 3 cartilage
UBERON:2001876.def: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 3 (pharyngeal arch 5).

UBERON:2001877.name: neural arch 1
UBERON:2001877.def: Neural arch that is the anteriormost neural arch.

UBERON:2001878.name: rib of vertebra 2
UBERON:2001878.def: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the second centrum.

UBERON:2001879.name: rib of vertebra 1
UBERON:2001879.def: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the first centrum.

UBERON:2001880.name: rib of vertebra 3
UBERON:2001880.def: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the third centrum.

UBERON:2001881.name: rib of vertebra 4
UBERON:2001881.def: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the fourth centrum.

UBERON:2001883.name: parapophysis + rib of vertebra 3 + rib of vertebra 4

UBERON:2001884.name: accessory neural arch
UBERON:2001884.def: Neural arch that is located posterior to the neurocranium and anterior to neural arch 1. The accessory neural arch is not associated with a vertebral centrum.

UBERON:2001885.name: neural spine 1
UBERON:2001885.def: Neural spine that is associated with the first vertebra.

UBERON:2001886.name: neural spine 2
UBERON:2001886.def: Neural spine that is associated with the second vertebra.

UBERON:2001887.name: neural spine 3
UBERON:2001887.def: Neural spine that is associated with the third vertebra.

UBERON:2001888.name: supraneural 1 bone
UBERON:2001888.def: Supraneural bone located dorsal to vertebra 1.

UBERON:2001889.name: supraneural 1 cartilage
UBERON:2001889.def: Postcranial axial cartilage located dorsal to vertebra 1.

UBERON:2001892.name: interhyal element
UBERON:2001892.def: Skeletal element that is bilaterally paired and articulates dorsally with the hyosymplectic cartilage or the articulation of the hyomandibula and symplectic.

UBERON:2001893.name: hypobranchial element
UBERON:2001893.def: Skeletal element that is bilaterally paired and articulates medially with a median skeletal element and laterally with a ceratobranchial element.

UBERON:2001894.name: hypobranchial 1 element
UBERON:2001894.def: Skeletal element that is ventral, bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 1 element laterally.

UBERON:2001895.name: hypobranchial 2 element
UBERON:2001895.def: Skeletal element that is ventral, bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 2 element laterally.

UBERON:2001896.name: hypobranchial 3 element
UBERON:2001896.def: Skeletal element that is ventral, bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 3 element laterally.

UBERON:2001897.name: hypobranchial 4 element
UBERON:2001897.def: Skeletal element that is ventral, bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 4 element laterally.

UBERON:2001898.name: ceratobranchial element
UBERON:2001898.def: Skeletal element that is bilaterally paired and forms part of the ventral branchial arches.

UBERON:2001904.name: epibranchial element
UBERON:2001904.def: Skeletal element that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial element.

UBERON:2001909.name: pharyngobranchial element
UBERON:2001909.def: Skeletal element of the branchial arches located medial to the epibranchials.

UBERON:2001910.name: pharyngobranchial 1 element
UBERON:2001910.def: Most anterior pharyngobranchial element, located medial to the epibranchials.

UBERON:2001911.name: pharyngobranchial 2 element
UBERON:2001911.def: Pharyngobranchial element, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 1 element.

UBERON:2001912.name: pharyngobranchial 3 element
UBERON:2001912.def: Pharyngobranchial element, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 2 element.

UBERON:2001913.name: pharyngobranchial 4 element
UBERON:2001913.def: Most posterior pharyngobranchial element, located medial to the epibranchials.

UBERON:2001914.name: obsolete basibranchial element
UBERON:2001914.def: Endochondral element that is ventral, median, and associated with a single pharyngeal arch in the pharyngeal arch 3-7 skeleton.

UBERON:2001915.name: basibranchial 1 element
UBERON:2001915.def: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 1.

UBERON:2001916.name: basibranchial 2 element
UBERON:2001916.def: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 2.

UBERON:2001917.name: basibranchial 3 element
UBERON:2001917.def: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 3.

UBERON:2001918.name: basibranchial 4 element
UBERON:2001918.def: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 4.

UBERON:2001919.name: basibranchial 5 element
UBERON:2001919.def: Skeletal element that is median and associated with branchial arch 5.

UBERON:2001920.name: pseudotympanum
UBERON:2001920.def: Anatomical structure that is formed as a hiatus in the muscles covering the anterior chamber of the swim bladder in the area of ribs 5 and 6.

UBERON:2001921.name: adipose eyelid
UBERON:2001921.def: Surface structure that is a fleshy membrane covering part of the eye.

UBERON:2001922.name: inter-frontal joint
UBERON:2001922.def: Joint between the left and right frontal bone.

UBERON:2001923.name: aortic canal
UBERON:2001923.def: Canal that houses the dorsal aorta.

UBERON:2001924.name: occipital artery foramen
UBERON:2001924.def: Foramina that allow passage of occipital arteries.

UBERON:2001925.name: spiracular canal
UBERON:2001925.def: Foramen for passage of nerve supplying otic lateral line.

UBERON:2001926.name: posterior myodome
UBERON:2001926.def: Fossa or chamber on posterior portion of orbital region of neurocranium that serves as attachment site for posterior extrinsic eye muscles.

UBERON:2001927.name: anterior myodome
UBERON:2001927.def: Fossa or chamber on anterior portion of orbital region of neurocranium that serves as attachment site for anterior extrinsic eye musculature.

UBERON:2001928.name: articular fossa of opercle
UBERON:2001928.def: Fossa of opercle that articulates with hyomandibular condyle for opercle.

UBERON:2001929.name: epioccipital posterior process
UBERON:2001929.def: Process of the epioccipital that extends posteriorly, is laminar in form and is usually attached to Weberian apparatus.

UBERON:2001930.name: accessory vomerine tooth plate
UBERON:2001930.def: Dermal bone that is located lateral to vomer off midline of palate. Accessory vomerine tooth plate bears teeth and may be present as one or more pairs.

UBERON:2001931.name: infranuchal scute
UBERON:2001931.def: Scute that is an elongated plate associated with a ligament running between posterior nuchal plate and rib on vertebra 6. Infranuchal scute is paired and develops from its associated ligament and sensory canal tubular ossicle.

UBERON:2001932.name: sensory canal tubular ossicle
UBERON:2001932.def: Dermal bone that is ring-shaped or cylindrical and surrounds a sensory canal.

UBERON:2001933.name: sensory canal tubule
UBERON:2001933.def: Sensory canal that is a side branch between a sensory canal proximally and a pore at its distal end. Sensory canal tubule is bilaterally paired although often imperfectly so.

UBERON:2001934.name: rostral plate
UBERON:2001934.def: Dermal bone that is located on midline of snout in skin above mesethmoid and lateral ethmoid bones. Rostral plate bears type 1 odontodes and is unpaired.

UBERON:2001935.name: oral disk
UBERON:2001935.def: Lip that is expanded to form a broad, rounded cup around the mouth.

UBERON:2001936.name: posterior nasal barbel
UBERON:2001936.def: Barbel that is attached to the anterior rim of the posterior nostril. Posterior nasal barbel is paired.

UBERON:2001937.name: anterior nasal barbel
UBERON:2001937.def: Barbel that is associated with the anterior nostril. Anterior nasal barbel is paired.

UBERON:2001938.name: maxillary barbel
UBERON:2001938.def: Barbel that is attached to the distal end of the maxilla and that originates on the side of the mouth. Maxillary barbel is paired.

UBERON:2001939.name: inter-basipterygium joint
UBERON:2001939.def: Joint that articulates the left and right basipterygium cartilage or bone. Inter-basipterygium joint is unpaired.

UBERON:2001940.name: vertebra 4-vertebra 5 joint
UBERON:2001940.def: Joint between the centra, and sometimes the neural arches or parapophyses of vertebra 4 and vertebra 5.

UBERON:2001941.name: orbitosphenoid-lateral ethmoid joint
UBERON:2001941.def: Joint that articulates the orbitosphenoid cartilage or bone and lateral ethmoid cartilage or bone. Orbitosphenoid-lateral ethmoid joint is paired.

UBERON:2001942.name: autopalatine-maxillary joint
UBERON:2001942.def: Joint that articulates the autopalatine cartilage or bone and maxilla.

UBERON:2001943.name: metapterygoid-autopalatine ligament
UBERON:2001943.def: Ligament that connects the metapterygoid to the autopalatine.

UBERON:2001944.name: lateral ethmoid-autopalatine ligament
UBERON:2001944.def: Lateral ethmoid-autopalatine ligament is a ligament that connects the lateral ethmoid to the autopalatine.

UBERON:2001945.name: mesethmoid-premaxillary ligament
UBERON:2001945.def: Mesethmoid-premaxillary ligament is a ligament that connects the mesethmoid to the premaxilla.

UBERON:2001946.name: mesethmoid-maxillary ligament
UBERON:2001946.def: Mesethmoid-maxillary ligament is a ligament that connects the mesethmoid to the maxilla.

UBERON:2001947.name: hyomandibular-otic region joint
UBERON:2001947.def: Joint that articulates the hyomandibular cartilage or bone and otic region cartilage or sphenotic bone, and often pterotic bone and prootic bone. Hyomandibular-otic region joint is paired.

UBERON:2001948.name: anal fin hook
UBERON:2001948.def: Process that is part of the anal fin lepidotrichium.

UBERON:2001949.name: caudal fin hook
UBERON:2001949.def: Process that is part of the caudal fin lepidotrichium.

UBERON:2001950.name: inter-premaxillary joint
UBERON:2001950.def: Joint that articulates the left and right premaxillary bones. Inter-premaxillary joint is unpaired.

UBERON:2001951.name: skin flap
UBERON:2001951.def: Surface structure that is a portion of skin that projects or hangs from the body.

UBERON:2001952.name: dentary tooth row
UBERON:2001952.def: Tooth row that is on the dentary.

UBERON:2001956.name: epibranchial 1 bone proximal cartilage
UBERON:2001956.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the proximal end of epibranchial 1 bone, and that usually articulates with a pharyngobranchial element. Epibranchial 1 bone proximal cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001957.name: epibranchial 2 bone proximal cartilage
UBERON:2001957.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the proximal end of epibranchial 2 bone, and that usually articulates with a pharyngobranchial element. Epibranchial 2 bone proximal cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001958.name: ceratobranchial 3 bone distal cartilage
UBERON:2001958.def: Pharynbeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of ceratobranchial 3 bone, and that usually articulates with epibranchial 3 element. Ceratobranchial 3 bone distal cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001959.name: ceratobranchial 4 bone proximal cartilage
UBERON:2001959.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the proximal end of ceratobranchial 4 bone, and that usually articulates with basibranchial 4 element. Ceratobranchial 4 proximal cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001960.name: ceratobranchial 4 bone distal cartilage
UBERON:2001960.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of ceratobranchial 4 bone, and that usually articulates with epibranchial 4 element. Ceratobranchial 4 distal cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001961.name: ceratobranchial 5 bone distal cartilage
UBERON:2001961.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of ceratobranchial 5 bone. Ceratobranchial 5 bone distal cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001962.name: hypobranchial 1 bone distal cartilage
UBERON:2001962.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of hypobranchial 1 bone, and that usually articulates with ceratobranchial 1 element. Hypobranchial 1 bone distal cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001963.name: hypobranchial 2 bone distal cartilage
UBERON:2001963.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of hypobranchial 2 bone, and that usually articulates with ceratobranchial 2 element. Hypobranchial 2 bone distal cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001964.name: epibranchial 3 bone uncinate process cartilage
UBERON:2001964.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of epibranchial bone 3 uncinate process. epibranchial bone 3 uncinate process cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001965.name: epibranchial 4 bone uncinate process cartilage
UBERON:2001965.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that is part of and at the distal end of epibranchial bone 4 uncinate process. Epibranchial bone 4 uncinate process cartilage is paired.

UBERON:2001968.name: outer mental barbel
UBERON:2001968.def: Mental barbel that originates on the chin, in a posterolateral position relative to the inner mental barbel.

UBERON:2001969.name: inner mental barbel
UBERON:2001969.def: Mental barbel that originates on the chin, in an anteromedial position relative to the outer mental barbel. The inner mental barbel is nearer to the mandibular symphysis than is the outer mental barbel.

UBERON:2001971.name: parapophysis 4
UBERON:2001971.def: Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the fourth centrum. Parapophysis 4 is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:2001972.name: intercostal ligament
UBERON:2001972.def: Ligament that connects one rib to another.

UBERON:2001976.name: interorbital septum
UBERON:2001976.def: Anatomical cluster composed of one or more bones and tissue that separates the orbits.

UBERON:2001977.name: pad
UBERON:2001977.def: Surface structure that is a portion of the integument thickened relative to surrounding area.

UBERON:2001978.name: maxillary tooth row
UBERON:2001978.def: Tooth row that is on the maxilla.

UBERON:2001979.name: hyomandibula-metapterygoid joint
UBERON:2001979.def: Joint that articulates the hyomandibula bone and metapterygoid bone.

UBERON:2001980.name: vertebral element 6
UBERON:2001980.def: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 5.

UBERON:2001981.name: vertebral element 7
UBERON:2001981.def: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 6.

UBERON:2001982.name: vertebral element 8
UBERON:2001982.def: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 7.

UBERON:2001983.name: centrum 1
UBERON:2001983.def: Centrum that is part of vertebra 1.

UBERON:2001984.name: centrum 2
UBERON:2001984.def: Centrum that is part of vertebra 2.

UBERON:2001985.name: centrum 3
UBERON:2001985.def: Centrum that is part of vertebra 3.

UBERON:2001986.name: centrum 4
UBERON:2001986.def: Centrum that is part of vertebra 4.

UBERON:2001987.name: centrum 5
UBERON:2001987.def: Centrum that is part of vertebra 5.

UBERON:2001988.name: centrum 6
UBERON:2001988.def: Centrum that is part of vertebra 6.

UBERON:2001989.name: mandibular-hyoid median cartilage
UBERON:2001989.def: Pharyngeal arch cartilage that is a spherical mass of cartilage located between the mandibular symphysis and ventral hyoid arch. Mandibular-hyoid median cartilage is unpaired.

UBERON:2001990.name: epibranchial arborescent organ
UBERON:2001990.def: Anatomical cluster that is an outgrowth of the soft tissue around the dorsolateral corner of a branchial arch that is internally supported by a core of rigid cartilage-like tissue. Epibranchial arborescent organ is paired.

UBERON:2001991.name: lateral bone
UBERON:2001991.def: Membrane bone extending between a transverse process of the second proximal dorsal-fin radial and the pleural rib of the sixth vertebra. Lateral bone is paired.

UBERON:2001992.name: branched anal fin ray
UBERON:2001992.def: Anal fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched.

UBERON:2001993.name: branched pectoral fin ray
UBERON:2001993.def: Pectoral fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched and segmented.

UBERON:2001994.name: gill raker row
UBERON:2001994.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of adjacent gill rakers constituting a row and is part of a ceratobranchial or epibranchial element of the branchial arches. Gill raker row is paired.

UBERON:2001995.name: papilla
UBERON:2001995.def: Surface structure that is a small, fleshy protuberance.

UBERON:2001997.name: parietal-supraoccipital
UBERON:2001997.def: Compound dermal and endochondral bone that results from the fusion of the paired dermal parietal bones and the median endochondral supraoccipital. Forms the dorso-posterior element of the dermatocranium.

UBERON:2001998.name: posttemporal-supracleithrum
UBERON:2001998.def: Dermal bone that results from the fusion of the dermal posttemporal and the dermal supracleithrum. Forms the upper skeletal element of the pectoral girdle between the cleithrum and neurocranium. Posttemporal-supracleithrum is paired.

UBERON:2001999.name: posterior cleithral process
UBERON:2001999.def: Process arising from the posterior or postero-dorsal margin of the cleithrum dorsally adjacent to the insertion of the pectoral fin. Posterior cleithral process is paired.

UBERON:2002000.name: posterior dentation of pectoral fin spine
UBERON:2002000.def: Process that is tooth-like or thorn-like and arising from the posteriorly-facing margin of the abducted pectoral spine.
synonym: posterior denticle of pectoral fin spine
posterior serration of pectoral fin spine
posterior thorn of pectoral fin spine
posterior tooth of pectoral fin spine

UBERON:2002001.name: anterior dentation of pectoral fin spine
UBERON:2002001.def: Process that is tooth- or thorn-like and arising from the anteriorly-facing margin of the abducted pectoral spine. Anterior dentation of pectoral fin spine is usually present on the proximal and/or middle section of the pectoral fin spine.
synonym: anterior denticle of pectoral fin spine
anterior serration of pectoral fin spine
anterior thorn of pectoral fin spine
anterior tooth of pectoral fin spine

UBERON:2002002.name: anterior distal serration of pectoral fin spine
UBERON:2002002.def: Process that is retrorse, thorn-like and arising from the anteriorly-facing margin of the abducted pectoral spine. Anterior distal serration of pectoral fin spine is usually present on the distal section of the pectoral fin spine.
synonym: anterior denticle of pectoral fin spine
anterior serration of pectoral fin spine
anterior thorn of pectoral fin spine
anterior tooth of pectoral fin spine
pectoral fin spine anterior distal serration

UBERON:2002003.name: posterior dentation of dorsal fin spine 2
UBERON:2002003.def: Process that is tooth or thorn-like and arising from the posteriorly-facing margin of the abducted dorsal-fin spine 2.
synonym: posterior denticle of dorsal fin spine 2
posterior serration of dorsal fin spine 2
posterior thorn of dorsal fin spine 2
posterior tooth of dorsal fin spine 2

UBERON:2002004.name: anterior dentation of dorsal fin spine 2
UBERON:2002004.def: Process that is tooth- or thorn-like and arising from the anteriorly-facing margin of the abducted dorsal-fin spine 2.
synonym: anterior denticle of dorsal fin spine 2
anterior serration of dorsal fin spine 2
anterior thorn of dorsal fin spine 2
anterior tooth of dorsal fin spine 2

UBERON:2002005.name: canal plate
UBERON:2002005.def: Dermal bone that is ventral to the preopercle and bears a portion of the preopercular sensory canal.

UBERON:2002006.name: axillary pore
UBERON:2002006.def: Pore that is located ventral to the posterior cleithral process and medial to the pectoral fin. Axillary pore is at the end of a duct from an integumentary gland.

UBERON:2002008.name: neural lamina
UBERON:2002008.def: Neural lamina is a median, vertical ridge or bony septum between neural spine 3 and neural spine 4 on the dorsal side of the Weberian vertebra. Neural lamina is unpaired.

UBERON:2002009.name: medial cartilage of palatine
UBERON:2002009.def: Pharyngeal cartilage that caps the medial margin of the palatine at the autopalatine-lateral ethmoid joint.

UBERON:2002010.name: hyoideomandibular nerve
UBERON:2002010.def: Nerve that is a branch of cranial nerve VII that passes through or around the suspensorium to innervate muscles and sensory organs on or near pharyngeal arch 2.

UBERON:2002011.name: lateral fontanel of frontal
UBERON:2002011.def: Fontanel within the frontal bone near the frontal-sphenotic joint. Lateral fontanel of frontal is paired.

UBERON:2002012.name: dentary foramen
UBERON:2002012.def: Foramen located on the dentary for passage of the mandibular nerve.

UBERON:2002013.name: ascending limb of ceratobranchial 5 bone
UBERON:2002013.def: Process that is the dorsally directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 bone.

UBERON:2002014.name: ascending limb of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage
UBERON:2002014.def: Process that is the dorsally directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage.

UBERON:2002015.name: pharyngobranchial tooth plate
UBERON:2002015.def: Dermal bone of upper pharyngeal arches associated with pharyngobranchial bones or cartilages, usually bearing teeth.

UBERON:2002016.name: pharyngobranchial 4 tooth plate
UBERON:2002016.def: Pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 4.

UBERON:2002017.name: anterior limb of ceratobranchial 5 bone
UBERON:2002017.def: Process that is the anterior and medially directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 bone part of ceratobranchial 5 bone.

UBERON:2002018.name: anterior limb of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage
UBERON:2002018.def: Process that is the anterior and medially directed portion of ceratobranchial 5 cartilage.

UBERON:2002019.name: pterotic-posttemporal-supracleithrum
UBERON:2002019.def: Bone that is a fusion of the pterotic, posttemporal, and supracleithrum bones.

UBERON:2002020.name: hypomaxilla
UBERON:2002020.def: Dermal bone bearing teeth located between the distal end of the premaxilla and the middle of the maxilla. The hypomaxilla is a paired bone.

UBERON:2002021.name: ascending process of the parasphenoid
UBERON:2002021.def: Process that is the lateral projection of the parasphenoid arising and articulating with the more dorsal portions of the neurocranium, usually at the level of the prootic.

UBERON:2002022.name: dermethmoid
UBERON:2002022.def: Dermal bone of the dorsal surface of the olfactory region. Dermethmoid can be paired or median.

UBERON:2002023.name: second preethmoid bone
UBERON:2002023.def: Endochondral bone found between the preethmoid and maxilla.

UBERON:2002024.name: mental barbel
UBERON:2002024.def: Barbel that originates on the chin.

UBERON:2002026.name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone 1
UBERON:2002026.def: Pectoral fin proximal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2002027.name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone 2
UBERON:2002027.def: Pectoral fin proximal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2002028.name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone 3
UBERON:2002028.def: Pectoral fin proximal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2002029.name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone 4
UBERON:2002029.def: Pectoral fin proximal radial 4 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2002030.name: ventral keel of coracoid
UBERON:2002030.def: Process on the ventral surface of the horizontal limb of the coracoid, close to and parallel to the coracoid-cleithrum joint. Ventral keel of coracoid is paired.

UBERON:2002031.name: orbital foramen
UBERON:2002031.def: Foramen in the bone or cartilage comprising the anterior wall of the orbit, and through which passes at least the deep ophthalmic branch of cranial nerve V (trigeminal).

UBERON:2002032.name: lateral ethmoid-frontal joint
UBERON:2002032.def: Joint that articulates the lateral ethmoid and frontal. lateral ethmoid-frontal joint is paired.

UBERON:2002033.name: prootic-pterosphenoid joint
UBERON:2002033.def: Joint that articulates the prootic and pterosphenoid. prootic-pterosphenoid joint is paired.

UBERON:2002034.name: prootic-exoccipital joint
UBERON:2002034.def: Joint that articulates the prootic and exoccipital. Prootic-exoccipital joint is paired.

UBERON:2002038.name: basioccipital-exoccipital joint
UBERON:2002038.def: Joint that articulates the basioccipital and exoccipital. Basioccipital-exoccipital joint is paired.

UBERON:2002039.name: dilatator fossa
UBERON:2002039.def: Fossa located on the neurocranium that is formed from portions of the sphenotic, frontal and pterotic bones.

UBERON:2002040.name: inter-coracoid joint
UBERON:2002040.def: Joint between the right and left coracoid bones of the pectoral girdle.

UBERON:2002041.name: parapophysis 6
UBERON:2002041.def: Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the sixth centrum.

UBERON:2002042.name: parapophysis 5
UBERON:2002042.def: Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the fifth centrum.

UBERON:2002043.name: posterior limb of parapophysis 4
UBERON:2002043.def: Process that arises and projects posterolaterally from parapophysis 4. Posterior limb of parapophysis 4 is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:2002044.name: anterior limb of parapophysis 4
UBERON:2002044.def: Process that arises and projects anterolaterally from parapophysis 4. Anterior limb of parapophysis 4 is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:2002049.name: obsolete alarm substance cell
UBERON:2002049.def: Epithelial cell that produces a chemical that triggers antipredator behavior.

UBERON:2002050.name: obsolete Schreckstoff
UBERON:2002050.def: Chemical substance that functions as an alarm signal.

UBERON:2002051.name: scale circulus
UBERON:2002051.def: Fine ridge on surface of scale, often parallel to the circumference of scale.

UBERON:2002052.name: prootic depression
UBERON:2002052.def: Shallow area that exists on the prootic.

UBERON:2002053.name: bony plate
UBERON:2002053.def: Dermal bone that is located on or subjacent to the surface anywhere on the body and that is not part of the general complement of scales, dermal bone of the dermatocranium, postcranial axial skeleton or paired fin skeleton. Bony plate may exist singly, or as unpaired or paired clusters or series.

UBERON:2002054.name: vertebra 5-vertebra 6 joint
UBERON:2002054.def: Joint between the centra, and sometimes the neural arches or parapophyses.

UBERON:2002055.name: vertebra 6 - vertebra 7 joint
UBERON:2002055.def: Joint between the centra, and sometimes the neural arches or parapophyses of vertebra 6 and vertebra 7.

UBERON:2002057.name: gill opening
UBERON:2002057.def: Anatomical space that is the external opening of a gill slit connecting the pharyngeal cavity to the exterior. Gill opening is usually paired and located on the lateral or ventral surfaces of the head.

UBERON:2002058.name: Weberian complex centrum
UBERON:2002058.def: Centrum that is the fusion of centra 2-4.

UBERON:2002061.name: predorsal vertebra
UBERON:2002061.def: Vertebra that is positioned between the vertebra immediately anterior to the first dorsal-fin pterygiophore to the anteriormost vertebra.

UBERON:2002062.name: branched caudal fin ray
UBERON:2002062.def: Caudal fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched.

UBERON:2002063.name: nuchal plate series
UBERON:2002063.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one type of nuchal plate in an individual.

UBERON:2002064.name: uroneural 1
UBERON:2002064.def: Uroneural that is the anteriormost element of the uroneural series.

UBERON:2002065.name: ural centrum 1
UBERON:2002065.def: A vertebral centrum that is immediately posterior to preural vertebra 1. Ural centrum 1 is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2002066.name: auditory fenestra
UBERON:2002066.def: Opening in the neurocranium to allow communication between the swimbladder and the inner ear.

UBERON:2002067.name: upper hypural set
UBERON:2002067.def: Anatomical cluster including hypural 3 and more dorsal hypurals that supports the dorsal series of principal caudal lepidotrichia or rays. The upper hypural set articulates or fuses to ural centra 3, 4 or 5 (polyural terminology) or ural centrum 2 (diural terminology) depending on the teleost subgroup. The upper hypural set is composed of unpaired median bones.

UBERON:2002068.name: lower hypural set
UBERON:2002068.def: Anatomical cluster including hypurals 1 and 2 that supports part of the ventral principal caudal lepidotrichia or rays and that separates from the dorsal hypural set through the hypural diastema. The lower hypural set articulates or fuses to ural centra 1 and 2 (polyural terminology) or ural centrum 1 (diural terminology) depending on the teleost subgroup. The lower hypural set is composed of unpaired median bones.

UBERON:2002069.name: distal cartilage of posterior process of basipterygium
UBERON:2002069.def: Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal margin or tip of posterior process of basipterygium and projects posteriorly.

UBERON:2002070.name: internal anterior process of basipterygium
UBERON:2002070.def: Process that is bony and arises from anteromedial corner of basipterygium and projects anteriorly or anteromedially.

UBERON:2002071.name: distal cartilage of internal anterior process of basipterygium
UBERON:2002071.def: Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal tip of internal anterior process of basipterygium.

UBERON:2002072.name: middle anterior process of basipterygium
UBERON:2002072.def: Process that is bony and arises from anterior margin of basipterygium between internal anterior process of basipterygium and external anterior process of basipterygium. Middle anterior process of basipterygium projects anteriorly or anteromedially.

UBERON:2002073.name: distal cartilage of middle anterior process of basipterygium
UBERON:2002073.def: Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal tip of middle anterior process of basipterygium.

UBERON:2002074.name: external anterior process of basipterygium
UBERON:2002074.def: Process that is bony and arises from anterolateral corner of basipterygium and projects anteriorly or anteromedially.

UBERON:2002075.name: distal cartilage of external anterior process of basipterygium
UBERON:2002075.def: Process that is cartilaginous and arises from the distal tip of external anterior process of basipterygium.

UBERON:2002076.name: lateral process of basipterygium
UBERON:2002076.def: Process that is bony and arises from lateral margin of basipterygium lateral to pelvic fin lepidotrichium 1 and projects laterally or anterolaterally.

UBERON:2002077.name: lateropterygium
UBERON:2002077.def: Bone that is attached or adjacent to lateral margin of basipterygium and anterior to pelvic fin lepidotrichium 1. The lateropterygium is a paired bone.

UBERON:2002078.name: hypural plate
UBERON:2002078.def: Perichondrally ossified bone that results from the fusion of two or more hypurals and support a variable number of principal caudal lepidotrichia. The hypural plate is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2002079.name: leptocephalous larva
UBERON:2002079.def: Larval stage in some teleosts before metomorphosis.

UBERON:2002080.name: spina occipitalis
UBERON:2002080.def: Process that is a ventral projection from the supraoccipital that extends between the exoccipitals to the dorsal margin of the foramen magnum.

UBERON:2002082.name: basal fulcrum
UBERON:2002082.def: Fulcrum that is large, laterally expanded, paired or unpaired, scale-like, and that precedes the base of a fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

UBERON:2002083.name: fringing fulcrum
UBERON:2002083.def: Fulcrum that is a small, paired dermal structure associated with the marginal, leading rays of paired and/or unpaired fins. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

UBERON:2002084.name: pleurostyle
UBERON:2002084.def: Postero-dorsal process of preural vertebra 1 or postero-dorsal process of the compound terminal centrum. The pleurostyle is a paired membrane bone.

UBERON:2002085.name: ural centrum
UBERON:2002085.def: A vertebral centrum that is posterior to preural vertebra 1 and consequently the most posterior vertebral centra. Ural centrum is a unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2002086.name: pelvic axillary process
UBERON:2002086.def: Anatomical cluster consisting of only a bony element or a combination of a bony element and one or more scales, or only modified scales, which lies in a fin fold at the base of the uppermost ray.

UBERON:2002087.name: pectoral axillary process
UBERON:2002087.def: Pectoral axillary process is an elongate structure formed by one or more additional postcleithra or modified scales or a combination of both, that is firmly attached to a skin fold above the articular condyle of the uppermost pectoral fin ray or lepidotrichium 1.

UBERON:2002088.name: interhaemal bone
UBERON:2002088.def: A small bone articulating distally with the haemal arch or a short haemal spine.

UBERON:2002089.name: gular plate
UBERON:2002089.def: Dermal bone located on the ventral surface of the skull and positioned between the two rami of the lower jaw. Anteriorly the gular attaches to the symphysis of the lower jaw through fibrous connective tissue. The gular is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2002092.name: rostral cartilage
UBERON:2002092.def: Median chondrified cartilage bound to premaxillary ascending process by a rostro-premaxilla ligament.

UBERON:2002094.name: dorsal fin pterygiophore 1
UBERON:2002094.def: Dorsal fin pterygiophore that is the anteriormost pterygiophore of the dorsal fin.

UBERON:2002095.name: ventromedial opening of posttemporal fossa
UBERON:2002095.def: A third opening of the posttemporal fossa posteriorly located relative to the fossa. It is bordered completely by the epiocciptial, or by both the epioccipital and exoccipital.

UBERON:2002096.name: bony plate series
UBERON:2002096.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one bony plate in an individual.

UBERON:2002097.name: sensory canal pore series
UBERON:2002097.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one sensory canal pore.

UBERON:2002099.name: lateral line scale series
UBERON:2002099.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of more than one lateral line scale.

UBERON:2002101.name: branchiostegal ray series
UBERON:2002101.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of the branchiostegal rays within an individual.

UBERON:2002102.name: epibranchial series
UBERON:2002102.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of the epibranchial elements within an individual.

UBERON:2002103.name: ceratobranchial series
UBERON:2002103.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of the ceratobranchial elements within an individual.

UBERON:2002105.name: electrosensory lateral line lobe
UBERON:2002105.def: Anatomical structure located in the hindbrain that receives primary electroreceptor input.

UBERON:2002106.name: eminentia granularis
UBERON:2002106.def: Anatomical structure that is a subdivision of the cerebellum; it is the location of some lateral line nerve synapses.

UBERON:2002107.name: medullary command nucleus
UBERON:2002107.def: Anatomical structure that consists of two neuron types: pacemaker cells and relay cells. The medullary command nucleus commands the timing of the electric organ discharge.

UBERON:2002108.name: buccal papilla
UBERON:2002108.def: Papilla that is part of the mouth.

UBERON:2002114.name: cotylephore
UBERON:2002114.def: Multi-tissue structure that is a transient outgrowth of tissue on skin brooding fish that acts as an attachment site for embryos.

UBERON:2002117.name: ovipositor
UBERON:2002117.def: Organ that functions in egg deposition.

UBERON:2002118.name: scale radius
UBERON:2002118.def: Erosion channel that radiates out from the growth center (focus) of the scale across and through the circuli.

UBERON:2002122.name: pouch scale
UBERON:2002122.def: Scale that forms part of the posterior border of the caudal-fin organ. Pouch scales are usually hypertrophied.

UBERON:2002124.name: nuptial tubercle
UBERON:2002124.def: Surface structure that is a small protuberance on the surface of the body. Nuptial tubercles primarily function to facilitate contact between individuals for breeding.

UBERON:2002125.name: caudal-fin organ
UBERON:2002125.def: Organ that consists of a pouch located on the ventral caudal-fin lobe, opening posteriorly, and composed of glandular tissue. The caudal-fin organ presumably functions to secrete pheromones during courtship.

UBERON:2002126.name: caudal-fin ray pump
UBERON:2002126.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of thickened caudal-fin rays modified into a pumping mechanism associated with the caudal-fin organ.

UBERON:2002127.name: myorhabdoid bone
UBERON:2002127.def: Intermuscular bone that is located in the dorsal and ventral forward flexures of the myoseptum.

UBERON:2002129.name: caudal rod
UBERON:2002129.def: Multi-tissue structure that is a cartilaginous or collagenous bar supporting the caudal appendage.

UBERON:2002130.name: caudal appendage
UBERON:2002130.def: Multi-tissue structure that is region of the body posterior to the last anal-fin ray.

UBERON:2002131.name: obsolete horizontal septum
UBERON:2002131.def: Anatomical structure that consists of a sheet of connective tissue attached to the vertebral column and dividing the epaxial and hypaxial musculature.

UBERON:2002133.name: dorsal organ
UBERON:2002133.def: Surface structure that is a midsaggital strap of flattened ectodermal tissue extending along the posterodorsal midline.

UBERON:2002141.name: annular ligament
UBERON:2002141.def: Ligament that is in the eye and is located at the angle between the cornea and the iris.

UBERON:2002144.name: obsolete anterior catecholaminergic tract
UBERON:2002144.def: CNS white matter, an axonal tract between ventral diencephalon and ventral telencephalon. At 3 d, the anterior catecholaminergic tract includes noradrenergic projections from the hindbrain and dopaminergic projections from ventral dopaminergic neurons. During later development, other catecholaminergic projections may also contribute to the anterior catecholaminergic tract.

UBERON:2002145.name: anterior swim bladder bud
UBERON:2002145.def: Portion of tissue that forms from the swim bladder epithelium at the anterior end of the swim bladder.

UBERON:2002149.name: vertebral element 9
UBERON:2002149.def: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 8.

UBERON:2002150.name: vertebral element 10
UBERON:2002150.def: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 9.

UBERON:2002151.name: vertebral element 11
UBERON:2002151.def: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 10.

UBERON:2002152.name: vertebral element 12
UBERON:2002152.def: Vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 11. May have hemal arch and rib.

UBERON:2002154.name: opercular cavity
UBERON:2002154.def: Anatomical space which is located beneath the operculum and external to the gills.

UBERON:2002158.name: obsolete palatine
UBERON:2002158.def: Compound endochdondral and dermal bone that results from the fusion of the dermal dermopalatine and the endochondral autopalatine and forms the antero-lateral region of the palate. Commonly, it articulates with the maxilla antero-laterally and with the ethmoidal region medially. The palatine is paired.

UBERON:2002159.name: caudal basal fulcrum
UBERON:2002159.def: Basal fulcrum that precedes a caudal fin lobe. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

UBERON:2002160.name: ural centrum 3
UBERON:2002160.def: A vertebral centrum that is located immediately posterior to ural centrum 2 (polyural terminology). Ural centrum 3 articulates with hypural 3 ventrally. Ural centrum 3 is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2002161.name: ural centrum 4
UBERON:2002161.def: A vertebral centrum that is located immediately posterior to ural centrum 3 (polyural terminology) and may fuse to ural centrum 3 early in ontogeny. Ural centrum 4 articulates with hypural 4 ventrally. Ural centrum 4 is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2002162.name: ural vertebra
UBERON:2002162.def: Vertebra that is incomplete or rudimentary and may bear a rudimentary neural arch and sometimes a rudimentary spine or the neural arch and spine are completely absent. Ural vertebrae are one of the last bony elements of the vertebral column, usually smaller than the preural centra. Ural vertebrae are numbered beginning from anterior (1) to posterior (2, 3, 4, etc.). Ural vertebra is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2002163.name: ural vertebra 1
UBERON:2002163.def: Ural vertebra that is located directly posterior to preural centrum 1. It may bear a rudimentary neural arch and sometimes a rudimentary spine or the neural arch and spine are completely absent and it may articulate or fuse with hypural 1 (polyural terminology). Ural vertebra 1 is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2002164.name: caudal principal ray set
UBERON:2002164.def: Anatomical cluster including all segmented-and-branched rays plus one unbranched but segmented ray located at the leading margin in each lobe of the caudal fin (Hubbs and Lagler, 1947) and that associates with endoskeletal elements such as hypurals and hemal spines of preural centra 1 and 2 (Arratia, 2008). Caudal principal rays are counted from the dorsalmost one ventrally. Caudal principal rays are unpaired median bones.

UBERON:2002165.name: caudal procurrent ray set
UBERON:2002165.def: An anatomical cluster of short rays, shorter than the principal ones, which form the anterior dorsal and ventral series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin that may be associated with neural spines, epurals and uroneurals (dorsal series) and haemal spines of preural vertebrae (ventral series) (Arratia, 2008). The anteriormost procurrent rays are commonly unsegmented, but the posteriormost ones are usually segmented. The procurrent rays are numbered from caudal to rostral direction. The caudal procurrent ray series is an unpaired median series.

UBERON:2002166.name: pseudourostyle
UBERON:2002166.def: An elongate lateral process ventrally placed to the proximal region of the pleurostyle. The pseudourostyle is paired.

UBERON:2002167.name: stegural
UBERON:2002167.def: Modified neural arch, probably of ural centrum 4, formed by a bony base that may extend along the dorso-lateral surfaces of ural centra and preural centra 1 or 2 and by a well-developed antero-dorsal membranous projection that extends lateral to the base of epural(s) and anterior toward the neural arches and/or spines of preural centra 1 or 2 (Arratia and Schultze, 1992). The stegural is a paired bone.

UBERON:2002168.name: preural centrum 1 + ural centrum 1 + ural centrum 2
UBERON:2002168.def: Urostyle that is the result of fusion of preural centrum 1 with ural centra 1 and 2.

UBERON:2002174.name: octaval nerve motor nucleus
UBERON:2002174.def: Hindbrain nucleus which consists of cell bodies whose axons exit the hindbrain via cranial nerve VIII and innervate hair cells of the lateral line and inner ear. The neurons of these nuclei are unusual in that they extend both contra- and ipsilateral dendrites.

UBERON:2002175.name: rostral octaval nerve motor nucleus
synonym: rostral cranial nerve VIII motor nucleus

UBERON:2002179.name: obsolete peripheral nucleus of ventral telencephalon
UBERON:2002179.def: Telencephalic nucleus which has migrated away from the ependyma and consists of the central, lateral nuclei and the dorsal and ventral entopeduncular nuclei. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.

UBERON:2002180.name: obsolete central nucleus of ventral telencephalon
UBERON:2002180.def: Peripheral nucleus of the ventral telencephalon which is located immediately lateral to the dorsal nucleus of the ventral telencephalon. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.

UBERON:2002185.name: climbing fiber
UBERON:2002185.def: Portion of tissue that consists of afferent axons from the inferior olive and synapsing with Purkinje cells within the molecular layer of the valvula cerebelli and corpus cerebelli.

UBERON:2002192.name: dorsolateral motor nucleus of vagal nerve
UBERON:2002192.def: Motor nucleus of vagal nerve that is located within the dorsolateral portion of rhomobomere 8.

UBERON:2002193.name: dorsolateral septum
UBERON:2002193.def: Portion of tissue that grows in from the dorsolateral wall of the otic vesicle, forming a dorsolateral partition between the developing anterior and posterior semicircular canals.

UBERON:2002195.name: epidermal placode
UBERON:2002195.def: Portion of tissue that is a thickening and reshaping of the epidermal basal stratum cells beneath which fibroblasts accumulate to form the scale primordium.

UBERON:2002198.name: obsolete head muscle
UBERON:2002198.def: Muscle which is part of the head.

UBERON:2002199.name: obsolete hindbrain commissure
UBERON:2002199.def: CNS white matter that crosses the midline within the hindbrain.

UBERON:2002200.name: hypobranchial muscle
UBERON:2002200.def: Head muscle that originates on the anterior region of the cleithrum and inserts on the urohyal. The hypobranchial forms initially as left and right parts that later fuse together forming a cone shape.

UBERON:2002202.name: intermediate nucleus
UBERON:2002202.def: Diencephalic nucleus which is located between the dorsal hypothalamus and the caudal tuberal nucleus and does not contain tyrosine hydroxylase immunoreactive cells.

UBERON:2002204.name: obsolete lateral nucleus of ventral telencephalon
UBERON:2002204.def: Peripheral nucleus of the ventral telencephalon that has migrated to the periphery of the brain. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.

UBERON:2002207.name: medial motor nucleus of vagal nerve

UBERON:2002208.name: obsolete mesonephric podocyte
UBERON:2002208.def: Podocyte that is part of the kidney (mesonephros).

UBERON:2002213.name: obsolete optic nerve head
UBERON:2002213.def: Portion of cranial nerve II where large fasicles of axons from the optic fiber layer come together prior to leaving the eye.

UBERON:2002218.name: parallel fiber, teleost
UBERON:2002218.def: A parallel fiber results from the axon of a cerebellar granule cell ascending through the molecular layer where it does not bifurcate and synapses on the dendritic branches of Purkinje cells and stellate cells. The parallel fibers in teleost fish do not bifurcate in contrast to other vertebrates.

UBERON:2002222.name: obsolete periventricular nucleus of ventral telencephalon

UBERON:2002226.name: preglomerular nucleus
UBERON:2002226.def: Diencephalic nucleus which is located in the caudal tuberculum. The preglomerular nuclei make up most of the migrated nuclei within the caudal tuberculum. From Neuroanatomy of the Zebrafish Brain.

UBERON:2002232.name: presumptive cardiac ventricle primitive heart tube

UBERON:2002237.name: obsolete pronephric podocyte
UBERON:2002237.def: Podocyte that is part of the pronephros.

UBERON:2002248.name: supratemporal commissure
UBERON:2002248.def: Lateral line canal that that crosses the supratemporal region posterior to the openings of the endolymphatic ducts and connects the lateral canals of each side.

UBERON:2002255.name: ocular side
UBERON:2002255.def: Organism subdivision that is the side of the body possessing eyes.

UBERON:2002256.name: blind side
UBERON:2002256.def: Organism subdivision that is the side of the body lacking eyes.

UBERON:2002260.name: premaxillary-maxillary joint
UBERON:2002260.def: Joint that articulates the premaxilla and maxilla. Premaxillary-maxillary joint is paired.

UBERON:2002269.name: interarcual cartilage
UBERON:2002269.def: Pharyngeal arch cartilage located between uncinate process of epibranchial 1 and pharyngobranchial 2.

UBERON:2002274.name: transforming ctenoid scale
UBERON:2002274.def: Ctenoid scale with two or three alternating rows of cteni marginally and truncated cteni submarginally. (Roberts 1993).

UBERON:2002275.name: Jakubowski's organ
UBERON:2002275.def: Neuromast of the supraorbital sensory canal in the nasal bone. It is innervated by the buccal nerve rather than by the supraorbital nerve, which invariably innervates neuromasts of the supraorbital canal. (Johnson and Patterson 1993).

UBERON:2002276.name: obsolete median fin
UBERON:2002276.def: Fin that is an unpaired fin located in the sagittal plane of the organism.

UBERON:2002277.name: pectoral fin distal radial bone 1
UBERON:2002277.def: Pectoral fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2002279.name: pectoral fin distal radial bone 2
UBERON:2002279.def: Pectoral fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2002280.name: pectoral fin distal radial bone 3
UBERON:2002280.def: Pectoral fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2002282.name: preopercle-opercle joint
UBERON:2002282.def: Joint that articulates the preopercle and opercle. Preopercle-opercle joint is paired.

UBERON:2002284.name: body marking
UBERON:2002284.def: Surface structure that is a visible mark on the body resulting from pigmentation.

UBERON:2002285.name: cycloid scale
UBERON:2002285.def: Scale that is smooth-edged, round or oval and composed of acellular dermal bone lacking small spines on the posterior exposed edge. (from http://www.briancoad.com/Dictionary/introduction.htm).

UBERON:2002288.name: obsolete aqueous humor
UBERON:2002288.def: Clear ocular fluid in the anterior segment of the eye. It is produced primarily by dorsal ciliary epithelial cells.

UBERON:2002289.name: obsolete sclera
UBERON:2002289.def: Multi-tissue structure that composes the opaque fibrous outer layer of the eye.

UBERON:2002290.name: obsolete vitreous
UBERON:2002290.def: Portion of organism substance that is a gelatinous extracellular matrix structure that fills the vitreous cavity of the eye.

UBERON:2002291.name: fulcrum
UBERON:2002291.def: Dermal bone that is typically associated with a fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

UBERON:2002292.name: epaxial basal fulcrum
UBERON:2002292.def: Basal fulcrum that is positioned at the dorsal or anterodorsal margin of the caudal fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

UBERON:2002293.name: hypaxial basal fulcrum
UBERON:2002293.def: Basal fulcrum that is positioned at the anteroventral margin of the caudal fin. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

UBERON:2002294.name: fish scute
UBERON:2002294.def: Dermal bone that is an unpaired, scale-like structure. Arratia, G. 2009. Identifying patterns of diversity of the actinopterygian fulcra. Acta Zoologica (Stockholm) 90 (Suppl. 1): 220-235.

UBERON:2005010.name: mid cerebral vein
UBERON:2005010.def: The mesencephalic veins (MsV) enter the mid cerebral veins (MCeV) at the dorsal midline. THe MCeVs originate at the dorsal midline, proceede lateraly in a ventral direction to drain into the paired primordial midbrain channels (PHBC). ogai et al. 2001., Kimmel et al. 1993.

UBERON:2005011.name: pseudobranchial artery
UBERON:2005011.def: A vascular loop attached to the efferent part of the mandibular arch that forms at 3.5 dpf. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005013.name: concurrent branch afferent branchial artery
UBERON:2005013.def: The branch of the afferent branchial artery that continues posteriodorsally. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005014.name: recurrent branch afferent branchial artery
UBERON:2005014.def: The anterioventral proceeding branch of the afferent branchial artery. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005017.name: primordial midbrain channel
UBERON:2005017.def: The vessel between the anterior cerebral vein and the mid cerebral vein. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005020.name: central artery
UBERON:2005020.def: Arteries that irrigate the forebrain and midbrain Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005021.name: cerebellar central artery
UBERON:2005021.def: Extend upward from the PCS, branch to provide an arterial feed to the hindbrain, then drain back down into the PHBC Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005022.name: opercular artery
UBERON:2005022.def: The opercular artery arises from the hyoid stump on the first aortic arch, then follows the lateral margin of the operculum (gill covering) ventrally to reconnect into the proximal part of the first aortic arch. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005025.name: dorsal longitudinal anastomotic vessel
UBERON:2005025.def: Trunk vessel that connects to the primitive hindbrain channel and the basilar artery at the caudal end of the medulla oblongata. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005026.name: primary head sinus
UBERON:2005026.def: Main route for venous drainage of the anterior and mid cerebral veins as well as portions of the primordial hindbrain channel. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005027.name: posterior cerebral vein
UBERON:2005027.def: Vein that drains the dorsal longitudinal vessel and the caudal portions of the venous capillary network of the medulla oblongata. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005029.name: rostral blood island
UBERON:2005029.def: Hematopoietic tissue derived from the cephalic mesoderm. Predominantly produces myeloid cells. de Jong and Zon 2005.

UBERON:2005031.name: dorsal longitudinal vein
UBERON:2005031.def: Vessel that connects to the primitive hindbrain channel and the basilar artery at the caudal end of the medulla oblongata. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005032.name: optic vein
UBERON:2005032.def: Vein that connects to the hyaloid vein that drains the eye. External to eye. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005034.name: parachordal vessel
UBERON:2005034.def: Vessels run longitudinally along the horizontal myoseptum. These vessels are not functional until after lumenization which occurs near 4 dpf. Isogai et al. 2003.

UBERON:2005036.name: supraintestinal artery
UBERON:2005036.def: A continuation of the anterior mesenteric artery, which branches out from the dorsal aorta just caudal to the pronephric glomus. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005044.name: optic artery
UBERON:2005044.def: The artery that carries blood to the eye. It branches from the internal carotid artery and enters the eye ventrally through the optic fissure. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005048.name: primitive prosencephalic artery
UBERON:2005048.def: Vessel that branches from cranial division of the internal carotid artery, extending laterally around the rostral end of the head. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005049.name: prosencephalic artery
UBERON:2005049.def: After the primitive prosencephalic artery forms it becomes disconnected from the cranial division of the internal carotid artery and instead it connects to the anterior mesencephalic central artery and the communicating vessels of the palatocerebral artery.

UBERON:2005050.name: palatocerebral artery
UBERON:2005050.def: The PLA branches ventrally from the CrDI. It extends rostrally along the base of mid- and forebrain, then loops medially and links to the corresponding vessel from the other side of the embryo. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005051.name: communicating vessel palatocerebral artery
UBERON:2005051.def: Connect the palatocerebral artery with the prosencephalic artery. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005052.name: anterior mesencephalic central artery
UBERON:2005052.def: Arteries that irrigate rostral regions of the midbrain. They extend between the Basial communicating artery to the anterior cerebral vein. Isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2005055.name: median palatocerebral vein
