It is formed by the suprascapular notch of the scapula and the superior transverse scapular ligament. From http://medical-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/suprascapular+foramen.

UBERON:4200128.name: synarcual region of vertebral column
UBERON:4200128.def: Series of fused cervical vertebrae or vertebral elements. Based on Jeffrey C. Carrier. Biology of Sharks and Their Relatives, 2012. CRC Press.

UBERON:4200129.name: synarcual region
UBERON:4200129.def: Axial subdivision that includes a series of fused cervical vertebrae or vertebral elements. Based on Jeffrey C. Carrier. Biology of Sharks and Their Relatives, 2012. CRC Press.

UBERON:4200130.name: tibial facet of astragalus
UBERON:4200130.def: Facet for the articulation of the tibia on the astragalus (talus).

UBERON:4200131.name: trochanteric shelf
UBERON:4200131.def: Anatomical projection on the anterolateral region of the proximal end of the femur.

UBERON:4200132.name: obsolete tuber
UBERON:4200132.def: OBSOLETE Eminence or swelling on anatomical surface.

UBERON:4200133.name: crest
UBERON:4200133.def: A ridge or similar projection rising above the surface of an anatomical structure.

UBERON:4200134.name: antimere
UBERON:4200134.def: A part in the body of an organism that corresponds to an opposite symmetrical part.

UBERON:4200135.name: puboischiadic bar
UBERON:4200135.def: A transverse flattened or cylindrical plate in the posterior body wall opposite the anterior ends of the pelvic fins, in front of the vent and at the posterior end of the body cavity, that supports a few anterior pelvic radials and a basal cartilage, the basipterygium.  from  Leonard J. V. Compagno. 2001. Sharks of the World: An Annotated and Illustrated Catalogue of Shark Species Known to Date. Volume 2.

UBERON:4200136.name: triphycercal tail
UBERON:4200136.def: A caudal fin with three lobes.

UBERON:4200139.name: palatoquadrate element
UBERON:4200139.def: Endochondral element that is part of the suspensorium sometimes ossifying distally as the quadrate bone and linking the basal section of the braincase to the lower jaw.

UBERON:4200140.name: prepollical element
UBERON:4200140.def: Is a endochondral element that is part of the mesopodial skeleton and is contained within the prepollex which in some taxa appears as a pre-axial digit-like projection anterior to the first digit of the hand.

UBERON:4200141.name: prehallical element
UBERON:4200141.def: Is a endochondral element that is part of the mesopodial skeleton and is contained within the prehallux which in some taxa appears as a pre-axial digit-like projection anterior to the first digit of the foot.

UBERON:4200150.name: accessory foramen
UBERON:4200150.def: Foramen found on the humerus of tetrapodomorphs beyond the entepicondyle and ectepicondyle foramen. Often denoted as foramen 'c' and 'd' after Jarvik 1996.

UBERON:4200152.name: intertarsale sesamoid
UBERON:4200152.def: Sesamoid bone in the tarsal region.

UBERON:4200159.name: ventral ridge system
UBERON:4200159.def: A collection of attached ridges on the ventrl surface of the femur consisting of the internal and fourth trochanters plus the adductor blade and crest. Most notible in early amniotes (based on Romer 1956).

UBERON:4200160.name: mesomere (fin)
UBERON:4200160.def: The median series of bones supporting the pectoral fin of sarcopterygian fish. See Dipnomorpha. In the pectoral fin, the first mesomere is the humerus, the second the ulna, and the third probably the intermedium. The radius is the first preaxial radial. All other homologies are suspect. from http://palaeos.com/vertebrates/glossary.

UBERON:4200165.name: basal scute
UBERON:4200165.def: A scute parte of the basal surface of the fin in Sarcopterygian fish.

UBERON:4200166.name: hindlimb interepipodial space
UBERON:4200166.def: The space between the bones of the tibia and the fibula.

UBERON:4200169.name: process 2 of entepicondyle
UBERON:4200169.def: Process on the humerus of basal tetrapods, anterior to the entepicondyle and associated with subscapularis muscle (based on Coates 1996).

UBERON:4200170.name: process 3 of entepicondyle
UBERON:4200170.def: Process on the humerus of basal tetrapods, anterior to the entepicondyle and adjacent to process 4 of entepicondyle (see Coates 1996).

UBERON:4200171.name: process 4 of entepicondyle
UBERON:4200171.def: Process on the humerus of basal tetrapods, anterior to the entepicondyle and adjacent to process 3 of entepicondyle (see Coates 1996).

UBERON:4200174.name: distal condyle of humerus
UBERON:4200174.def: The area encompassing the radial and ulnar condyles of the humerus.

UBERON:4200176.name: ascending process of clavicle
UBERON:4200176.def: A bony dorsal extension of the clavicle.

UBERON:4200180.name: semilunate carpal
UBERON:4200180.def: The moon shaped fusion of distal carpals 1 and 2 found in some theropod dinosaurs, permitting greater wrist mobility.

UBERON:4200181.name: astragalus head
UBERON:4200181.def: The region of the astragalus/ talus that carries the articular surface for the navicular or central metatarsal.

UBERON:4200183.name: bicipital tuberosity
UBERON:4200183.def: The rough eminence which is on the anterior inner aspect of the neck of the radius and into which the tendon of the biceps is inserted. From http://www.merriam-webster.com/medical.

UBERON:4200184.name: ulnar tuberosity
UBERON:4200184.def: His roughened area of bone sits distomedially at the base of the coronoid process. It is the attachment site for the brachialis muscle. From http://www.anatomyexpert.com/.

UBERON:4200185.name: entepicondyle fossa
UBERON:4200185.def: A fossa on the distal humerus proximal to the entepicondyle.

UBERON:4200187.name: obsolete hyperphalangy of manus
UBERON:4200187.def: Increase the number of phalanges per digit beyond their ancestral digital formulas. Modified from Cooper and Dawson 2009.

UBERON:4200190.name: zygosphene
UBERON:4200190.def: An articular process on anterior surface of neural arch of vertebrae which fits into zygantrum. Modified from Henderson's dictionary of Biological terms 12th Edition.

UBERON:4200191.name: obsolete humeral facet of the ulna

UBERON:4200193.name: posterodorsal process of ilium
UBERON:4200193.def: Anatomical project part of the blade of the ilium that projects posteriorly.

UBERON:4200194.name: intercentrum
UBERON:4200194.def: The anteriormost of the two possible elements found in the tetrapod centrum (when the centrum is not a single element).

UBERON:4200195.name: pleurocentrum
UBERON:4200195.def: The posteriormost of the two possible elements found in the tetrapod centrum (when the centrum is not a single element).

UBERON:4200196.name: atlas intercentrum
UBERON:4200196.def: The intercentrum unit of the atlas vertebra.

UBERON:4200197.name: anterior humeral ridge
UBERON:4200197.def: Ridge or keel at the proximal end of the humerus. (see Laurin 1998).

UBERON:4200198.name: incisor process
UBERON:4200198.def: Process that is part of the mandible that is in close proximity to the incisor teeth.

UBERON:4200199.name: sallet sensory system
UBERON:4200199.def: Ciliary restraint system in the inner ear that uses sallets instead of the tectorial membrane.

UBERON:4200203.name: humeral facet on the ulna
UBERON:4200203.def: Facet on the ulna for articulation with the ulnar condyle of the humerus.

UBERON:4200204.name: humeral facet on radius
UBERON:4200204.def: Facet on the radius for articulation with the radial condyle of the humerus.

UBERON:4200206.name: internal rim of coracoid foramen
UBERON:4200206.def: The internal part of the rim denoting the coracoid foramen.

UBERON:4200207.name: external rim of the coracoid foramen
UBERON:4200207.def: The external wall of the rim denoting the coracoid foramen.

UBERON:4200208.name: pectoral fin intermediate radial bone
UBERON:4200208.def: Radial bone found in between the proximal and distal radial bones.

UBERON:4200209.name: postaxial process of the ulnare
UBERON:4200209.def: A projection on the postaxial region of the ulnare.

UBERON:4200210.name: postaxial process of the femur
UBERON:4200210.def: A projection on the postaxial region of the femur.

UBERON:4200211.name: postaxial process of the fibula
UBERON:4200211.def: A projection on the postaxial region of the fibula.

UBERON:4200214.name: epipodial facet
UBERON:4200214.def: Facets for the articulation of the epipodial (zeugopodial) elements.

UBERON:4200215.name: suture
UBERON:4200215.def: Line of junction between two parts immovably connected. Modified from Henderson's Dictionary of Biological Terms.

UBERON:4200216.name: fibula facet of femur
UBERON:4200216.def: Facet on the femur for the fibula.

UBERON:4200217.name: tibial facet of femur
UBERON:4200217.def: Facet on the femur for the tibia.

UBERON:4200218.name: musculotendinous bundle
UBERON:4200218.def: A collection of muscle and tendinous tissue.

UBERON:4200221.name: growth line
UBERON:4200221.def: Distinct layer that indicate the growth of an organism.

UBERON:4200222.name: distal groove of humerus
UBERON:4200222.def: Groove along the distal margin of the humerus, ventral to the radial and ulnar condyle.

UBERON:4200223.name: foramen C
UBERON:4200223.def: Foramen located on the scapulocoracoid, located just behind the cleithral anteroventral process(the articulation with the cleithrum). Modified from Coates 1996.

UBERON:4200224.name: columnar area
UBERON:4200224.def: Modified from Garvey et al. 2005. ' Between the dorsal ridge and the caput humeri is a futher recessed area......that clearly separates the two structures and is slightly separted from the dorsal surface of the entepicondyle, and more specifically from the unfinished bone of the entepicondyle, by a narrow ridge.'.

UBERON:4200225.name: scapulohumeralis muscle
UBERON:4200225.def: Muscle found primarily in basal sarcopterygians that runs between teh scapulocoracoid and the humerus. Its exact homologies with more derived shoulder muscles in Tetrapoda is unclear.

UBERON:4200226.name: anteroventral process of cleithrum
UBERON:4200226.def: A ramus of the celithrum that descend along the girdle. Its rounded outer surface forms the articulation surface for the clavicle while its anterior surface overlaps with the anterior process of the scapulocoracoid.

UBERON:4200230.name: surface of bone
UBERON:4200230.def: An anatomical surface that is part of a bone.

UBERON:4200231.name: unfinished bone surface
UBERON:4200231.def: A bone surface that is not smooth and periosteal.  The usual implication is that the bone was still growing, was covered in cartilage, or both. From Paleos.com.

UBERON:4200233.name: dorsal clavicular process
UBERON:4200233.def: A process, extending dorsally from the clavicular plate, that attaches to the cleithrum. Modified from Clack 2012 and Coates 1996.

UBERON:4200243.name: surangular pit line
UBERON:4200243.def: ...a v-shaped pair of ridges, each carrying three or four smallpores Modified from Ahlberg et al. 2005.

UBERON:4200245.name: parasymphysial plate
UBERON:4200245.def: Bone, often with tooth attachments, on the lingual side of the anterior of the lower jaw.

UBERON:4200250.name: meckelian bone
UBERON:4200250.def: The ossification of the Meckel's cartilage.

UBERON:4300001.name: obsolete maxillary saddle
UBERON:4300001.def: A fossa that is a depression in the proximal end of the maxilla involved in articulation with the palatine [Baldwin, CC and Johnson GD. 1996. Interrelationships of Aulopiformes. Pages 355-404 in MLJ Stiassny, LR Parenti, and DG Johnson, (eds.), Interrelationships of fishes. Academic Press, San Diego, CA.].

UBERON:4300002.name: palatine prong
UBERON:4300002.def: A process on the palatine that projects outward and upward and articulates with a depression (maxillary saddle) in the proximal end of the maxilla [Gosline WA et al, 1966; Baldwin, CC and Johnson GD. 1996. Interrelationships of Aulopiformes. Pages 355-404 in MLJ Stiassny, LR Parenti, and DG Johnson, (eds.), Interrelationships of fishes. Academic Press, San Diego, CA.].

UBERON:4300003.name: urodermal bone
UBERON:4300003.def: Paired, thin dermal bones at the rear of the caudal fin skeleton, derived from scales.

UBERON:4300004.name: scale pocket
UBERON:4300004.def: A continuous flap of skin with scales implanted in pockets or invaginations [Baldwin, CC and Johnson GD. 1996. Interrelationships of Aulopiformes. Pages 355-404 in MLJ Stiassny, LR Parenti, and DG Johnson, (eds.), Interrelationships of fishes. Academic Press, San Diego, CA.].

UBERON:4300005.name: aphakic space
UBERON:4300005.def: The space in the pupil, which is not occupied by the lens. A rostral aphakic space may enhance the forward binocular field of vision.

UBERON:4300006.name: scale row
UBERON:4300006.def: A series of scales in alignment with each other along some axis of the body.

UBERON:4300007.name: medial pelvic process
UBERON:4300007.def: Process that is posteriorly oriented and medially located on the basipterygium. It is a paired projection. [PHENOSCAPE:bf].

UBERON:4300008.name: epipleural series
UBERON:4300008.def: Anatomical cluster that consists of the epipleurals.

UBERON:4300012.name: clavus
UBERON:4300012.def: A rudder-like lobe formed from extensions of dorsal and anal fin rays.

UBERON:4300016.name: pelvic cartilage
UBERON:4300016.def: Cartilage element associated with the pelvic fin in aulopiform fishes.

UBERON:4300017.name: rostrodermethmoid
UBERON:4300017.def: Dermal bone formed by the fusion of dermethmoids and rostral bones [Fink, W L Weitzman, S H. 1982. Relationships of the stomiiform fishes (Teleostei), with a description of Diplophos Bulletin of The Museum of Comparative Zoology 150:31-93. http://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/part/28697].

UBERON:4300018.name: ventral marginal cartilage
UBERON:4300018.def: In the clasper skeleton, a flat semicylindrical cartilage that is partially fused to the lateral edge of the axial cartilage, and forms the lateral wall of the clasper groove [Compagno, L. 2001. Sharks of the World: An Annotated and Illustrated Catalogue of Shark Species Known to Date. Volume 2].

UBERON:4300019.name: dorsal fin basal cartilage (elasmobranchs)
UBERON:4300019.def: The large cartilage of the dorsal fin, on which the radials articulate distally [Compagno 2001. Sharks of the World: An Annotated and Illustrated Catalogue of Shark Species Known to Date. Volume 2].

UBERON:4300020.name: anal fin basal cartilage
UBERON:4300020.def: The large cartilage of the anal fin, on which the radials articulate distally [Compagno 2001. Sharks of the World: An Annotated and Illustrated Catalogue of Shark Species Known to Date. Volume 2].

UBERON:4300021.name: anterolateral plate
UBERON:4300021.def: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderm fishes.

UBERON:4300022.name: anteroventral plate
UBERON:4300022.def: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, located in the ventral armour adjacent to the interolateral (IL) and anterior ventrolateral (AVL) plates.

UBERON:4300023.name: interolateral plate
UBERON:4300023.def: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, and located anterior to the anterior ventrolateral (AVL) plate.

UBERON:4300024.name: spinal plate
UBERON:4300024.def: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, and located lateral to the anterior ventrolateral (AVL) plate.

UBERON:4300025.name: posterior dorsolateral plate
UBERON:4300025.def: Dermal bone that is part of the scapular complex in placoderms, located posterior to the main components of the complex.

UBERON:4300026.name: anterior ventrolateral plate
UBERON:4300026.def: Dermal bone that is part of the ventral region of scapular complex in placoderms (see also posterior ventrolateral plate). In most placoderms with a long ventral armour, the ventral wall is typically composed of two large paired lateral plates (anterior and posterior ventrolaterals).

UBERON:4300028.name: posterior ventrolateral plate
UBERON:4300028.def: Dermal bone that is part of the ventral region of scapular complex in placoderms (see also anterior ventrolateral plate). In most placoderms with a long ventral armour, the ventral wall is typically composed of two large paired lateral plates (anterior and posterior ventrolaterals).

UBERON:4300029.name: dermal neck joint
UBERON:4300029.def: Dermal articulation between skull and shoulder girdle localized to paired dermal neck-joint between anterior dorsolateral plate (ADL) and paranuchal (PNu) plates in placoderms.

UBERON:4300031.name: fin web
UBERON:4300031.def: Membrane that connects the lepidotrichia or ceratotrichia of a fin.

UBERON:4300032.name: posterior dorsal fin basal cartilage (elasmobranchs)
UBERON:4300032.def: The large cartilage of the posterior dorsal fin, on which the radials articulate distally.

UBERON:4300033.name: anterior dorsal fin basal cartilage (elasmobranchs)
UBERON:4300033.def: The large cartilage of the anterior dorsal fin, on which the radials articulate distally.

UBERON:4300034.name: antorbital cartilage
UBERON:4300034.def: Cartilage element on the neurocranium of sawsharks and batoids, separate cartilages attached to the sides of the nasal capsules that support the sides or front of the head. [Compagno, L.J.V. Sharks of the world. An annotated and illustrated catalogue of shark species known to date. Volume 2. Bullhead, mackerel and carpet sharks (Heterodontiformes, Lamniformes and Orectolobiformes). FAO Species Catalogue for Fishery Purposes. No. 1, Vol. 2. Rome, FAO. 2001. 269p. ISBN 92-5-104543-7].

UBERON:4300035.name: supraneural element
UBERON:4300035.def: Endochondral element that is median and located in the dorsal skeletogenous septum between the cranium and the dorsal fin.

UBERON:4300037.name: bony fin ray
UBERON:4300037.def: Fin ray that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:4300038.name: facet
UBERON:4300038.def: A small smooth area on a bone or other firm structure.  A worn spot on a tooth, produced by chewing or grinding.

UBERON:4300090.name: X bone
UBERON:4300090.def: The x bone is a detached neural spine anterior to the neural spine of preural centrum 2.

UBERON:4300091.name: Y bone
UBERON:4300091.def: The y bone is a detached neural spine anterior to the haemal spines of preural centrum 2.

UBERON:4300096.name: anal fin pterygiophore 1
UBERON:4300096.def: Anal fin pterygiophore that is the anteriormost of the series.

UBERON:4300097.name: anal fin spine 1
UBERON:4300097.def: Anal fin spine that is the anteriormost element of the series.

UBERON:4300098.name: anal fin spine 2
UBERON:4300098.def: Anal fin spine that is located posteriorly adjacent to the first anal fin spine.

UBERON:4300101.name: dorsal fin ceratotrichial spine (elasmobranchs)
UBERON:4300101.def: A small to large enameloid-covered, dentine-cored spine located on the anterior margins of one or both of the dorsal fins, found on bullhead sharks (Heterodontiformes), many dogfish sharks, fossil (but not living) batoids, chimaeroids, but lost entirely or buried in the fin bases of other shark-like fishes [Compagno, Sharks of the World].

UBERON:4300102.name: postcleithral scale
UBERON:4300102.def: Scale that is posteriorly adjacent to the pectoral girdle [Cloutier and Arratia 2004, character 183].

UBERON:4300103.name: rudimentary pectoral fin ray
UBERON:4300103.def: Pectoral fin lepidtrichium that is small, unbranched and unsegmented.

UBERON:4300104.name: ectocoracoid bone
UBERON:4300104.def: A paired dermal bone in Gasterosteiformes connected with the coracoid and extending posteriorly. Has also been applied to the element below the scapula and applied to the coracoid in Dipnoi. Dictionary of Ichthyology.

UBERON:4300105.name: caudal vertebra 1
UBERON:4300105.def: Caudal vertebra that is the anteriormost element of the series.

UBERON:4300106.name: ventral limb of posttemporal
UBERON:4300106.def: Zone of bone organ that is the ventral extension of the posttemporal.

UBERON:4300108.name: lepidotrichial segment
UBERON:4300108.def: Zone of bone organ that is part of a lepidotrich and connected to other segments by collagen fibers. These segments lend flexibility to the lepidtrich.

UBERON:4300109.name: proximal segment of caudal ray
UBERON:4300109.def: Lepidotrichial segment that is part of the proximal region of a caudal fin ray.

UBERON:4300111.name: lateral ethmoid element
UBERON:4300111.def: Endochondral element that separates the olfactory region from the orbit, extends medially to meet its fellow medially below the frontal bones and is bordered by the mesethmoid anteriorly. It may articulate with the autopalatine and infraorbital 1 laterally. The lateral ethmoid is paired.

UBERON:4300112.name: distal segment of caudal ray
UBERON:4300112.def: Lepidotrichial segment that is part of the distal region of a caudal fin ray.

UBERON:4300114.name: pelvic sucking disc
UBERON:4300114.def: An adhesive disk modified from the pelvic fins in, for example, clingfishes (Gobiesocidae), gobies (Gobiidae) and snailfishes (Liparidae).

UBERON:4300115.name: sucking disc
UBERON:4300115.def: Distinctive first dorsal fin taking the form of a modified oval sucker-like organ with slat-like structures that open and close to create suction and take a firm hold against the skin of larger marine animals.

UBERON:4300116.name: dorsal fin ray
UBERON:4300116.def: Soft ray that is part of the dorsal fin.

UBERON:4300117.name: pelvic fin ray
UBERON:4300117.def: Soft ray that is part of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:4300119.name: glenoid region
UBERON:4300119.def: Region surrounding the glenoid fossa on the scapulocoracoid.

UBERON:4300120.name: spinous region of dorsal fin
UBERON:4300120.def: Region of dorsal fin that is composed of spinous rays (vs soft rays).

UBERON:4300121.name: zygantrum
UBERON:4300121.def: A fossa on the posterior median part of the neural arch of a vertebra (as of a snake) that accommodates the zygosphene of the next vertebra.

UBERON:4300122.name: obsolete postzygapophysis
UBERON:4300122.def: Posteriorly projecting processes allowing de facto contact between consecutive vertebrae (some soft tissues are also present) via articular facets.

UBERON:4300123.name: pre-axial region
UBERON:4300123.def: Anatomical region lying to the anterior or dorsal side of the metapterygial axis.

UBERON:4300124.name: axis intercentrum
UBERON:4300124.def: The intercentrum unit of the axis vertebra. .

UBERON:4300125.name: dorsal iliac ridge
UBERON:4300125.def: Ridge that is part of the ilium.

UBERON:4300126.name: tectorial restraint system
UBERON:4300126.def: Tectorial restraint system is a type of ciliary restraint system for hair cells in the inner ear.  In tectorial restraint systems, the tectorial membrane restrains the cilia of the hair cells by attaching either directly to ciliary tufts or indirectly through various kinds of fibrous structure (simple fibers, fibrous strands, finger-like processes, tectorial plates) [Phylogenetic Relationships of the Lizard Families: Essays Commemorating Charles L. Camp. 1988. Eds. R Estes, GK Pregill. Stanford University Press].

UBERON:4300127.name: nuchal crest
UBERON:4300127.def: Bony protuberance on the external surface of the occipital bone.[PHENOSCAPE:AD].

UBERON:4300128.name: sacral rib
UBERON:4300128.def: Elements of the sacrum joining true sacral vertebrae to pelvis [12th edition of Henderson's Dictionary of Biological terms].

UBERON:4300129.name: dorsal pelvic gland
UBERON:4300129.def: Cloacal glands that secrete into the dorsal roof of the cloacal tube and or the anterior cloacal chamber. Found in male salamanders.

UBERON:4300132.name: glossopharyngeal nerve foramen
UBERON:4300132.def: Foramen for the passage of the glossopharyngeal nerve IX.

UBERON:4300133.name: upper jaw symphyseal region
UBERON:4300133.def: The region of the upper jaw on or near the midline.

UBERON:4300134.name: lateral commissure
UBERON:4300134.def: Region of the braincase which bears the facets for the hyomandibula in fishes. This region disappears in the origin of tetrapods and the space it occipied comes to contribute to the fenestra vestibulii. Clack, JA, 2001. Ch. 23, The otoccipital region. In Major Events in Early Vertebrate Evolution. Per Ahlberg editor.

UBERON:4300135.name: upper jaw symphyseal tooth
UBERON:4300135.def: Tooth of the upper jaw that is adjacent to the upper jaw symphysis.

UBERON:4300137.name: lingual region
UBERON:4300137.def: The region of an anatomical structure (such as a tooth or jaw bone) facing the tongue.

UBERON:4300138.name: labial region
UBERON:4300138.def: The region of an anatomical structure, such as a tooth or jaw bone, facing the lips.[PHENOSCAPE:WD].

UBERON:4300139.name: posterolingual region
UBERON:4300139.def: The region of an anatomical structure, such as a tooth or jaw bone, oriented posteriorly and facing the lips.

UBERON:4300140.name: mesial region
UBERON:4300140.def: The region of an anatomical structure, such as a tooth or jaw bone, facing the midline of the jaw.

UBERON:4300142.name: internal carotid foramen
UBERON:4300142.def: Foramen for the passage of the internal carotid artery.

UBERON:4300144.name: profundus foramen
UBERON:4300144.def: Foramen for the profundus or ophthalmic nerve.

UBERON:4300147.name: pectoral fin base
UBERON:4300147.def: Subdivision of organism that is the basal region of the pectoral fin.

UBERON:4300150.name: gill membrane
UBERON:4300150.def: Membrane organ that is usually supported by branchiostegal rays and forms the ventral and posterior wall of the gill cavity.

UBERON:4300151.name: pelvic intercleithral cartilage
UBERON:4300151.def: Cartilage element that lies between processes of the cleithrum and pelvic girdle in gobioid fishes. Posterodorsal to the ventral end of each cleithrum is a posteriorly projecting process. The pelvic intercleithral cartilage (an unpaired, median structure) forms a bridge between the processes (From Springer, 1983).

UBERON:4300152.name: accessory nasal sac
UBERON:4300152.def: Accessory nasal sacs are found in a variety of teleosts (Webb, 1993) and likely assist in ventilating the olfactory epithelium by transmitting pressure fluctuations associated with gill irrigation from theoral cavity to the nasal (or sensory) sac (Jakubowski,1975; Webb, 1993; Belanger et al., 2003). [def from Eastman, J. T. and Lannoo, M. J. (2004)].

UBERON:4300153.name: Sharpey's fiber
UBERON:4300153.def: Sharpey's fibres (bone fibres, or perforating fibres) are a matrix of connective tissue consisting of bundles of strong collagenous fibres connecting periosteum to bone. They are part of the outer fibrous layer of periosteum, entering into the outer circumferential and interstitial lamellae of bone tissue.

UBERON:4300154.name: procurrent spur
UBERON:4300154.def: A ventrally projecting spur on the posteriormost ventral procurrent caudal ray overlapping ventrally the preceding ray in various percomorphs (Johnson, 1975).

UBERON:4300155.name: pectoral splint
UBERON:4300155.def: Unpaired bone that covers the base of the first pectoral ray. [Filleul and Lavoué 2001].

UBERON:4300157.name: midshaft
UBERON:4300157.def: Region in the middle of the shaft of a long bone (e.g. humerus, femur etc).

UBERON:4300172.name: pectoral fin bud
UBERON:4300172.def: A paired fin bud that develops into a pectoral fin.

UBERON:4300173.name: pelvic fin bud
UBERON:4300173.def: A paired fin bud that develops into a pelvic fin.

UBERON:4300174.name: actinopterygian pyloric caecum
UBERON:4300174.def: A finger-like out-pocketing of the intestine where it meets the end of the stomach (pylorus). Also spelled cecum (ceca). Serves to aid digestion.

UBERON:4300175.name: procumbent dorsal fin spine
UBERON:4300175.def: Fin spine that precedes the dorsal fin, oriented anteriorly towards the head of the fish.

UBERON:4300176.name: parietal branch of the supraorbital canal
UBERON:4300176.def: Branch of supraorbital sensory canal that extends to the parietal.

UBERON:4300177.name: replacement tooth row
UBERON:4300177.def: Tooth row consisting of replacement teeth.

UBERON:4300178.name: inner tooth row of dentary
UBERON:4300178.def: Dentary tooth row that is lingual in position relative to other tooth rows.

UBERON:4300179.name: inner tooth row of premaxilla
UBERON:4300179.def: Tooth row on the premaxilla that is lingually located relative to other tooth rows.

UBERON:4300180.name: isthmus
UBERON:4300180.def: The fleshy throat region of a fish which extends forward from the ventral part of the chest and narrows anteriorly, and externally separating the two gill chambers; that narrowed portion of the breast which lies between the gill chambers and separates them.

UBERON:4300181.name: posterior sclerotic cartilage
UBERON:4300181.def: Sclerotic cartilage that is located posterior to the eye.

UBERON:4300182.name: anterior sclerotic cartilage
UBERON:4300182.def: Sclerotic cartilage that is located anterior to the eye.

UBERON:4300184.name: neural spine 5
UBERON:4300184.def: Neural spine that is associated with the fifth vertebra.

UBERON:4300185.name: neural spine 6
UBERON:4300185.def: Neural spine that is associated with the sixth vertebra.

UBERON:4300186.name: neural spine 7
UBERON:4300186.def: Neural spine that is associated with the seventh vertebra.

UBERON:4300188.name: terminal scale
UBERON:4300188.def: The posteriormost scale in a scale series.

UBERON:4300189.name: parapophysis 3
UBERON:4300189.def: Parapophysis that is the lateral projection from the third centrum. Parapophysis 3 is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:4300190.name: claustrum element
UBERON:4300190.def: Postcranial axial skeletal element and Weberian ossicle that is located dorsal to the scaphium. The claustrum skeletal element is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:4300192.name: branched pelvic fin ray
UBERON:4300192.def: Pelvic fin lepidotrichium that is distally branched and segmented.

UBERON:4300193.name: unbranched anal fin ray
UBERON:4300193.def: Anal fin lepidotrichium that is not distally branched.

UBERON:4300194.name: photophore
UBERON:4300194.def: A light-emitting organ which appears as luminous spots on various marine animals, including fish and cephalopods.

UBERON:4300195.name: rostral tubule
UBERON:4300195.def: Consists of a set of tubuli occupying the space between the external dermal bones above the dorsal and anterior wal of the nasal capsule below. Thomson and Campbell (1971).

UBERON:4300197.name: Westoll line
UBERON:4300197.def: More or less concentric lines of discontinuity in the cosmine of Dipnoi, probably due to cyclic resorption and redeposition during growth occurring on the bases of individual scales and also as large structures between headshield plates.[Fishbase].

UBERON:4300198.name: epichordal radial
UBERON:4300198.def: Radial found above the vertebral column.

UBERON:4300199.name: postsplenial
UBERON:4300199.def: Dermal bone of the lower jaw.

UBERON:4300200.name: postparietal shield
UBERON:4300200.def: Dermal bones (postparietals, supratemporals, intertemporals, extrascapulars) posterior to the intracranial joint. Forey 1997.

UBERON:4300201.name: subepiotic fossa
UBERON:4300201.def: Fossa for epaxial musculature inserting on the braincase. Forey et al. 1996.

UBERON:4300202.name: endoskeletal cranial joint
UBERON:4300202.def: The braincase of most plesiomorphic sarcopterygians is divided by the intracranial point into ethmosphenoid and otic-occipital portions each covered by dermal bones. The function of the joint is presumably to increase the gape of the mouth rapidly during opening phases. (Forey 1997).

UBERON:4300203.name: tectum orbitale
UBERON:4300203.def: The dorsal portion of the endocranium that covers the orbital region. Hanken and Hall (1993).

UBERON:4300204.name: obsolete accessory nasal sac
UBERON:4300204.def: Structures that communicate with the main olfactory chamber and may be located posterior, ventral, or dorsal to it [De Pinna, 1996].

UBERON:4300205.name: palato-maxillary ligament
UBERON:4300205.def: Ligament between the palatine and maxilla [Stiassny 1986].

UBERON:4300206.name: mandibulo-lacrimal ligament
UBERON:4300206.def: Ligament that connects the ventromedial end of the lacrimal to the anguloarticular (or 'mandible'). Parenti (2008).

UBERON:4300208.name: submandibular series
UBERON:4300208.def: A series of plate like bones found ventrally to the jaw.

UBERON:4300210.name: transversus epibranchialis 2
UBERON:4300210.def: Dorsal gill-arch muscle connecting right and left epibranchial 2s. Springer and Johnson (2015).

UBERON:4300211.name: lateral plate
UBERON:4300211.def: Body plates on the lateral sides of the body that occur as single bilateral rows and their number is highly heritable. Bell and Richkind (1981).

UBERON:4300212.name: acrodin
UBERON:4300212.def: Odontoid tissue forming a cap on teeth found in teeth of actinopterygian fishes.

UBERON:4300213.name: supraneural 1 element
UBERON:4300213.def: Postcranial axial skeletal element located dorsal to vertebra 1.

UBERON:4300214.name: supraneural 2 element
UBERON:4300214.def: Postcranial axial skeletal element located dorsal to vertebra 2.

UBERON:4300215.name: supraneural 3 element
UBERON:4300215.def: Postcranial axial skeletal element located dorsal to vertebrae 3 and 4.

UBERON:4300216.name: supraneural 4 element
UBERON:4300216.def: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 4.

UBERON:4300217.name: supraneural 5 element
UBERON:4300217.def: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 5.

UBERON:4300218.name: supraneural 6 element
UBERON:4300218.def: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 6.

UBERON:4300219.name: supraneural 7 element
UBERON:4300219.def: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 7.

UBERON:4300220.name: supraneural 8 element
UBERON:4300220.def: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 8.

UBERON:4300221.name: supraneural 9 element
UBERON:4300221.def: Supraneural element dorsal to neural spine 9.

UBERON:4300222.name: axilar scale
UBERON:4300222.def: Scale that is adjacent to the pelvic fin and aligned with the origin of the pelvic fin. It is typically an elongate scale.[Mattox and Toledo-Piza 2012].

UBERON:4300223.name: precaudal vertebra
UBERON:4300223.def: Vertebral bone lacking hemal spines (Weitzman, 1962), refers generally to the anterior vertebral region bounding the abdominal cavity. Alternate but not quite synonymous terms are abdominal or trunk vertebrae, which bear parapophyses and ribs. In many actinopterygians dorsal to the posterior abdominal cavity there are transitional vertebrae lacking ribs but also without hemal spines or sometimes even enclosed hemal arches. The primary definition would identify these vertebrae as precaudal. Bird and Mabee, 2003.

UBERON:4300224.name: precaudal vertebra endochondral element
UBERON:4300224.def: Vertebral elements lacking hemal spines (Weitzman, 1962), refers generally to the anterior vertebral region bounding the abdominal cavity. Alternate but not quite synonymous terms are abdominal or trunk vertebrae, which bear parapophyses and ribs. In many actinopterygians dorsal to the posterior abdominal cavity there are transitional vertebrae lacking ribs but also without hemal spines or sometimes even enclosed hemal arches. The primary definition would identify these vertebrae as precaudal.(Bird and Mabee, 2003).

UBERON:4300225.name: precaudal vertebra cartilage element
UBERON:4300225.def: Vertebral cartilage elements lacking hemal spines (Weitzman, 1962), refers generally to the anterior vertebral region bounding the abdominal cavity. Alternate but not quite synonymous terms are abdominal or trunk vertebrae, which bear parapophyses and ribs. In many actinopterygians dorsal to the posterior abdominal cavity there are transitional vertebrae lacking ribs but also without hemal spines or sometimes even enclosed hemal arches. The primary definition would identify these vertebrae as precaudal.(Bird and Mabee, 2003).

UBERON:4300226.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a forelimb bud.

UBERON:4300227.name: hindlimb bud mesenchyme
UBERON:4300227.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a hindlimb bud.

UBERON:4300228.name: pectoral fin bud mesenchyme
UBERON:4300228.def: Mesechyme that is part of a pectoral fin bud.

UBERON:4300229.name: pelvic fin bud mesenchyme
UBERON:4300229.def: Mesechyme that is part of a pelvic fin bud.

UBERON:4300230.name: forelimb wing bud
UBERON:4300230.def: A wing bud that develops into a wing.

UBERON:4300231.name: forelimb wing bud mesenchyme
UBERON:4300231.def: Mesenchyme that is part of a forelimb wing bud.

UBERON:4300233.name: mammiliform tooth
UBERON:4300233.def: Calcareous tooth with a hyptertrophied base.

UBERON:4300234.name: scale sheath
UBERON:4300234.def: Series of scales in which each scale envelopes or overlaps an adjacent scale.

UBERON:4300235.name: spinoid scale
UBERON:4300235.def: A cycloid scale bearing a serrated margin; superficially similar to ctenoid scales but having spines as outgrowths of the scale as oppose to true ctenii.

UBERON:4300236.name: rib of vertebra 7
UBERON:4300236.def: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the seventh centrum.

UBERON:4300237.name: rib of vertebra 8
UBERON:4300237.def: Rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the eighth centrum.

UBERON:4300239.name: hind flipper
UBERON:4300239.def: Hindlimb that is used to propel an animal through water.

UBERON:4300240.name: rostral ossicle
UBERON:4300240.def: Ossicle that surrounds the sensory canals of the snout when passing from the ethmoidal commissure to the infraorbital series and have first been noticed by Nybelin [14] in Elops. From: Filleul and Lavoué. (2001). Basal teleosts and the question of elopomorph monophyly. Morphological and molecular approaches. Comptes rendus de l'Académie des sciences. Série III, Sciences de la vie. 324. 393-9. 10.1016/S0764-4469(00)01302-0.

UBERON:4300241.name: ethmoid commissure
UBERON:4300241.def: Sensory canal that traverses the rostral bone.

UBERON:4300242.name: lateral line scale 6
UBERON:4300242.def: The sixth scale in the lateral line series.

UBERON:4300243.name: premaxillary tooth 2
UBERON:4300243.def: Premaxillary tooth that is the second tooth in a premaxillary tooth series, and positioned adjacent to the symphyseal tooth.

UBERON:4300244.name: premaxillary tooth 3
UBERON:4300244.def: Premaxillary tooth that is the third tooth in a premaxillary tooth series, and positioned adjacent to the second tooth.

UBERON:4300246.name: dentary tooth 2
UBERON:4300246.def: Dentary tooth that is the second tooth in a dentary tooth series, and positioned adjacent to the symphyseal tooth.

UBERON:4300247.name: dentary tooth 3
UBERON:4300247.def: Dentary tooth that is the third tooth in a dentary tooth series, and positioned adjacent to the symphyseal tooth.

UBERON:4300248.name: fused hypural 1 and 2
UBERON:4300248.def: Single hypural element formed from the fusion of hypural 1 and 2.

UBERON:4300249.name: lateral occipital foramen
UBERON:4300249.def: Foramen that has the exoccipital as the anterior and dorsal rim. The occipital forms the anterior rim during early development. [database_cross_reference: GOC:cvs][database_cross_reference: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2244-7917][database_cross_reference: ZFIN:ZDB-PUB-961014-192].

UBERON:4300252.name: ethmo-palatine cartilage
UBERON:4300252.def: The ethmo-palatine cartilage (EPC) is a distinct body situated between the posterior surface of the upper arm of the premaxilla and the anterior margin of the palatine. There is usually only a single cartilage mass lying between these bones, although that cartilage is apparently subdivided into two units in some taxa (e.g., the Old World characiform family Citharinidae, Vari, 1979:294). Vari 1989a.

UBERON:4300261.name: pectoral fin hook
UBERON:4300261.def: Process that is part of the pectoral fin lepidotrichium.

UBERON:4300262.name: pelvic fin hook
UBERON:4300262.def: Process that is part of the pelvic fin lepidotrichium.

UBERON:4300269.name: epioccipital bridge
UBERON:4300269.def: Extension of the exoccipital that extends over the posttemporal fossa.

UBERON:4300270.name: outer tooth row of premaxilla
UBERON:4300270.def: Tooth row on the premaxilla that is labially located relative to other tooth rows.

UBERON:4300271.name: interneural spine cartilage
UBERON:4300271.def: Cartilage element adjacent to neural spine of preural centrum.

UBERON:4300272.name: interhaemal spine cartilage
UBERON:4300272.def: Cartilage element adjacent to haemal spine of preural centrum.

UBERON:4300274.name: adipose fin ray
UBERON:4300274.def: Soft ray that is part of the adipose fin.

UBERON:4300275.name: suborbital stay
UBERON:4300275.def: A backwards extension of the third circumorbital bone (part of the lateral head/cheek skeleton, below the eye socket) across the cheek to the preoperculum, to which it is connected in most species [wikipedia].

UBERON:4300279.name: outer tooth row of dentary
UBERON:4300279.def: Dentary tooth row that is labial in position relative to other tooth rows.

UBERON:4300280.name: metapterygoid tooth
UBERON:4300280.def: Tooth that is attached to the metapterygoid.

UBERON:4300281.name: dorsal fin hook
UBERON:4300281.def: Anatomical projection that is part of the anal fin lepidotrichium.

UBERON:4300282.name: dorsal myorhabdoid bone
UBERON:4300282.def: Myorhabdoid bones located dorsal to the epineurals.

UBERON:4300283.name: ventral myorhabdoid bone
UBERON:4300283.def: Myorhabdoid bones located ventral to the epipleurals.

UBERON:4300284.name: fin hook
UBERON:4300284.def: Anatomical projection that is part of a fin.

UBERON:4300285.name: second preethmoid cartilage
UBERON:4300285.def: Cartilage element found between the preethmoid and maxilla.

UBERON:4300286.name: second preethmoid element
UBERON:4300286.def: Endochondral skeletal element found between the preethmoid and maxilla.

UBERON:4300287.name: nasal barbel
UBERON:4300287.def: Barbel that is associated with a nostril. Nasal barbels are paired.

UBERON:4300288.name: rictal barbel
UBERON:4300288.def: Barbel located from the fleshy corner of the mouth.

UBERON:4400000.name: metapterygium cartilage
UBERON:4400000.def: The posterior and innermost of the three principal basal cartilages in the fins of fishes.

UBERON:4400001.name: ceratotrichium
UBERON:4400001.def: Elastoidin fin ray that is thickened, generally unbranched and found in the fins of Chondrichthyes.

UBERON:4400005.name: fin ray
UBERON:4400005.def: A rod-like entity that functions in support of fin folds and fins.

UBERON:4400006.name: elastoidin fin ray
UBERON:4400006.def: Fin ray that is composed of elastoidin, unmineralized, and unsegmented.

UBERON:4400007.name: camptotrichium
UBERON:4400007.def: Fin ray found in dipnoans that are composed of a superficial region of acellular fibrous bone, and a deep, mostly unmineralized, zone (Géraudie and Meunier 1982).

UBERON:4440011.name: paired fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:4440011.def: Lepidotrichium that is part of a paired fin.

UBERON:4500002.name: upper uroneural
UBERON:4500002.def: Uroneurals that form the uppermost three uroneural series that overlap, and lie at an angle to, longer anterior ones.

UBERON:4500003.name: predorsal scale
UBERON:4500003.def: Scale that is part of row along the midline between the dorsal fin and the back of the skull. In counting, all scales crossing the midline are included. (Fishbase) .

UBERON:4500004.name: adipose fin skeleton
UBERON:4500004.def: Median fin skeleton supporting the adipose fin.

UBERON:4500005.name: prenasal ossicle
UBERON:4500005.def: Tubular ossifications around extension of nasal lateral line canal in fishes; typically one or two.

UBERON:4500006.name: anal fin ray
UBERON:4500006.def: Soft ray that is part of the anal fin.

UBERON:4500007.name: pectoral fin ray
UBERON:4500007.def: Soft ray that is part of the pectoral fin.

UBERON:4500008.name: median fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:4500008.def: Lepidotrichium that is part of a median fin.

UBERON:4500009.name: paired fin spine

UBERON:4500020.name: pelvic fin distal radial cartilage

UBERON:5111981.def: A subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of manual digit 6 plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:5111983.def: A subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of manual digit 8 plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:5111984.name: pedal digit 6 digitopodial skeleton
UBERON:5111984.def: A subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of pedal digit 6 plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:5112137.name: pedal digit 7 digitopodial skeleton
UBERON:5112137.def: A subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of pedal digit 7 plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:5112138.name: pedal digit 8 digitopodial skeleton
UBERON:5112138.def: A subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of pedal digit 8 plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:5112260.name: alular digit digitopodial skeleton
UBERON:5112260.def: A subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of alular digit plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:5112261.name: manual major digit (Aves) digitopodial skeleton
UBERON:5112261.def: A subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of manual major digit (Aves) plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:5112262.def: A subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of manual minor digit (Aves) plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:6000002.name: arthropod tagma
UBERON:6000002.def: One of the main divisions of the whole organism of arthropods formed from groups of segments.

UBERON:6000005.name: insect ocular segment
UBERON:6000005.def: Head segment derived from the second embryonic segment (between the labral and antennal segments). In the larva, this segment includes Bolwig's organ.

UBERON:6000006.name: insect head segment
UBERON:6000006.def: Any segment that is part of some insect head.

UBERON:6000007.name: procephalic segment
UBERON:6000007.def: A segment that is anterior to the gnathal segments.

UBERON:6000008.name: labral segment
UBERON:6000008.def: Procephalic segment anterior to the antennal segment. In the adult it bears the clypeo-labrum.

UBERON:6000009.name: antennal segment
UBERON:6000009.def: Segment anterior to the intercalary segment. In the adult it bears the antennae.

UBERON:6000011.name: insect gnathal segment
UBERON:6000011.def: The head segments that develop posterior to the embryonic/larval mouth.

UBERON:6000014.name: insect labial segment
UBERON:6000014.def: Most posterior of the gnathal segments. In the adult it bears a pair of fused appendages, the labia, and its ectodermal invaginations give rise to the salivary glands.

UBERON:6000015.name: insect thorax
UBERON:6000015.def: The main middle section of the insect body comprising three thoracic rings: the pro-, the meso- and the metathoraces which are more or less well fused and cask-like sometimes having on the upper lateral part one of two pairs of wings, while on the ventrolateral part each thoracic ring bears a pair of legs.

UBERON:6000016.name: insect thoracic segment
UBERON:6000016.def: Any segment (UBERON:6000003) that is part of some thorax (UBERON:6000015).

UBERON:6000017.name: insect prothoracic segment
UBERON:6000017.def: The first (most anterior) segment of the thorax.

UBERON:6000018.name: insect mesothoracic segment
UBERON:6000018.def: The second (middle) segment of the thorax.

UBERON:6000019.name: insect metathoracic segment
UBERON:6000019.def: The third (most posterior) segment of the thorax.

UBERON:6000020.name: insect abdomen
UBERON:6000020.def: The most posterior of the three tagma (UBERON:6000002).

UBERON:6000046.name: insect dorsal appendage
UBERON:6000046.def: Paired appendage of the eggshell, located on the anterior-dorsal side of the egg, just posterior to the operculum. Functions as a respiratory structures.

UBERON:6000094.name: obsolete clypeo-labral anlage in statu nascendi

UBERON:6000119.name: insect anterior ectoderm
UBERON:6000119.def: The region of the ectoderm anterior to the cephalic furrow.

UBERON:6000128.name: insect trunk mesoderm
UBERON:6000128.def: The mesoderm of segments T1-A9. It first becomes morphologically distinct during ventral furrow formation. Following invagination during stages 6 and 7, it remains a coherent structure with no morphologically apparent subdivisions, apart from transient metamery during stage 9, until stage 11. It undergoes a number of morphological changes during this period: as its cells divide following invagination, it loses its epithelial integrity and by stage 9 has rearranged into a monolayer of cuboidal cells. A further division happens during stage 10 leading to two distinct layers by stage 11.

UBERON:6000132.name: insect mesodermal crest of segment T3

UBERON:6000137.name: embryonic tagma
UBERON:6000137.def: Any tagma (UBERON:6000002) that is part of some embryo (UBERON:6000052).

UBERON:6000154.name: insect embryonic segment
UBERON:6000154.def: Any insect segment that is part of some embryo.

UBERON:6000157.name: insect embryonic head segment
UBERON:6000157.def: Any segment that is part of some insect embryonic head.

UBERON:6000158.name: insect embryonic procephalic segment
UBERON:6000158.def: Any procephalic segment (UBERON:6000007) that is part of some embryonic head (UBERON:6000155) in an insect.

UBERON:6000160.name: insect embryonic antennal segment
UBERON:6000160.def: Any antennal segment (UBERON:6000009) that is part of some embryonic head (UBERON:6000155).

UBERON:6000162.name: insect embryonic gnathal segment
UBERON:6000162.def: Any gnathal segment (UBERON:6000011) that is part of some embryonic head (UBERON:6000155).

UBERON:6000165.name: insect embryonic labial segment
UBERON:6000165.def: Any labial segment (UBERON:6000014) that is part of some embryonic head (UBERON:6000155).

UBERON:6000166.name: insect embryonic thorax
UBERON:6000166.def: Any thorax (UBERON:6000015) that is part of some embryo (UBERON:6000052).

UBERON:6000167.name: insect embryonic thoracic segment
UBERON:6000167.def: Any segment (UBERON:6000003) that is part of some embryonic thorax (UBERON:6000166).

UBERON:6000172.name: insect embryonic abdominal segment
UBERON:6000172.def: Metameric subdivision of the embryonic abdomen.

UBERON:6000180.name: insect embryonic abdominal segment 8
UBERON:6000180.def: Any abdominal segment 8 (UBERON:6000029) that is part of some embryonic abdomen (UBERON:6000171).

UBERON:6000181.name: insect embryonic abdominal segment 9
UBERON:6000181.def: Any abdominal segment 9 (UBERON:6000030) that is part of some embryonic abdomen (UBERON:6000171).

UBERON:6000186.name: insect embryonic optic lobe primordium
UBERON:6000186.def: Primordium of the insect embryo that gives rises to the embryonic/larval optic anlage.

UBERON:6001055.name: insect presumptive embryonic/larval nervous system
UBERON:6001055.def: The sum of all the structures in the embryo that will develop into the embryonic/larval nervous system.

UBERON:6001056.name: insect presumptive embryonic/larval central nervous system
UBERON:6001056.def: The sum of all the structures in the embryo that will develop into the embryonic/larval central nervous system.

UBERON:6001135.name: insect proneural cluster
UBERON:6001135.def: An equivalence group of the neurectoderm where all cells can, although only one will, become a neural progenitor cell.

UBERON:6001648.name: insect embryonic imaginal precursor
UBERON:6001648.def: Embryonic structure that will proliferate during larval development into a larval imaginal disc. During early embryogenesis the precursor is part of the epithelial sheet before segregating from the epithelial sheet by late embryogenesis (Bate and Martinez Arias, 1991).

UBERON:6001649.name: insect imaginal disc primordium
UBERON:6001649.def: Population of contiguous, morphologically distinct cells that will form an imaginal disc.

UBERON:6001650.name: insect labial disc primordium
UBERON:6001650.def: Primordium that will form the labial disc.

UBERON:6001652.name: insect eye-antennal disc primordium
UBERON:6001652.def: Primordium from which the eye-antennal disc develops.

UBERON:6001661.name: insect genital disc primordium
UBERON:6001661.def: Primordium from which the genital disc develops.

UBERON:6001662.name: insect male genital disc primordium
UBERON:6001662.def: Primordium from which the male genital disc derives.

UBERON:6001663.name: insect female genital disc primordium
UBERON:6001663.def: Primordium from which the female genital disc derives.

UBERON:6001664.name: insect embryonic/larval circulatory system
UBERON:6001664.def: Tubular system of the embryo/larva through which hemolymph flows.

UBERON:6001668.name: insect embryonic/larval lymph gland
UBERON:6001668.def: Hematopoietic organ of the larva, located along the dorsal vessel, behind the brain. It produces the plasmatocytes, crystal cells and lamellocytes which are released at the end of the larval instar and onset of metamorphosis. It is composed of 3 pairs of bilateral lobes: an anterior primary lobe, a posterior secondary lobe and the most posterior lobe (or multiple lobes), the tertiary lobe. Each lobe is separated by pericardial cells. In the late embryo, the lymph gland consists of a single pair of lobes (primary lobes) containing around 20 cells each that flank the dorsal vessel. By the second larval instar, the lymph gland is composed of two or three new pairs of posterior lobes, and the primary lobes have increased in size to contain around 200 cells. During the first and early second larval instars, the lymph gland comprises only the hematopoietic progenitor population. The lymph gland increases in size ten-fold by the late third instar, and at this stage the progenitor cells (prohemocytes) become restricted to the medial region (medullary zone) of the primary lobe and become quiescent. The differentiated hemocytes are found in the periphery (cortical zone) of the primary lobe and these cells proliferate extensively. The posterior signalling center is a group of about 30 cells at the posterior tip of the primary lobe that secretes several signalling molecules and functions as a stem-cell niche. The secondary and tertiary lobes contain prohemocytes, and rarely a differentiated cell. Lymph glands are eliminated at metamorphosis.

UBERON:6001722.name: insect ring gland
UBERON:6001722.def: A closely associated cluster of three neuroendocrine glands located anterior to the aorta and dorsal to the esophagus. At embryonic stage 17 and in larva it is found anterior to the brain and is formed by the corpus cardiacum ventrally, the prothoracic gland laterally and the corpus allatum dorsally. The adult ring gland is located anterior to the proventriculus and is formed by the corpus cardiacum ventrally, the corpus allatum dorsally and the hypocerebral ganglion posterior to the corpus cardiacum. It is innervated by neurons of the nervus corporis cardiaci (NccI-III).

UBERON:6001728.name: insect larval tagma
UBERON:6001728.def: Any tagma (UBERON:6000002) that is part of some larva (UBERON:6001727).

UBERON:6001729.name: insect larval segment
UBERON:6001729.def: Any segment that is part of some larva.

UBERON:6001730.name: insect larval head
UBERON:6001730.def: Any head that is part of some larva.

UBERON:6001731.name: insect larval ocular segment
UBERON:6001731.def: Any ocular segment (UBERON:6000005) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

UBERON:6001732.name: insect larval head segment
UBERON:6001732.def: Any segment that is part of some larval head.

UBERON:6001733.name: insect larval procephalic segment
UBERON:6001733.def: Any procephalic segment (UBERON:6000007) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

UBERON:6001734.name: insect larval labral segment
UBERON:6001734.def: Any labral segment (UBERON:6000008) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

UBERON:6001735.name: insect larval antennal segment
UBERON:6001735.def: Any antennal segment (UBERON:6000009) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

UBERON:6001737.name: insect larval gnathal segment
UBERON:6001737.def: Any gnathal segment (UBERON:6000011) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

UBERON:6001740.name: insect larval labial segment
UBERON:6001740.def: Any labial segment (UBERON:6000014) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

UBERON:6001741.name: insect larval thorax
UBERON:6001741.def: Any thorax (UBERON:6000015) that is part of some larva (UBERON:6001727).

UBERON:6001742.name: insect larval thoracic segment
UBERON:6001742.def: Any segment (UBERON:6000003) that is part of some larval thorax (UBERON:6001741).

UBERON:6001743.name: insect larval prothoracic segment
UBERON:6001743.def: Any prothoracic segment (UBERON:6000017) that is part of some larval thorax (UBERON:6001741).

UBERON:6001744.name: insect larval mesothoracic segment
UBERON:6001744.def: Any mesothoracic segment (UBERON:6000018) that is part of some larval thorax (UBERON:6001741).

UBERON:6001745.name: insect larval metathoracic segment
UBERON:6001745.def: Any metathoracic segment (UBERON:6000019) that is part of some larval thorax (UBERON:6001741).

UBERON:6001746.name: insect larval abdomen
UBERON:6001746.def: Any abdomen (UBERON:6000020) that is part of some larva (UBERON:6001727).

UBERON:6001747.name: insect larval abdominal segment
UBERON:6001747.def: Any segment (UBERON:6000003) that is part of some larval abdomen (UBERON:6001746).

UBERON:6001755.name: insect larval abdominal segment 8
UBERON:6001755.def: Any abdominal segment 8 (UBERON:6000029) that is part of some larval abdomen (UBERON:6001746).

UBERON:6001756.name: insect larval abdominal segment 9
UBERON:6001756.def: Any abdominal segment 9 (UBERON:6000030) that is part of some larval abdomen (UBERON:6001746).

UBERON:6001760.name: insect embryonic/larval imaginal precursor
UBERON:6001760.def: Imaginal precursor that is part of the embryo/larva.

UBERON:6001764.name: insect labial disc
UBERON:6001764.def: Imaginal disc that, in the adult, gives rise to the proboscis, including the prementum, prestomal cavity, labellum, labellar cap and pseudotrachea (Cohen, 1993).

UBERON:6001765.name: insect clypeo-labral disc
UBERON:6001765.def: Imaginal disc that in the adults gives rise to the labrum, anterior and posterior cibarial plates, fish trap bristles, epipharyngeal sclerite and clypeus (Cohen, 1993).

UBERON:6001766.name: insect eye-antennal disc
UBERON:6001766.def: Imaginal disc that, in the adults, gives rise to the eye, antenna, head capsule (including all bristles and external membranes) and the maxillary palps (Cohen, 1993).

UBERON:6001767.name: insect antennal disc
UBERON:6001767.def: Posterior portion of the eye-antennal disc. It gives rise to the adult antennal segments and the maxillary palp, as well as contributing to the head capsule.

UBERON:6001776.name: insect dorsal thoracic disc
UBERON:6001776.def: Imaginal disc that is a precursor of dorsal thoracic structures of the adult.

UBERON:6001778.name: insect wing disc
UBERON:6001778.def: Dorsal imaginal disc of the mesothorax. Precursor of dorsal mesothoracic structures of the adult including the postnotum, scutum, scutellum, wing, wing hinge and part of the notal pleura.

UBERON:6001779.name: insect haltere disc
UBERON:6001779.def: Dorsal imaginal disc of the metathorax. Precursor of structure of the adult dorsal metathorax including the haltere.

UBERON:6001780.name: insect ventral thoracic disc
UBERON:6001780.def: Imaginal disc that is a precursor of ventral thoracic structures of the adult.

UBERON:6001781.name: insect prothoracic leg disc
UBERON:6001781.def: Imaginal disc of the ventral prothoracic segment. Precursor of structures of the adult ventral prothorax including the prothoracic (1st) leg.

UBERON:6001784.name: insect genital disc
UBERON:6001784.def: Imaginal disc that gives rise to the internal and external genitalia, analia and adult hind gut (Cohen, 1993).

UBERON:6001785.name: insect male genital disc
UBERON:6001785.def: Genital disc that gives rise to the penis and external genitalia, sperm pump, ejaculatory duct, paragonia and vas deferens, anal plates and adult hindgut (Cohen, 1993).

UBERON:6001787.name: insect female genital disc
UBERON:6001787.def: Genital disc that gives rise to the vagina and vaginal plates, uterus, parovaria, spermatheca, seminal recepticle, oviducts, female analia and hindgut. (Cohen, 1993).

UBERON:6001790.name: insect histoblast nest
UBERON:6001790.def: One of several groups of cells in the larval abdomen that gives rise to the adult external abdomen.

UBERON:6001791.name: obsolete insect dorsal histoblast nest abdominal

UBERON:6001792.name: obsolete insect anterior dorsal histoblast nest abdominal

UBERON:6001809.name: obsolete insect posterior dorsal histoblast nest abdominal

UBERON:6001842.name: insect embryonic/larval digestive system
UBERON:6001842.def: Digestive system of the insect embryo or larva.

UBERON:6001845.name: insect cephalopharyngeal skeleton
UBERON:6001845.def: A group of connected sclerites of the anterior embryonic/larval digestive system (atrium, pharynx and dorsal pouch). The cibarial dilator muscles connect to the cephalopharyngeal skeleton to lift the roof of the pharynx and thereby widen its lumen (Jurgens, 1986).

UBERON:6001848.name: insect epipharyngeal sclerite
UBERON:6001848.def: Unpaired sclerite to which the median tooth (labrum) posteriorly merges, and bears the cuticular pores of the labral sense organ.

UBERON:6001919.name: insect embryonic/larval central nervous system
UBERON:6001919.def: Central nervous system of the embryo/larva.

UBERON:6002639.name: insect larval sense organ
UBERON:6002639.def: Any sense organ that is part of some larva.

UBERON:6002642.name: insect embryonic/larval ocular segment sensillum
UBERON:6002642.def: Any embryonic/larval sense organ (UBERON:6002639) that is part of some larval ocular segment (UBERON:6001731).

UBERON:6003005.name: insect adult tagma
UBERON:6003005.def: Any tagma (UBERON:6000002) that is part of some adult (UBERON:6003004).

UBERON:6003010.name: insect adult procephalic segment
UBERON:6003010.def: Any procephalic segment (UBERON:6000007) that is part of some adult head (UBERON:6003007).

UBERON:6003011.name: insect adult labral segment
UBERON:6003011.def: Any labral segment (UBERON:6000008) that is part of some adult head (UBERON:6003007).

UBERON:6003012.name: insect adult antennal segment
UBERON:6003012.def: Any antennal segment (UBERON:6000009) that is part of some adult head (UBERON:6003007).

UBERON:6003019.name: insect adult thoracic segment
UBERON:6003019.def: Any segment (UBERON:6000003) that is part of some adult thorax (UBERON:6003018).

UBERON:6003020.name: insect adult prothoracic segment
UBERON:6003020.def: Any prothoracic segment (UBERON:6000017) that is part of some adult thorax (UBERON:6003018).

UBERON:6003021.name: insect adult mesothoracic segment
UBERON:6003021.def: Any mesothoracic segment (UBERON:6000018) that is part of some adult thorax (UBERON:6003018).

UBERON:6003024.name: insect adult abdominal segment
UBERON:6003024.def: Any abdominal segment (UBERON:6000021) that is part of some adult abdomen (UBERON:6003023).

UBERON:6003039.name: dorsal trunk of insect trachea
UBERON:6003039.def: Longitudinal tracheal branch of the insect tracheal system, dorsal to the lateral trunk.

UBERON:6003259.name: insect adult somatic muscle
UBERON:6003259.def: Muscle attached to the inner surface of the adult body wall, extending between articulated or flexibly joined areas, that serves to move the parts of the exoskeleton.

UBERON:6003559.name: insect adult nervous system
UBERON:6003559.def: Nervous system of the adult insect.

UBERON:6003623.name: insect adult central nervous system
UBERON:6003623.def: Central nervous system of the adult.

UBERON:6003626.name: insect supraesophageal ganglion
UBERON:6003626.def: The pre-oral neuropils of the brain located above and some of it below the esophagus, comprising three fused ganglia (protocerebrum, deutocerebrum, and tritocerebrum) in the head.

UBERON:6003627.name: insect protocerebrum
UBERON:6003627.def: The most anterior of the segmental subdivisions of the insect CNS; thought to represent the first pre-oral segment of the brain. The protocerebrum comprises many discrete neuropil regions including the central body complex and mushroom bodies.

UBERON:6003632.name: insect adult central complex
UBERON:6003632.def: A midline crossing complex of 4 synaptic neuropil domains of the adult brain: the ellipsoid body, the fan-shaped body, the paired noduli, and the protocerebral bridge. It is closely associated with another paired synaptic neuropil domain, the lateral complex. It lies in the middle of the brain between the pedunculi of the mushroom bodies and is bounded ventrally by the esophagus, dorsally by the pars intercerebralis and laterally by the antenno-glomerular tracts.

UBERON:6004296.name: insect sex comb
UBERON:6004296.def: A row of darkly pigmented, male specific chaetae located on the prothoracic metatarsal segment of the prothoracic leg. The number of chaetae (teeth) per sex comb varies between individuals, e.g.- Hannah-Alava and Stern report 10-13.

UBERON:6004340.name: insect wing hair
UBERON:6004340.def: The posteriorly oriented trichome of a cell of the wing blade. Each cell makes one of these trichomes at its posterior vertex.

UBERON:6004475.name: insect sclerite
UBERON:6004475.def: A region of integument whose external cuticular part is a hard, sclerotized plate.

UBERON:6004476.name: insect tergite
UBERON:6004476.def: The dorsal plate (sclerite) of an adult abdominal segment.

UBERON:6004519.name: insect arista
UBERON:6004519.def: Highly specialised, slender sixth segment of the antenna covered in bristle-like outgrowths known as laterals. It extends laterally from the dorsal region of the third segment of the antenna.

UBERON:6004521.name: insect clypeus
UBERON:6004521.def: The anterior part of the head between the frons and the labrum, which occasionally may fuse with either one to form the frontoclypeus and the clypeolabrum. In the context of Drosophila refers to a round structure on the center of the frontal adult external head.

UBERON:6004535.name: insect proboscis
UBERON:6004535.def: The trunk-like extension of adult head, forming a protrusible sucking proboscis for the ingestion of liquid food (pg 425 Miller et al., 1950; pg 383, Ferris et al., 1950).

UBERON:6004551.name: insect adult external thorax
UBERON:6004551.def: External structures that make up the adult insect thorax.

UBERON:6004552.name: insect tergum
UBERON:6004552.def: The upper, originally unpaired plate of the segmented insect body, which either independently or fused with a ventral plate covers the body dorsally, specifically that of the thorax.

UBERON:6004580.name: insect mesothoracic tergum
UBERON:6004580.def: The dorsal sclerites (tergites) of the mesothorax.

UBERON:6004646.name: insect tarsal segment
UBERON:6004646.def: A segment of the tarsus of the adult leg. The first tarsal segment, the metatarsus, is proximally connected to the tibia. Tarsal segments are covered in 8 longitudinal rows of bristles, with row 1 being the most ventral.

UBERON:6004648.name: insect metatarsus
UBERON:6004648.def: The first of the tarsal segments of the adult leg. It is located between the tibia and the second tarsal segment and is longer than the other tarsal segments. It has 8 longitudinal rows of bristles around the circumference.

UBERON:6004668.name: insect prothoracic tarsal segment
UBERON:6004668.def: Tarsal segment of the adult prothoracic leg.

UBERON:6004670.name: insect prothoracic metatarsus
UBERON:6004670.def: First tarsal segment of the prothoracic leg. Proximally, it articulates with the tibia and distally with the second tarsal segment. Its surface is covered with eight longitudinal rows of bristles and with transverse rows of bristles (TR) in the anterior compartment, between proximo-distal rows 7 and 8. There is sexual dimorphism in the number of TRs (transverse row bristles, TR). In males, 2 TRs are replaced by the sex comb and one central bristle.

UBERON:6004823.name: insect analia
UBERON:6004823.def: The set of external structures of adult abdominal segment(s) that makes up the anal apparatus.

UBERON:6004979.name: insect trichome
UBERON:6004979.def: Non-innervated projection of the cuticle around an actin-rich cellular process of an underlying epidermal cell.

UBERON:6005023.name: insect imaginal precursor
UBERON:6005023.def: Structure that proliferates to produce a larval imaginal disc and which gives rise to adult tissues (Bate and Martinez Arias, 1991).

UBERON:6005036.name: insect tracheal pit
UBERON:6005036.def: Deep and narrow pit formed by the invagination of a tracheal placode in a late extended germ band embryo. Invagination of the placode begins during stage 11. Branches begin to bud from the pit during stage 11, with a dorsal and ventral stem being apparent by mid-stage 12. The pit closes over during stage 13. There are 10 pairs of tracheal pits - one pair in each tracheal metamere (each segment from T2 to A8). Pits are located in the central one third of each parasegment, with the most anterior in parasegment 4 and the most posterior in parasegment 14.

UBERON:6005037.name: insect tracheal primordium
UBERON:6005037.def: Primordium of a single tracheal metamere of the embryonic/larval tracheal system from its appearance as a placode during stage 11 to the completion of fusion with adjacent tracheal metameres in stage 15/16. There are 10 pairs of tracheal primordia - one pair in each segment from T2 to A8. Each tracheal primordium originates as a slight depression in the lateral ectoderm during stage 10 known as a tracheal placode. During stage 11, these placodes invaginate to form tracheal pits that elongate and branch. These pits close over during stage 13. Fusion of tracheal primordia begins at stage 14 with fusion of the dorsal trunk primordia and is complete by early stage 16.

UBERON:6005043.name: insect trachea
UBERON:6005043.def: Cuticle-lined epithelial tube that forms part of the insect tracheal system.

UBERON:6005054.name: insect spiracle
UBERON:6005054.def: Opening of the tracheal system on the surface of the body.

UBERON:6005070.name: obsolete visceral muscle
UBERON:6005070.def: The visceral musculature comprises circular and longitudinal fibers which surround the entire intestinal tract, with the exception of the recurrent layer of the proventriculus. The circular fibers derive from a bilaterally symmetrical band of mesodermal cells extending continuously throughout most of the germ band. The longitudinal fibers derive from clusters of mesodermal cells which appear during stage 12 at the posterior end of the embryo and migrate anteriorly.

UBERON:6005096.name: insect stomatogastric nervous system
UBERON:6005096.def: A group of small, interconnected ganglia situated posterior to and between the two brain hemispheres and associated with the pharynx, esophagus and aorta.

UBERON:6005177.name: insect chaeta
UBERON:6005177.def: A sensillum with a long, unicellular, setiform outgrowth that is strongly chitinized.

UBERON:6005378.name: insect wing margin
UBERON:6005378.def: The border or edge of the wing. It separates the dorsal and ventral compartments.

UBERON:6005380.name: insect pharynx
UBERON:6005380.def: Section of the insect foregut anterior to the esophagus.

UBERON:6005413.name: obsolete insect anlage in statu nascendi

UBERON:6005425.name: obsolete insect visual anlage in statu nascendi

UBERON:6005467.name: insect lymph gland primordium
UBERON:6005467.def: Primordium of the insect embryo that gives rise to the embryonic/larval lymph gland.

UBERON:6005558.name: insect ventral ectoderm
UBERON:6005558.def: Ventral part of the insect trunk ectoderm.

UBERON:6005569.name: insect presumptive embryonic/larval tracheal system
UBERON:6005569.def: The sum of all the structures in the embryo that will develop into the embryonic/larval tracheal system. This corresponds to the tracheal primordia and their component tracheal branch primordia along with primordia of the spiracles.

UBERON:6005805.name: insect Bolwig organ
UBERON:6005805.def: Visual organ of the larva. It consists of a dense cluster of 12 ciliated photoreceptor neurons.

UBERON:6005830.name: insect Bolwig organ primordium
UBERON:6005830.def: Primordium of the insect embryo that gives rise to the larval Bolwig organ.

UBERON:6005913.name: insect arista lateral
UBERON:6005913.def: A bristle-like, non-innervated outgrowth of the arista. Each lateral is formed from the outgrowth of a single polyploid central core cell.

UBERON:6006011.name: insect pharate adult
UBERON:6006011.def: The developing adult after pupal-adult apolysis, i.e. from stage P8 (when yellow eye color first becomes visible through the pupal case), to eclosion.

UBERON:6006032.name: insect mesothoracic tergum primordium
UBERON:6006032.def: Region of the dorsal mesothoracic disc that will develop into the mesothoracic tergum.

UBERON:6007020.name: insect metatarsus of male prothoracic leg
UBERON:6007020.def: First tarsal segment of the male prothoracic leg. In contrast to females, it has a sex comb, central bristle and 5 to 6 transverse rows of bristles (TR).

UBERON:6007045.name: insect trunk ectoderm
UBERON:6007045.def: The region of the ectoderm posterior to the cephalic furrow.

UBERON:6007046.name: insect dorsal ectoderm derivative
UBERON:6007046.def: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the dorsal ectoderm.

UBERON:6007070.name: insect centro-posterior medial synaptic neuropil domain
UBERON:6007070.def: A synaptic neuropil domain of the larval brain located posterior to the medial lobe of the mushroom body. It is separated from the centro-lateral compartment by the peduncle, and from the centro-posterior intermediate compartment by the antenno-cerebral tract to which it is connected via a branch.

UBERON:6007116.name: insect presumptive embryonic/larval system
UBERON:6007116.def: The sum of all the developing presumptive components of a specific embryonic/larval system in an embryo.

UBERON:6007149.name: segment of antenna
UBERON:6007149.def: Any appendage segment that is part of some antenna.

UBERON:6007150.name: insect segment of leg
UBERON:6007150.def: Any appendage segment that is part of some leg.

UBERON:6007231.name: insect external sensillum
UBERON:6007231.def: Sensillum which is embedded in the body wall and has a specific cuticular structure involved in the transduction of some sensory signal as a part.

UBERON:6007232.name: insect eo-type sensillum
UBERON:6007232.def: Sensillum with innervated external cuticular sensory structure consisting of one or more bipolar sensory neurons, and 3 support cells: a trichogen cell which makes the external cuticular sensory structure, a thecogen cell which makes the socket that holds the base of the external sensory structure and a tormogen cell which makes the cuticular matrix (cap) at the tip of the innervating dendrite(s).

UBERON:6007233.name: insect internal sensillum
UBERON:6007233.def: Sensillum that is internal to the animal - i.e. having no part that is part of the cuticle.

UBERON:6007240.name: insect embryonic/larval sensillum
UBERON:6007240.def: Any sensillum (UBERON:6007152) that is part of some larva (UBERON:6001727).

UBERON:6007242.name: insect embryonic/larval head sensillum
UBERON:6007242.def: Any sensillum (UBERON:6007152) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

UBERON:6007248.name: insect chorionic specialization
UBERON:6007248.def: Specialized structure of the chorion of the egg.

UBERON:6007280.name: insect embryonic/larval head sense organ
UBERON:6007280.def: Any sense organ (UBERON:6005155) that is part of some larval head (UBERON:6001730).

UBERON:6007284.name: insect region of integument
UBERON:6007284.def: A region of cuticle and its underlying epidermis.

UBERON:6007285.name: insect segmental subdivision of integument
UBERON:6007285.def: A segmental subdivision of the integument of the whole animal.

UBERON:6007331.name: insect segmental subdivision of organ system
UBERON:6007331.def: The part of some organism that is part of some specified segment.

UBERON:6007373.name: insect internal sense organ
UBERON:6007373.def: Sense organ that is internal to the animal - i.e. having no part that is part of the cuticle.

UBERON:6007424.name: insect epithelial furrow
UBERON:6007424.def: A region of an epithelium that folds inwards from the epithelial plane to form a furrow.

UBERON:6016022.name: insect abdominal histoblast primordium
UBERON:6016022.def: A primordium of the insect embryo that gives rise to the larval abdominal histoblast nests.

UBERON:6017021.name: insect abdominal histoblast anlage
UBERON:6017021.def: A population of cells of the insect epidermis primordium that give rises to the abdominal histoblast primordium.

UBERON:6025991.name: insect anterior ectoderm derivative
UBERON:6025991.def: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the anterior ectoderm.

UBERON:6025993.name: insect ventral ectoderm derivative
UBERON:6025993.def: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the ventral ectoderm.

UBERON:6026000.name: insect trunk mesoderm derivative
UBERON:6026000.def: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the trunk mesoderm.

UBERON:6026002.name: insect visceral mesoderm derivative
UBERON:6026002.def: An insect embryonic structure that develops from the visceral mesoderm.

UBERON:6040003.name: insect non-connected developing system
UBERON:6040003.def: The sum of all the anlagen and primordia that will develop into a single system.

UBERON:6040005.name: insect synaptic neuropil
UBERON:6040005.def: The part of the neuropil consisting largely of synapsing neuron projections.

UBERON:6040007.name: insect synaptic neuropil domain
UBERON:6040007.def: Region of synaptic neuropil whose boundaries are largely discontinuities in the density of presynaptic terminals: high density in the synaptic neuropil domain, lower or zero density outside this region. These boundaries often correspond to a boundary with glial sheath, tract neuropil or cortex.

UBERON:6041000.name: insect synaptic neuropil block
UBERON:6041000.def: A closely associated group of synaptic neuropil domains.

UBERON:6057001.name: obsolete insect anterior-posterior subdivision of organism

UBERON:6110636.name: insect adult cerebral ganglion
UBERON:6110636.def: The pre-oral neuropils of the adult brain located above, around and partially below the esophagus, including the optic lobes. It excludes the gnathal ganglion. Developmentally, it comprises three fused neuromeres: protocerebrum, deutocerebrum, and tritocerebrum.

UBERON:6110746.name: insect presumptive prothoracic metatarsus
UBERON:6110746.def: Region of the prothoracic leg disc that will develop into the prothoracic metatarsus.

UBERON:6110811.name: insect presumptive arista
UBERON:6110811.def: Region of the antennal disc that will develop into the arista.

UBERON:7500033.name: obsolete distal-most point of medial condyle of femur
UBERON:7500033.def: OBSOLETE The distal-most point of the medial condyle of a femur.

UBERON:7500034.name: obsolete distal-most point of trochlea of humerus
UBERON:7500034.def: OBSOLETE The distal-most point of the trochlea of a humerus.

UBERON:7500035.name: obsolete tip of tail
UBERON:7500035.def: OBSOLETE Outermost point of a tail.

UBERON:7500036.name: obsolete line from caundal-sacral region of the vertebral column to the last vertebra
UBERON:7500036.def: OBSOLETE An anatomical line along a tail that extends from the first caudal vertebra to the last cuadal vertebra.

UBERON:7500037.name: obsolete line from helix of outer ear to intertragus incisure
