CL:0000749.def: A bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with photoreceptors cells and neurons in the inner half of the inner plexiform layer. These cells depolarize in response to light stimulation of their corresponding photoreceptors.

CL:0000750.name: OFF-bipolar cell
CL:0000750.def: A bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with photoreceptors cells and neurons in the outer half of the inner plexiform layer. These cells depolarize in response to light to dark transition.

CL:0000751.name: rod bipolar cell
CL:0000751.def: A bipolar neuron found in the retina that is synapsed by rod photoreceptor cells but not by cone photoreceptor cells.  These neurons depolarize in response to light.

CL:0000752.name: cone retinal bipolar cell
CL:0000752.def: A bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptor cells and neurons in the inner plexiform layer.

CL:0000753.name: type 1 cone bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0000753.def: An OFF-bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptors cells and neurons in the outer half of the inner plexiform layer. The cell body of these cells is in the middle of the inner plexiform layer. The dendritic tree is stout and the axon terminates in sublamina 1. The axonal terminal is wide and has only a few varicosities.

CL:0000754.name: type 2 cone bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0000754.def: An OFF-bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptors cells and neurons in the outer half of the inner plexiform layer. The dendritic tree is not well filled and the dendrites are more delicate than in type 1 cells. The axon terminal is bushier and exhibits a dense plexus of varicosities in the inner part of sublamina 1 (Ghosh et al., 2004).  It can be differentiated from other retinal bipolar neurons by its expression of marker genes: Neto1, Lhx3 and Irx-6 (Shekhar, 2016).

CL:0000755.name: type 3 cone bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0000755.def: An OFF-bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptors cells and neurons in the outer half of the inner plexiform layer. The dendritic tree is delicate and the dendritic tips appear small when compared with type 1 cells. The axon terminal is stratified and restricted to sublamina 2 of the inner plexiform layer.

CL:0000756.name: type 4 cone bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0000756.def: An OFF-bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptors cells and neurons in the outer half of the inner plexiform layer. The cell has a diffuse axon terminal with varicosities in sublaminae 1 and 2 of the inner plexiform layer.

CL:0000757.name: type 5 cone bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0000757.def: An ON-bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptors cells and neurons in the inner half of the inner plexiform layer. The axon terminal is restricted to sublamina 3 of the inner plexiform layer. It is narrowly stratified and branched. The dendritic tree has many delicate branches.

CL:0000758.name: type 6 cone bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0000758.def: An ON-bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptors cells and neurons in the inner half of the inner plexiform layer. The cell has a loose, delicate axon terminal that opens in sublamina 3 of the inner plexiform layer and descends into sublamina 4.

CL:0000759.name: type 7 cone bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0000759.def: An ON-bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptors cells and neurons in the inner half of the inner plexiform layer. The axon terminal is narrowly stratified and are found just below a calretinin-expressing band in sublamina 4 of the inner plexiform layer.

CL:0000760.name: type 8 cone bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0000760.def: An ON-bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptors cells and neurons in the inner half of the inner plexiform layer. This cell has the widest dendritic field and the widest axon terminal of all retinal bipolar cells. The axon terminal is delicate and stratified through sublaminae 4 and 5 of the inner plexiform layer.

CL:0000761.name: type 9 cone bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0000761.def: An ON-bipolar neuron found in the retina and having connections with cone photoreceptors cells and neurons in the inner half of the inner plexiform layer. The dendritic tree is wide and the dendritic convergence indicates cone selectivity. The axon terminal is sparsely branched and terminates in sublamina 5 of the inner plexiform layer.

CL:0000762.name: nucleated thrombocyte
CL:0000762.def: A nucleated blood cell involved in coagulation, typically seen in birds and other non-mammalian vertebrates.

CL:0000763.name: myeloid cell
CL:0000763.def: A cell of the monocyte, granulocyte, mast cell, megakaryocyte, or erythroid lineage.

CL:0000764.name: erythroid lineage cell
CL:0000764.def: A immature or mature cell in the lineage leading to and including erythrocytes.

CL:0000765.name: erythroblast
CL:0000765.def: A nucleated precursor of an erythrocyte that lacks hematopoietic lineage markers.

CL:0000766.name: myeloid leukocyte
CL:0000766.def: A cell of the monocyte, granulocyte, or mast cell lineage.

CL:0000767.name: basophil
CL:0000767.def: Any of the immature or mature forms of a granular leukocyte that in its mature form has an irregularly shaped, pale-staining nucleus that is partially constricted into two lobes, and with cytoplasm that contains coarse, bluish-black granules of variable size. Basophils contain vasoactive amines such as histamine and serotonin, which are released on appropriate stimulation. A basophil is CD123-positive, CD193-positive, CD203c-positive, and FceRIa-positive.

CL:0000768.name: immature basophil
CL:0000768.def: Any of the immature forms of a basophil, in which basophilic specific granules are present but other phenotypic features of the mature form may be lacking.

CL:0000769.name: basophilic metamyelocyte
CL:0000769.def: A basophil precursor in the granulocytic series, being a cell intermediate in development between a basophilic myelocyte and a band form basophil. The nucleus becomes indented where the indentation is smaller than half the distance to the farthest nuclear margin; chromatin becomes coarse and clumped; specific granules predominate while primary granules are rare. Markers are CD11b-positive, CD15-positive, CD16-positive, CD24-positive, CD33-positive, and CD13-positive.

CL:0000770.name: band form basophil
CL:0000770.def: A late basophilic metamyelocyte in which the nucleus is in the form of a curved or coiled band, not having acquired the typical multilobar shape of the mature basophil.

CL:0000771.name: eosinophil
CL:0000771.def: Any of the immature or mature forms of a granular leukocyte with a nucleus that usually has two lobes connected by one or more slender threads of chromatin, and cytoplasm containing coarse, round granules that are uniform in size and which can be stained by the dye eosin. Eosinophils are CD9-positive, CD191-positive, and CD193-positive.

CL:0000772.name: immature eosinophil
CL:0000772.def: Any of the immature forms of an eosinophil, in which eosinophilic specific granules are present but other phenotypic features of the mature form may be lacking.

CL:0000773.name: eosinophilic metamyelocyte
CL:0000773.def: A eosinophil precursor in the granulocytic series, being a cell intermediate in development between a eosinophilic myelocyte and a band form eosinophil. The nucleus becomes indented where the indentation is smaller than half the distance to the farthest nuclear margin; chromatin becomes coarse and clumped; specific granules predominate while primary granules are rare. Markers are integrin alpha-M-positive, fucosyltransferase FUT4-positive, low affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc region receptor III-positive, CD33-positive, CD24-positive and aminopeptidase N-negative.

CL:0000774.name: band form eosinophil
CL:0000774.def: A late eosinophilic metamyelocyte in which the nucleus is in the form of a curved or coiled band, not having acquired the typical multilobar shape of the mature eosinophil.

CL:0000775.name: neutrophil
CL:0000775.def: Any of the immature or mature forms of a granular leukocyte that in its mature form has a nucleus with three to five lobes connected by slender threads of chromatin, and cytoplasm containing fine inconspicuous granules and stainable by neutral dyes.

CL:0000776.name: immature neutrophil
CL:0000776.def: Any of the immature forms of a neutrophil in which neutrophilic specific granules are present but other phenotypic features of the mature form may be lacking.

CL:0000777.name: mesangial phagocyte
CL:0000777.def: A tissue-resident macrophage of the renal glomerular mesangium involved in the disposal and degradation of filtration residues, presentation of antigen to T cells and in tissue remodeling.

CL:0000778.name: mononuclear osteoclast
CL:0000778.def: A specialized mononuclear osteoclast associated with the absorption and removal of bone, precursor of multinuclear osteoclasts.

CL:0000779.name: multinuclear osteoclast
CL:0000779.def: A specialized multinuclear osteoclast, forming a syncytium through the fusion of mononuclear precursor cells, associated with the absorption and removal of bone.

CL:0000780.name: multinuclear odontoclast
CL:0000780.def: A specialized multinuclear osteoclast associated with the absorption and removal of cementum.

CL:0000781.name: mononuclear odontoclast
CL:0000781.def: A specialized mononuclear osteoclast associated with the absorption and removal of cementum.

CL:0000782.name: myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0000782.def: A dendritic cell of the myeloid lineage.

CL:0000783.name: multinucleated phagocyte
CL:0000783.def: A phagocyte formed by the fusion of mononuclear phagocytes.

CL:0000784.name: plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0000784.def: A dendritic cell type of distinct morphology, localization, and surface marker expression (CD123-positive) from other dendritic cell types and associated with early stage immune responses, particularly the release of physiologically abundant amounts of type I interferons in response to infection.

CL:0000785.name: mature B cell
CL:0000785.def: A B cell that is mature, having left the bone marrow. Initially, these cells are IgM-positive and IgD-positive, and they can be activated by antigen.

CL:0000786.name: plasma cell
CL:0000786.def: A terminally differentiated, post-mitotic, antibody secreting cell of the B cell lineage with the phenotype CD138-positive, surface immunonoglobulin-negative, and MHC Class II-negative. Plasma cells are oval or round with extensive rough endoplasmic reticulum, a well-developed Golgi apparatus, and a round nucleus having a characteristic cartwheel heterochromatin pattern and are devoted to producing large amounts of immunoglobulin.

CL:0000787.name: memory B cell
CL:0000787.def: A memory B cell is a mature B cell that is long-lived, readily activated upon re-encounter of its antigenic determinant, and has been selected for expression of higher affinity immunoglobulin. This cell type has the phenotype CD19-positive, CD20-positive, MHC Class II-positive, and CD138-negative.

CL:0000788.name: naive B cell
CL:0000788.def: A naive B cell is a mature B cell that has the phenotype surface IgD-positive, surface IgM-positive, CD20-positive, CD27-negative and that has not yet been activated by antigen in the periphery.

CL:0000789.name: alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000789.def: A T cell that expresses an alpha-beta T cell receptor complex.

CL:0000790.name: immature alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000790.def: An alpha-beta T cell that has an immature phenotype and has not completed T cell selection.

CL:0000791.name: mature alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000791.def: A alpha-beta T cell that has a mature phenotype.

CL:0000792.name: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
CL:0000792.def: A CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta T cell that regulates overall immune responses as well as the responses of other T cell subsets through direct cell-cell contact and cytokine release.
synonym: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte

CL:0000793.name: CD4-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0000793.def: A CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell that is found in the columnar epithelium of the gastrointestinal tract.

CL:0000794.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytotoxic T cell
CL:0000794.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that is capable of killing target cells in an antigen specific manner with the phenotype perforin-positive and granzyme B-positive.

CL:0000795.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
CL:0000795.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that regulates overall immune responses as well as the responses of other T cell subsets through direct cell-cell contact and cytokine release.

CL:0000796.name: CD8-alpha-beta-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0000796.def: A alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell found in the columnar epithelium of the gastrointestinal tract. Intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.

CL:0000797.name: alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0000797.def: A mature alpha-beta T cell of the columnar epithelium of the gastrointestinal tract. Intraepithelial T cells often have distinct developmental pathways and activation requirements.

CL:0000798.name: gamma-delta T cell
CL:0000798.def: A T cell that expresses a gamma-delta T cell receptor complex.

CL:0000799.name: immature gamma-delta T cell
CL:0000799.def: A gamma-delta T cell that has an immature phenotype.

CL:0000800.name: mature gamma-delta T cell
CL:0000800.def: A gamma-delta T cell that has a mature phenotype. These cells can be found in tissues and circulation where they express unique TCR repertoire depending on their location.

CL:0000801.name: gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0000801.def: A mature gamma-delta T cell that is found in the columnar epithelium of the gastrointestinal tract. These cells participate in mucosal immune responses.

CL:0000802.name: CD8-alpha alpha positive, gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0000802.def: A gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell that has the phenotype CD8-alpha alpha-positive.

CL:0000803.name: CD4-negative CD8-negative gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0000803.def: A gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell that has the phenotype CD4-negative and CD8-negative.

CL:0000805.name: immature single positive thymocyte
CL:0000805.def: A thymocyte that has the phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-positive, CD44-negative, CD25-negative, and pre-TCR-positive.

CL:0000806.name: DN2 thymocyte
CL:0000806.def: A thymocyte that has the phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD44-positive, and CD25-positive.

CL:0000807.name: DN3 thymocyte
CL:0000807.def: A thymocyte that has the phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD44-negative, and CD25-positive and expressing the T cell receptor beta-chain in complex with the pre-T cell receptor alpha chain.

CL:0000808.name: DN4 thymocyte
CL:0000808.def: A thymocyte that has the phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD44-negative, CD25-negative, and pre-TCR-positive.

CL:0000809.name: double-positive, alpha-beta thymocyte
CL:0000809.def: A thymocyte expressing the alpha-beta T cell receptor complex as well as both the CD4 and CD8 coreceptors.

CL:0000810.name: CD4-positive, alpha-beta thymocyte
CL:0000810.def: An immature alpha-beta T cell that is located in the thymus and is CD4-positive and CD8-negative.

CL:0000811.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta thymocyte
CL:0000811.def: An immature alpha-beta T cell that is located in the thymus and is CD8-positive and CD4-negative.

CL:0000813.name: memory T cell
CL:0000813.def: A long-lived, antigen-experienced T cell that has acquired a memory phenotype including distinct surface markers and the ability to differentiate into an effector T cell upon antigen reexposure.

CL:0000814.name: mature NK T cell
CL:0000814.def: A mature alpha-beta T cell of a distinct lineage that bears natural killer markers and a T cell receptor specific for a limited set of ligands. NK T cells have activation and regulatory roles particularly early in an immune response.

CL:0000815.name: regulatory T cell
CL:0000815.def: A T cell which regulates overall immune responses as well as the responses of other T cell subsets through direct cell-cell contact and cytokine release.

CL:0000816.name: immature B cell
CL:0000816.def: An immature B cell is a B cell that has the phenotype surface IgM-positive and surface IgD-negative, and have not undergone class immunoglobulin class switching or peripheral encounter with antigen and activation.

CL:0000817.name: precursor B cell
CL:0000817.def: A precursor B cell is a B cell with the phenotype CD10-positive.

CL:0000818.name: transitional stage B cell
CL:0000818.def: An immature B cell of an intermediate stage between the pre-B cell stage and the mature naive stage with the phenotype surface IgM-positive and CD19-positive, and are subject to the process of B cell selection. A transitional B cell migrates from the bone marrow into the peripheral circulation, and then to the spleen.

CL:0000819.name: B-1 B cell
CL:0000819.def: A B cell of distinct lineage and surface marker expression. B-1 B cells are thought to be the primary source of natural IgM immunoglobulin, that is, IgM produced in large quantities without prior antigenic stimulation and generally reactive against various microorganisms, as well as the source of T-independent IgA immunoglobulin in the mucosal areas. These cells are CD43-positive.

CL:0000820.name: B-1a B cell
CL:0000820.def: A B-1 B cell that has the phenotype CD5-positive.

CL:0000821.name: B-1b B cell
CL:0000821.def: A B-1 B cell that has the phenotype CD5-negative, but having other phenotypic attributes of a B-1 B cell.

CL:0000822.name: B-2 B cell
CL:0000822.def: A conventional B cell subject to antigenic stimulation and dependent on T cell help and with a distinct surface marker expression pattern from B-1 B cells. These cells are CD43-negative.

CL:0000823.name: immature natural killer cell
CL:0000823.def: A natural killer cell that is developmentally immature and expresses natural killer cell receptors (NKR).

CL:0000824.name: mature natural killer cell
CL:0000824.def: A natural killer cell that is developmentally mature and expresses a variety of inhibitory and activating receptors that recognize MHC class I and other stress related molecules.

CL:0000825.name: pro-NK cell
CL:0000825.def: A lymphoid progenitor cell that is committed to the natural killer cell lineage, expressing CD122 (IL-15) receptor, but lacking many of the phenotypic characteristics of later stages of natural killer cell development such as expression of NK activating and inhibitory molecules. In human this cell has the phenotype CD34-positive, CD45RA-positive, CD10-positive, CD117-negative, and CD161 negative.

CL:0000826.name: pro-B cell
CL:0000826.def: A progenitor cell of the B cell lineage, with some lineage specific activity such as early stages of recombination of B cell receptor genes, but not yet fully committed to the B cell lineage until the expression of PAX5 occurs.

CL:0000827.name: pro-T cell
CL:0000827.def: A lymphoid progenitor cell of the T cell lineage, with some lineage specific marker expression, but not yet fully committed to the T cell lineage.

CL:0000828.name: thromboblast
CL:0000828.def: A progenitor cell of the thrombocyte, a nucleated blood cell involved in coagulation typically seen in birds and other non-mammalian vertebrates.

CL:0000829.name: basophilic myeloblast
CL:0000829.def: A myeloblast committed to the basophil lineage.

CL:0000830.name: basophilic promyelocyte
CL:0000830.def: A promyelocyte committed to the basophil lineage.

CL:0000831.name: mast cell progenitor
CL:0000831.def: A progenitor cell of the mast cell lineage. Markers for this cell are FceRIa-low, CD117-positive, CD9-positive, T1/ST2-positive, SCA1-negative, and lineage-negative.

CL:0000832.name: eosinophilic myeloblast
CL:0000832.def: A myeloblast committed to the eosinophil lineage.

CL:0000833.name: eosinophilic promyelocyte
CL:0000833.def: A promyelocyte committed to the eosinophil lineage.

CL:0000834.name: neutrophil progenitor cell
CL:0000834.def: A progenitor cell of the neutrophil lineage.

CL:0000835.name: myeloblast
CL:0000835.def: The most primitive precursor in the granulocytic series, having fine, evenly distributed chromatin, several nucleoli, a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ration (5:1-7:1), and a nongranular basophilic cytoplasm. They reside in the bone marrow.

CL:0000836.name: promyelocyte
CL:0000836.def: A precursor in the granulocytic series, being a cell intermediate in development between a myeloblast and myelocyte, that has distinct nucleoli, a nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio of 5:1 to 3:1, and containing a few primary cytoplasmic granules. Markers for this cell are fucosyltransferase FUT4-positive, CD33-positive, integrin alpha-M-negative, low affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc region receptor III-negative, and CD24-negative.

CL:0000837.name: hematopoietic multipotent progenitor cell
CL:0000837.def: A hematopoietic multipotent progenitor cell is multipotent, but not capable of long-term self-renewal. These cells are characterized as lacking lineage cell surface markers and being CD34-positive in both mice and humans.

CL:0000838.name: lymphoid lineage restricted progenitor cell
CL:0000838.def: A progenitor cell restricted to the lymphoid lineage.

CL:0000839.name: myeloid lineage restricted progenitor cell
CL:0000839.def: A progenitor cell restricted to the myeloid lineage.

CL:0000840.name: immature conventional dendritic cell
CL:0000840.def: An immature cell of the conventional dendritic cell lineage, characterized by high levels of antigen uptake via endocytosis, macropinocytosis, and phagocytosis, and typically found resident in the tissues. Markers for this cell are CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHC-II-low.

CL:0000841.name: mature conventional dendritic cell
CL:0000841.def: A mature cell of the conventional dendritic cell lineage, characterized by a high capacity for antigen presentation and typically found in a lymph node.

CL:0000842.name: mononuclear leukocyte
CL:0000842.def: A leukocyte with a single non-segmented nucleus in the mature form.

CL:0000843.name: follicular B cell
CL:0000843.def: A resting mature B cell that has the phenotype IgM-positive, IgD-positive, CD23-positive and CD21-positive, and found in the B cell follicles of the white pulp of the spleen or the corticol areas of the peripheral lymph nodes. This cell type is also described as being CD19-positive, B220-positive, AA4-negative, CD43-negative, and CD5-negative.

CL:0000844.name: germinal center B cell
CL:0000844.def: A rapidly cycling mature B cell that has distinct phenotypic characteristics and is involved in T-dependent immune responses and located typically in the germinal centers of lymph nodes. This cell type expresses Ly77 after activation.

CL:0000845.name: marginal zone B cell of spleen
CL:0000845.def: A mature B cell that is located in the marginal zone of the spleen with the phenotype CD23-negative and CD21-positive and expressing a B cell receptor usually reactive to bacterial cell wall components or senescent self components such as oxidized-LDL. This cell type is also described as being CD19-positive, B220-positive, IgM-high, AA4-negative, CD35-high.
synonym: B cell of marginal zone of spleen
marginal zone of spleen B cell

CL:0000846.name: vestibular dark cell
CL:0000846.def: An epithelial cell of the vestibular sensory organ that is characterized by intense enzymatic activities and numerous basal membrane infoldings.

CL:0000847.name: ciliated olfactory receptor neuron
CL:0000847.def: An olfactory receptor cell in which the apical ending of the dendrite is a pronounced ciliated olfactory knob.

CL:0000848.name: microvillous olfactory receptor neuron
CL:0000848.def: An olfactory receptor cell in which the apical ending of the dendrite is a knob that bears numerous microvilli.

CL:0000849.name: crypt olfactory receptor neuron
CL:0000849.def: An olfactory receptor cell with short cilia growing in an invagination bordered by microvilli.

CL:0000850.name: serotonergic neuron
CL:0000850.def: A neuron that releases serotonin as a neurotransmitter.

CL:0000851.name: neuromast mantle cell
CL:0000851.def: Neuromast mantle cell is a non-sensory cell. Neuromast mantle cells surround the neuromast support cells and neuromast hair cells, separating the neuromast from the epidermis, and secrete cupula in which the ciliary bundles of all the hair cells are embedded.

CL:0000852.name: neuromast supporting cell
CL:0000852.def: Neuromast support cell is a non-sensory cell of the neuromast that extend between the sensory hair cells from the basement membrane to the apical surface; neuromast support cells are surrounded by neuromast mantle cells.

CL:0000853.name: olfactory epithelial supporting cell
CL:0000853.def: Olfactory epithelial support cell is a columnar cell that extends from the epithelial free margin to the basement membrane of the olfactory epithelium. This cell type has a large, vertically, elongate, euchromatic nucleus, along with other nuclei, forms a layer superficial to the cell body of the receptor cell; sends long somewhat irregular microvilli into the mucus layer; at the base, with expanded end-feet containing numerous lamellated dense bodies resembling lipofuscin of neurons.

CL:0000854.name: interneuromast cell
CL:0000854.def: Interneuromast cell is a neuroectodermal cell deposited by the migrating lateral line primordium between the neuromasts. Interneuromast cells proliferate and migrate to form additional neuromasts.

CL:0000855.name: sensory hair cell
CL:0000855.def: Hair cell is a mechanoreceptor cell that is sensitive to movement of the hair-like projections (stereocilia and kinocilia) which relay the information centrally in the nervous system.

CL:0000856.name: neuromast hair cell
CL:0000856.def: Neuromast hair cell is a hair cell that acts as a sensory receptor of the neuromast; it is morphologically polarized as a result of the relative position of the single kinocilium and the clusters of stereocilia on its apical surface.

CL:0000857.name: slow muscle myoblast
CL:0000857.def: A skeletal muscle myoblast that differentiates into slow muscle fibers.

CL:0000858.name: fast muscle myoblast
CL:0000858.def: A skeletal muscle myoblast that differentiates into fast muscle fibers.

CL:0000860.name: classical monocyte
CL:0000860.def: A monocyte that responds rapidly to microbial stimuli by secreting cytokines and antimicrobial factors and which is characterized by high expression of CCR2 in both rodents and humans, negative for the lineage markers CD3, CD19, and CD20, and of larger size than non-classical monocytes.

CL:0000861.name: elicited macrophage
CL:0000861.def: A macrophage which develops from an inflammatory monocyte and is recruited into the tissues in response to injury and infection as part of an inflammatory response. Markers include CD11b-positive, CD68-positive, and F4/80-positive.

CL:0000862.name: suppressor macrophage
CL:0000862.def: A macrophage that suppresses immune responses.

CL:0000863.name: inflammatory macrophage
CL:0000863.def: An elicited macrophage that is recruited into the tissues in response to injury and infection as part of an inflammatory response, expresses high levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines, ROS and NO, and shows potent microbicidal activity.

CL:0000864.name: tissue-resident macrophage
CL:0000864.def: A macrophage constitutively resident in a particular tissue under non-inflammatory conditions, and capable of phagocytosing a variety of extracellular particulate material, including immune complexes, microorganisms, and dead cells.

CL:0000865.name: gastrointestinal tract (lamina propria) macrophage
CL:0000865.def: A gut-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage found in lamina propria of the gut.

CL:0000866.name: thymic macrophage
CL:0000866.def: A tissue-resident macrophage resident found in the thymus, involved in the clearance of apoptotic thymocytes.

CL:0000867.name: secondary lymphoid organ macrophage
CL:0000867.def: A tissue-resident macrophage found in a secondary lymphoid organ.

CL:0000868.name: lymph node macrophage
CL:0000868.def: A secondary lymphoid organ macrophage found in a lymph node. This cell is CD169-high.

CL:0000869.name: tonsillar macrophage
CL:0000869.def: A gut-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage found in tonsils.

CL:0000870.name: Peyer's patch macrophage
CL:0000870.def: A gut-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage found in the Peyer's patches.

CL:0000871.name: splenic macrophage
CL:0000871.def: A secondary lymphoid organ macrophage found in the spleen.

CL:0000872.name: splenic marginal zone macrophage
CL:0000872.def: A splenic macrophage found in the marginal zone of the spleen, involved in recognition and clearance of particulate material from the splenic circulation. Markers include F4/80-negative, MARCO-positive, SR-A-positive, SIGN-R1-positive, and Dectin2-positive.

CL:0000873.name: splenic metallophillic macrophage
CL:0000873.def: A splenic macrophage found in the areas surrounding the white pulp of the spleen, adjacent to the marginal sinus. Markers include F4/80-negative, Dectin2-low, sialoadhesin-positive.

CL:0000874.name: splenic red pulp macrophage
CL:0000874.def: A splenic macrophage found in the red-pulp of the spleen, and involved in immune responses to blood-borne pathogens and in the clearance of senescent erythrocytes. Markers include F4/80-positive, CD68-positive, MR-positive, Dectin2-positive, macrosialin-positive, and sialoadhesin-low.

CL:0000875.name: non-classical monocyte
CL:0000875.def: A type of monocyte characterized by low expression of CCR2, low responsiveness to monocyte chemoattractant CCL2/MCP1, low phagocytic activity, and decrease size relative to classical monocytes, but increased co-stimulatory activity. May also play a role in tissue repair.

CL:0000876.name: splenic white pulp macrophage
CL:0000876.def: A splenic macrophage found in the white pulp of the spleen. Markers include F4/80-negative, CD68-positive, and macrosialin-positive.

CL:0000877.name: splenic tingible body macrophage
CL:0000877.def: A splenic white pulp macrophage found in and around the germinal centers of the white pulp of the spleen that participates in phagocytosis of apoptotic B cells from the germinal centers. A marker for a cell of this type is Mertk-positive.

CL:0000878.name: central nervous system macrophage
CL:0000878.def: A tissue-resident macrophage found in the central nervous system.

CL:0000879.name: meningeal macrophage
CL:0000879.def: A border associated macrophage that is part of a meninx. This macrophage type is elongated and amoeboid spindle-shaped with limited mobility. This macrophage is highly phagocytic, expresses scavenger receptors, has dynamic protrusions and extends its processes during inflammation.

CL:0000880.name: choroid plexus macrophage
CL:0000880.def: A border associated macrophage found at the interface between the blood and the cerebrospinal fluid in the brain. This central nervous system macrophage has a star-like shaped body and expresses scavenger receptors.

CL:0000881.name: perivascular macrophage
CL:0000881.def: A border associated macrophage that is adjacent to a small blood vessel of a brain. A perivascular macrophage expresses the markers CD14, CD16 and CD163. In homeostatic conditions, this central nervous system macrophage has a non-motile cell body with extending and retracting projections through the blood vessel wall.

CL:0000882.name: thymic medullary macrophage
CL:0000882.def: A thymic macrophage found in the thymic medulla.

CL:0000883.name: thymic cortical macrophage
CL:0000883.def: A thymic macrophage found in the thymic cortex.

CL:0000884.name: mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage
CL:0000884.def: A tissue-resident macrophage found in the mucosa associated lymphoid tissue.

CL:0000885.name: gut-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage
CL:0000885.def: A mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage found in the mucosa-associated lymphoid tissues of the gut.

CL:0000886.name: nasal and broncial associated lymphoid tissue macrophage
CL:0000886.def: A mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue macrophage found in the nasal and bronchial mucosa-associated lymphoid tissues.

CL:0000887.name: lymph node subcapsular sinus macrophage
CL:0000887.def: A lymph node macrophage found in the subcapsular sinus of lymph nodes that participates in sensing, clearance, and antigen presentation of lymph-borne particulate antigens. This macrophage is capable of activating invaraint NKT cells and is CD169-positive.

CL:0000888.name: lymph node tingible body macrophage
CL:0000888.def: A lymph node macrophage found in the cortex of lymph nodes, in particular in and around the germinal centers, and that participates in phagocytosis of apoptotic B cells from the germinal centers.

CL:0000889.name: myeloid suppressor cell
CL:0000889.def: An immature myeloid leukocyte of heterogeneous phenotype found particularly in cancer and sepsis patients that is capable of suppressing activity of T cells in ex vivo assays. This cell type is CD45-positive, CD11b-positive.

CL:0000890.name: alternatively activated macrophage
CL:0000890.def: An elicited macrophage characterized by low production of pro-inflammatory and Th1 polarizing cytokines and high expression of arginase-1, and associated with tissue remodelling.

CL:0000891.name: foam cell
CL:0000891.def: A type of cell containing lipids in small vacuoles and typically seen in atherolosclerotic lesions, as well as other conditions.

CL:0000892.name: smooth muscle cell derived foam cell
CL:0000892.def: A type of foam cell derived from a smooth muscle cell containing lipids in small vacuoles and typically seen in atherolosclerotic lesions, as well as other conditions.

CL:0000893.name: thymocyte
CL:0000893.def: An immature T cell located in the thymus.

CL:0000894.name: DN1 thymic pro-T cell
CL:0000894.def: A pro-T cell that has the phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD44-positive, and CD25-negative.

CL:0000895.name: naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000895.def: An antigen inexperienced CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD127-positive and CD62L-positive. This cell type develops in the thymus. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD62L-high, and CD44-low.
synonym: naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte

CL:0000896.name: activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000896.def: A recently activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, and CD25-positive.

CL:0000897.name: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell
CL:0000897.def: A CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has differentiated into a memory T cell.

CL:0000898.name: naive T cell
CL:0000898.def: Mature T cell not yet exposed to antigen with the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD45RA-positive, and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD62L-high and CD44-low.

CL:0000899.name: T-helper 17 cell
CL:0000899.def: CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype RORgamma-t-positive, CXCR3-negative, CCR6-positive, and capable of producing IL-17.

CL:0000900.name: naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000900.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has not experienced activation via antigen contact and has the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CCR7-positive and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD62L-high and CD44-low.
synonym: naive thymus-dervied CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte

CL:0000901.name: Tr1 cell
CL:0000901.def: CD4-positive alpha-beta T cell with regulatory function that produces IL-10.

CL:0000902.name: induced T-regulatory cell
CL:0000902.def: CD4-positive alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CD25-positive, CTLA-4-positive, and FoxP3-positive with regulatory function.

CL:0000903.name: natural T-regulatory cell
CL:0000903.def: CD4-positive alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype FoxP3-positive, CD25-positive, CD62L-positive, and CTLA-4 positive with regulatory function.

CL:0000904.name: central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000904.def: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
synonym: central CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell
central CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte
central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte

CL:0000905.name: effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000905.def: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
synonym: effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell
effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte
effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte

CL:0000906.name: activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000906.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, CD25-positive, and CCR7-negative.

CL:0000907.name: central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000907.def: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CCR7-positive, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
synonym: central CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell
central CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte
central memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte

CL:0000908.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytokine secreting effector T cell
CL:0000908.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, and CD25-positive, that secretes cytokines.
synonym: CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytokine secreting effector T lymphocyte
CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytokine secreting effector T-cell
CD8-positive, alpha-beta cytokine secreting effector T-lymphocyte

CL:0000909.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell
CL:0000909.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has differentiated into a memory T cell.

CL:0000910.name: cytotoxic T cell
CL:0000910.def: A mature T cell that differentiated and acquired cytotoxic function with the phenotype perforin-positive and granzyme-B positive.

CL:0000911.name: effector T cell
CL:0000911.def: A differentiated T cell with ability to traffic to peripheral tissues and is capable of mounting a specific immune response.

CL:0000912.name: helper T cell
CL:0000912.def: A effector T cell that provides help in the form of secreted cytokines to other immune cells.

CL:0000913.name: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0000913.def: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.
synonym: effector CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell
effector CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte
effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte

CL:0000914.name: immature NK T cell
CL:0000914.def: An immature alpha-beta T-cell that express Egr2. These cells give rise to T cells expressing NK markers.

CL:0000915.name: CD8-alpha-alpha-positive, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0000915.def: An alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell with the phenotype CD8-alpha-alpha-positive located in the columnar epithelium of the gastrointestinal tract. These cells have a memory phenotype of CD2-negative and CD5-negative.

CL:0000916.name: dendritic epidermal T cell
CL:0000916.def: A mature gamma-delta T cell located in the epidermis that regulates wound healing.

CL:0000917.name: Tc1 cell
CL:0000917.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta positive T cell that has the phenotype T-bet-positive, eomesodermin-positive, CXCR3-positive, CCR6-negative, and is capable of producing interferon-gamma.

CL:0000918.name: Tc2 cell
CL:0000918.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta positive T cell expressing GATA-3 and secreting IL-4.

CL:0000919.name: CD8-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
CL:0000919.def: A CD8-positive alpha beta-positive T cell with the phenotype FoxP3-positive and having suppressor function.
synonym: CD8-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte

CL:0000920.name: CD8-positive, CD28-negative, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
CL:0000920.def: CD8-positive, alpha-beta positive regulatory T cell with the phenotype CD28-negative and FoxP3-positive.
synonym: CD8-positive, CD28-negative, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte

CL:0000921.name: type I NK T cell
CL:0000921.def: An alpha-beta T cell expressing NK cell markers that is CD1d restricted and expresses specific V-alpha chains. NK T cells of this type recognize the glycolipid alpha-galactosylceramide in the context of CD1d.

CL:0000922.name: type II NK T cell
CL:0000922.def: An alpha-beta T cell expressing NK call markers that is CD1d restricted and expresses a diverse TCR repertoire. Type II NKT cells do not become activated by alpha-galactosylceramide when presented by CD1d.

CL:0000923.name: CD4-positive type I NK T cell
CL:0000923.def: A type I NK T cell that has the phenotype CD4-positive.
synonym: CD4-positive type I NK T lymphocyte

CL:0000924.name: CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T cell
CL:0000924.def: A type I NK T cell that has the phenotype CD4-negative and CD8-negative.
synonym: CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T lymphocyte
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-cell
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-lymphocyte
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NKT cell

CL:0000925.name: activated CD4-positive type I NK T cell
CL:0000925.def: A type I NK T cell that has been recently activated, secretes interferon-gamma and IL-4, and has the phenotype CD4-positive, CD69-positive, and downregulated NK markers.
synonym: activated CD4-positive type I NK T lymphocyte
activated CD4-positive type I NK T-cell
activated CD4-positive type I NK T-lymphocyte
activated CD4-positive type I NKT cell

CL:0000926.name: CD4-positive type I NK T cell secreting interferon-gamma
CL:0000926.def: A mature NK T cell that secretes interferon-gamma and enhances type 1 immune responses.
synonym: CD4-positive type I NK T cell secreting IFN-gamma
CD4-positive type I NK T lymphocyte secreting interferon-gamma
CD4-positive type I NK T-cell secreting interferon-gamma
CD4-positive type I NK T-lymphocyte secreting interferon-gamma
CD4-positive type I NKT cell secreting interferon-gamma

CL:0000927.name: CD4-positive type I NK T cell secreting interleukin-4
CL:0000927.def: A mature NK T cell that predominantly secretes type 2 cytokines such as interleukin-4 and interleukin-13 and enhances type 2 immune responses.
synonym: CD4-positive type I NK T cell secreting IL-4
CD4-positive type I NK T lymphocyte secreting interleukin-4
CD4-positive type I NK T-cell secreting interleukin-4
CD4-positive type I NK T-lymphocyte secreting interleukin-4
CD4-positive type I NKT cell secreting interleukin-4

CL:0000928.name: activated CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T cell
CL:0000928.def: A type I NK T cell that has been recently activated, secretes interferon-gamma and interleukin-4, and has phenotype CD4-negative, CD8-negative, CD69-positive, and downregulated NK markers.
synonym: activated CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T lymphocyte
activated CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-cell
activated CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-lymphocyte
activated CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NKT cell

CL:0000929.name: CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T cell secreting interferon-gamma
CL:0000929.def: A mature NK T cell that secretes interferon-gamma and enhances Th1 immune responses.
synonym: CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T cell secreting IFN-gamma
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T lymphocyte secreting interferon-gamma
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-cell secreting interferon-gamma
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-lymphocyte secreting interferon-gamma
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NKT cell secreting interferon-gamma

CL:0000930.name: CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T cell secreting interleukin-4
CL:0000930.def: A mature NK T cell that secretes interleukin-4 and enhances Th2 immune responses.
synonym: CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T cell secreting IL-4
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T lymphocyte secreting interleukin-4
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-cell secreting interleukin-4
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NK T-lymphocyte secreting interleukin-4
CD4-negative, CD8-negative type I NKT cell secreting interleukin-4

CL:0000931.name: activated type II NK T cell
CL:0000931.def: A type II NK T cell that has been recently activated, secretes interferon-gamma and interleukin-4, and has the phenotype CD69-positive and downregulated NK markers.
synonym: activated type II NK T lymphocyte

CL:0000932.name: type II NK T cell secreting interferon-gamma
CL:0000932.def: A type II NK T cell that has been recently activated, secretes interferon-gamma, and has the phenotype CD69-positive and downregulated NK markers.
synonym: type II NK T cell secreting IFN-gamma
type II NK T lymphocyte secreting interferon-gamma
type II NK T-cell secreting interferon-gamma
type II NK T-lymphocyte secreting interferon-gamma
type II NKT cell secreting interferon-gamma

CL:0000933.name: type II NK T cell secreting interleukin-4
CL:0000933.def: A type II NK T cell that has been recently activated, secretes interleukin-4, and has the phenotype CD69-positive and downregulated NK markers.
synonym: type II NK T cell secreting IL-4
type II NK T lymphocyte secreting interleukin-4
type II NK T-cell secreting interleukin-4
type II NK T-lymphocyte secreting interleukin-4
type II NKT cell secreting interleukin-4

CL:0000934.name: CD4-positive, alpha-beta cytotoxic T cell
CL:0000934.def: A CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has cytotoxic function.

CL:0000935.name: CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0000935.def: A CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta intraepithelial T cell that is found in the columnar epithelium of the gastrointestinal tract.
synonym: CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta intraepithelial T lymphocyte

CL:0000936.name: early lymphoid progenitor
CL:0000936.def: A lymphoid progenitor cell that is found in bone marrow, gives rise to B cells, T cells, natural killer cells and dendritic cells, and has the phenotype Lin-negative, Kit-positive, Sca-1-positive, FLT3-positive, CD34-positive, CD150 negative, and GlyA-negative.

CL:0000937.name: pre-natural killer cell
CL:0000937.def: Cell committed to natural killer cell lineage that has the phenotype CD122-positive, CD34-positive, and CD117-positive. This cell type lacks expression of natural killer receptor proteins.

CL:0000938.name: CD16-negative, CD56-bright natural killer cell, human
CL:0000938.def: NK cell that has the phenotype CD56-bright, CD16-negative, and CD84-positive with the function to secrete interferon-gamma but is not cytotoxic.
synonym: CD56-bright cytokine secreting natural killer cell

CL:0000939.name: CD16-positive, CD56-dim natural killer cell, human
CL:0000939.def: A mature natural killer cell that has the phenotype CD56-low, CD16-positive and which is capable of cytotoxicity and cytokine production.

CL:0000940.name: mucosal invariant T cell
CL:0000940.def: An alpha-beta T cell that is found in the lamina propria of mucosal tissues and is restricted by the MR-1 molecule.

CL:0000941.name: thymic conventional dendritic cell
CL:0000941.def: A dendritic cell arising in thymus that has the phenotype CD11c-positive, CD11b-negative, and CD45RA-negative.

CL:0000942.name: thymic plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0000942.def: A plasmacytoid dendritic cell developing in the thymus with phenotype CD11c-negative or low, CD45RA-positive, CD11b-negative, and CD123-positive.

CL:0000943.name: Be1 Cell
CL:0000943.def: A Be cell that facilitates development of T-helper 1 (Th1) phenotype in CD4-positive T cells, and secretes high levels of interleukin-2, tumor necrosis factor-alpha and interferon-gamma.

CL:0000944.name: Be2 cell
CL:0000944.def: A Be cell that facilitates development of T-helper 2 (Th2) phenotype T cells, and secretes high levels of interleukin-2, interleukin-10, interleukin-4, and interleukin-6.

CL:0000945.name: lymphocyte of B lineage
CL:0000945.def: A lymphocyte of B lineage with the commitment to express an immunoglobulin complex.

CL:0000946.name: antibody secreting cell
CL:0000946.def: A lymphocyte of B lineage that is devoted to secreting large amounts of immunoglobulin.

CL:0000947.name: IgE plasma cell
CL:0000947.def: A long lived plasma cell that secretes IgE.

CL:0000948.name: IgE memory B cell
CL:0000948.def: A class switched memory B cell that expresses IgE on the cell surface.

CL:0000949.name: IgD plasmablast
CL:0000949.def: A plasmablast that secretes IgD, and which occur in a small proportion of B cells in the adult.

CL:0000951.name: IgE short lived plasma cell
CL:0000951.def: A short lived plasma cell that secretes IgE.

CL:0000952.name: preBCR-positive large pre-B-II cell
CL:0000952.def: An preBRC-positive large pre-B-II cell is a large pre-B-II cell that is pre-B cell receptor-positive, composed of surrogate light chain protein (SL), which is composed of VpreB , Lambda 5/14.1, in complex with immunoglobulin mu heavy chain (IgHmu) on the cell surface.

CL:0000953.name: preBCR-negative large pre-B-II cell
CL:0000953.def: A pre-BCR-negative large pre-B-II cell is a large pre-B-II cell that is pre-B cell receptor-negative, composed of surrogate light chain protein (SL), which is composed of VpreB and Lambda 5/14.1, in complex with immunoglobulin mu heavy chain (IgHmu), on the cell surface, and lack a DNA rearrangement of immunoglobulin light chain genes.

CL:0000954.name: small pre-B-II cell
CL:0000954.def: A small pre-B-II cell is a pre-B-II cell that is Rag1-positive, Rag2-positive, pre-BCR-negative, and BCR-negative, is not proliferating, and carries a DNA rearrangement of one or more immunoglobulin light chain genes.

CL:0000955.name: pre-B-II cell
CL:0000955.def: A pre-B-II cell is a precursor B cell that expresses immunoglobulin mu heavy chain (IgHmu+), and lack expression of CD34, TdT, immunoglobulin kappa light chain and immunoglobulin lambda light chain.

CL:0000956.name: pre-B-I cell
CL:0000956.def: A pre-B-I cell is a precursor B cell that expresses CD34 and surrogate immunoglobulin light chain (VpreB , Lambda 5 (mouse)/14.1 (human)) on the cell surface, and TdT, Rag1,and Rag2 intracellularly. Cell type carries a D-JH DNA rearrangement, and lacks expression of immunglobulin heavy chain protein.

CL:0000957.name: large pre-B-II cell
CL:0000957.def: A large pre-B-II cell is a pre-B-II cell that is proliferating and is Rag1-negative and Rag2-negative.

CL:0000958.name: T1 B cell
CL:0000958.def: A transitional stage B cell that migrates from the bone marrow into the peripheral circulation, and finally to the spleen. This cell type has the phenotype surface IgM-positive, surface IgD-negative, CD21-negative, CD23-negative, and CD62L-negative, and CD93-positive. This cell type has also been described as IgM-high, CD19-positive, B220-positive, AA4-positive, and CD23-negative.

CL:0000959.name: T2 B cell
CL:0000959.def: A transitional stage B cell that has the phenotype surface IgM-positive, surface IgD-postive, CD21-positive, CD23-positive, CD62L-negative, CD93-positive and is located in the splenic B follicles. This cell type has also been described as IgM-high, CD19-positive, B220-positive, AA4-positive, and CD23-positive.

CL:0000960.name: T3 B cell
CL:0000960.def: A transitional stage B cell that expresses surface IgM and IgD, and CD62L. This cell type appears to be an anergic B cell that does not proliferate upon BCR signaling, is found in the spleen and lymph nodes, and has the phenotype surface IgM-positive, surface IgD-positive, CD21-positive, CD23-positive, CD62L-positive, and CD93-positive. This cell type has also been described as IgM-low, CD19-positive, B220-positive, AA4-positive, and CD23-positive (i.e. this cell-type is distinguished from T2 cells by surface expression of IgM).

CL:0000961.name: Bm1 B cell
CL:0000961.def: A follicular B cell that is IgD-positive, CD23-negative, and CD38-negative. This naive cell type is activated in the extrafollicular areas through interaction with interdigitating dendritic cells and antigen-specific CD4-positive T cells.

CL:0000962.name: Bm2 B cell
CL:0000962.def: A follicular B cell that is IgD-positive and CD23-positive and CD38-positive. This naive cell type is activated in the extrafollicular areas via interaction with dendritic cells and antigen specific T cells.

CL:0000963.name: Bm3-delta B cell
CL:0000963.def: A germinal center B cell that develops from a Bm3 B cell. This cell has the phenotype IgM-negative, IgD-positive, and CD38-positive.

CL:0000964.name: Bm2' B cell
CL:0000964.def: A germinal center B cell that founds a germinal center, and has the phenotype IgD-positive, CD38-positive, and CD23-negative.

CL:0000965.name: Bm3 B cell
CL:0000965.def: A germinal center B cell that is rapidly dividing and has the phenotype IgD-negative, CD38-positive, and CD77-positive. Somatic hypermutation of the immunoglobulin V gene region can occur during proliferation of this cell type.

CL:0000966.name: Bm4 B cell
CL:0000966.def: A germinal center B cell that has the phenotype CD77-negative, IgD-negative, and CD38-positive. These cells have undergone somatic mutation of the B cell receptor.

CL:0000967.name: Bm5 B cell
CL:0000967.def: A memory B cell arising in the germinal center that is IgD-negative and has undergone somatic mutation of the variable region of the immunoglobulin heavy and light chain genes.

CL:0000968.name: Be cell
CL:0000968.def: A mature B cell that produces cytokines that can influence CD4 T cell differentiation.

CL:0000969.name: regulatory B cell
CL:0000969.def: A mature B cell that has the phenotype CD1d-positive and expresses interleukin-10. This cell type has been associated with suppression of chronic inflammatory responses and T cell responses.

CL:0000970.name: unswitched memory B cell
CL:0000970.def: An unswitched memory B cell is a memory B cell that has the phenotype IgM-positive, IgD-positive, CD27-positive, CD138-negative, IgG-negative, IgE-negative, and IgA-negative.

CL:0000971.name: IgM memory B cell
CL:0000971.def: An IgM memory B cell is an unswitched memory B cell with the phenotype IgM-positive and IgD-negative.

CL:0000972.name: class switched memory B cell
CL:0000972.def: A class switched memory B cell is a memory B cell that has undergone Ig class switching and therefore is IgM-negative on the cell surface. These cells are CD27-positive and have either IgG, IgE, or IgA on the cell surface.

CL:0000973.name: IgA memory B cell
CL:0000973.def: A class switched memory B cell that expresses IgA.

CL:0000974.name: long lived plasma cell
CL:0000974.def: A fully differentiated plasma cell that lives for years, as opposed to months, secretes immunoglobulin, and has the phenotype weakly CD19-positive, CD20-negative, CD38-negative, strongly CD138-positive, MHC Class II-negative, surface immunoglobulin-negative, IgD-negative, and strongly CXCR4-positive. The majority of these cells of this type reside in the bone marrow.

CL:0000975.name: short lived plasma cell
CL:0000975.def: A fully differentiated plasma cell that lives for months.

CL:0000976.name: IgA short lived plasma cell
CL:0000976.def: A short lived plasma cell that secretes IgA. These cells may be found in the bone marrow as well as in the mucosal immune system.

CL:0000977.name: IgG short lived plasma cell
CL:0000977.def: A short lived plasma cell that secretes IgG.

CL:0000978.name: IgM short lived plasma cell
CL:0000978.def: A short lived plasma cell that secretes IgM.

CL:0000979.name: IgG memory B cell
CL:0000979.def: An IgG memory B cell is a class switched memory B cell that is class switched and expresses IgG on the cell surface.

CL:0000980.name: plasmablast
CL:0000980.def: An activated mature (naive or memory) B cell that is secreting immunoglobulin, typified by being CD27-positive, CD38-positive, CD138-negative.

CL:0000981.name: double negative memory B cell
CL:0000981.def: A memory B cell with the phenotype IgD-negative and CD27-negative.

CL:0000985.name: IgG plasma cell
CL:0000985.def: A fully differentiated plasma cell that secretes IgG.

CL:0000986.name: IgM plasma cell
CL:0000986.def: A fully differentiated plasma cell that secretes IgM.

CL:0000987.name: IgA plasma cell
CL:0000987.def: A fully differentiated plasma cell that secretes IgA.

CL:0000988.name: hematopoietic cell
CL:0000988.def: A cell of a hematopoietic lineage.

CL:0000989.name: CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0000989.def: CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell is a leukocyte that is CD11c-low, CD45R-positive, GR1-positive and CD11b-negative.

CL:0000990.name: conventional dendritic cell
CL:0000990.def: Conventional dendritic cell is a dendritic cell that is CD11c-high.

CL:0000991.name: CD11c-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0000991.def: CD11c-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell is a leukocyte is CD11c-negative, CD45RA-positive, CD85g-positive(ILT7), CD123-positive, CD303-positive.

CL:0000992.name: immature CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0000992.def: Immature CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell is a CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell that is CD80-low and CD86-low.

CL:0000993.name: mature CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0000993.def: Mature CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell is a CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell that is CD83-high and is CD80-positive, CD86-positive, and MHCII-positive.

CL:0000994.name: immature CD11c-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0000994.def: Immature CD11c-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell is a CD11c-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell is CD80-negative, CD86-low and MHCII-low.

CL:0000995.name: CD34-positive, CD38-positive common myeloid progenitor OR CD34-positive, CD38-positive common lymphoid progenitor
CL:0000995.synonym: CD71-positive common myeloid precursor OR CD7-negative lymphoid precursor OR CD7-positive lymphoid

CL:0000996.name: mature CD11c-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0000996.def: Mature CD11c-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell is a CD11c-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0000997.name: immature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell
CL:0000997.def: Immature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0000998.name: CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0000998.def: CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-negative, CD4-negative CD8-alpha-negative and is CD205-positive. This cell is able to cross- present antigen to CD8-alpha-positive T cells.

CL:0000999.name: CD4-positive CD11b-positive dendritic cell
CL:0000999.def: CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-positive, CD4-positive and is CD205-negative and CD8-alpha-negative.

CL:0001000.name: CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001000.def: CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-negative, CD4-negative and is CD205-positive and CD8-alpha-positive.

CL:0001001.name: immature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001001.def: Immature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001002.name: mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001002.def: Mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001003.name: mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell
CL:0001003.def: Mature CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-negative CD11b-positive dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001004.name: immature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001004.def: Immature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001005.name: mature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell
CL:0001005.def: Mature CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell is a CD8-alpha-positive CD11b-negative dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001006.name: dermal dendritic cell
CL:0001006.def: Dermal dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-positive, CD205-positive and CD8 alpha-negative.

CL:0001007.name: interstitial dendritic cell
CL:0001007.def: Interstitial dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-positive, CD1a-positive, CD206-positive, CD209-positive, and CD36-positive.

CL:0001008.name: Kit and Sca1-positive hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0001008.def: A hematopoietic stem cell that has plasma membrane part Kit-positive, SCA-1-positive, CD150-positive and CD34-negative.

CL:0001009.name: immature dermal dendritic cell
CL:0001009.def: Immature dermal dendritic cell is a dermal dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001010.name: mature dermal dendritic cell
CL:0001010.def: Mature dermal dendritic cell is a dermal dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001011.name: immature interstitial dendritic cell
CL:0001011.def: Immature interstitial dendritic cell is a interstitial dendritic cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001012.name: CD7-negative lymphoid progenitor OR granulocyte monocyte progenitor

CL:0001013.name: mature interstitial dendritic cell
CL:0001013.def: Mature interstitial dendritic cell is a interstitial dendritic cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001014.name: CD1a-positive Langerhans cell
CL:0001014.def: CD1a-positive Langerhans cell is a Langerhans_cell that is CD1a-positive and CD324-positive.

CL:0001015.name: CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell
CL:0001015.def: CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell is a Langerhans cell that is CD205-high and is CD8-alpha-low.

CL:0001016.name: immature CD1a-positive Langerhans cell
CL:0001016.def: Immature CD1a-positive Langerhans cell is a CD1a-positive Langerhans cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001017.name: mature CD1a-positive Langerhans cell
CL:0001017.def: Mature CD1a-positive Langerhans cell is a CD1a-positive Langerhans cell that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001018.name: immature CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell
CL:0001018.def: Immature CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell is a CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell that is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0001019.name: CD115-positive monocyte OR common dendritic progenitor

CL:0001020.name: mature CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell
CL:0001020.def: Mature CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell is a CD8-alpha-low Langerhans cell that that is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0001021.name: CD34-positive, CD38-positive common lymphoid progenitor
CL:0001021.def: A common lymphoid progenitor that is CD10-positive, CD45RA-positive, CD34-positive and CD38-positive.

CL:0001022.name: CD115-positive monocyte
CL:0001022.def: CD115-positive monocyte is a monocyte that is CD115-positive and CD11b-positive.

CL:0001023.name: Kit-positive, CD34-positive common myeloid progenitor
CL:0001023.def: A common myeloid progenitor that is Kit-positive and CD34-positive, Il7ra-negative, and is SCA1-low and Fcgr2-low and Fcgr3-low.

CL:0001024.name: CD34-positive, CD38-negative hematopoietic stem cell
CL:0001024.def: CD133-positive hematopoietic stem cell is a hematopoietic stem cell that is CD34-positive, CD90-positive, and CD133-positive.

CL:0001025.name: Kit-positive, Sca1-positive common lymphoid progenitor
CL:0001025.def: A common lymphoid progenitor that is Kit-low, FLT3-positive, IL7ralpha-positive, and SCA1-low.

CL:0001026.name: CD34-positive, CD38-positive common myeloid progenitor
CL:0001026.def: A common myeloid progenitor that is CD34-positive, CD38-positive, IL3ra-low, CD10-negative, CD7-negative, CD45RA-negative, and IL-5Ralpha-negative.

CL:0001027.name: CD7-negative lymphoid progenitor cell
CL:0001027.def: CD7-negative lymphoid progenitor cell is a lymphoid progenitor cell that is CD34-positive, CD7-negative and CD45RA-negative.

CL:0001028.name: CD7-positive lymphoid progenitor cell
CL:0001028.def: CD7-positive lymphoid progenitor cell is a lymphoid progenitor cell that is CD34-positive, CD7-positive and is CD45RA-negative.

CL:0001029.name: common dendritic progenitor
CL:0001029.def: Common dendritic precursor is a hematopoietic progenitor cell that is CD117-low, CD135-positive, CD115-positive and lacks plasma membrane parts for hematopoietic lineage markers.

CL:0001030.name: CD117-positive common myeloid progenitor OR CD217-positive common lymphoid progenitor

CL:0001031.name: cerebellar granule cell
CL:0001031.def: An excitatory granule cell with a soma located in the granular layer of cerebellar cortex. A mature cerebellar granule cell has short dendrites with a characteristic claw-like appearance and a long axon that ascends to the molecular layer where it bifurcates (except in non-teleost fish, where it does not bifurcate) and extends mediolaterally to form parallel fibers.

CL:0001032.name: cortical granule cell
CL:0001032.def: Granule cell that is part of the cerebral cortex.

CL:0001033.name: hippocampal granule cell
CL:0001033.def: Granule cell with a soma found in the hippocampus.

CL:0001034.name: cell in vitro
CL:0001034.def: A cell that is maintained or propagated in a controlled artificial environment for use in an investigation.

CL:0001035.name: bone cell
CL:0001035.def: A connective tissue cell found in bone.

CL:0001039.name: terminally differentiated osteoblast
CL:0001039.def: Osteoblast that is terminally differentiated, located adjacent to acellular or cellular bone tissue within periosteum, and is capable of mineralizing the matrix.

CL:0001040.name: non-terminally differentiated osteoblast
CL:0001040.def: Osteoblast that is non-terminally differentiated and located in cellular bone tissue or under the periosteum in acellular bone.

CL:0001041.name: CD8-positive, CXCR3-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
CL:0001041.def: A CD8-positive alpha-beta-positive T cell with the phenotype CXCR3-positive and having suppressor function. They are capable of producing IL-10, suppressing proliferation, and suppressing IFN-gamma production.
synonym: CD8-positive, CXCR3-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte

CL:0001042.name: T-helper 22 cell
CL:0001042.def: CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell that produces IL-22.

CL:0001043.name: activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell, human
CL:0001043.def: A recently activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive, CD38-positive, CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, and CD25-positive.
synonym: activated CD4-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte, human

CL:0001044.name: effector CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0001044.def: A CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD45RA-positive.

CL:0001045.name: naive CCR4-positive regulatory T cell
CL:0001045.def: A naive regulatory T cell with the phenotype CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CD127lo, CCR4-positive, and CD45RO-negative.

CL:0001046.name: memory CCR4-positive regulatory T cell
CL:0001046.def: A memory regulatory T cell with phenotype CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CD127lo, CCR4-positive, and CD45RO-positive.

CL:0001047.name: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
CL:0001047.def: A CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell with the additional phenotype CCR4-positive.
synonym: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte
CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-cell
CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-lymphocyte

CL:0001048.name: activated CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell, human
CL:0001048.def: A CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta T regulatory cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive, indicating recent activation.
synonym: activated CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T lymphocyte
activated CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-cell
activated CD4-positive, CD25-positive, CCR4-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T-lymphocyte

CL:0001049.name: activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell, human
CL:0001049.def: A recently activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive, CD38-positive, CD69-positive, CD62L-negative, CD127-negative, CCR7-negative, and CD25-positive.
synonym: activated CD8-positive, alpha-beta T lymphocyte, human

CL:0001050.name: effector CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0001050.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with the phenotype CCR7-negative, CD45RA-positive.

CL:0001051.name: CD4-positive, CXCR3-negative, CCR6-negative, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0001051.def: A CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has the phenotype CXCR3-negative, CCR6-negative.
synonym: CD4-positive, CXCR3-negative, CCR6-negative, alpha-beta T lymphocyte

CL:0001052.name: CD8-positive, CXCR3-negative, CCR6-negative, alpha-beta T cell
CL:0001052.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has the phenotype CXCR3-negative, CCR6-negative.
synonym: CD8-positive, CXCR3-negative, CCR6-negative, alpha-beta T lymphocyte

CL:0001053.name: IgD-negative memory B cell
CL:0001053.def: A memory B cell that lacks expression of surface IgD.

CL:0001054.name: CD14-positive monocyte
CL:0001054.def: A monocyte that expresses CD14 and is negative for the lineage markers CD3, CD19, and CD20.

CL:0001055.name: CD14-positive, CD16-low monocyte
CL:0001055.def: An intermediate monocyte that is CD14-positive and with low amounts of CD16.

CL:0001056.name: dendritic cell, human
CL:0001056.def: A dendritic cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive.

CL:0001057.name: myeloid dendritic cell, human
CL:0001057.def: A myeloid dendritic cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive.

CL:0001058.name: plasmacytoid dendritic cell, human
CL:0001058.def: A plasmacytoid dendritic cell with the phenotype HLA-DRA-positive, CD123-positive, and CD11c-negative.

CL:0001059.name: common myeloid progenitor, CD34-positive
CL:0001059.def: A progenitor cell committed to myeloid lineage, including the megakaryocyte and erythroid lineages. These cells are CD34-positive, and express Gata1, Gata2, C/EBPa, and Pu.1.
synonym: colony forming unit granulocyte, erythrocyte, macrophage, and megakaryocyte

CL:0001060.name: hematopoietic oligopotent progenitor cell, lineage-negative
CL:0001060.def: A hematopoietic oligopotent progenitor cell that has the ability to differentiate into limited cell types but lacks lineage cell markers and self renewal capabilities. Cell lacks hematopoeitic lineage markers.

CL:0001061.name: abnormal cell
CL:0001061.def: A cell found in an organism or derived from an organism exhibiting a phenotype that deviates from the expected phenotype of any native cell type of that organism. Abnormal cells are typically found in disease states or disease models.

CL:0001062.name: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated
CL:0001062.def: A CD8-positive, alpha beta memory T cell with the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, and CCR7-negative.

CL:0001063.name: neoplastic cell
CL:0001063.def: An abnormal cell exhibiting dysregulation of cell proliferation or programmed cell death and capable of forming a neoplasm, an aggregate of cells in the form of a tumor mass or an excess number of abnormal cells (liquid tumor) within an organism.

CL:0001064.name: malignant cell
CL:0001064.def: A neoplastic cell that is capable of entering a surrounding tissue

CL:0001065.name: innate lymphoid cell
CL:0001065.def: A lymphocyte that lacks characteristic T cell, B cell, myeloid cell, and dendritic cell markers, that functions as part of the innate immune response to produce cytokines and other effector responses.

CL:0001066.name: erythroid progenitor cell, mammalian
CL:0001066.def: A progenitor cell committed to the erythroid lineage. This cell is ter119-positive but lacks expression of other hematopoietic lineage markers (lin-negative).

CL:0001067.name: group 1 innate lymphoid cell
CL:0001067.def: An innate lymphoid cell that is capable of producing the type 1 cytokine IFN-gamma, but not Th2 or Th17 cell-associated cytokines.

CL:0001068.name: ILC1
CL:0001068.def: A group 1 innate lymphoid cell that is non-cytotoxic.

CL:0001069.name: group 2 innate lymphoid cell
CL:0001069.def: An innate lymphoid cell that is capable of producing T-helper 2-cell associated cytokines upon stimulation.

CL:0001070.name: beige adipocyte
CL:0001070.def: An adipocyte that is beige in color, thermogenic, and which differentiates in white fat tissue from a Myf5-negative progenitor.

CL:0001071.name: group 3 innate lymphoid cell
CL:0001071.def: An innate lymphoid cell that constituitively expresses RORgt and is capable of expressing IL17A and/or IL-22.

CL:0001072.name: CD34-negative, CD117-positive innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001072.def: An innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype CD34-negative, CD117-positive, and a precusor to NK cells, ILC2 cells, and ILC3 cells.
synonym: CD34-negative, CD117-positive innate lymphoid cell precusor

CL:0001073.name: CD34-negative, CD56-positive, CD117-positive innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001073.def: An innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype CD34-negative, CD56-positive, CD117-positive.Thie cell type may include precusors to NK cells and ILC3 cells.
synonym: CD34-negative, CD56-positive, CD117-positive innate lymphoid cell precursor

CL:0001074.name: CD34-positive, CD56-positive, CD117-positive common innate lymphoid precursor, human
CL:0001074.def: An innate lymphoid cell precursor in the human with the phenotype CD34-positive, CD56-positive, CD117-positive.Thie cell type may include precusors to NK cells and ILC3 cells.

CL:0001075.name: KLRG1-positive innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001075.def: An innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype KLRG1-positive that is a precusor for ILC2 cells.

CL:0001076.name: NKp46-positive innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001076.def: An innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype NKp46-positive that is a precusor for NK cells and ILC3 cells.

CL:0001077.name: ILC1, human
CL:0001077.def: An ILC1 cell in the human with the phenotype CD56-negative, IL-7Ralpha-positive, T-bet-positive.

CL:0001078.name: group 3 innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001078.def: A group 3 innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype IL-7Ralpha-positive.

CL:0001079.name: NKp44-positive group 3 innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001079.def: A group 3 innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype IL-7Ralpha-positive, and NKp44-positive.

CL:0001080.name: NKp44-negative group 3 innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001080.def: A group 3 innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype IL-7Ralpha-positive, and NKp44-negative.

CL:0001081.name: group 2 innate lymphoid cell, human
CL:0001081.def: A group 2 innate lymphoid cell in the human with the phenotype CD25-positive, CD127-positive, CD161-positive, and GATA-3-positive.

CL:0001082.name: immature innate lymphoid cell
CL:0001082.def: An innate lyphoid cell with an immature phenotype.

CL:0001087.name: effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated
CL:0001087.def: A CD4-positive, alpha beta memory T cell with the phenotype CD45RA-positive, CD45RO-negative, and CCR7-negative.

CL:0001200.name: lymphocyte of B lineage, CD19-positive
CL:0001200.def: A lymphocyte of B lineage that is CD19-positive.

CL:0001201.name: B cell, CD19-positive
CL:0001201.def: A B cell that is CD19-positive.

CL:0001203.name: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive
CL:0001203.def: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell with memory phenotype indicated by being CD45RO and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD44-high, and CD122-high.
synonym: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte, CD45RO-positive

CL:0001204.name: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive
CL:0001204.def: CD4-positive, alpha-beta long-lived T cell with the phenotype CD45RO-positive and CD127-positive. This cell type is also described as being CD25-negative, CD44-high, and CD122-high.
synonym: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T lymphocyte, CD45RO-positive

CL:0001658.name: visual pigment cell (sensu Nematoda and Protostomia)

CL:0002000.name: Kit-positive erythroid progenitor cell
CL:0002000.def: An erythroid progenitor cell is Kit-positive, Ly6A-negative, CD41-negative, CD127-negative, and CD123-negative. This cell type is also described as being lin-negative, Kit-positive, CD150-negative, CD41-negative, CD105-positive, and FcgR-negative.

CL:0002001.name: CD34-positive, CD38-positive granulocyte monocyte progenitor
CL:0002001.def: A granulocyte monocyte progenitor is CD34-positive, CD38-positive, IL-3receptor-alpha-positive and is CD45RA-negative.

CL:0002002.name: Kit-positive granulocyte monocyte progenitor
CL:0002002.def: A granulocyte monocyte progenitor that is Kit-positive, CD34-positive, Fc-gamma receptor II/II-positive, and is Sca-1-negative, Il7ra-negative, Cxc3r1-negative, and CD90-negative.

CL:0002003.name: CD34-positive, GlyA-negative erythroid progenitor cell
CL:0002003.def: An erythroid progenitor cell that is CD34-positive and is GlyA-negative.

CL:0002004.name: CD34-negative, GlyA-negative proerythroblast
CL:0002004.def: A proerythoblast that is CD34-negative and GlyA-negative.

CL:0002005.name: CD34-positive, CD38-positive megakaryocyte erythroid progenitor cell
CL:0002005.def: A megakaryocyte erythroid progenitor cell is CD34-positive, CD38-positive and is IL3-receptor alpha-negative and CD45RA-negative.

CL:0002006.name: Kit-positive, CD34-negative megakaryocyte erythroid progenitor cell
CL:0002006.def: A megakaryocyte erythroid progenitor cell that is Kit-positive and is Sca1-negative, CD34-negative, CD90-negative, IL7r-alpha-negative and Fcgr II/III-low.

CL:0002007.name: Kit-low, CD34-positive eosinophil progenitor cell
CL:0002007.def: A lineage marker-negative, CD34-positive, IL5r-alpha-positive, and Sca1-negative eosinophil progenitor cell.

CL:0002008.name: CD34-positive, CD38-positive eosinophil progenitor cell
CL:0002008.def: A lineage marker-negative, CD34-positive, CD38-positive, IL3r-alpha-positive, IL5r-alpha-positive, and CD45RA-negative eosinophil progenitor cell.

CL:0002009.name: macrophage dendritic cell progenitor
CL:0002009.def: A progenitor cell that can give rise to plasmacytoid and myeloid dendritic cells, and to monocytes and macrophages.

CL:0002010.name: pre-conventional dendritic cell
CL:0002010.def: A lin-negative, MHC-II-negative, CD11c-positive, FLT3-positive cell with intermediate expression of SIRP-alpha.

CL:0002011.name: Kit-positive macrophage dendritic cell progenitor
