CL:0002372.def: A transversely striated, multinucleated syncytial muscle cell, formed by the fusion of myoblasts during muscle development.

CL:0002373.name: growth hormone releasing hormone secreting cell
CL:0002373.def: A peptide hormone secreting cell that secretes growth hormone releasing hormone.

CL:0002374.name: ear hair cell
CL:0002374.def: A hair cell of the ear that contains the organs of balance and hearing.

CL:0002375.name: Schwann cell precursor
CL:0002375.def: A multipotent progenitor cell that develops from a migratory neural crest cell. The schwann cell precursor is embedded among axons, with minimal extracellular space separating them from nerve cell membranes. This cell lacks a basal lamina, which distinguishes it from more mature Schwann cells. In rodents, cadherin-19 (Cdh19) serves as a specific marker for this developmental stage.

CL:0002376.name: non-myelinating Schwann cell
CL:0002376.def: A glial cell that ensheaths multiple small diameter axons in the peripheral nervous system. The non-myelinating Schwann cell is embedded among neurons (axons) with minimal extracellular spaces separating them from nerve cell membranes and has a basal lamina. Cells can survive without an axon present. These cells can de-differentiate into immature Schwann cells.

CL:0002377.name: immature Schwann cell
CL:0002377.def: A glial cell that develops from a Schwann cell precursor. The immature Schwann cell is embedded among neurons (axons) with minimal extracellular spaces separating them from nerve cell membranes and has a basal lamina. Cells can survive without an axon present. Immature Schwann cell can be found communally ensheathing large groups of axons.

CL:0002378.name: immature Vgamma2-positive fetal thymocyte
CL:0002378.def: A double negative thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive and is found in the fetal thymus.

CL:0002379.name: meningothelial cell
CL:0002379.def: A neurecto-epithelial cell found in the arachnoid villi of dura mater. This cell type facilitates flow of cerebrospinal fluid into the blood.

CL:0002380.name: oospore
CL:0002380.def: An asexual spore formed by Oomycetes; formed upon fertilization of an oosphere.

CL:0002381.name: uninucleate conidium
CL:0002381.def: A conidium that has only one nucleus.

CL:0002382.name: multinucleate conidium
CL:0002382.def: A conidium that has more than one nucleus.

CL:0002383.name: conidium of conidiophore head
CL:0002383.def: A uninucleate spore formed on specialized cells or projections, sterigma, of a conidiophore head.

CL:0002384.name: uninucleate macroconidium
CL:0002384.def: A macroconidium that has only one nucleus.

CL:0002385.name: blastoconidium
CL:0002385.def: An oblong or round asexual spore formed from conidial chains.

CL:0002386.name: multinucleate macroconidium
CL:0002386.def: A macroconidium that has more than one nucleus.

CL:0002387.name: arthroconidium
CL:0002387.def: Cylindrical spore formed by development and compartmentation of hyphae; the hyphae are often supporting blastoconidiophores.

CL:0002388.name: multinucleate arthroconidium
CL:0002388.def: An arthroconidium that has more than one nucleus.

CL:0002389.name: uninucleate arthroconidium
CL:0002389.def: An arthroconidium that has only one nucleus.

CL:0002390.name: uninucleate blastconidium
CL:0002390.def: A blastoconidium that has only one nucleus.

CL:0002391.name: multinucleate blastoconidium
CL:0002391.def: A blastoconidium that has more than one nucleus.

CL:0002392.name: obsolete plant spore
CL:0002392.def: Obsolete. Use PO:0025017 from Plant Ontology instead. A plant cell that arises through meiosis and develops into a gametophyte.

CL:0002393.name: intermediate monocyte
CL:0002393.def: A monocyte that has characteristics of both patrolling and inflammatory monocytes.

CL:0002394.name: CD141-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002394.def: A myeloid dendritic cell found in the blood, lymph nodes, tonsil, bone marrow, and spleen that is CD141-positive (BDCA-3), XCR1-positive, and Clec9A-positive. This cell-type can cross-present antigen to CD8-positive T cells and can produce inteferon-beta.

CL:0002395.name: Gr1-high classical monocyte
CL:0002395.def: A resident monocyte that is Gr-1 high, CD43-negative, CX3CR1-negative, CD115-positive, and B220-negative.

CL:0002396.name: CD14-low, CD16-positive monocyte
CL:0002396.def: A patrolling monocyte that is CD14-low and CD16-positive.

CL:0002397.name: CD14-positive, CD16-positive monocyte
CL:0002397.def: A CD14-positive monocyte that is also CD16-positive and CCR2-negative.

CL:0002398.name: Gr1-positive, CD43-positive monocyte
CL:0002398.def: An intermediate monocyte that is Gr1-positive, CD43-positive.

CL:0002399.name: CD1c-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002399.def: A myeloid dendritic cell that is CD1c-positive.

CL:0002400.name: fraction B/C precursor B cell
CL:0002400.def: A precursor B cell that is AA4-positive, IgM-negative, CD19-positive, CD43-positive and HSA-positive.

CL:0002401.name: mature dendritic epithelial T cell precursor
CL:0002401.def: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that has as part a Vgamma3 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus with highest numbers occurring at E17-E18.

CL:0002402.name: Peyer's patch B cell
CL:0002402.def: A resting mature B cell within the Peyer's patch that is CD19-positive, B220-positive, IgM-positive, AA4-negative, CD23-positive, CD43-negative, and CD5-negative.

CL:0002403.name: mature Vgamma2-positive fetal thymocyte
CL:0002403.def: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus.

CL:0002404.name: fetal thymocyte
CL:0002404.def: A thymocyte found in the fetal thymus.

CL:0002405.name: gamma-delta thymocyte
CL:0002405.def: A post-natal thymocyte expressing components of the gamma-delta T cell receptor. This cell type is always double-negative (i.e. CD4-negative, CD8-negative).

CL:0002406.name: immature Vgamma2-positive thymocyte
CL:0002406.def: A double negative post-natal thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive.

CL:0002407.name: mature Vgamma2-positive thymocyte
CL:0002407.def: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative.

CL:0002408.name: immature Vgamma2-negative thymocyte
CL:0002408.def: A double negative post-natal thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that does not contain a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive.

CL:0002409.name: mature Vgamma2-negative thymocyte
CL:0002409.def: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that does not contain the Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative.

CL:0002410.name: pancreatic stellate cell
CL:0002410.def: A cell that is found in the periacinar space of the exocrine pancreas and in perivascular and periductal regions of the pancreas, and has long cytoplasmic processes that encircle the base of the acinus. Expresses several intermediate filament proteins including vimentin and nestin. Shares many of the characteristics of hepatatic stellate cells, but not stellate cells of the central nervous system. Upon activation, this cell type undergoes morphological and gene expression changes that make the cell suggestive of being a type of myofibroblast.

CL:0002411.name: Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
CL:0002411.def: A gamma-delta receptor that expresses Vgamma1.1 but does not express Vdelta6.3 chains in the T-cell receptor.

CL:0002412.name: Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
CL:0002412.def: A gamma-delta receptor that expresses Vgamma1.1-Vdelta6.3 chains in the T-cell receptor.

CL:0002413.name: mature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
CL:0002413.def: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte that is CD24-negative.

CL:0002414.name: immature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
CL:0002414.def: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive.

CL:0002415.name: immature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
CL:0002415.def: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte that is CD24-positive.

CL:0002416.name: mature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
CL:0002416.def: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte that is CD24-negative.

CL:0002417.name: primitive erythroid lineage cell
CL:0002417.def: An immature or mature cell of the first erythroid lineage to arise during embryonic development.

CL:0002418.name: hemangioblast
CL:0002418.def: A pluripotent cell in the yolk sac that can give rise to mesenchymal cells including erythrocytes and endothelial cells.

CL:0002419.name: mature T cell
CL:0002419.def: A T cell that expresses a T cell receptor complex and has completed T cell selection.

CL:0002420.name: immature T cell
CL:0002420.def: A T cell that has not completed T cell selection.

CL:0002421.name: nucleated reticulocyte
CL:0002421.def: A reticulocyte that retains the nucleus and other organelles. Found in birds, fish, amphibians and reptiles.

CL:0002422.name: enucleated reticulocyte
CL:0002422.def: A reticulocyte lacking a nucleus and showing a basophilic reticulum under vital staining due to the presence of ribosomes.

CL:0002423.name: DN2a thymocyte
CL:0002423.def: A DN2 thymocyte that is Kit-hi.

CL:0002424.name: DN2b thymocyte
CL:0002424.def: A DN2 thymocyte that is Kit-low.

CL:0002425.name: early T lineage precursor
CL:0002425.def: A pro-T cell that is lin-negative, CD25-negative, CD127-negative, CD44-positive and kit-positive.

CL:0002426.name: CD11b-positive, CD27-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002426.def: A mature natural killer cell that is CD11b-positive and CD27-positive.

CL:0002427.name: resting double-positive thymocyte
CL:0002427.def: A double-positive, alpha-beta thymocyte that is small and not proliferating.

CL:0002428.name: double-positive blast
CL:0002428.def: A double-positive thymocyte that is large (i.e. has a high forward scatter signal in flow cytometry) and is actively proliferating.

CL:0002429.name: CD69-positive double-positive thymocyte
CL:0002429.def: A double-positive thymocyte that is CD69-positive and has begun positive selection.

CL:0002430.name: CD4-intermediate, CD8-positive double-positive thymocyte
CL:0002430.def: A double-positive thymocyte that is undergoing positive selection, has high expression of the alpha-beta T cell receptor, is CD69-positive, and is in the process of down regulating the CD4 co-receptor.

CL:0002431.name: CD4-positive, CD8-intermediate double-positive thymocyte
CL:0002431.def: A double-positive thymocyte that is undergoing positive selection, has high expression of the alpha-beta T cell receptor, is CD69-positive, and is in the process of down regulating the CD8 co-receptor.

CL:0002432.name: CD24-positive, CD4 single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002432.def: A CD4-positive, CD8-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive and expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor.

CL:0002433.name: CD69-positive, CD4-positive single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002433.def: A CD4-positive, CD8-negative thymocyte that expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor and is CD69-positive.

CL:0002434.name: CD24-positive, CD8 single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002434.def: A CD8-positive, CD4-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive and expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor.

CL:0002435.name: CD69-positive, CD8-positive single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002435.def: A CD8-positive, CD4-negative thymocyte that expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor and is CD69-positive.

CL:0002436.name: mature CD4 single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002436.def: A mature CD4-positive, CD8-negative alpha-beta T cell found in the thymus that is CD24-low and has high expression of the T cell receptor.

CL:0002437.name: mature CD8 single-positive thymocyte
CL:0002437.def: A mature CD8-positive, CD4-negative alpha-beta T cell found in the thymus that is CD24-low and has high expression of the T cell receptor.

CL:0002438.name: NK1.1-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002438.def: A mature NK cell that is NK1.1-positive.

CL:0002439.name: NKGA2-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002439.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is NKGA2-positive.

CL:0002440.name: Ly49D-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002440.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49D-positive.

CL:0002441.name: CD94-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002441.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-positive.

CL:0002442.name: CD94-negative, Ly49CI-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002442.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-negative and Ly49Cl-negative.

CL:0002443.name: Ly49CI-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002443.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49Cl-positive.

CL:0002444.name: Ly49H-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002444.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49H-positive.

CL:0002445.name: Ly49D-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002445.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49D-negative.

CL:0002446.name: Ly49CI-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002446.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49Cl-negative.

CL:0002447.name: CD94-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002447.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-negative.

CL:0002448.name: Ly49H-negative natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002448.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49H-negative.

CL:0002449.name: CD94-positive Ly49CI-positive natural killer cell, mouse
CL:0002449.def: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-positive and Ly49Cl-positive.

CL:0002450.name: tether cell
CL:0002450.def: A specialized hair cell that has an elongated kinocilium upon which an otolith accretes. The tether cell then anchors the otolith in place.

CL:0002451.name: mammary stem cell
CL:0002451.def: A multi-fate stem cell that is the source of cells for growth of the mammary gland during puberty and gestation. This cell type gives rise to both the luminal and myoepithelial cell types of the gland, and have been shown to have the ability to regenerate the entire organ in mice. This cell type also plays an important role in carcinogenesis of the breast. This cell type is Lin-, CD24-positive, CD29-hi.

CL:0002453.name: oligodendrocyte precursor cell
CL:0002453.def: A progenitor cell of the central nervous system that can differentiate into oligodendrocytes or type-2 astrocytes. This cell originates from multiple structures within the developing brain including the medial ganglion eminence and the lateral ganglionic eminence. These cells migrate throughout the central nervous system and persist into adulthood where they play an important role in remyelination of injured neurons.

CL:0002454.name: CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative, CD11b-positive dendritic cell
CL:0002454.def: CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative, CD11b-positive dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-positive, CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative and is CD205-positive.

CL:0002455.name: CD8-alpha-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0002455.def: A CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-negative and CD4-positive.

CL:0002456.name: CD8-alpha-positive plasmacytoid dendritic cell
CL:0002456.def: A CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-positive and CD4-positive.

CL:0002457.name: epidermal Langerhans cell
CL:0002457.def: A Langerhans cell that is in the epidermis and is CD45-positive, MHCII-positive, and CD11b-positive.

CL:0002458.name: langerin-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002458.def: A dermal dendritic cell that is langerin-positive and CD103-positive.

CL:0002459.name: langerin-negative dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002459.def: A dermal dendritic cell that is langerin-negative, CD103-negative, and CD11b-positive.

CL:0002460.name: CD8-alpha-negative thymic conventional dendritic cell
CL:0002460.def: A conventional thymic dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-negative.

CL:0002461.name: CD103-positive dendritic cell
CL:0002461.def: A conventional dendritic cell that is CD103-positive. This cell type is usually found in non-lymphoid tissue.

CL:0002462.name: adipose dendritic cell
CL:0002462.def: A F4/80-negative dendritic cell located in adipose tissue.

CL:0002463.name: SIRPa-positive adipose dendritic cell
CL:0002463.def: An adipose dendritic cell that is SIRPa-positive.

CL:0002464.name: SIRPa-negative adipose dendritic cell
CL:0002464.def: An adipose dendritic cell that is SIRPa-negative.

CL:0002465.name: CD11b-positive dendritic cell
CL:0002465.def: A conventional dendritic cell that expresses CD11b (ITGAM).

CL:0002466.name: small intestine serosal dendritic cell
CL:0002466.def: A CD11b-positive dendritic cell located in the serosal portion of the small intestine epithelium. This cell type is CD45-positive, MHC-II-positive, CD11c-low, CD103-negative.

CL:0002467.name: Gr1-high myeloid suppressor cell
CL:0002467.def: A myeloid suppressor cell that is Gr1-high and CD11c-negative.

CL:0002468.name: Gr1-low myeloid suppressor cell
CL:0002468.def: A myeloid suppressor cell that is Gr1-low and CD11c-positive.

CL:0002469.name: MHC-II-negative classical monocyte
CL:0002469.def: Gr1-high monocyte that lacks MHC-II receptor complex.

CL:0002470.name: MHC-II-positive classical monocyte
CL:0002470.def: Gr1-high monocyte that has a MHC-II receptor complex.

CL:0002471.name: MHC-II-negative non-classical monocyte
CL:0002471.def: Gr1-low non-classical monocyte that lacks expression of a MHC-II complex.

CL:0002472.name: MHC-II-low non-classical monocyte
CL:0002472.def: Gr1-low non-classical monocyte that has low to intermediate expression of the MHC-II complex.

CL:0002473.name: MHC-II-high non-classical monocyte
CL:0002473.def: Gr1-low non-classical monocyte that has high surface expression of a MHC-II complex.

CL:0002474.name: lymphoid MHC-II-negative classical monocyte
CL:0002474.def: A MHC-II-negative classical monocyte located in lymphoid tissue that is F4/80-positive, CD11c-negative, and CD11b-high.

CL:0002475.name: lymphoid MHC-II-negative non-classical monocyte
CL:0002475.def: A MHC-II-negative classical monocyte located in lymphoid tissue that is F4/80-positive, CD11c-intermediate, and CD11b-high.

CL:0002476.name: bone marrow macrophage
CL:0002476.def: A tissue-resident macrophage located in the bone marrow. This cell type is B220-negative, CD3e-negative, Ly-6C-negative, CD115-positive, F4/80-positive.

CL:0002477.name: adipose macrophage
CL:0002477.def: A macrophage located in adipose tissue that is CD45-positive, CD11c-positive, and SIRPa-positive.

CL:0002478.name: F4/80-negative adipose macrophage
CL:0002478.def: An adipose macrophage that does not express F4/80but is MHC-II-positive. This cell type exhibits autofluorescence under typical flow cyometry conditions.

CL:0002479.name: F4/80-positive adipose macrophage
CL:0002479.def: An adipose macrophage that does not express MHC-II but is F4/80-positive.

CL:0002480.name: nasal mucosa goblet cell
CL:0002480.def: A goblet cell located in the nasal epithelium.

CL:0002481.name: peritubular myoid cell
CL:0002481.def: The flattened smooth myoepithelial cells of mesodermal origin that lie just outside the basal lamina of the seminiferous tubule.

CL:0002482.name: dermal melanocyte
CL:0002482.def: A melanocyte that produces pigment in the dermis.

CL:0002483.name: hair follicle melanocyte
CL:0002483.def: A melanocyte that produces pigment within the hair follicle.

CL:0002484.name: epithelial melanocyte
CL:0002484.def: A melanocyte that produces pigment in the epithelium.

CL:0002485.name: retinal melanocyte
CL:0002485.def: A melanocyte of the retina. This cell type is distinct from pigmented retinal epithelium.

CL:0002486.name: strial intermediate cell
CL:0002486.def: A melanocyte located between the epithelial marginal cell layer and the mesodermal basal cell layer within the intrastrial space; the predominant cellular component of the electrogenic machinery that generates an endocochlear potential (80-100 mV) .

CL:0002487.name: cutaneous/subcutaneous mechanoreceptor cell
CL:0002487.def: A neuronal receptor that respond to mechanical pressure or distortion in the skin.

CL:0002488.name: trophoblast giant cell
CL:0002488.def: A trophoblast cell that has a large volume of cytoplasm, is polyploid and is usually mononuclear but is also occasionally multi-nucleate. This cell type is important in establishing maternal physiology and remodeling of the vasculature of the placenta.

CL:0002489.name: double negative thymocyte
CL:0002489.def: A thymocyte that lacks expression of CD4 and CD8.

CL:0002490.name: organ of Corti supporting cell
CL:0002490.def: A supporting cell of the organ of Corti.

CL:0002491.name: auditory epithelial cell
CL:0002491.def: A specialized cell involved in auditory sensory perception.

CL:0002492.name: strial marginal cell
CL:0002492.def: A polarized columnar cell that covesr the lateral surface of the cochlear duct, secretes potassium ions and forms a continuous sheet in contact with the endolymph; marginal cells form extensive interdigitations with the basal and intermediate cells in the normal adult stria.

CL:0002493.name: strial basal cell
CL:0002493.def: A polarized cell that is juxtaposed to fibrocytes in the underlying spiral ligament. This cell type secretes potassium ions derived from fibrocytes through gap junctions.

CL:0002494.name: cardiocyte
CL:0002494.def: A cell located in the heart, including both muscle and non muscle cells.

CL:0002495.name: fetal cardiomyocyte
CL:0002495.def: A fetal and neonatal heart cell that undergoes proliferation and is not yet terminally differentiated into a binucleate or a multinucleate cardiac myocyte.

CL:0002496.name: intraepithelial lymphocyte
CL:0002496.def: A T cell that is located in the intestinal epithelium and is capable of a mucosal immune response.

CL:0002497.name: primary trophoblast giant cell
CL:0002497.def: A trophoblast giant cell derived from the mural trophectoderm.

CL:0002498.name: secondary trophoblast giant cell
CL:0002498.def: A trophoblast giant cell that is derived from ectoplacental cone and, later in gestation, the spongiotrophoblast.

CL:0002499.name: spongiotrophoblast cell
CL:0002499.def: A trophoblast cell that arises in the junctional zone (basal plate) of the placenta.

CL:0002500.name: P enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002500.def: A P/D1 enteroendocrine cell that is Grimelius positive and stores bombesin-like polypeptide.

CL:0002501.name: type D1 enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002501.def: A P/D1 enteroendocrine cell that is argyrophilic and stores vasoactive intestinal polypeptide.

CL:0002502.name: type M enteroendocrine cell
CL:0002502.def: An enteroendocrine cell of the small intestine that secretes motilin.

CL:0002503.name: adventitial cell
CL:0002503.def: A cell of the adventitial layer of ductal structures such as the uterer, defent duct, biliary duct, etc

CL:0002504.name: enteric smooth muscle cell
CL:0002504.def: A smooth muscle cell of the intestine.

CL:0002505.name: liver CD103-negative dendritic cell
CL:0002505.def: A CD11b-positive dendritic cell that is CD11b-high, CD45-positive, MHC-II-positive and CD103-negative.

CL:0002506.name: liver CD103-positive dendritic cell
CL:0002506.def: A CD11b-positive dendritic cell that is CD11b-low, CD45-positive, MHC-II-high and CD103-positive that is located in the liver.

CL:0002507.name: langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002507.def: A dermal dendritic cell isolated from skin draining lymph nodes that is langerin-positive, MHC-II-positive, and CD4-negative and CD8a-negative.

CL:0002508.name: langerin-negative, CD103-negative lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002508.def: A dermal dendritic cell isolated from skin draining lymph nodes that is langerin-negative, MHC-II-positive, and CD4-negative and CD8a-negative.

CL:0002509.name: CD103-positive, langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002509.def: A langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell that is CD103-positive and CD11b-low.

CL:0002510.name: CD103-negative, langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002510.def: A langerin-positive lymph node dendritic cell that is CD103-negative and CD11b-high.

CL:0002511.name: CD11b-low, CD103-negative, langerin-negative lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002511.def: A langerin-negative lymph node dendritic cell that is CD103-negative and CD11b-low.

CL:0002512.name: CD11b-high, CD103-negative, langerin-negative lymph node dendritic cell
CL:0002512.def: A langerin-negative lymph node dendritic cell that is CD103-negative and CD11b-high.

CL:0002513.name: Vgamma5-positive CD8-alpha alpha positive gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0002513.def: A CD8-alpha alpha positive gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell that expresses a TCR encoded in part by the Vgamma5 gene segment.

CL:0002514.name: Vgamma5-negative CD8-alpha alpha positive gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell
CL:0002514.def: A CD8-alpha alpha positive gamma-delta intraepithelial T cell that does not express a TCR partially encoded by the Vgamma5 gene segment.

CL:0002515.name: interrenal norepinephrine type cell
CL:0002515.def: An interrenal chromaffin cell found in teleosts that contain heterogeneous vesicles with electron-dense granules located asymmetrically within the vesicular membrane.

CL:0002516.name: interrenal chromaffin cell
CL:0002516.def: A chromaffin cell interspersed among the interrenal epithelial layer of the anterior kidney of teloest fish.

CL:0002517.name: interrenal epinephrin secreting cell
CL:0002517.def: An interrenal chromaffin cell found in teleosts that contain small, homogeneous electron-lucent granules that are separated from the vesicular membrane by a visible halo.

CL:0002518.name: kidney epithelial cell
CL:0002518.def: An epithelial cell of the kidney.

CL:0002519.name: interrenal epithelial cell
CL:0002519.def: An interrenal epithelial kidney cell is an epithelial cell found in the anterior kidney of teleosts fish. This cell type is arranged in layers around the posterior cardinal vein and contains many mitochondria with tubulovesicular cristae. Interrenal chromaffin cells are interspersed among the tissue layer created by this cell type.

CL:0002520.name: nephrocyte
CL:0002520.def: An insect excretory cell that regulates hemolymph composition by filtration and filtrate endocytosis.

CL:0002521.name: subcutaneous adipocyte
CL:0002521.def: An adipocyte that is part of subcutaneous adipose tissue.

CL:0002522.name: renal filtration cell
CL:0002522.def: A renal filtration cell is a specialized cell of the renal system that filter fluids by charge, size or both.

CL:0002523.name: mesonephric podocyte
CL:0002523.def: A specialized epithelial cell that contains foot processes that interdigitate with the foot processes of other glomerular epithelial cells in the mesonephros.

CL:0002524.name: disseminated nephrocyte
CL:0002524.def: A disseminated nephrocyte is a nephrocyte that filters hemolymph and is found at scattered locations in the fat body or other tissues.

CL:0002525.name: metanephric podocyte
CL:0002525.def: A specialized epithelial cell that contains foot processes that interdigitate with the foot processes of other glomerular epithelial cells in the metanephros.

CL:0002526.name: CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002526.def: A dermal dendritic cell that is CD1a-negative and CD14-positive.

CL:0002527.name: immature CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002527.def: An immature CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0002528.name: mature CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002528.def: A mature CD14-positive dermal dendritic cell is CD80-high, CD86-high, MHCII-high and is CD83-positive.

CL:0002529.name: CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002529.def: A dermal dendritic cell that is CD1a-positive and CD14-negative.

CL:0002530.name: immature CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002530.def: An immature CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0002531.name: mature CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell
CL:0002531.def: A mature CD1a-positive dermal dendritic cell is CD80-high, CD83-positive, CD86-high, and MHCII-high.

CL:0002532.name: CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002532.def: A myeloid dendritic cell found in the blood that is CD16-positive.

CL:0002533.name: immature CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002533.def: An immature CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell is CD80-low, CD86-low, and MHCII-low.

CL:0002534.name: mature CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell
CL:0002534.def: A mature CD16-positive myeloid dendritic cell is CD80-high, CD83-positive, CD86-high, and MHCII-high.

CL:0002535.name: epithelial cell of cervix
CL:0002535.def: An epithelial cell of the cervix.
synonym: cervical canal of uterus epithelial cell
epithelial cell of cervical canal of uterus
epithelial cell of cervix of uterus
epithelial cell of neck of uterus

CL:0002536.name: epithelial cell of amnion
CL:0002536.def: An epithelial cell that is part of the amnion.

CL:0002537.name: amnion mesenchymal stem cell
CL:0002537.def: A mesenchymal stem cell of the amnion membrane.

CL:0002538.name: intrahepatic cholangiocyte
CL:0002538.def: An epithelial cell of the intrahepatic portion of the bile duct. These cells are flattened or cuboidal in shape, and have a small nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio relative to large/extrahepatic cholangiocytes.

CL:0002539.name: aortic smooth muscle cell
CL:0002539.def: A smooth muscle cell of the aorta.

CL:0002540.name: mesenchymal stem cell of the bone marrow
CL:0002540.def: A mesenchymal stem cell that is part of the bone marrow.

CL:0002541.name: chorionic membrane mesenchymal stem cell
CL:0002541.def: A mesenchymal stem cell of the chorionic membrane.

CL:0002543.name: vein endothelial cell
CL:0002543.def: An endothelial cell that is part of the vein.

CL:0002544.name: aortic endothelial cell
CL:0002544.def: An arterial endothelial cell that is part of the aorta endothelium.

CL:0002545.name: thoracic aorta endothelial cell
CL:0002545.def: An endothelial cell that is part of the thoracic endothelium.

CL:0002546.name: embryonic blood vessel endothelial progenitor cell
CL:0002546.def: An endothelial progenitor cell that participates in angiogenesis during development.

CL:0002547.name: fibroblast of the aortic adventitia
CL:0002547.def: A fibroblast of the aortic adventitia.

CL:0002548.name: fibroblast of cardiac tissue
CL:0002548.def: A fibroblast that is part of the heart.

CL:0002549.name: fibroblast of choroid plexus
CL:0002549.def: A fibroblast that is part of the choroid plexus.

CL:0002550.name: fibroblast of the conjunctiva
CL:0002550.def: A fibroblast that is part of the conjuctiva of the eye.

CL:0002551.name: fibroblast of dermis
CL:0002551.def: Any skin fibroblast that is part of some dermis.

CL:0002552.name: fibroblast of gingiva
CL:0002552.def: Any fibroblast that is part of some gingiva.

CL:0002553.name: fibroblast of lung
CL:0002553.def: A fibroblast that is part of lung.

CL:0002554.name: fibroblast of lymphatic vessel
CL:0002554.def: A fibroblast of the lymphatic system.

CL:0002555.name: fibroblast of mammary gland
CL:0002555.def: A fibroblast that is part of the mammary gland.

CL:0002558.name: fibroblast of villous mesenchyme
CL:0002558.def: A fibroblast that is part of villous mesenchyme.

CL:0002559.name: hair follicle cell
CL:0002559.def: An animal cell that is part of a hair follicle.

CL:0002560.name: inner root sheath cell
CL:0002560.def: An epithelial cell that resides in the inner root sheath of the hair follicle.

CL:0002561.name: outer root sheath cell
CL:0002561.def: An epithelial cell that is part of the outer root sheath.

CL:0002562.name: hair germinal matrix cell
CL:0002562.def: An epidermal cell that is part of the germinal matrix.

CL:0002563.name: intestinal epithelial cell
CL:0002563.def: An epithelial cell of the lining of the intestine.

CL:0002564.name: nucleus pulposus cell of intervertebral disc
CL:0002564.def: A connective tissue cell of the nucleus pulposus cell of intervertebral disc.

CL:0002565.name: iris pigment epithelial cell
CL:0002565.def: A pigment cell located in the epithelium of the iris.

CL:0002566.name: dark melanocyte
CL:0002566.def: A melanocyte that appears darker due to content or amount of melanin granules.

CL:0002567.name: light melanocyte
CL:0002567.def: A melanocyte that appears lighter in color.

CL:0002568.name: mesenchymal stem cell of Wharton's jelly
CL:0002568.def: A mesenchymal stem cell that is part of Wharton's jelly.

CL:0002569.name: mesenchymal stem cell of umbilical cord
CL:0002569.def: A mesenchymal stem cell of the umbilical cord.

CL:0002570.name: mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue
CL:0002570.def: A mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue.

CL:0002571.name: hepatic mesenchymal stem cell
CL:0002571.def: A mesenchymal stem cell of liver.

CL:0002572.name: vertebral mesenchymal stem cell
CL:0002572.def: A mesenchymal stem cell of the vertebrae.

CL:0002573.name: Schwann cell
CL:0002573.def: A glial cell that myelinates or ensheathes axons in the peripheral nervous system.

CL:0002574.name: stromal cell of pancreas
CL:0002574.def: A stromal cell of the pancreas.

CL:0002575.name: central nervous system pericyte
CL:0002575.def: A pericyte of the central nervous system.

CL:0002576.name: perineurial cell
CL:0002576.def: A glial cell that is part of the perineurium. This cell type has thin long bipolar cytoplasmic processes, pinocytotic vesicles, fragments of external lamina and/or external lamina-like material, attachment plaques, and desmosome-like junctions. Perineurial cells historically have been referred to as fibroblasts because of shape; however, unlike fibroblasts, a perineurial cell: does not have a compact nucleus and large endoplasmic reticulum; does have a double basement membrane opposed to a single basal lamina; is carefully joined to other perineurial cells by tight junctions into a single sheet as opposed to arranged in a large mass; and finally, can surround a small axon bundle at a nerve terminal whereas a fibroblast cannot.

CL:0002577.name: placental epithelial cell
CL:0002577.def: An epithelial cell of the placenta.

CL:0002578.name: mesenteric preadipocyte
CL:0002578.def: A preadipocyte found in mesenteric tissue.

CL:0002579.name: omentum preadipocyte
CL:0002579.def: A preadipocyte that is part of an omentum.

CL:0002580.name: preadipocyte of the breast
CL:0002580.def: A preadipocyte that is part of the breast.

CL:0002581.name: perirenal preadipocyte
CL:0002581.def: A preadipocyte that is part of a perirenal fat tissue.

CL:0002582.name: visceral preadipocyte
CL:0002582.def: A preadipocyte that is part of visceral tissue.

CL:0002583.name: subcutaneous preadipocyte
CL:0002583.def: A preadipocyte that is part of subcutaneous tissue.

CL:0002584.name: renal cortical epithelial cell
CL:0002584.def: An epithelial cell of the kidney cortex.

CL:0002585.name: retinal blood vessel endothelial cell
CL:0002585.def: A blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of the retina.

CL:0002586.name: retinal pigment epithelial cell
CL:0002586.def: An epithelial cell of the retinal pigmented epithelium.

CL:0002588.name: smooth muscle cell of the umbilical vein
CL:0002588.def: A smooth muscle cell of the umbilical vein.

CL:0002589.name: smooth muscle cell of the brachiocephalic vasculature
CL:0002589.def: A smooth muscle cell of the bachiocephalic vasculature.

CL:0002590.name: smooth muscle cell of the brain vasculature
CL:0002590.def: A vascular associated smooth muscle cell of the brain vasculature.

CL:0002591.name: smooth muscle cell of the pulmonary artery
CL:0002591.def: A smooth muscle of the pulmonary artery.

CL:0002592.name: smooth muscle cell of the coronary artery
CL:0002592.def: A smooth muscle cell of the coronary artery.

CL:0002593.name: smooth muscle cell of the internal thoracic artery
CL:0002593.def: A smooth muscle of the internal thoracic artery.

CL:0002594.name: smooth muscle cell of the umbilical artery
CL:0002594.def: A smooth muscle cell of the umbilical artery.

CL:0002595.name: smooth muscle cell of the subclavian artery
CL:0002595.def: A smooth muscle cell of the subclavian artery.

CL:0002596.name: smooth muscle cell of the carotid artery
CL:0002596.def: Smooth muscle cell of the carotid artery.

CL:0002597.name: smooth muscle cell of bladder
CL:0002597.def: A smooth muscle cell of the bladder.

CL:0002598.name: bronchial smooth muscle cell
CL:0002598.def: Any smooth muscle cell that is part of some bronchus.

CL:0002599.name: smooth muscle cell of the esophagus
CL:0002599.def: A smooth muscle cell of the esophagus.

CL:0002600.name: smooth muscle cell of trachea
CL:0002600.def: A smooth muscle cell of the trachea.

CL:0002601.name: uterine smooth muscle cell
CL:0002601.def: A smooth muscle cell of the uterus.

CL:0002602.name: annulus pulposus cell
CL:0002602.def: Any connective tissue cell that is part of some annulus fibrosus disci intervertebralis.

CL:0002604.name: hippocampal astrocyte
CL:0002604.def: An astrocyte that is part of the hippocampus.

CL:0002605.name: astrocyte of the cerebral cortex
CL:0002605.def: A transcriptomically distinct astrocyte that is found in the cerebral cortex.

CL:0002606.name: astrocyte of the spinal cord
CL:0002606.def: An astrocyte of the spinal cord.

CL:0002607.name: migratory enteric neural crest cell
CL:0002607.def: A neural crest cell that gives rise to cells of the enteric nervous system.

CL:0002608.name: hippocampal neuron
CL:0002608.def: A neuron with a soma found in the hippocampus.

CL:0002610.name: raphe nuclei neuron
CL:0002610.def: A neuron of the raphe nuclei.

CL:0002611.name: neuron of the dorsal spinal cord
CL:0002611.def: A CNS neuron of the dorsal spinal cord.

CL:0002612.name: neuron of the ventral spinal cord
CL:0002612.def: A neuron of the ventral spinal cord.

CL:0002614.name: neuron of the substantia nigra
CL:0002614.def: A neuron of the substantia nigra.

CL:0002615.name: adipocyte of omentum tissue
CL:0002615.def: An adipocyte that is part of omentum tissue.

CL:0002616.name: perirenal adipocyte
CL:0002616.def: An adipocyte of perirenal fat tissue.

CL:0002617.name: adipocyte of breast
CL:0002617.def: An adipocyte that is part of the breast.

CL:0002618.name: endothelial cell of umbilical vein
CL:0002618.def: An endothelial cell of the umbilical vein.

CL:0002619.name: adult endothelial progenitor cell
CL:0002619.def: An adult angioblastic cell released from the bone marrow, or from the kidney in some teleost species, capable of blood circulation and participation in angiogenesis by differentiating into blood vessel endothelial cells.

CL:0002621.name: gingival epithelial cell
CL:0002621.def: Any stratified squamous epithelial cell that is part of some gingival epithelium.

CL:0002622.name: prostate stromal cell
CL:0002622.def: A stromal cell of the prostate.

CL:0002623.name: acinar cell of salivary gland
CL:0002623.def: An acinar cell of salivary gland.

CL:0002624.name: paneth cell of the appendix
CL:0002624.def: A paneth cell of the appendix.

CL:0002625.name: seminiferous tubule epithelial cell
CL:0002625.def: A cell of the seminiferous tubule epithelium.

CL:0002627.name: mature astrocyte
CL:0002627.def: A mature astrocyte that is capable of producing cytokines.

CL:0002628.name: immature microglial cell
CL:0002628.def: An immature microglial cell with a ramified morphology.

CL:0002629.name: mature microglial cell
CL:0002629.def: A mature microglial cell that has changed shape to an amoeboid morphology and is capable of cytokine production and antigen presentation.

CL:0002630.name: actinomycete-type spore
CL:0002630.def: A spore formed from bacteria in the order Actinomycetales.

CL:0002631.name: epithelial cell of upper respiratory tract
CL:0002631.def: Any epithelial cell that is part of some upper respiratory tract epithelium.

CL:0002632.name: epithelial cell of lower respiratory tract
CL:0002632.def: Any epithelial cell that is part of some lower respiratory tract epithelium.

CL:0002633.name: respiratory basal cell
CL:0002633.def: A basal cell in the respiratory tract.

CL:0002634.name: epithelial cell of anal column
CL:0002634.def: An epithelial cell of the anal column.

CL:0002635.name: nonkeratinized epithelial cell of anal column
CL:0002635.def: A nonkeratinized epithelial cell of the anal canal.

CL:0002636.name: nonkeratinized epithelial cell of inferior part of anal canal
CL:0002636.def: A nonkeratinized cell epithleial cell of the inferior part of the anal canal.

CL:0002637.name: keratinized epithelial cell of the anal canal
CL:0002637.def: An epithelial cell of the anal canal that is keratinized. This cell type is found towards the lower, rectal end of the anal canal.

CL:0002638.name: bronchioalveolar stem cell
CL:0002638.def: A respiratory stem cell found at the junction of the terminal (conductive) bronchiole and the respiratory bronchiole. This cell types gives rise to alveolar cell types and club cells in response to lung injury. This cell type expresses markers Scgb1a1 and Sftpc.
synonym: basal epithelial cell of bronchioalveolar duct junction

CL:0002639.name: amniotic stem cell
CL:0002639.def: An amniotic stem cell is a mesenchymalstem cell extracted from amniotic fluid. Amniotic stem cells are able to differentiate into various tissue type such as skin, cartilage, cardiac tissue, nerves, muscle, and bone

CL:0002640.name: amniotic epithelial stem cell
CL:0002640.def: An epithelial fate stem cell derived form the amnion membrane.

CL:0002641.name: epithelial cell of esophageal gland proper
CL:0002641.def: An epithelial cell of the esophageal gland proper.

CL:0002642.name: epithelial cell of esophageal cardiac gland
CL:0002642.def: An epithelial cell of the esophageal cardiac gland that occurs both in the proximal and distal esophagus, within the lamina propia.

CL:0002643.name: nonkeratinized cell of stratum corneum of esophageal epithelium
CL:0002643.def: An epithelial cell of stratum corneum of esophageal epithelium that lacks keratin.

CL:0002644.name: endo-epithelial cell of tympanic part of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:0002644.def: An endothelial cell of viscerocranial mucosa that is part of the tympanic region of the viscerocranial mucosa.

CL:0002645.name: endo-epithelial cell of pharyngotympanic part of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:0002645.def: An endocranial viscerocranial mucosa cell that is part of viscerocranial mucosa.

CL:0002646.name: obsolete epithelial cell of buccal part of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:0002646.def: An ecto-epithelial cell of the buccal region of the viscerocranial mucosa.

CL:0002647.name: obsolete epithelial cell of anterior palatal part of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:0002647.def: An ecto-epithelial cell of the palatal region of the viscerocranial mucosa.

CL:0002648.name: obsolete epithelial cell of nasal part of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:0002648.def: An ecto-epithelial cell of the nasal region of the viscerocranial mucosa.

CL:0002649.name: obsolete epithelial cell of gingival part of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:0002649.def: An ecto-epithelial cell of the gingival region of the viscerocranial mucosa.

CL:0002650.name: obsolete epithelial cell of paranasal sinus part of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:0002650.def: An ecto-epithelial cell of the paranasal region of the viscerocranial mucosa.

CL:0002651.name: endothelial cell of venous sinus of spleen
CL:0002651.def: An endothelial cell that is part of the venous sinus of spleen. This endothelial cell has an elongated, spindle-shaped, flattened morphology that is parallel to long axis of sinus. This cell type rests on a basement membrane interrupted by numerous narrow slits.

CL:0002652.name: endothelial cell of high endothelial venule
CL:0002652.def: A venule endothelial cell that is cubodial, expresses leukocyte-specific receptors, and allows for passage of lymphocytes into bloodstream.
synonym: endothelial cell of postcapillary venule of lymph node

CL:0002654.name: epithelial cell of stratum corneum of esophageal epithelium
CL:0002654.def: An epithelial cell of stratum corneum of esophageal epithelium.

CL:0002655.name: epithelial cell of stratum spinosum of esophageal epithelium
CL:0002655.def: An epithelial cell of stratum spinosum of esophageal epithelium.

CL:0002656.name: glandular endometrial unciliated epithelial cell
CL:0002656.def: A glandular epithelial cell of the endometrium. Following ovulation, these cells secrete a glycogen-rich substance known as histotroph or uterine milk, which nourishes the embryo if implantation occurs.

CL:0002657.name: glandular cell of esophagus
CL:0002657.def: A glandular epithelial cell of the esophagus.

CL:0002658.name: glandular cell of the large intestine
CL:0002658.def: A glandular epithelial cell of the large intestine.

CL:0002659.name: glandular epithelial cell of stomach
CL:0002659.def: A glandular epithelial cell that is part of the stomach.

CL:0002660.name: luminal cell of acinus of lactiferous gland
CL:0002660.def: A luminal epithelial cell of mammary gland located in acinus of structure.

CL:0002661.name: luminal cell of lactiferous terminal ductal lobular unit
CL:0002661.def: A luminal cell of terminal ducts, i.e.e the terminal branch of a lactiferous duct which alveolar cells drain into.

CL:0002662.name: luminal cell of lactiferous duct
CL:0002662.def: A luminal epithelial cell of the lactiferous duct. This cuboidal epithelial cell expresses keratin-18 and is estrogen-receptor alpha positive.

CL:0002663.name: myocardial endocrine cell of atrium
CL:0002663.def: A myocardial endocrine cell that is part of the atrium.

CL:0002664.name: cardioblast
CL:0002664.def: A stem cell that can give rise to multiple cell types (i.e. smooth muscle, endothelial) in the developing heart.

CL:0002665.name: otic fibrocyte
CL:0002665.def: A fibrocyte of the cochlea that has specialized structural and molecular adaptions.

CL:0002666.name: type 2 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002666.def: An otic fibrocyte that underlies the spiral prominence and is part of a mesenchymal gap junction network that regulates ionic homeostasis of the endolymph.

CL:0002667.name: type 5 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002667.def: An otic fibrocyte that resides above the stria vasularis and is part of a mesenchymal gap junction network that regulates ionic homeostasis of the endolymph.

CL:0002668.name: type 4 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002668.def: An otic fibrocyte that is lateral to the basilar membrane and anchoris it to the lateral wall.

CL:0002669.name: type 3 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002669.def: An otic fibrocyte that lines the otic capsule.

CL:0002670.name: type 1 otic fibrocyte
CL:0002670.def: An otic fibrocyte that underlies the stria vascularis and is part of a mesenchymal gap junction network that regulates ionic homeostasis of the endolymph.

CL:0002671.name: endothelial stalk cell
CL:0002671.def: An endothelial stalk cell is a specialized endothelial cell that follows behind the tip cell of an angiogenic sprout.

CL:0002672.name: retinal progenitor cell
CL:0002672.def: A multi-fate stem cell that can give rise to different retinal cell types including rod and cone cells.

CL:0002673.name: tongue muscle cell
CL:0002673.def: A skeletal muscle cell that is part of the tongue.

CL:0002674.name: H minus
CL:0002674.def: A S. pombe mating type determined by the mat1-Mc and mat1-Mi on the mat1 locus.

CL:0002675.name: H plus
CL:0002675.def: A S. pombe cell type determined by mat1-Pc and mat1-Pi on the mat1 locus.

CL:0002676.name: neural crest derived neuroblast
CL:0002676.def: A neuroblast derived from a neural crest cell.

CL:0002677.name: naive regulatory T cell
CL:0002677.def: A regulatory T cell that has not encountered antigen.

CL:0002678.name: memory regulatory T cell
CL:0002678.def: A CD4-positive, CD25-positive alpha-beta regulatory T cell that has encountered antigen.

CL:0002679.name: natural helper lymphocyte
CL:0002679.def: A lymphocyte found in adipose tissue that lacks lineage markers of other lymphocytes but is capable of mediating TH2 cytokine responses. This cell type is found in fat associated lymphoid clusters, proliferates in response to IL2 and produce large amounts of TH2 cytokines such as IL5, IL6 and IL13

CL:0002680.name: PP cell of intestine
CL:0002680.def: A PP cell found in intestine.

CL:0002681.name: kidney cortical cell
CL:0002681.def: A cell that is part of a cortex of kidney.

CL:0003001.name: bistratified retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003001.def: A retinal ganglion cell that has dendrites stratified in two layers of the inner-plexiform layer.

CL:0003002.name: G1 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003002.def: A retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendritic field and a medium dendritic arbor with post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layer S3.

CL:0003003.name: G2 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003003.def: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendritic field and a sparse dendritic arbor with post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layer S3.

CL:0003004.name: G3 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003004.def: A bistratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendritic field with sparse density that terminates at the intersection of the S4-S5 sublaminar level, and a second dendrite field that is medium in size and degree of arborization that terminates in sublaminar layer S2.

CL:0003005.name: G4 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003005.def: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendritic field and dense dendritic arbor.

CL:0003006.name: G4-ON retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003006.def: A G4 retinal ganglion cell that has post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layers S3 and S4 and is depolarized by illumination of its receptive field center.

CL:0003007.name: G4-OFF retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003007.def: A G4 retinal ganglion cell that has post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layers S2 and S3 and is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center

CL:0003008.name: G5 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003008.def: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a medium dendritic field and a medium dendritic arbor with post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layer S2.

CL:0003009.name: G6 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003009.def: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a medium dendritic field and a sparse dendritic arbor with post sympatic terminals in sublaminar layer S4 and S5.

CL:0003010.name: G7 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003010.def: A bistratified retinal ganglion cell that has a dendrite field that terminates in sublaminar layer S2 and a second dendrite field that terminates in sublaminar layer S4.

CL:0003011.name: G8 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003011.def: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a large dendritic field and a sparse dendritic arbor with post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S4.

CL:0003012.name: G9 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003012.def: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a large dendritic field and a medium dendritic arbor with post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S1 and S2.

CL:0003013.name: G10 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003013.def: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a large dendritic field, a medium dendritic arbor, and a long secondary dendrite shaft with post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S4.

CL:0003014.name: G11 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003014.def: A mono-stratified retinal ganglion cell that has a large dendritic field, a medium dendritic arbor, and a medium length secondary dendrite shaft.

CL:0003015.name: G11-ON retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003015.def: A G11 retinal ganglion cell that has post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S4 and is depolarized by illumination of its receptive field center.

CL:0003016.name: G11-OFF retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003016.def: A G11 retinal ganglion cell that has post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S2 and is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center

CL:0003017.name: retinal ganglion cell B3 outer
CL:0003017.def: A retinal ganglion B cell that has post synaptic terminals in S2.

CL:0003018.name: retinal ganglion cell B3 inner
CL:0003018.def: A retinal ganglion B3 cell with dentrites terminating in S4.

CL:0003020.name: retinal ganglion cell C outer
CL:0003020.def: A retinal ganglion cell C that has post-synaptic terminals in S2.

CL:0003021.name: retinal ganglion cell C4
CL:0003021.def: A retinal ganglion cell C outer that has a medium dendritic field and a dense dendritic arbor.

CL:0003022.name: retinal ganglion cell C5
CL:0003022.def: A retinal ganglion cell C outer that has medium dendritic density and field size.

CL:0003023.name: retinal ganglion cell C6
CL:0003023.def: A retinal ganglion cell C outer that has dense dendritic diversity.

CL:0003024.name: retinal ganglion cell C inner
CL:0003024.def: A retinal ganglion cell C with medium cell bodies and large dendritic field.

CL:0003025.name: retinal ganglion cell C3
CL:0003025.def: A retinal ganglion cell C inner that has sparse dendritic density, and large dendritic field.

CL:0003026.name: retinal ganglion cell D1
CL:0003026.def: A bistratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendrite fields with a sparse dendrite arbor terminating in S2 and S3.

CL:0003027.name: retinal ganglion cell D2
CL:0003027.def: A bistratified retinal ganglion cell D cell that has medium dendritic arbor and a large dendritic field that terminates in S2 and S4.

CL:0003028.name: M1 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003028.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small dendrite field with a dense dendrite arbor with post synaptic terminals in sublaminer layer S4.

CL:0003029.name: M2 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003029.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small soma, a small dendrite field with a dense dendrite arbor, and post synaptic terminals in sublaminer layer S2 and S3.

CL:0003030.name: M3 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003030.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has a medium soma and a small dendrite field.

CL:0003031.name: M3-ON retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003031.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S4 and is depolarized by illumination of its receptive field center.

CL:0003032.name: M3-OFF retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003032.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S2 and is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center

CL:0003033.name: M4 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003033.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has a large soma, a medium dendritic field with post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S3.

CL:0003034.name: M5 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003034.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that has a small soma, an assymetric dendritic field with post synaptic terminals in sublaminar layer S3.

CL:0003035.name: M6 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003035.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell that contains opsin.

CL:0003036.name: M7 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003036.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell with large soma and large dendritic field, with medium dendritic arbor, and has dendrites in layers 2 and 5.

CL:0003037.name: M7-ON retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003037.def: An M7 retinal ganglion cells with synaptic terminals in S4 and is depolarized by illumination of its receptive field center.

CL:0003038.name: M7-OFF retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003038.def: An M7 retinal ganglion cells with synaptic terminals in S2 and is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center

CL:0003039.name: M8 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003039.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell with large soma and medium dendritic field, with dense dendritic arbor.

CL:0003040.name: M9 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003040.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell with large soma and large dendritic field, with medium dendritic arbor, and has dendrites in layers 1 and 5.

CL:0003041.name: M9-ON retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003041.def: An M9 retinal ganglion cells with synaptic terminals in S2 and is depolarized by illumination of its receptive field center.

CL:0003042.name: M9-OFF retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003042.def: An M9 retinal ganglion cell with synaptic terminals in S4 that is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center

CL:0003043.name: M10 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003043.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell with large soma and large dendritic field, with dense dendritic arbor.

CL:0003044.name: M11 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003044.def: A bistratified ganglion cell with small, dense dendritic fields that terminate in S1 and S3.

CL:0003045.name: M12 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003045.def: A bistratified ganglion cell with larger, asymetric dendritic fields that terminate in S2 and S4.

CL:0003046.name: M13 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003046.def: A bistratifed retinal ganglion cell that has small, symmetric dendritic fields that terminate in S2 and S4.

CL:0003047.name: M14 retinal ganglion cell
CL:0003047.def: A bistratifed retinal ganglion cell that has small, symmetric dendritic fields that terminate in S1 and S4-S5.

CL:0003048.name: L cone cell
CL:0003048.def: A cone cell that detects long wavelength light. Exact peak of spectra detected differs between species. In humans, spectra peaks at 564-580 nm.

CL:0003049.name: M cone cell
CL:0003049.def: A cone cell that detects medium wavelength light. Exact peak of spectra detected differs between species. In humans, spectra peaks at 534-545 nm.

CL:0003050.name: S cone cell
CL:0003050.def: A cone cell that detects short wavelength light. Exact peak of spectra detected differs between species. In humans, spectra peaks at 420-440 nm.

CL:0003051.name: UV cone cell
CL:0003051.def: A cone cell that detects ultraviolet (UV) wavelength light.

CL:0004001.name: local interneuron
CL:0004001.def: An interneuron whose axon stays entirely within the gray matter region where the cell body resides.

CL:0004115.name: retinal ganglion cell B
CL:0004115.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell with small to medium soma and small to medium dendritic field.

CL:0004116.name: retinal ganglion cell C
CL:0004116.def: A retinal ganglion with cell medium cell bodies and medium to large dendritic fields.

CL:0004117.name: retinal ganglion cell A
CL:0004117.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell with large soma and large dendritic field.

CL:0004119.name: retinal ganglion cell B1
CL:0004119.def: A retinal ganglion cell B that has medium body size, medium dendritic field and dense dendritic arbor, and has post synaptic terminals in S2.

CL:0004120.name: retinal ganglion cell A1
CL:0004120.def: A retinal ganglion A cell found in the retina with large somata, often polygonal in shape. The dendritic fields consist of three to seven stout dendrites that are sparce near soma. Dendrites terminate in S4.

CL:0004121.name: retinal ganglion cell B2
CL:0004121.def: A retinal ganglion cell B that has a very small but very dense dendritic field, and has post synaptic terminals in S2.

CL:0004124.name: retinal ganglion cell C1
CL:0004124.def: A retinal ganglion cell C inner that has medium dendritic diversity.

CL:0004125.name: retinal ganglion cell C2 inner
CL:0004125.def: A retinal ganglion cell C inner that has dense dendritic diversity.

CL:0004126.name: retinal ganglion cell C2 outer
CL:0004126.def: A retinal ganglion cell C outer that has symmetrical and dense dendritic dendritic tree with a large dendritic field.

CL:0004137.name: retinal ganglion cell A2 inner
CL:0004137.def: A retinal ganglion A2 cell with dendrites terminating in S4.

CL:0004138.name: retinal ganglion cell A2
CL:0004138.def: A retinal ganglion A cell with dense arbor near soma.

CL:0004139.name: retinal ganglion cell A2 outer
CL:0004139.def: A retinal ganglion A2 cell with dendrites terminating in S2.

CL:0004161.name: 510 nm-cone
CL:0004161.def: A cone whose sensitivity measurements have an average spectral peak of 510 nm. These cones are described in rat.

CL:0004162.name: 360 nm-cone
CL:0004162.def: A cone whose sensitivity measurements have an average spectral peak of 358.2 nm. These cones are described in rat.

CL:0004183.name: retinal ganglion cell B3
CL:0004183.def: A monostratified retinal ganglion cell with medium soma, sparse dendritic tree, and medium dendritic field.

CL:0004213.name: type 3a cone bipolar cell
CL:0004213.def: A type of type 3 cone bipolar cell with distinctive curly dendrites.

CL:0004214.name: type 3b cone bipolar cell
CL:0004214.def: A type of type 3 cone bipolar cell with distinctive crescent-shaped dendrites.

CL:0004215.name: type 5a cone bipolar cell
CL:0004215.def: A type 5 cone bipolar cell with narrowly stratified post synaptic terminals.

CL:0004216.name: type 5b cone bipolar cell
CL:0004216.def: A type 5 cone bipolar cell with diffuse axonal branches.

CL:0004217.name: H1 horizontal cell
CL:0004217.def: A horizontal cell with a large cell body, thick dendrites, and a large dendritic arbor.

CL:0004218.name: H2 horizontal cell
CL:0004218.def: A horizontal cell with a small cell body, thin dendrites, and small dendritic arbor.

CL:0004219.name: A2 amacrine cell
CL:0004219.def: A bistratifed retinal amacrine cell with a small dendritic field, dendrite stratification in S1-S2, and a second dendrite stratification in S5. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004220.name: flag amacrine cell
CL:0004220.def: An amacrine cell with a small, asymteric dendritic field.

CL:0004221.name: flag A amacrine cell
CL:0004221.def: A flag amacrine cell with post-synaptic terminals in S2 and S3. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004222.name: flag B amacrine cell
CL:0004222.def: A flag amacrine cell with post-synaptic terminals in S3, S4, and S5. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004223.name: AB diffuse-1 amacrine cell
CL:0004223.def: A amacrine cell with a small dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S1, S2, S3, and S4. AB diffuse-1 amacrine cells have a tent-shaped dendritic arbor and undulate dendrites.

CL:0004224.name: AB diffuse-2 amacrine cell
CL:0004224.def: A broadly stratifying amacrine cell that has a small dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S2 and S3. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004225.name: spider amacrine cell
CL:0004225.def: A broadly stratifying amacrine cell with a small dendritic field, straight dendrites and post-synaptic terminals in S1, S2, and S3.

CL:0004226.name: monostratified amacrine cell
CL:0004226.def: An amacrine cell with a small dendritic field with post-synaptic terminals in S3 and S4.

CL:0004227.name: flat bistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004227.def: A bistratified amacrine cell with a small dendritic field. Flat bistratified amacrine cells have post-synaptic terminals both on the border of S1 and S2, and on the border of S3 and S4. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004228.name: broad diffuse amacrine cell
CL:0004228.def: An amacrine cell with a small dendritic field that has post-synaptic terminals in S1, S2, S3, and S4.

CL:0004229.name: A2-like amacrine cell
CL:0004229.def: A bistratified amacrine cell with a small dendritic field that has dendrite stratification in S2, and in S3 and S4.

CL:0004230.name: diffuse bistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004230.def: A bistratified amacrine cell with a small dendritic field that has post-synaptic terminals in S1 and the border of S1-S2, and termination of a second arbor within the border of S2-S3 and S3.

CL:0004231.name: recurving diffuse amacrine cell
CL:0004231.def: A broadly stratifying amacrine cell with a small dendritic field and a complex dendritic arbor. Recurving diffuse amacrine cells have post-synaptic terminals in S2, S3, and S4.

CL:0004232.name: starburst amacrine cell
CL:0004232.def: An amacrine cell with a flat dendritic arbor and a medium dendritic field. Starburst amacrine cells have post-synaptic terminals in S2. This cell type releases the neurotransmitters gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and acetylcholine.

CL:0004233.name: DAPI-3 amacrine cell
CL:0004233.def: An amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals that stratify at S2, with a second stratification that occurs in S3 and S4. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter glycine.

CL:0004234.name: diffuse multistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004234.def: An amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S2, and in S3-S4.

CL:0004235.name: AB broad diffuse-1 amacrine cell
CL:0004235.def: An amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S2 and S3. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA).

CL:0004236.name: AB broad diffuse-2 amacrine cell
CL:0004236.def: An amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S2, S3, and S4. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA).

CL:0004237.name: fountain amacrine cell
CL:0004237.def: A retinal amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S1, S2, S3, and S4. This cell type releases the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA).

CL:0004238.name: asymmetric bistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004238.def: A bistratified amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field, a flat and sparse dendritic arbor, and post-synaptic terminals at the intersections of S1 and S2, and S3 and S4.

CL:0004239.name: wavy bistratified amacrine cell
CL:0004239.def: A bistratified amacrine cell with a medium dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S1-S2, and S4.

CL:0004240.name: WF1 amacrine cell
CL:0004240.def: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field, dendrites in S1, and post-synaptic terminals in S1.

CL:0004241.name: WF2 amacrine cell
CL:0004241.def: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field, dendrites in S2, and post-synaptic terminals in S1.

CL:0004242.name: WF3-1 amacrine cell
CL:0004242.def: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field, dendrites in S3, and post-synaptic terminals in S3. Dendrites of this cell type are straight and minimally branched.

CL:0004243.name: WF3-2 amacrine cell
CL:0004243.def: An amacrine cell with a wild dendritic field, dendrites in S3, and post-synaptic terminals in S3. Dendrites have spikes, cross over each other, and cover a larger volume than dendrties of W3-1 retinal amacrine cells.

CL:0004244.name: WF4 amacrine cell
CL:0004244.def: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field, dendrites in S4, and post-synaptic terminals in S4.

CL:0004245.name: indoleamine-accumulating amacrine cell
CL:0004245.def: An amacrine cell with a wide dendritic field and post-synaptic terminals in S5. This cell type releases the neurotransmitters gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and serotonin.

CL:0004246.name: monostratified cell
CL:0004246.def: A central nervous system neuron that stratifies at one and only one location.

CL:0004247.name: bistratified cell
CL:0004247.def: A neuron that stratifies dendrites at two and only two locations.

CL:0004250.name: bistratified retinal amacrine cell
CL:0004250.def: An amicrine that stratifies dendrites at two and only two locations.

CL:0004251.name: narrow field retinal amacrine cell
CL:0004251.def: An amicrine that has a narrow dendritic field.

CL:0004252.name: medium field retinal amacrine cell
CL:0004252.def: An amicrine that has a medium dendritic field.

CL:0004253.name: wide field retinal amacrine cell
CL:0004253.def: An amicrine that has a wide dendritic field.

CL:0005000.name: spinal cord interneuron
CL:0005000.def: A CNS interneuron located in the spinal cord.

CL:0005001.name: iridoblast
CL:0005001.def: A non-terminally differentiated cell that originates from the neural crest and differentiates into an iridophore.

CL:0005002.name: xanthoblast
CL:0005002.def: A non-terminally differentiated cell that differentiates into a xanthophore.

CL:0005003.name: leucoblast
CL:0005003.def: A non-terminally differentiated cell that originates from the neural crest and differentiates into a leucophore.

CL:0005004.name: pigment erythroblast
CL:0005004.def: A non-terminally differentiated cell that originates from the neural crest and differentiates into an erythrophore.

CL:0005005.name: cyanoblast
CL:0005005.def: A non-terminally differentiated cell that originates from the neural crest and differentiates into a cyanophore.

CL:0005006.name: ionocyte
CL:0005006.def: Specialized epithelial cells involved in the maintenance of osmotic homeostasis. They are characterized by abundant mitochondria and ion transporters. In amniotes, they are present in the renal system. In freshwater fish, ionocytes in the skin and gills help maintain osmotic homeostasis by absorbing salt from the external environment.

CL:0005007.name: Kolmer-Agduhr neuron
CL:0005007.def: Kolmer-Agduhr neurons are ciliated GABAergic neurons that contact the central canal of the spinal cord and have ipsilateral ascending axons.

CL:0005008.name: macular hair cell
CL:0005008.def: An auditory hair cell located in the macula that is sensitive to auditory stimuli.

CL:0005009.name: renal principal cell
CL:0005009.def: A cuboidal epithelial cell of the kidney which regulates sodium and potassium balance. The activity of sodium and potassium channels on the apical membrane of the cell is regulated by aldosterone and vasopressin. In mammals this cell type is located in the renal collecting duct system.

CL:0005010.name: renal intercalated cell
CL:0005010.def: A cuboidal epithelial cell of the kidney that regulates acid/base balance.

CL:0005011.name: renal alpha-intercalated cell
CL:0005011.def: A cuboidal epithelial cell of the kidney which secretes acid and reabsorbs base to regulate acid/base balance.

CL:0005012.name: multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:0005012.def: A columnar/cuboidal epithelial cell with multiple motile cilia on its apical surface. These cells facilitate the movement of liquids such as mucus or cerebrospinal fluid across the epithelial surface.

CL:0005013.name: single ciliated epithelial cell
CL:0005013.def: A ciliated epithelial cell with a single cilium.

CL:0005014.name: auditory epithelial supporting cell
CL:0005014.def: A non-sensory cell that extends from the basement membrane to the apical surface of the auditory epithelium and provides support for auditory hair cells.

CL:0005015.name: inner phalangeal cell
CL:0005015.def: An auditory epithelial support cell that surrounds the nerve fibers and synapses of the auditory inner hair cells.

CL:0005016.name: obsolete apical cell
CL:0005016.def: Obsolete. Use PO:0030007 from Plant Ontology instead. The apical cell is the upper cell formed after the first division of a plant zygote.

CL:0005017.name: obsolete plant basal cell
CL:0005017.def: Obsolete. Use PO:0002002 from Plant Ontology instead. The lower cell formed after the first division of a plant zygote.

CL:0005018.name: ghrelin secreting cell
CL:0005018.def: A cell that secretes ghrelin, the peptide hormone that stimulates hunger.

CL:0005019.name: pancreatic epsilon cell
CL:0005019.def: Ghrelin secreting cells found in the endocrine pancreas.

CL:0005021.name: mesenchymal lymphangioblast
CL:0005021.def: Mesenchymal derived lymphatic progenitor cells that give rise to the superficial lymphatics.

CL:0005022.name: vascular lymphangioblast
CL:0005022.def: Lymphatic progenitor cells, derived from the veins, that give rise to lymphatic endothelial cells.

CL:0005023.name: branchiomotor neuron
CL:0005023.def: Cranial motor neuron which innervates muscles derived from the branchial (pharyngeal) arches.

CL:0005024.name: somatomotor neuron
CL:0005024.def: A motor neuron that innervates a skeletal muscle.  These motor neurons are all excitatory and cholinergic.

CL:0005025.name: visceromotor neuron
CL:0005025.def: A motor neuron that synapses to parasympathetic neurons that innervate tear glands, sweat glands, and the smooth muscles and glands of the pulmonary, cardiovascular, and gastrointestinal systems.

CL:0005026.name: hepatoblast
CL:0005026.def: Multi fate stem cell that gives rise to both hepatocytes and cholangiocytes as descendants. The term often refers to fetal precursors of hepatocytes (differently from 'hepatic stem cell', usually applied to the self-renewing pool of hepatocyte precursors in the adult liver). Hepatoblasts may also be endogenous, as some stem cells found in the liver come from the bone marrow via blood circulation.

CL:0007000.name: preameloblast
CL:0007000.def: Skeletogenic cell that has the potential to develop into an ameloblast. Located in the inner enamel epithelium, these cells elongate, their nuclei shift distally (away from the dental papilla), and their cytoplasm becomes filled with organelles needed for synthesis and secretion of enamel proteins.

CL:0007001.name: skeletogenic cell
CL:0007001.def: Cell that has the potential to form a skeletal cell type (e.g. cells in periosteum, cells in marrow) and produce extracellular matrix (often mineralized) and skeletal tissue (often mineralized).

CL:0007002.name: precementoblast
CL:0007002.def: Skeletogenic cell that has the potential to develop into a cementoblast.

CL:0007003.name: preodontoblast
CL:0007003.def: Skeletogenic cell that has the potential to form an odontoblast, deposits predentine, and arises from a cranial neural crest cell.

CL:0007004.name: premigratory neural crest cell
CL:0007004.def: Cell that is part of the neural crest region of the neuroepithelium, prior to migration. Note that not all premigratory neural crest cells may become migratory neural crest cells.

CL:0007005.name: notochordal cell
CL:0007005.def: Cell that is part of the notochord.

CL:0007006.name: chordamesodermal cell
CL:0007006.def: Mesodermal cell that is axially located and gives rise to the cells of the notochord.

CL:0007007.name: notochordal sheath cell
CL:0007007.def: Notochordal cell that is part of the outer epithelium of the notochord and surrounds the vacuolated notochord cells.

CL:0007008.name: notochordal vacuole cell
CL:0007008.def: Notochordal cell that is inner portion of the notochord and becomes vacuolated as development proceeds.

CL:0007009.name: prechondroblast
CL:0007009.def: Skeletogenic cell that has the potential to develop into a chondroblast; and arises from neural crest, meseosdermal and notochordal and connective tissue cells.

CL:0007010.name: preosteoblast
CL:0007010.def: Skeletogenic cell that has the potential to transform into an osteoblast, and develops from neural crest or mesodermal cells.

CL:0007011.name: enteric neuron
CL:0007011.def: Neuron that is part of the enteric nervous system.

CL:0007012.name: non-terminally differentiated odontoblast
CL:0007012.def: Odontoblast that non-terminally differentiated, located in the odontogenic papilla and dentine tissue, and transforms from a odontoblast cell.

CL:0007013.name: terminally differentiated odontoblast
CL:0007013.def: Odontoblast that is terminally differentiated and derived from an odontogenic papilla and associated with dentine.

CL:0007014.name: obsolete cell line cell
CL:0007014.def: OBSOLETE: A cultured cell that has been passaged at least one time in culture.

CL:0007015.name: obsolete mortal cell line cell
CL:0007015.def: OBSOLETE: A cell line cell that is expected to be capable of replicating a limited number of times in culture before undergoing senescence. Mortal cell line cells cannot be propagated indefinitely (as immortal cell line cells can).

CL:0007016.name: adaxial cell
CL:0007016.def: Muscle precursor cell that is adjacent to the notochord and part of the presomitic mesoderm.

CL:0007017.name: Stiftchenzellen
CL:0007017.def: An epidermal cell with apical microvilli or a single apical projection have synaptic associations with nerve fibres in the epidermis.

CL:0007018.name: epidermal ciliary cell
CL:0007018.def: Ciliated cell of the embryonic epidermis and functions in embryonic movements.

CL:0007020.name: bottle cell
CL:0007020.def: Characteristic early embryonic cell with a bottle or flask shape that is first to migrate inwards at the blastopore during gastrulation in amphibians.

CL:0007021.name: alarm substance cell
CL:0007021.def: Secretory cell that produces a chemical mixture that triggers antipredator behavior. The substance is released only upon disruption of the epidermis. [Behavior of teleost fishes, second edition, edited by Pitcher, 1992]

CL:0007022.name: micropylar cell
CL:0007022.def: A specialized pore forming cell of the follicle, located adjacent to the animal pole of the oocyte. The micropylar cell makes the single micropyle (pore) through the chorion through which the sperm fertilizes the egg.

CL:0007023.name: flask cell
CL:0007023.def: Epidermal cell rich in mitochondria. In amphibians, appears during metamorphosis.

CL:0008000.name: non-striated muscle cell
CL:0008000.def: Any muscle cell in which the fibers are not organised into sarcomeres.

CL:0008001.name: hematopoietic precursor cell
CL:0008001.def: Any hematopoietic cell that is a precursor of some other hematopoietic cell type.

CL:0008002.name: skeletal muscle fiber
CL:0008002.def: A transversely striated, synctial cell of skeletal muscle. It is formed when proliferating myoblasts exit the cell cycle, differentiate and fuse.

CL:0008003.name: somatic muscle myotube
CL:0008003.def: A myotube that is part of some somatic muscle.  Examples include arthropod somatic muscle cells.

CL:0008004.name: somatic muscle cell
CL:0008004.def: A muscle cell that is part of some somatic muscle.

CL:0008005.name: obliquely striated somatic muscle cell
CL:0008005.def: A somatic muscle cell that is obliquely striated and mononucleated. Examples include the somatic muscles of nematodes.

CL:0008006.name: muscle founder cell
CL:0008006.def: A myoblast that detemines the properties (size, shape and attachment to the epidermis) of a `somatic muscle myotube` (CL:0008003) .  It develops into a somatic muscle myotube via fusion with `fusion component myoblasts` (CL:0000621).

CL:0008007.name: visceral muscle cell
CL:0008007.def: A muscle cell that is part of some visceral muscle.

CL:0008008.name: striated visceral muscle cell
CL:0008008.def: A visceral muscle cell that is striated.  Examples include the visceral muscle cells of arhtropods.

CL:0008009.name: transversely striated visceral muscle cell
CL:0008009.def: A visceral muscle that is transversely striated.  Examples include the visceral muscle cells of arthropods.

CL:0008010.name: cranial somatomotor neuron
CL:0008010.def: A cranial motor neuron whose soma is located in the midbrain andor hindbrain and which innervates the skeletal muscles of the eye or tongue.

CL:0008011.name: skeletal muscle satellite stem cell
CL:0008011.def: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that divides by stem cell division.  A proportion of this population undergoes symmetric stem cell division, producing two skeletal muscle satellite stem cells. The rest undergo asymmetric stem cell division - retaining their identity while budding off a daughter cell that differentiates into an adult skeletal muscle myoblast.
