CL:0008012.name: quiescent skeletal muscle satellite cell
CL:0008012.def: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that is mitotically quiescent.  These cells are wedge shaped and have a large nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio with few organelles, a small nucleus and condensed interphase chromatin. Satellite cells typically remain in this state until activated following muscle damage.

CL:0008013.name: cranial visceromotor neuron
CL:0008013.def: A visceromotor motor neuron whose soma is located in the hindbrain, and which synapses to parasympathetic neurons that innervate tear glands, sweat glands, and the smooth muscles of the head.

CL:0008014.name: obsolete excitatory motor neuron
CL:0008014.def: A motor neuron that is capable of directly inducing muscle contraction.

CL:0008015.name: inhibitory motor neuron
CL:0008015.def: A motor neuron that is capable of directly inhibiting muscle contraction.

CL:0008016.name: activated skeletal muscle satellite cell
CL:0008016.def: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that has become mitotically active - typically following muscle damage.

CL:0008017.name: adult skeletal muscle myoblast
CL:0008017.def: A skeletal muscle myoblast that is part of a skeletal mucle.  These cells are formed following acivation and division of skeletal muscle satellite cells. They form a transient population that is lost when they fuse to form skeletal muscle fibers.

CL:0008018.name: somatic muscle myoblast
CL:0008018.def: A myoblast that is commited to developing into a somatic muscle.

CL:0008019.name: mesenchymal cell
CL:0008019.def: A non-polarised cell precursor cell that is part of some mesenchyme, is associated with the cell matrix but is not connected to other cells and is capable of migration.

CL:0008020.name: skeletal muscle satellite myogenic cell
CL:0008020.def: A skeletal muscle satellite cell that undergoes symmetric division to produce two adult skeleltal muscle myoblasts.

CL:0008021.name: anterior lateral line ganglion neuron
CL:0008021.def: Any peripheral nervous system neuron that has its soma located in some anterior lateral line ganglion.

CL:0008022.name: endocardial cushion cell
CL:0008022.def: A mesenchymal cell of the endocardial cushion.   These cells develop via an epithelial to mesenchymal transition when endocardial cells break cell-to-cell contacts and migrate into the cardiac jelly. Cells from this population form the heart septa and valves.

CL:0008024.name: pancreatic endocrine cell
CL:0008024.def: An endocrine cell that is part of the pancreas.

CL:0008025.name: noradrenergic neuron
CL:0008025.def: A neuron that release noradrenaline (noriphinephrine) as a neurotransmitter.

CL:0008026.name: open tracheal system tracheocyte
CL:0008026.def: An epithelial cell that is part of the epithelium of a tracheal tube in an open tracheal system, such as that found in insects.

CL:0008027.name: rod bipolar cell (sensu Mus)
CL:0008027.def: A bipolar neuron found in the retina that is synapsed by rod photoreceptor cells.  These neurons have axons that arborize and synapse to targets in inner plexiform layers 4 and 5 and depolarize in response to light.

CL:0008028.name: visual system neuron
CL:0008028.def: Any neuron that is capable of part of some visual perception.

CL:0008031.name: cortical interneuron
CL:0008031.def: An interneuron that has its soma located in the cerebral cortex.

CL:0008032.name: rosehip neuron
CL:0008032.def: A GABAergic interneuron in human cortical layer 1 that has large rosehip-shaped axonal boutons and compact arborization.

CL:0008033.name: decidual pericyte
CL:0008033.def: A pericyte of the decidual vasculature.

CL:0008034.name: mural cell
CL:0008034.def: Mural cells are pericytes and the vascular smooth muscle cells (vSMCs) of the microcirculation.

CL:0008035.name: microcirculation associated smooth muscle cell
CL:0008035.def: Any vascular associated smooth muscle cell that is part of some microcirculatory vessel.

CL:0008036.name: extravillous trophoblast
CL:0008036.def: A trophoblast cell that is not part of a placental villous.

CL:0008037.name: gamma motor neuron
CL:0008037.def: A lower motor neuron that innervates only intrafusal muscle fibers. Unlike the alpha motor neurons, gamma motor neurons do not directly adjust the lengthening or shortening of muscles but function in adjusting the sensitivity of muscle spindles and in keeping muscle spindles taut, thereby allowing the continued firing of alpha neurons.

CL:0008038.name: alpha motor neuron
CL:0008038.def: A large, multipolar lower motor neuron of the brainstem and spinal cord that innervates the extrafusal muscle fibers of skeletal muscle and are directly responsible for initiating their contraction. While their cell bodies are in the CNS (in the anterior gray horn of the spinal cord), they are part of the somatic nervous system - a branch of the PNS.

CL:0008039.name: lower motor neuron
CL:0008039.def: The motor neurons of vertebrates that directly innervate skeletal muscles. They receive input from upper motor neurons.

CL:0008040.name: squamous endothelial cell of venule
CL:0008040.def: An endothelial cell of the venule that is squamous shaped. This is in contrast to the cubodial shape of high endothelial venule cells.

CL:0008041.name: mesothelial cell of intestine
CL:0008041.def: A mesothelial cell that is part of the intestinal serosa.

CL:0008042.name: tanycyte of subfornical organ
CL:0008042.def: A tanycyte of the subfornical organ (SFO).  These cells extend long and slender fibers extending from their cell bodies in the ependyma toward fenestrated capillaries associated with the SFO, where they form a dense network surrounding these capillaries.

CL:0008044.name: tanycyte of area postrema
CL:0008044.def: A tanycyte of the area postrema (AP).  These cells extend long and slender fibers extending from their cell bodies in the ependyma toward fenestrated capillaries associated with the AP, where they form a dense network surrounding these capillaries.

CL:0008045.name: tanycyte of subcommissural organ
CL:0008045.def: A tanycyte of the subcommisural organ (SCO).  These cells extend long and slender fibers extending from their cell bodies in the ependyma toward fenestrated capillaries associated with the SCO, where they form a dense network surrounding these capillaries.

CL:0008046.name: extrafusal muscle fiber
CL:0008046.def: A skeletal muscle fiber that is innervated by alpha motor neuron and generates tension by contracting, thereby allowing for skeletal movement. These fibers make up the large mass of skeletal muscle tissue and are attached to bones by tendons.

CL:0008047.name: intrafusal muscle fiber
CL:0008047.def: A skeletal muscle fiber that is part of a muscle spindle. These are specialized muscle fibers that serve as proprioceptors, detecting the amount and rate of change in length of a muscle. They are innervated by both sensory neurons and motor neurons (gamma and beta motorneurons, collectively referred to as fusimotor neurons).

CL:0008048.name: upper motor neuron
CL:0008048.def: A glutamatergic motor neuron with a soma in the brainstem or cerebral cortex.  They do not synapse directly to muscles but rather to lower motor neurons, which do.  They are the main controllers of voluntary movement.

CL:0008049.name: Betz cell
CL:0008049.def: A giant pyramidal neuron with a soma in layer Vb of the primary motor cortex that sends its axons down the spinal cord via the corticospinal tract, either synapsing directly with alpha motor neurons, or targeting interneurons in the spinal cord. In humans, Betz cells are the largest known in the central nervous system.

CL:0008053.name: circumventricular organ capillary endothelial cell
CL:0008053.def: A capillary endothelial cell that is part of the circumventricular organs (CVOs), characterized by fenestrations that facilitate selective permeability to molecules, distinguishing it from the non-fenestrated endothelial cells of the blood-brain barrier. This cell is integral to the unique vascular structure of CVOs, which lack a traditional blood-brain barrier. It enables bidirectional exchange of polar molecules between blood and neural tissue, supporting neuroendocrine signaling, fluid balance, and immune responses. It is marked by the expression of PLVAP, a component of the fenestral diaphragm, in both rodents and humans.

CL:0008055.name: respiratory tract secretory epithelial cell
CL:0008055.def: A secretory epithelial cell of the respiratory tract epithelium.  These cells have an endodermal origin.

CL:0009000.name: sensory neuron of spinal nerve
CL:0009000.def: A sensory neuron of the spinal nerve that senses body position and sends information about how much the muscle is stretched to the spinal cord.

CL:0009001.name: compound eye retinal cell
CL:0009001.def: Any cell in the compound eye, a light sensing organ composed of ommatidia.

CL:0009002.name: inflammatory cell
CL:0009002.def: Any cell participating in the inflammatory response to a foreign substance, e.g. neutrophil, macrophage.

CL:0009003.name: larval midgut cell
CL:0009003.def: Any cell in the midgut (middle subdivision of a digestive tract) of an insect larva.

CL:0009004.name: retinal cell
CL:0009004.def: Any cell in the retina, the innermost layer or coating at the back of the eyeball, which is sensitive to light and in which the optic nerve terminates.

CL:0009005.name: salivary gland cell
CL:0009005.def: Any cell in a salivary gland.

CL:0009006.name: enteroendocrine cell of small intestine
CL:0009006.def: An enteroendocrine cell that is located in the small intestine.

CL:0009007.name: gastrointestinal tract (lamina propria) macrophage of small intestine
CL:0009007.def: A macrophage which is resident in the lamina propria of the small intestine.
synonym: small intestine lamina propria resident macrophage

CL:0009008.name: gastrointestinal tract (lamina propria) macrophage of large intestine
CL:0009008.def: A macrophage which is resident in the lamina propria of the large intestine.
synonym: large intestine lamina propria resident macrophage

CL:0009009.name: paneth cell of colon
CL:0009009.def: A paneth cell that is located in the epithelium of the colon.
synonym: paneth cell of epithelium of colon
paneth cell of epithelium of large intestine

CL:0009010.name: transit amplifying cell
CL:0009010.def: Transit-amplifying cells (TACs) are an undifferentiated population in transition between stem cells and differentiated cells.

CL:0009011.name: transit amplifying cell of colon
CL:0009011.def: A rapidly proliferating population of cells that differentiate from stem cells of the intestinal crypt of the colon. Stem cells located in the crypts of Lieberkühn give rise to proliferating progenitor or transit amplifying cells that differentiate into the four major epithelial cell types. These include columnar absorptive cells or enterocytes, mucous secreting goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells and paneth cells.
synonym: transient amplifying cell of crypt of Lieberkuhn of colon
transit amplifying cell of crypt of Lieberkuhn of colon
transit amplifying cell of large intestine

CL:0009012.name: transit amplifying cell of small intestine
CL:0009012.def: A rapidly proliferating population of cells that differentiate from stem cells of the intestinal crypt of the small intestine. Stem cells located in the crypts of Lieberkühn give rise to proliferating progenitor or transit amplifying cells that differentiate into the four major epithelial cell types. These include columnar absorptive cells or enterocytes, mucous secreting goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells and paneth cells.
synonym: transient amplifying cell of crypt of Lieberkuhn of small intestine
transient amplifying cell of small intestine
transit amplifying cell of crypt of Lieberkuhn of small intestine

CL:0009013.name: fetal hepatobiliary progenitor cell
CL:0009013.def: A progenitor cell with hepatic and biliary lineage potential, identified in mouse and human, and anatomically restricted to the ductal plate of fetal liver.

CL:0009014.name: Peyer's patch lymphocyte
CL:0009014.def: A lymphocyte that is part of a Peyer's patch. These cells have a major role in driving the immune response to antigens sampled from the intestinal lumen, and in regulating the formation of follicle-associated epithelium and M cells in Peyer's patches by converting intestitial enterocytes into M cells.

CL:0009015.name: Peyer's patch follicular dendritic cell
CL:0009015.def: A follicular dendritic cell located in the Peyer's patch. These cells from a meshwork in which Peyer's patch B cells reside.

CL:0009016.name: intestinal crypt stem cell of large intestine
CL:0009016.def: An intestinal stem cell that is located in the large intestine crypt of Liberkuhn. These stem cells reside at the bottom of crypts in the large intestine and are highly proliferative. They either differentiate into transit amplifying cells or self-renew to form new stem cells.
synonym: crypt stem cell of large intestine
stem cell of large intestine crypt of Lieberkuhn

CL:0009017.name: intestinal crypt stem cell of small intestine
CL:0009017.def: An intestinal stem cell that is located in the small intestine crypt of Liberkuhn. These stem cells reside at the bottom of crypts in the small intestine and are highly proliferative. They either differentiate into transit amplifying cells or self-renew to form new stem cells.
synonym: crypt stem cell of small intestine
stem cell of small intestine crypt of Lieberkuhn

CL:0009018.name: lymphocyte of large intestine lamina propria
CL:0009018.def: A lymphocyte that resides in the lamina propria of the large intestine.
CL:0009018.synonym: lamina propria lymphocyte of large intestine

CL:0009019.name: nephrogenic zone cell
CL:0009019.def: A kidney cortical cell that is part of the nephrogenic zone.

CL:0009020.name: tuft cell of appendix
CL:0009020.def: An intestinal tuft cell that is a part of a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009021.name: stromal cell of lamina propria of large intestine
CL:0009021.def: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the large intestine.

CL:0009022.name: stromal cell of lamina propria of small intestine
CL:0009022.def: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the small intestine.

CL:0009023.name: small intestine Peyer's patch T cell
CL:0009023.def: A T cell which resides in the Peyer's patch of the small intestine.
synonym: T cell of Peyer's patch of small intestine
T cell of small intestine Peyer's patch

CL:0009024.name: mesothelial cell of small intestine
CL:0009024.def: A mesothelial cell that is part of the small intestine.

CL:0009025.name: mesothelial cell of colon
CL:0009025.def: A mesothelial cell that is part of the colon.

CL:0009026.name: enterocyte of appendix
CL:0009026.def: An enterocyte that is a part of a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009027.name: transit amplifying cell of appendix
CL:0009027.def: A transit amplifying cell that is part of a crypt of Lieberkuhn of large intestine.
synonym: transit amplifying cell of appendix vermiformis
transit amplifying cell of vermiform appendix

CL:0009028.name: intestinal crypt stem cell of appendix
CL:0009028.def: An intestinal crypt stem cell that is located in the vermiform appendix. These stem cells reside at the bottom of crypts in the appendix and are highly proliferative. They either differentiate into transit amplifying cells or self-renew to form new stem cells.
synonym: intestinal crypt stem cell of appendix vermiformis
intestinal crypt stem cell of vermiform appendix
stem cell of intestinal crypt of Lieberkuhn of appendix
stem cell of intestinal crypt of Lieberkuhn of appendix vermiformis

CL:0009029.name: mesothelial cell of appendix
CL:0009029.def: A mesothelial cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009030.name: enteroendocrine cell of appendix
CL:0009030.def: An intestinal enteroendocrine cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009031.name: T cell of appendix
CL:0009031.def: A T cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009032.name: B cell of appendix
CL:0009032.def: A B cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009033.name: plasma cell of appendix
CL:0009033.def: A plasma cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009034.name: dendritic cell of appendix
CL:0009034.def: A dendritic cell that is located in a vermiform appendix.

CL:0009035.name: stromal cell of lamina propria of vermiform appendix
CL:0009035.def: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the vermiform appendix.
synonym: stromal cell of appendix lamina propria
stromal cell of lamina propria of appendix vermiformis

CL:0009036.name: appendix macrophage
CL:0009036.def: A macrophage located in the vermiform appendix.

CL:0009037.name: lymph node mantle zone B cell
CL:0009037.def: A B lymphocyte that resides in the mantle zone of the lymph node germinal center. These are generally IgM and IgD positive activated B cells that form a 'corona' around the germinal center and are part of the establishment of a secondary lymphatic follicule.
synonym: mantle zone B cell of lymph node

CL:0009038.name: colon macrophage
CL:0009038.def: A macrophage that is located in the colon.

CL:0009039.name: colon goblet cell
CL:0009039.def: A goblet cell that is located in the colon.

CL:0009040.name: stromal cell of lamina propria of colon
CL:0009040.def: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the colon.
CL:0009040.synonym: stromal cell of colon lamina propria

CL:0009041.name: tuft cell of colon
CL:0009041.def: A tuft cell that is part of the colonic epithelium, primarily adapted for microbial sensing in the dense colonic microbiota. Unlike its small intestinal counterpart, it does not participate in parasite-driven tuft cell–ILC2 circuits. Instead, it detects bacterial metabolites via taste-signaling pathways (Strine and Craig, 2022). The colonic tuft cell plays a key role in epithelial repair, modulates inflammatory responses through IL-25 secretion, and contributes to intestinal homeostasis by balancing microbiome interactions (Sebastian et al., 2021).

CL:0009042.name: enteroendocrine cell of colon
CL:0009042.def: An enteroendocrine cell that is located in the colon.

CL:0009043.name: intestinal crypt stem cell of colon
CL:0009043.def: An intestinal crypt stem cell that is located in the crypt of Lieberkuhn of colon.

CL:0009044.name: lymphocyte of small intestine lamina propria
CL:0009044.def: A lymphocyte that resides in the lamina propria of the small intestine. Lamina propria leukocytes and intraepithelial lymphocytes are the effector compartments of the gut mucosal immune system. Lymphocytes circulate through gut associated lymphoid tissues until recruitment by intestinal antigens. They are involved in the gut immune response.
synonym: gastrointestinal tract (lamina propria) lymphocyte of small intestine
gastrointestinal tract small intestine (lamina propria) leukocyte
lamina propria lymphocyte of small intestine

CL:0009045.name: B cell of medullary sinus of lymph node
CL:0009045.def: A B cell found in the lymph node medullary sinus.

CL:0009046.name: T cell of medullary sinus of lymph node
CL:0009046.def: A T cell found in the lymph node medullary sinus.

CL:0009047.name: macrophage of medullary sinus of lymph node
CL:0009047.def: A macrophage found in the medullary sinus of the lymph node.

CL:0009048.name: anorectum macrophage
CL:0009048.def: A macrophage that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009049.name: smooth muscle cell of high endothelial venule of lymph node
CL:0009049.def: A layer of smooth muscle cells that forms the outer layer of the high endothelial venule of lymph node and pumps to allow flow of lymph fluid carrying lymphocytes.
synonym: high endothelial venule of lymph node smooth muscle cell
high endothelial venule smooth muscle cell

CL:0009050.name: B cell of anorectum
CL:0009050.def: A B cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009051.name: T cell of anorectum
CL:0009051.def: A T cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009052.name: smooth muscle cell of anorectum
CL:0009052.def: A smooth muscle cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009053.name: stromal cell of anorectum lamina propria
CL:0009053.def: A stromal cell found in the lamina propria of the anorectum.

CL:0009054.name: microfold cell of epithelium proper of anorectum
CL:0009054.def: A microfold cell (M cell) that is part of the anorectum.

CL:0009055.name: paneth cell of anorectum
CL:0009055.def: A paneth cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009056.name: transit amplifying cell of anorectum
CL:0009056.def: A transit amplifying cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009057.name: anorectum goblet cell
CL:0009057.def: A goblet cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009058.name: enterocyte of anorectum
CL:0009058.def: An enterocyte that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009059.name: plasma cell of medullary sinus of lymph node
CL:0009059.def: A plasma cell that is located in the medullary sinus of the lymph node.

CL:0009060.name: marginal zone B cell of lymph node
CL:0009060.def: A mature B cell located in the marginal zone of the lymph node.
synonym: lymph node marginal zone B cell

CL:0009061.name: intestinal crypt stem cell of anorectum
CL:0009061.def: An intestinal crypt stem cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009062.name: germinal center T cell
CL:0009062.def: A specialized type of CD4 positive T cell, the follicular helper T cell (TFH cell), that upregulates CXCR5 expression to enable its follicular localization. These specialised T cells reside in the germinal center of the lymph node.
synonym: lymph node germinal center T follicular helper cell
T follicular helper cell of germinal center of lymph node
T follicular helper cell of lymph node germinal center

CL:0009063.name: enteroendocrine cell of anorectum
CL:0009063.def: An enteroendocrine cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009064.name: lymph node paracortex T cell
CL:0009064.def: A T cell located in the lymph node paracortex, where macrophages and dendritic cells present antigenic peptides to these naïve T cells, stimulating them to become activated helper T cells or cytotoxic T lymphocytes.
synonym: T cell of lymph node paracortex

CL:0009065.name: tuft cell of anorectum
CL:0009065.def: An intestinal tuft cell that is located in the anorectum.

CL:0009066.name: stratified squamous epithelial cell of anal canal
CL:0009066.def: A stratified squamous epithelial cell that is part of the anal canal.
CL:0009066.synonym: anal canal stratified squamous epithelial cell

CL:0009067.name: vacuolated fetal-type enterocyte
CL:0009067.def: An enterocyte found in the small intestine of newborn mammals and characterized by the presence of an apical canalicular system (ACS) leading to production of large vacuoles, important for colostral macromolecule uptake. After birth, the vacuolated fetal-type enterocytes are replaced with enterocytes lacking an ACS.

CL:0009068.name: CD8aa(I) thymocyte
CL:0009068.def: An unconventional T lymphocyte population within the thymic medulla that is potentially a thymic resident population.

CL:0009069.name: CD8aa(II) thymocyte
CL:0009069.def: An unconventional T lymphocyte population within the thymic medulla that expresses both alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cell signatures.

CL:0009070.name: corticomedullary thymic epithelial cell
CL:0009070.def: A thymic epithelial cell located at the corticomedullary junction.

CL:0009071.name: medullary thymic epithelial cell type 1
CL:0009071.def: A thymic medullary epithelial cell considered to be a pre-AIRE mTEC population.

CL:0009072.name: medullary thymic epithelial cell type 2
CL:0009072.def: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses AIRE or other canonical markers of mature mTECs like Fezf2.

CL:0009073.name: medullary thymic epithelial cell type 3
CL:0009073.def: A thymic medullary epithelial cell considered to be a post-AIRE cell. This group of AIRE-mTECs is heterogeneous and also includes mTECs within Hassall's Corpuscles.

CL:0009074.name: medullary thymic epithelial cell type 4
CL:0009074.def: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses typical tuft cell markers instead of classical mTEC or cTEC markers. This population has a bulbous-like structure.

CL:0009075.name: myo-medullary thymic epithelial cell
CL:0009075.def: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses muscle-specific biomarkers.

CL:0009076.name: neuro-medullary thymic epithelial cell
CL:0009076.def: A thymic medullary epithelial cell that expresses neuroendocrine biomarkers.

CL:0009077.name: subcapsular thymic epithelial cell
CL:0009077.def: A thymic epithelial cell located within the subcapsular region of the thymus.

CL:0009078.name: thymic fibroblast type 1
CL:0009078.def: A fibroblast located in the thymic capsule.

CL:0009079.name: thymic fibroblast type 2
CL:0009079.def: A fibroblast located between thymic lobules.

CL:0009080.name: tuft cell of small intestine
CL:0009080.def: A tuft cell located in the small intestine.
synonym: brush cell of epithelium of small intestine
brush cell of epithelium proper of small intestine
tuft cell of epithelium of small intestine

CL:0009081.name: specified double negative thymocyte (Homo sapiens)
CL:0009081.def: The human equivalent of a DN2 thymocyte; typically contains two phases, in the latter of which these thymocytes begin the process of beta selection.

CL:0009082.name: committed double negative thymocyte (Homo sapiens)
CL:0009082.def: The human equivalent of a DN3 thymocyte; these thymocytes finish the process of beta selection.

CL:0009083.name: rearranging double negative thymocyte (Homo sapiens)
CL:0009083.def: The human equivalent of a DN4 thymocyte.

CL:0009084.name: glandular epithelial cell of endometrium
CL:0009084.def: An epithelial cell that is part of an endometrium glandular epithelium.

CL:0009085.name: colony forming unit – Hill cell
CL:0009085.def: An adult endothelial progenitor cell characterised in vivo by homing to ischemic sites and paracrine support of angiogenesis. They may form discrete colonies.

CL:0009086.name: endothelial cell of respiratory system lymphatic vessel
CL:0009086.def: An endothelial cell that is part of a respiratory system lymphatic vessel.

CL:0009087.name: fused extravillous trophoblast
CL:0009087.def: An extravillous trophoblast that is polynuclear.

CL:0009088.name: circulating angiogenic cell
CL:0009088.def: An adult endothelial progenitor cell characterised in vivo by homing to ischemic sites and paracrine support of angiogenesis. These cells do not form colonies.

CL:0009089.name: lung pericyte
CL:0009089.def: A pericyte cell that is part of a lung.

CL:0009090.name: endothelial colony forming cell
CL:0009090.def: An adult endothelial progenitor cell that is resident of adult vasculature and capable of differentiating to regenerate endothelial cell populations. Endothelial colony forming cells are characterised in vivo by clonal proliferative status, de novo vessel formation, homing to ischemic sites and paracrine support of angiogenesis. These cells are phenotypically similar to endothelial cells.

CL:0009091.name: Leydig stem cell
CL:0009091.def: A stem cell found in the interstitial compartment of the neonatal testis; it is capable of self-renewal as well as differentiation into steroidogenic cells (adult Leydig cells). Intermediate stages of development include progenitor Leydig cells and immature Leydig cells.

CL:0009092.name: endothelial cell of placenta
CL:0009092.def: An endothelial cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:0009093.name: smooth muscle cell of placenta
CL:0009093.def: A smooth muscle cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:0009094.name: endothelial cell of hepatic portal vein
CL:0009094.def: An endothelial cell that is part of a hepatic portal vein.

CL:0009095.name: endothelial cell of uterus
CL:0009095.def: An endothelial cell that is part of a uterus.

CL:0009096.name: esophagus non-keratinized squamous epithelial cell
CL:0009096.def: Any cell that is part of the esophageal non-keratinized stratified squamous epithelium. In humans, the esophagus, which requires flexibility to accommodate swallowing of a bolus, is covered with a non-keratinized epithelium.
synonym: non-keratinized squamous epithelial cell of esophagus
non-keratinizing squamous epithelial cell of esophagus
nonkeratinized squamous epithelial cell of esophagus
nonkeratinizing squamous epithelial cell of esophagus

CL:0009097.name: embryonic skeletal muscle fiber
CL:0009097.def: A skeletal muscle fiber found in an embryo. In mammalian embryos, skeletal muscle expresses myosin heavy chain-embryonic (MyHC-emb, encoded by the MYH3 gene), which regulates skeletal muscle development.

CL:0009098.name: fetal and neonatal skeletal muscle fiber
CL:0009098.def: A skeletal muscle fiber found at the fetal and neonatal stages. In mammalian fetuses and neonates, skeletal muscle expresses myosin heavy chain-neonatal (MyHC-neo, encoded by the MYH8 gene). This expression disappears shortly after birth and is replaced by expression of adult heavy chain myosins.

CL:0009099.name: fibro/adipogenic progenitor cell
CL:0009099.def: A progenitor cell that is a tissue-resident mesenchymal cell, important for skeletal muscle regeneration, and able to differentiate into both adipocytes or fibroblasts.

CL:0009100.name: hepatic portal fibroblast
CL:0009100.def: A fibroblast located in the portal triad. Hepatic portal fibroblast are a non-parenchymal cell population located adjacent to bile duct epithelia in liver and are distinct from stellate cells. They differentiate into fibrogenic myofibroblasts during chronic injury states producing high levels of collagen.

CL:0009101.name: fibroblastic reticular cell
CL:0009101.def: A reticular cell involved in directing B cells and T cells to specific regions within a tissue.

CL:0009102.name: lymph node fibroblastic reticular cell
CL:0009102.def: A specialized, fibroblastic reticular cell of mesenchymal origin found in lymph nodes. In human, it expresses several markers common to myofibroblasts (desmin, vimentin, CD73, CD90, α-smooth muscle actin (αSMA)), and can be differentiated from endothelial cells by its lack of CD31 expression. These cells are critical for the overall organization and function of the lymph node. Lymph node fibroblastic reticular cells (FRCs) can be further classified based on their location, function, and unique marker expression.

CL:0009103.name: lymph node marginal reticular cell
CL:0009103.def: A fibroblastic reticular cell found in the lymph node subcapsular sinus.

CL:0009104.name: B cell zone reticular cell
CL:0009104.def: A fibroblastic reticular cell found in the lymph node germinal center dark zone (B cell zone).
synonym: lymph node germinal center dark zone fibroblastic reticular cell

CL:0009105.name: T cell zone reticular cell
CL:0009105.def: A fibroblastic reticular cell found in the lymph node T cell domain.
synonym: lymph node T cell domain fibroblastic reticular cell

CL:0009106.name: medullary reticular cell
CL:0009106.def: A specialized fibroblast found in the medulla of lymph node.
synonym: medullary reticular cell of lymph node

CL:0009107.name: lymphatic endothelial cell of subcapsular sinus ceiling
CL:0009107.def: A lymphatic endothelial cell located in the subcapsular sinus ceiling of a lymph node. In human, it's characterized by a unique marker expression (NT5e+ and Caveolin-1+).
CL:0009107.synonym: lymphatic endothelial cell of subcapsular sinus ceiling of lymph node

CL:0009108.name: lymphatic endothelial cell of subcapsular sinus floor
CL:0009108.def: A lymphatic endothelial cell located in the subcapsular sinus floor of a lymph node. In human, it's characterized by a unique marker expression (TNFRSF9+).
CL:0009108.synonym: lymphatic endothelial cell of subcapsular sinus floor of lymph node

CL:0009109.name: lymphatic endothelial cell of trabecula
CL:0009109.def: A lymphatic endothelial cell located in a lymph node trabecula.
synonym: lymphatic endothelial cell of lymph node trabecula

CL:0009110.name: lymphatic endothelial cell of medulla ceiling
CL:0009110.def: A lymphatic endothelial cell located in the ceiling part of a lymph node medulla.
CL:0009110.synonym: lymphatic endothelial cell of lymph node medulla ceiling

CL:0009111.name: centrocyte
CL:0009111.def: A germinal center B cell found in a lymph node germinal center light zone.

CL:0009112.name: centroblast
CL:0009112.def: A germinal center B cell found in a lymph node germinal center dark zone.

CL:0009113.name: T follicular regulatory cell
CL:0009113.def: A regulatory T cell present in the B cell follicles and germinal centers of lymphoid tissues. In humans, it is CXCR5+.

CL:0009114.name: monocytoid B cell
CL:0009114.def: A B cell found in the perisinusoidal area of a lymph node. In humans, monocytoid B cells are a morphologically distinct B cell population (oval nuclei, abundant cytoplasm, monocyte-like appearance), share many similarities with marginal zone B cells including marker expression, and are increased in disease settings.

CL:0009115.name: lymph node lymphatic vessel endothelial cell
CL:0009115.def: An endothelial cell located in a lymph node lymphatic vessel.

CL:0009116.name: progenitor cell of mammary luminal epithelium
CL:0009116.def: A progenitor cell with the potential to differentiate into luminal epithelial cells of mammary glands. In mouse, CD61 and c-kit were found to be coexpressed by the majority of, but not all, committed luminal progenitor cells.
synonym: progenitor cell of luminal mammary epithelium

CL:0010000.name: keratinized cell of hair follicle
CL:0010000.def: A hair follicle matrix region cell which synthesizes keratin and undergoes a characteristic change as it moves upward from the hair bulb to become the hair medulla cortex and hair root sheath.

CL:0010001.name: stromal cell of bone marrow
CL:0010001.def: A stromal cell that is part_of a bone marrow.

CL:0010002.name: epithelial cell of umbilical artery
CL:0010002.def: An epithelial cell that is part_of a umbilical artery.

CL:0010003.name: obsolete epithelial cell of alveolus of lung
CL:0010003.def: OBSOLETE. An epithelial cell that is part_of a alveolus of lung.

CL:0010004.name: mononuclear cell of bone marrow
CL:0010004.def: A mononuclear cell that is part_of a bone marrow.

CL:0010005.name: atrioventricular bundle cell
CL:0010005.def: A specialized cardiomyocyte that transmit signals from the AV node to the cardiac Purkinje fibers.

CL:0010006.name: cardiac blood vessel endothelial cell
CL:0010006.def: Any blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of some heart.

CL:0010007.name: His-Purkinje system cell
CL:0010007.def: Any cell that is part of some His-Purkinje system.

CL:0010008.name: cardiac endothelial cell
CL:0010008.def: Any endothelial cell that is part of some heart.

CL:0010009.name: camera-type eye photoreceptor cell
CL:0010009.def: Any photoreceptor cell that is part of some camera-type eye.

CL:0010010.name: cerebellar stellate cell
CL:0010010.def: A GABAergic interneuron that is located in the molecular layer of the cerebellum. This cell receives excitatory inputs primarily from parallel fibers and plays a crucial role in feed-forward inhibition by suppressing the activity of Purkinje cells and modulating the output of the cerebellar cortex. The stellate cell is part of the local circuitry that contributes to the fine-tuning of motor coordination and a regulator of cerebellar blood flow via neurovascular coupling.

CL:0010011.name: cerebral cortex GABAergic interneuron
CL:0010011.def: A GABAergic interneuron whose soma is located in the cerebral cortex.

CL:0010012.name: cerebral cortex neuron
CL:0010012.def: A CNS neuron of the cerebral cortex.

CL:0010015.name: coronet cell
CL:0010015.def: A highly specialized cell type exclusive to and forming neuroepithelium of the Saccus vasculosus, covering the caudal diverticulum of the infundibular recess.

CL:0010016.name: collar cell
CL:0010016.def: A cell with a flagellum surrounded by a collar of microvilli. The motion of the flagellum draws water past the microvilli, serving either a feeding or sensory function. Collar cells are found in multiple animals, including sponges, echinoderms, and cnidarians. They are also found outside animals in the choanoflagellates. Although collar cells are superficially similar, their cytoskeletal structure and functional biology are different in different groups of organisms.

CL:0010017.name: zygote
CL:0010017.def: A zygote in a plant or an animal.

CL:0010020.name: cardiac glial cell
CL:0010020.def: Any glial cell that is part of some heart.

CL:0010021.name: cardiac myoblast
CL:0010021.def: Any myoblast that develops into some cardiac muscle cell.

CL:0010022.name: cardiac neuron
CL:0010022.def: A neuron that has its soma in the heart.

CL:0011000.name: dorsal horn interneuron
CL:0011000.def: A CNS interneuron located in the dorsal horn of the spinal cord.

CL:0011001.name: spinal cord motor neuron
CL:0011001.def: A motor neuron that passes from the spinal cord toward or to a muscle and conducts an impulse that causes movement.

CL:0011002.name: lateral motor column neuron
CL:0011002.def: A motor neuron that is generated only on limb levels and send axons into the limb mesenchyme.

CL:0011003.name: magnocellular neurosecretory cell
CL:0011003.def: A neurosecretory neuron residing mainly in the hypothalamic supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei and in a number of smaller accessory cell groups between these two nuclei, that is capable of secreting the hormones oxytocin or vasopressin, and sometimes both, into the systemic circulation.

CL:0011004.name: lens fiber cell
CL:0011004.def: A vetebrate lens cell that is any of the elongated, tightly packed cells that make up the bulk of the mature lens in a camera-type eye.

CL:0011005.name: GABAergic interneuron
CL:0011005.def: An interneuron that uses GABA as a vesicular neurotransmitter.  These interneurons are inhibitory

CL:0011006.name: Lugaro cell
CL:0011006.def: A cerebellar interneuron characterized by a spindle-shaped or triangular soma, parasagittally oriented and located at the border between the granular layer and the Purkinje cell layer. The Lugaro cell extends dendrites predominantly in the parasagittal plane, forming synaptic interactions with basket, stellate, and Golgi cells. Its axonal projections extend upward into the molecular layer, where they form a parasagittal plexus and emit long transverse collaterals that run parallel to the long axis of the cerebellar folia. The Lugaro cell is capable of co-releasing GABA and glycine, as evidenced by the expression of glutamate decarboxylase (GAD65/67) and the glycine transporter GlyT2.

CL:0011007.name: paraxial cell
CL:0011007.def: A cell in the area of mesoderm in the neurulating embryo that flanks and forms simultaneously with the neural tube. The cells of this region give rise to somites.

CL:0011008.name: embryonic hemocyte
CL:0011008.def: A hemocyte derived from the embryonic head mesoderm, which enters the hemolymph as a circulating cell.

CL:0011009.name: embryonic plasmatocyte
CL:0011009.def: A plasmatocyte derived from the embryonic head mesoderm.

CL:0011010.name: lateral mesodermal cell
CL:0011010.def: A cell derived from the mesoderm that is found at the periphery of the embryo.

CL:0011011.name: intermediate mesodermal cell
CL:0011011.def: A cell derived from the mesoderm that is located between the paraxial mesoderm and the lateral plate.

CL:0011012.name: neural crest cell
CL:0011012.def: A cell of the neural crest. Neural crest cells are multipotent. Premigratory neural crest cells are found at the neural plate boarder, some of which will undergo ectomesynchymal transition and delamination to form migratory neural crest cells.

CL:0011013.name: motile sperm cell
CL:0011013.def: A sperm cell that is cabaple of motion (motility).

CL:0011014.name: non-motile sperm cell
CL:0011014.def: A sperm cell that is not cabaple of motion (motility).

CL:0011015.name: amoeboid sperm cell
CL:0011015.def: A motile sperm cell that contain no F-actin, and their motility is powered by a dynamic filament system.

CL:0011016.name: flagellated sperm cell
CL:0011016.def: A motile sperm cell that contains a slender threadlike microscopic appendage that enables motion.

CL:0011017.name: vagal neural crest cell
CL:0011017.def: Cell that is part of the vagal neural crest population. The vagal neural crest arises from the axial level of somites 1-7 and has been described as a hybrid between the head and the trunk populations.

CL:0011018.name: lymphoid tissue–inducer cell
CL:0011018.def: A group 3 innate lymphoid cell that express ROR gamma t and IL-7R alpha in the absence of lineage markers (e.g. CD3, CD19, B220, CD11c, Gr-1), with the functional ability to interact with mesenchymal cells through lymphotoxin and tumor necrosis factor. Lymphoid tissue-inducer cells are key to the development of lymph nodes and Peyer’s patches.

CL:0011019.name: mesothelial cell of epicardium
CL:0011019.def: A mesothelial cell that is part of the epicardium.

CL:0011020.name: neural progenitor cell
CL:0011020.def: An undifferentiated cell derived from a neural stem cell, with a limited capacity to self-renew (Dibajnia and Morshead, 2013) and the ability to generate multiple types of lineage-restricted progenitors, contributing to the formation of neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes.

CL:0011021.name: fibroblast of upper back skin
CL:0011021.def: A fibroblast that is part of upper back skin.

CL:0011022.name: fibroblast of skin of back
CL:0011022.def: A fibroblast that is part of skin of back.

CL:0011023.name: CD25+ mast cell
CL:0011023.def: A mast cell that is CD25+.

CL:0011024.name: double negative T regulatory cell
CL:0011024.def: A double negative thymocyte that is CD3-positive, CD4-negative, CD8-negative, that that are present in the periphery in very low numbers and predominantly produce INF-gamma, TNF-alpha, and a low amount of TGF-beta, but not IL-2, IL-4, IL-10 or IL-13 upon activation.
synonym: CD4-negative, CD8-negative, alpha-beta regulatory T cells

CL:0011025.name: exhausted T cell
CL:0011025.def: An effector T cell that displays impaired effector functions (e.g., rapid production of effector cytokines, cytotoxicity) and has limited proliferative potential.

CL:0011026.name: progenitor cell
CL:0011026.def: A precursor cell that has a tendency to differentiate into a specific type of cell. They are descendants of stem cells, only they are more constrained in their differentiation potential or capacity for self-renewal, and are often more limited in both senses.

CL:0011027.name: skeletal muscle fibroblast
CL:0011027.def: Any fibroblast that is part of skeletal muscle tissue.

CL:0011028.name: olfactory ensheathing cell
CL:0011028.def: A neural-crest derived glial cell that supports the growth and survival of primary olfactory neuroons from the neuroepithelium in the nasal cavity to the brain by encasing large bundles of numerous unmyelinated axons.

CL:0011029.name: cnidocyte
CL:0011029.def: An explosive cell containing one giant secretory organelle called a cnidocyst (also known as a cnida (plural cnidae) or nematocyst) that contains a toxin responsible for the stings delivered by a cnidarian to other organisms. Cnidae are used to capture prey and as a defense against predators. The presence of cnidocytes defines the phylum Cnidaria (corals, sea anemones, hydrae, jellyfish, etc.).

CL:0011030.name: dermal microvascular endothelial cell
CL:0011030.def: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of the dermis.

CL:0011031.name: monocyte-derived dendritic cell
CL:0011031.def: A dendritic cell that develops from a monocyte.

CL:0011032.name: lysosome-rich enterocyte
CL:0011032.def: An enterocyte that possesses a large supranuclear vacuolar system that preferentially internalizes dietary protein via receptor-mediated and fluid-phase endocytosis for intracellular digestion and trans-cellular transport. In zebrafish these cells are located in the posterior region of the mid intestine throughout life. In mammals they are found in the ileum pre-weaning and later are replaced by mature enterocytes.

CL:0011100.name: galanergic neuron
CL:0011100.def: Neuron that secretes the neurotransmitter galanin.

CL:0011101.name: chorionic trophoblast cell
CL:0011101.def: Cells of the uterine chorion that acquire specialized structural and/or functional features that characterize chorionic trophoblasts. These cells will migrate towards the spongiotrophoblast layer and give rise to syncytiotrophoblasts of the labyrinthine layer.

CL:0011102.name: parasympathetic neuron
CL:0011102.def: Parasympathetic neurons are part of the parasympathetic nervous sysem and the cell bodies lie in the brain and sacral region of the spinal cord. The neurons are mainly cholinergic.

CL:0011103.name: sympathetic neuron
CL:0011103.def: Sympathetic neurons are part of the sympathetic nervous system and are primarily adrenergic producing the neurotransmitter noradrenalin along with other neuropeptides.

CL:0011104.name: interplexiform cell
CL:0011104.def: A type of interneuron in the retinal inner nuclear layer which carries information from the inner plexiform layer and the outer plexiform layer.

CL:0011105.name: dopamanergic interplexiform cell
CL:0011105.def: A type of interneuron in the retinal inner nuclear layer which carries information from the inner plexiform layer and the outer plexiform layer, using dopamine.

CL:0011106.name: GABAnergic interplexiform cell
CL:0011106.def: A type of interneuron in the retinal inner nuclear layer which carries information from the inner plexiform layer and the outer plexiform layer using GABA.

CL:0011107.name: obsolete Muller cell
CL:0011107.def: OBSOLETE: Astrocyte-like radial glial cell that extends vertically throughout the retina, with the nucleus are usually in the middle of the inner nuclear layer.

CL:0011108.name: colon epithelial cell
CL:0011108.def: Epithelial cell that is part of the colon epithelium.

CL:0011109.name: hypocretin-secreting neuron
CL:0011109.def: A neuron that releases hypocretin as a neurotransmitter.

CL:0011111.name: gonadotropin-releasing hormone neuron
CL:0011111.def: A neuroendocrine cell that secretes gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH). A GnRH neuron is born in the nasal placode during embryonic development and migrates through the nose and forebrain to the hypothalamus. This cell regulates reproduction by secreting GnRH into the pituitary portal vessels to induce the release of gonadotropins into the general circulation.

CL:0011112.name: obsolete magnocellular neurosecretory cell
CL:0011112.def: OBSOLETE: Neurons part of the hypothalamic supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei that secrete the hormones, oxytocin and vasopressin into the systemic circulation from the posterior pituitary gland.

CL:0011113.name: spiral ganglion neuron
CL:0011113.def: Neuron found in the spiral ganglion.

CL:0011114.name: segmented neutrophil of bone marrow
CL:0011114.def: A segmented neutrophilic cell of the bone marrow reserve pool that expresses CD11b (integrin alpha-M) and high levels of CD16 (low affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc region receptor III) on its cell surface.

CL:0011115.name: precursor cell
CL:0011115.def: A cell that, by division or terminal differentiation, can give rise to other cell types.

CL:0012001.name: neuron of the forebrain
CL:0012001.def: A CNS neuron of the forebrain.

CL:0013000.name: forebrain radial glial cell
CL:0013000.def: Any radial glial cell that is part of some forebrain.

CL:0015000.name: cranial motor neuron
CL:0015000.def: Motor neuron that innervate muscles that control eye, jaw, and facial movements of the vertebrate head and parasympathetic neurons that innervate certain glands and organs.

CL:0017000.name: pulmonary ionocyte
CL:0017000.def: An ionocyte that is part of the lung epithelium. The cells from this type are major sources of the CFTR protein in human and mice.

CL:0017001.name: splanchnic mesodermal cell
CL:0017001.def: A mesodermal cell that is part of the splanchnic layer of lateral plate mesoderm.

CL:0017002.name: prostate neuroendocrine cell
CL:0017002.def: A neuroendocrine cell that is part of the prostate epithelium.

CL:0017003.name: epithelial cell of prostatic urethra
CL:0017003.def: An epithelial cell that is part of the prostatic urethra.

CL:0017004.name: telocyte
CL:0017004.def: A supportive cell with a small, oval-shaped body and one to five telopodes. Telopodes are cytoplasmic protrusions from tens to hundreds of micrometers long and mostly below 0.2 microns of caliber.

CL:0017005.name: lymphoblast
CL:0017005.def: A lymphocyte that has gotten larger after being stimulated by an antigen.

CL:0017006.name: B-lymphoblast
CL:0017006.def: A lymphocyte of B lineage that has gotten larger after being stimulated by an antigen.

CL:0017009.name: Axl+ dendritic cell, human
CL:0017009.def: A human dendritic cell that expresses the AXL and SIGLEC6 genes.

CL:0017010.name: hillock cell of urethral epithelium
CL:0017010.def: A hillock cell that is part of the urethra.

CL:0017011.name: hillock cell of prostatic urethral epithelium
CL:0017011.def: A hillock cell that is part of the prostatic urethra.

CL:0017500.name: neutrophillic cytoplasm
CL:0017500.def: Cytoplasm that exhibits a characteristic staining and color, pale-pink, with Wright-Giemsa stain.

CL:0017501.name: obsolete lobed nucleus
CL:0017501.def: Nucleus with two or more lobes connected by a thin filament that contains no internal chromatin.

CL:0017502.name: acidophilic cytoplasm
CL:0017502.def: Cytoplasm that exhibits a characteristic staining and color, red or pink, with Eosin stain.

CL:0017503.name: basophilic cytoplasm
CL:0017503.def: Cytoplasm that exhibits molecular interaction for basic dyes under specific pH conditions.

CL:0017504.name: polychromatophilic cytoplasm
CL:0017504.def: Cytoplasm that exhibits affinity for both basic and acid stains under specific pH conditions.

CL:0017505.name: obsolete increased nucleus size
CL:0017505.def: OBSOLETE. A nucleus size quality which is relatively high compared to the amount of cytoplasm present in the same cell.

CL:0017506.name: banded nucleus
CL:0017506.def: A concave nuclear shape where the nucleus is indented to more than half the distance to the farthest nuclear margin, but in no area is the chromatin condensed to a single filament.

CL:0017507.name: reniform nucleus
CL:0017507.def: A concave nucleus shape where the indentation is smaller than half of the distance to the farthest nuclear margin.

CL:0017508.name: cartwheel heterochromatin
CL:0017508.def: Heterochromatin that is arranged in a carthwheel pattern.

CL:0017509.name: alobate nucleus
CL:0017509.def: Any nucleus that has characteristic some alobate.

CL:0019001.name: tracheobronchial serous cell
CL:0019001.def: Any serous secreting cell that is part of the tracheobronchial epithelium.

CL:0019002.name: tracheobronchial chondrocyte
CL:0019002.def: Any chondrocyte that is part of the tracheobronchial tree.

CL:0019003.name: tracheobronchial goblet cell
CL:0019003.def: Any goblet cell that is part of the tracheobronchial epithelium.

CL:0019015.name: lung parenchyma resident eosinophil
CL:0019015.def: An eosinophil with a ring-shaped nucleus that is resident in the lung parenchyma. In mouse, lung parenchyma resident eosinophils are IL-5-independent Siglec-F(intermediate) CD62L+ CD101(low). In human, they are Siglec-8+ CD62L+ IL-3R(low).

CL:0019017.name: lymphatic vessel smooth muscle cell
CL:0019017.def: A smooth muscle cell that is part of any lymphatic vessel.
CL:0019017.synonym: smooth muscle cell of lymphatic vessel

CL:0019018.name: blood vessel smooth muscle cell
CL:0019018.def: A smooth muscle cell that is part of any blood vessel.
CL:0019018.synonym: smooth muscle cell of blood vessel

CL:0019019.name: tracheobronchial smooth muscle cell
CL:0019019.def: A smooth muscle cell that is part of the tracheobronchial tree.
CL:0019019.synonym: smooth muscle cell of tracheobronchial tree

CL:0019020.name: extrahepatic cholangiocyte
CL:0019020.def: An epithelial cell of the extrahepatic bile ducts, including the left and right hepatic duct, common hepatic duct, and common bile duct. They are columnar in shape, and have a large nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio relative to small/intrahepatic cholangiocytes.

CL:0019021.name: endothelial cell of periportal hepatic sinusoid
CL:0019021.def: An endothelial cell found in the periportal region hepatic sinusoid, near the portal triad. The fenestrae of these cells are larger but fewer in number compared with those of endothelial cells near the centrilobular region of the hepatic sinusoid.

CL:0019022.name: endothelial cell of pericentral hepatic sinusoid
CL:0019022.def: An endothelial cell found in the centrilobular region hepatic sinusoid, near the central vein. The fenestrae of these cells are smaller but more numerous compared with those of endothelial cells near the periportal region of the hepatic sinusoid.
synonym: central venous hepatic sinusoidal endothelial cell

CL:0019026.name: periportal region hepatocyte
CL:0019026.def: Any hepatocyte that is part of the liver lobule periportal region. These cells are primarily involved in oxidative energy metabolism.

CL:0019028.name: midzonal region hepatocyte
CL:0019028.def: Any hepatocyte that is part of the liver lobule midzonal region. These cells have mixed functionality in comparison with those in the other two regions of the liver lobule.

CL:0019029.name: centrilobular region hepatocyte
CL:0019029.def: Any hepatocyte that is part of the liver lobule centrilobular region. These cells are the primary location for the biotransformation of drugs.

CL:0019031.name: intestine goblet cell
CL:0019031.def: Goblet cells reside throughout the length of the small and large intestine and are responsible for the production and maintenance of the protective mucus blanket by synthesizing and secreting high-molecular-weight glycoproteins known as mucins. Human intestinal goblet cells secrete the MUC2 mucin, as well as a number of typical mucus components: CLCA1, FCGBP, AGR2, ZG16, and TFF3.

CL:0019032.name: intestinal tuft cell
CL:0019032.def: A tuft cell that is part of the intestinal epithelium, characterized by a distinctive apical tuft and lateral cytospinules connecting to neighbouring cells. This cell senses luminal stimuli via taste receptors and succinate signalling, initiating type 2 immune responses through the secretion of interleukin-25 while modulating epithelial regeneration through prostaglandin synthesis. It expresses key molecular markers such as doublecortin-like kinase 1 (DCLK1) in mice (Hendel et al., 2022), and KIT proto-oncogene in humans (Huang et al., 2024). Developed from intestinal crypt stem cells, this cell requires transcription factor POU2F3 for its development.

CL:0700009.name: obsolete kidney collecting duct beta-intercalated cell
CL:0700009.def: OBSOLETE. A renal beta-intercalated cell that is part of the cortical collecting duct. The medullary collecting duct does not contain the renal beta-intercalated cell type.
synonym: kidney collecting duct intercalated cell type B

CL:1000001.name: retrotrapezoid nucleus neuron
CL:1000001.def: Any neuron that has its soma located in some retrotrapezoid nucleus.

CL:1000022.name: mesonephric nephron tubule epithelial cell
CL:1000022.def: Any epithelial cell that is part of some mesonephric nephron tubule.

CL:1000042.name: forebrain neuroblast
CL:1000042.def: Any neuroblast (sensu Vertebrata) that is part of some forebrain.

CL:1000050.name: lateral line nerve glial cell
CL:1000050.def: Any glial cell that is part of some lateral line nerve.

CL:1000073.name: spinal cord radial glial cell
CL:1000073.def: Any radial glial cell that is part of some spinal cord.

CL:1000085.name: stratified non keratinized epithelial stem cell

CL:1000090.name: pronephric nephron tubule epithelial cell
CL:1000090.def: Any epithelial cell that is part of some pronephric nephron tubule.

CL:1000123.name: metanephric nephron tubule epithelial cell
CL:1000123.def: Any epithelial cell that is part of some metanephric nephron tubule.

CL:1000143.name: lung goblet cell
CL:1000143.def: Any goblet cell that is part of some lung epithelium.

CL:1000147.name: cardiac valve cell
CL:1000147.def: A cell that is part of a cardiac valve.

CL:1000155.name: Malpighian tubule stellate cell
CL:1000155.def: A specialized epithelial secretory cell that moves chloride ions and water across the tubule epithelium.

CL:1000182.name: malpighian tubule tip cell
CL:1000182.def: Any tip cell that is part of some Malpighian tubule.

CL:1000191.name: pillar cell
CL:1000191.def: A rod-like cell in the inner ear, having their heads joined and their bases on the basilar membrane widely separated so as to form a spiral tunnel known as the tunnel of Corti.

CL:1000217.name: growth plate cartilage chondrocyte
CL:1000217.def: Any chondrocyte that is part of some growth plate cartilage.

CL:1000222.name: stomach neuroendocrine cell
CL:1000222.def: A specialised neuroendocrine cell located in the gastric mucosa that regulates digestive processes including acid secretion and gut motility. This cell stores hormones in large dense core vesicles and synaptic-like microvesicles.

CL:1000223.name: pulmonary neuroendocrine cell
CL:1000223.def: A neuroendocrine cell that is part of respiratory epithelium of the lung and is involved in the sensory detection of environmental stimuli, including hypoxia, nicotine and air pressure. Ultrastructurally, this cell type is characterized by the presence of cytoplasmic dense core granules, which are considered the storage sites of amine and peptide hormones. Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells are innervated and appear as solitary cells or as clustered masses, localized at airway bifurcation sites, called neuroepithelial bodies that can release serotonin in response to hypoxia and interact with sensory nerve terminals. Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells also function as reserve stem cells that repair the surrounding epithelium after injury.

CL:1000236.name: posterior lateral line nerve glial cell
CL:1000236.def: Any glial cell that is part of some posterior lateral line nerve.

CL:1000239.name: anterior lateral line nerve glial cell
CL:1000239.def: Any glial cell that is part of some anterior lateral line nerve.

CL:1000245.name: posterior lateral line ganglion neuron

CL:1000596.def: Any kidney cell that is part of some juxtamedullary cortex.

CL:1000597.def: A cell that is part of a tip of a renal papilla.

CL:1000600.name: lower urinary tract cell

CL:1000601.name: ureteral cell
CL:1000601.def: Any cell that is part of some ureter.

CL:1000606.def: Any neuron that has its soma located in some kidney.

CL:1000612.def: Any renal cortical epithelial cell that is part of some renal corpuscle.

CL:1000615.name: kidney cortex tubule cell
CL:1000615.def: Any kidney tubule cell that is part of some renal cortex tubule.

CL:1000616.name: kidney outer medulla cell
CL:1000616.def: Any kidney medulla cell that is part of some outer medulla of kidney.

CL:1000617.name: kidney inner medulla cell
CL:1000617.def: Any kidney medulla cell that is part of some inner medulla of kidney.

CL:1000618.name: juxtaglomerular complex cell
CL:1000618.def: Any kidney cortical cell that is part of some juxtaglomerular apparatus.

CL:1000681.name: kidney cortex interstitial cell
CL:1000681.def: A cell that is part of an interstitial compartment of a renal cortex.

CL:1000682.name: kidney medulla interstitial cell
CL:1000682.def: A cell that is part of an interstitum of a renal medulla.

CL:1000692.name: kidney interstitial fibroblast
CL:1000692.def: A fibroblast that is part of an interstitial compartment of a kidney.

CL:1000698.name: kidney resident macrophage
CL:1000698.def: A tissue-resident macrophage that is part of some kidney.

CL:1000699.name: kidney resident dendritic cell
CL:1000699.def: A resident-dendritic cell that is part of a kidney.

CL:1000702.name: kidney pelvis smooth muscle cell
CL:1000702.def: Any smooth muscle cell that is part of some kidney pelvis smooth muscle.

CL:1000703.name: kidney pelvis urothelial cell
CL:1000703.def: Any kidney epithelial cell that is part of some kidney pelvis urothelium.

CL:1000706.name: ureter urothelial cell
CL:1000706.def: A urothelial cell that is part of the urothelium of ureter.

CL:1000708.name: ureter adventitial cell
CL:1000708.def: Any ureteral cell that is part of some adventitia of ureter.

CL:1000714.name: kidney cortex collecting duct principal cell
CL:1000714.def: Any renal principal cell that is part of some cortical collecting duct.

CL:1000715.name: kidney cortex collecting duct intercalated cell
CL:1000715.def: Any renal intercalated cell that is part of some cortical collecting duct.

CL:1000716.name: kidney outer medulla collecting duct principal cell
CL:1000716.def: Principal cell that is part of some outer medullary collecting duct. It is known in some mammalian species that this cell may express the epithelial sodium channel (ENaC).

CL:1000717.name: kidney outer medulla collecting duct intercalated cell
CL:1000717.def: Intercalated cell that is part of some outer medullary collecting duct. It is known in some mammalian species that this cell may contribute in the maintenance of acid/base homeostasis.

CL:1000718.name: kidney inner medulla collecting duct principal cell
CL:1000718.def: Any renal principal cell that is part of some inner medullary collecting duct.

CL:1000719.name: kidney inner medulla collecting duct intercalated cell
CL:1000719.def: Any renal intercalated cell that is part of some inner medullary collecting duct.

CL:1000720.name: kidney papillary duct intercalated cell
CL:1000720.def: Any renal intercalated cell that is part of some papillary duct.

CL:1000721.name: kidney papillary duct principal cell
CL:1000721.def: Any renal principal cell that is part of some papillary duct.

CL:1000742.name: glomerular mesangial cell
CL:1000742.def: A mesangial cell located among the glomerular capillaries in a renal corpuscle.

CL:1000746.name: glomerular cell
CL:1000746.def: Any kidney corpuscule cell that is part of some renal glomerulus.

CL:1000768.name: kidney connecting tubule epithelial cell
CL:1000768.def: Any nephron tubule epithelial cell that is part of some renal connecting tubule.

CL:1000803.name: kidney inner medulla interstitial cell
CL:1000803.def: A cell that is part of an interstitial compartment of an inner renal medulla.

CL:1000804.name: kidney outer medulla interstitial cell
CL:1000804.def: A kidney cell that is part of an interstitial compartment of an outer renal medulla.

CL:1000838.name: kidney proximal convoluted tubule epithelial cell
CL:1000838.def: Any epithelial cell of proximal tubule that is part of some proximal convoluted tubule and has part some brush border.

CL:1000839.name: kidney proximal straight tubule epithelial cell
CL:1000839.def: Any epithelial cell of proximal tubule that is part of some proximal straight tubule.

CL:1000849.name: kidney distal convoluted tubule epithelial cell
CL:1000849.def: Any epithelial cell of distal tubule that is part of some distal convoluted tubule.

CL:1000850.name: macula densa epithelial cell
CL:1000850.def: An epithelial cell that is part of the macula densa, characterized by a tightly packed arrangement, apically positioned nuclei, and prominent primary cilia, creating a distinctive 'dense spot' appearance under microscopy. It is involved in regulating renal blood flow, glomerular filtration rate, and renin release.

CL:1000854.name: kidney blood vessel cell
CL:1000854.def: A blood vessel cell that is part of a kidney.

CL:1000891.name: kidney arterial blood vessel cell
CL:1000891.def: Any kidney blood vessel cell that is part of some kidney arterial blood vessel.

CL:1000892.name: kidney capillary endothelial cell
CL:1000892.def: An endothelial cell that is part of the capillary of the kidney.

CL:1000893.name: kidney venous blood vessel cell
CL:1000893.def: Any kidney blood vessel cell that is part of some renal vein.

CL:1000909.name: kidney loop of Henle epithelial cell
CL:1000909.def: Any nephron tubule epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle.

CL:1000979.name: ureter smooth muscle cell
CL:1000979.def: Any smooth muscle cell that is part of some muscular coat of ureter.

CL:1001005.name: glomerular capillary endothelial cell
CL:1001005.def: An endothelial cell that is part of the glomerular capillary of the kidney.

CL:1001006.name: kidney afferent arteriole cell
CL:1001006.def: An endothelial cell which is part of the afferent arteriole in the kidney. This cell is  responsible for maintaining renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate.

CL:1001009.name: kidney efferent arteriole cell
CL:1001009.def: Any kidney arterial blood vessel cell that is part of some renal efferent arteriole.

CL:1001016.name: kidney loop of Henle ascending limb epithelial cell
CL:1001016.def: Any kidney loop of Henle epithelial cell that is part of some ascending limb of loop of Henle.

CL:1001021.name: kidney loop of Henle descending limb epithelial cell
CL:1001021.def: Any kidney loop of Henle epithelial cell that is part of some descending limb of loop of Henle.

CL:1001033.name: peritubular capillary endothelial cell
CL:1001033.def: An endothelial cell that is part of the peritubular capillary of the kidney. This cell is highly fenestrated and plays a vital role in the kidney's filtration process, enabling the exchange of materials between the blood and the renal tubules.

CL:1001036.name: vasa recta cell
CL:1001036.def: A cell that is part of a vasa recta.

CL:1001045.name: kidney cortex artery cell
CL:1001045.def: Any kidney arterial blood vessel cell that is part of some renal cortex artery.

CL:1001052.name: kidney cortex vein cell
CL:1001052.def: Any kidney venous blood vessel cell that is part of some renal cortex vein.

CL:1001068.name: kidney venous system smooth muscle cell

CL:1001096.name: kidney afferent arteriole endothelial cell
CL:1001096.def: An endothelial cell that lines the interior surface of the afferent arteriole and maintains vascular tone. This cell responds to changing ion concentrations and blood pressure by releasing vasoactive substances, in order to regulate blood flow into the glomeruli, which is essential for glomerular filtration.

CL:1001097.name: kidney afferent arteriole smooth muscle cell
CL:1001097.def: A smooth muscle cell found in the wall of the afferent arteriole. This cell contracts and relaxes in response to changes in blood pressure, a process known as a myogenic response, to alter artery diameter and regulate blood flow into the glomeruli.

CL:1001099.name: kidney efferent arteriole endothelial cell
CL:1001099.def: Any endothelial cell that is part of some renal efferent arteriole.

CL:1001100.name: kidney efferent arteriole smooth muscle cell
CL:1001100.def: Any smooth muscle cell that is part of some renal efferent arteriole.

CL:1001106.name: kidney loop of Henle thick ascending limb epithelial cell
CL:1001106.def: An epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle thick ascending limb. It is known in some mammalian species that this cell may express the Na+-K+-2Cl− cotransporter (NKCC2) apically.

CL:1001107.name: kidney loop of Henle thin ascending limb epithelial cell
CL:1001107.def: An epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle thin ascending limb.

CL:1001108.name: kidney loop of Henle medullary thick ascending limb epithelial cell
CL:1001108.def: An epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle thick ascending limb segment located in the renal medulla.

CL:1001109.name: kidney loop of Henle cortical thick ascending limb epithelial cell
CL:1001109.def: An epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle thick ascending limb segment located in the renal cortex.

CL:1001111.name: kidney loop of Henle thin descending limb epithelial cell
CL:1001111.def: An epithelial cell that is part of some loop of Henle thin descending limb.

CL:1001123.name: kidney outer medulla peritubular capillary cell
CL:1001123.def: An endothelial cell that is part of the peritubular capillary of the outer renal medulla.

CL:1001124.name: kidney cortex peritubular capillary cell
CL:1001124.def: An endothelial cell that is part of the peritubular capillary of the renal cortex.

CL:1001126.name: inner renal medulla vasa recta cell
CL:1001126.def: Any vasa recta cell that is part of some inner renal medulla vasa recta.

CL:1001127.name: outer renal medulla vasa recta cell
CL:1001127.def: Any vasa recta cell that is part of some outer renal medulla vasa recta.

CL:1001131.name: vasa recta ascending limb cell
CL:1001131.def: A cell that is part of some vasa recta ascending limb.

CL:1001135.name: arcuate artery cell
CL:1001135.def: Any kidney cortex artery cell that is part of some kidney arcuate artery.

CL:1001138.name: interlobular artery cell
CL:1001138.def: Any kidney cortex artery cell that is part of some interlobular artery.

CL:1001142.name: arcuate vein cell
CL:1001142.def: Any kidney cortex vein cell that is part of some kidney arcuate vein.

CL:1001145.name: interlobular vein cell
CL:1001145.def: Any kidney cortex vein cell that is part of some renal interlobular vein.

CL:1001209.name: inner medulla vasa recta ascending limb cell
CL:1001209.def: Any vasa recta ascending limb cell that is part of some inner medulla ascending vasa recta.

CL:1001210.name: outer medulla vasa recta ascending limb cell
CL:1001210.def: Any vasa recta ascending limb cell that is part of some outer medulla ascending vasa recta.

CL:1001213.name: arcuate artery endothelial cell
CL:1001213.def: Any endothelial cell that is part of some kidney arcuate artery.

CL:1001214.name: arcuate artery smooth muscle cell
CL:1001214.def: Any smooth muscle cell that is part of some kidney arcuate artery.

CL:1001216.name: interlobulary artery endothelial cell
CL:1001216.def: Any endothelial cell that is part of some interlobular artery.

CL:1001217.name: interlobulary artery smooth muscle cell
CL:1001217.def: Any smooth muscle cell that is part of some interlobular artery.

CL:1001220.name: arcuate vein endothelial cell
CL:1001220.def: Any endothelial cell that is part of some kidney arcuate vein.

CL:1001221.name: arcuate vein smooth muscle cell
CL:1001221.def: Any smooth muscle cell that is part of some kidney arcuate vein.

CL:1001223.name: interlobulary vein endothelial cell
CL:1001223.def: Any endothelial cell that is part of some renal interlobular vein.

CL:1001224.name: interlobulary vein smooth muscle cell
CL:1001224.def: Any smooth muscle cell that is part of some renal interlobular vein.

CL:1001225.name: kidney collecting duct cell
CL:1001225.def: A cell that is part of a collecting duct of renal tubule.

CL:1001285.name: vasa recta descending limb cell
CL:1001285.def: A cell that is part of some vasa recta descending limb.

CL:1001286.name: inner medulla vasa recta descending limb cell
CL:1001286.def: Any vasa recta descending limb cell that is part of some inner medulla descending vasa recta.

CL:1001287.name: outer medulla vasa recta descending limb cell
CL:1001287.def: Any vasa recta descending limb cell that is part of some outer medulla descending vasa recta.

CL:1001318.name: renal interstitial pericyte
CL:1001318.def: A pericyte cell located in the kidney interstitium.

CL:1001319.name: bladder cell
CL:1001319.def: Any cell that is part of some urinary bladder.

CL:1001320.name: urethra cell
CL:1001320.def: Any cell that is part of some urethra.

CL:1001428.name: bladder urothelial cell
CL:1001428.def: A urothelial cell that is part of the urothelium of the urinary bladder.
synonym: transitional epithelial cell of urinary bladder

CL:1001430.name: urethra urothelial cell
CL:1001430.def: A urothelial cell that is part of the urethra urothelium. This cell plays a crucial role in maintaining the urethral barrier function, protecting against toxic substances in urine, sensing environmental changes, and defending against pathogen entry.

CL:1001431.name: kidney collecting duct principal cell
CL:1001431.def: Any renal principal cell that is part of some collecting duct of renal tubule.

CL:1001432.name: kidney collecting duct intercalated cell
CL:1001432.def: Any renal intercalated cell that is part of some collecting duct of renal tubule.

CL:1001433.name: epithelial cell of exocrine pancreas
CL:1001433.def: An epithelial cell of the exocrine pancreas.

CL:1001434.name: olfactory bulb interneuron
CL:1001434.def: A neuron residing in the olfactory bulb that serve to process and refine signals arising from olfactory sensory neurons

CL:1001435.name: periglomerular cell
CL:1001435.def: The small neuron in the glomerular layer of the olfactory bulb whose dendrites arborize within a glomerulus, where it receives synaptic input from olfactory receptor cell axon terminals, and also engages in dendrodendritic interactions with mitral and tufted cell dendrites; uses both GABA and dopamine as a neurotransmitter.

CL:1001436.name: hair-tylotrich neuron
CL:1001436.def: The subcutaneous mechanoreceptors that innervate tylotrich hair follicles.

CL:1001437.name: hair-down neuron
CL:1001437.def: The subcutaneous mechanoreceptors that innervate vellus hairs.

CL:1001451.name: sensory neuron of dorsal root ganglion
CL:1001451.def: A sensory neuron of the dorsal root ganglia that senses body position and sends information about how much the muscle is stretched to the spinal cord.

CL:1001474.name: medium spiny neuron
CL:1001474.def: An inhibitory, GABAergic projection neuron in the striatum that integrates glutamatergic signals arising from the cerebral cortex and thalamus.
synonym: gamma-aminobutyric acid ergic spiny projection neuron

CL:1001502.name: mitral cell
CL:1001502.def: The large glutaminergic nerve cells whose dendrites synapse with axons of the olfactory receptor neurons in the glomerular layer of the olfactory bulb, and whose axons pass centrally in the olfactory tract to the olfactory cortex.

CL:1001503.name: olfactory bulb tufted cell
CL:1001503.def: The principal glutaminergic neuron located in the outer third of the external plexiform layer of the olfactory bulb; a single short primary dendrite traverses the outer external plexiform layer and terminates within an olfactory glomerulus in a tuft of branches, where it receives the input from olfactory receptor neuron axon terminals; axons of the tufted cells transfer information to a number of areas in the brain, including the piriform cortex, entorhinal cortex, olfactory tubercle, and amygdala.

CL:1001505.name: parvocellular neurosecretory cell
CL:1001505.def: The secretory neurons of the paraventricular nucleus that synthesize and secrete vasopressin, corticotropin-releasing factor (CRF) and thyrotropin-releasing hormone (TRH) into blood vessels in the hypothalamo-pituitary portal system.

CL:1001509.name: glycinergic neuron
CL:1001509.def: The neurons that utilize glycine as a neurotransmitter.

CL:1001516.name: intestinal enteroendocrine cell
CL:1001516.def: The various hormone- or neurotransmitter-secreting cells present throughout the mucosa of the intestinal tract.

CL:1001517.name: stomach enteroendocrine cell
CL:1001517.def: The various hormone- or neurotransmitter-secreting cells present throughout the mucosa of the stomach.

CL:1001561.name: vomeronasal sensory neuron
CL:1001561.def: Chemosensitive cells that innervate the vomernasal organ epithelium and are responsible for receiving and transmitting pheromone signals.

CL:1001566.name: obsolete bronchioalveolar stem cells
CL:1001566.def: OBSOLETE. A respiratory stem cell found at the junction of the terminal (conductive) bronchiole and the respiratory bronchiole, which gives rise to alveolar cell types and club cells in response to lung injury.

CL:1001567.name: lung endothelial cell
CL:1001567.def: Any endothelial cell of vascular tree that is part of some lung.

CL:1001568.name: pulmonary artery endothelial cell
CL:1001568.def: Any endothelial cell of vascular tree that is part of some pulmonary artery.

CL:1001569.name: hippocampal interneuron
CL:1001569.def: An interneuron with a soma found in the hippocampus.

CL:1001571.name: hippocampal pyramidal neuron
CL:1001571.def: A pyramidal neuron with a soma found in the hippocampus.

CL:1001572.name: colon endothelial cell
CL:1001572.def: A vascular endothelial cell found in colon blood vessels.

CL:1001575.name: uterine cervix squamous cell
CL:1001575.def: Squamous cell of uterine cervix epithelium.

CL:1001576.name: oral mucosa squamous cell
synonym: oral cavity mucosa squamous epithelial cell

CL:1001580.name: hippocampal glial cell
CL:1001580.def: A glial cell that is part of the hippocampus.

CL:1001583.name: obsolete breast adipocyte
CL:1001583.def: OBSOLETE: Adipocytes found in the subcutaneous adipose tissue of breast. The breast consists of three main components, the skin, the subcutaneous adipose tissue and the functional glandular tissue that comprises both parenchyma and stroma.

CL:1001585.name: appendix glandular cell
CL:1001585.def: Glandular cell of appendix epithelium. Example: Goblet cells; enterocytes or absorptive cells; enteroendocrine and M cells.

CL:1001586.name: mammary gland glandular cell
CL:1001586.def: Glandular cell of mammary epithelium. Example: glandular cells of large and intermediate ducts, glandular cells in terminal ducts.

CL:1001587.name: uterine cervix secretory cell
CL:1001587.def: Glandular cell of uterine cervix epithelium.

CL:1001588.name: colon glandular cell
CL:1001588.def: Glandular cell of colon epithelium. Example: Goblet cells; enterocytes or absorptive cells; enteroendocrine and M cells.

CL:1001589.name: duodenum secretory cell
CL:1001589.def: Glandular cell of duodenal epithelium. Example: Enterocytes, Goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells; Paneth cells; M cells; Brunner's gland cell.

CL:1001591.name: oviduct secretory cell
CL:1001591.def: Glandular cell of oviduct epithelium. Example: peg cells, ciliated cells.

CL:1001595.name: rectum glandular cell
CL:1001595.def: Glandular cell of rectal epithelium. Example: Goblet cell; enterocytes or absorptive cells; enteroendocrine and M cells.

CL:1001596.name: salivary gland glandular cell
CL:1001596.def: Glandular cell of salivary gland. Example: Serous cells, mucous cells, cuboidal epithelial cells of the intercalated ducts, simple cuboidal epithelium of the striated ducts, epithelial cells of excretory ducts.

CL:1001597.name: seminal vesicle glandular cell
CL:1001597.def: Glandular cell of seminal vesicle epithelium.

CL:1001598.name: small intestine secretory cell
CL:1001598.def: A glandular cell found in the epithelium of the small intestine. Example: Enterocytes, Goblet cells, enteroendocrine cells; Paneth cells; M cells; Somatostatin-secreting Cells (D-cells) .

CL:1001599.name: pancreas exocrine glandular cell
CL:1001599.def: Glandular cell of exocrine pancreas epithelium. Example: pancreatic acinar cell, glandular cells in pancreatic canaliculi, glandular cells in pancreatic ducts.

CL:1001601.name: adrenal gland glandular cell
CL:1001601.def: Hormone secreting cell located in the cortex of adrenal gland. Glandular cells in the adrenal cortex secrete mineralocorticoids, glucocorticoids and androgens.

CL:1001602.name: cerebral cortex endothelial cell
CL:1001602.def: A distinct endothelial cell forming the walls of the capillaries within the cerebral cortex.

CL:1001603.name: lung macrophage
CL:1001603.def: Circulating macrophages and tissue macrophages (alveolar macrophages) of lung.

CL:1001607.name: articular chondrocyte
CL:1001607.def: Chondrocyte forming the hyaline cartilage found in joints.

CL:1001610.name: bone marrow hematopoietic cell
