CL:1001610.def: Hematopoietic cells resident in the bone marrow. Include: hematopoietic stem cells (lymphoid stem cells and myeloid stem cells) and the precursor cells for thrombocytes, erythrocytes, basophils, neutrophils, eosinophils, monocytes and lymphocytes.

CL:1100001.name: secretory epithelial cell
CL:1100001.def: An epithelial cell that is specialised for the synthesis and secretion of specific biomolecules.

CL:2000000.name: epidermal melanocyte
CL:2000000.def: Any melanocyte that is part of a epidermis.

CL:2000001.name: peripheral blood mononuclear cell
CL:2000001.def: A leukocyte with a single non-segmented nucleus in the mature form found in the circulatory pool of blood.

CL:2000002.name: decidual cell
CL:2000002.def: A specialized, enlarged, connective tissue cell of the decidua with enlarged nucleus, dense membrane‐bound secretory granules and cytoplasmic accumulation of glycogen and lipid droplets. These cells develop by the transformation of endometrial stromal cells during decidualization.

CL:2000004.name: pituitary gland cell
CL:2000004.def: Any cell that is part of a pituitary gland.

CL:2000005.name: brain macroglial cell
CL:2000005.def: Any macroglial cell that is part of a brain.

CL:2000006.name: tonsil germinal center B cell
CL:2000006.def: Any germinal center B cell that is part of a tonsil.

CL:2000007.name: articular chondrocyte of knee joint
CL:2000007.def: Chondrocyte forming the hyaline cartilage found in the knee joint.

CL:2000008.name: microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000008.def: Any blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of a microvascular endothelium.

CL:2000009.name: obsolete microvascular endothelium blood vessel endothelial cell
CL:2000009.def: Any blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of a microvascular endothelium.

CL:2000010.name: dermis blood vessel endothelial cell
CL:2000010.def: Any blood vessel endothelial cell that is part of a dermis.

CL:2000011.name: dermis lymphatic vessel endothelial cell
CL:2000011.def: Any endothelial cell of lymphatic vessel that is part of a dermis.

CL:2000012.name: fibroblast of pedal digit skin
CL:2000012.def: Any skin fibroblast that is part of a pedal digit skin.

CL:2000013.name: fibroblast of skin of abdomen
CL:2000013.def: Any skin fibroblast that is part of a skin of abdomen.

CL:2000014.name: fibroblast of upper leg skin
CL:2000014.def: Any skin fibroblast that is part of a upper leg skin.

CL:2000015.name: fibroblast of arm
CL:2000015.def: Any skin fibroblast that is part of a arm.

CL:2000016.name: lung microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000016.def: Any lung endothelial cell that is part of a microvascular endothelium.

CL:2000017.name: fibroblast of peridontal ligament
CL:2000017.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a periodontal ligament.

CL:2000018.name: endothelial cell of coronary artery
CL:2000018.def: Any endothelial cell of artery that is part of a coronary artery.

CL:2000019.name: compound eye photoreceptor cell
CL:2000019.def: Any photoreceptor cell that is part of a compound eye.

CL:2000020.name: inner cell mass cell
CL:2000020.def: Any native cell that is part of a inner cell mass.

CL:2000021.name: sebaceous gland cell
CL:2000021.def: Any native cell that is part of a sebaceous gland.

CL:2000022.name: cardiac septum cell
CL:2000022.def: Any native cell that is part of a cardiac septum.

CL:2000023.name: spinal cord ventral column interneuron
CL:2000023.def: Any interneuron that is part of a spinal cord ventral column.

CL:2000024.name: spinal cord medial motor column neuron
CL:2000024.def: Any neuron that is part of a spinal cord medial motor column.

CL:2000025.name: spinal cord oligodendrocyte
CL:2000025.def: Any oligodendrocyte that is part of a spinal cord.

CL:2000026.name: obsolete cerebellum Golgi cell
CL:2000026.def: Any Golgi cell that is part of a cerebellum.

CL:2000027.name: cerebellum basket cell
CL:2000027.def: Any basket cell that is part of a cerebellum.

CL:2000028.name: cerebellum glutamatergic neuron
CL:2000028.def: Any glutamatergic neuron that is part of a cerebellum.

CL:2000029.name: central nervous system neuron
CL:2000029.def: Any neuron that is part of a central nervous system.

CL:2000030.name: hypothalamus cell
CL:2000030.def: Any native cell that is part of a hypothalamus.

CL:2000031.name: lateral line ganglion neuron
CL:2000031.def: Any neuron that is part of a lateral line ganglion.

CL:2000032.name: peripheral nervous system neuron
CL:2000032.def: A neuron that is part of a peripheral nervous system.

CL:2000033.name: limb basal cell of epidermis
CL:2000033.def: Any basal cell of epidermis that is part of a limb.

CL:2000034.name: anterior lateral line neuromast hair cell
CL:2000034.def: Any neuromast hair cell that is part of a anterior lateral line.

CL:2000035.name: anterior lateral line neuromast mantle cell
CL:2000035.def: Any neuromast mantle cell that is part of an anterior lateral line.

CL:2000036.name: anterior lateral line neuromast supporting cell
CL:2000036.def: Any neuromast support cell that is part of a anterior lateral line.
CL:2000036.synonym: anterior lateral line neuromast support cell

CL:2000037.name: posterior lateral line neuromast hair cell
CL:2000037.def: Any neuromast hair cell that is part of a posterior lateral line.

CL:2000038.name: posterior lateral line neuromast mantle cell
CL:2000038.def: Any neuromast mantle cell that is part of a posterior lateral line.

CL:2000039.name: posterior lateral line neuromast supporting cell
CL:2000039.def: Any neuromast support cell that is part of a posterior lateral line.
CL:2000039.synonym: posterior lateral line neuromast support cell

CL:2000040.name: bladder microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000040.def: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a urinary bladder.

CL:2000041.name: dermis microvascular lymphatic vessel endothelial cell
CL:2000041.def: Any dermis lymphatic vessel endothelial cell that is part of a microvascular endothelium.

CL:2000042.name: embryonic fibroblast
CL:2000042.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a embryo.

CL:2000043.name: brain pericyte
CL:2000043.def: Any pericyte cell that is part of a brain.

CL:2000044.name: brain microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000044.def: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a brain.

CL:2000045.name: foreskin melanocyte
CL:2000045.def: Any melanocyte of skin that is part of a skin of prepuce of penis.

CL:2000046.name: ventricular cardiac muscle cell
CL:2000046.def: Any cardiac muscle cell that is part of a cardiac ventricle.

CL:2000047.name: brainstem motor neuron
CL:2000047.def: Any motor neuron that is part of a brainstem.

CL:2000048.name: anterior horn motor neuron
CL:2000048.def: A lower motor neuron whose soma is located in the anterior horn. Anterior horn motor neurons project from the anterior portion of the grey matter in the spinal cord to some skeletal muscles.
synonym: ventral horn of spinal cord spinal cord motor neuron

CL:2000049.name: primary motor cortex pyramidal cell
CL:2000049.def: Any pyramidal cell that is part of a primary motor cortex.

CL:2000050.name: obsolete retina retinal ganglion cell
CL:2000050.def: Any retinal ganglion cell that is part of a retina.

CL:2000051.name: splenic fibroblast
CL:2000051.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a spleen.

CL:2000052.name: umbilical artery endothelial cell
CL:2000052.def: Any endothelial cell of artery that is part of a umbilical cord.

CL:2000053.name: splenic endothelial cell
CL:2000053.def: Any endothelial cell that is part of a spleen.

CL:2000054.name: hepatic pit cell
CL:2000054.def: A large, granular, liver specific natural killer cell that adheres to the endothelial cells of the hepatic sinusoid.

CL:2000055.name: liver dendritic cell
CL:2000055.def: Any dendritic cell that is part of a liver.

CL:2000056.name: Meynert cell
CL:2000056.def: Any pyramidal cell that is part of a regional part of cerebral cortex.

CL:2000057.name: femoral osteoblast
CL:2000057.def: Any osteoblast that is part of a femur.

CL:2000058.name: calvarial osteoblast
CL:2000058.def: Any osteoblast that is part of a skull.

CL:2000059.name: prostate gland microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000059.def: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a prostate gland.

CL:2000060.name: placental villous trophoblast
CL:2000060.def: A trophoblast of placental villi.  These cells fuse to form synctial  trophoplast - the placental side of the interface between the placenta and maternal blood sinusoids in the decidua.

CL:2000061.name: placental amniotic mesenchymal stromal cell
CL:2000061.def: Any mesenchymal stem cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:2000062.name: placental villus capillary endothelial cell
CL:2000062.def: Any capillary endothelial cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:2000063.name: ovarian fibroblast
CL:2000063.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a female gonad.

CL:2000064.name: ovarian surface epithelial cell
CL:2000064.def: A meso-epithelial cell of the ovarian surface epithelium, varying in shape from flat to cuboidal to pseudostratified columnar. This cell plays a crucial role in ovulation by producing proteolytic enzymes in response to gonadotropins, facilitating follicle rupture through tissue breakdown and TNF-alpha signaling. Additionally, this cell contributes to post-ovulatory wound repair (Morris et al., 2022) and exhibits stem cell-like properties (Flesken-Nikitin et al., 2013; Wang et al., 2019).

CL:2000065.name: ovarian microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000065.def: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a female urethra.

CL:2000066.name: cardiac ventricle fibroblast
CL:2000066.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a cardiac ventricle.

CL:2000067.name: cardiac atrium fibroblast
CL:2000067.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a cardiac atrium.

CL:2000068.name: pericardium fibroblast
CL:2000068.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a pericardium.

CL:2000069.name: gallbladder fibroblast
CL:2000069.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a gallbladder.

CL:2000070.name: optic choroid fibroblast
CL:2000070.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a optic choroid.

CL:2000071.name: mammary microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000071.def: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a breast.

CL:2000072.name: adipose microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000072.def: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a adipose tissue.

CL:2000073.name: migratory cardiac neural crest cell
CL:2000073.def: Any migratory neural crest cell that is part of a cardiac neural crest.

CL:2000074.name: splenocyte
CL:2000074.def: Any leukocyte that is part of a spleen.

CL:2000075.name: anterior visceral endoderm cell
CL:2000075.def: Any endodermal cell that is part of a anterior visceral endoderm.

CL:2000076.name: hindlimb stylopod vein endothelial cell
CL:2000076.def: Any vein endothelial cell that is part of a hindlimb stylopod.

CL:2000077.name: skeletal muscle tissue of pectoralis major striated muscle cell
CL:2000077.def: Any striated muscle cell that is part of a skeletal muscle tissue of pectoralis major.

CL:2000078.name: placental pericyte
CL:2000078.def: Any pericyte cell that is part of a placenta.

CL:2000079.name: mesenchymal stem cell of femoral bone marrow
CL:2000079.def: Any mesenchymal stem cell of the bone marrow that is part of a femur.

CL:2000080.name: mesenchymal stem cell of abdominal adipose tissue
CL:2000080.def: Any mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue that is part of an abdomen.
CL:2000080.synonym: mesenchymal stem cell of abdominal adipose

CL:2000081.name: melanocyte of skin of face
CL:2000081.def: Any melanocyte of skin that is part of a skin of face.

CL:2000082.name: obsolete melanocyte of foreskin
CL:2000082.def: OBSOLETE. Any melanocyte of skin that is part of a skin of prepuce of penis.

CL:2000083.name: hair follicle dermal papilla cell of scalp
CL:2000083.def: Any hair follicle dermal papilla cell that is part of a scalp.

CL:2000084.name: conjunctiva goblet cell
CL:2000084.def: A goblet cell that is part of the conjunctival epithelium, characterized by apical accumulation of mucin granules (containing MUC5AC in humans; Muc5ac/Muc5b in mice). These gel-forming mucins support tear film stability, ocular lubrication, and pathogen defence. The conjunctival goblet cell forms tight junctions with neighbouring epithelial cells via species-specific claudins (claudin-10 in humans, claudin-2 in mice) and regulates immune homeostasis by facilitating soluble antigen transport to dendritic cells through goblet cell-associated antigen passages (GAPs) (Barbosa et al., 2017). The transcription factor SPDEF is essential for its differentiation.

CL:2000085.name: mononuclear cell of umbilical cord
CL:2000085.def: Any mononuclear cell that is part of a umbilical cord.

CL:2000086.name: neocortex basket cell
CL:2000086.def: Any basket cell that is part of a neocortex.

CL:2000087.name: dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation basket cell
CL:2000087.def: Any basket cell that is part of a dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation.

CL:2000088.name: Ammon's horn basket cell
CL:2000088.def: Any basket cell that is part of a Ammon's horn.

CL:2000089.name: dentate gyrus granule cell
CL:2000089.def: A granule cell that has soma location in the dentate gyrus cell layer of the hippocampal formation and has an elliptical cell body and characteristic cone-shaped tree of spiny apical dendrites. The branches extend throughout the molecular layer and the distal tips of the dendritic tree end just at the hippocampal fissure or at the ventricular surface. The dentate gyrus granule cell is the principal cell type of the dentate gyrus.
CL:2000089.synonym: dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation granule cell

CL:2000090.name: dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation stellate cell
CL:2000090.def: Any stellate cell that is part of a dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation.

CL:2000091.name: endometrial microvascular endothelial cell
CL:2000091.def: Any microvascular endothelial cell that is part of a endometrial blood vessel.

CL:2000092.name: hair follicular keratinocyte
CL:2000092.def: Any keratinocyte that is part of a hair follicle.

CL:2000093.name: bronchus fibroblast of lung
CL:2000093.def: Any fibroblast of lung that is part of a bronchus.

CL:2000094.name: nasal cavity respiratory epithelium epithelial cell of viscerocranial mucosa
CL:2000094.def: Any epithelial cell of viscerocranial mucosa that is part of a nasal cavity respiratory epithelium.

CL:2000095.name: cord blood hematopoietic stem cell
CL:2000095.def: Any hematopoietic stem cell that is part of a umbilical cord blood.

CL:2000096.name: fibroblast of the reticular layer of dermis
CL:2000096.def: Any fibroblast that is part of a reticular layer of dermis.

CL:2000097.name: midbrain dopaminergic neuron
CL:2000097.def: Any dopaminergic neuron that is part of a midbrain.

CL:3000000.name: ciliated epithelial cell of esophagus
CL:3000000.def: A ciliated epithelial cell of the esophagus.

CL:3000001.name: Hofbauer cell
CL:3000001.def: A tissue-resident macrophage that is part of the placenta. A Hofbauer cell expresses high levels of growth factors and metalloproteinases that support vasculogenesis, angiogenesis, branching morphogenesis and tissue remodeling. A Hofbauer cell has a fetal origin, is found in the villous stroma, chorion, and amnion, and is present throughout pregnancy.

CL:3000003.name: sympathetic cholinergic neuron
CL:3000003.def: A type of autonomic neuron that releases acetylcholine.

CL:3000004.name: peripheral sensory neuron
CL:3000004.def: A neuron type that is located in a peripheral nervous system and it transmits sensory information from the peripheral (PNS) to the central nervous system (CNS). A sensory neuron converts physical (light, sound, touch) or chemical (such as taste and smell) stimuli into an electrical signal through a process known as sensory transduction. The function of a sensory neuron is to carry informations from the external environment and internal body conditions to the central nervous system for further processing.

CL:4006000.name: fibroblast of breast
CL:4006000.def: A fibroblast that is part of the breast.

CL:4006001.name: fibroblast of skin of scalp
CL:4006001.def: A fibroblast that is part of the skin of scalp.

CL:4023000.name: beta motor neuron
CL:4023000.def: A motor neuron that innervates both intrafusal and extrafusal muscle fibers. Low abundancy. They control both muscle contraction and responsiveness of the sensory feedback from muscle spindles.

CL:4023001.name: static beta motor neuron
CL:4023001.def: A beta motor neuron that innervates nuclear chain fibers.

CL:4023002.name: dynamic beta motor neuron
CL:4023002.def: A beta motor neuron that innervates the nuclear bag fibers of muscle spindles.

CL:4023003.name: nuclear chain fiber
CL:4023003.def: A type of intrafusal muscle fiber that has nuclei arranged in a linear row. Unlike nuclear bag fibers, the equatorial region of these fibers (in the centre of the spindle) is not expanded. These fibers are responsible for the detection of changes in muscle length. They are innervated by static gamma motor neurons and are principally associated with type II sensory fibers.

CL:4023004.name: nuclear bag fiber
CL:4023004.def: A type of intrafusal muscle fiber that lies in the center of a muscle spindle. Nuclei are clustered centrally and give the equatorial region a swollen appearance. They are associated with associated with dynamic gamma motor neurons, and the stretching of the equatorial region of the nuclear bag fibers results in an increase in the firing rate of type Ia sensory fibers.

CL:4023005.name: dynamic nuclear bag fiber
CL:4023005.def: A nuclear bag fiber that is sensitive mainly to the rate of change in muscle length.

CL:4023006.name: static nuclear bag fiber
CL:4023006.def: A nuclear bag fiber that is sensitive only changes in muscle length but not the rate of that change.

CL:4023007.name: L2/3 bipolar VIP GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023007.def: A VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron with bipolar morphology, with a soma found in L2/3. L2/3 bipolar VIP cells have extending axons across all layers (with preferences for layers II/III and Va) and a dendritic tree that is vertically more restricted than deeper layer VIP cells and extend fewer dendrites into the layers outside their home layer (location of soma). L2/3 bipolar VIP cells have great variability in firing patterns, though most are continuous adapting. L2/3 bipolar VIP cells are more depolarized in their resting state, had less fast rectification, and had smaller after hyperpolarization than deeper VIP cells.

CL:4023008.name: intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023008.def: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects to structures of telencephalic origins.

CL:4023009.name: extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023009.def: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects to structures not derived from telencephalon.

CL:4023010.name: alpha7 GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023010.def: A GABAergic cortical interneuron that is strongly labelled for α7 nAChRs. These cells have soma found in L1 and have multipolar dendrites with vertically descending axonal collaterals that project deep into the column, usually branching and terminating in L5A.

CL:4023011.name: lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023011.def: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses Lamp5. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: CGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters Lamp5.

CL:4023012.name: near-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023012.def: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects axons locally rather than distantly.

CL:4023013.name: corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023013.def: A glutamatergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that projects to the thalamus.

CL:4023014.name: L5 VIP GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023014.def: A VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron with a soma found in L5. L5 VIP cells have mostly local morphology with some deep-projecting axons. They show only moderate resistance, comparable to that of sst subclass and unlike typical VIP subclass cells that tend to show high input resistance. L5 VIP cells show particularly low resting membrane potential.

CL:4023015.name: sncg GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023015.def: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses Gamma-synuclein. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: CGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters Sncg.

CL:4023016.name: VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023016.def: A transcriptomically distinct cortical GABAergic neuron that expresses the vasocactive intestinal polypeptide and that has its soma located in the cerebral cortex. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: CGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster Vip.

CL:4023017.name: sst GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023017.def: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic neuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses somatostatin (sst). The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: MGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster Sst.

CL:4023018.name: pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023018.def: A transcriptomically distinct GABAergic interneuron with a soma located in a cerebral cortex and it expresses Parvalbumin. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: MGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster Pvalb.

CL:4023019.name: L5/6 cck, VIP GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023019.def: A VIP GABAergic cortical interneuron that expresses cck. L5/6 cck cells have soma found mainly in L5 and L6 and have large axonal arborization.

CL:4023020.name: dynamic gamma motor neuron
CL:4023020.def: A gamma motor neuron that innervates dynamic nuclear bag fibers (bag1 fibers) and enhances the sensitivities of Ia sensory neurons. They alter muscle spindle sensitivity and increases its discharge in response to velocity of muscle length (rather than just magnitude).

CL:4023021.name: static gamma motor neuron
CL:4023021.def: A gamma motor neuron that innervates static nuclear bag fibers (bag2 fibers) and increases their firing, in response to an increase in the magnitude of change in length, and controls the static sensitivity of the stretch reflex.

CL:4023022.name: canopy lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023022.def: A Lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron that has extended axons in the surface of L1. Canopy Lamp5 cells resemble neurogliaform cells in having elongated horizontal axonal arbors largely confined to L1; but the dendritic arbors are wider and have fewer branches, while the axon is less tortuous and extends further from the soma

CL:4023023.name: L5,6 neurogliaform lamp5 GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023023.def: A lamp 5 GABAergic cortical interneuron with neurogliaform morphology with a soma found in L5,6. L5,6 NGC lamp5 have deep afterhyperpolarization (AHP) but narrow action potentials (APs). Unlike other deep neurogliaform cells (which are caudal ganglionic eminence (CGE) derived), L5,6 NGC lamp5 cells are medial ganglionic eminence (MGE)-derived

CL:4023024.name: neurogliaform lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023024.def: A lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron with layer-adapting morphology. NGC lamp5 cells have a small round soma, short dendrites, and a wide dense axonal arbor that tends to establish a dense axonal mesh with high connection probability both to themselves and L2 pyramidal cells. NGC lamp5 cells have unique synaptic properties that distinguish them from other GABAergic interneurons, including the release of GABA to the extracellular space via volume transmission, and the ability to produce GABA-B responses in connected postsynaptic targets.

CL:4023025.name: long-range projecting sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023025.def: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron that is both an interneuron and a projecting neuron. They are found in all layers from upper L2/3 down to the bottom of L6. They have long-range projections, some with axons fading into white matter. These cells have low rebound potential, low hyperpolarization sag, and high variability in membrane time constant.

CL:4023026.name: direct pathway medium spiny neuron
CL:4023026.def: A medium spiny neuron that expresses dopamine type 1 receptors and projects to the globus pallidus internus or the substantia nigra pars reticulata.

CL:4023027.name: L5 sst T-Martinotti interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023027.def: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron with a soma found in L5 and possesses 'T-shaped' Martinotti morphologies with local axonal plexus in L5a and translaminar axons restricted to the uppermost part of L1. They show low-threshold spiking patterns with strong rebound firing, and inhibit the L1 apical tuft of nearby pyramidal cells.

CL:4023028.name: L5 non-Martinotti sst GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023028.def: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron with a soma found in lower L5 with mostly local axonal arborization but with some sparse ascending axons. L5 non-Martinotti sst cells show somatic localization and local axon plexus in L5b and L5b/6 and substantial innervation of L3 and L4, and receive thalamic input from the ventral posteromedial nucleus and specifically target L4 neurons, avoiding L5 pyramidal cells. L5 non-Martinotti sst cells tend to show a higher input resistance and seem to be less stuttering.

CL:4023029.name: indirect pathway medium spiny neuron
CL:4023029.def: A medium spiny neuron that expresses dopamine type 2 receptors and projects to the external globus pallidus.

CL:4023030.name: L2/3/5 fan Martinotti sst GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023030.def: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron that has fanning-out Martinotti morphology that is found in layer 2/3/5 of the cerebral cortex. They have local axon arbor and long ascending axons that spreads horizontally and arborizes significantly in L1.

CL:4023031.name: L4 sst Martinotti interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023031.def: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron with a soma found in lower L2/3 and upper 5, L4 Sst cells have Martinotti morphology with ascending axons but denser local axons and sparser ‘fanning-out’ projections to L1. L4 sst cells have smaller membrane time constant to calb2 (L2/3/5 fan Martinotti Cell) and non-zero afterdepolarization (ADP).

CL:4023033.name: OFF retinal ganglion cell
CL:4023033.def: A retinal ganglion cell that is depolarized by decreased illumination of their receptive field center.

CL:4023034.name: obsolete L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)
CL:4023034.def: OBSOLETE A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron transcriptomically between the sst and the pvalb families with a soma found in L2/3. Some L2/3 PV-like sst cells have Martinotti morphology while some have basket cell morphology. L2/3 PV-like sst cells have lower AP width and higher firing rate than typical Sst subclass cells. L2/3 PV-like sst cells have high maximum firing rate variability, with many classified as belonging to the pvalb subclass on the basis of electrophysiology.

CL:4023035.name: lateral ganglionic eminence derived neuron
CL:4023035.def: A neuron that is derived from a precursor cell in the lateral ganglion eminence.

CL:4023036.name: chandelier pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023036.def: A transcriptomically distinct pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron that is recognizable by the straight terminal axonal 'cartridges' of vertically oriented strings of synaptic boutons. Chandelier PV cells' boutons target exclusively the axon initial segment (AIS) of pyramidal cells, with a single cell innervating hundreds of pyramidal cells in a clustered manner. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: CGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters Chandelier.

CL:4023038.name: L6b glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023038.def: A glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 6b. They are transcriptomically related to corticothalamic-projecting neurons but have differential projections to the thalamus or anterior cingulate. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Deep layer (non-IT) excitatory neuron', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster L6b.

CL:4023039.name: amygdala excitatory neuron
CL:4023039.def: Any neuron that has its soma located in some amygdala and is capable of some glutamate secretion, neurotransmission.

CL:4023040.name: L2/3-6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4023040.def: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layers L2/3-6.

CL:4023041.name: L5 extratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023041.def: A transcriptomically distinct glutamatergic neuron, with a soma found in the deeper portion of L5, that has long-range axonal projections including deep subcortical targets outside of the telencephalon and, in some cases, the spinal cord. While the L5 ET neuron projections are not limited to ET targets, they are clearly differentiated from the neuron subclasses whose projections are constrained to intratelencephalic (IT) targets.  L5 ET neurons are generally the largest excitatory cortical neurons, typically having a thick apical dendrite with a prominent dendritic tuft in layer 1 and displaying burst-firing physiological characteristics. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Deep layer (non-IT) excitatory neurons ', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters L5 ET.

CL:4023042.name: L6 corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron
CL:4023042.def: A transcriptomically distinct corticothalamic-projecting neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 6. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Deep layer (non-IT) excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters L6 CT.

CL:4023043.name: L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023043.def: A transcriptomically distinct near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5/6 of the primary motor cortex. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Deep layer (non-IT) excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', cluster L5/6 NP.

CL:4023044.name: non-medulla, extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023044.def: An extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron located in layer 5b of the primary motor cortex that does not project to the medulla. Non-MY ET cells are large, big-tufted cells with the apical dendrite often bifurcating close to the soma, suggesting they are corticospinal cells. Non-MY ET cells have bigger hyperpolarization sag, lower input resistance, and smaller AP width, compared to L5 IT neurons.

CL:4023045.name: medulla-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023045.def: An extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron located in layer 5b of the primary motor cortex that projects to the medulla. MY ET cells are large, big-tufted cells with the apical dendrite often bifurcating close to the soma, suggesting they are corticospinal cells. MY ET cells have bigger hyperpolarization sag, lower input resistance, and smaller AP width, compared to L5 IT neurons.
synonym: medulla-projecting extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex

CL:4023046.name: L6b glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023046.def: An excitatory glutamatergic neuron transcriptomically related to the CT subclass, with a soma preferentially located in the bottom of L6 of the primary motor cortex.
CL:4023046.synonym: L6b subplate glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex

CL:4023047.name: L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023047.def: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 2/3 of the primary motor cortex.

CL:4023048.name: L4/5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023048.def: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic with a soma located in upper L5 of the primary motor cortex. These cells have thin untufted apical dendrites.

CL:4023049.name: L5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023049.def: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in L5 of the primary motor cortex.

CL:4023050.name: L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023050.def: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in L6 of the primary motor cortex. These cells are short untufted pyramidal cells, which could be stellate or inverted.

CL:4023051.name: vascular leptomeningeal cell
CL:4023051.def: A transcriptomically distinct type of mesothelial fibroblast that is derived from the neural crest, is localized on blood vessels, and is a key component of the pia and arachnoid membranes surrounding the brain. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: Non-neuronal cells', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters VLMC.

CL:4023052.name: Betz upper motor neuron
CL:4023052.def: A Betz cell that synapses with lower motor neurons directly.

CL:4023053.name: spinal interneuron synapsing Betz cell
CL:4023053.def: A Betz cell that syanpses with spinal interneurons.

CL:4023054.name: mesothelial fibroblast
CL:4023054.def: A mesothelial cell that has undergone mesothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (MMT) to become a fibroblast cell.

CL:4023055.name: corticothalamic VAL/VM projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex
CL:4023055.def: A corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic neuron that is located in L6 and lower L5 of the primary motor cortex, with a pyramidal morphology and mostly untufted apical dendrites terminating in midcortical layers. CT VAL/VM (ventroanterior-ventrolateral complex/ventromedial nucleus) cells have a near tonic firing pattern and are distinguished from L6 IT neurons by a lower inter-spike interval adaptation index.

CL:4023056.name: vascular leptomeningeal cell (Mmus)
CL:4023056.def: A type of mouse mesothelial fibroblast that is derived from the neural crest, is localized on blood vessels, and is a key component of the pia and arachnoid membranes surrounding the brain.

CL:4023057.name: cerebellar inhibitory GABAergic interneuron
CL:4023057.def: Any GABAergic interneuron that has its soma located in some cerebellar cortex.

CL:4023058.name: mesothelial fibroblast of the leptomeninx
CL:4023058.def: A mesothelial fibroblast found in the leptomeninx.

CL:4023059.name: differentiation-committed oligodendrocyte precursor
CL:4023059.def: An oligodendrocyte precursor cell that is committed to differentiate.

CL:4023060.name: hippocampal CA1-3 neuron
CL:4023060.def: A neuron that has its soma located in CA1-3 of the hippocampus.

CL:4023061.name: hippocampal CA4 neuron
CL:4023061.def: A neuron that has its soma located in CA4 of the hippocampus.

CL:4023062.name: dentate gyrus neuron
CL:4023062.def: A neuron with its soma located in the dentate gyrus of the hippocampus.

CL:4023063.name: medial ganglionic eminence derived interneuron
CL:4023063.def: An interneuron that is derived from the medial ganglionic eminence.

CL:4023064.name: caudal ganglionic eminence derived cortical interneuron
CL:4023064.def: An interneuron that is derived from the caudal ganglionic eminence.
synonym: caudal ganglionic eminence derived GABAergic cortical interneuron

CL:4023065.name: meis2 expressing cortical GABAergic cell
CL:4023065.def: A GABAergic cell located in the cerebral cortex that expresses meis2.

CL:4023066.name: horizontal pyramidal neuron
CL:4023066.def: A pyramidal neuron which has an apical tree which is oriented parallel to the pia. This is unlike typical pyramidal neurons which have its apical dendrite aligned vertically.

CL:4023067.name: obsolete Martinotti morphology L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)
CL:4023067.def: OBSOLETE A L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus) that has Martinotti morphology.

CL:4023068.name: thalamic excitatory neuron
CL:4023068.def: An excitatory neuron that has its soma located in the thalamic complex. This neuron type can be involved in a series of circuits related to sensory integration, motor integration, pain processing, social behaviour and reward response.

CL:4023069.name: medial ganglionic eminence derived GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023069.def: A GABAergic cortical interneuron that develops from the medial ganglionic eminence and has migrated to the cerebral cortex.

CL:4023070.name: obsolete caudal ganglionic eminence derived GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023070.def: OBSOLETE. A GABAergic cortical interneuron that develops from the caudal ganglionic eminence and has migrated to the cerebral cortex.

CL:4023071.name: L5/6 cck GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023071.def: A GABAergic cortical interneuron that expresses cck. L5/6 cck cells have soma found mainly in L5 and L6 and have large axonal arborization.

CL:4023072.name: brain vascular cell
CL:4023072.def: A cell that is part of the brain vasculature.

CL:4023073.name: obsolete choroid plexus cell
CL:4023073.def: OBSOLETE. A cell that is part of the choroid plexus.

CL:4023074.name: mammillary body neuron
CL:4023074.def: A neuron that has its soma located in the mammillary body.

CL:4023075.name: L6 th sst GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023075.def: A sst GABAergic cortical interneuron found in L6 that expresses tyrosine hydroxylase. L6 Th+ SST cells have mostly local axonal arborization within L6.
synonym: L6 tyrosine hydroxylase positive sst expressing GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)

CL:4023076.name: Martinotti neuron
CL:4023076.def: An interneuron that has Martinotti morphology. These interneurons are scattered throughout various layers of the cerebral cortex, sending their axons up to the cortical layer I where they form axonal arborization.

CL:4023077.name: bitufted neuron
CL:4023077.def: A type of interneuron that has two clusters of dendritic branches that originate directly from the soma and extend in opposite directions and axons that form a plexus which spreads widely. Compared to bipolar neurons, bitufted neurons have branching that occur close to the soma.

CL:4023078.name: obsolete basket morphology L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)
CL:4023078.def: OBSOLETE A L2/3 pvalb-like sst GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus) that has basket morphology.

CL:4023079.name: midbrain-derived inhibitory neuron
CL:4023079.def: A GABAergic inhibitory neuron that is derived from the midbrain.

CL:4023080.name: stellate L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Mmus)
CL:4023080.def: a L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex that has stellate pyramidal morphology.

CL:4023081.name: inverted L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Mmus)
CL:4023081.def: a L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex that has inverted pyramidal morphology.

CL:4023083.name: chandelier cell
CL:4023083.def: A GABAergic interneuron that selectively innervates the axon initial segment of pyramidal cells. Their local axonal clusters are formed by high-frequency branching at shallow angles, often ramifying around, above or below their somata with a high bouton density. The characteristic terminal portions of the axon form short vertical rows of boutons, resembling the candlesticks and candles of a chandelier. Chandelier cells can be multipolar or bitufted.

CL:4023086.name: T Martinotti neuron
CL:4023086.def: A Martinotti neuron that has axons that form a horizontal ramification, making it T-shaped.

CL:4023087.name: fan Martinotti neuron
CL:4023087.def: A Martinotti neuron that has axons that form a fan-like plexus.

CL:4023088.name: large basket cell
CL:4023088.def: A basket cell that is large, and typically ascends to give rise to many long horizontally and vertically projecting axon collaterals that traverse neighboring columns and can extend through all cortical layers.

CL:4023089.name: nest basket cell
CL:4023089.def: A basket cell which has simpler dendritic arbors (compared to small or large basket cells), and an axonal plexus of intermediate density, composed of a few long, smooth axonal branches.

CL:4023090.name: small basket cell
CL:4023090.def: A basket cell with axonal arbors composed of frequent, short, curvy axonal branches that tend to be near their somata and within the same layer.

CL:4023092.name: inverted pyramidal neuron
CL:4023092.def: A pyramidal neuron which has an apical tree which is oriented towards the white matter.

CL:4023093.name: stellate pyramidal neuron
CL:4023093.def: A pyramidal neuron which lacks a tuft formation but extends small radial distances forming a star-like shape.

CL:4023094.name: tufted pyramidal neuron
CL:4023094.def: A pyramidal neuron which has a distinctive tuft formation, distal from the soma.

CL:4023095.name: untufted pyramidal neuron
CL:4023095.def: A pyramidal neuron which lacks a clear tuft formation but extends to large radial distances.

CL:4023097.name: arachnoid barrier cell
CL:4023097.def: A mesothelial fibroblast of the arachnoid barrier layer. Arachnoid barrier cells make up the tight-junctioned layer in the leptomeninx that functions as the physiologic barrier between the cerebrospinal fluid in the subarachnoid space and the fenestrated capillaries in the dura.

CL:4023098.name: obsolete L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Homo sapiens)
CL:4023098.def: OBSOLETE An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 2/3 of the human primary motor cortex.

CL:4023099.name: obsolete L5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Homo sapiens)
CL:4023099.def: OBSOLETE. An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5 of the human primary motor cortex.

CL:4023100.name: obsolete L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Homo sapiens)
CL:4023100.def: OBSOLETE. An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 6 of the human primary motor cortex.

CL:4023101.name: obsolete L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Homo sapiens)
CL:4023101.def: OBSOLETE. A near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5/6 of the human primary motor cortex.

CL:4023102.name: obsolete L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023102.def: OBSOLETE. A near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5/6 of the marmoset primary motor cortex.

CL:4023103.name: obsolete L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023103.def: OBSOLETE. An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 2/3 of the marmoset primary motor cortex.

CL:4023104.name: obsolete L5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023104.def: OBSOLETE An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 5 of the marmoset primary motor cortex.

CL:4023105.name: obsolete L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the primary motor cortex (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023105.def: OBSOLETE. An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in layer 6 of the marmoset primary motor cortex.

CL:4023106.name: obsolete meis2 expressing cortical GABAergic cell (Callithrix jacchus)
CL:4023106.def: OBSOLETE. A mouse GABAergic cell located in the marmoset cerebral cortex that expresses meis2.

CL:4023107.name: reticulospinal neuron
CL:4023107.def: A neuron with soma location in the reticular formation with axons that extend into the spinal cord such. Reticulospinal neuron activity can lead to a variety of motor behaviors.

CL:4023108.name: oxytocin-secreting magnocellular cell
CL:4023108.def: A magnocellular neurosecretory cell that is capable of producing and secreting oxytocin.

CL:4023109.name: vasopressin-secreting magnocellular cell
CL:4023109.def: A magnocellular neurosecretory cell that is capable of producing and secreting vasopressin.

CL:4023110.name: amygdala pyramidal neuron
CL:4023110.def: A pyramidal neuron with soma located in the amygdala.

CL:4023111.name: cerebral cortex pyramidal neuron
CL:4023111.def: A pyramidal neuron with soma located in the cerebral cortex.

CL:4023112.name: vestibular afferent neuron
CL:4023112.def: An afferent neuron of the vestibular system that innervate the base of the hair cell and increase or decrease their neural firing rate as the receptor cell is excited or inhibited.

CL:4023113.name: bouton vestibular afferent neuron
CL:4023113.def: A vestibular afferent neuron that makes bouton synapses to type II hair cells.

CL:4023114.name: calyx vestibular afferent neuron
CL:4023114.def: A vestibular afferent neuron which posseses a unique postsynaptic terminal, the calyx, which completely covers the basolateral walls of type I hair cells and receives input from multiple ribbon synapses.

CL:4023115.name: type 1 spiral ganglion neuron
CL:4023115.def: A spiral ganglion neuron that innervates inner hair cells. Type 1 spiral ganglion neurons are myelinated and bipolar.

CL:4023116.name: type 2 spiral ganglion neuron
CL:4023116.def: A spiral ganglion neuron that innervates outer hair cells. Type 1 spiral ganglion neurons are unmyelinated and unipolar.

CL:4023118.name: L5/6 non-Martinotti sst GABAergic interneuron (Mmus)
CL:4023118.def: A sst GABAergic interneuron does not have Martinotti morphology with a soma found in L5/6 of the cerebral cortex.
synonym: L5/6 non-Martinotti morphology sst expressing GABAergic cortical interneuron (Mus musculus)

CL:4023119.name: displaced amacrine cell
CL:4023119.def: A subpopulation of amacrine cell that migrate further than other amacrine cells, and come to lie basal to the inner plexiform layer (IPL) in the ganglion cell layer. Displaced amacrine cells still have their neurites extending apically into the IPL, and therefore exhibit an inverted polarity with respect to the other amacrine cells.

CL:4023120.name: cochlea auditory hair cell
CL:4023120.def: An auditory hair cell found in the cochlea.

CL:4023121.name: sst chodl GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023121.def: A transcriptomically distinct sst GABAergic cortical interneuron that also expresses Chodl. These neurons are rare and correspond to the only known cortical interneurons with long-range projection. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: MGE-derived interneurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters Sst Chodl.

CL:4023122.name: oxytocin receptor sst GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4023122.def: An interneuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses the oxytocin receptor. These interneurons also express somatostatin.

CL:4023123.name: hypothalamus kisspeptin neuron
CL:4023123.def: A kisspeptin neuron that is located in the hypothalamus. These neurons project to and activate gonadotrophin-releasing hormone neurons (acting via the kisspeptin receptor) in the hypothalamus and stimulate the secretion of gonadotrophin-releasing hormone.

CL:4023124.name: dentate gyrus kisspeptin neuron
CL:4023124.def: A kisspeptin neuron that is located in the dentate gyrus of the hippocampus.

CL:4023125.name: KNDy neuron
CL:4023125.def: A hypothalamus kisspeptin neuron that coexpresses kisspeptin, neurokinin B and dynorphin.
CL:4023125.synonym: kisspeptin, neurokinin B and dynorphin expressing neuron

CL:4023127.name: arcuate nucleus of hypothalamus KNDy neuron
CL:4023127.def: a KNDy neuron that is located in the arcuate nucleus of the hypothalamus.

CL:4023128.name: rostral periventricular region of the third ventricle KNDy neuron
CL:4023128.def: a KNDy neuron that is located in the rostral periventricular region of the third ventricle.

CL:4023129.name: retinoblast
CL:4023129.def: A retinal cell that is immature or undifferentiated.

CL:4023130.name: kisspeptin neuron
CL:4023130.def: A neuron that expresses kisspeptin. These neurons are predominantly located in the hypothalamus, but also found in other parts of the brain including the hippocampal dentate gyrus.

CL:4023154.name: myelinating glial cell
CL:4023154.def: A glial cell that myelinates axonal processes.

CL:4023158.name: octopus cell of the mammalian cochlear nucleus
CL:4023158.def: A neuron in the posterior ventral cochlear nucleus that is distinguished by their long, thick and tentacle-shaped dendrites that typically emanate from one side of the cell body.

CL:4023159.name: double bouquet cell
CL:4023159.def: An interneuron that has double bouquet morphology.

CL:4023160.name: cartwheel cell
CL:4023160.def: A neuron of the dorsal cochlear nucleus with spiny dendrites that receive input from the axons of granule cells and with axons that release GABA and glycine onto cartwheel, pyramidal and giant cell targets.

CL:4023161.name: unipolar brush cell
CL:4023161.def: An excitatory glutamatergic interneuron found in the granular layer of the cerebellar cortex and also in the granule cell domain of the cochlear nucleus. Unipolar brush cells have a round or oval cell body with usually a single short dendrite that ends in a brush-like tuft of short dendrites unique to them known as dendrioles.

CL:4023162.name: bushy cell
CL:4023162.def: A neuron found in the anterior part of the ventral cochlear nucleus that has the appearance of bushes, having short dendrites. Bushy cells give outputs to different parts of the superior olivary complex.

CL:4023163.name: spherical bushy cell
CL:4023163.def: A bushy cell that receives only few large excitatory endbulb synapses from auditory nerves. Spherical bush cells give excitatory input to the lateral and medial parts of the superior olive.

CL:4023164.name: globular bushy cell
CL:4023164.def: A bushy cell that receives a large number of medium-sized synapses, called modified endbulbs. Globular bushy cells extend to the superior olive on both sides of the brainstem where they give input to the bipolar neurons.

CL:4023168.name: somatosensory neuron
CL:4023168.def: A neuron that is part of the somatic sensory system. Somatosensory neurons innervate the skin or integument to detect different types of thermal, chemical, and mechanical touch stimuli.

CL:4023169.name: trigeminal neuron
CL:4023169.def: A neuron that is responsible for sensation in the face or motor functions such as biting and chewing. Trigeminal neurons extend a single axon shaft along the lateral white matter of the hindbrain and spinal cord. The highly branched axons innervate the integument of the head.

CL:4023170.name: trigeminal sensory neuron
CL:4023170.def: A trigeminal neuron that is responsible for sensation in the face.

CL:4023171.name: trigeminal motor neuron
CL:4023171.def: A trigeminal neuron that is responsible for motor functions such as biting and chewing.

CL:4023181.name: hypendymal cell
CL:4023181.def: A neurecto-epithelial cell that is part of the basal layer of the subcommissural organ and specializes in the secretion of proteins into the subarachnoid space. Hypendymal cells have similar characteristics to ependymal cells and express SCO-spondin.

CL:4023187.name: koniocellular cell
CL:4023187.def: A neuron with a small cell body that is located in a koniocellular layer of the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN).

CL:4023188.name: midget ganglion cell of retina
CL:4023188.def: A retinal ganglion cell that originate in the ganglion cell layer of the retina, and project to the parvocellular layers of the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN). These cells are known as midget retinal ganglion cells due to the small sizes of their dendritic trees and cell bodies.

CL:4023189.name: parasol ganglion cell of retina
CL:4023189.def: A retinal ganglion cell located in the ganglion cell layer of the retina. This cell projects to magnocellular cells in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN). They have large cell bodies and extensive, branching dendritic networks that contribute to their large receptive fields.

CL:4028001.name: pulmonary capillary endothelial cell
CL:4028001.def: Any capillary endothelial cell that is part of a lung.

CL:4028002.name: alveolar capillary type 1 endothelial cell
CL:4028002.def: An alveolar capillary endothelial cell that is located distally to alveolar capillary type 2 endothelial cells.

CL:4028003.name: alveolar capillary type 2 endothelial cell
CL:4028003.def: An alveolar capillary endothelial cell that is located proximally to alveolar capillary type 1 endothelial cells and in close apposition to alveolar type 1 epithelial cells (also known as type I pneumocytes).

CL:4028004.name: alveolar type 1 fibroblast cell
CL:4028004.def: A pulmonary interstitial fibroblast that is part of the alveolus and contains lipid droplets.

CL:4028006.name: alveolar adventitial fibroblast
CL:4028006.def: A pulmonary interstitial fibroblast that is part of the alveolus and localizes to vascular adventitia.

CL:4029001.name: gamete-nursing cell
CL:4029001.def: A cell that supports the development of a gamete by providing it cytoplasmic material (including entire organelles) by direct cross-membrane channels (del Pino, 2021).

CL:4029002.name: germline-derived nurse cell
CL:4029002.def: A gamete-nursing cell that derives from a germline cell (del Pino, 2021).

CL:4029003.name: somatic nurse-like cell
CL:4029003.def: A gamete-nursing cell that derives from the somatic tissues of the gonad (del Pino, 2021).

CL:4030000.name: choroidal melanocyte
CL:4030000.def: A melanocyte located in the vascular uvea and involved in photoprotection, regulation of oxidative damage and immune responses.

CL:4030001.name: stromal cell of thymus
CL:4030001.def: A stromal cell that is part of the thymus.

CL:4030002.name: effector memory CD45RA-positive, alpha-beta T cell, terminally differentiated
CL:4030002.def: An alpha-beta memory T cell with the phenotype CD45RA-positive.
synonym: terminally differentiated effector memory CD45RA+ T cells
terminally differentiated effector memory cells re-expressing CD45RA

CL:4030003.name: interstitial cell of thymus
CL:4030003.def: A cell that makes up the loose connective tissue of the thymus.

CL:4030004.name: thymic nurse cell
CL:4030004.def: A large epithelial cell found in the thymus. This cell type may internalize thymocytes through extensions of plasma membrane. The cell surface and cytoplasmic vacuoles of a thymic nurse cell express MHC Class I and MHC Class II antigens. The interaction of these antigens with a developing thymocyte determines whether the thymocyte undergoes positive or negative selection.

CL:4030005.name: kidney collecting duct beta-intercalated cell
CL:4030005.def: A renal beta-intercalated cell that is part of the cortical collecting duct. The medullary collecting duct does not contain the renal beta-intercalated cell type.
synonym: kidney collecting duct intercalated cell type B

CL:4030006.name: fallopian tube secretory epithelial cell
CL:4030006.def: An epithelial cell that is part of the fallopian tube that secretes mucus and oviduct-specific products in response to hormonal stimulation from estrogen and luteinizing hormone. This fallopian tube secretory cell is similar in height to the ciliated cell, but typically exhibits a more narrow, columnar shape. Its nucleus is ovoid and oriented perpendicular to the cell's long axis, with denser chromatin and a smaller nucleolus compared to the ciliated cell.

CL:4030007.name: fallopian tube multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:4030007.def: A multi-ciliated epithelial cell that is part of the fallopian tube, mainly found on the apex of the mucosal folds. This cell exhibits a columnar shape with an oval nucleus and is characterized by the presence of cilia on its surface. The coordinated beating of these cilia, together with peristaltic contractions, contributes to the self-propulsion of spermatozoa, the transport of ovum during ovulation and the transport of the fertilized ovum to the intramural fallopian tube.

CL:4030008.name: pronephric podocyte
CL:4030008.def: A specialized epithelial cell that contains foot processes that interdigitate with the foot processes of other glomerular epithelial cells in the pronephros.

CL:4030009.name: epithelial cell of proximal tubule segment 1
CL:4030009.def: A brush border cell that is part of segment 1 (S1) of the proximal tubule epithelium, located in the renal cortex.
CL:4030009.synonym: epithelial cell of segment 1 of proximal tubule

CL:4030010.name: epithelial cell of proximal tubule segment 2
CL:4030010.def: A brush border cell that is part of segment 2 (S2) of the proximal tubule epithelium, located in the renal cortex. In addition to its reabsorptive functions, it is also specialized in the secretion of organic anions and cations, including para-aminohippurate.
CL:4030010.synonym: epithelial cell of segment 2 of proximal tubule

CL:4030011.name: epithelial cell of proximal tubule segment 3
CL:4030011.def: A brush border cell that is part of segment 3 (S3) of the proximal tubule epithelium, which extends from the medullary rays of the renal cortex into the outer medulla.
CL:4030011.synonym: epithelial cell of segment 3 of proximal tubule

CL:4030012.name: kidney loop of Henle short descending thin limb epithelial cell
CL:4030012.def: Epithelial cell of the descending thin limb of the short loop (cortical) nephron limited to the outer medulla (mainly inner strip). It is known in some mammalian species that the short descending limb of the loop of Henle selectively expresses the serine protease Corin, the homeobox TF Uncx, and the urea channel Slc14a2.
CL:4030012.synonym: epithelial cell of the descending thin limb of the short loop of Henle

CL:4030013.name: kidney loop of Henle long descending thin limb outer medulla epithelial cell
CL:4030013.def: Epithelial cell of the descending thin limb of the long loop (juxtamedullary) nephron that spans the outer medulla (inner stripe). It is known in some mammalian species that the long descending limb of the loop of Henle in the outer medulla selectively expresses the secreted activin-antagonist protein follistatin (Fst), the GPI-linked adhesion protein Cdh13, and the protein kinase Stk32a.
CL:4030013.synonym: epithelial cell of the outer medulla of the long descending limb of the loop of Henle

CL:4030014.name: kidney loop of Henle long descending thin limb inner medulla epithelial cell
CL:4030014.def: Epithelial cell of the descending thin limb of the long loop (juxtamedullary) nephron that spans the inner medulla. It is known in some mammalian species that the long descending limb of the loop of Henle in the inner medulla selectively expresses the nuclear receptor Nr2e3, the Ig kappa chain Igkc, and the secreted protein dermokine (Dmkn). SLC14A2, which expresses a urea transporter, is also expressed in the inner medulla.
CL:4030014.synonym: epithelial cell of the inner medulla of the long descending limb of the loop of Henle

CL:4030015.name: kidney collecting duct alpha-intercalated cell
CL:4030015.def: A renal alpha-intercalated cell that is part of the collecting duct of the renal tubule.
CL:4030015.synonym: kidney collecting duct intercalated cell type A

CL:4030016.name: epithelial cell of early distal convoluted tubule
CL:4030016.def: An epithelial cell located in the early distal convoluted tubule.

CL:4030017.name: epithelial cell of late distal convoluted tubule
CL:4030017.def: An epithelial cell located in the late distal convoluted tubule.

CL:4030018.name: kidney connecting tubule principal cell
CL:4030018.def: A renal principal cell located in the connecting tubule.

CL:4030019.name: kidney connecting tubule intercalated cell
CL:4030019.def: A renal intercalated cell that is part of the renal connecting tubule.

CL:4030020.name: kidney connecting tubule alpha-intercalated cell
CL:4030020.def: A renal alpha-intercalated cell that is part of the renal connecting tubule.
synonym: kidney connecting tubule intercalated cell type A

CL:4030021.name: kidney connecting tubule beta-intercalated cell
CL:4030021.def: A renal beta-intercalated cell that is part of the renal connecting tubule.
synonym: kidney connecting tubule intercalated cell type B

CL:4030022.name: renal medullary fibroblast
CL:4030022.def: A fibroblast that is located in the renal medulla interstitium.

CL:4030023.name: respiratory tract hillock cell
CL:4030023.def: A hillock cell that is located in respiratory epithelium. In some mammalian species, this cell type has been noted to express KRT13 and KRT4 and is postulated to play a role in squamous barrier function and immunomodulation.

CL:4030024.name: hillock cell
CL:4030024.def: An epithelial, transitional cell type between basal and secretory; located in stratified, non-ciliated structures (called hillocks) with high cell turnover in epithelium. In some mammalian species, this cell type has been noted to express KRT13 and is postulated to play a role in squamous barrier function and immunomodulation.

CL:4030025.name: renal cortical fibroblast
CL:4030025.def: A fibroblast that is located in the renal cortical interstitium.

CL:4030026.name: BEST4+ enterocyte
CL:4030026.def: An enterocyte of the human intestine expressing bestrophin-4 (BEST4) calcium-activated ion channels.

CL:4030027.name: GABAergic amacrine cell
CL:4030027.def: An amacrine cell that uses GABA as a neurotransmitter.

CL:4030028.name: glycinergic amacrine cell
CL:4030028.def: An amacrine cell that uses glycine as a neurotransmitter.

CL:4030030.name: peripheral blood lymphocyte
CL:4030030.def: A blood lymphocyte located in the flowing, circulating blood of the body.

CL:4030031.name: interstitial cell
CL:4030031.def: Any cell that is located within the interstitium between the cells most prominent in defining a given tissue. Interstitial cell is a morphological term and refers to a variety of cells with differing origins and phenotypes.

CL:4030032.name: valve interstitial cell
CL:4030032.def: An interstitial cell that is part of a cardiac valve leaflet. Along with valve endothelial cells, a valve interstitial cell maintains tissue homeostasis for the function of cardiac valves through secreting biochemical signals, matrix proteins and matrix remodeling enzymes.

CL:4030033.name: valve endothelial cell
CL:4030033.def: An endothelial cell that lines a surface of a cardiac valve leaflet. Along with valve interstitial cells, a valve endothelial cell maintains tissue homeostasis for the function of cardiac valves through secreting biochemical signals, matrix proteins and matrix remodeling enzymes.

CL:4030034.name: respiratory tract multiciliated cell
CL:4030034.def: A multiciliated epithelial cell located in the respiratory tract epithelium, characterized by a columnar shape and motile cilia on its apical surface. This cell develops through a highly orchestrated process, transitioning from a basal progenitor via an intermediate deuterosomal cell stage that generates centrioles essential for ciliogenesis.
synonym: ciliated cell of the respiratory tract

CL:4030035.name: dental pulp stem cell
CL:4030035.def: A dental pulp cell that possesses stem-cell-like qualities, including self-renewal capability and multi-lineage differentiation.

CL:4030036.name: early spermatid
CL:4030036.def: A spermatid in an early stage of maturation that has a round morphology and is transcriptionally active.

CL:4030037.name: late spermatid
CL:4030037.def: A spermatid in a late stage of maturation that has an elongated morphology and is transcriptionally inert when the acrosome is fully developed.

CL:4030038.name: CD24-positive, CD-133-positive, vimentin-positive proximal tubular cell
CL:4030038.def: A CD24-positive, CD-133-positive, vimentin-positive cell found scattered throughout a renal proximal tubule and that may participate in tubular regeneration. Compared to other proximal tubular cell types, this cell contains less cytoplasm, fewer mitochondria and no brush border.

CL:4030039.name: von Economo neuron
CL:4030039.def: An extratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron that is morphologically-defined with a large, spindle-shaped cell body, thick bipolar dendrites with limited branching and a moderate density of spines, and often an axon initial segment that emanates from the side of the cell body. This cell type is associated with markers POU3F, BMP3 and ITGA4.

CL:4030040.name: endometrial multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:4030040.def: A multi-ciliated cell of the endometrial epithelium. This cell is characterized by the presence of 9+2 motile cilia on its apical surface, which facilitates the movement of mucus across the endometrial surface.

CL:4030041.name: luminal endometrial multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:4030041.def: A ciliated cell of the endometrial luminal epithelium. This cell is characterized by the presence of motile cilia on its apical surface.

CL:4030042.name: glandular endometrial multiciliated epithelial cell
CL:4030042.def: A ciliated cell of the endometrial glandular epithelium. This cell is characterized by the presence of motile cilia on its apical surface.

CL:4030043.name: matrix D1 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030043.def: A DRD1-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a matrix compartment of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030047.name: matrix D2 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030047.def: A DRD2-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a matrix compartment of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030048.name: striosomal D1 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030048.def: A DRD1-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a striosome of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030049.name: striosomal D2 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030049.def: A DRD2-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a striosome of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030050.name: D1/D2-hybrid medium spiny neuron
CL:4030050.def: A medium spiny neuron that expresses both DRD1 and DRD2 and is part of an extra-striosomal part of dorsal striatum.

CL:4030051.name: nucleus accumbens shell and olfactory tubercle D1 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030051.def: A DRD1-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a nucleus accumbens shell or olfactory tubercle.
synonym: NAc shell and OT D1 medium spiny neuron

CL:4030052.name: nucleus accumbens shell and olfactory tubercle D2 medium spiny neuron
CL:4030052.def: A DRD2-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of a nucleus accumbens shell or olfactory tubercle.
synonym: NAc shell and OT D2 medium spiny neuron
nucleus accumbens shell and olfactory tubercle D2-MSN

CL:4030053.name: Island of Calleja granule cell
CL:4030053.def: A DRD1-expressing, medium spiny neuron-like granule cell that is part of an Island of Calleja.

CL:4030054.name: RXFP1-positive interface island D1-medium spiny neuron
CL:4030054.def: A DRD1-expressing medium spiny neuron that is part of dense, RXFP1-positive cell islands throughout the nucleus accumbens, putamen, and near the adjacent septal nuclei.

CL:4030055.name: intermediate cell of urothelium
CL:4030055.def: A urothelial cell that is part of the regenerative layer(s) of cells directly superficial to basal cells in urothelium. The layer of intermediate cells in the urothelium ranges from one to several layers thick depending on the species with intermediate cells attached to adjacent cell layers and one another via desmosomes.

CL:4030056.name: umbrella cell of urothelium
CL:4030056.def: A urothelial cell that is terminally differentiated and part of the urothelial apical surface that forms the high-resistance barrier of urothelium. Umbrella cells have been described as the largest of urothelial cell types, highly polarized, and, in some species, multinucleated. In the relaxed state, these cells form a dome-shaped structure at the apical pole and can also cover multiple underlying intermediate cells, leading to the name umbrella cells. In contrast, these cells flatten when the bladder is filled.

CL:4030057.name: eccentric medium spiny neuron
CL:4030057.def: A medium spiny neuron that exhibits transcriptional divergence from direct and indirect spiny projection neurons, for example, enrichment in Casz1, Otof, Cacng5 and Pcdh8 noted in mice. Whilst in general medium spiny neurons have been found to be differentially distributed across the basal ganglia, the eccentric medium spiny neuron cell type has been found to be more evenly distributed throughout cerebral nuclei.

CL:4030058.name: TCR-positive macrophage
CL:4030058.def: A macrophage that expresses the T cell receptor complex at the cell surface.

CL:4030059.name: L2/3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030059.def: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found between cortical layer 2-4. This intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron has thin-tufted apical dendrites and extends its axonal projection into L5 in the neocortex. This neuronal type has a hyperpolarised resting membrane potential. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', clusters L2/3 IT.

CL:4030060.name: L2 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030060.def: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 2.

CL:4030061.name: L3 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030061.def: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 3.

CL:4030062.name: L4/5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030062.def: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic with a soma located in cortical layer 4/5.

CL:4030063.name: L4 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030063.def: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 3-4. This neuron type can have a pyramidal, star-pyramidal or spiny stellate morphology and projects its output to L2/3 and L5A/B. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', L4 IT.

CL:4030064.name: L5 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030064.def: An intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 5. The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', L5 IT.

CL:4030065.name: L6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030065.def: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in L6 of the primary motor cortex. These cells are short untufted pyramidal cells, which could be stellate or inverted.  The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_subclass', L6 IT.

CL:4030066.name: ureteric bud cell
CL:4030066.def: An epithelial cell that is part of a ureteric bud. A ureteric bud cell has the potential to induce metanephric mesenchymal cells to proliferate and convert to epithelia that form renal tubules via: (1) the secretion of multiple diffusible growth factors that rescue renal progenitors from apoptosis and stimulate them to proliferate and (2) contact-dependent mechanisms that induce mesenchymal-epithelial conversion.

CL:4030067.name: L5/6 near-projecting glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030067.def: A near-projecting glutamatergic neuron with a soma found in cortical layer 5/6.

CL:4030068.name: L6 intratelencephalic projecting Car3 glutamatergic neuron
CL:4030068.def: A transcriptomically distinct intratelencepalic-projecting glutamatergic neuron that expresses Car3 with a soma found in L6 . The standard transcriptomic reference data for this cell type can be found on the CellxGene census under the collection: 'Transcriptomic cytoarchitecture reveals principles of human neocortex organization', dataset: 'Supercluster: IT-projecting excitatory neurons', Author Categories: 'CrossArea_cluster', L6 IT Car3.

CL:4032000.name: club-like cell of the urethral epithelium
CL:4032000.def: An epithelial cell of the urethra that has an expression profile similar to lung club cells. Club-like cells of the urethra epithelium are similar to lung club cells in their expression of SCGB1A1 and in their enrichment of immunomodulatory programs.
synonym: club cell of the urethra epithelium
club-like cell of the prostatic urethra epithelium

CL:4032001.name: reelin GABAergic cortical interneuron
CL:4032001.def: A GABAergic interneuron located in the cerebral cortex that expresses reelin (rln).

CL:4033000.name: endothelial cell of venule of lymph node
CL:4033000.def: A(n) endothelial cell that is part of a(n) venule of lymph node.

CL:4033001.name: endothelial cell of arteriole of lymph node
CL:4033001.def: A(n) endothelial cell that is part of a(n) arteriole of lymph node.

CL:4033002.name: neuroendocrine cell of epithelium of crypt of Lieberkuhn
CL:4033002.def: A(n) neuroendocrine cell that is part of a(n) epithelium of crypt of Lieberkuhn.

CL:4033003.name: myoepithelial cell of bronchus submucosal gland
CL:4033003.def: A(n) myoepithelial cell that is part of a(n) bronchus submucosal gland.

CL:4033004.name: smooth muscle cell of taenia coli
CL:4033004.def: A(n) smooth muscle cell that is part of a(n) taenia coli.

CL:4033005.name: serous secreting cell of bronchus submucosal gland
CL:4033005.def: A(n) serous secreting cell that is part of a(n) bronchus submucosal gland.

CL:4033006.name: endothelial cell of efferent lymphatic vessel
CL:4033006.def: A(n) endothelial cell that is part of a(n) efferent lymphatic vessel.

CL:4033007.name: brush cell of epithelium of lobar bronchus
CL:4033007.def: A(n) brush cell that is part of a(n) epithelium of lobar bronchus.

CL:4033008.name: vein endothelial cell of respiratory system
CL:4033008.def: A(n) vein endothelial cell that is part of a(n) respiratory system.

CL:4033009.name: goblet cell of epithelium of lobar bronchus
CL:4033009.def: A(n) goblet cell that is part of a(n) epithelium of lobar bronchus.

CL:4033010.name: neuroendocrine cell of epithelium of lobar bronchus
CL:4033010.def: A(n) neuroendocrine cell that is part of a(n) epithelium of lobar bronchus.

CL:4033011.name: smooth muscle cell of large intestine smooth muscle circular layer
CL:4033011.def: A(n) smooth muscle cell that is part of a(n) large intestine smooth muscle circular layer.

CL:4033012.name: smooth muscle cell of large intestine smooth muscle longitudinal layer
CL:4033012.def: A(n) smooth muscle cell that is part of a(n) large intestine smooth muscle longitudinal layer.

CL:4033013.name: suprabasal keratinocyte
CL:4033013.def: A keratinocyte of the epidermis suprabasal layer. This cell may express the differentiation markers keratin 10 and keratin 1.

CL:4033014.name: peg cell
CL:4033014.def: A small, narrow, peg-shaped epithelial cell with little cytoplasm that is part of oviduct epithelium. This cell is rarer than the ciliated and secretory epithelial cells of the fallopian tube epithelium and is often found intercalated between them. Peg cells are generally distributed basally along the epithelium and have been found in high concentrations at the fimbriated, distal end of the fallopian tube in humans. It may have a regenerative/stem-cell function. In humans, markers include EPCAM, CD44, and ITGA6.

CL:4033015.name: retinal astrocyte
CL:4033015.def: A star-shaped glial cell that is part of some retina. This cell links neurons to blood vessels and may provide structural and physiological support to optic nerve head axons.

CL:4033016.name: secondary crest myofibroblast
CL:4033016.def: A myofibroblast that is part of an alveoli during alveolarization. The contractile force of this cell elongates the secondary crest, while producing a framework of elastin and tenascin. During the maturation of the septa, secondary crest myofibroblasts, together with matrix fibroblasts, secrete metalloproteinases and other ECM‐remodeling proteins to thin the septal tip ECM. The secondary crest myofibroblast continues producing elastin, eventually undergoing apoptosis during adulthood.
