PATO:0001993.def: A cellularity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of more than one cell.

PATO:0001995.name: organismal quality
PATO:0001995.def: A quality that inheres in an entire organism or part of an organism.

PATO:0002005.name: concavity
PATO:0002005.def: Surface shape that refers to the inward or outward curvature of the surface.

PATO:0002006.name: 2-D shape
PATO:0002006.def: A shape that inheres in a 2 dimensional entity, such as a cross section or projection of a 3 dimensional entity.

PATO:0002007.name: convex 3-D shape
PATO:0002007.def: A complete three dimensional shape in which for every line connecting pair of points on the object is within the object. Or: a shape lacking cavities. Contrast: concave.

PATO:0002008.name: concave 3-D shape
PATO:0002008.def: A complete three dimensional shape in which there is a line connecting pair of points on the object that lies outside the object. Or: a shape with cavities. Contrast: concave.

PATO:0002009.name: branchiness
PATO:0002009.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the degree to which there are subdivisions or offshoots in a bearer entity.

PATO:0002011.name: neoplastic
PATO:0002011.def: A structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter's disposition the presence of abnormally proliferating masses of cells.

PATO:0002014.name: structure, cavities
PATO:0002014.def: A structural quality that inheres in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing hollow areas.

PATO:0002039.name: biconcave
PATO:0002039.def: A concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's curving inward on both sides or surfaces.

PATO:0002045.name: dendritic
PATO:0002045.def: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having smaller branches arising from larger branches. Resembling a tree in branching structure.

PATO:0002051.name: increased occurrence
PATO:0002051.def: An occurrence which is relatively high.

PATO:0002052.name: decreased occurrence
PATO:0002052.def: An occurrence which is relatively low.

PATO:0002064.name: fenestrated
PATO:0002064.def: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's delimited by a surface with holes.

PATO:0002078.name: hollow
PATO:0002078.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an empty space or cavity within.

PATO:0002094.name: basophilic
PATO:0002094.def: An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction for basic dyes under specific pH conditions.

PATO:0002097.name: neoplastic, malignant
PATO:0002097.def: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to progress, invade surrounding tissues or metastasize.

PATO:0002124.name: laminar
PATO:0002124.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's processing the form of a thin plate sheet or layer.

PATO:0002198.name: quality of a substance
PATO:0002198.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its constitution.

PATO:0002226.name: subcylindrical
PATO:0002226.def: A cylindrical shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being imperfectly cylindrical or approximately cylindrical.

PATO:0002254.name: flattened
PATO:0002254.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's surface becoming more extended in a plane.

PATO:0002255.name: grooved
PATO:0002255.def: Texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked with one or more channels.

PATO:0002266.name: 3-D shape
PATO:0002266.def: A shape that inheres in a 3 dimensional entity.

PATO:0002287.name: increased elasticity
PATO:0002287.def: An elasticity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002288.name: decreased elasticity
PATO:0002288.def: An elasticity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002299.name: tubular
PATO:0002299.def: A cylindrical shape that is hollow.

PATO:0002300.name: increased quality
PATO:0002300.def: A quality that has a value that is increased compared to normal or average.

PATO:0002301.name: decreased quality
PATO:0002301.def: A quality that has a value that is decreased compared to normal or average.

PATO:0002302.name: decreased process quality
PATO:0002302.def: A quality of a process that has a value that is decreased compared to normal or average.

PATO:0002303.name: decreased object quality
PATO:0002303.def: A quality of an object that has a value that is decreased compared to normal or average.

PATO:0002304.name: increased process quality
PATO:0002304.def: A quality of a process that has a value that is increased compared to normal or average.

PATO:0002305.name: increased object quality
PATO:0002305.def: A quality of an object that has a value that is increased compared to normal or average.

PATO:0002309.name: fiber shaped
PATO:0002309.def: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a consistently sized and approximately round cross-section along its length, which is many times larger than its diameter.

PATO:0002317.name: parallelogram
PATO:0002317.def: A convex quadrilateral is a parallelogram if and only if any one of the following statements are true: 1. Each diagonal divides the quadrilateral into two congruent triangles with the same orientation. 2. The opposite sides are congruent in pairs. 3. The diagonals bisect each other. 4. The opposite angles are congruent in pairs. 5. The sum of the squares of the sides equals the sum of the squares of the diagonals. (This is the parallelogram law) 6.It possesses rotational symmetry. 7.One pair of opposite sides are parallel and congruent. 8.Two pairs of adjacent angles are supplementary.

PATO:0002318.name: superelliptic
PATO:0002318.def: A shape constituting a transition between a rectangle and a circle; a closed curve, of which the circle and ellipse are special cases, whose parametric equation is x = a.cos2/rt, y = b.cos2/rt

PATO:0002323.name: temporal distribution quality
PATO:0002323.def: A temporal distribution pattern of process occurrences within a regulation/reference process.

PATO:0002353.name: activation quality
PATO:0002353.def: A quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its realizing one of its functions.

PATO:0002354.name: active
PATO:0002354.def: A quality of an physical object that is currently realizing one of its functions.

PATO:0002418.name: acidophilic
PATO:0002418.def: An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction for acidic dyes under specific pH conditions.

PATO:0002420.name: amphiphilic
PATO:0002420.def: Having both hydrophilic and hydrophobic (or lipophilic) groups.

PATO:0002422.name: acinar
PATO:0002422.def: Pertaining to the individual parts making up an aggregate fruit like a many-lobed \

PATO:0002444.name: mineralized
PATO:0002444.def: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being composed of or possessing inorganic material.

PATO:0002462.name: collagenous
PATO:0002462.def: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of collagen.

PATO:0002468.name: distensible
PATO:0002468.def: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of swelling or stretching.

PATO:0002478.name: transversely striated
PATO:0002478.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines or grooves, usually parallel, that are oriented transversely relative to the long axis of the bearer.

PATO:0002479.name: obliquely striated
PATO:0002479.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines or grooves, usually parallel, that are oriented obliquely relative to the long axis of the bearer.

PATO:0002505.name: nucleated
PATO:0002505.def: A nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one or more nucleus.

PATO:0002506.name: alobate
PATO:0002506.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not having undulating edges forming lobes.

PATO:0002507.name: keratinous
PATO:0002507.def: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of keratin.

PATO:0010001.name: disconnected
PATO:0010001.def: A structural quality inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer consisting of multiple structures lacking any physical connection to each other.

PATO:0010006.name: cell morphology
PATO:0010006.def: A quality of a single cell inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's size or shape or structure.

PATO:0010007.name: multiciliated
PATO:0010007.def: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having multiple cilia.

PATO:0015006.name: polymeric
PATO:0015006.def: A quality inhering in a structure by virtue of it consisting of many of repeated, similar or identical subunits, arranged in some orderly array.

PATO:0015008.name: distensibility
PATO:0015008.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the extent to which the bearer is capable of being stretched or swollen.

PATO:0040072.name: high nuclear/cytoplasmic ratio
PATO:0040072.def: A quality inhering in a cell by virtue of the cell having a high nuclear/cytoplasmic ratio.

PATO:0045001.name: normal object quality
PATO:0045001.def: A quality of an object that has a value that is normal or average.

PATO:0045009.name: normal coiling
PATO:0045009.def: A coiling which is normal or average.

PATO:0045011.name: normal contractility
PATO:0045011.def: A contractility which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045016.name: normal elasticity
PATO:0045016.def: An elasticity which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045021.name: normal flexibility
PATO:0045021.def: A flexibility which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045026.name: normal life span
PATO:0045026.def: A life span which is relatively normal or average.

PATO:0045050.name: normal size
PATO:0045050.def: A size quality which is relatively normal or average

PATO:0045073.name: normal process quality
PATO:0045073.def: A quality of a process that has a value that is normal or average.

PATO:0045081.name: normal viscosity
PATO:0045081.def: A viscosity which is relatively normal or average

PATO:0045086.name: normal occurrence
PATO:0045086.def: An occurrence which is relatively normal.

PATO:0070001.name: neurogliaform morphology
PATO:0070001.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have a small round soma, a large number of short, smooth, or slightly beaded primary dendrites that give rise to only a few secondary branches, and a branched axon that establishes a dense axonal mesh with thin shafts.

PATO:0070002.name: basket cell morphology
PATO:0070002.def: A cell morphology that inheres in multipolar neurons with densely branched terminal axonal arborizations that form basket-like structures surrounding and synapsing to the somas of target cells.

PATO:0070003.name: small basket cell morphology
PATO:0070003.def: A basket cell morphology that inheres in neurons with axonal arbors composed of frequent, short, curvy axonal branches that tend to be near their somata and within the same layer.

PATO:0070004.name: large basket cell morphology
PATO:0070004.def: A basket cell morphology that inheres in neurons that are large, and typically ascend to give rise to many long horizontally and vertically projecting axon collaterals that traverse neighboring columns and can extend through all cortical layers.

PATO:0070005.name: nest basket cell morphology
PATO:0070005.def: A basket cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have simpler dendritic arbors (compared to small or large basket cell morphology), and an axonal plexus of intermediate density, composed of a few long, smooth axonal branches.

PATO:0070006.name: cortical bipolar morphology
PATO:0070006.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have two principal dendrites that emerge from the soma and begin to branch some distance from it, have few spines, and branch in narrow fields. This is in contrast to bitufted morphology where branching occurs close to the soma.

PATO:0070007.name: Martinotti morphology
PATO:0070007.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which are large and non-spiny, with dendrites radiating in a multipolar or bitufted pattern, often favouring the descending side, and axons that ascend directly from the superficial side of the soma, and travel upward without branching.

PATO:0070008.name: T Martinotti morphology
PATO:0070008.def: A Martinotti cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have axons that form a horizontal ramification, making it T-shaped.

PATO:0070009.name: fan Martinotti morphology
PATO:0070009.def: A Martinotti cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have axons that form a fan-like plexus.

PATO:0070010.name: stellate morphology
PATO:0070010.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons that have dendritic processes radiating from the cell body forming a star-like shape.

PATO:0070011.name: chandelier cell morphology
PATO:0070011.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which are small and round, and make highly specialized synapses with the axon initial segments of pyramidal neurons, wrapping them with candle-shaped synaptic 'cartridges'.

PATO:0070012.name: bitufted cell morphology
PATO:0070012.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have two clusters of primary dendrites that originate directly and extend from opposite ends of the soma, and axons that form a plexus which spreads widely. Compared to the narrow vertical axonal projection of bipolar morphology, and the 'horse-tail' axonal cluster of double boquet cells, bitufted morphology has wide horizontal axonal spans, and branching that occur close to the soma. Their vertical projection is also less extensive and crosses mostly to neighboring layers.

PATO:0070013.name: spiny stellate cell morphology
PATO:0070013.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have spiny basal dendrites and resemble pyramidal cells but lose their apical dendrites as they mature. Their axons nearly always emerge from the descending side of the soma, but often recurve and ascend with arc-like collaterals.

PATO:0070015.name: pyramidal family morphology
PATO:0070015.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have a pyramidal shaped soma, a single axon, a large apical dendrite and multiple basal dendrites.

PATO:0070016.name: horizontal pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070016.def: A pyramidal family morphology that inheres in neurons which have an apical tree which is oriented parallel to the pia.

PATO:0070017.name: standard pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070017.def: A pyramidal family morphology that inheres in neurons which have a standard pyramidal shape with its apical dendrite aligned vertically.

PATO:0070018.name: tufted pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070018.def: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have a distinct tuft formation, distal from the soma.

PATO:0070019.name: untufted pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070019.def: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which lack a clear tuft formation but extend to large radial distances.

PATO:0070020.name: stellate pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070020.def: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which lack a tuft formation but extend to small radial distances forming a star-like shape.

PATO:0070021.name: inverted pyramidal morphology
PATO:0070021.def: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which have an apical tree which is oriented towards the white matter.

PATO:0070025.name: unipolar neuron morphology
PATO:0070025.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with only one process, a neurite, that extends from the cell body. The neurite then branches to form dendritic and axonal processes.

PATO:0070026.name: multipolar neuron morphology
PATO:0070026.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons which possess three or more neurites, usually a single axon and many dendrites and dendritic branches.

PATO:0070027.name: bitufted dendrite cell morphology
PATO:0070027.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with dendrites that are bidirectional, emerging from opposite ends of the soma, with the two arbors extending in radial or tangential directions.

PATO:0070028.name: extratelencephalic projecting
PATO:0070028.def: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons whose soma is located in the telencephalon and that project to structures outside the telencephalon

PATO:0070029.name: corticothalamic projecting
PATO:0070029.def: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons with soma in the cerebral cortex and projections to the thalamus.

PATO:0070030.name: near projecting
PATO:0070030.def: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons with projections that terminate locally rather than distantly.

PATO:0070031.name: corticomedulla projecting
PATO:0070031.def: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons that project to the medulla oblongata from other brain regions.

PATO:0070033.name: neuron projection quality
PATO:0070033.def: A physical quality inhering in a neuron by virtue of the relative location of its soma and the regions to which it projects and makes synaptic contacts in.

PATO:0070034.name: intratelencephalic projecting
PATO:0070034.def: A neuron projection quality that is a characteristic of neurons with both soma and projections entirely within the telencephalon.

PATO:0070044.name: anatomical structure quality
PATO:0070044.def: A quality of continuant that exist at the anatomical level of organisation and anything under it. This includes, but is not limited to, cells , tissues, and components.

PATO:0070045.name: anatomical histological quality
PATO:0070045.def: A quality inhering in an anotomical structure by virtue of its capacity to be stained by specific histological dyes.

PATO:0070046.name: neutrophillic
PATO:0070046.def: An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction that stains and colors, pale-pink, with Wright-Giemsa stain.

PATO:0070047.name: polychromatophilic
PATO:0070047.def: An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction for both basic and acid stains under specific pH conditions.

PATO:0070060.name: quality of interaction of a substance with electromagnetic radiation
PATO:0070060.def: A quality of a substance on which or through which electromagnetic radiation impinges or traverses with respect to radiation. This substance quality changes the quality of the incident radiation with respect to any of: intensity, direction, scatter and wavelength.

PATO:0070061.name: double bouquet morphology
PATO:0070061.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with bitufted dendritic morphology but with the special feature of a tight fascicular axonal cylinder that resembles a 'horse tail'.

PATO:0070062.name: bistratified dendrite cell morphology
PATO:0070062.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with dendrites that stratify at two and only two locations.

PATO:0070063.name: monostratified dendrite cell morphology
PATO:0070063.def: A cell morphology that inheres in neurons with dendrites that stratify at one and only one location.

PR:000000001.name: protein
PR:000000001.def: An amino acid chain that is produced de novo by ribosome-mediated translation of a genetically-encoded mRNA, and any derivatives thereof.

PR:000001002.name: CD19 molecule
PR:000001002.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD19 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. It is composed of an N-terminal extracellular domain containing two Ig-like C2-type (immunoglobulin-like) domains, followed by a single-pass transmembrane segment and a cytoplasmic C-terminal tail. CD19 expression is restricted to members of the B cell lineage. It functions as a co-receptor for B-cell antigen receptor (BCR), regulating signal transduction.

PR:000001003.name: CD34 molecule
PR:000001003.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD34 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. It is a leukocyte membrane protein expressed specifically by lymphohematopoietic progenitor cells. It contains a single-pass transmembrane domain and that show distinct expression on early hematopoietic precursors and vascular-associated tissue. Acts as a scaffold that presents selectin carbohydrate ligands in a clustered, tissue specific manner to allow for higher avidity interactions between leukocytes and endothelial cells during the inflammatory process. In common with related sialomucins (endoglycan and podocalyxin), the extracellular region is dominated by an N-terminal mucin-like domain, which is densely substituted with sialylated O-linked carbohydrates. The mucin-like region is followed by a cysteine-containing and presumably globular domain. This domain may fold into an immunoglobulin-like structure as the positions of 2 of the cysteines are conserved in the C2 set of the immunoglobulin superfamily. The cytoplasmic domain is around 73-76 residues long and highly conserved.

PR:000001004.name: CD4 molecule
PR:000001004.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD4 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. CD4 is an accessory protein for MHC class-II antigen/T-cell receptor interaction. It is the primary receptor for HIV-1. CD4 has four immunoglobulin-like domains in its extracellular region that share the same structure, but can differ in sequence.

PR:000001005.name: integrin alpha with A domain
PR:000001005.def: An integrin alpha that contains an A domain. A hallmark of this class is the presence of a von Willebrand factor type A domain (Pfam:PF00092) (I-domain) of approximately 200 amino acid residues at the N terminus, which confers divalent cation binding properties. Unlike other integrin alpha proteins, they do not undergo proteolytic cleavage.

PR:000001006.name: receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase C
PR:000001006.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human PTPRC gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. It is composed of an extracellular domain, a single transmembrane segment and two tandem intracytoplasmic protein-tyrosine phosphatase domains. Contains 1 to 3 copies of the Fibronectin type III domain (Pfam:PF00041) followed by two copies of the Protein-tyrosine phosphatase (Pfam:PF00102) domain. Receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase C (CD45) regulates signal transduction and lymphocyte activation by specific association with receptor molecules on T and B cells. Multiple isoforms of CD45 (180-235 kDa) can be generated asa result of alternative splicing of three variable exons 4(A), 5(B) and 6(C), encoding sequences at the N-terminal extracellular domain of the molecule.

PR:000001007.name: integrin alpha-1
PR:000001007.def: An integrin alpha with A domain that is a translation product of the human ITGA1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001008.name: integrin alpha-2
PR:000001008.def: An integrin alpha with A domain that is a translation product of the human ITGA2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001010.name: integrin alpha-E
PR:000001010.def: An integrin alpha with A domain that is a translation product of the human ITGAE gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001012.name: integrin alpha-M
PR:000001012.def: An integrin alpha with A domain that is a translation product of the human ITGAM gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. They constitute subunits of the integrin alpha-M/beta-2 receptor. This receptor is implicated in various adhesive interactions of monocytes, macrophages and granulocytes as well as in mediating the uptake of complement-coated particles. It is also a receptor for fibrinogen, factor X and ICAM1.
synonym: cell surface glycoprotein MAC-1 subunit alpha

PR:000001013.name: integrin alpha-X
PR:000001013.def: An integrin alpha with A domain that is a translation product of the human ITGAX gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. Integrin alpha-X complexed with beta-2 is a receptor for fibrinogen. It recognizes the sequence GPR in fibrinogen. It mediates cell-cell interaction during inflammatory responses. It is especially important in monocyte adhesion and chemotaxis.
synonym: leukocyte adhesion glycoprotein p150,95 alpha chain

PR:000001014.name: receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase C isoform CD45RABC
PR:000001014.def: A receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase C that is a translation product of some mRNA whose exon structure and start site selection renders it capable of giving rise to a protein with the amino acid sequence represented by UniProtKB:P08575-3 or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001015.name: receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase C isoform CD45RA
PR:000001015.def: A receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase C isoform CD45R that is a translation product of some mRNA whose exon structure and start site selection renders it capable of giving rise to a protein with the amino acid sequence represented by UniProtKB:P08575-8 or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001017.name: receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase C isoform CD45RO
PR:000001017.def: A receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase C that is a translation product of some mRNA whose exon structure and start site selection renders it capable of giving rise to a protein with the amino acid sequence represented by UniProtKB:P08575-4 or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001018.name: CD3 subunit with immunoglobulin domain
PR:000001018.def: A protein that has a core domain composition consisting of an extracellular N-terminal domain that adopts an immunoglobulin fold, a transmembrane domain, and an intracellular C-terminal domain with a single copy of the Immunoreceptor tyrosine-based activation motif (Pfam:PF02189) (ITAM). It constitutes the invariant subunit of the T cell antigen receptor (TCR). TCR is a surface receptor on T cells responsible for recognizing MHC-restricted antigens and initiating the cellular immune response.

PR:000001020.name: CD3 epsilon
PR:000001020.def: A CD3 subunit with immunoglobulin domain that is a translation product of the human CD3E gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: T-cell surface antigen T3/Leu-4 epsilon chain

PR:000001022.name: neural cell adhesion molecule
PR:000001022.def: A protein with a domain composition consisting of a large extracellular domain, including five Ig-like C2-type domains followed by two copies of the Fibronectin type-III domain (Pfam:PF00041), a single-pass transmembrane domain and a short cytoplasmic C-terminal domain.

PR:000001023.name: neural cell adhesion molecule NCAM
PR:000001023.def: A neural cell adhesion molecule that is involved in neuronal development, synaptic plasticity, and regeneration.

PR:000001024.name: neural cell adhesion molecule 1
PR:000001024.def: A neural cell adhesion molecule NCAM that is a translation product of the human NCAM1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001025.name: C-type lectin with multiple lectin domains
PR:000001025.def: A protein that is a type I transmembrane receptor with an N-terminal cysteine-rich domain, a single Fibronectin type II (FNII) domain (Pfam:PF00040) and eight to ten copies of the Lectin C-type domain (Pfam:PF00059) (CTLDs). The presence of multiple copies of the CTLD domain is a hallmark of this class.

PR:000001026.name: lymphocyte antigen 75
PR:000001026.def: A C-type lectin with multiple lectin domains that is a translation product of the mouse LY75 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. It consists of 12 extracellular domains (an N-terminal cysteine-rich domain, a fibronectin type II domain and 10 C-type carbohydrate recognition domains), a transmembrane region and a small cytoplasmic C terminus containing a single Tyr residue, but no obvious kinase domain.
synonym: C-type lectin domain family 13 member B

PR:000001082.name: CD160 molecule
PR:000001082.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD160 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001083.name: CD2 molecule
PR:000001083.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001084.name: T-cell surface glycoprotein CD8 alpha chain
PR:000001084.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD8A gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. CD8 is a transmembrane that is a co-receptor for MHC class-I antigen/T-cell receptor interaction. The most common form of CD8 is composed of a CD8 alpha and a CD8 beta chain.

PR:000001085.name: T-cell surface glycoprotein CD8 beta chain
PR:000001085.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD8B gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. CD8 is a transmembrane receptor that is a co-receptor for MHC class-I antigen/T-cell receptor interaction. The most common form of CD8 is composed of a CD8 alpha and a CD8 beta chain.

PR:000001087.name: adhesion G-protein coupled receptor
PR:000001087.def: A G-protein coupled receptor with a 7 transmembrane (secretin family) domain (Pfam:PF00002) preceded by an amino-terminal region containing one or more functional domains with adhesion-like motifs.

PR:000001094.name: rhodopsin-like G-protein coupled receptor
PR:000001094.def: A G-protein coupled receptor that contains the 7 transmembrane receptor (rhodopsin family) domain (Pfam:PF00001), which includes 7 transmembrane helices (TMI-TM7) with 3 intracellular loops (IL1-IL3) and 3 extracellular loops (EL1-EL3) between the helices. The amino-terminal region is extracellular and the carboxyl-terminal region is intracellular. Rhodopsin-like G-protein coupled receptors (GPCRs) are unique among the several classes of GPCRs in that most have a very short amino-terminal segment and several characteristic sequence motifs, particularly NSxxNPxxY in TM7 and D/E-R-Y/F between TM3 and loop IL2. Most bind their ligands within a cavity between the TM regions.

PR:000001107.name: D(1)-like dopamine receptor
PR:000001107.def: A dopamine receptor that is a product of the DRD1 or DRD5 gene. The active form binds dopamine and its activity is mediated by G proteins that cause activation of adenylate cyclase.

PR:000001108.name: D(2)-like dopamine receptor
PR:000001108.def: A dopamine receptor that is a product of the DRD2, DRD3, or DRD4 gene. The active form binds dopamine and its activity is mediated by G proteins that cause inhibition of adenylate cyclase.

PR:000001119.name: animal opsin
PR:000001119.def: A rhodopsin-like G-protein coupled receptor that is a translation product of the human OPN1LW, OPN1MW, OPN1SW, RHO, OPN3, OPN4, or OPN5 genes, 1:1 orthologs thereof, or a semi-ortholog thereof in Metazoa. The active form binds a vitamin A-based retinaldehyde chromophore through a Schiff base linkage to a Lys residue in the seventh transmembrane alpha helix.

PR:000001128.name: chemokine receptor
PR:000001128.def: A rhodopsin-like G-protein coupled receptor that in active form binds to one or more chemokines.

PR:000001175.name: D(1A) dopamine receptor
PR:000001175.def: A D(1)-like dopamine receptor that is a translation product of the human DRD1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001177.name: D(2) dopamine receptor
PR:000001177.def: A D(2)-like dopamine receptor that is a translation product of the human DRD2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001197.name: chemokine receptor CCR1/3/1L
PR:000001197.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CCR1 or CCR3 genes, the mouse CCR1L1 gene, 1:1 orthologs thereof, or a semi-ortholog thereof.

PR:000001199.name: C-C chemokine receptor type 2
PR:000001199.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CCR2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligands include CCL2, CCL7, CCL8, CCL13.

PR:000001200.name: C-C chemokine receptor type 4
PR:000001200.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CCR4 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligands include CCL17 and CCL22.

PR:000001201.name: C-C chemokine receptor type 5
PR:000001201.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CCR5 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligands include CCL3, CCL4, CCL5, CCL8, CCL14.

PR:000001202.name: C-C chemokine receptor type 6
PR:000001202.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CCR6 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligand is CCL20.

PR:000001203.name: C-C chemokine receptor type 7
PR:000001203.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CCR7 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligands are CCL19 and CCL21.

PR:000001206.name: CX3C chemokine receptor 1
PR:000001206.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CX3CR1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligand is CX3CL1.

PR:000001207.name: C-X-C chemokine receptor type 3
PR:000001207.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CXCR3 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligands include CXCL9, CXCL10, CXCL11.

PR:000001208.name: C-X-C chemokine receptor type 4
PR:000001208.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CXCR4 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligand is CXCL12.

PR:000001209.name: C-X-C chemokine receptor type 5
PR:000001209.def: A chemokine receptor that is a translation product of the human CXCR5 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligand is CXCL13.

PR:000001224.name: medium-wave-sensitive opsin
PR:000001224.def: An animal opsin that is a translation product of the human OPN1MW, OPN1MW2, or OPN1MW3 genes, 1:1 orthologs thereof, or a semi-ortholog thereof.

PR:000001226.name: high affinity interleukin-8 receptor
PR:000001226.def: A chemokine receptor whose active form binds interleukin-8 with high affinity.

PR:000001243.name: melanopsin
PR:000001243.def: An animal opsin that is a translation product of the human OPN4 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001244.name: long-wave-sensitive opsin 1
PR:000001244.def: An animal opsin that is a translation product of the human OPN1LW gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001254.name: C-C chemokine receptor type 1
PR:000001254.def: A chemokine receptor CCR1/3/1L that is a translation product of the human CCR1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001255.name: C-C chemokine receptor type 3
PR:000001255.def: A chemokine receptor CCR1/3/1L that is a translation product of the human CCR3 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001256.name: C-X-C chemokine receptor type 1
PR:000001256.def: A high affinity interleukin-8 receptor that is a translation product of the human CXCR1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001257.name: C-X-C chemokine receptor type 2
PR:000001257.def: A high affinity interleukin-8 receptor that is a translation product of the human CXCR2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001281.name: ADP-ribosyl cyclase
PR:000001281.def: A protein that contains the ADP-ribosyl cyclase domain (Pfam:PF02267).

PR:000001288.name: B-cell receptor CD22
PR:000001288.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD22 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001289.name: membrane-spanning 4-domains subfamily A member 1
PR:000001289.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human MS4A1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001290.name: B7-related protein
PR:000001290.def: A protein that is a member of a family that includes translation products of genes CD86, CD276, ICOSLG, and others. These are membrane-anchored proteins with a small intracellular domain and an extracellular domain with signal sequence, an Immunoglobulin V-set domain (Pfam:PF07686), and a CD80-like C2-set immunoglobulin domain (Pfam:PF08205).

PR:000001292.name: C-type lectin domain family 4 member C
PR:000001292.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CLEC4C gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001293.name: C-type lectin domain family 4 member K
PR:000001293.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD207 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001300.name: CD209 molecule
PR:000001300.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD209 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: C-type lectin domain family 4 member L

PR:000001307.name: CD44 molecule
PR:000001307.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD44 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001308.name: CD48 molecule
PR:000001308.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD48 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001310.name: CD83 molecule
PR:000001310.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD83 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001318.name: L-selectin
PR:000001318.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human SELL gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. It is a leukocyte adhesion receptor that play an important role in regulating the inflammatory response by mediating leukocyte tethering and rolling on adherent leukocytes.

PR:000001319.name: SLAM family member 5
PR:000001319.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD84 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001320.name: alpha-(1,3)-fucosyltransferase
PR:000001320.def: A protein that is a stand alone version of the Glycosyltransferase family 10 (fucosyltransferase) (Pfam:PF00852) domain. Proteins in this class may catalyze alpha-1,3 glycosidic linkages.

PR:000001325.name: beta-1,3-glucuronyltransferase
PR:000001325.def: A protein with a core domain structure consisting of a very small cytoplasmic domain followed by a transmembrane domain and a Glycosyltransferase family 43 (Pfam:PF03360) domain.

PR:000001326.name: bone marrow stromal antigen 2
PR:000001326.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human BST2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001327.name: cadherin
PR:000001327.def: A protein that has a core domain structure of signal sequence, propeptide, five Cadherin domains (Pfam:PF00028), a transmembrane region, and a Cadherin cytoplasmic region (Pfam:PF01049). Cadherins function as adhesion molecules that mediate Ca2+-dependent cell-cell adhesion in solid tissues.

PR:000001332.name: carcinoembryonic antigen-related cell adhesion molecule 8
PR:000001332.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CEACAM8 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001337.name: complement receptor type 1
PR:000001337.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CR1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001338.name: complement receptor type 2
PR:000001338.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CR2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001343.name: CD69 molecule
PR:000001343.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD69 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. A type II transmembrane protein with a C-type lectin binding domain in the extracellular portion of the molecule. Involved in lymphocyte proliferation and functions as a signal transmitting receptor in lymphocytes, natural killer (NK) cells, and platelets.
synonym: C-type lectin domain family 2 member C

PR:000001344.name: ectonucleotide pyrophosphatase/phosphodiesterase family member 3
PR:000001344.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human ENPP3 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001345.name: endoglin
PR:000001345.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human ENG gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001350.name: forkhead box protein P3
PR:000001350.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human FOXP3 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001352.name: glycophorin
PR:000001352.def: A protein that contains an extracellular Glycophorin A domain (Pfam:PF01102), followed by a single-pass transmembrane region and a small intracellular domain. A protein that is an integral protein of the red cell membrane. Proteins in this class are responsible for the molecular basis of the blood group antigens, surface markers on the outside of the red blood cell membrane.

PR:000001355.name: immunoglobulin gamma Fc receptor II/III/IV
PR:000001355.def: A protein with a core domain architecture consisting of an extracellular domain containing two copies of the Immunoglobulin domain (Pfam:PF00047), followed by a single-pass transmembrane region and a small intracellular domain. The active protein is a low affinity receptor for immunoglobulin gamma chain Fc region. Human II-a, II-b, and II-c represent a recent gene expansion and are equally related to mouse II, III, and IV. Human III-A and III-B are closely related and closer to mouse IV than to mouse III.

PR:000001356.name: immunoglobulin gamma Fc receptor I
PR:000001356.def: A protein with a core domain architecture consisting of an extracellular domain containing two or three copies of the Immunoglobulin domain (Pfam:PF00047), followed by a single-pass transmembrane region and a small intracellular domain.

PR:000001380.name: interleukin-2 receptor subunit alpha
PR:000001380.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human IL2RA gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001381.name: interleukin-2 receptor subunit beta
PR:000001381.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human IL2RB gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: high affinity IL-2 receptor subunit beta

PR:000001398.name: leukocyte immunoglobulin-like receptor subfamily A member 4
PR:000001398.def: A leukocyte immunoglobulin-like receptor subfamily member that is a translation product of the human LILRA4 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. This gene is a member of a lineage-specific gene expansion in primates.

PR:000001402.name: killer cell lectin-like receptor subfamily D member 1
PR:000001402.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human KLRD1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001403.name: tetraspanin
PR:000001403.def: A protein with four transmembrane domains, small intracellular amino- and carboxyl-terminal regions, and two extracellular loops, a small one (EC1) and a larger one (EC2) of about 100 residues. The EC2 loop contains at least 4 cysteine residues, including a highly conserved 'CCG' motif.

PR:000001408.name: ADP-ribosyl cyclase/cyclic ADP-ribose hydrolase 1
PR:000001408.def: An ADP-ribosyl cyclase that is a translation product of the human CD38 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001412.name: CD86 molecule
PR:000001412.def: A B7-related protein that is a translation product of the human CD86 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001431.name: N-formyl peptide receptor
PR:000001431.def: A rhodopsin-like G-protein coupled receptor that is a translation product of the human FPR1, FPR2, or FPR3 genes, 1:1 orthologs thereof, or a semi-ortholog thereof. The active form binds N-formyl methionyl peptides.

PR:000001438.name: CD80 molecule
PR:000001438.def: A B7-related protein that is a translation product of the human CD80 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001440.name: galactosylgalactosylxylosylprotein 3-beta-glucuronosyltransferase 1
PR:000001440.def: A beta-1,3-glucuronyltransferase that is a translation product of the human B3GAT1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001444.name: cadherin-5
PR:000001444.def: A cadherin that is a translation product of the human CDH5 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001447.name: cadherin-1
PR:000001447.def: A cadherin that is a translation product of the human CDH1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001456.name: alpha-(1,3)-fucosyltransferase 4
PR:000001456.def: An alpha-(1,3)-fucosyltransferase that is a translation product of the human FUT4 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001460.name: glycophorin-A
PR:000001460.def: A glycophorin that is a translation product of the human GYPA gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. It is the major sialoglycoprotein of the erythrocyte membrane. Structurally, glycophorin A consists of an N-terminal extracellular domain, heavily glycosylated on Ser and threonine residues, followed by a transmembrane region and a C-terminal cytoplasmic domain.

PR:000001465.name: high affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc receptor I
PR:000001465.def: An immunoglobulin gamma Fc receptor I that is a translation product of the human FCGR1A gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001479.name: low affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc region receptor II
PR:000001479.def: An immunoglobulin gamma Fc receptor II/III/IV that is a translation product of the mouse Fcgr2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001481.name: low affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc region receptor II-b
PR:000001481.def: An immunoglobulin gamma Fc receptor II/III/IV that is a translation product of the human FCGR2B gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001483.name: low affinity immunoglobulin gamma Fc region receptor III
PR:000001483.def: An immunoglobulin gamma Fc receptor II/III/IV that is a translation product of the mouse Fcgr3 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001547.name: prostaglandin D2 receptor DP2
PR:000001547.def: A prostanoid receptor that is a translation product of the human PTGDR2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligand is 11-dehydro-thromboxane B2. This receptor is not closely related to the prostaglandin D2 receptor encoded by PGD2.
synonym: chemoattractant receptor-homologous molecule expressed on Th2 cells

PR:000001549.name: prostanoid receptor
PR:000001549.def: A rhodopsin-like G-protein coupled receptor that is a translation product of the human PTGDR, PTGDR2, PTGER1 to PTGER4, PTGFR, PTGIR, or TBXA2R genes, 1:1 orthologs thereof, or a semi-ortholog thereof. The active form binds prostanoids (prostaglandins and thromboxanes).

PR:000001551.name: relaxin family peptide receptor protein
PR:000001551.def: A rhodopsin-like G-protein coupled receptor that is a translation product of the human RXFP1 to RXFP4 genes, 1:1 orthologs thereof, or a semi-ortholog thereof. The active form binds relaxins.

PR:000001562.name: vasopressin/oxytocin receptor
PR:000001562.def: A rhodopsin-like G-protein coupled receptor that is a translation product of the human AVPR1A, AVPR1B, AVPR2, or OXTR genes, 1:1 orthologs thereof, or a semi-ortholog thereof. These receptors bind vasopressin or oxytocin or related nonapeptides.

PR:000001580.name: fMet-Leu-Phe receptor
PR:000001580.def: An N-formyl peptide receptor that is a translation product of the human FPR1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligand is the peptide fMet-Leu-Phe, a bacterial peptide that acts as a chemoattractant in various pathophysiological conditions.

PR:000001635.name: oxytocin receptor
PR:000001635.def: A vasopressin/oxytocin receptor that is a translation product of the human OXTR gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The preferred ligand is oxytocin.

PR:000001666.name: relaxin receptor 1
PR:000001666.def: A relaxin family peptide receptor protein that is a translation product of the human RXFP1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. This receptor is expressed in the brain, kidney, testis, placenta, uterus, ovary, adrenal, prostate, skin and heart.

PR:000001753.name: transcription factor NF-kappa-B subunit
PR:000001753.def: A protein that has a core domain composition consisting of a Rel homology domain (RHD) (Pfam:PF00554), an IPT/TIG domain (Pfam:PF01833), six copies of the Ankyrin repeat (Pfam:PF00023), a Death domain (Pfam:PF00531) and a C-terminal PEST region.

PR:000001785.name: prominin
PR:000001785.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of one Prominin (Pfam:PF05478) domain. The prominins are an emerging family of proteins that, among the multispan membrane proteins, display a novel topology. Mouse and human prominin and prominin-like 1 are predicted to contain five membrane spanning domains, with an N-terminal domain exposed to the extracellular space followed by four, alternating small cytoplasmic and large extracellular, loops and a cytoplasmic C-terminal domain.

PR:000001786.name: prominin-1
PR:000001786.def: A prominin that is a translation product of the human PROM1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001806.name: C-type lectin domain family 6 member A
PR:000001806.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CLEC6A gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001807.name: C-type lectin domain family 7 member A
PR:000001807.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CLEC7A gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001808.name: C/C-C motif small inducible chemokine
PR:000001808.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of a Small cytokines (intecrine/chemokine), interleukin-8 like (Pfam:PF00048) domain.

PR:000001809.name: CD59-like glycoprotein
PR:000001809.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD59 gene, a 1:1 ortholog thereof, or pro-orthologs thereof.

PR:000001810.name: CSF-1/PDGF receptor-type tyrosine-protein kinase
PR:000001810.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of asignal sequence, 5 Ig-like domains, followed by a transmembrane sequence, followed by a Protein tyrosine kinase domain (Pfam:PF07714). However, only 1-3 of the Ig domains are detected by the Pfam HMMs in most of the sequences. Pfam:PF00047 is most common, but other members of the Ig domain clan, Pfam:PF07679 and Pfam:PF07686 can be identified instead. The fourth Ig domain lacks the disulfide-bonded cysteines.

PR:000001813.name: adhesion G protein-coupled receptor E1
PR:000001813.def: An adhesion G-protein coupled receptor that is a translation product of the human ADGRE1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001820.name: MHC class II histocompatibility antigen alpha chain
PR:000001820.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of a signal sequence, a Class II histocompatibility antigen, alpha domain (Pfam:PF00993) and an Immunoglobulin C1-set domain (Pfam:PF07654); these form the extracellular domain and are followed by a single-pass transmembrane region and a small cytoplasmic region.

PR:000001832.name: SIRP/SHPS-1 family protein
PR:000001832.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of a signal sequence, one Immunoglobulin V-set domain (Pfam:PF07686), two Immunoglobulin C1-set domains (Pfam:PF07654), a single-pass transmembrane region and a very small cytoplasmic region.

PR:000001833.name: SLAM family member 1
PR:000001833.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human SLAMF1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001835.name: T-box transcription factor TBX21
PR:000001835.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human TBX21 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001836.name: CD7 molecule
PR:000001836.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD7 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001838.name: T-cell surface glycoprotein CD1
PR:000001838.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of a signal sequence, an extracellular region with Class I Histocompatibility antigen, domains alpha 1 and alpha two (Pfam:PF00129) and an Immunoglobulin C1-set domain (Pfam:PF07654), a single-pass transmembrane region, and a very short cytoplasmic region. Forms a heterodimer with beta-2 microglobulin.

PR:000001839.name: T-cell surface glycoprotein CD5
PR:000001839.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD5 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001841.name: T-cell-specific surface glycoprotein CD28
PR:000001841.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD28 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001843.name: Thy-1 membrane glycoprotein
PR:000001843.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human THY1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001844.name: arginase-1
PR:000001844.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human ARG1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001850.name: cathepsin K
PR:000001850.def: A cathepsin-like protease that is a translation product of the human CTSK gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001852.name: cytotoxic T-lymphocyte protein 4
PR:000001852.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CTLA4 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001854.name: ectonucleoside triphosphate diphosphohydrolase 1
PR:000001854.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human ENTPD1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001858.name: immunoglobulin iota chain
PR:000001858.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human VPREB1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof. The gene is recently and independently duplicated in mouse and rabbit, giving rise to very closely related VPREB2 genes in those species. The protein associates with the Ig-mu chain to form a molecular complex that is expressed only on the surface of pre-B-cells.

PR:000001859.name: immunoglobulin lambda-like polypeptide 1
PR:000001859.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human IGLL1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001860.name: inducible T-cell costimulator
PR:000001860.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human ICOS gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001861.name: integrin beta
PR:000001861.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of a large extracellular region containing one Integrin, beta chain domain (Pfam:PF00362), up to four EGF-like domains (Pfam:PF07974), and an Integrin beta tail domain (Pfam:PF07965), followed by a single-pass transmembrane region and a small cytoplasmic region often containing an Integrin beta cytoplasmic domain (Pfam:PF08725).

PR:000001865.name: interleukin-3 receptor class 2 alpha chain
PR:000001865.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human IL3RA gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: interleukin-3 receptor class II alpha chain

PR:000001867.name: interleukin-5 receptor subunit alpha
PR:000001867.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human IL5RA gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001869.name: interleukin-7 receptor subunit alpha
PR:000001869.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human IL7R gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001874.name: KLRB1-like protein
PR:000001874.def: A protein that is a translation product of the KLRB1 gene or its closely related paralogs (KLRB1A-F). There are lineage-specific expansions in mouse and rat.

PR:000001879.name: leukosialin
PR:000001879.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human SPN gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001880.name: low affinity immunoglobulin epsilon Fc receptor
PR:000001880.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human FCER2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: C-type lectin domain family 4 member J

PR:000001883.name: lysosome-associated membrane protein
PR:000001883.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of a Lysosome-associated membrane glycoprotein (Pfam:PF01299) domain. It is a single-pass type I membrane protein that shuttles between lysosomes, endosomes, and the plasma membrane.

PR:000001884.name: macrophage receptor MARCO
PR:000001884.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human MARCO gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001885.name: macrophage scavenger receptor types I and II
PR:000001885.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human MSR1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: macrophage acetylated LDL receptor I and II

PR:000001888.name: membrane alanyl aminopeptidase-like metallopeptidase
PR:000001888.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of a Peptidase family M1 domain (Pfam:PF01433).

PR:000001889.name: CD14 molecule
PR:000001889.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD14 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001892.name: CD33 molecule
PR:000001892.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD33 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001893.name: natural cytotoxicity triggering receptor 1
PR:000001893.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human NCR1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001894.name: natural cytotoxicity triggering receptor 2
PR:000001894.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human NCR2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001896.name: natural killer cell receptor 2B4
PR:000001896.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD244 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: NK cell type I receptor protein 2B4

PR:000001897.name: natural killer cell receptor NKG2
PR:000001897.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of an as yet unnamed domain in the amino-terminal half and a carboxyl-terminal Lectin C-type domain (Pfam:PF00059).

PR:000001898.name: neprilysin
PR:000001898.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human MME gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001902.name: nuclear receptor ROR-gamma
PR:000001902.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human RORC gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: nuclear receptor subfamily 1 group F member 3

PR:000001903.name: paired box protein PAX-5
PR:000001903.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human PAX5 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001905.name: platelet glycoprotein 4
PR:000001905.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD36 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001907.name: platelet glycoprotein Ib alpha chain
PR:000001907.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human GP1BA gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001919.name: programmed cell death protein 1
PR:000001919.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human PDCD1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001925.name: scavenger receptor cysteine-rich type 1 protein M130
PR:000001925.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD163 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001927.name: sialic acid-binding Ig-like lectin 5
PR:000001927.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human SIGLEC5 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001928.name: sialic acid-binding Ig-like lectin 6
PR:000001928.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human SIGLEC6 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001931.name: sialoadhesin
PR:000001931.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human SIGLEC1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001932.name: signal transducer CD24
PR:000001932.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD24 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: small cell lung carcinoma cluster 4 antigen

PR:000001935.name: syndecan-1
PR:000001935.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human SDC1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001937.name: tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase type 5
PR:000001937.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human ACP5 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001938.name: thrombomodulin-like receptor
PR:000001938.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of a signal sequence, a Lectin C-type domain (Pfam:PF00059), 5 or 6 EGF-like domains (Pfam:PF00008, Pfam:PF09064, or Pfam:PF07645), a transmembrane region, and a small cytoplasmic region (36-51 amino acids).

PR:000001941.name: trans-acting T-cell-specific transcription factor GATA-3
PR:000001941.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human GATA3 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001944.name: transcription factor PU.1
PR:000001944.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human SPI1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001945.name: transferrin receptor protein 1
PR:000001945.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human TFRC gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001950.name: tumor necrosis factor ligand superfamily member 5
PR:000001950.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD40LG gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001954.name: tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 11A
PR:000001954.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human TNFRSF11A gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001963.name: CD27 molecule
PR:000001963.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human CD27 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 7

PR:000001968.name: tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type substrate 1
PR:000001968.def: A SIRP/SHPS-1 family protein that is a translation product of the human SIRPA gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: brain Ig-like molecule with tyrosine-based activation motifs

PR:000001969.name: urokinase plasminogen activator surface receptor
PR:000001969.def: A protein that is a translation product of the human PLAUR gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000001971.name: vascular endothelial growth factor receptor
PR:000001971.def: A protein with core architecture consisting of a signal sequence, followed by 7 Ig-like domains (Pfam:PF00047, Pfam:PF07679, or Pfam:PF07686), a transmembrane region, and a cytoplasmic Protein tyrosine kinase domain.

PR:000001998.name: C-C motif chemokine 3/4
PR:000001998.def: A C/C-C motif small inducible chemokine that is a translation product of the CCL3, CCL3L1/CCL3L3, or CCL4 gene.

PR:000002001.name: receptor-type tyrosine-protein kinase FLT3
PR:000002001.def: A CSF-1/PDGF receptor-type tyrosine-protein kinase that is a translation product of the human FLT3 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002015.name: MHC class II histocompatibility antigen alpha chain DRA
PR:000002015.def: An MHC class II histocompatibility antigen alpha chain that is a translation product of the human HLA-DRA gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002023.name: NKG2-A/NKG2-B type II integral membrane protein
PR:000002023.def: A natural killer cell receptor NKG2 that is a translation product of the human KLRC1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002025.name: T-cell surface glycoprotein CD1a
PR:000002025.def: A T-cell surface glycoprotein CD1 that is a translation product of the human CD1A gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002027.name: T-cell surface glycoprotein CD1c
PR:000002027.def: A T-cell surface glycoprotein CD1 that is a translation product of the human CD1C gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002028.name: antigen-presenting glycoprotein CD1d
PR:000002028.def: A T-cell surface glycoprotein CD1 that is a translation product of the human CD1D gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002030.name: alpha-type platelet-derived growth factor receptor
PR:000002030.def: A CSF-1/PDGF receptor-type tyrosine-protein kinase that is a translation product of the human PDGFRA gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002031.name: aminopeptidase N
PR:000002031.def: A membrane alanyl aminopeptidase-like metallopeptidase that is a translation product of the human ANPEP gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002037.name: complement component C1q receptor
PR:000002037.def: A thrombomodulin-like receptor that is a translation product of the human CD93 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002039.name: glutamyl aminopeptidase
PR:000002039.def: A membrane alanyl aminopeptidase-like metallopeptidase that is a translation product of the human ENPEP gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002062.name: macrophage colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor
PR:000002062.def: A CSF-1/PDGF receptor-type tyrosine-protein kinase that is a translation product of the human CSF1R gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002064.name: macrosialin
PR:000002064.def: A lysosome-associated membrane protein that is a translation product of the human CD68 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002065.name: mast/stem cell growth factor receptor
PR:000002065.def: A CSF-1/PDGF receptor-type tyrosine-protein kinase that is a translation product of the human KIT gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002105.name: thrombomodulin
PR:000002105.def: A thrombomodulin-like receptor that is a translation product of the human THBD gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002112.name: vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2
PR:000002112.def: A vascular endothelial growth factor receptor that is a translation product of the human KDR gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002123.name: C-C motif chemokine 3
PR:000002123.def: A C-C motif chemokine 3/4 that is a translation product of the human CCL3 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002972.name: macrophage mannose receptor 1
PR:000002972.def: A C-type lectin with multiple lectin domains that is a translation product of the human MRC1 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: C-type lectin domain family 13 member D
C-type lectin domain family 13 member D-like

PR:000002976.name: Ly-6-like protein
PR:000002976.def: A protein that is the translation product of any of the LY6 genes (LY6A-LY6I).

PR:000002977.name: killer cell lectin-like receptor subfamily B member 1C
PR:000002977.def: A KLRB1-like protein that is a translation product of the mouse Klrb1c gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.
synonym: natural killer cell surface protein P1-40

PR:000002978.name: lymphocyte antigen 6G
PR:000002978.def: An Ly-6-like protein that is a translation product of the mouse Ly6g gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002979.name: lymphocyte antigen 6A-2/6E-1
PR:000002979.def: An Ly-6-like protein that is a translation product of the mouse Ly6a gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002980.name: lymphocyte antigen 6C2
PR:000002980.def: An Ly-6-like protein that is a translation product of the mouse Ly6c2 gene or a 1:1 ortholog thereof.

PR:000002981.name: lymphocyte antigen 76 (mouse)
PR:000002981.def: A protein that is a translation product of the Ly76 gene in mouse.

PR:000003262.name: collagen alpha chain
PR:000003262.def: A protein that is a component of collagen. Collagens are trimeric molecules in which each chain comprises a repeating Gly-X-Y triplet, in which X and Y can be any residue but are usually proline and hydroxyproline, respectively. PR:000030035.name: G-protein coupled receptor
PR:000030035.def: A protein that has G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) activity. Each GPCR consists of a single polypeptide with an extracellular N-terminus, an intracellular C-terminus and seven hydrophobic transmembrane domains (TM1-TM7) linked by three extracellular loops (ECL1-ECL3) and three intracellular loops (ICL1-ICL3). GPCRs function as part of a heterotrimeric complex to transmit an extracellular signal across the membrane by activating an associated G-protein via the exchange of GDP for GTP on the alpha subunit.

PR:000037797.def: A protein that contains a copy of the 'Paired box' domain (Pfam:PF00292), a conserved amino acid motif with DNA-binding activity. PR:000044672.name: aquaporin protein

PR:000044676.name: channel protein
