PATO:0001280.def: Pink color having medium brightness and low saturation.

PATO:0001281.name: saturated purple
PATO:0001281.def: A color consisting of purple color and high saturation.

PATO:0001282.name: desaturated purple
PATO:0001282.def: A color consisting of purple color and low saturation.

PATO:0001283.name: saturated red
PATO:0001283.def: A color consisting of red hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001284.name: desaturated red
PATO:0001284.def: A color consisting of red hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001285.name: saturated yellow
PATO:0001285.def: A color consisting of yellow hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001286.name: desaturated yellow
PATO:0001286.def: A color consisting of yellow hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001287.name: red brown
PATO:0001287.def: A color consisting of red and brown hue.

PATO:0001288.name: dark red brown
PATO:0001288.def: A color consisting of red and brown hue and low brightness.

PATO:0001289.name: light red brown
PATO:0001289.def: A color consisting of red and brown hue and high brightness.

PATO:0001290.name: fluorescent
PATO:0001290.def: A fluorescence quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of emitting light during exposure to radiation from an external source.

PATO:0001291.name: obsolete electromagnetic (EM) radiation quality
PATO:0001291.def: OBSOLETE A radiation quality that inheres in a bearer by virtue of how that bearer interacts with electromagnetic radiation.

PATO:0001293.name: absorption quality
PATO:0001293.def: A scalar EM radiation quality which obtains by the capacity of the bearer to retain radiation.

PATO:0001295.name: albedo
PATO:0001295.def: A reflective quality restricted to a particular wavelength.

PATO:0001296.name: luminous flux
PATO:0001296.def: A scalar optical quality which obtains by the magnitude of the light emitted by the bearer.

PATO:0001298.name: phosphorescence
PATO:0001298.def: A fluorescence in which the emittence continues after the absorption has ceased.

PATO:0001299.name: radiation emitting quality
PATO:0001299.def: A scalar EM radiation quality which obtains by the capacity of the bearer to emit radiation.

PATO:0001301.name: chromatic property
PATO:0001301.def: An optical quality that is the mixture, purity or pattern of wavelengths of light perceived by the observer.

PATO:0001302.name: vermilion
PATO:0001302.def: A color consisting of red and orange hue with a slight amount of gray.

PATO:0001303.name: variability
PATO:0001303.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to varying or changing.

PATO:0001304.name: variability of temperature
PATO:0001304.def: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits temperature variation or change.

PATO:0001305.name: increased temperature
PATO:0001305.def: A temperature which is relatively high.

PATO:0001306.name: decreased temperature
PATO:0001306.def: A temperature which is relatively low.

PATO:0001307.name: decreased variability of temperature
PATO:0001307.def: A variability of temperature which is relatively low.

PATO:0001308.name: increased variability of temperature
PATO:0001308.def: A variability of temperature which is relatively high.

PATO:0001309.name: duration
PATO:0001309.def: A process quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's magnitude of the temporal extent between the starting and ending point.

PATO:0001310.name: duration of temperature
PATO:0001310.def: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's duration of exhibition of thermal energy.

PATO:0001311.name: decreased duration of temperature
PATO:0001311.def: A duration of temperature which is lesser relative to the normal or average enduring or continuing in time.

PATO:0001312.name: increased duration of temperature
PATO:0001312.def: A duration of temperature which is greater relative to the normal or average in respect to the quality of temperature of enduring or continuing in time.

PATO:0001313.name: invariant temperature
PATO:0001313.def: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking or not exhibiting variation of temperature.

PATO:0001314.name: variant temperature
PATO:0001314.def: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or exhibiting variation of temperature.

PATO:0001315.name: mild increased temperature
PATO:0001315.def: A temperature which is increased by a low degree.

PATO:0001316.name: moderate increased temperature
PATO:0001316.def: A temperature which is increased by a medium degree.

PATO:0001317.name: severe increased temperature
PATO:0001317.def: A temperature which is increased by a high degree.

PATO:0001318.name: indiscriminate
PATO:0001318.def: A discrimination quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being incapable perceiving differences between two or more stimuli.

PATO:0001319.name: discriminate
PATO:0001319.def: A discrimination quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of perceiving differences between two or more stimuli.

PATO:0001320.name: pubescent hair
PATO:0001320.def: A pilosity quality of being covered with short hairs or soft down.

PATO:0001321.name: right angle to
PATO:0001321.def: An angle which is 90 degrees to another entity.

PATO:0001322.name: straight angle to
PATO:0001322.def: An angle which is 180 degrees to another entity.

PATO:0001323.name: area
PATO:0001323.def: A 2-D extent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's two dimensional extent.

PATO:0001324.name: bilateral symmetry
PATO:0001324.def: A symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being symmetric about a plane running from its frontal end to its caudal end (head to tail), and has nearly identical right and left halves.

PATO:0001325.name: radial symmetry
PATO:0001325.def: A symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having equal proportion around a central point or axis.

PATO:0001327.name: zygomorphic
PATO:0001327.def: A symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of division into symmetrical halves by only one longitudinal plane passing through the axis.

PATO:0001328.name: actinomorphic
PATO:0001328.def: A symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of division into symmetrical halves by any longitudinal plane passing through the axis.

PATO:0001329.name: flavourful
PATO:0001329.def: A flavor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having flavour.

PATO:0001330.name: flavourless
PATO:0001330.def: A flavor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking flavour.

PATO:0001331.name: odorous
PATO:0001331.def: An odor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having odour.

PATO:0001332.name: amorphous
PATO:0001332.def: A morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lack of distinct morphology.

PATO:0001333.name: temporally extended
PATO:0001333.def: A quality of a process which ends later than the natural end time.

PATO:0001334.name: diameter
PATO:0001334.def: A length quality which is equal to the length of any straight line segment that passes through the center of a circle and whose endpoints are on the circular boundary.

PATO:0001335.name: bacterial mating type
PATO:0001335.def: A mating type that indicates whether the F plasmid has integrated into the chromosome.

PATO:0001336.name: obsolete unknown sex
PATO:0001336.def: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual whose sex is unknown.

PATO:0001338.name: mixed sex
PATO:0001338.def: A biological sex quality inhering in a population of multiple sexes.

PATO:0001339.name: biomaterial purity
PATO:0001339.def: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's homogeneity of a biomaterial.

PATO:0001340.name: hermaphrodite
PATO:0001340.def: A biological sex quality inhering in an organism or a population with both male and female sexual organs in one individual.

PATO:0001341.name: a mating type (yeast)
PATO:0001341.def: A S. cerevisiae mating type cells that secrete a pheromone that in alpha haploids stimulates processes that lead to mating.

PATO:0001343.name: Schizosaccharomyces pombe mating type
PATO:0001343.def: A S. pombe mating type determined by the gene configuration on the mat1 locus.

PATO:0001344.name: alpha mating type (yeast)
PATO:0001344.def: A S. cerevisiae mating type cells that secrete a pheromone that stimulates a haploids.

PATO:0001345.name: h minus
PATO:0001345.def: A S. pombe mating type determined by the mat1-Mc and mat1-Mi on the mat1 locus.

PATO:0001346.name: h plus
PATO:0001346.def: A S. pombe mating type determined by the mat1-Pc and mat1-Pi on the mat1 locus.

PATO:0001347.name: F mating type
PATO:0001347.def: A bacterial mating type indicating the presence of F plasmid in a bacterial cell.

PATO:0001348.name: F minus mating type
PATO:0001348.def: A bacterial mating type indicating the absence of F plasmid in a bacterial cell.

PATO:0001349.name: high frequency recombinant
PATO:0001349.def: A mating type that indicates that the F plasmid has integrated into the chromosome.

PATO:0001350.name: angular acceleration
PATO:0001350.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the rate of change of the bearer's angular velocity.

PATO:0001351.name: area density
PATO:0001351.def: A density quality which inheres in a bearer by virtue of some influence exerted by the bearer's mass on a given area.

PATO:0001352.name: linear density
PATO:0001352.def: A density quality which is equal to the mass exerting an influence on a one-dimensional object.

PATO:0001353.name: volumetric density
PATO:0001353.def: A density quality which inheres in a bearer by virtue of some influence exerted by the bearer's mass on a given volume.

PATO:0001354.name: translucent
PATO:0001354.def: A optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting low opacity.

PATO:0001355.name: convex
PATO:0001355.def: A shape quality that obtains by virtue of the bearer having inward facing edges; having a surface or boundary that curves or bulges outward, as the exterior of a sphere.

PATO:0001356.name: pleomorphic
PATO:0001356.def: A shape quality inhering in a cell by virtue of the bearer's ability to take on two or more different shapes during its life cycle.

PATO:0001357.name: pulvinate
PATO:0001357.def: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a cushion or has a marked convex cushion-like form.

PATO:0001358.name: umbonate
PATO:0001358.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a knob or knoblike protuberance.

PATO:0001359.name: rugose
PATO:0001359.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having many wrinkles or creases on the surface.

PATO:0001360.name: filamentous
PATO:0001360.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having thin filamentous extensions at its edge.

PATO:0001361.name: warty
PATO:0001361.def: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered with warts or projections that resemble warts resulting in a hard rough surface.

PATO:0001362.name: fragile
PATO:0001362.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being easily damaged or destroyed.

PATO:0001364.name: rhizoidal
PATO:0001364.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having root like extensions radiating from its center.

PATO:0001365.name: spiny
PATO:0001365.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having spines, thorns or similar thin projections on its surface.

PATO:0001366.name: punctiform
PATO:0001366.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being small and resembling a point.

PATO:0001367.name: lobate
PATO:0001367.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having deeply undulating edges forming lobes.

PATO:0001368.name: erose
PATO:0001368.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an irregularly toothed edge.

PATO:0001369.name: raised
PATO:0001369.def: A shape quality inhering in a colony by virtue of the bearer's appearing above the medium surface with terraced edges.

PATO:0001370.name: viscid
PATO:0001370.def: A coating quality which is sticky or clammy.

PATO:0001371.name: mucoid
PATO:0001371.def: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's consistency of mucus.

PATO:0001372.name: refractivity
PATO:0001372.def: A physical quality that inheres in propagating wave (light or sound) virtue of the bearer's change in direction when passing from one medium to another.

PATO:0001373.name: glistening
PATO:0001373.def: A reflectivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's reflecting lots of light.

PATO:0001376.name: monoploid
PATO:0001376.def: A ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing a single set of unique homologous chromosomes.

PATO:0001378.name: autopolyploid
PATO:0001378.def: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing chromosomes derived from a single species.

PATO:0001379.name: allopolyploidy
PATO:0001379.def: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing chromosomes derived from different species.

PATO:0001380.name: paleopolyploid
PATO:0001380.def: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an ancient polyploid ancestor.

PATO:0001381.name: triploid
PATO:0001381.def: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing three homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001382.name: tetraploid
PATO:0001382.def: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing four homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001383.name: pentaploid
PATO:0001383.def: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing five homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001384.name: hexaploid
PATO:0001384.def: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing six homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001385.name: aneuploid
PATO:0001385.def: A ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing a non-integral multiple of the monoploid number, due to extra or missing chromosomes.

PATO:0001386.name: monosomy
PATO:0001386.def: An aneuploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing only one chromosome from a pair in a cell's nucleus.

PATO:0001387.name: disomy
PATO:0001387.def: An aneuploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing only two chromosome from a pair in a cell's nucleus.

PATO:0001388.name: uniparental disomy
PATO:0001388.def: A disomy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing two copies of the chromosome from one of the parents (with no contribution from the other parent).

PATO:0001389.name: trisomy
PATO:0001389.def: An aneuploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing three, instead of two, chromosomes of a particular numbered type in an organism.

PATO:0001390.name: partial trisomy
PATO:0001390.def: A trisomy quality inhering in a bearer when part of the bearer's extra chromosome is attached to one of the other chromosomes, or if one of the bearer's chromosomes has two copies of part of its chromosome.

PATO:0001391.name: mosaic trisomy
PATO:0001391.def: A trisomy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having extra chromosomal material in only some of it's cells.

PATO:0001392.name: endopolyploid
PATO:0001392.def: A polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's chromosome number being increased by endomitosis and for which the degree of ploidy is proportional to the number of times that endomitosis has taken place.

PATO:0001395.name: haplodiploid
PATO:0001395.def: A diploidy quality inhering in a bearer in by virtue of belonging in a species whose one of the sexes has haploid cells and the other has diploid cells.

PATO:0001398.name: self-renewal
PATO:0001398.def: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the ability to go through numerous cycles of cell division while maintaining the undifferentiated state.

PATO:0001399.name: totipotent
PATO:0001399.def: A cellular potency that is the capacity to produce differentiated cell types of all three primary germ layers and extraembryonic cell types.

PATO:0001403.name: pluripotent
PATO:0001403.def: A cellular potency that is the capacity to produce differentiated cell types of all three primary germ layers but not extraembryonic cell types.

PATO:0001409.name: spindle-shaped
PATO:0001409.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a long tapered rod.

PATO:0001411.name: structured
PATO:0001411.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having distinct structure.

PATO:0001412.name: unstructured
PATO:0001412.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking distinct structure.

PATO:0001413.name: angular velocity
PATO:0001413.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the rate of the bearer's angular movement about an axis; the angle rotated in a given time.

PATO:0001414.name: catalytic activity
PATO:0001414.def: A physical quality inhering in a catalyst by virtue of the amount of the catalyst's action.

PATO:0001415.name: morbidity
PATO:0001415.def: A quality inhering in a population by virtue of the proportion of its members that are ill at a given time.

PATO:0001416.name: regular duration
PATO:0001416.def: A duration which has regular start and/or end times.

PATO:0001417.name: irregular duration
PATO:0001417.def: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's duration which has irregular start and/or end times.

PATO:0001418.name: lethargic
PATO:0001418.def: A behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being deficient in alertness or activity.

PATO:0001419.name: sharp
PATO:0001419.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating in a point or edge.

PATO:0001420.name: buoyancy
PATO:0001420.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to rise or float in a fluid medium such as water or air.

PATO:0001421.name: alive
PATO:0001421.def: A viability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's condition before death.

PATO:0001422.name: dead
PATO:0001422.def: A viability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the cessation of the bearer's life.

PATO:0001423.name: refractile
PATO:0001423.def: A reflectivity quality inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to refract light.

PATO:0001424.name: violet
PATO:0001424.def: A color hue with very low wavelength of that portion of the visible spectrum lying between reddish blue or bluish purple, evoked in the human observer by radiant energy with wavelengths of approximately 420 to 380 nanometers.

PATO:0001425.name: rosy
PATO:0001425.def: A color hue consisting of red hue and yellow hue and high brightness.

PATO:0001426.name: maroon
PATO:0001426.def: A color consisting of purple and brown hue.

PATO:0001427.name: compound acidity
PATO:0001427.def: A concentration quality inhering in compound by virtue of the bearer's tendency to act as a hydron donor.

PATO:0001428.name: medium acidity
PATO:0001428.def: A concentration quality inhering in a medium by virtue of the bearer's tendency to hydronate a specific reference base.

PATO:0001429.name: acidic
PATO:0001429.def: An medium acidity quality inhering in a solution by virtue of the bearer's a high concentration of H+ ions.

PATO:0001430.name: alkaline
PATO:0001430.def: An medium acidity quality inhering in a solution by virtue of the bearer's a low concentration of H+ ions.

PATO:0001431.name: adhesivity
PATO:0001431.def: An emergent molecular quality that arises by virtue of the bearer's disposition to exhibit molecular attraction to another entity in contact.

PATO:0001432.name: decayed
PATO:0001432.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decomposition into component parts.

PATO:0001433.name: growth quality of occurrent
PATO:0001433.def: A quality of a single process which describes the growth of an organism, structure, or group of organisms.

PATO:0001434.name: reproductive quality
PATO:0001434.def: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to produce new life or offspring.

PATO:0001435.name: attachment quality
PATO:0001435.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having connection or association with another entity.

PATO:0001436.name: sessile (sensu botany)
PATO:0001436.def: An attachment quality inhering in a flower by virtue of the bearer's lacking a stalk, as in flowers or leaves that grow directly from the stem.

PATO:0001437.name: sessile (sensu zoology)
PATO:0001437.def: A attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's inability to move about.

PATO:0001438.name: pedicellate
PATO:0001438.def: A attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or being supported by a pedicel or pedicle.

PATO:0001439.name: tonicity
PATO:0001439.def: A contractile quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's elastic tension that facilitate response to stimuli.

PATO:0001440.name: homophilic
PATO:0001440.def: A cellular adhesivity quality inhering in a molecule in one cell by virtue of the bearer's attachment to an identical molecule in an adjacent cell.

PATO:0001441.name: heterophilic
PATO:0001441.def: A cellular adhesivity quality inhering in a molecule in one cell by virtue of the bearer's attachment to an nonidentical molecule in an adjacent cell.

PATO:0001442.name: wholeness
PATO:0001442.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer includes all its components.

PATO:0001444.name: broken
PATO:0001444.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's components no longer being in a single contiguous unit.

PATO:0001445.name: disassembled
PATO:0001445.def: A wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being taken apart into its constituent parts.

PATO:0001446.name: whole
PATO:0001446.def: A wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's including all its components.

PATO:0001447.name: calcified
PATO:0001447.def: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's being encrusted or impregnated with calcium carbonate (CHEBI:3311).

PATO:0001448.name: ossified
PATO:0001448.def: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's being hardened by the deposition of calcium into bone.

PATO:0001449.name: cartilaginous
PATO:0001449.def: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's cartilage quantities.

PATO:0001450.name: edematous
PATO:0001450.def: A structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter exhibits an excessive accumulation of extracellular fluid.

PATO:0001451.name: obsolete edematous (sensu botany)
PATO:0001451.def: An extended swelling in plant organs caused primarily by an excessive accumulation of water.

PATO:0001453.name: detached from
PATO:0001453.def: An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking connection or association with another entity.

PATO:0001454.name: sensitivity to oxygen
PATO:0001454.def: A sensitivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's dependence on oxygen.

PATO:0001455.name: aerobic
PATO:0001455.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's dependence on oxygen.

PATO:0001456.name: anaerobic
PATO:0001456.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's independence on oxygen.

PATO:0001457.name: sensitivity of a process
PATO:0001457.def: A quality of a process inhering in bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to respond to stimulation.

PATO:0001458.name: sensitivity of a process to oxygen
PATO:0001458.def: A sensitivity of a process quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's unfolding in a location with or without oxygen.

PATO:0001459.name: aerobic (for occurrence)
PATO:0001459.def: A sensitivity of a process inhering in a biological process by virtue of the process unfolding in a location with oxygen.

PATO:0001460.name: anaerobic (for occurrence)
PATO:0001460.def: A sensitivity of a process inhering in a biological process by virtue of the process unfolding in a location without oxygen.

PATO:0001461.name: surface tension
PATO:0001461.def: A physical quality inhering in a liquid by virtue of the bearer's ability to attraction of molecules at its surface as a result of unbalanced molecular cohesive forces.

PATO:0001462.name: membrane potential
PATO:0001462.def: A quality inhering in a cell's plasma membrane by virtue of the electrical potential difference across it.

PATO:0001463.name: action potential
PATO:0001463.def: A quality inhering in a cell's plasma membrane by virtue of a brief fluctuation in the bearer's potential caused by the rapid opening and closing of voltage-gated ion channels.

PATO:0001464.name: electric potential
PATO:0001464.def: A quality that is equal to the potential energy per unit charge associated with a static (time-invariant) electric field, also called the electrostatic potential.

PATO:0001465.name: monstrous
PATO:0001465.def: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's all-encompassing, grotesque morphological defects.

PATO:0001466.name: curved rostral
PATO:0001466.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the front of an organism.

PATO:0001467.name: curved caudal
PATO:0001467.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the part of the body from which the tail arises.

PATO:0001468.name: curved dorsal
PATO:0001468.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the back or upper surface of an organism.

PATO:0001469.name: curved ventral
PATO:0001469.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the abdomen of an organism.

PATO:0001470.name: ratio
PATO:0001470.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's magnitude in proportion to the magnitude of another entity.

PATO:0001472.name: decreased depth
PATO:0001472.def: A depth which is relatively low.

PATO:0001473.name: duplicated
PATO:0001473.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being present in two copies.

PATO:0001474.name: anteverted
PATO:0001474.def: An oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's axis being positioned forward.

PATO:0001475.name: increased position
PATO:0001475.def: A position which is relatively high.

PATO:0001476.name: decreased position
PATO:0001476.def: A positional which is relatively low.

PATO:0001477.name: retracted
PATO:0001477.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being drawn in or pulled back from any given point.

PATO:0001478.name: collapsed
PATO:0001478.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being broken down; caved in.

PATO:0001480.name: spongy
PATO:0001480.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a sponge in elasticity, absorbency, or porousness.

PATO:0001481.name: sloped
PATO:0001481.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an oblique or slanted direction.

PATO:0001482.name: prominent
PATO:0001482.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's standing out or projecting beyond a surface or line.

PATO:0001483.name: aplastic
PATO:0001483.def: Absence of an organ, tissue or cell due to failure to develop from a primordium or precursor cell.

PATO:0001484.name: recent
PATO:0001484.def: A quality of a process which occurs near to or not long before the present.

PATO:0001485.name: condensed
PATO:0001485.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being thicker or more closely packed together; pressed tightly together.

PATO:0001486.name: chronological age
PATO:0001486.def: An age quality that exists by virtue of the time (years and months) that the bearer has existed.

PATO:0001487.name: senescent
PATO:0001487.def: A time quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's growing old; aging.

PATO:0001488.name: cellular motility
PATO:0001488.def: A cellular quality inhering in a cell by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability to move spontaneously.

PATO:0001490.name: heterochronic growth
PATO:0001490.def: A growth quality of a process inhering in an organism, structure, or group of organisms by virtue of the bearer's reduced or increased growth.

PATO:0001491.name: neotenous growth
PATO:0001491.def: A paedomorphic growth quality which is due to a reduced rate.

PATO:0001492.name: growth rate
PATO:0001492.def: The rate or speed of the change in size of an individual entity or change in number of a population.

PATO:0001495.name: notched
PATO:0001495.def: A concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape being a V-shaped cut.

PATO:0001496.name: brood quality
PATO:0001496.def: A reproductive quality inhering in the young of an animal by virtue of the bearer's being cared for at one time.

PATO:0001497.name: brood viability
PATO:0001497.def: A reproductive quality inhering in the young of an animal by virtue of the bearer's disposition to survive and develop normally.

PATO:0001499.name: spherical
PATO:0001499.def: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a ball (a sphere whose equatorial diameter is equal to the polar diameter).

PATO:0001500.name: tapered
PATO:0001500.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being gradually narrower or thinner toward one end.

PATO:0001502.name: complexity
PATO:0001502.def: A monadic quality of continuant inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being intricate and compounded.

PATO:0001503.name: simple
PATO:0001503.def: A complexity quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having few parts or being complicated or compound.

PATO:0001504.name: complex
PATO:0001504.def: A complexity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being intricate and compounded.

PATO:0001505.name: separated from
PATO:0001505.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not being in contact with another entity, or of no longer being connected or joined with another entity.

PATO:0001506.name: diastatic
PATO:0001506.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's separation of normally joined parts, such as the separation of adjacent bones without fracture or of certain abdominal muscles during pregnancy.

PATO:0001507.name: disrupted
PATO:0001507.def: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being interrupted of its normal course.

PATO:0001510.name: functional
PATO:0001510.def: A functionality quality held by the bearer when the latter is able to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001511.name: non-functional
PATO:0001511.def: A disfunctional quality held by the bearer when the latter is unable to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001512.name: punctate
PATO:0001512.def: A pattern inhering in a surface by virtue of the bearer's being marked by the presence of dots, punctures, points or pits.

PATO:0001514.name: delaminated
PATO:0001514.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking some outer layer.

PATO:0001515.name: variable color
PATO:0001515.def: A color quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being uneven in color.

PATO:0001516.name: focus
PATO:0001516.def: An optical quality where light rays originating from a point on the object converge.

PATO:0001517.name: focused
PATO:0001517.def: An optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having focus.

PATO:0001518.name: blurry
PATO:0001518.def: An optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking focus.

PATO:0001519.name: sound quality
PATO:0001519.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of vibration, as perceived by the sense of hearing.

PATO:0001521.name: sound amplitude
PATO:0001521.def: A physical quality inhering in a sound wave by virtue of the maximum magnitude (value without regard to sign) of its disturbance.

PATO:0001522.name: sound speed
PATO:0001522.def: A physical quality inhering in sound by virtue of the bearer's travelling speed in a given medium under specified conditions.

PATO:0001523.name: sound wavelength
PATO:0001523.def: A physical quality which is equal to the quotient of the speed of a sound wave divided by its wavelength.

PATO:0001524.name: intrasonic
PATO:0001524.def: A sound frequency in the range of 0-20 Hz.

PATO:0001525.name: sonic
PATO:0001525.def: A sound frequency in the range of 20 to 20.000 Hz.

PATO:0001526.name: ultrasonic
PATO:0001526.def: A sound frequency in the range of 20 000 + Hz.

PATO:0001527.name: quiet
PATO:0001527.def: A sound amplitude which is relatively low.

PATO:0001528.name: loud
PATO:0001528.def: A sound amplitude which is relatively high.

PATO:0001529.name: cellular spatiotemporal quality
PATO:0001529.def: A spatiotemporal quality inhering in a cell.

PATO:0001530.name: behavioral quality of a process
PATO:0001530.def: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's behavior.

PATO:0001531.name: cellular adhesivity
PATO:0001531.def: A cellular quality that exists by virtue of the disposition of the cell to adhere to other cells and molecules, through the emergent action of the molecular parts of the cell surface.

PATO:0001532.name: mono-colored
PATO:0001532.def: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one hue.

PATO:0001533.name: multi-colored
PATO:0001533.def: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's having two or more hues or degrees of saturation.

PATO:0001534.name: motley
PATO:0001534.def: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's having 3 or more hues or degrees of saturations.

PATO:0001535.name: dappled
PATO:0001535.def: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's being marked with small spots, patches, or specks of hue or degree of saturation differing from that of the background.

PATO:0001536.name: solubility
PATO:0001536.def: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the bearer's disposition to dissolve in a liquid.

PATO:0001537.name: soluble in
PATO:0001537.def: A solubility quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the bearer's disposition to dissolve in a liquid.

PATO:0001538.name: insoluble in
PATO:0001538.def: A solubility quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the bearer's inability of a substance to dissolve in a liquid.

PATO:0001539.name: amylose composition
PATO:0001539.def: A compositional quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's quantities or relative ratios of amylose of the inhering entity.

PATO:0001540.name: glutinous
PATO:0001540.def: An amylose composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's having negligible or no amylose content.

PATO:0001541.name: non-glutinous
PATO:0001541.def: An amylose composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's having high amount of amylose content.

PATO:0001542.name: delayed phase
PATO:0001542.def: A phase which starts later than natural start point.

PATO:0001545.name: inflexible
PATO:0001545.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's inability of being turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

PATO:0001549.name: increased sensitivity toward

PATO:0001781.def: A thickness quality which lacks pattern.

PATO:0001782.name: increased intensity
PATO:0001782.def: An intensity which is relatively high.

PATO:0001783.name: decreased intensity
PATO:0001783.def: An intensity which is relatively low.

PATO:0001784.name: bifurcated
PATO:0001784.def: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided into two branches.

PATO:0001785.name: splayed
PATO:0001785.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outward.

PATO:0001786.name: split
PATO:0001786.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided or broken up into parts or divisions.

PATO:0001787.name: rotational curvature
PATO:0001787.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved around an axis.

PATO:0001788.name: increased mass density
PATO:0001788.def: A density which is higher relative to the normal or average.

PATO:0001789.name: domed
PATO:0001789.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape resembling a dome.

PATO:0001790.name: decreased mass density
PATO:0001790.def: A density which is lower relative to the normal or average.

PATO:0001791.name: multi-localised
PATO:0001791.def: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being confined or restricted to multiple locations.

PATO:0001792.name: left side of
PATO:0001792.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located on left side of from the a another entity.

PATO:0001793.name: right side of
PATO:0001793.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located on right side of a another entity.

PATO:0001798.name: kinked
PATO:0001798.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having multiple angles in its length.

PATO:0001799.name: ruffled
PATO:0001799.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting disturbance of its smoothness or regularity.

PATO:0001800.name: water composition
PATO:0001800.def: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the quantities or relative ratios of water of the inhering entity.

PATO:0001801.name: decreased water composition
PATO:0001801.def: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the reduction in amount of water the bearer contains.

PATO:0001802.name: loose
PATO:0001802.def: A pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not being compact or dense in arrangement.

PATO:0001803.name: phototoxic
PATO:0001803.def: A photosensitivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being susceptible to damage by light.

PATO:0001804.name: scaly
PATO:0001804.def: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered or partially covered with scales.

PATO:0001805.name: flaky
PATO:0001805.def: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's formed or tending to form flakes or thin, crisp fragments.

PATO:0001806.name: sensitivity to irradiation
PATO:0001806.def: A sensitivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exposure to radiation.

PATO:0001807.name: decreased sensitivity to irradiation
PATO:0001807.def: A sensitivity to irradiation which is relatively low.

PATO:0001808.name: increased sensitivity to irradiation
PATO:0001808.def: A sensitivity to irradiation which is relatively high.

PATO:0001809.name: tight
PATO:0001809.def: A pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being compact or dense in arrangement.

PATO:0001810.name: wrinkled
PATO:0001810.def: A grooved texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by one or more creases in a normally smooth surface.

PATO:0001811.name: obsolete increased relaxation
PATO:0001811.def: A relaxation which is relatively high.

PATO:0001812.name: obsolete decreased relaxation
PATO:0001812.def: A relaxation which is relatively low.

PATO:0001813.name: atonicity
PATO:0001813.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lack elastic tension that facilitate response to stimuli.

PATO:0001814.name: dystonicity
PATO:0001814.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's impaired elastic tension that facilitate response to stimuli.

PATO:0001815.name: fatigability
PATO:0001815.def: A strength quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to lose strength.

PATO:0001816.name: increased fatigability
PATO:0001816.def: A fatigability which is relatively high.

PATO:0001817.name: decreased fatigability
PATO:0001817.def: A fatigability which is relatively low.

PATO:0001818.name: progressive
PATO:0001818.def: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's increasing over time.

PATO:0001819.name: atretic
PATO:0001819.def: A morphological quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's absence or closure of a normal body orifice or tubular passage.

PATO:0001821.name: imperforate
PATO:0001821.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having no opening.

PATO:0001822.name: wetness
PATO:0001822.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer's being covered by a liquid.

PATO:0001823.name: wet
PATO:0001823.def: A wetness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered by a liquid.

PATO:0001824.name: dry
PATO:0001824.def: A wetness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not being covered by a liquid.

PATO:0001825.name: increased wetness
PATO:0001825.def: A wetness quality that is relatively high.

PATO:0001826.name: decreased wetness
PATO:0001826.def: A wetness quality that is relatively low.

PATO:0001827.name: pseudohermaphrodite
PATO:0001827.def: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population by virtue of having internal reproductive organs of one sex and external sexual characteristics of the other sex.

PATO:0001828.name: male pseudohermaphrodite
PATO:0001828.def: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population by virtue of having internal reproductive organs of male and external sexual characteristics of female.

PATO:0001829.name: female pseudohermaphrodite
PATO:0001829.def: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population by virtue of having internal reproductive organs of female and external sexual characteristics of male.

PATO:0001830.name: decreased female fertility
PATO:0001830.def: A female fertility which is relatively low.

PATO:0001831.name: increased female fertility
PATO:0001831.def: A female fertility which is relatively high.

PATO:0001832.name: increased male fertility
PATO:0001832.def: A male fertility which is relatively high.

PATO:0001833.name: decreased male fertility
PATO:0001833.def: A male fertility which is relatively low.

PATO:0001834.name: decreased fertility
PATO:0001834.def: A fertility which is relatively low.

PATO:0001835.name: increased fertility
PATO:0001835.def: A fertility which is relatively high.

PATO:0001836.name: congested
PATO:0001836.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer with some kind of aperture or opening that is blocked or clogged.

PATO:0001838.name: decreased fluid flow
PATO:0001838.def: A flow that is relatively low.

PATO:0001839.name: increased fluid flow
PATO:0001839.def: A fluid flow that is relatively high.

PATO:0001841.name: remittent intensity
PATO:0001841.def: An intensity which is characterized by temporary abatement in severity.

PATO:0001842.name: acidity
PATO:0001842.def: A concentration quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing acid (hydrogen ions).

PATO:0001843.name: decreased acidity
PATO:0001843.def: An acidity which is relatively low.

PATO:0001844.name: increased acidity
PATO:0001844.def: An acidity which is relatively high.

PATO:0001845.name: irregular rhythm
PATO:0001845.def: A rhythm quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking rhythm lacking pattern.

PATO:0001846.name: tangled
PATO:0001846.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being entwined and difficult to unravel.

PATO:0001847.name: constricted
PATO:0001847.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being drawn together, compressed or squeezed physically.

PATO:0001848.name: asymmetrically curved
PATO:0001848.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved asymmetrically.

PATO:0001849.name: abrased
PATO:0001849.def: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of a portion of the bearer's surface being scraped away.

PATO:0001850.name: scarred
PATO:0001850.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being fibrous tissue that replaces normal tissue destroyed by injury or disease.

PATO:0001851.name: swollen
PATO:0001851.def: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting transient abnormal enlargement, not due to cell proliferation.

PATO:0001852.name: dislocated
PATO:0001852.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being out of its usual or proper place, or position due to it being physically moved from the normal location.

PATO:0001853.name: hydrocephalic
PATO:0001853.def: A structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter exhibits an excessive accumulation of cerebral spinal fluid.

PATO:0001854.name: vertical
PATO:0001854.def: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being situated at right angles to the horizon.

PATO:0001855.name: horizontal
PATO:0001855.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in the plane of the horizon.

PATO:0001856.name: introverted
PATO:0001856.def: An oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being turned inward upon itself.

PATO:0001858.name: partially paralysed
PATO:0001858.def: A functionality quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being not completely paralysed.

PATO:0001859.name: increased coordination
PATO:0001859.def: A coordination which is relatively high.

PATO:0001860.name: decreased coordination
PATO:0001860.def: A coordination which is relatively low.

PATO:0001861.name: fasciculated
PATO:0001861.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming a bundle of aligned anatomical fibers, as of muscle or nerve.

PATO:0001862.name: lack of fertility in offspring
PATO:0001862.def: A fertility quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to make its offspring sterile.

PATO:0001863.name: chronic
PATO:0001863.def: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having slow progressive course of indefinite duration.

PATO:0001865.name: spheroid
PATO:0001865.def: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a quadric surface in three dimensions obtained by rotating an ellipse about one of its principal axes. Includes spheres and oblate/prolate spheroids.

PATO:0001866.name: prolate
PATO:0001866.def: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a polar diameter longer than its equatorial diameter.

PATO:0001867.name: rectangular
PATO:0001867.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of it being a quadrilateral polygon in which all four angles are right angles.

PATO:0001868.name: autofluorescence
PATO:0001868.def: A fluorescence quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting fluorescence which is self-induced.

PATO:0001869.name: pathological
PATO:0001869.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abnormal and having a destructive effect on living tissue.

PATO:0001875.name: triangular
PATO:0001875.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three angles.

PATO:0001876.name: dumbbell-shaped
PATO:0001876.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two parts, roughly spherical and of equal size, connected by a bar.

PATO:0001877.name: lanceolate
PATO:0001877.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a lance-head, considerably longer than wide, tapering towards the tip from below the middle; attached at the broad end.

PATO:0001878.name: sigmoid
PATO:0001878.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of two curves, in opposite directions. S-shaped.

PATO:0001879.name: U-shaped
PATO:0001879.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter U.

PATO:0001880.name: caudate
PATO:0001880.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a tail or tail-like projection.

PATO:0001881.name: arrow-shaped
PATO:0001881.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming two equal obtuse triangles with a short side in common.

PATO:0001882.name: limaciform
PATO:0001882.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a slug.

PATO:0001883.name: clavate
PATO:0001883.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gradually becoming thicker towards the end.

PATO:0001884.name: hydrophobicity
PATO:0001884.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's disposition to being water-repellent; tending to repel and not absorb water.

PATO:0001885.name: hydrophobic
PATO:0001885.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking affinity for water; tending to repel and not absorb water; tending not to dissolve in or mix with or be wetted by water.

PATO:0001886.name: hydrophilicity
PATO:0001886.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's disposition to having an affinity for water; it is readily absorbing or dissolving in water.

PATO:0001887.name: hydrophilic
PATO:0001887.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to having a strong affinity for water; tending to dissolve in, mix with, or be wetted by water.

PATO:0001888.name: miscibility
PATO:0001888.def: A quality of a liquid inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to mix with (dissolve in) another liquid.

PATO:0001889.name: scalloped
PATO:0001889.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the border, edge, or outline cut into a series of segments of circles resembling a scallop-shell.

PATO:0001890.name: tripartite
PATO:0001890.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided into three branches.

PATO:0001891.name: ovate
PATO:0001891.def: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a continuous convex surface with an axis of symmetry and one axis longer than the other; egg-shaped.

PATO:0001892.name: decreased odor
PATO:0001892.def: An odor quality of having decreased odor.

PATO:0001893.name: increased odor
PATO:0001893.def: An odor quality of having increased odor.

PATO:0001894.name: phenotypic sex
PATO:0001894.def: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's physical expression of sexual characteristics.

PATO:0001895.name: mating type
PATO:0001895.def: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population that undergo sexual reproduction.

PATO:0001896.name: unlumenized
PATO:0001896.def: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking of a three dimensional space surrounded by one or more anatomical structures and containing one or more anatomical substances.

PATO:0001897.name: lumenized
PATO:0001897.def: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a three dimensional space surrounded by one or more anatomical structures and containing one or more anatomical substances.

PATO:0001898.name: increased circumference
PATO:0001898.def: A circumference which is relatively high.

PATO:0001899.name: decreased circumference
PATO:0001899.def: A circumference which is relatively low.

PATO:0001900.name: front
PATO:0001900.def: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction that is similar to the direction of an object to the south when it faces north.

PATO:0001901.name: back
PATO:0001901.def: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction that is similar to the direction of an object to the north when it faces south.

PATO:0001902.name: unidirectional
PATO:0001902.def: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one direction only.

PATO:0001903.name: bi-directional
PATO:0001903.def: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two directions.

PATO:0001904.name: circling direction
PATO:0001904.def: A directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction approximating the shape of a circle.

PATO:0001905.name: has normal numbers of parts of type
PATO:0001905.def: The bearer of this quality has_part = n, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. Note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part.

PATO:0001906.name: movement quality
PATO:0001906.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's participation in movement.

PATO:0001907.name: botryoidal
PATO:0001907.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being like the surface of a compact mass of grapes.

PATO:0001909.name: trinucleate
PATO:0001909.def: A nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three nuclei.

PATO:0001911.name: circling
PATO:0001911.def: A behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting movement in a circular course.

PATO:0001912.name: physiological state
PATO:0001912.def: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the state of bearer's mechanical, physical, and biochemical processes.

PATO:0001913.name: ictal
PATO:0001913.def: A physiological state which is characterized by periods of high-frequency high amplitude electrical activity in neuronal tissue.

PATO:0001914.name: non-ictal
PATO:0001914.def: A physiological state which is characterized by normal electrical activity in neuronal tissue.

PATO:0001915.name: anterodorsal to
PATO:0001915.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the front and upper surface of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001916.name: posterodorsal to
PATO:0001916.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear and upper surface of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001917.name: anteroventral to
PATO:0001917.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the front and abdomen of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001918.name: posteroventral to
PATO:0001918.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear and abdomen of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001919.name: mislocalised dorsally
PATO:0001919.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the back or upper surface of an organism.

PATO:0001920.name: mislocalised ventrally
PATO:0001920.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the abdomen of an organism.

PATO:0001921.name: mislocalised anteriorly
PATO:0001921.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the front of an organism.

PATO:0001922.name: mislocalised posteriorly
PATO:0001922.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the rear of an organism.

PATO:0001923.name: mislocalised laterally
PATO:0001923.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the side of an organism.

PATO:0001924.name: mislocalised medially
PATO:0001924.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the middle of an organism.

PATO:0001926.name: increased fluorescence
PATO:0001926.def: A fluorescence which is higher than normal.

PATO:0001927.name: decreased fluorescence
PATO:0001927.def: A fluorescence which is lower than normal.

PATO:0001928.name: blistered
PATO:0001928.def: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of a local accumulation of fluid underneath the surface of the bearer.

PATO:0001929.name: variability of shape
PATO:0001929.def: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits shape variation or change.

PATO:0001930.name: variant shape
PATO:0001930.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's having or exhibiting variation its shape.

PATO:0001931.name: invariant shape
PATO:0001931.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking or not exhibiting variation of shape.

PATO:0001932.name: alternate placement
PATO:0001932.def: A pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being placed alternately one above the other.

PATO:0001933.name: opposite
PATO:0001933.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned on opposite sides on the same plane.

PATO:0001934.name: orbicular
PATO:0001934.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being perfectly circular.

PATO:0001935.name: obtuse
PATO:0001935.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being roundish, a little inclining to be oblong.

PATO:0001936.name: obovate
PATO:0001936.def: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being egg-shaped and flat, with the narrow end attached to the base.

PATO:0001937.name: spatulate
PATO:0001937.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being oblong, with the lower end very much attenuated.

PATO:0001938.name: rhomboid
PATO:0001938.def: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being oval and a little angular in the middle.

PATO:0001940.name: gigantic
PATO:0001940.def: A size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being many folds greater relative to the normal average.

PATO:0001941.name: yellow green
PATO:0001941.def: A color consisting of yellow and green hues.

PATO:0001942.name: brown green
PATO:0001942.def: A color consisting of brown and green hues.

PATO:0001943.name: lilac
PATO:0001943.def: A purple color which has low saturation and low brightness.

PATO:0001944.name: yellow orange
PATO:0001944.def: A color consisting of yellow and orange hue.

PATO:0001945.name: ochre
PATO:0001945.def: A moderate yellow-orange to orange color.

PATO:0001946.name: banded
PATO:0001946.def: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's exhibiting transverse stripes of one hue or degree of saturation crossing another.

PATO:0001947.name: netted
PATO:0001947.def: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's being covered with reticulated lines of a different hue or degree of saturation.

PATO:0001948.name: furrowed
PATO:0001948.def: A grooved texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by two or more parallel channels.

PATO:0001949.name: pointleted
PATO:0001949.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating abruptly in a little point.

PATO:0001950.name: blunt
PATO:0001950.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating gradually in a rounded end.

PATO:0001951.name: whorled
PATO:0001951.def: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in opposition round a common axis.

PATO:0001952.name: distichous
PATO:0001952.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being arranged in two opposite rows (and hence in the same plane).

PATO:0001953.name: decussate
PATO:0001953.def: A pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of paired parts that alternately cross each other.

PATO:0001954.name: subulate
PATO:0001954.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being linear, very narrow, tapering to a very fine point from a narrow base.

PATO:0001955.name: cuneate
PATO:0001955.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being narrowly triangular, wider at the apex and tapering toward the base.

PATO:0001956.name: variability of size
PATO:0001956.def: A variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits size variation or change.

PATO:0001957.name: decreased variability of size
PATO:0001957.def: A variability of size which is relatively low.

PATO:0001958.name: increased variability of size
PATO:0001958.def: A variability of size which is relatively high.

PATO:0001959.name: defasciculated
PATO:0001959.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's in which bundles of aligned anatomical fibers have become separated.

PATO:0001960.name: interdigitated
PATO:0001960.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's parts or projections being interlocked; for example, the fingers of two hands that are clasped.

PATO:0001961.name: in contact with
PATO:0001961.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's touching another entity.

PATO:0001962.name: involute
PATO:0001962.def: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being rolled inwards spirally on each side.

PATO:0001963.name: revolute
PATO:0001963.def: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being rolled backwards spirally on each side.

PATO:0001964.name: circinate
PATO:0001964.def: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being rolled spirally downwards.

PATO:0001965.name: reclinate
PATO:0001965.def: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being bent down upon their stalk.

PATO:0001966.name: convolute
PATO:0001966.def: A curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's one edge of its surface being wholly rolled up in another.

PATO:0001967.name: actinodromous
PATO:0001967.def: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three or more primary branches diverging radially from a single point.

PATO:0001968.name: parallelodromous
PATO:0001968.def: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two or more parallel primary branches originate beside each other and converge apically.

PATO:0001969.name: craspedodromous
PATO:0001969.def: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches terminating at the margin.

PATO:0001970.name: brochidodromous
PATO:0001970.def: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches joined together in a series of prominent arches.

PATO:0001971.name: cladodromous
PATO:0001971.def: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches freely branching toward the margin.

PATO:0001972.name: reticulodromous
PATO:0001972.def: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches branching into a reticulum toward the margin.

PATO:0001973.name: cuspidate
PATO:0001973.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being tapering gradually into a rigid point.

PATO:0001974.name: retuse
PATO:0001974.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating in a round end, the centre of which is depressed.

PATO:0001975.name: unserrated
PATO:0001975.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking sharp straight-edged teeth pointing to the apex.

PATO:0001976.name: serration
PATO:0001976.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or lacking sharp straight-edged teeth pointing to the apex.

PATO:0001977.name: angular
PATO:0001977.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having at least one salient angle on the margin.

PATO:0001978.name: cut
PATO:0001978.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being regularly divided by deep incisions.

PATO:0001980.name: digitate
PATO:0001980.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having distinct parts arising from a common point or center.

PATO:0001981.name: auriculate
PATO:0001981.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape resembling an ear.

PATO:0001982.name: attenuate
PATO:0001982.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gradually tapering to a slender point.

PATO:0001983.name: perfoliate
PATO:0001983.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's two basal lobes being united together.

PATO:0001984.name: decurrent
PATO:0001984.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being prolonged below the point of insertion.

PATO:0001985.name: frozen
PATO:0001985.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being kept below its freezing point.

PATO:0001986.name: dissolved
PATO:0001986.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's passing into solution.

PATO:0001989.name: sinuous
PATO:0001989.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having many curves and turns.

PATO:0001990.name: duration of disease
PATO:0001990.def: A duration quality of a process inhering in a disease by virtue of the bearer's duration of an impairment of health or of a condition of abnormal functioning.

PATO:0001991.name: immortal
PATO:0001991.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being capable of indefinite growth or division.

PATO:0001994.name: unicellular
PATO:0001994.def: A cellularity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of exactly one cell.

PATO:0001997.name: decreased amount
PATO:0001997.def: An amount which is relatively low.
synonym: present in fewer numbers in organism

PATO:0001998.name: conspicuousness
PATO:0001998.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its visibility.

PATO:0001999.name: lacks parts or has fewer parts of type
PATO:0001999.def: The bearer of this quality has_part < n of the indicated entity type, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. Note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part. Formally: If a bearer entity e has fewer parts of type X at time t, then the number of instances x of X at t such that x part_of e is < n, where n is either the normal number for comparable entities, or n is stated explicitly. This case includes the limit case, where the bearer lacks all parts of the specified type.

PATO:0002000.name: lacks all parts of type
PATO:0002000.def: A quality of physical entities inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking a physical part as specified by the additional entity.
PATO:0002000.synonym: lacks all physical parts of type

PATO:0002001.name: has fewer parts of type
PATO:0002001.def: The bearer of this quality has_part < n AND has_part > 0 of the indicated entity type, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. Note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part. Formally: If a bearer entity e has fewer parts of type X at time t, then the number of instances x of X at t such that x part_of e is < n, where n is either the normal number for comparable entities, or n is stated explicitly.
synonym: has fewer physical parts of type

PATO:0002002.name: has extra parts of type
PATO:0002002.def: The bearer of this quality has_part > n of the indicated entity type, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. Note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part.

PATO:0002003.name: population quality
PATO:0002003.def: A quality that inheres in an entire population or part of a population.

PATO:0002004.name: obsolete surface shape
PATO:0002004.def: A shape that inheres in a part of a surface. An object can have different surface shapes on different parts of its surface.

PATO:0002010.name: looseness
PATO:0002010.def: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bing full of small openings or gaps.

PATO:0002012.name: coating
PATO:0002012.def: A texture quality that exists through a liquid cover on the surface of the bearer.

PATO:0002013.name: fasciculation
PATO:0002013.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer forms a bundle of anatomical fibers, as of muscle or nerve.

PATO:0002019.name: aplastic growth
PATO:0002019.def: A growth quality of occurrent in which the growth of an organism, structure or group of organisms does not occur.

PATO:0002020.name: pale pink
PATO:0002020.def: Pink color having high brightness and low saturation.

PATO:0002021.name: conical
PATO:0002021.def: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a cone (a 3-D shape with a round cross section that tapers).

PATO:0002022.name: villiform
PATO:0002022.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a minute projection (villus).

PATO:0002023.name: apical-basal polarity
PATO:0002023.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location of features or characteristics along an apical-basal axis.

PATO:0002024.name: anterior-posterior polarity
PATO:0002024.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location of features or characteristics along the anterior-posterior axis.

PATO:0002025.name: external angle
PATO:0002025.def: A convex angle that is formed by one side of a polygon and a line extended from an adjacent side.

PATO:0002026.name: non-progressive
PATO:0002026.def: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not increasing over time.

PATO:0002027.name: osmolality
PATO:0002027.def: A concentration quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's amount of osmoles of solute per kilogram of solvent.

PATO:0002028.name: decreased osmolality
PATO:0002028.def: An osmolality which is relatively low.

PATO:0002029.name: increased osmolality
PATO:0002029.def: An osmolality which is relatively high.

PATO:0002030.name: specificity to
PATO:0002030.def: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability of a probe to react precisely with a specific target molecule.

PATO:0002031.name: upturned
PATO:0002031.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved or tilted such that the tip points upwards.

PATO:0002032.name: forward scatter
PATO:0002032.def: A reflectivity quality inhering in light by virtue of the bearer's scattering occurring at small angle to the incident beam.

PATO:0002033.name: side scatter
PATO:0002033.def: A reflective quality that is the light scattering occurring at wide angle (around 90 degrees) to the incident beam.

PATO:0002034.name: undivided
PATO:0002034.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being unseparated into parts or divisions.

PATO:0002035.name: ipsilateral to
PATO:0002035.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being on the same side in relation to another structure.

PATO:0002036.name: axial to
PATO:0002036.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located towards the central axis of the organism or an extremity.

PATO:0002037.name: degeneration
PATO:0002037.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting deterioration of its structure.

PATO:0002038.name: non-degenerate
PATO:0002038.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer whose structure which does not deteriorate.

PATO:0002040.name: biconvex
PATO:0002040.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being convex on both sides or surface.

PATO:0002041.name: anterior-posterior diameter
PATO:0002041.def: A diameter that is along the anterior-posterior axis.

PATO:0002042.name: decreased anterior-posterior diameter
PATO:0002042.def: An anterior-posterior diameter quality which is relatively small.

PATO:0002043.name: increased anterior-posterior diameter
PATO:0002043.def: An anterior-posterior diameter quality which is relatively large.

PATO:0002044.name: trapezoid
PATO:0002044.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being a quadrilateral with two parallel sides.

PATO:0002046.name: abaxial to
PATO:0002046.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being away from or on the opposite side of the central axis.

PATO:0002047.name: adaxial to
PATO:0002047.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located on the side nearest to the axis of an organ or organism.

PATO:0002048.name: mosaicism
PATO:0002048.def: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two or more cell populations that differ in genetic makeup. This situation can affect any type of cell, including blood cells, gametes (egg and sperm cells), and skin.

PATO:0002049.name: lateral and rotional curvature
PATO:0002049.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved around an axis and towards the side.

PATO:0002050.name: normal amount
PATO:0002050.synonym: present in normal numbers in organism

PATO:0002053.name: dorso-ventrally flattened
PATO:0002053.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flattened along dorso-ventral axis.

PATO:0002054.name: laterally compressed
PATO:0002054.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flattened along transverse axis.

PATO:0002055.name: increased fragility
PATO:0002055.def: A fragility which is relatively high.

PATO:0002056.name: decreased fragility
PATO:0002056.def: A fragility which is relatively low.

PATO:0002057.name: increased area
PATO:0002057.def: An area which is relatively high.

PATO:0002058.name: decreased area
PATO:0002058.def: An area which is relatively low.

PATO:0002059.name: emmision wavelength
PATO:0002059.def: The specific wavelength of light emitted by a fluorescent molecule, such as a labelled probe, upon absorption of light at the (higher) excitation wavelength.

PATO:0002060.name: absorption wavelength
PATO:0002060.def: The specific wavelength of radiation that can be retained by a bearer.

PATO:0002063.name: columnar
PATO:0002063.def: A shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being elongated and cylindrical.

PATO:0002065.name: star shaped
PATO:0002065.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being arranged like rays or radii; radiating from a common center.

PATO:0002066.name: crystal configuration
PATO:0002066.def: A solid configuration inhering in a material entity by virtue of its constituent atoms, molecules, or ions being arranged in an orderly repeating pattern extending in all three spatial dimensions.

PATO:0002067.name: stratification
PATO:0002067.def: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's layered configuration.

PATO:0002068.name: stratified
PATO:0002068.def: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a layered configuration.

PATO:0002069.name: unstratified
PATO:0002069.def: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking a layered configuration.

PATO:0002070.name: affinity
PATO:0002070.def: A molecular quality that arises from the molecular attraction exerted between two atoms or compounds.

PATO:0002071.name: increased affinity
PATO:0002071.def: An affinity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002072.name: decreased affinity
PATO:0002072.def: An affinity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002073.name: avidity
PATO:0002073.def: A molecular quality that arises from the synergistic strength of bond affinities between multiple bond interactions.

PATO:0002074.name: increased avidity
PATO:0002074.def: An avidity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002075.name: decreased avidity
PATO:0002075.def: An avidity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002076.name: movement behavioral quality
PATO:0002076.def: A behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's movement.

PATO:0002077.name: stacked
PATO:0002077.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned with multiple entities of the same type above and below.

PATO:0002080.name: broken into two pieces
PATO:0002080.def: A broken quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being separated into two contiguous wholes.

PATO:0002081.name: shattered
PATO:0002081.def: A broken quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being broken into multiple contiguous wholes.

PATO:0002082.name: partially broken
PATO:0002082.def: A broken quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being still one contiguous whole but structurally damaged such that in danger of become two or more.

PATO:0002084.name: obsolete post-mortem
PATO:0002084.def: The period after death of the organism.

PATO:0002085.name: obsolete pre-mortem
PATO:0002085.def: The period before death of the organism.

PATO:0002087.name: bullet-shaped
PATO:0002087.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being short and wide and tapered distally.

PATO:0002088.name: monocystic
PATO:0002088.def: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's body containing one cyst - a formation of a sac-like closed membranous structure not associated with neoplasia.

PATO:0002089.name: polycystic
PATO:0002089.def: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's body containing more than one cyst - formations of sac-like closed membranous structures not associated with neoplasia.

PATO:0002090.name: adenomatous
PATO:0002090.def: A morphology quality inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting the morphological characteristics of a glandular epithelial cell.

PATO:0002091.name: subacute
PATO:0002091.def: A quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an onset and time course between acute and chronic.

PATO:0002092.name: anaplastic
PATO:0002092.def: A morphology quality inhering in a neoplastic cell by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting breakdown of cell-cell interaction maintaining tissue architecture, proliferative dysregulation and bizarre modification to nucleus size and shape.

PATO:0002093.name: ballooning
PATO:0002093.def: A volume quality inhering in a degenerating cell by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting an increase in volume associated with cytoplasmic abnormalities.

PATO:0002095.name: obsolete neoplasm disposition
PATO:0002095.def: A disposition inhering in a tumour to progress or fail to progress during it's life time.

PATO:0002096.name: neoplastic, non-malignant
PATO:0002096.def: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition not to progress, invade surrounding tissues or metastasize.

PATO:0002098.name: neoplastic, metastatic
