PATO:0002098.def: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to spread and invade distant tissues.

PATO:0002099.name: differentiated
PATO:0002099.def: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its stable specialization to a particular cell type.

PATO:0002100.name: undifferentiated
PATO:0002100.def: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of having not yet acquired a special structure of function.

PATO:0002101.name: metaplastic
PATO:0002101.def: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of having changed from one fully differentiated state into another.

PATO:0002102.name: proliferative
PATO:0002102.def: A cellular quality inhering in a cell that arises by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability to grow and proliferate in number through cell division.

PATO:0002103.name: infiltrative
PATO:0002103.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's penetrating or permeating another substance or area.

PATO:0002104.name: inflamed
PATO:0002104.def: A compositional quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's infiltration by leukocytes, local edema and accumulation of plasma proteins.

PATO:0002105.name: hemorrhagic
PATO:0002105.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting excessive discharge of blood from the blood vessels.

PATO:0002106.name: poorly differentiated
PATO:0002106.def: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its lacking most of the cellular characteristics which would allow it to be fully differentiated.

PATO:0002107.name: peripheral
PATO:0002107.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being at the edge or boundary of a related entity.

PATO:0002108.name: papillary
PATO:0002108.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling small nipple like projection.

PATO:0002109.name: caseous
PATO:0002109.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling cheese.

PATO:0002110.name: well differentiated
PATO:0002110.def: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its having most of the cellular characteristics of the tissue of origin.

PATO:0002111.name: moderately well differentiated
PATO:0002111.def: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its lacking few of the cellular characteristics which would allow it to be fully differentiated.

PATO:0002112.name: perforate
PATO:0002112.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a hole or holes, especially a row or array of small holes.

PATO:0002114.name: fatty
PATO:0002114.def: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing excess lipid.

PATO:0002115.name: fibrinoid
PATO:0002115.def: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing fibrin.

PATO:0002116.name: fibrinopurulent
PATO:0002116.def: A composition quality inhering in exudate by virtue of the bearer's containing fibrin.

PATO:0002117.name: glandular
PATO:0002117.def: A morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhbiting the morphological characteristics of a gland.

PATO:0002118.name: multiple
PATO:0002118.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being present in more than two copies.

PATO:0002119.name: hydropic
PATO:0002119.def: A structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter exhibits an excessive accumulation of intracellular fluid.

PATO:0002120.name: suppurative
PATO:0002120.def: A quality inhering a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to generate pus.

PATO:0002121.name: trabecular
PATO:0002121.def: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's structure resembling an irregular meshwork with cross-linking struts.

PATO:0002122.name: mixed
PATO:0002122.def: A composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being composed of more than one identifiable entities.

PATO:0002123.name: minimal
PATO:0002123.def: Being smallest in amount, extent or degree.

PATO:0002125.name: nodular
PATO:0002125.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting a knot-like mass.

PATO:0002126.name: osseous
PATO:0002126.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing bone.

PATO:0002127.name: scirrhous
PATO:0002127.def: A hardness quality of being rigid and resistant to pressure and fibrous.

PATO:0002128.name: serous
PATO:0002128.def: A quality inhering a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing or resembling serum.

PATO:0002129.name: neoplastic, invasive
PATO:0002129.def: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to invade surrounding tissues.

PATO:0002130.name: neoplastic, deeply invasive
PATO:0002130.def: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to invade surrounding tissues to a large extend.

PATO:0002131.name: abduction
PATO:0002131.def: A displaced angular placement quality inhering in a body part by virtue of the bearer's movement away from the medial plane of the body.

PATO:0002132.name: neoplastic, non-invasive
PATO:0002132.def: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition not to invade surrounding tissues.

PATO:0002133.name: adduction
PATO:0002133.def: A displaced angular placement quality inhering in a body part by virtue of the bearer's movement closer the medial plane of the body.

PATO:0002134.name: fibrillary
PATO:0002134.def: A composition quaity inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing of or pertaining to fibrils, or nanoscale fibers.

PATO:0002135.name: delayed closure
PATO:0002135.def: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's delay to complete the closure of the opening of an anatomical entity.

PATO:0002136.name: radiopacity
PATO:0002136.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's relative inability of electromagnetism to pass through a particular material, particularly X-rays.

PATO:0002137.name: radiopaque
PATO:0002137.def: A radiopacity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's prevention of the passage of electromagnetic radiation.

PATO:0002138.name: edibility
PATO:0002138.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being fit to be eaten.

PATO:0002139.name: edible
PATO:0002139.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being suitable for use as food.

PATO:0002140.name: inedible
PATO:0002140.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer not being suitable for use as food.

PATO:0002141.name: irregular density
PATO:0002141.def: A density quality which lacks pattern.

PATO:0002144.name: increased radiopacity
PATO:0002144.def: A radiopacity that is relatively high.

PATO:0002145.name: decreased radiopacity
PATO:0002145.def: A radiopacity that is relatively low.

PATO:0002146.name: virulence
PATO:0002146.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the severity of infectious disease caused by the bearer in a target organism.

PATO:0002147.name: reduced virulence
PATO:0002147.def: A virulence that is relatively low.

PATO:0002148.name: increased virulence
PATO:0002148.def: A virulence that is relatively high.

PATO:0002149.name: ivory
PATO:0002149.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting increased density resulting in exhibiting increased degree of radiopacity (in X-rays).

PATO:0002150.name: splayed caudal
PATO:0002150.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards from the part of the body from which the tail arises.

PATO:0002151.name: splayed dorsal
PATO:0002151.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards from the back or upper surface of an organism.

PATO:0002152.name: splayed lateral
PATO:0002152.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards from the side.

PATO:0002153.name: splayed rostral
PATO:0002153.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards the front of an organism.

PATO:0002154.name: splayed ventral
PATO:0002154.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards the abdomen of an organism.

PATO:0002155.name: medially rotated
PATO:0002155.def: A rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the middle of an organism.

PATO:0002156.name: laterally rotated
PATO:0002156.def: A rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the side of an organism.

PATO:0002157.name: partially dislocated
PATO:0002157.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being slightly out of its usual or proper place, or position.

PATO:0002161.name: bicornuate
PATO:0002161.def: Having two horns or horn-shaped branches.

PATO:0002162.name: high-arched
PATO:0002162.def: A concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming or resembling an arch of an increased apical height.

PATO:0002163.name: herniated into
PATO:0002163.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bodily structure that has protruded through an abnormal opening in the wall that contains it into the surface or boundary of another entity.

PATO:0002164.name: curved medial
PATO:0002164.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the middle.

PATO:0002166.name: premature closure
PATO:0002166.def: A duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's premature completion of the closure of the opening of an anatomical entity.

PATO:0002167.name: herniated out of
PATO:0002167.def: A protruding quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bodily structure that has protruded out of the surface or boundary of another entity.

PATO:0002168.name: displaced to
PATO:0002168.def: An angular placement quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being changed in position in relation to another entity.

PATO:0002169.name: split medially
PATO:0002169.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split along the median axis.

PATO:0002170.name: split laterally
PATO:0002170.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split asymmetrically on one side.

PATO:0002171.name: split bilaterally
PATO:0002171.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split on two side.

PATO:0002172.name: split radially
PATO:0002172.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split along the radial axis.

PATO:0002173.name: misaligned towards
PATO:0002173.def: An alignment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in a improper spatial positioning towards an additional entity.

PATO:0002174.name: misaligned away from
PATO:0002174.def: An alignment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in a improper spatial positioning away from an additional entity.

PATO:0002175.name: spatial deviation
PATO:0002175.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changed direction of position towards another entity.

PATO:0002176.name: deviation towards the lateral side
PATO:0002176.def: A deviation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changed direction of position towards the side.

PATO:0002177.name: deviation towards the medial side
PATO:0002177.def: A deviation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changed direction of position towards the middle.

PATO:0002178.name: mislocalised radially
PATO:0002178.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being out of its usual or proper place, or position around a central point or axis.

PATO:0002179.name: mislocalised proximally
PATO:0002179.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards to point of attachment or origin.

PATO:0002180.name: straight
PATO:0002180.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being free of curves, bends, or angles.

PATO:0002181.name: displaced
PATO:0002181.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's being changed in position.

PATO:0002182.name: molecular quality
PATO:0002182.def: A quality which inheres in a molecular entity, a single molecule, atom, ion, radical etc.

PATO:0002183.name: cyclicity
PATO:0002183.def: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of whether that there is a presence of cycles in the connection of the atoms within the molecular entity.

PATO:0002184.name: cyclic cyclicity
PATO:0002184.def: Cyclic cyclicity inheres in a molecule when the atoms of the molecule do contain at least one cycle in the atom-atom connection paths (through bonds).

PATO:0002185.name: acyclic cyclicity
PATO:0002185.def: Acyclic cyclicity inheres in a molecule when the atoms within the molecule do not contain at least one cycle in the atom-atom connection paths (through the bonds).

PATO:0002186.name: polarity
PATO:0002186.def: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of whether or not the molecular entity has a separation of electric charge which leads to the molecule having an electric dipole.

PATO:0002187.name: polar polarity
PATO:0002187.def: Polar polarity is a quality that inheres in a molecular entity when the molecular entity is polar, i.e. does possess an electric dipole.

PATO:0002188.name: nonpolar polarity
PATO:0002188.def: A molecular quality which inheres in a molecular entity when the molecular entity does not possess an electrical dipole.

PATO:0002189.name: electric polarizability
PATO:0002189.def: The ease of distortion of the electron cloud of a molecular entity by an electric field.

PATO:0002190.name: aromaticity
PATO:0002190.def: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the presence of a conjugated ring of unsaturated bonds, lone pairs, or empty orbitals that exhibit a stabilization stronger than would be expected by the stabilization of conjugation alone.

PATO:0002191.name: aromatic
PATO:0002191.def: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity when it possesses at least one ring that is aromatic, i.e. A conjugated ring of unsaturated bonds, lone pairs, or empty orbitals that exhibit a stabilization stronger than would be expected by the stabilization of conjugation alone.

PATO:0002192.name: non-aromatic
PATO:0002192.def: A quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecule possessing no rings that are aromatic.

PATO:0002193.name: electric charge
PATO:0002193.def: A molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the overall electric charge of the molecule, which is due to a comparison between the total number of electrons and the total number of protons.

PATO:0002194.name: neutral charge
PATO:0002194.def: A quality which inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecular entity possessing the same amount of electrons overall as protons, thus having an overall neutral charge.

PATO:0002195.name: positive charge
PATO:0002195.def: A quality which inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecular entity possessing more protons overall than electrons, thus having an overall positive charge.

PATO:0002196.name: negative charge
PATO:0002196.def: A quality which inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecular entity possessing more electrons overall than protons, thus having an overall negative charge.

PATO:0002197.name: electronegativity
PATO:0002197.def: A quality that describes the power of an atom to attract electrons to itself .

PATO:0002199.name: meltability
PATO:0002199.def: A quality which inheres in a substance by virtue of the ease with which the substance can be changed from a solid to a liquid state especially by the application of heat.

PATO:0002200.name: vaporizability
PATO:0002200.def: A quality which inheres in a substance by virtue of the ease with which the substance can be changed into a gaseous state.

PATO:0002201.name: handedness
PATO:0002201.def: A behavioral quality inhering ina bearer by virtue of the bearer's unequal distribution of fine motor skill between its left and right hands or feet.

PATO:0002202.name: left handedness
PATO:0002202.def: Handedness where the organism preferentially uses the left hand or foot for tasks requiring the use of a single hand or foot or a dominant hand or foot.

PATO:0002203.name: right handedness
PATO:0002203.def: Handedness where the organism preferentially uses the right hand or foot for tasks requiring the use of a single hand or foot or a dominant hand or foot.

PATO:0002204.name: ambidextrous handedness
PATO:0002204.def: Handedness where the organism exhibits no overall dominance in the use of right or left hand or foot in the performance of tasks that require one hand or foot or a dominant hand or foot.

PATO:0002205.name: capacitance
PATO:0002205.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to hold an electrical charge.

PATO:0002206.name: neonatal
PATO:0002206.def: A maturity quality inhering to a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being at the point or short after birth.

PATO:0002207.name: insertion depth
PATO:0002207.def: A quality that is the distance between the end of the inserted object and the surface of the object into which it penetrates.

PATO:0002208.name: spoon-shaped
PATO:0002208.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of a spoon.

PATO:0002209.name: incisiform
PATO:0002209.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the shape of an incisor tooth.

PATO:0002210.name: bulbous
PATO:0002210.def: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a teardrop.

PATO:0002211.name: recurved
PATO:0002211.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved backward or inward.

PATO:0002212.name: slender
PATO:0002212.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being small or narrow in circumference or width in proportion to length or height.

PATO:0002213.name: obclavate
PATO:0002213.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape being inversely clavate.

PATO:0002214.name: bilobed
PATO:0002214.def: A lobed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided into or having two lobes.

PATO:0002215.name: falciform
PATO:0002215.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the shape of a scythe or sickle.

PATO:0002216.name: ubiquinated
PATO:0002216.def: A molecular quality that pertains to the post-translational modification of a protein by the covalent attachment of one or more ubiquitin monomer.

PATO:0002217.name: nitrated
PATO:0002217.def: A molecular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being combined, or impregnated, with nitric acid, or some of its compounds.

PATO:0002218.name: demyelinated
PATO:0002218.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's loss of myelin sheath.

PATO:0002219.name: fan-shaped
PATO:0002219.def: A quality inhering in a bearer that is shaped in the form of a fan.

PATO:0002220.name: phosphorylated
PATO:0002220.def: A quality inhering in a protein or a molecule by virtue of the bearer's having a phosphate (PO4) group.

PATO:0002221.name: increased phosphorylation
PATO:0002221.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being phosphorylated to a more than normal extent, or fully saturated with phosphate groups.

PATO:0002222.name: decreased phosphorylation
PATO:0002222.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being phosphorylated to a lesser than normal extent, or less than fully.

PATO:0002223.name: oxidized
PATO:0002223.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having reacted with oxygen, or been modified by oxidation (the reaction in which the atoms of an element lose electrons and the valence of the element increases).

PATO:0002224.name: V-shaped
PATO:0002224.def: An angular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a single angle in its length giving the bearer the form of the letter V.

PATO:0002225.name: L-shaped
PATO:0002225.def: An angular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a single angle in its length giving the bearer the form of the letter L.

PATO:0002227.name: cup-shaped
PATO:0002227.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape form resembling the shape of a cup.

PATO:0002228.name: acuminate
PATO:0002228.def: A tapered shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's tapering gradually to a sharp point.

PATO:0002229.name: subrectangular
PATO:0002229.def: A quadrangular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being approximately rectangular.

PATO:0002230.name: subtriangular
PATO:0002230.def: A triangular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being nearly, but not perfectly, triangular.

PATO:0002231.name: multifid
PATO:0002231.def: A split shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or being divided into many lobes or similar segments.

PATO:0002232.name: semicircular
PATO:0002232.def: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having shape or form of half a circle.

PATO:0002233.name: far from
PATO:0002233.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located far (not close to) in space in relation to another entity.

PATO:0002234.name: emarginate
PATO:0002234.def: A notched shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a notched tip or edge.

PATO:0002235.name: blade-like
PATO:0002235.def: A tapered shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flat, slender, and tapering to a point.

PATO:0002236.name: aliform
PATO:0002236.def: Shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a wing.

PATO:0002237.name: retrorse
PATO:0002237.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved backward or downward.

PATO:0002238.name: antrorse
PATO:0002238.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved forward or upward.

PATO:0002239.name: hourglass-shaped
PATO:0002239.def: A concave 3-D shape that inheres in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's nearly) symmetric shape wide at its ends and narrow in the middle, resembling the figure of number 8.

PATO:0002240.name: teardrop-shaped
PATO:0002240.def: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape resembling falling drop.

PATO:0002241.name: trilobed
PATO:0002241.def: A lobed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided into or having three lobes.

PATO:0002242.name: velocity
PATO:0002242.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's rate of change of the position.

PATO:0002243.name: fluid flow rate
PATO:0002243.def: A physical quality inhering in a fluid (liquid or gas) by virtue of the amount of fluid which passes through a given surface per unit time.

PATO:0002244.name: mass flow rate
PATO:0002244.def: A flow rate quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the mass of substance which passes through a given surface per unit time.

PATO:0002246.name: decreased force
PATO:0002246.def: A force which is relative low.

PATO:0002247.name: degree of pigmentation
PATO:0002247.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or lacking of substances produced by living organisms that have a color resulting from selective color absorption.

PATO:0002248.name: pigmented
PATO:0002248.def: A degree of pigmentation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having substances produced by living organisms that have a color resulting from selective color absorption.

PATO:0002249.name: unpigmented
PATO:0002249.def: A degree of pigmentation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking substances produced by living organisms that have a color resulting from selective color absorption.

PATO:0002250.name: increased pigmentation
PATO:0002250.def: A degree of pigmentation quality that is relatively high.

PATO:0002251.name: decreased pigmentation
PATO:0002251.def: A degree of pigmentation quality that is relative low.

PATO:0002252.name: antero-posteriorly flattened
PATO:0002252.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flattened along the antero-posterior axis.

PATO:0002253.name: platelike
PATO:0002253.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being roundish, flattish shape, possibly with a slightly angled edge.

PATO:0002256.name: tricuspidate
PATO:0002256.def: A cuscpidate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer possessing three cusps.

PATO:0002257.name: multicuspidate
PATO:0002257.def: A cuscpidate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer possessing more than one cusp.

PATO:0002258.name: pointed
PATO:0002258.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a point.

PATO:0002259.name: adjacent to
PATO:0002259.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located near in space in relation to another entity.

PATO:0002260.name: semi erect
PATO:0002260.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being partially upright in position or posture.

PATO:0002261.name: located in
PATO:0002261.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location within another entity.

PATO:0002262.name: phosphorylation
PATO:0002262.def: A quality inhering in a protein or a molecule by virtue of the addition of a phosphate (PO4) group to the bearer.

PATO:0002263.name: dephosphorylated
PATO:0002263.def: A quality inhering in a protein or a molecule by virtue of the bearer's lacking a phosphate (PO4) group.

PATO:0002264.name: organization quality
PATO:0002264.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being arranged in a systematic fashion.

PATO:0002265.name: behavioural activity
PATO:0002265.def: A behavioral quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to exhibit marked activity.

PATO:0002268.name: centered
PATO:0002268.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located in a position equidistant from edges.

PATO:0002269.name: accumulation
PATO:0002269.def: A structural quality of the collection or massing of one physical object within another physical object.

PATO:0002270.name: increased accumulation
PATO:0002270.def: An increased number of physical objects that are accumulated within another physical object usually as a result of a failure to break down or remove objects in a timely manner.

PATO:0002271.name: decreased accumulation
PATO:0002271.def: An accumulation which is relative low.

PATO:0002272.name: parallel to
PATO:0002272.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at the same continuous distance relative to another object.

PATO:0002273.name: marbled
PATO:0002273.def: Multicolored quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being colored with a variegated pattern resembling marble,.

PATO:0002274.name: mottled
PATO:0002274.def: Multicolored quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being dappled with spots, patches, or blotches of different colors.

PATO:0002275.name: high contrast color pattern
PATO:0002275.def: A color pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's color pattern in which light and dark colors (for example white and black) are codistributed to create a visual impression.

PATO:0002276.name: barred
PATO:0002276.def: A color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's exhibiting vertical bars of one hue or degree of saturation crossing another.

PATO:0002277.name: iridescent
PATO:0002277.def: A quality of certain surfaces which appear to change colour as the angle of view changes.

PATO:0002278.name: articulated with
PATO:0002278.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's participating in a joint with another entity.

PATO:0002279.name: tightly articulated with
PATO:0002279.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being strongly articulated with another entity.

PATO:0002280.name: broadly articulated with
PATO:0002280.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing a broad surface in articulation with another entity.

PATO:0002281.name: biscupidate
PATO:0002281.def: A cuscpidate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer possessing two cusps.

PATO:0002282.name: increased mobility
PATO:0002282.def: A mobility which is relative high.

PATO:0002283.name: decreased mobility
PATO:0002283.def: A mobility which is relative low.

PATO:0002284.name: tension
PATO:0002284.def: A physical quality that pertains by virtue of a pulling force that is directed away from the bearer and attempts to stretch or elongate the bearer.

PATO:0002285.name: increased branchiness
PATO:0002285.def: Branchiness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of increasing the degree to which there are subdivisions or offshoots in a bearer entity.

PATO:0002286.name: decreased branchiness
PATO:0002286.def: Branchiness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of decreasing the degree to which there are subdivisions or offshoots in a bearer entity.

PATO:0002289.name: setose
PATO:0002289.def: A hairy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered with setae.

PATO:0002290.name: aplastic/hypoplastic
PATO:0002290.def: Decreased size or absence of organ, tissue or cell due to a reduction in cell numbers.

PATO:0002291.name: agenesis
PATO:0002291.def: Absence of a tissue or organ due to failure to develop.

PATO:0002292.name: transient
PATO:0002292.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's underlying structure being capable of change.

PATO:0002293.name: permanent
PATO:0002293.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's underlying structure not changing over time.

PATO:0002294.name: scrobiculate
PATO:0002294.def: A texture that is uniformly covered in short, oblong, or trench-like depressions.

PATO:0002295.name: areolate
PATO:0002295.def: A surface feature shape inhering in a surface by virtue of the bearer's being divided by ridge-like structures into a number of small, irregular spaces.

PATO:0002296.name: foveate
PATO:0002296.def: A texture quality inhering in a surface by virtue of the bearer's being marked by the presence of small, shallow, regular depressions called fovae.

PATO:0002297.name: decreased cellular motility
PATO:0002297.def: A cellular motility which is lower relative to the normal or average.

PATO:0002298.name: increased cellular motility
PATO:0002298.def: A cellular motility which is higher relative to the normal or average.

PATO:0002306.name: equilateral triangular
PATO:0002306.def: A triangular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having all sides of the same length.

PATO:0002307.name: isosceles triangular
PATO:0002307.def: A triangular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two sides have the same length.

PATO:0002308.name: scalene triangular
PATO:0002308.def: A triangular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having all sides of unequal length.

PATO:0002310.name: robust
PATO:0002310.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being strong, thick or sturdy.

PATO:0002311.name: fimbriated
PATO:0002311.def: Having a fringe or border of hairlike or fingerlike projections.

PATO:0002312.name: segmented
PATO:0002312.def: Consisting of segments or similar parts arranged in a longitudinal series.

PATO:0002313.name: telescopic
PATO:0002313.def: Having or resembling the shape of a telescope.

PATO:0002314.name: ligamentous
PATO:0002314.def: Having the nature or characteristic of, a ligament; composed of the tissue proper to ligaments.

PATO:0002315.name: brush-like shape
PATO:0002315.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling the end of a brush with a multitude of bristles.

PATO:0002316.name: autogenous
PATO:0002316.def: Being separate or discrete from other skeletal elements.

PATO:0002319.name: squircle
PATO:0002319.def: A shape with properties between those of a square and those of a circle.

PATO:0002320.name: diamond shaped
PATO:0002320.def: A superelliptic shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape resembling a diamond.

PATO:0002324.name: offset quality
PATO:0002324.def: The temporal relation between the end of the process with respect to a reference process.

PATO:0002325.name: onset quality
PATO:0002325.def: The temporal relation between the start of the process with respect to a reference process.

PATO:0002326.name: angle
PATO:0002326.def: An orientation inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's placement at an angle.

PATO:0002327.name: increased angle to
PATO:0002327.def: An angle which is relatively high.

PATO:0002328.name: decreased angle to
PATO:0002328.def: An angle which is relatively low.

PATO:0002329.name: hyponastic
PATO:0002329.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a upward bending of its leaves or other plant parts.

PATO:0002330.name: oblanceolate
PATO:0002330.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being extended along a straight line, and is shaped like a reversed lance-point, with the tapering point attached to the leafstalk.

PATO:0002331.name: adhesive
PATO:0002331.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting molecular attraction to another entity in contact.

PATO:0002332.name: non-adhesive
PATO:0002332.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer not exhibiting molecular attraction to another entity in contact.

PATO:0002333.name: increased adhesivity
PATO:0002333.def: A adhesivity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002334.name: decreased adhesivity
PATO:0002334.def: A adhesivity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002335.name: tholiform
PATO:0002335.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being dome-shaped.

PATO:0002336.name: pyramidal
PATO:0002336.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having triangular faces that meet at a common point and containing a polygonal shaped base.

PATO:0002337.name: lance-ovate
PATO:0002337.def: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a continuous convex surface with an axis of symmetry and one axis longer than the other; characterized with an egg-shaped form crossed with a lance-head shaped form.

PATO:0002338.name: lanceolate-triangular
PATO:0002338.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a lance-head, considerably longer than wide, tapering towards the tip from below the middle together forming three angles; attached at the broad end.

PATO:0002339.name: hispid
PATO:0002339.def: A quality of being covered with stiff or rough hairs.

PATO:0002340.name: hispidulous
PATO:0002340.def: A quality of being minutely hispid.

PATO:0002341.name: tomentose
PATO:0002341.def: A quality of being covered with short, dense, matted hairs.

PATO:0002342.name: cupulate
PATO:0002342.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being a cupule, with a structure similar to a cup that also encloses the ovule in partiality.

PATO:0002343.name: decumbent
PATO:0002343.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lying or growing on the ground but with erect or rising tips.

PATO:0002344.name: arachnose
PATO:0002344.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being characterized by fine, entangled hairs giving the appearance of cobweb.

PATO:0002345.name: lemon-shaped
PATO:0002345.def: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a quadric surface in three dimensions obtained by rotating less than half of a circular arc about an axis passing through the endpoints of the arc

PATO:0002346.name: snowman-shaped
PATO:0002346.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two connected parts, roughly spherical, of different sizes.

PATO:0002347.name: obconical
PATO:0002347.def: A conical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a cone, with the pointed end attached to an organism.

PATO:0002348.name: ligneous
PATO:0002348.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer resembling wood.

PATO:0002349.name: basal to
PATO:0002349.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the base of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0002350.name: cauline to
PATO:0002350.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the stalk of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0002351.name: fleshy
PATO:0002351.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer resembling or containing flesh.

PATO:0002352.name: herbaceous
PATO:0002352.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's upper parts die back to the rootstock at the end of the growing season.

PATO:0002355.name: inactive
PATO:0002355.def: A quality of a physical object that is currently realizing none of its functions.

PATO:0002356.name: constitutively active
PATO:0002356.def: A quality of a physical object that has been constantly realizing some of its functions.

PATO:0002357.name: D-shaped
PATO:0002357.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a strait side and an arched side giving the bearer the form of the letter D.

PATO:0002358.name: ridged
PATO:0002358.def: An elongated raised margin or border.

PATO:0002359.name: broad
PATO:0002359.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's width being notably higher than its length.

PATO:0002360.name: tendency
PATO:0002360.def: A disposition that can be compared on a linear scale - that is that it can be increased or decreased.

PATO:0002361.name: increased tendency
PATO:0002361.def: A tendency which is relatively high.

PATO:0002362.name: decreased tendency
PATO:0002362.def: A tendency which is relatively low.

PATO:0002363.name: bronze
PATO:0002363.def: A medium brown color with a metallic sheen, resembles the actual alloy bronze.

PATO:0002364.name: shortened
PATO:0002364.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's length being notably lower than its width.

PATO:0002365.name: intact female
PATO:0002365.def: Female quality of having complete, unaltered reproductive organs

PATO:0002366.name: intact male
PATO:0002366.def: Male quality of having complete, unaltered reproductive organs.

PATO:0002367.name: castrated male
PATO:0002367.def: Male quality of being incapable to reproduce because of functional loss of the testicles from surgical removal or chemical means.

PATO:0002368.name: nulliparous
PATO:0002368.def: A viviparous organism having never given birth.

PATO:0002369.name: multiparous
PATO:0002369.def: A viviparous organism that has given birth two or more times.

PATO:0002370.name: parity
PATO:0002370.def: The number of time that a viviparous organism has given birth.

PATO:0002371.name: primiparous
PATO:0002371.def: A viviparous organism having given birth one time.

PATO:0002372.name: grand multiparous
PATO:0002372.def: A viviparous organism that has given birth five or more times.

PATO:0002373.name: mediolateral polarity
PATO:0002373.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location of features or characteristics along the mediolateral axis.

PATO:0002374.name: fluctuating
PATO:0002374.def: Recurrent and often more or less cyclic alteration.

PATO:0002375.name: trumpet-shaped
PATO:0002375.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape form resembling the shape of a trumpet.

PATO:0002376.name: inflated
PATO:0002376.def: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being filled with air.

PATO:0002377.name: uninflated
PATO:0002377.def: A structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being not filed with air.

PATO:0002378.name: acinus
PATO:0002378.def: Having a shape that resembles a many-lobed \

PATO:0002379.name: ovariohysterectomized female
PATO:0002379.def: A female fertility quality inhering in a female by virtue of the bearer's not being capable of reproducing because of surgical removal of ovaries and uterus.

PATO:0002380.name: ovariectomized female
PATO:0002380.def: A female fertility quality inhering in a female by virtue of the bearer's not being capable of reproducing because of surgical removal of ovaries.

PATO:0002381.name: waxiness
PATO:0002381.def: A composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the presence of long chain aliphatic lipids on the surface of an organism.

PATO:0002382.name: increased waxiness
PATO:0002382.def: A waxiness which is relatively high.

PATO:0002383.name: decreased waxiness
PATO:0002383.def: A waxiness which is relatively low.

PATO:0002384.name: waxy
PATO:0002384.def: Presence of long chain aliphatic lipids on the surface of an organism.

PATO:0002385.name: striate-angular
PATO:0002385.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines, usually parallel, with at least one salient angle on the margin

PATO:0002386.name: anvil
PATO:0002386.def: A concave 3-D shape that inheres in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape that is wider at one end and narrow in the middle.

PATO:0002387.name: peracute
PATO:0002387.def: Extremely acute and aggressive onset of a pathological process.

PATO:0002388.name: pedunculate
PATO:0002388.def: Being supported by a peduncle or stalk.

PATO:0002389.name: procumbent
PATO:0002389.def: Growing horizontal to the ground without setting roots.

PATO:0002390.name: radius
PATO:0002390.def: A length quality which is equal to the length of any straight line segment that passes from the center of a circle to any endpoint on the circular boundary. The radius is half of the diameter.

PATO:0002391.name: triradiate
PATO:0002391.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three rays or radiating branches.

PATO:0002392.name: diagonal to
PATO:0002392.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located on a sloping line joining two nonconsecutive points of an entity relative to another entity.

PATO:0002393.name: increased tolerance to
PATO:0002393.def: A tolerance quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's increased ability to endure a stimulus.

PATO:0002394.name: decreased tolerance to
PATO:0002394.def: A tolerance quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decreased ability to endure a stimulus.

PATO:0002395.name: mislocalized abaxially
PATO:0002395.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned away from the axis of an organism.

PATO:0002396.name: mislocalized adaxially
PATO:0002396.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the axis of an organism.

PATO:0002397.name: subcircular
PATO:0002397.def: A circular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being nearly, but not perfectly, circular.

PATO:0002399.name: anteromedially rotated
PATO:0002399.def: A rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the front and the middle of an organism.

PATO:0002400.name: fusiform
PATO:0002400.def: Having a spindle-like shape that is wide in the middle and tapers at both ends.

PATO:0002402.name: multifocal to coalescing
PATO:0002402.def: Multiple lesions some interconnecting with each other.

PATO:0002403.name: generalized
PATO:0002403.def: Affecting all regions without specificity of distribution.

PATO:0002405.name: friability
PATO:0002405.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to be reduced to smaller pieces with little effort.

PATO:0002406.name: friable
PATO:0002406.def: Easily reduced to powder or easily fragmentable or crumbly.

PATO:0002407.name: indurated
PATO:0002407.def: Having become firm or hard especially by increase of fibrous elements.

PATO:0002410.name: beige
PATO:0002410.def: A colour that is very pale yellowish brown.

PATO:0002411.name: yellow brown
PATO:0002411.def: A color consisting of yellow and brown hue.

PATO:0002412.name: dark yellow brown
PATO:0002412.def: A color consisting of yellow and brown hue and low brightness.

PATO:0002413.name: light yellow brown
PATO:0002413.def: A color consisting of yellow and brown hue and high brightness.

PATO:0002414.name: chronic-active
PATO:0002414.def: A quality of duration having progressive course of indefinite duration with active, acute-like elements.

PATO:0002415.name: focally extensive
PATO:0002415.def: Single lesion with expansion into surrounding tissue.

PATO:0002416.name: sunken
PATO:0002416.def: Flattened from above downward; below the normal level or the level of the surrounding parts.

PATO:0002417.name: transmural
PATO:0002417.def: Extending through or affecting the entire thickness of the wall of an organ or cavity or boundary.

PATO:0002419.name: obsolete eosinophilic
PATO:0002419.def: OBSOLETE. An affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction for eosin dye.

PATO:0002421.name: cicatricial
PATO:0002421.def: Having or resembling the characteristic of a cicatrix - a scar resulting from formation and contraction of fibrous tissue.

PATO:0002423.name: papillomatous
PATO:0002423.def: A round or lobulated protruding form resembling a nipple.

PATO:0002424.name: divergent from
PATO:0002424.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two or more entities that extend from a common point in different directions.

PATO:0002425.name: exposed
PATO:0002425.def: Open to view or not covered by another entity.

PATO:0002426.name: scaphoid
PATO:0002426.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a boat.

PATO:0002427.name: knobbled
PATO:0002427.def: A surface feature shape having numerous very small circular rounded projections or protuberances.

PATO:0002428.name: tripodal
PATO:0002428.def: A 3-D shape with three supports or legs.

PATO:0002429.name: x-shaped
PATO:0002429.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter X.

PATO:0002430.name: strap-shaped
PATO:0002430.def: A shape quality in which the bearer is shaped like a narrow band; ligulate.

PATO:0002431.name: waisted
PATO:0002431.def: A shape quality in which the bearer possesses a gradual, yet distinct, thinning from a wide starting point.

PATO:0002432.name: spade-shaped
PATO:0002432.def: A shape that is in the form of a spade.

PATO:0002433.name: sculpted surface
PATO:0002433.def: A surface feature shape marked by large amounts of relief, often with multiple ridges and grooves in close association. Topographically complex.

PATO:0002434.name: perpendicular to
PATO:0002434.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at a right angle relative to another entity.

PATO:0002435.name: abutting
PATO:0002435.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer touching another entity along a border or with a projecting part.

PATO:0002436.name: offset
PATO:0002436.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's position being displaced from a reference point.

PATO:0002437.name: interlocked with
PATO:0002437.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being locked together or interconnected to another entity.

PATO:0002438.name: subdermal
PATO:0002438.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located or placed beneath the skin.

PATO:0002439.name: w-shaped
PATO:0002439.def: An angular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two angles in its length giving the bearer the form of the letter W.

PATO:0002440.name: ornamentation
PATO:0002440.def: A surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the degree of the bearer's highly topographical with ridges, pits, rugosity or other surface structures.

PATO:0002441.name: ornamented
PATO:0002441.def: A surface feature shape in which the bearer's surface is highly topographical with ridges, pits, rugosity or other surface structures.

PATO:0002442.name: unornamented
PATO:0002442.def: A surface feature shape in which the bearer's surface is lacking ridges, pits, rugosity or other surface structures.

PATO:0002443.name: level with
PATO:0002443.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at the same level as another entity.

PATO:0002445.name: torsioned
PATO:0002445.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being twisted or turned.

PATO:0002446.name: anchor-shaped
PATO:0002446.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape resembling an anchor.

PATO:0002447.name: quadripartite
PATO:0002447.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being divided into four parts.

PATO:0002448.name: oriented towards
PATO:0002448.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being aligned or positioned towards another entity.

PATO:0002449.name: posteromedial to
PATO:0002449.def: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear and mid-line surface of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0002450.name: firm
PATO:0002450.def: A hardness quality of giving significant resistance to pressure.

PATO:0002451.name: sexually dimorphic
PATO:0002451.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a phenotypic difference between males and females of the same species.

PATO:0002452.name: decondensed
PATO:0002452.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being thinner or more loosely packed.

PATO:0002453.name: eroding
PATO:0002453.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer bring gradually worn away.

PATO:0002454.name: carpel-like
PATO:0002454.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a carpel.

PATO:0002455.name: corymb-like
PATO:0002455.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's architecture bearing resemblence to a corymb type of inflorescence.

PATO:0002456.name: inflorescence-like
PATO:0002456.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of an inflorescence.

PATO:0002457.name: leaf-like
PATO:0002457.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a leaf.

PATO:0002458.name: pin-like
PATO:0002458.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being thin and lacking outgrowths.

PATO:0002459.name: sepal-like
PATO:0002459.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a sepal,

PATO:0002460.name: shriveled
PATO:0002460.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being smaller and contracted, especially due to loss of moisture.

PATO:0002461.name: wilty
PATO:0002461.def: To bend or hang downwards due to loss of water

PATO:0002463.name: extends to
PATO:0002463.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of some aspect of the bearer extending to the position of another entity.

PATO:0002464.name: extends beyond
PATO:0002464.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of some aspect of the bearer extending past the position of another entity.

PATO:0002465.name: prism shaped
PATO:0002465.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a prism.

PATO:0002466.name: keyhole shaped
PATO:0002466.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer resembling a keyhole.

PATO:0002467.name: lathlike
PATO:0002467.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer resembling a thin narrow strip.

PATO:0002469.name: sutured to
PATO:0002469.def: Structural quality inhering in a bearer in which a joint has apposed bony surfaces united by fibrous tissue, permitting no movement; found only between bones.

PATO:0002470.name: transformed to
PATO:0002470.def: A morphological quality between two bearers inhering that one bearer is subject to change the nature, function, or condition of itself to become the other.

PATO:0002471.name: increased velocity
PATO:0002471.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's increased rate of change of the position.

PATO:0002472.name: decreased velocity
PATO:0002472.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decreased rate of change of the position.

PATO:0002473.name: neoplastic, spontaneous
PATO:0002473.def: A disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to spontaneously arise.

PATO:0002474.name: bitter
PATO:0002474.def: A flavor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an acrid, sharp, or disagreeable flavor.

PATO:0002475.name: subterminal
PATO:0002475.def: A position quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's existing near the end of another entity.

PATO:0002476.name: terminal
PATO:0002476.def: A position quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming the end of another entity.

PATO:0002477.name: brittle
PATO:0002477.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to breaks without significant deformation (strain) when subjected to stress.

PATO:0002480.name: poorly ossified
PATO:0002480.def: A quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing only minor levels of ossification.

PATO:0002481.name: oblique orientation
PATO:0002481.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a slanting direction or position : neither perpendicular nor parallel.

PATO:0002482.name: slit-like
PATO:0002482.def: Shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a narrow and elongate opening.

PATO:0002483.name: external to
PATO:0002483.def: Positional quality in which an entity is located outside of another entity.

PATO:0002484.name: inverted-V shaped
PATO:0002484.def: An angular shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a single angle in its length giving the bearer the form of an inverted letter V.

PATO:0002485.name: parallel-sided
PATO:0002485.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing two sides that are at the same continuous distance relative to each other.

PATO:0002486.name: multi-organismal process quality
PATO:0002486.def: A quality inhering in a process by virtue of that process having two or more organisms as participants.

PATO:0002487.name: single organismal process quality
PATO:0002487.def: A quality inhering in a process by virtue of that process having exactly one organism as a participant.

PATO:0002488.name: overlapping
PATO:0002488.def: Overlap with quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned over another entity so as to cover some portion of it.

PATO:0002489.name: overlapped by
PATO:0002489.def: Overlap with quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned under another entity so as to be covered by some portion of it.

PATO:0002490.name: anterior orientation
PATO:0002490.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anteriorly.

PATO:0002491.name: anterodorsal orientation
PATO:0002491.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anterodorsally.

PATO:0002492.name: anterolateral orientation
PATO:0002492.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anterolaterally.

PATO:0002493.name: anteroventral orientation
PATO:0002493.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anteroventrally.

PATO:0002494.name: distal orientation
PATO:0002494.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed distally.

PATO:0002495.name: dorsal orientation
PATO:0002495.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed dorsally.

PATO:0002496.name: dorsolateral orientation
PATO:0002496.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed dorsolaterally.

PATO:0002497.name: lateral orientation
PATO:0002497.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed laterally.

PATO:0002498.name: medial orientation
PATO:0002498.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed medially.

PATO:0002499.name: posterior orientation
PATO:0002499.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posteriorly.

PATO:0002500.name: ventrolaterally orientation
PATO:0002500.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed ventrolaterally.

PATO:0002501.name: ventral orientation
PATO:0002501.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed ventrally.

PATO:0002502.name: transverse orientation
PATO:0002502.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed transversely.

PATO:0002503.name: posterolateral orientation
PATO:0002503.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posterolaterally.

PATO:0002504.name: posterodorsal orientation
PATO:0002504.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posterodorsally.

PATO:0002508.name: concealed
PATO:0002508.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being hidden from view.

PATO:0002509.name: hexagonal
PATO:0002509.def: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having six angles and six sides.

PATO:0002510.name: multipartite
PATO:0002510.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being divided into multiple parts.

PATO:0002511.name: cane-like
PATO:0002511.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a cane.

PATO:0002512.name: confluent with
PATO:0002512.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer flowing or coming together with another entity.

PATO:0002513.name: oblique to
PATO:0002513.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a slanting direction (neither perpendicular nor parallel) relative to another entity.

PATO:0002514.name: anteromedial orientation
PATO:0002514.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anteromedially.

PATO:0002515.name: increased elevation relative to
PATO:0002515.def: An elevation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's being in a high position relative to another entity.

PATO:0002516.name: concealed by
PATO:0002516.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being hidden from view or covered by another entity.

PATO:0002517.name: saddle-shaped
PATO:0002517.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a saddle.

PATO:0002518.name: flush
PATO:0002518.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being level or even with another surface.

PATO:0002519.name: cancellous
PATO:0002519.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an open, latticed, or porous structure; used especially of bone.

PATO:0002520.name: scute-like
PATO:0002520.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being shaped like a scute or an osteoderm.

PATO:0002521.name: funnel-shaped
PATO:0002521.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a funnel.

PATO:0002522.name: keel-shaped
PATO:0002522.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having an elongate structure, similar to a ridge, that extends longitudinally along an anatomical entity.

PATO:0002523.name: vertical to
PATO:0002523.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at a right angle relative to another entity and to the horizon.

PATO:0002524.name: mesiolateral orientation
PATO:0002524.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed mesiolaterally.

PATO:0002525.name: separating
PATO:0002525.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being in a position that produces a separation in, or acting to separate, another entity.

PATO:0002526.name: anterodistal orientation
PATO:0002526.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anterodistally.

PATO:0002527.name: posterodistal orientation
PATO:0002527.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posterodistally.

PATO:0002533.name: bipartite
PATO:0002533.def: A multipartite quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being divided into two parts.

PATO:0002534.name: plowshare shaped
PATO:0002534.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a plowshare.

PATO:0002535.name: peg-like
PATO:0002535.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a short and stout cylindrical shape.

PATO:0002536.name: boomerang shaped
PATO:0002536.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape like a boomerang, with two arms connected at an angle.

PATO:0002537.name: subovoid
PATO:0002537.def: A spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a shape not quite ovoid. approximately ovoid.

PATO:0002538.name: concavo-convex
PATO:0002538.def: A shape quality that obtains by virtue of the bearer being concave on one side and convex on the other.

PATO:0002539.name: ring shaped
PATO:0002539.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape like a ring (a circular shape enclosing a space).

PATO:0002540.name: spur shaped
PATO:0002540.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing a small, spike-like shape.

PATO:0002541.name: homeostatic
PATO:0002541.def: Pertaining to the ability or tendency of an organism or cell to maintain internal equilibrium by adjusting its physiological processes.

PATO:0002628.name: borderline intensity
PATO:0002628.def: An intensity which is borderline in it its effect or force as compared to baseline or normal.

PATO:0002629.name: profound intensity
PATO:0002629.def: An intensity which is characterized by being very severe.

PATO:0002630.name: episodic
PATO:0002630.def: An occurrence quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a course that occurs occasionally.

PATO:0002631.name: refractory
PATO:0002631.def: An occurrence of a process during which time there is an inability to change the course, extent, or repetition of the process.

PATO:0002632.name: secondary
PATO:0002632.def: A quality in which the effect or outcome is not primary or the focus of the observation.

PATO:0005000.name: hemispheroid
PATO:0005000.def: A 3-D shape that is half of a sphere.

PATO:0005001.name: variability of count
PATO:0005001.def: A variability quality inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer having a variable number or count of an entity.

PATO:0005002.name: pear shaped
PATO:0005002.def: Having the shape of a pear; tapering near the top and bulging toward the base or bottom. From thefreedictionary.com

PATO:0005003.name: paddle shaped
PATO:0005003.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling the form of a paddle.

PATO:0005004.name: subelliptical
PATO:0005004.def: A shape that is almost an ellipse.

PATO:0005005.name: radiating
PATO:0005005.def: Shape quality inhering in a bearer expanding outward, or having parts expanding outward, from a center point.

PATO:0005006.name: differentiated from
PATO:0005006.def: A morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being morphologically distinguishable from another entity.

PATO:0005007.name: hypsodont
PATO:0005007.def: A 3-D shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having dentition characterized by high-crowned teeth and enamel which extends far past the gum line, which provides extra material for wear and tear.

PATO:0005008.name: brachydont
PATO:0005008.def: A 3-D shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having dentition characterized by low-crowned teeth. Human teeth are brachydont.

PATO:0005009.name: molariform
PATO:0005009.def: A 3-D shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an entity in the form of a molar tooth.

PATO:0005010.name: plumose
PATO:0005010.def: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having many fine filaments or branches that give a feathery appearance: for example, resembling a feather.

PATO:0005011.name: continuous with
PATO:0005011.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer possessing an uninterrupted or unbroken connection or spatial distribution relative to the position of another entity.

PATO:0005012.name: complete structure
PATO:0005012.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being fully formed compared to entities lacking parts.

PATO:0005013.name: incomplete structure
PATO:0005013.def: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking parts or having a reduced form compared to fully formed entities.

PATO:0005014.name: subspherical
PATO:0005014.def: A spheroid shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being nearly, but not perfectly, spherical.

PATO:0005015.name: tapered size
PATO:0005015.def: A size quality inhering in an entity or set of entities in which size increases or decreases along the extent of the entity or set.

PATO:0005016.name: surrounded by
PATO:0005016.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being enclosed on all sides by another entity.

PATO:0005017.name: labiolingually compressed
PATO:0005017.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being compressed from the side facing the lips to the side facing the tongue.

PATO:0005018.name: mesiodistally compressed
PATO:0005018.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being compressed from the side facing the midline of the jaw to the side opposite the midline.

PATO:0005019.name: curved lingually
PATO:0005019.def: A curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the tongue.

PATO:0005020.name: irregularly shaped
PATO:0005020.def: A shape quality inhering on a bearer by virtue of a bearer's shape lacking in pattern or uniformity; for example, it may have sides of different lengths, different curvatures, or unequal angles.

PATO:0005021.name: unicuspidate
PATO:0005021.def: Cuspidate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing a single cusp.

PATO:0005022.name: uniform diameter
PATO:0005022.def: A diameter that remains constant throughout the extent of an entity.

PATO:0005023.name: parasagittal orientation
PATO:0005023.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is in the parasagittal plane.

PATO:0005024.name: longitudinal orientation
PATO:0005024.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed along the longitudinal or anterior-posterior axis.

PATO:0010000.name: maximally connected
PATO:0010000.def: A structural quality inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer consisting of a single, maximally connected structure.

PATO:0010002.name: propagation velocity
PATO:0010002.def: The velocity of spatial propagation of a process. Examples include the velocity of propagation of an action potential along an axon.

PATO:0010003.name: increased propagation velocity
PATO:0010003.def: A propagation velocity that is higher than normal.

PATO:0010004.name: decreased propagation velocity
PATO:0010004.def: A propagation velocity that is lower than normal.

PATO:0010005.name: spatial distribution of a process
PATO:0010005.def: A physical quality of a process that is its spatial distribution. For example, bone mineralization follows stereotypical spatial distribution patterns during development, which may be altered in some phenotypes.

PATO:0010008.name: monociliated
PATO:0010008.def: A cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having only one cilium.

PATO:0015001.name: absence due to degeneration
PATO:0015001.def: Absence due to a degenerative process.

PATO:0015002.name: process efficacy
PATO:0015002.def: The ability of a process to produce its output.

PATO:0015003.name: decreased efficacy
PATO:0015003.def: A decrease in the ability of a process to produce its output.

PATO:0015004.name: increased efficacy
PATO:0015004.def: A increase in the ability of a process to produce its output.

PATO:0015007.name: prominence
PATO:0015007.def: A quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the degree to which the bearers stands out or projects beyond a surface or line.

PATO:0015009.name: humidity
PATO:0015009.def: A quality inhering in air by virtue of the partial pressure exerted by the bearer's water vapour content.

PATO:0015012.name: quality of a plasma
PATO:0015012.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting the physical characteristics of an entity consisting of roughly equal proportions of positively and negatively charged particles, having neither a defined volume nor defined shape, having internal magnetic fields, and being electrically conductive.

PATO:0015013.name: degree of illumination
PATO:0015013.def: The degree to which the bearer is exposed to visible light.

PATO:0015016.name: stepped
PATO:0015016.def: Having a shape or form that resembles a step of a stairway (e.g., a ledge or offset margin).

PATO:0015017.name: quality of a colloid
PATO:0015017.def: A physical quality inhering in an entity by virtue of a portion of the bearer's molecular or polymolecular constituents present in one phase being dispersed in a portion of the bearer's constituents present in another phase.

PATO:0015018.name: quality of an aerosol
PATO:0015018.def: A physical quality inhering in an entity by virtue of the bearer's solid or liquid constituents being suspended in a gas.

PATO:0015019.name: C-shaped
PATO:0015019.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter C.

PATO:0015020.name: J-shaped
PATO:0015020.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter J.

PATO:0015021.name: combustibility
PATO:0015021.def: The propensity of a material to undergo combustion. Combustion encompasses smouldering and flaming combustion. Combustibility is usually applied to solids.

PATO:0015026.name: stability
PATO:0015026.def: quality, state, or degree of being stable.

PATO:0015029.name: quality of a suspension
PATO:0015029.def: A physical quality inhering in an entity by virtue of the bearer's solid or liquid constituents being transiently dispersed in a solid, liquid, or gas before settling due to gravity or centrifugal forces.

PATO:0015030.name: plume-shaped
PATO:0015030.def: A shape that ineres in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's mass being distributed in a feather-like fashion.

PATO:0015031.name: contamination
PATO:0015031.def: The presence of a constituent, impurity, or some other undesirable element that spoils, corrupts, infects, makes unfit, or makes inferior a material, physical body, natural environment, place of human occupancy, or other material entity.

PATO:0020000.name: genotypic sex
PATO:0020000.def: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual based upon genotypic composition of sex chromosomes.

PATO:0020001.name: male genotypic sex
PATO:0020001.def: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual based upon genotypic composition that confers the capability for an organism to differentiate male gonads.

PATO:0020002.name: female genotypic sex
PATO:0020002.def: A biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population based upon genotypic composition that confers the capability for an organism to differentiate female gonads.

PATO:0025000.name: potability
PATO:0025000.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being fit to be used as a safe means of hydration.

PATO:0025001.name: non-potable
PATO:0025001.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer not being suitable for use as a safe means of hydration.

PATO:0025002.name: potable
PATO:0025002.def: A physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being suitable for use as a safe means of hydration.

PATO:0030000.name: anteriorized
PATO:0030000.def: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally anterior structures and missing some or all of what are normally posterior structures.

PATO:0030001.name: dorsalized
PATO:0030001.def: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally dorsal structures and missing some or all of what are normally ventral structures.

PATO:0030002.name: posteriorized
PATO:0030002.def: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally posterior structures and missing some or all of what are normally anterior structures.

PATO:0030003.name: ventralized
PATO:0030003.def: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally ventral structures and missing some or all of what are normally dorsal structures.

PATO:0030004.name: partially anteriorized
PATO:0030004.def: An anteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally anterior structures and missing some but not all of what are normally posterior structures.

PATO:0030005.name: partially dorsalized
PATO:0030005.def: A dorsalized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally dorsal structures and missing some but not all of what are normally ventral structures.

PATO:0030006.name: partially posteriorized
PATO:0030006.def: A posteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally posterior structures and missing some but not all of what are normally anterior structures.

PATO:0030007.name: partially ventralized
PATO:0030007.def: A ventralized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally ventral structures and missing some but not all of what are normally dorsal structures.

PATO:0030008.name: dorso-anteriorized
PATO:0030008.def: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally dorso-anterior structures and missing some or all of what are normally ventro-posterior structures.

PATO:0030009.name: partially dorso-anteriorized
PATO:0030009.def: A dorso-anteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally dorso-anterior structures and missing some but not all of what are normally ventro-posterior structures.

PATO:0030010.name: wholly dorso-anteriorized
PATO:0030010.def: A dorso-anteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing only what are normally dorso-anterior structures.

PATO:0030011.name: ventro-posteriorized
PATO:0030011.def: A malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally ventro-posterior structures and missing some or all of what are normally dorso-anterior structures.

PATO:0030012.name: partially ventro-posteriorized
PATO:0030012.def: A ventro-posteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing what are normally ventro-posterior structures and missing some but not all of what are normally dorso-anterior structures.

PATO:0030013.name: wholly ventro-posteriorized
PATO:0030013.def: A ventro-posteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing only what are normally ventro-posterior structures.

PATO:0040000.name: heterotaxic
PATO:0040000.def: An oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abnormally placed or arranged.

PATO:0040002.name: position originates from
PATO:0040002.def: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of some aspect of that bearer beginning from a position on another entity.

PATO:0040003.name: pathogenicity
PATO:0040003.def: The ability of a pathogen to produce an infectious disease or disorder in an another organism.

PATO:0040004.name: plush
PATO:0040004.def: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered or partially covered with hair that has increased thickness and softness.

PATO:0040005.name: posteroventral orientation
PATO:0040005.def: An orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posteroventrally.

PATO:0040006.name: crown like
PATO:0040006.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape like a crown.

PATO:0040007.name: shell shaped
PATO:0040007.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape like a shell.

PATO:0040008.name: fringed
PATO:0040008.def: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an ornamental border consisting of short straight or twisted threads or strips hanging from cut or raveled edges or from a separate band.

PATO:0040009.name: bowl shaped
PATO:0040009.def: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of a bowl.

PATO:0040010.name: mobile relative to
PATO:0040010.def: Mobility relative to a second entity.

PATO:0040011.name: immobile relative to
PATO:0040011.def: Immobility relative to a second entity.
